translations.translation: ba'alaahe seme 'ejege bathaame ruxeruhe bathaame 'azaanye bakxonawe
mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegabaawe ya`aalamaate geetaa lakxonawe;
'ejege bathaame rexeruhe bathaame 'azaanye
yaferedu qane baalabeete lakxonawe
'anetane becaa 'enegegazaalane; 'anetaneme becaa 'eredaataane 'enelamenaalane
qathetanyaawene manegade meraane
ya'enaziyaane banaresu laaye bago yawaalekelaacawene banasu laaye yaaletaqothaahebaacawenenaa yaaletasaasaatuteneme sawoce manegade (meraane; balu)
'a.la.ma
yehe matsehhafe (ka'alaahe lamakxonu) therethere yalabateme; lafaraaheyaane mari nawe
lanaziyaa baruqu nagare yamiyaamenu solaateneme danebune thabeqawe yamisagedu kasathanaacaweme sisaaye yamicaru lakxonute;
la'enaziyaame wada 'aneta batawaradawenaa ka'aneta bafiteme batawaradawe yamiyaamenu bamacharashaayetume (`aalame) 'enaresu yamiyaaragaagethu lakxonute (mari nawe)
'enaziyaa kageetaacawe bamamaraate laaye naacawe; 'enaziyaame 'enasu felaagotaacawene yaaganyu naacawe
'enaziyaa yakaadute (sawoce) betaasefaraaraacaweme baataasefaraaraacaweme banaresu laaye 'ekule nawe; 'ayaamenume
'alaahe balebocaacawe laaye bamasemiyaacaweme laaye 'atemobaacawaale; ba`aayenocaacaweme laaye mashafanyaa 'alela; lanasume taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacawe
kasawoceme <<ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane 'amenanaale>> yamilu 'alelu; 'enaresume 'amaanyoce 'ayedalume
'alaahenenaa 'enaziyaane yaamanutene (sawoce) yaataalelaalu; yamaayaawequ sikxonu nafesocaacawene 'eneje leelaane 'ayaataalelume
balebocaacawe wesethe (yanefeqenaa) bashetaa 'alabaacawe 'alaaheme bashetaane chamarabaacawe lanaresume yewaashu banabarute mekeneyaate 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
lanaresume <<bamedere laaye 'ataabalaashu>> batabaalu gizee <<'enyaa 'asaamaariwoce becaa nane>> yelaalu
nequ 'enaresu 'athefiwocu 'enasuwe naacawe; gene 'ayaawequme
lanasume <<sawocu 'enedaamanu 'emanu>> batabaalu gizee <<qilocu 'enedaamanu 'enaamenaalane?>> yelaalu 'awaaje nequ 'enaresu qilocu 'enaresuwe naacawe; gene 'ayaawequme
'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene bataganaanyu gizee <<'amenanaale>> yelaalu wada sayethaanocaacaweme baagalalu gizee <<'enyaa kanaaneta gaare nane; 'enyaa (banasu) tasaalaaqiwoce becaa nane>> yelaalu
'alaahe banasu yesaalaqebaacawaale; bathemataacaweme wesethe yamiwaalelu sikxonu yaazagayaacawaale
'enazihe 'enaziyaa sehetatene baqenenate yagazu naacawe negedaacaweme 'alaatarafaceme; qathetanyoceme 'alekxonume

(banefeqenaa) mesaaleeyaacawe 'enedaziyaa 'esaatene 'enedaanadada sawe bazuriyaawe yaalawene hulu baabaraace gizeeme 'alaahe berehaanaacawene 'enedawasadabaacawe bachalamaawoceme wesethe yamaayaayu kxonawe 'enedatawaacawe (sawoce) bethee nawe
('enasu) daneqorowoce, didaawoce, `eweroce naacawe; selazihe 'enaresu 'ayemalasume

wayeme (mesaaleeyaacawe) kasamaaye 'eneda warada zenaame (baalabeetoce) nawe; baresu (badamanaawe) wesethe chalamaawoce, nagodegwaademe, belechetaame yaalubate sikxone kamaberaqocu motene lamaferaate thaatocaacawene bajorocaacawe wesethe 'enedamiyaadaregu bethee nawe 'alaaheme kahhaadiwocene kabaabi nawe

belechetaawe `aayenocaacawene linatheqe yeqarebaale lanaresu baabaraalaacawe quthere baresu wesethe yekxeedaalu banasume laaye baachalama gizee yeqomaalu 'alaaheme bashaa noro masemiyaacawenenaa maayaawocaacawene bawasada nabare; 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yafatharaacehune 'enaziyaaneme kanaaneta bafite yanabarutene (yafatharawene) geetaacehune tagazu; (qethaatene) letethanaqaqu yekajalaalenaa

('eresu) yaa lanaaneta mederene menethaafe samaayeneme thaaraa yaadaraga nawe; kasamaayeme (kadamanaa) wehaane yaawarada baresume kafereewoce lanaaneta sisaayene yaawathaa nawe 'enaanetame (fathaarinatune) yametaawequ setekxonu la'alaahe baalaanethaawocene 'ataaderegu
babaariyaaceneme laaye kaawaradenawe bamatharaathare wesethe betekxonu kabetheewe 'aneditene me`eraafe 'amethu 'ewenatanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu ka'alaahe leelaa masekaariwocaacehune theru
(yehenene) baateszaru fatsemome 'ateszarutemenaa yaacene maqathaathayaawaa sawocenaa denegaayoce yakxonacewene 'esaate tathabaqu; lakahhaadiwoce tadagesaalace

'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamoceneme yaszarutene lanaresu kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe ganatoce yaalwacawe makxonune 'abeseraacawe kareswa kaferee (`aayenate) sisaayene batamagabu quthere (fereewocewaa selamimasaasalu) <<yehe yaa ka'ahune bafite yatagamabenawe nawe>> yelaalu 'eresuneme tamasaasaaye kxono tasathute lanasume bawesethwa netsuhe yatadaragu misetoce 'alwacawe 'enasume bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe

'alaahe maanenyaaweneme nagare tenenyeneme kxona (bateneshenate wayeme bateleqenate) kabalaayewaa yakxonaneme mesaalee lamaaderage 'ayaafereme 'enaziyaa yaamanutemaa; 'eresu (mesaaleewe) kageetaacawe (yataganya) 'ewenate makxonune yaaweqaalu 'enaziyaame yakaadutemaa <<'alaahe bazihe menene mesaalee shaa>> yelaalu baresu (bamesaaleewe) bezuwocene yaasaasetaale baresume bezuwocene yaaqanaale baresume 'amatzanyocene 'eneje leelaane 'ayaasaaseteme

'enaziyaa ya'alaahene qaale kidaane ka'athabaqabaacawe baxwaalaa yamiyaafaresu 'enediqathaleme baresu yaazazawene nagare yamiqorethu bamedereme laaye yamiyaabalaashu 'enaziyaa 'enaresu kasaariwocu naacawe

mutaane yanabaraacehu setekxonu hheyaawe yaadaragaacehu kaziyaame yamigadelaacehu kaziyaame hheyaawe yamiyaadaregaacehu sikxone kaziyaame wadaresu yametemalasu setekxonu ba'alaahe 'enedeete tekedaalacehu!
'eresu yaa bamedere yaalawene hulu la'enaaneta yafathara nawe kaziyaame wada samaaye 'asaba; sabaate samaayaateme 'adaragaacawe 'eresume banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe

(muhhamade hoye) geetaahe lamalaa'ekete - <<'enee bamedere laaye metekene 'aderaagi nanye;>> baala gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawese; 'enaresume) <<'enyaa kamaamasegane gaare yamenaatharaahe laanetame yameneqadese senekxone bareswa wesethe yamiyaathafaanenaa damoceneme yamiyaafasene taadaregaalahene?>> 'alu ('alaahe) <<'enee yamaataawequtene nagare 'aweqaalahu>> 'alaacawe
'adameneme semocene hulwaneme 'asetamaarawe kaziyaame bamalaa'ekete laaye (tathariwocune) 'aqarabaacawe <<'ewenatanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu yanazihene (tathariwoce) semoce negarunye>> 'alaacawe
<<theraate yegabaahe; ka'asetamaarekane nagare basetaqare lanyaa `eweqate yalaneme 'aneta `awaaqiwe thebabanyaawe 'aneta becaa nahenaa>> ('alu)

-<<'adame hoye semocaacawene negaraacawe>> 'alawe semocaacawene banagaraacaweme gizee <<'enee yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene ruqe mesethire `aweqaalahu; yametegaletsutenenaa yaaneneme tedabequte yanabaraacehutene `aweqaalahu 'alaalekwaacehumene?>> 'alaacawe
lamalaa'eketeme <<la'adame segadu>> baalene gizee ('asetaawese) hulume wadiyaawenu sagadu; belise (diyaabelose) becaa siqare 'emebi 'ala; koraame kakahhaadiwocume kxona
<<'adame hoye! 'aneta kanamisetehe baganate taqamathe; kareswame bafalagaacehute seferaa basafiwe tamagabu; gene yehecene zaafe 'ateqerabu; kabadalanyoce tekxonaalaacehunaa>> 'aleneme

kareswame sayethaane 'adaalathaacawe bawesethume kanabarubate (delote) 'awathaacawe <<kafilaacehume lakafilu thalaate sikxone weradu; lanaanetame bamedere laaye 'eseka gizee (motaacehu) derase maregiyaanaa mathaaqamiyaa 'alaacehu>> 'alenaacawe
'adameme kageetaawe qaalaatene taqabala baresu laayeme (geetaawe tsatsatene bamaqabale) tamalasalate; 'enaho 'eresu tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye nawenaa
<<hulaacehume kxonaacehu kareswa weradu kaneeme yakxona mamariyaa bimathaalaacehu wadiyaawenu mamariyaayeene yatakatala sawe banasu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayaazenume>> 'alenaacawe
'enaziyaame (bamaleketanyocaacene) yakaadu ba'aneqatsocaaceneme yaasetabaabalu 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe
ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! yaacene banaaneta laaye yalagasekwaatene tsagaayeene 'asetaawesu baqaale kidaaneeme mulu; baqaale kidaanaacehu 'emolaalahunaa; 'eneeneme becaa feru

kanaaneta gaare yaalawene (matsehhafe) yamiyaaragaagethe hono baawaradekuteme (qure'aane) 'emanu baresume yamajamariyaa kahhaadi 'atehunu ba'aneqatsoceeme theqitene waagaa 'atelawethu 'eneeneme becaa tathaneqaqu
'ewenatuneme baweshate 'ateqalaaqelu 'enaanetame yametaawequ setehonu 'ewenatene 'atedabequ
solaateneme danebune thabeqaacehu segadu zakaaneme (gedeetaa metsewaatene) sethu (lageetaacehu) ka'agonebaashoce gaareme 'agonebesu
'enaaneta matsehhafune yametaanabu honaacehu sawocene babago szeraa taazaalaacehune? nafesocaacehuneme terasaalaacehune? (yaszeraacehune mathefonate) 'ataawequmene?
bamataagasenaa basolaateme taradu 'ereswame (solaate) bafariwoce laaye 'eneje baleelaawe laaye ba'eregethe kabaade naate
'enaziyaa 'enaresu geetaacawene yamiganaanyu 'enasume wada'eresu tamalaashoce makxonaacawene yamiyaaragaagethu bakxonute (laaye 'eneje kabaade naate)

ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! yaacene banaaneta laaye yalagasekwaatene tsagaayeenenaa 'eneeme ba`aalamaate laaye yaabalathekwaacehu ('abaatocaacehune bagizeeyaacawe kanabarute `aalamaate yaabalathekuwaacawe) makxoneene 'asetaawesu

(maanenyaawaa) nafeseme ka(leelaawaa) nafese meneneme yamaatemanadaabatene, kareswame melejaane yamaayeqabalubaatene, kareswame beezaa yamaayeyaazebatene, 'enaresume yamaayeradubatene qane tathaneqaqu

kafare`oneme beetasaboce (kagosocunaa kasaraawitu) beretune qethaate yamiyaaqamesuwaacehu wanedoce lejocaacehune yamiyaaredu seetocaacehuneme yamitawe sikxonu baadaanenaacehu gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawesu) bazihaacehume kageetaacehu taalaaqe fatanaa 'alabate
banaanetame mekeneyaate baahherune bakafalene gizee ('asetaawesu) wadiyaaweme 'adaanenaacehu yafare`oneneme beetasaboce 'enaaneta yametemalakatu kxonaacehu 'asathamenaacawe
musaaneme 'arebaane leelite baqatharenawe gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawesu) kaziyaame karesu (makxeede) baxwaalaa 'enaaneta badaayoce setekxonu wayefanene ('amelaake 'aderegaacehu) yaazaacehu
kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa 'enaaneta taamasagenu zanede kanaaneta mehherate 'adaragene
musaaneme matsehhafenenaa ('ewenatenaa weshatene) malayaaneme temaru zanede basathanawe gizee ('asetaawesu)

musaame lahhezebocu - <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enaaneta wayefanene ('amelaake 'aderegaacehu) bamayaazaacehu nafesocaacehune badalaacehu wada fathaariyaacehume tamalasu; nafesocaacehuneme gedalu; yehaacehu bafathaariyaacehu zanede lanaaneta balaache nawe>> baala gizee ('asetaawese) ba'enaanetame laaye tsatsatene bamaqabale tamalasalaacehu 'enaho 'eresu tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye nawenaa
<<musaa hoye! 'alaahene bageletse 'esekamenaaye derase laaneta bafetsume 'anaameneleheme>> balaacehume gizee ('asetaawesu) 'enaanetame 'eyatamalakataacehu maberaqe yaazacaacehu
kaziyaame taamasagenu zanede kamotaacehu baxwaalaa 'asenasaanaacehu

banaanetame laaye damanaane 'athalalene banaatame laaye ('eneda nache maare yaala) manenaane 'enaa derechetene 'awaradene kasathanaacehume thaafaachoce <<belu ('alene) >> 'alebadalunememe gene nafesocaacawene yebadelu nabare

<<yeheceneme katamaa gebu kareswame bashaacehute seferaa safine (megebe) tamagabu baruneme yaagonabasaacehu kxonaacehu gebu; (theyaaqeeyaacene yaxaathi'ataacene maregafe nawe) balume xaathi'atocaacehune lanaaneta 'enemeraalanenaa bago szariwoceneme (menedaane) 'enechamerelaacawaalane>> baalene gizee ('asetaawesu)
'enaziyaame yabadalute sawoce kaziyaa lanasu katabaalute leelaa qaalene lawathu banaziyaame babadalute laaye yaamatsu bamahonaacawe mekeneyaate maqeszafetene 'awaradenebaacawe

musaame lahhezebocu mathathene bafalaga gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawesu) <<denegaayuneme babaterehe metaa>> 'alenawe (mataaweme) karesume `aszeraahulate menechoce falaqu sawocu hulu mathachaacawene ba'eregethe `awaqu <<ka'alaahe sisaaye belu; thathume; 'amathanyoceme kxonaacehu bamedere laaye 'ataabalaashu>> ('alenaacawe)

musaa hoye - <<ba'anede (`aayenate) megebe laaye bafetsume 'anetaagaszeme; selazihe geetaahene kaziyaa medere kametaabaqelawe hulu kaqethalaaqethale kadubaawaame kasenedeewaame kameserewaame kashenekuretwame lanyaa yaawathaa zanede lanyaa lamenelene>> baalaacehume gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawesu musaame - <<yaanene 'eresu zeqetanyaa yakxonawene baziyaa 'eresu balaache bakxonawe nagare lawethene tefalegaalaacehune? wada katamaa weradu; lanaanetame yathayaqaacehute nagare 'alaacehu>> 'alaacawe banaresume laaye weredatenaa dekxenate tamataabaacawe ka'alaaheme bakxona quthaa tamalasu yehe 'enaresu ba'alaahe taameraatoce yekedunaa nabiyaateneme yaala hhege yegadelu selanabaru nawe yehe bamaamatsaacawenaa wasane yamiyaalefu bamakxonaacawe nawe

'enaziyaa yaamanu 'enaziyaame yehudaaweyaane yakxonu, keresetiyaanoceme, saabiyaanoceme (ka'enaresu) ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yaamana malekaameneme szeraa yaszaraa lanaresu bageetaacawe zanede menedaacawe 'alaacawe banaresume laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayaazenume

kabalaayaacehume yathurene taraaraa yaanasaane kxonane yathabaqa qaalekidaanaacehune bayaazene gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawesu) <<yaanene yasathanaacehune baxayele yaazu; bawesethu yaalaweneme nagare (ka'esaate) tethabaqu zanede 'asetaawesu>> ('alene)
kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa (kidaanune) tawaacehu banaanetame laaye ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baalenabara noro ba'eregethe kathafiwocu bakxonaacehu nabare
'enaziyaaneme ka'enaaneta wesethe baqedaamee qane (`aszaane bamaathemade) wasane yaalafutenenaa lanasu <<waraadaawoce setekxonu zenejarowoce kxunu>> yaalenaacawene ba'eregethe `awaqaacehu
(qethaatituneme) lanaziyaa basetafitewaa lanabarutenaa lanaziyaame kabaxwaalaawaa laalute (hhezeboce) maqathaachaa lafaraaheyaaneme magasachaa 'adaragenaate

musaame lahhezebocu - <<'alaahe laamene 'enedetaaredu yaazaacexwaale>> baala gizee ('asetaawasu) <<masaalaqiyaa 'aderegahe teyezanaalahene?>> 'alute <<katasaalaaqiwoce kamakxone ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu>> 'alaacawe

<<lanyaa geetaahene thayeqelene; 'ereswa mene 'enedakxonace (`edemeewaane) yaaberaaraalene>> 'alu <<'eresu 'ereswa yaalaarajace thejaame yaalekxonace bazihe makaakale lekanyaa yakxonace gidare naate yelaacexwaale; yataazazaacehuteneme szeru>> 'alaacawe
<<lanyaa geetaahene thayeqelene; malekwaa mene 'enedakxona lanyaa yegelatselene>> 'alu <<'eresu 'ereswa malekwaa damaaqe tamalekaacocene yametaasedasete daalacaa laame naate yelaacexwaale>> 'alaacawe
<<lanyaa geetaahene thayeqelene; 'ereswa mene 'enedakxonace yegelatselene; kabetoce banyaa laaye tamasaasalubene 'enyaame 'alaahe yashaa 'enedakxona ba'eregethe tamariwoce nane>> 'alu

<<'eresu 'ereswa yaaletagaraace mederene (bamaarase) yamaataasenasaa 'ereshaaneme yamaataathathaa (kanawere) yatathabaqace leyu melekete yaleelabaate naate yelaacexwaale>> 'alaacawe <<'ahune batekekele mathaahe>> 'alu; liszaru yaaletaqaarabume sikxonu 'aradwate
nafesename bagadalaacehunaa bareswame (gadaaye) batakaraakaraacehu gizee ('asetaawesu) 'alaaheme tedabequte yanabaraacehutene hulu galaache nawe
<<(badenune) bakafilwame metute>> 'alene; 'enedazihu 'alaahe mutaanene yaasenasaale; taawequme zanede taameraatocene yaasaayaacexwaale

kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa lebocaacehu daraqu; 'ereswame 'eneda denegaayoce wayeme badereqenaa yebalethe yabarataace naate kadenegaayoceme karesu jiratoce yamifasulate 'alela kanaresume ba'eregethe yamisanathaqenaa karesu wehaa (meneche) yamiwathaawe 'alela kanaresume 'alaahene kamaferaate yatanasaa wada taace yamiwarede 'alela 'alaaheme kameteszarute nagare zanegi 'ayedalame
('ayehudoce) kanasu yakxonu cheferoce ya'alaahene qaale yamisamunaa kaziyaame kataradute baxwaalaa 'enaresu 'eyaawaqu yamilawethute sikxonu lanaaneta maamanaacawene tekajelaalaacehune?

'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene baaganyu gizee <<'amenanaale>> yelaalu kafilaacaweme wada kafilu baagalala <<gizee 'alaahe banaaneta laaye bagalatsalaacahu nagare 'egeetaacehu zanede baresu 'enedikaraakaruwaacehu tenageruwaacawaalaacehune? 'ataawequmene?>> yelaalu
'alaahe yamidabequtenenaa yamigaletsutene yamiyaaweqe makxonune 'ayaawequmene?
kanasume matsehhafune yamaayaawequ mahaayemaanaane 'alu gene kanetu menyotocene (yemanyaalu); 'enaresume yamitharaatharu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume

lanaziyaame matsehhafune ba'ejocaacawe lamitsefunaa kaziyaame baresu theqitene waagaa ligazubate <<yehe ka'alaahe zanede nawe>> lamilu wayolaacawe lanaresume kaziyaa 'ejocaacawe katsaafute wayolaacawe lanasume kaziyaa kamiyaafarute (xaathi'aate) wayolaacawe

<<'esaateme yataqotharune qanoce 'eneji 'atenakaaneme>> 'alu <<'alaahe zanede qaale kidaane yezaacexwaalene? (yehe kakxona) 'alaaheme kidaanune 'ayaafareseme; ba'ewenatu ba'alaahe laaye yamaataawequtene tenaagaraalaacehu>> balaacawe
'ayedalame (tenakaacexwaalace); mathefone (kehhedatene) yaszaraa baresume xaatha'aatu yakababacewe sawe 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe
'enaziyaame yaamanute bago szeraawoceneme yaszarute 'enaziyaa yaganate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zalaalame zawetaariwoce naacawe

ya'eseraa'eele lejoceneme thebeqe kidaane 'alaahene 'eneji leelaane 'ataameleku; bawalaajoceme bagone szeraa ('aderegu); bazemedenaa baalabeetoceme, bayatimoceme ('abaate yaleelaacawe lejoce) bamesekinoceme (bago waalu); lasawoceme malekaamene tanaagaru; solaateneme danebune thabeqaacehu segadu; zakaaneme sethu bamaalate bayaazenebaacawe gizee ('asetaawesu) kaziyaame kanaaneta theqitoce siqaru shashaacehu 'enaanetame (kidaanene) yametetawu naacehu

damocaacehune 'ataafesesu nafesocaacehuneme (kafilaacehune) ka'agarocaacehu 'ataawethu yamenele senekxone yathabaqa qaale kidaanaacehune bayaazenebaacehu gizee ('asetaawesu) kaziyaame (bakidaanu) 'aragaagathaacehu; 'enaanetame temasakeraalaacehu

kaziyaame 'enaaneta 'enaziyaa nafesocaacehune yametegadelu kanaanetame yakxonu cheferocene baxaathi'atenaa bamabadale banaresu laaye yameteradaadu setekxonu ka'agarocaacawe yametaawathu merekonyoceme kxonawe bimathuwaacehu yametebazhu naacehu 'eresu (nagaru) 'enaresune maawethaate ba'enaaneta laaye yatakalakala nawe bamatsehhafu kafile taamenaalaacehune? bakafilume tekedaalaacehune? ka'enaanetame yehenene yamiszaraa sawe qethaate baqerebitu hheyewate weredate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame bateneszaa'ee qaneme wada beretu qethaate yemalasaalu 'alaaheme kameteszarute szeraa hulu zanegi 'ayedalame
'enazihe 'enaziyaa qerebitune hheyewate bamacharashaayetu 'agare yagazu naacawe kanasume qethaatu 'ayeqalelaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayereradume

musaaneme matsehhafene ba'eregethe sathanawe kabaxwaalaaweme maleketenyocene 'asekataatalene yamareyamene leje `isaaneme geletse taameraatocene sathanawe baqedusu manefaseme 'abarataanawe nafesocaacehu bamaatewadawe nagare maleketanyaa bamathaalaacehu quthere (kamakatale) tekoraalaacehune? kafilune 'asetabaabalaacehu; kafiluneme tegadelaalaacehu
<<lebocaaceneme shefenoce naacawe>> 'alu; 'ayedalame 'alaahe bakehhedataacawe mekeneyaate ragamaacawe theqiteneme becaa yaamenaalu

kanasume gaare yaalawene (matsehhafe) 'aragaagaache yakxona matsehhafe ka'alaahe zanede bamathaalaacawe gizee (kamamethaatu) bafite banaziyaa bakaadute laaye yeradubate yanabaru sikxonu yaawaqute nagare bamathaalaacawe gizee baresu kaadu ya'alaaheme regemaane bakahhaadiwoce laaye yekxune

nafesocaacawene baresu yashathubate nagare kafaa! ('eresume) 'alaahe kabaarocu bamishaawe sawe laaye kacerotaawe (raa'eyene) maaweradune bamamaqenyate 'alaahe baawaradawe nagare makaadaacawe nawe baquthaa laayeme quthaa (yataragaagathabaacawe sikxonu) tamalasu lakahhaadiwoceme 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alaacawe

'alaaheme baawaradawe (hulu) la'enaresu <<'emanu>> batabaalu gizee <<banyaa laaye batawaradawe (matsehhafe becaa) 'enaamenaalane>> yelaalu karesu xwaalaa baalawe (qure'ane) 'eresu kanasu gaare laalawe (matsehhafe) 'aragaagaache 'ewetanyaa sikxone yekedaalu <<'amaanyoce kakxonaacehu ka'ahune bafite ya'alaahene nabiyaate lamene gadalaacehu?>> balaacawe
musaame bataameraatoce ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu kaziyaame kabaxwaalaawe 'enaaneta badaayoce setekxonu wayefanene ('amelaake 'aderegaacehu) yaazaacehu

yathureneme gaaraa kabalaayaacehu yaanasaane senekxone (ba'orite hhege 'enedeteszaru) kidaanaacehune bayaazene gizee ('asetaawesu) <<yasathanaacehune baxayele yaazu; semume;>> ('alene) <<samaane 'amatseneme>> 'alu yawayefanuneme wedeetaa bakehhedataacawe mekeneyaate balebocaacawe wesethe tathathu <<'amaanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu 'emenataacehu baresu yamiyaazaacehu nagare kafaa!>> balaacawe
<<yamacharashaayetu 'agare (ganate) 'alaahe zanede kasawe hulu leelaa yatalayace setekxone la'enaaneta becaa 'enedakxonace 'ewenatanyoce kakxonaacehu motene tamanyu>> balaacawe
'ejocaacaweme baasaalafute (baszarute) mekeneyaate mene gizeeme fatsemo 'ayemanyuteme; 'alaaheme badaayocene `awaaqi nawe

kasawoceme hulu ka'enaziyaame (thaa`otene) ka'agaarute yebalethe bahheyewate laaye yamigwaagu kxonawe ba'eregethe taaganyaacawaalahe 'anedaacawe shihhe `aamate `edemee bisathe yewadaale 'eresume `edemee masathatu kaqethaate yamiyaareqawe 'ayedalame 'alaaheme yamiszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

lajiberile (lagabere'eele) thalaate yakxona sawe (baquchete yemute) balaacawe 'eresu (qure'aanune) kabafitu lanabarute (matsaahhefete) 'aragaagaache lame'emanaane marinaa beseraate sikxone ba'alaahe faqaade balebehe laaye 'aweredotaalenaa
la'alaahenaa lamalaa'eketu lamaleketanyocume lajiberileme lamikaaleme (mikaa'eele) thalaate yakxona sawe 'alaahe la('enazihe) kahhaadiwoce thalaate nawe
wadaanetame geletse yakxonutene 'aneqatsoce ba'eregethe 'aweredanaale bareswame 'amatsanyoce 'eneji leelaawe 'ayekedeme;
qaale kidaaneneme qaale bagabu quthere ka'enaresu kafilu yethelawaalene? (yaafaresawaalene?); yelequneme 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaamenume

'enaresu gaareme laalawe (matsehhafe) 'aragaagaache yakxona maleketanyaa ka'alaahe zanede bamathaalaacawe gizee kanaziyaa matsehhafene katasathute kafilu 'enaresu 'enedamaayaawequ kxonawe ya'alaahene matsehhafe kajarebaawocaacawe xwaalaa thaalu

sayethaanaateme basulayemaane (salomone) zamana manegesete yamiyaanabutene (degemete) takatalu sulayemaaneme 'alekaadame; (degemetanyaa 'alenabarame); gene sayethaanaate sawocene degemetene yamiyaasetameru sikxonu kaadu yaaneneme babaabile bahulatu malaa'ekete bahaarutenaa maarute laaye yatawaradawene nagare (yaasetameruwaacawaale) <<'enyaa mafatanyaa nanenaa 'atekaade>> 'esekamilume derase 'anedeneme 'ayaasetamerume ka'enasume basaweyawenaa bamisetu makaakale baresu yamilayubatene nagare yemaaraalu 'enaresume ba'alaahe faqaade kaalekxona baresu 'anedeneme gojiwoce 'ayedalume yamigodaacawenenaa yamaayethaqemaacaweneme yemaaraalu yagazaaweme sawe laresu bamacharashaayetu 'agare meneme 'edele yaleelawe makxonune ba'eregethe `awaqu nafesocaacaweneme baresu yashathubate waagaa kafaa! yamiyaawequ bakxonu noro (baaleszarute nabare)
'enaresume ('ayehudoce) baamanunaa batathanaqaqu noro (batamanadu nabare) yamiyaawequ bikxonu ka'alaahe zanede yakxonawe menedaa (nafesocaacawene kamishathubate) balaache nawe;
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! (lanabiyu) raa`inaa 'atebalu tamalakatene balume semume; lakahhaadiwoceme 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

'enaziyaa kamatsehhafu baalabeetocenaa ka'agaariwocume yakaadute banaaneta laaye kageetaacehu yakxona malekaame nagare mawaradune 'ayewadume 'alaaheme bacerotaawe (banabiyenate) yamishaawene yemarethaale 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe
ka'aneqatse benelawethe wayeme 'ereswane benaaserasaahe kareswa yamibalethene wayeme betheewaane 'enaamathaalane; 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye kahaali (caaye) makxonune 'ataaweqemene?
'alaahe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa laresu becaa makxonune 'ataaweqemene? la'enaanetame ka'alaahe leelaa zamadenaa radaate meneme yalaacehume
ba'ewenatu ka'ahune bafite musaa 'enedatathayaqa bethee maleketanyaacehune letethayequ tefalegaalaacehune? ba'emenateme kehedatene yamilawethe sawe tekekelanyaawene manegade ba'eregethe tasaasaata

kamatsehhafu baalabeetoce bezuwoce 'ewenatu katagalatsalaacawe baxwaalaa kanafesocaacawe bakxonawe meqanyenate ka'emenataacehu baxwaalaa kahhaadiwoce 'aderegawe limalesuwaacehu tamanyu 'alaaheme te`ezaazune 'esekamiyaamathaa derase yeqeretaa 'aderegu; 'elafwacaweme 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye kahaali nawenaa
solaateneme 'asetakaakelaacehu segadu zakaaneme sethu lanafesocaacehume kabago szeraa yametaaseqademutene 'alaahe zanede taaganyutaalaacehu 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawenaa

<<ganateneme 'ayehudene wayeme keresetiyaanocene yakxona sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayegabaateme>> 'alu yeheci (kanetu) menyotaacawe naate <<'ewenatanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu 'aserajaacehune 'amethu>> balaacawe
'ayedalame (leelaaweme yegabaataale) 'eresu bago szari kxono fitune la'alaahe yasatha sawe laresu bageetaawe zanede menedaawe 'alawe banasume laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayaazenume

'enaresu matsehhafune yamiyaanabu sikxonu 'ayehudoce - keresetiyaanoce bameneme laaye 'ayedalume 'alu keresetiyaanoceme - 'ayehudoce bameneme laaye 'ayedalume 'alu 'enedazihu 'enaziyaa yamaayaawequte ('agaariwoce) yanegegeraacawene bethee 'alu 'alaaheme baziyaa baresu yelayaayubate banabarute nagare bateneszaa'ee qane bamakaakalaacawe yefaredaale

ya'alaaheneme masegidoce bawesethaacawe semu 'enedaayewasaa kakalakalanaa 'ereswaneme bamaabalaashate karotha sawe yebalethe badaaye maanawe? 'enaziyaa fariwoce kxonawe 'eneji la'enaresu baqerebitu `aalame weredate 'alaacawe lanaresume bamacharashaayetu 'agare taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacawe
meszeraaqume me`eraabume ya'alaahe nawe (fitocaacehune) wada yateme betaazoru ya'alaahe fite 'eziyaa nawe 'alaahe cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawenaa
'alaaheme leje 'alawe 'alu (kamilute) theraate tagabaawe 'ayedalame basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu yaresu nawe hulume laresu taazaazhoce naacawe
samaayaatenenaa mederene yaalabethee fathaari nawe; nagareneme (maaseganyate) bashaa gizee laresu yamilawe - <<kxune nawe;>> wadiyaaweme yekxonaale

'enaziyaame yamaayaawequte ('aneta maleketanyaa selamakxonehe) 'alaahe 'ayaanaageraneme noro'alene? wayeme (la'ewenatanyaanatehe) taamere 'atemathaaleneme noro'alene? 'alu 'enedazihu 'enaziyaa kanasu bafite yanabarute 'eneda negegeraacawe bethee belawaale lebocaacawe (bakehhedate) tamasaasalu lamiyaaragaagethu hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene ba'eregethe 'aberaaretanaale
'enyaa 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari kxonahe bawenate laakenehe ka'esaateme gwaadoce 'atethayaqeme

'ayehudocenaa keresetiyaanoceme haayemaanotaacawene 'esekametekatale derase kaaneta fatsemo 'ayewadume <<ya'alaahe mameraate (tekekelanyaawe) mameraate 'eresu becaa nawe>> balaacawe kaziyaame 'eweqatu kamathaalehe baxwaalaa zenebaaleeyaacawene betekatale la'aneta ka'alaahe (yamikalakelelehe) zamadenaa radaate meneme yalaheme
'enaziyaa matsehhafune yasathanaacawe tagabi nebaabune yaanabutaale 'enaziyaa baresu yaamenaalu; baresume yamikedu 'enaziyaa 'enaresu kasaariwocu naacawe
ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! yaacene banaaneta laaye yalagasekwaatene tsagaayeenenaa 'eneeme ba`aalamaate laaye yaabalathekwaacehu makxoneene 'asetaawesu
('amaanye) nafeseme ka(kahhaadi) nafese meneneme yamaatethaqemebatene, kareswame beezaa yamaayewasadebatene, melejaame lareswa yamaatethaqemebatene, 'enaresume yamaayeradubatene qane tathaneqaqu

beraahimeneme geetaawe baqaalaate (bahhegegaate) bafatanawenaa bafatsamaacawe gizee ('asetaawese); <<'enee lasawoce mari 'aderaagihe nanye>> 'alawe <<kazaroceeme ('aderege)>> 'ala qaale kidaanee badaayocune 'ayaaganyeme 'alawe

beetuneme lasawoce mamalashaanaa tsathetanyaa baadaragene gizee ('asetaawese) kaberaahimeme maqomiyaa masegajaane 'aderegu wada beraahimenaa wada semaa`ileme beeteene lazawaariwocunaa lataqamaachocume la'agonebaashoce sagaajocume 'atheru senele qaale kidaane yaazene

beraahime baala gizee ('asetaawese) geetaayee hoye! yehenene tsathetanyaa 'agare 'aderege beetasabocuneme kanasu ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yaamanawene sawe kafereewoce sethawe ('alaaheme) yakaadaweneme sawe; ('esathawaalahu) theqiteme 'ethaqemawaalahu; kaziyaame wada 'esaate qethaate 'asethagaawaalahu; mene tekafaame mamalashaa! ('ala)
beraahimenaa semaaleme <<geetaacene hoye! ka'enyaa taqabale 'aneta samiwenaa `awaaqiwe 'aneta nahenaa>> yamilu sikxonu kabeetu maszaratocune kafe baadaragu gizee ('asetaawese)

<<geetaacene hoye! laanata taazaazhoceme 'aderegane kazarocaaceneme laaneta taazaazhoce hhezebocene ('aderege) hhegegaataaceneneme 'asaayane; ('asaaweqane) banyaame laaye tamalasene; 'aneta tsatsatene taqabaayu ruxeruxe 'aneta becaa nahenaa >>

<<geetaacene hoye! bawesethaacaweme kanasuwe yakxonane maleketanyaa banaresu laaye 'aneqatsocehene yamiyaanabelaacawene matsehhafenenaa thebabeneme yamiyaasetameraacawene (kakehedate) yamiyaatharaacaweneme laake; 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe 'aneta becaa nahenaa>> (yamilume sikxonu)

kaberaahimeme hhegegaate nafesune yaaqeela sawe kaalekxona basetaqare yamiyaafagafege maanawe? (yalame); baqerebitume `aalame ba'eregethe marathenawe bamacharashaayetume `aalame 'eresu kamalekaamocu nawe
geetaawe laresu taazaze baalawe gizee (marathawe) la`aalamaate geetaa taazazeku 'ala

bareswame (bahhegegaatitu) beraahime lejocune 'azaza yaa`equbeme ('enedazihu lejocune 'azaza) <<lejocee hoye! 'alaahe lanaaneta haayemaanotene maratha; selazihe 'enaaneta muselimoce kxonaacehu 'eneji 'atemutu>> ('alaacawe)

yaa`equbene mote bamathaabate gizee lalejocu kanee baxwaalaa maanene tegazaalaacehu baala gizee qaraabiwoce nabaraacehune? ('enaresume) 'amelaakehenenaa ya'abaatocehene yaberaahimene yasemaa`ilenenaa yasehhaqeneme 'amelaake 'anede yakxonawene 'amelaake 'enyaa laresu fetzume taazaazhoce kxonane 'enaamalekaalane 'alu
yehece (yatawasaacewe) ba'eregethe yaalaface hhezebe naate lareswa yaszaraacewe (menedaa) 'alaate lanaanetame yaszaraacehute (menedaa) 'alaacehu yeszaruteme kanabarute 'atethayaqume

<<'ayehudene wayeme keresetiyaanocene kxunu; (qenune manegade) temaraalaacehunaa>> 'alume <<'ayedalame yaberaahimene haayemaanote qathetanyaa sikxone 'enekatalaalane; ka'agaariwoceme 'alenabarame>> balaacawe

<<ba'alaahenaa wadanyaa batawaradawe (qure'aane) wada beraahimeme wada semaa`ilenaa wada sehhaqeme wada yaa`equbenaa wada nagadocume batawaradawe baziyaame musaanaa `isaa batasathute baziyaame nabiyaate hulu kageetaacawe batasathute kanaresu ba'anedeme makaakale yamaanelaye senekxone 'amanene; 'enyaame laresu (la'alaahe) taazaazhoce nane>> balu
baresu baamanaacehubate bethee biyaamenu ba'eregethe tamaru bizorume 'enaresu bacheqecheqe wesethe becaa naacawe 'enaresuneme 'alaahe yebaqaahaale; 'eresume samiwe `awaaqiwe nawe
ya'alaahene (yatafathero) manekere ('emenate) yaazu bamanekareme ka'alaahe yebalethe yaamaara maanawe? (maaneme yalame) 'enyaame laresu becaa tagazhiwoce nane (balu)

'eresu ('alaahe) geetaacenenaa geetaacehu sikxone lanyaame szeraacene yaalane senekxone lanaanetame szeraacehu yaalaacehu setekxonu 'enyaame laresu fetsume taazaazhoce senekxone ba'alaahe (haayemaanote) tekaraakarunaalaacehune? balaacawe

wayeme beraahime semaa`ileme sehhaqeme yaa`equbeme nagadocume 'ayehudoce wayeme keresetiyaanoce nabaru telaalaacehune? <<'enaaneta taaweqaalaacehune? wayenese 'alaahe?>> balaacawe 'eresume zanede ka'alaahe yakxonacene mesekerenate kadabaqa sawe yebalethe badaaye maanawe? 'alaaheme kameteszarute hulu zanegi 'ayedalame
yeheci ba'eregethe yaalaface hhezebe naate; la'ereswa yaszaraacewe 'alaate; lanaanetame yaszaraacehute 'alaacehu; yeszaruteme kanabarute 'atethayaqume

kasawocu qilocu <<kaziyaace bareswa laaye kanabarubaate qibelaacawe mene 'azoraacawe?>> yelaalu; <<meszeraaqume me`eraabume ya'alaahe nawe; yashaawene sawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaraale>> balaacawe

'enedazihume ('enedamaraanaacehu) basawoce laaye masekaariwoce letehonunaa maleketanyaaweme banaaneta laaye masekaari yehone zanede merethe hhezeboce 'adaragenaacehu yaaceneme bareswa laaye yanabarekebaatene 'aqethaachaa maleketanyaawene yamikatalawene sawe wada kehedate kamimalasawe sawe lenaaweqe (lenegaletse) 'eneje qibelaa 'alaadaragenaateme 'ereswame banaziyaa 'alaahe bamaraacawe sawoce laaye basetaqare ba'eregethe kabaade naate 'alaaheme 'emenataacehune (segedataacehune) yamiyaathafaa 'ayedalame; 'alaahe lasawoce bathaame rexeruxe 'azaanye nawenaa

yafitehene wada samaaye magalaabathe ba'eregethe 'enaayaalane wadametewadaateme qibelaa 'enaazorehaalane selazihe fitehene wada takabarawe masegide (wada kaa`ebaa) 'agethaachaa 'azure yateme seferaa betekxonume (setesagedu) fitocaacehune wadaresu 'agethaachaa 'azuru 'enaziyaame matsehhafune yatasathute 'eresu kageetaacawe sikxone 'ewenate mahonune yaaweqaalu 'alaaheme kameteszarute szeraa zanegi 'ayedalame

'enaziyaaneme matsehhafene yatasathutene ba'aseraje hulu betemathaacawe qibelaahene 'ayekatalume 'anetame qibelaacawene takataaye 'ayedalaheme kafilaacaweme yakafilune qibelaa takataaye 'ayedalume ka`eweqateme (karaa`eye) kamathaalehe baxwaalaa zenebaaleeyaacawene betekatale 'aneta yaane gizee kabadaayoce nahe
'enaziyaa matsehhafene yasathanaacawe wanedoce lejocaacawene 'enedamiyaawequ (muhhamadene) yaawequtaale kanasume yatalayu kefeloce 'enaresu yamiyaawaqu sikxonu 'ewenatune ba'eregethe yedabeqaalu
(yehe) kageetaahe yakxona 'ewenate nawe; katatharaathaariwocume 'atehune

lahulume 'eresu (basegedate fitune) yamiyaazorebaate 'agethaachaa 'alacewe wada malekaame szeraawoceme tasheqadaadamu yateme seferaa betekxonu 'alaahe 'enaanetane yatasabasabaacehu kxonaacehu yaamathaacexwaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa
kayateme (laguzo) kawathaahebate seferaa fitehane wada takabarawe masegide 'agethaachaa 'azure 'eresume kageetaahe yakxona 'eregethanyaa 'ewenate nawe 'alaaheme kameteszarute szeraa zanegi 'ayedalame

kayateme kawathaahebate seferaa fitehene wada takalalawe masegide 'agethaachaa 'azure bayateme seferaa betekxonu lasawocu 'enaziyaa kanasu yabadalute siqaru (haayemaanotaacenene yekedaalu qibelaacenene yekatalaalu bamaalate) banaaneta laaye makaraakariyaa 'enedaayenoraacawe fitocaacehune wada 'agethaachaawe 'azuru 'ateferuwaacaweme; ferunyeme; (baziheme yaazazekwaacehu makaraakariyaa 'enedaayenoraacawe) banaanetame laaye tsagaayane 'enedemolaalaacehunaa (wada 'ewenateme) 'enedetemaru nawe

bawesethaacehu kanaanetawe yakxonane banaaneta laaye 'aneqatsocaacenene yamiyaanabelaacehunaa yamiyaatharaacehu, matsehhafenenaa thebabeneme yamiyaasetameraacehu, taawequte yaalenabaraacehuteneme nagare yamiyaasaaweqaacehu yakxonane maleketanyaa 'enedalaakene (tsagaane molaanelaacehu)
'asetaawesunyeme; 'asetaawesaacexwaalahunaa laneeme 'amasegenu; 'atekaadunyeme
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! bamataagasenaa basolaate taradu 'alaahe (ba'eredaataawe) kataagaashoce gaare nawenaa
ba'alaahe manegade (lahaayemaanotu) yamigadalutene sawoceme <<mutaane naacawe>> 'atebalu ba'ewenatu hheyaawaane naacawe; gene 'ataawequme
kaferehaatenaa karaxaabeme batheqite nagare, kaganezabocenaa kanafesoceme, kaferaafereewoceme bamaqanase ba'eregethe 'enemokeraacexwaalane taagaashoceneme (baganate) 'abesere
'enaziyaane makaraa; banakaacaacawe gizee <<'enyaa la'alaahe; nane 'enyaame wadaresu tamalaashoce>> nane yamilutene ('abesere)
'enaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye kageetaacawe yakxonu mehheratoce cerotaame 'alelu 'enaresume (wada 'ewenate) tamariwocu 'enaresu naacawe

sofaanaa marewaa ka'alaahe (te`ezaaze mafatsamiyaa) meleketoce naacawe beetune (kaa`ebaane) bahhaje wayeme ba`umeraahe szeraa yagobanya sawe bahulatu (makaakale) bamamalaalasu baresu laaye xaathi'ate yalabateme malekaameneme szeraa bafaqaadanyaanate yaszaraa sawe ('alaahe yemanadaawaale); 'alaahe 'amasegaanye `awaaqi nawenaa
'enaziyaa ka'aneqatsocenaa kaqene mameriyaa yaawaradenawene lasawoce bamatsehhafu kagalatsenawe baxwaalaa yamidabequ; 'enaziyaa 'alaahe yeragemaacawaale; ragaamiwoceme hulu yeragemwacawaale

'enaziyaa (kamadabaqe) yatatsatsatunaa (szeraacawene) yaasaamarume (yadabaqutene) yagalatsume becaa siqaru 'enaziheme banasu laaye (tsatsataacawene) 'eqabalaalahu; 'eneeme tsatsatene bathaame taqabaaye 'azaanyu nanye
'enaziyaa yakaadu 'enaresu kahhadiwoce kxonaweme yamotu 'enaziyaa banaresu laaye ya'alaahenaa yamalaa'ekete yasawoceme hulu 'eregemaane 'alabaacawe
bawesethwa (baregemaanewaa wesethe) hulegizee zawetaariwoce sikxonu qethaatu kanasu 'ayeqalaleme 'enaresume 'ayeqeqoyume (gizee 'ayesesathume)
'amelaakaacehume 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe; karesu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame ('eresu) 'ejege bathaame rexeruhe 'azaanye nawe

samaayaatenenaa mederene bamafethare leelitenenaa qaneneme bamaatakaakaate, baziyaacame sawocene bamithaqeme nagare (tachenaa) babaahere laaye bameteneshaalalawe taanekwaa, 'alaaheme kasamaaye baawaradawe wehaanaa baresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe bamaaderagu, bareswame wesethe kataneqasaaqaashe hulu bamabatanu, nafaasoceneme (baya'agethaachaawe) bamaagalabaabathe, basamaayenaa bamedere makaakale baminadaaweme damanaa lamiyaawequ hhezeboce 'eregethanyaa meleketoce 'alu

kasawoceme ka'alaahe leelaa baalanethaawocene (thaa`otaatene) 'alaahene 'enedamiwadu yamiwadwacawe kxonawe yamiyezu 'alelu 'enaziyaa yaamanuteme 'alaahene bamawedade (kanaresu) yebalethe yabaratu naacawe 'enaziyaame yabadalute sawoce qethaatene (bateneszaa'ee qane) baayu gizee xayele hulu la'alaahe becaa makxonunenaa 'alaaheme qethaatu beretu makxonune (ba'adunyaa `aalame) biyaawequ noro (baalaanethaawocene bamayaazaacawe batatsatsatu nabare)
'enaziyaa 'asekataayocu qethaatene yaayu sikxonu ka'enaziyaa katakataayoce batatheraarunaa ba'enaresume (makaakale) mekeneyaatoce bataqorathu gizee (yamikxonutene baawaqu noro batatsatsatu nabare)

'enaziyaame yatakatalute <<la'enyaa (wada qerebitu `aalame) 'anedite gizee mamalase banoracenenaa ka'enyaa 'enedatatheraaru ka'enaresu batatheraaraane 'enemanyaalane>> yelaalu 'enedazihu 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene banaresu laaye tsatsatoce 'aderego yaasaayaacawaale 'enaresume ka'esaate wachiwoce 'ayedalume
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! bamedere kaalawe nagare yatafaqada thaafaache sikxone belu yasayethaaneneme 'eremejaawoce 'atekataatalu 'eresu la'enaaneta geletse thalaate nawenaa
('eresu) yamiyaazaacehu baxaathi'aatenaa batsayaafe nagare ba'alaaheme laaye yamaataawequtene 'enedetenaagaru becaa nawe

la'enaresume <<'alaahe yaawaradawene takatalu>> batabaalu gizee <<'ayedalame 'abaatocaacenene baresu laaye yaaganyanebatene nagare 'enekatalaalane>> yelaalu 'abaatocaacawe meneme yamaayaawequnaa (wada 'ewenate) yamaayemarume bikxonu (yekataluwaacawaalene?)

yanaziyaame yakaadute ('enaa wada qene manegade yamitharaacawe sawe) mesaalee 'enedaziyaa demetsenenaa therine basetaqare leelaane bamaayesamaa ('enesesaa) laaye 'enedamichohe bethee nawe ('enaresu) daneqorowoce, didaawoce, `eweroce naacawe; selazihe 'enaresu 'ayaawequme
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kanaziyaa kasathanaacehu thaafaachoce belu la'alaaheme 'eresune becaa yametegazu 'enedakxonaacehu 'amasegenu

banaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawe baketenenaa damene, ya'eriyaa szegaaneme, ba'eresume (maarade) ka'alaahe seme leelaa yatanasaabatene nagare becaa nawe shefetaanaa wasane 'alaafi saayekxone (lamabelaate) yatagadada saweme baresu laaye xaathi'aate yalabateme 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

'enaziyaa 'alaahe kamatsehhafe yaawaradawene yamidabequ baresume (bamadabaqaacawe) theqitene waagaa yamigazu 'enaziyaa bahodocaacawe wesethe 'esaatene 'eneji 'ayebalume 'alaaheme bateneszaa'ee qane 'ayaanaageraacaweme; (kaxaathi'aate) 'ayaatharaacawememe lanaresume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
'enaziyaa thematene baqenenate qethaateneme bamehherate yagazu naacawe ba'esaate laayeme mene taagaashe 'adaragaacawe!

yehe (qethaate) 'alaahe matsehhafene ba'ewenate yaawarada bamakxonu mekeneyaate ('enaa baresu bamakaadaacawe) nawe 'enaziyaame bamatsehhafu yatalayaayute (ka'ewenate) baraaqa cheqecheqe wesethe naacawe

malekaame szeraa fitocaacehune wada meszeraaqenaa me`eraabe 'aqethaachaa maazore 'ayedalame gene malekaame szeraa ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane, bamalaa'eketeme, bamatsaahhefeteme, banabiyaateme, yaamana sawe ganezabeneme kamawedadu gaare lazemedenaa baalabeetocenaa layatimoce lamesekinoceme, lamanegadanyoceme, lalamaanyoceme, lachaaneqaawoceme (maaselaqaqe) yasatha sawenaa solaateneme danebune thabeqo yasagada, zakaaneme yasatha, qaale kidaaneme bagabu gizee bakidaanaacawe yamolu (sawoce szeraa) nawe bacegere babashetaanaa bathore gizeeme taagaashocene ('enaawadesaalane) 'enazihe 'enaziyaa 'ewenatene yayaazu naacawe 'enaziyaame tathaneqaaqiwocu 'enaresu naacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! batagadalu sawoce maamasaasale banaaneta laaye tatsaafa natsaa banatsaa baariyaame babaariyaa seeteme baseete (yegadalaalu) la'eresume (lagadaayu) kawanedemu (dame) teneshe nagare mehherate yatadaragalate sawe (bamahhaariwe laaye gumaawene) bamalekaame makataatale wadaresume (wada mahhaariwe) gadaayu bamalekaame 'akwaaxwaane makefale 'alabaacawe yehe kageetaacehu yakxona maaqaalalenaa 'ezenate nawe kaziheme baxwaalaa hhegene yatalaalafa sawe laresu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alawe
la'enaanetame baala 'a'emerowoce hoye! bamaamasaasale (hhege) wesethe hheyewate 'alaacehu tethanaqaqu zanede (gadaayene magedale tadanagagalaacehu)
'anedaacehune mote bamathaabate gizee habetene bitawe lawalaajocenaa laqerebe zamadoce babago manaazaze banaaneta laaye tatsaafa (yehe) bathenequqocu laaye 'eregethanyaa denegaagee tadanagaga
(nuzaazeewene) kasamaaweme baxwaalaa yalawathawe sawe xaathi'atu banaziyaa bamilawethute laaye becaa nawe 'alaahe sami `awaaqi nawenaa

katanaazaazhime bakule (kawenate) mazanebalene wayeme (kasziso bamachamare) xaathi'aatene yaawaqanaa bamakaakalaacawe yaasetaaraqa sawe ba'eresu laaye xaathi'aate yalabateme 'alaahe bathaame mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye tsome banaziyaa kanaaneta bafite banabarute (hhezeboce) laaye 'eneda tatsaafa banaanetame laaye tatsaafa (tadanabaa) letethanaqaqu yekajalaalenaa

yataqotharune qanoce (tsumu) ka'enaanetame wesathe bashetanyaa wayeme baguzo laaye yakxona sawe kaleeloce qanoce qutherocene matsome 'alabate ba'enaziyaame tsomene bamaayecelute laaye beezaa dekxaane maabelaate 'alabaacawe (beezaane bamachamare) malekaameneme szeraa yafaqada sawe 'eresu (faqedo machamaru) laresu balaache nawe matsomaacehume lanaaneta yabalatha nawe; yametaawequ betekxonu (temarethutaalaacehu)

('enedetetsomu yatatsaafabaacehu) yaa baresu wesethe lasawoce mari kaqene manegadenaa ('ewenatene kaweshate) kamilayume galaachoce ('aneqatsoce) sikxone qure'aane yatawaradabate yaramadaane ware nawe ka'enaanetame warune yaaganya sawe yetsumawe bashetanyaa wayeme baguzo laaye yakxoname sawe kaleeloce qanoce qutherocene (baleku) matsome 'alabate 'alaahe ba'enaaneta garune (nagare) yeshaale ba'enaanetame cegerune 'ayeshaame qutheroceneme letemolu 'alaaheneme qenune manegade selamaraacehu taakaberutenaa taamasagenute zanede (yehene danagagenelaacehu)

baaroceeme ka'enee bathayaquhe gizee ('enedihe balaacawe) - 'enee qerebe nanye yalamaanyene tsalote balamananye gizee 'eqabalawaalahu selazihe lanee yetaazazu; baneeme yemanu; 'enasu limaru yekajalaalenaa

batsome leelite wada seetocaacehu maderase lanaaneta tafaqadalaacehu 'enaresu lanaaneta lebesoce naacawe; 'enaanetame lanaresu lebesoce naacehu 'alaahe 'enaaneta nafesocaacehune yametebadelu makxonaacehune `awaqa ba'enaanetame laaye tamalasalaacehu ka'enaanetame yeqeretaa 'adaraga 'ahune taganaanyuwaacawe 'alaaheme lanaaneta yatsaafalaacehune nagare (lejene) falegu kagohe yakxonawe nachu kereme kathequru kere (kaleelite chalamaa) la'enaaneta 'esekamigaletselaacehu derase belu; thathume kaziyaame tsomene 'eseka leelitu derase mulu 'enaanetame bamasegidoce taqamaachoce setekxonu 'ateganaanyuwaacawe yehece ya'alaahe hhegegaate naatenaa (lamatalaalafe) 'ateqerabwate 'enedazihu 'alaahe 'aneqatsocune lasawoce yaaberaaraale 'enaresu (yatakalakalutene) lithanaqaqu yekajalaalenaa
ganezabocaacehuneme bamakaakalaacehu bakanetu (yaala 'agebaabe) 'atebelu 'enaanetame yametaawequ setekxonu kasawoce ganezaboce kafilene baxaathi'aate tebalu zanede wada daanyoce 'atethaalwate

(muhhamade hoye!) kalagaa charaqaawoce (malawaawathe) yethayaquhaale 'enaresu lasawoce theqeme lahhajeme (maawaqiyaa) gizeeyaatoce (meleketoce) naacawe balaacawe malekaame szeraame beetocene kajarebaawocaacawe bamamethaataacehu 'ayedalame gene yamalekaame szeraa baalabeete yatathanaqaqa sawe nawe beetoceneme kadajaafocaacawe bakule gebu; 'alaaheneme feru letedenu yekajalaalenaa (balaacawe)
'enaziyaaneme yamigaadaluwaacehune (kahhaadiwoce) ba'alaahe manegade tagaadalu wasaneneme 'atelafu; 'alaahe wasane 'alaafiwone 'ayewademenaa

baaganyaacexwaacaweme seferaa hulu gedaluwaacawe ka'awathwacehume seferaa 'awethwacawe makaraame kamagedale yebalethe yabarataace naate batakabarawe masegideme zanede baresu wesethe 'esekamigaadaluwaacehu derase 'ategaadaluwaacawe bigaadaluwaacehume gedaluwaacawe; yakahhaadiwoce qethaate 'enedazihe nawe
bikalakalume 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
hukate 'esekamaayeganyenaa haayemaanote la'alaahe becaa 'esekamikxone derase tagaadaluwaacawe bikalakelume wasanene maalafe; babadaayoce laaye 'eneji yalame (wasane 'atelafubaacawe)

yatakabarawe ware batakabarawe ware 'anetsaare nawe keberoceme hulu tamasaasaayoce naacawe ba'enaanetame laaye (batakabarawe ware) wasane yaalafabaacehune sawe banaaneta laaye wasane baalafawe bethee baresu laaye wasane 'elafubate 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe kamifarute gaare makxonuneme `ewaqu
ba'alaaheme manegade lagesu ba'ejocaacehume (nafesocaacehune) wada thefaate 'atethaalu bago szeraaneme szeru; 'alaahe bago szariwocene yewadaalenaa

hhajenenaa `umeraaneme la'alaahe mulu betetaagadume kahadeye (kamaszewaa'ete) yatagaraawene (masawaate) 'alabaacehu hadeyume 'eseferaawe 'esekamidarese derase raasocaacehune 'atelaachu kanaanetame wesethe bashetanyaa wayeme baraasu hukate yaalabate yakxona sawe (bilaache) katsome wayeme kametsewaate wayeme kamaszewaa`ete beezaa 'alabate tsathetaame baaganyaacehu gizee 'eseka hhaje ba`umeraa yatathaaqama sawe kahadeye yatagaraawene (maszawaate) 'alabate yaalaaganyame sawe sosetene qanoce bahhaje waraate; sabaateme batamalasaacehu gizee matsome 'alabate yehece mulu `aszere (qanaate) naate yeheme (hhege) beetasabocu kaqedusu masegide 'aqeraabiyaa laalekxonu nawe 'alaaheneme feru; 'alaaheme qethaata beretu makxonune 'ewaqu

hhaje (gizeeyaatu) yataawaqu waroce naacawe ba'enaresume wesethe hhajene ('enediszaraa) nafesune yaasegadada sawe bahhaje wesethe seetene maganaanyate maamatseme kerekereme yalame kabagome szeraa yameteszarutene hulu 'alaahe yaaweqawaale tasanaqume; kaseneqeme hulu balaachu theneqaaqee ('alaahene maferaate) nawe ya'a'emerowoceme baalabeetoce hoye! ferunye

(bahhaje gizee banegede szeraa) kageetaacehu terefene bamafalagaacehu banaaneta laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume ka`arafaateme bagorafaacehu gizee masha`aralehharaame zanede 'alaahene 'awesu (lahhaje) selamaraacehume 'awesute kamameraatu bafiteme ba'eregethe katasaasaacoce nabaraacehu
kaziyaame (qurayeshoce hoye!) sawocu kagorafubate seferaa gurafu; (tamalasu) 'alaaheneme mehheratene lamenu; 'alaahe 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

yahhaje szeraawocaacehuneme bafatsamaacehu gizee 'abaatocaacehune 'enedametaawasu wayeme yebalethe yabarataane maawesaate 'alaahene 'awesu kasawoceme wesethe - <<geetaacene hoye! bamedera`aalame malekaame `edelene sethane>> yamile sawe 'ala laresume bamacharashaayetu 'agare ka`edele meneme yalaweme

ka'enaresume wesethe - <<geetaacene hoye! bamedera `aalame dagene nagare (tsagaane) bamacharashaayetume 'agare dagene nagare (ganatene) sethane; ya'esaateneme qethaate thabeqane>> yamilu sawoce 'alelu
'enaziyaakaszarute bago szeraa lanaresu 'edele 'alaacawe 'alaaheme meremaraawe fathaane nawe

bataqotharu qanoceme wesethe (baminaa thatharocene setewaraweru) 'alaahene 'awesu bahulate qanoceme wesethe (bamakxeede) yatacaakola sawe baresu laaye xaathi'aate yalabateme yaqoyame sawe baresu laaye xaathi'aate yalabateme (yeheme) 'alaahene lafaraa sawe nawe 'alaaheneme feru 'enaaneta wadaresu yametesabasabu makxonaacehuneme `ewaqu
kasawoceme wesethe 'eresu kerekera beretu sikxone baqerebitu hheyewate negegeru yamidaneqehenaa balebu wesethe baalawe nagare laaye 'alaahene yamiyaasemasakere sawe 'alela
(kaaneta) bazorame gizee bamedere laaye bawesethwa liyaabalaashenaa 'azemaraanenaa 'enesesaawocene liyaathafaa yerothaale 'alaaheme maabalaashatene 'ayewademe
la'eresu <<'alaahene feraa>> batabaalame gizee; te`ebitu baxaathi'aate (szeraa) laaye tegafafaawaalace gahanameme baqiwe naate; ('ereswame) ba'eregethe yakafaace menethaafe naate
kasawoceme wesethe ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalage nafesune yamishathe sawe 'alela 'alaaheme labaarocu bathaame rexeruhe nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! hulaacehume bamataazaze wesethe gebu yasayethaaneneme 'eremejaawoce 'atekatalu; 'eresu la'enaaneta geletse thalaate nawenaa
geletse maaserajaawoceme kamathulaacehu baxwaalaa betezanabalu 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa makxonune 'ewaqu
'alaahe (qethaatu)naa malaa'eketu kadamanaa bakxonu thelaawoce wesethe limathuwaacawe 'eneji 'ayethabaabaqume nagarume tafatsama; nagaroceme hulu wada 'alaahe yemalasaalu
ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce kageletse ta`aamere senetene 'edasathanaacawe thayeqaacawe ya'alaaheneme tsagaa kamathaacelate baxwaalaa yamilawethe sawe 'alaahe qethaata beretu nawe

la'enaziyaa lakaadute ka'enaziyaa kaamanute yamisaalaqu sikxonu qerebitu hheyewate tashalamacelaacewe 'enaziyaame yatathanaqaqute bateneszaa'ee qane kabalaayaacawe naacawe 'alaaheme lamishaawe sawe yaala gemete yesathaale

sawocu hulu 'anede hhezebe nabaru; (talayaayu) 'alaaheme nabiyaatene 'abesaariwocenaa 'asefaraariwoce 'aderego laaka ka'enaresume gaare matsaahhefetene basawocu makaakale baziyaa baresu batalayaayubate nagare yefarede zanede ba'ewenate 'awarada ba'eresume (bahaayemaanote) geletse 'aserajiwoce kamathulaacawe baxwaalaa bamakaakalaacawe lakxonawe meqanyenate 'enaziyaawe yatasathute 'eneji 'aletalayaayubateme 'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene sawoce la'eziyaa ka'ewenate baresu latalayaayubate bafeqaadu maraacawe 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaraale

ba'ewenatu ya'enaziyaa kabafitaacehu yaalafute (me'emenaane makaraa) bethee saayemathaacehu ganatene letegabu taasebaalaacehune? maleketanyaawenaa 'enaziyaa karesu gaare yaamanute <<ya'alaahe 'eredaataa macee nawe?>> 'esekamilu derase makaraanaa gudaate nakaacaacawe; tarebadabadume nequ! ya'alaahe 'eredaataa ba'eregethe qerebe nawe (tabaalume)

menene (lamaaneme) 'enedamilagesu yethayequhaale kamalekaame nagare yametelagesute; lawalaajocenaa laqerebe zamadoce, layatimoceme, ladehoceme, lamanegadanyoceme nawe kabago nagareme maanenyaaweneme beteszaru 'alaahe 'eresune `awaaqi nawe balaacawe

magaadale 'eresu la'enaaneta yatathalaa sihone ba'enaaneta laaye tatsaafa 'anedaace nagarene 'eresu lanaaneta yabalatha sihone yametethalute makxonaacehu taragaagatha 'anedaaceneme nagare 'eresu lanaaneta mathefo sihone yametewadute mahonaacehu taragaagatha 'alaaheme (yamishaalaacehune) yaaweqaale gene 'enaaneta 'ataawequme

katakabarawe ware (karajabe) baresu wesethe kamagaadale yethayequhaale balaacawe <<baresu wesethe magaadale taalaaqe (xathi'ate) nawe gene ka'alaahe manegade (sawocene) makalaakale, baresume makaade, katakabaraweme masegide (maagade) baalabeetocuneme karesu maawethaate 'alaahe zanede yebalethe taalaaqe (wanejale) nawe fatanaame (maagaaraate) kamagedale yebalethe kabaade nawe (kahhadiwoce) bicelu kahaayemaanotaacehu 'esekamimalesaacehu derase yamiwaaguwaacehu kamahone 'ayebozenume ka'enaaneta wesetheme kahaayemaanotu yamimalasenaa 'eresume kahhadi hono yamimote sawe 'enaziyaa (bago) szeraacawe baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume 'agare tabalaashace 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu bareswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe >>
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa 'enaziyaame (ka'agaraacawe) yatasadadute ba'alaaheme manegade laaye yatagaadalute 'enaziyaa ya'alaahene 'ezenate yekajelaalu 'alaaheme 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

'a'emerone kamiqaawame mathathenaa kaqumaare yethayequhaale <<bahulatume wesethe taalaaqe xaathi'aatenaa lasawoce theqemoce 'alubaacawe gene xaathi'aataacawe katheqemaacawe bathaame teleqe nawe>> balaacawe menene 'enedamimatsawetume (mathanune) yethayequhaale <<terefene (matsewetu)>> balaacawe 'enedazihu taasetanatenu zanede 'alaahe lanaaneta 'aneqatsocene yegaletselaacexwaale

baqerebitu `aalamenaa bamacharashaayetu taasetanatenu zanede (yegalatselaacexwaale) kayatimoceme yethayequhaale <<la'enaresu (ganezabaacawene bamaaraabaate) maasaamare balaache nawe beteqalaaqalwacaweme wanedemocaacehu naacawe 'alaaheme yamiyaathafaawene kamiyaabajawe (layeto) yaaweqaale 'alaaheme bashaa noro baasecagaraacehu nabare; 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa>> balaacawe

(ba'alaahe) 'agaari yahonu seetoce 'esekamiyaamenu derase 'ataagebuwaacawe ka'agaariyetu meneme betedaneqaacehume 'enekwaa yaamanacewe baariyaa ba'eregethe balaache naate la'agaariwocume 'esekamiyaamenu derase 'atedaarulaacawe ka'agaariwe (geetaa) meneme bidaneqaacehu me'emenu baariyaa balaache nawe 'enaziyaa ('agaariwoce) wada 'esaate yethaaraalu 'alaaheme bafaqaadu wada ganatenaa wada mehherate yetharaale hhegegaatuneme lasawoce yegaletsaale 'enaresu ligasatsu yekajalaalenaa

kaware 'ababaame yethayequhaale 'eresu 'asethayaafi nawe seetoceneme baware 'ababaa gizee raaqwaacawe netsuhhe 'esekamikxonume derase 'ateqerabuwaacawe netsuhhe bakxonume gizee 'alaahe kaazazaacehu seferaa taganaanyuwaacawe 'alaahe (kaxaathi'aate) tamalaashocene yewadaale; tatheraariwoceneme yewadaale balaacawe

seetocaacehu lanaaneta 'ereshaa naacawe 'ereshaacehuneme bafalagaacehute kxunataa derasu lanafesocaacehume (malekaame szeraane) 'aseqademu 'alaaheneme feru 'enaanetame taganaanyewocu makxonaacehune `ewaqu me'emanaaneneme (baganate) 'abesere
malekaame 'enedaateszaru, 'alaaheneme 'enedaatefaru, basawoceme makaakale 'enedaataasetaarequ 'alaahene lamahhalaawocaacehu geredo 'ataaderegu 'alaaheme sami 'awaaqi nawe
bamahhalaawocaacehu bawedequ (saataasebu bametemelute) 'alaahe 'ayezaacehume gene lebocaacehu baasabute yeyezaacexwaale 'alaaheme bathaame mahhari taagaashe nawe
la'enaziyaa kaseetocaacawe (laayeqarebu) lamimelute 'araatene waroce mathabaqe 'alabaacawe (kamahhalaacawe) bimalasume 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
mafetaateneme qurethe 'asaabe biyaadaregu (yefetu) 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

yatafatu seetoceme nafesocaacawene (kamaagebaate) szosetene qure'e yethabequ ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaaweme qane yamiyaamenu bikxonu 'alaahe bamaahhetzanocaacawe wesethe yafatharawene lidabequ lanaresu 'ayefaqadelaacaweme baalocaacaweme bazihe wesethe 'ereqene bifalegu bamamaalasaacawe tagabiwoce naacawe la'enaresume (laseetoce) yaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye yaalabaacawe (gedaaje) bethee bamalekaame 'anuwaanuwaare (babaalocaacawe laaye mabete) 'alaacawe lawanedoceme (thaathaacawene selamishakamu) ba'enasu laaye belechaa 'alaacawe 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe

fece hulate gizee nawe; (kazihe baxwaalaa) bamalekaame mayaaze wayeme babago 'akwaaxwaane maasanaabate nawe ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate 'alamathabaqaacawene kaalaawaqu basetaqare kasathaacexaacawe nagare meneneme letewasedu la'enaaneta (labaaloce) 'ayefaqadelaacehume ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate 'alamathabaqaacawene betaawequ ba'eresu (nafeswane) batabazhacebate nagare bahulatume laaye xaathi'aate yalame yehece ya'alaahe hhegegaate naate; 'atetalaalafwateme ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate yamitalaalafu 'enaziyaa 'enaresu badaayoce naacawe

(szosetanyaa) bifataateme kazihe baxwaalaa leelaane baale 'esekametaagabaa derase laresu 'atefaqadelateme (hulatanyaawe baale) bifataateme ya'alaahene hhegegaate mathabaqaacawene biyaawequ bamamaalasaacawe bahulatume laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacaweme yeheceme ya'alaahe hhegegaate naate lamiyaawequ hhezeboce yaaberaaraataale

seetocene bafataacehunaa (ya`idaa) gizeeyaacawene badarasu gizee bamalekaame yaazuwaacawe; (tamaalaswacawe) wayeme bamalekaame kxuneetaa 'asanaabetuwaacawe lamagudaateme wasane taalefaabaacawe zanede 'ateyaazuwaacawe; yeheneneme yamiszaraa sawe nafesune ba'eregethe badala ya'alaaheneme 'aneqatsoce maalaagachaa 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu ya'alaaheneme tsagaa banaaneta laaye yaadaragawene kamatsehhafenaa kathebabeme baresu yamigasetsaacehu sikxone banaaneta laaye yaawaradawene 'asetaawesu 'alaaheneme feru; 'alaaheme nagarune hulu `awaaqi makxonune `ewaqu

seetoceneme bafataacehunaa gizeeyaacawene badarasu gizee bamakaakalaacawe bahhege batawaadadu gizee baalocaacawene kamaagebaate 'ataasetagwaagulwacawe yehe (makalekale) ka'enaaneta ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamene sawe baresu yegasatsebataale yehe huneetaacehu la'enaaneta balaache nawe; (kamatharethare) 'atherime nawe 'alaaheme yaaweqaale; 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme

'enaatoceme lejocaacawene mulu yakxonune hulate `aamataate yaathebu (yeheme) maathebaatene mamulaate lashaa sawe nawe la'eresume batawaladalate ('abaate) laaye megebaacawenaa lebesaacawe bacelotaawe leke 'alabate nafese celotaawaane 'eneji 'ategadademe walaajite ('enaate) balejewaa mekeneyaate laresu yatawaladalateme ('abaate) baleju mekeneyaate 'ayegodaadu bawaraasheme laaye 'enedazihu bethee 'alabate (walaajocu) kahulatume bakxona mawaadadenaa mamakaakare (lejune kathute) manathalene bifalegu bahulatume laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacaweme lejocaacehuneme laleeloce 'athebiwoce maasethabaatene betefalegu letesathu yashaacehutene bamalekaame kxuneetaa basathaacehu gizee (bamaasethabaataacehu) ba'enaaneta laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume 'alaaheneme feru; 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace makxonune `ewaqu

'enaziyaame kanaaneta wesethe yamimotunaa misetocene yamitawu (misetocaacawe) banafesocaacawe 'araate waroce ka`asere (qanaate kagaabecaa) yetaagasu gizeeyaacaweneme bacharasu gizee banafesocaacawe bataawaqa hhege baszarute nagare ba'enaaneta laaye xaathi'ate yalabaacehume 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe

seetoceneme kamaachate baresu baashamoraacehubate wayeme banafesocaacehu wesethe (lamaagebaate) badabaqaacehute banaaneta laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume 'alaahe 'enaaneta ba'eregethe yametaasetaaweswacawe makxonaacehune `awaqa (selazihe maashamorenenaa maasabene faqadalaacehu ) gene bahhege yataawaqane negegere yametenagaagaru kaalekxonaacehu basetaqare; mesethirene (gaabecaane) 'ateqaatharuwaacawe yatatsaafaweme (`idaahe) gizeewene 'esekamidarese derase gaabecaane lamawaawaale qurethe hhasaabe 'ataaderegu 'alaaheme banafesocaacehu yaalawene nagare yamiyaaweqe makxonune `ewaqu; tathaneqaquteme 'alaaheme mahhaari taagaashe makxonune `ewaqu

seetocene saatenakwaacawe (saateganaanyu); wayeme lanasu maherene saatewasenulaacawe betefatwacawe banaaneta laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume (daaragote bamasethate mafetaate tecelaalaacehu ) theqamwacaweme bahabetaame laaye celotaawe badexame laaye celotaawe ('aqemu yamifaqedawene masethate) 'alabate malekaame yakxonane matheqame babago szariwoce laaye yataragaagathane; (theqamwacawe)

la'enaresume mawasanene ba'eregethe yawasanaacehulaacawe setekxonu saatenakwaacawe bafite betafatwacawe kaalemaaruwaacehu wayeme yaa yagaabecaawe wele ba'eju yakxonawe (baaleyawe) kaalemaara basetaqare yawasanaacehute gemaashu 'alaacawe mehherateme maaderagaacehu wada 'alaahe feraacaa bathaame yaqaraba nawe bamakaakalaacehume cerotaane 'ateresu; 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawenaa
basolaatoce (batalaye) bamakaakalanyaayetume solaate laaye tathabaabaqu taazaazhoce kxonaacehume la'alaahe qumu
betefarume 'egeranyoce wayeme gaalaabiwoce kxonaacehu (segadu) tsathetanyoceme bakxonaacehu gizee taawequte yaalenabaraacehutene 'eneda 'asaawaqaacehu 'alaahene 'awesu (segadu)

'enaziyaa kanaaneta wesethe yamimotu misetoceneme yamitawu; lamisetocaacawe (kabeetaacawe) yamaayewathu sikxonu `aamate derase mathaqamene nuzaazeene (yenaazazu) bafaqaadaacawe biwathume bahhege kataawaqawe nagare banafesocaacawe baszarute ba'enaaneta (bamwacu zamadoce) laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
latafatu seetoceme bacelotaa mathane daaragote 'alaacawe 'alaahene bamifaru laaye tadanegegwaale
'enedazihu 'alaahe 'aneqatsocune taawequ zanede lanaaneta yaaberaaraalaacexwaale

wada 'enaziyaa 'enaresu bezu shihhe kxonawe motene lamaferaate kahagarocaacawe wada wathute sawoce `eweqatehe 'aledarasamene? 'alaaheme lanaresu <<mutu>> 'alaacawe; (motume) kaziyaame hheyaawe 'adaragaacawe 'alaaheme basawoce laaye baalacerotaa nawe; gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaamasagenume
ba'alaaheme manegade (haayemaanote) tagaadalu 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi makxonune `ewaqu
yaa la'alaahe malekaame bederene yamiyaabaderenaa la'eresu ('alaahe) bezu 'ethefoce 'aderego yamiyaanabaaberelate maanawe? 'alaaheme yechabethaale; yezaragaaleme; wada 'eresume temalasaalaacehu

ka'eseraa'eele lejoce kamusaa baxwaalaa wada nabarute cheferoce lanabiyaacawe (lasaamu'eele) - <<la'enyaa neguszene 'asenasaalene ba'alaahe manegade 'enewaagaalane;>> baalu gizee 'alaayahemene? ('alaawaqehemene?) -<<mawaagaate bitsaafebaacehu 'atewaagume yekxonaale>> 'alaacawe <<kahagarocaacenenaa kalejocaacene yatabaararene senekxone ba'alaahe manegade yamaanewaagaa la'enyaa mene 'alane?>> 'alu ba'enaresu laaye mawaagaate batatsaafabaacaweme gizee ka'enaresu theqitoce siqaru 'afagafagu 'alaaheme badaayocune `awaaqi nawe

nabiyaacaweme la'enaresu - <<'alaahe thwalutene (saa'olene) negusze 'aderego ba'eregethe laakalaacehu>> 'alaacawe ('enaresume) - <<'enyaa ka'eresu yeleqe banegeszenaa tagabiwoce senekxone kahabeteme sefaatene yaaletasatha sikxone la'eresu banyaa laaye 'enedeete negeszenaa yenorawaale?>> 'alu (nabiyaacaweme) -<<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye marathawe ba`eweqatenaa ba'akaaleme sefaatene chamaralate 'alaaheme negeszenaawene lamishaawe sawe yesathaale 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe>> 'alaacawe

nabiyaacaweme la'enaresu - <<yanegeszenaawe melekete kageetaacehu yakxona 'eregaataa yamusaa beetasabenaa yahaarune beetasabe kataweteme qerese bawesethu yaalabate malaa'ekete yamishakamute kxono saathenu limathaalaacehu nawe 'amaanyoce betekxonu bazihe la'enaaneta 'eregethanyaa melekete 'alela>> 'alaacawe

thwaluteme baszaraawitu (taajebo) bawathaa gizee - <<'alaahe bawaneze (wehaa) fataanyaacehu nawe karesume yathathaa sawe ka'enee 'ayedalame yaaleqamasaweme sawe ba'eju mazeganene yazagana sawe becaa siqare 'eresu kanee nawe>> 'ala ka'enaresume theqitoce siqaru karesu thathu 'eresunaa 'enaziyaame ka'eresu gaare yaamanute (wanezune) baalafute gizee - <<jaalotenenaa szaraawitune bamawaagaate lanyaa zaaree celotaa yalaneme>> 'alute 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'alaahene taganaanyewoce makxonaacawe yamiyaaragaagethute - <<katheqite cheferaa ba'alaahe faqaade bezune cheferaa yaashanaface bezu naate; 'alaaheme kataagaashoce gaare nawe>> 'alu
lajaalotenaa laszaraawitu batasalafume gizee - <<geetaacene hoye! ba'enyaa laaye te`egesetene 'anebwabwa; chaamaawocaaceneneme 'adalaadele; bakahhaadiyaane hhezeboceme laaye 'eredaane>> 'alu

ba'alaaheme faqaade dele matwacawe daawedeme jaalutene (daawite goleyaadene) gadala negeszenaanenaa thebabeneme (nabiyenatene) 'alaahe sathawe kamishaaweme nagare hulu 'asaawaqawe 'alaaheme sawocene kafilaacawene bakafilu mamalasu baalenabara noro medere batabalaashace nabare; gene 'alaahe ba`aalamaate laaye yacerotaa baalabeete nawe
'enazihe ('aneqatsoce) bawenate ba'aneta laaye yamenaanabaacawe sikxonu ya'alaahe 'aneqatsoce naacawe; 'anetame ba'eregethe kamaleketanyocu nahe

'enazihene maleketanyoce kafilaacawene bakafilu laaye 'abalathene ka'enaresu wesethe 'alaahe yaanagaagarawe 'alela kafilocaacaweneme badarajaawoce kafe 'adaraga yamareyamene leje `isaaneme geletse taameraatocene sathanawe baqedusu manefaseme 'abarataanawe 'alaaheme bashaa noro 'enaziyaa ka'enaresu (kamaleketanyocu) baxwaalaa yanabarute geletse taameraatoce kamathulaacawe baxwaalaa baaletagaadalu nabare gene talayaayu ka'enaresume wesethe yaamana sawe 'alela kanaresume wesethe yakaada sawe 'alela 'alaaheme bashaa noro baaletawaagu (baaletalayaayu) nabare gene 'alaahe yamishaawene yeszaraale
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! baresu wesethe sheyaache (mabazhate), wadaajenateme, melejaame yaleelabate qane kamamethaatu bafite kasathanaacehu nagare lagesu kahhaadiwoceme badaayocu 'enaresu naacawe

'alaahe ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame hheyaawe raasune caaye nawe maanegalaajateme 'eneqelefeme 'ateyezaweme basamaayaate wesethenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa nawe yaa 'eresu zanede bafaqaadu bikxone 'eneje yamiyaamaalede maanawe? (kafethuroce) bafitaacawe yaalawenenaa kaxwaalaacawe yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale bashaaweme nagare 'eneji ka`eweqatu bameneme nagare 'ayaakaabebume ('ayaawequme) manebaru samaayaatenenaa mederene safaa thebaqaacaweme 'ayaaqetaweme 'eresume yahulu balaaye taalaaqe nawe

bahaayemaanote maasegadade yalame qenu manegade kathamaamaawe ba'eregethe tagalatha bathaa`oteme yamikedenaa ba'alaahe yamiyaamene sawe lareswa mabathase yaleelaatene thanekaaraa zalabate ba'eregethe chabatha 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

'alaahe ya'enaziyaa yaamanute sawoce radaate nawe kachalamaawoce wada berehaane yaawathaacawaale 'enaziyaame yakaadute radaatocaacawe thaa`otaate naacawe kaberehaane wada chalamaawoce yaawathwacawaale 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe; 'enaresu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe

wadaziyaa 'alaahe negeszenaane selasathawe beraahimene bageetaawe nagare wada takaraakarawe sawe 'alaayahemene beraahime <<geetaayee yaa hheyaawe yamiyaadaregenaa yamigadele nawe>> baala gizee <<'enee hheyaawe 'adaregaalahu 'egadelaalahume>> 'ala beraahime - <<'alaahe tzahhayene kameszeraaqe bakule yaamathaale ('aneta) kame`eraabe bakule 'amethaate>> 'alawe yaame yakaadawe sawe waalala; (malese 'athaa) 'alaaheme badaayoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraame

wayeme yaanene bakatamaa laaye 'ereswa bathaaraawocewaa laaye yawadaqace setekxone yaalafawene sawe bethee ('alaayahemene) - <<yehecene (katamaa) kamotace baxwaalaa 'alaahe 'enedeete hheyaawe yaadaregaataale>> 'ala 'alaaheme gadalawe mato `aamatene ('aqoyaweme) kaziyaame 'asenasaawe - <<mene yaahele qoyahe>> 'alawe <<'anede qane wayeme yaqanene kafile qoyahu>> 'ala <<'ayedalame matone `aamate qoyahe wada megebehenaa wada mathatheheme yaaletalawatha sikxone tamalekate wada 'aheyaaheme tamalekate lasawoceme 'aseraje 'enaadaregehe zanede (yehenene szasaraane) wada `atzemocume 'enedeete 'enedamenaasenasaate kaziyaame szegaane 'enedamenaalabesaate tamalekate>> 'alawe laresume (bamaayate) batagalatsalate gizee - <<'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye makxonune `aweqaalahu>> 'ala

beraahimeme <<geetaayee hoye! mutaanene 'enedeete hheyaawe 'enedametaadarege 'asaayanye>> baala gizee ('asetaawese ) 'alaahe - <<'alaamanekemene>> 'alawe <<'ayedalame ('amenyaalahu); gene lebee 'enediragaa>> nawe 'ala ('alaaheme) - <<kabaraariwoce (kawafoce) 'araatene yaaze wada 'anetame sabesebaacawe (qoraarethaacaweme); kaziyaame bayakorabetaawe hulu laaye kanaresu quraachene 'aderege kaziyaame theraacawe; fathenawe yemathuhaalenaa 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa makxonune `ewaqe>> 'alawe

ya'enaziyaa ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade yamilagesu sawoce (legesenaa) mesaalee bayazalalaawe hulu mato qenethaate yaalabaacawene sabaate zalalaawoce 'eneda 'abaqalace 'anedite qenethaate bethee nawe 'alaaheme lamishaawe sawe (kazihe balaaye) yaanabaaberaale 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaa ganezabocaacawene ba'alaahe manegade yamilagesu kaziyaame yasathutene nagare mamatsaadaqenenaa maasekafaatene yamaayaasekatelu la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede menedaacawe 'alaacawe ba'enaresume laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enaresume 'ayaazenume
malekaame negegerenaa mehherate maaderage maasekafaate kamikatalaate metsewaate balaache nawe 'alaaheme tabeqaaqi taagaashe nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enedaziyaa ganezabune lasawoce maasaayate sile 'enedamisathawenaa ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaaweme qane 'enedamaayaamenawe sawe metsewaatocaacehune bamamatsaadaqenaa bamaasekafaate 'ataabalaashu mesaaleeweme balaayu `afare 'enedaalabate lanethaa denegaaye xaayelanyaame zenaabe 'enedaaganyawenaa melethe 'aderego 'enedatawawe bethee nawe kaszarute nagare bameneme laaye (lithaqamu) 'ayecelume 'alaaheme kahhaadiyaanene hhezeboce 'ayemaraame

ya'enaziyaame ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalagenaa lanafesocaacawe ('emenatene) lamaaragaagathe ganezabocaacawene yamilagesu sawoce mesaalee batasetakaakalace kafetanyaa seferaa laaye 'enedaalace 'atekelete, bezu zenaabe 'enedanakaate fereewaaneme 'ethefe kxono 'enedasathace, zenaabeme baayenakaate kaafiyaa 'enedamibaqaate bethee nawe 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

(ka'enaaneta) 'anedaacehu laresu kazamebaabaanaa kawayenoce baserewaa wanezoce yamifasubaate 'atekelete letenorawe, bawesethwame laresu kayafereewe hulu linorawe 'erejenaame linakaawenaa laresu dakaamaawoce zereyaawoce yaalute sikxone bawesethu 'esaate yaalabate wereche liyaaganyaatenaa leteqaathale yewadaalene 'enedazihu 'alaahe 'aneqatsocene la'enaaneta yaaberaaraale; letaasetanatenu yekajalaalenaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kaafaraacehutenaa kaziyaame la'enaaneta kamedere kaawathaanelaacehu kamalekaamu lagesu mathefoweneme (lamasethate) 'ataasebu ba'eresu `aayenocaacehune chafenaacehu 'eneji yamaatewasedute setekxonu ka'eresu (kamathefowe) tesathaalaacehune 'alaaheme tabeqaaqi mesegune makxonune `ewaqu
sayethaane ('enedaatelagesu) dekxenatene yaasefaraaraacexwaale bamathefome yaazaacexwaale 'alaaheme karesu yakxonane mehheratenaa cerotaane yeqatheraacexwaale 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe
lamishaawe sawe thebabene yesathaale; thebabeneme yamisesathe sawe bezune malekaame nagare ba'eregethe tasatha ya'a'emerowoce baalabeetoce 'eneji (leelaawe) 'ayegasatseme
kametsewaateme maanenyaaweneme yalagasaacehutene wayeme kaselate yatasaalaacehutene 'alaahe yaaweqawaale labadaayoceme karadaatoce meneme yalaacaweme

metsewaatocene betegaletsu 'ereswa menenyaa malekaame naate betedabeqwaatenaa ladekxoce betesathwateme 'eresu lanaaneta balaache nawe kaxaathi'atocaacehume ka'enaaneta yaabesaale 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

'enaresune maaqenaate ba'aneta laaye yalabeheme gene 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe yaaqanaale kaganezabeme yametelagesute (menedaawe) lanafesocaacehu nawe ya'alaaheneme fite (wedeetaawene) lamafalage 'eneji 'atelagesume kaganezabeme yametelagesute hulu (menedaawe) wadanaaneta yemolaale 'enaanetame 'atebadalume

(yametematsawetute) la'enaziyaa ba'alaahe manegade (lamataagale silu) lataagadute dekxoce nawe bamedere makxeedene 'ayecelume (lemanaane) kamathethabaqaacawe (yatanasaa) yamaayaaweqe sawe habetaamoce naacawe belo yetharatheraacawaale bameleketaacawe taaweqaacawaalahe sawocene baceketaa 'ayelamenume kaganezabeme yametelagesute 'alaahe 'eresune `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaa ganezabocaacawene baleelitenaa baqane badebeqeme bageletseme yamilagesu la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede menedaacawe 'alaacawe ba'enaresume laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme 'enaresume 'ayaazenume

'enaziyaa 'araathaane yamibalu yaa sayethaane kamanekaatu yatanasaa yamithelawe sawe (ka'awedequ) 'enedaminasaa bethee 'eneje (kamaqaaberaacawe) 'ayenasume yehe 'enaresu mashathe ya'araathaa bethee becaa nawe bamaalataacawe nawe gene mashathene 'alaahe faqedwale 'araathaaneme 'ereme 'aderegwaale kageetaaweme gesaatsee yamathaalatenaa yatakalakala sawe laresu (kamakalekalu bafite) yaalafawe 'alawe nagarume wada 'alaahe nawe; ('araathaane wada mabelaate) yatamalasame sawe 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe
'alaahe 'araathaane (barakatune) yaathafaale metsewaatoceneme yaafaafaale 'alaaheme xaathatanyaa kahhaadine hulu 'ayewademe

'enaziyaa yaamanu malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru solaateneme yaasetakaakalu zakaaneme yasathu lanaresu bageetaacawe zanede menedaacawe 'alaacawe ba'enaresume laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme 'enaresume 'ayaazenume
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru ka'araathaame yaqarawene tawu 'amaanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu (tathaneqaqu)
(yataazazaacehutene) baateszarume ka'alaahenaa kamaleketanyaawe bakxonace thore (mawagaataacehune) `ewaqu betetsatsatume la'enaaneta yaganezabocaacehu waanaawoce 'alwacehu 'atebadelume 'atebadalumeme
yadekxenate baalabeete yakxoname (baala`edaa) sawe binore 'emaagenyate derase maaqoyate nawe (bamamaare) mamatsewataacehume la'enaaneta balaache nawe yametaawequ betekxonu (teszarutaalaacehu)
ba'eresume wesethe wada 'alaahe yametemalasubatenenaa kaziyaame 'enaresu yamaayebadalu sihonu nafese hulu yaszaraacewene szeraa yametemolaabatene qane tathaneqaqu

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'eseka tawasana gizee derase ba`edaa batawaawaalaacehu gizee tsaafute tsahhafime bamakaakalaacehu batekekele yetsaafe tsahhafime 'alaahe 'eneda 'asaawaqawe matsaafene 'enebi 'ayebale yetsaafeme yaame baresu laaye `edaawe yaalabate sawe baqaalu yaasetsefe 'alaaheneme geetaawene yeferaa ka'eresume (kaalabate `edaa) meneneme 'ayaagudele yaame baresu laaye `edaawe yaalabate qile, wayeme dakaamaa, wayeme baqaalu maasetsaafene yamaayecele bikxone waabiwe batekekele yaasetsefelate kawanedocaacehume hulatene mesekeroce 'asemasekeru hulateme wanedoce baayekxonu kamesekeroce sikxonu kametewaduwaacawe yakxonune 'anede wanedenaa 'anedanyaawaa seterasaa 'anedanyaayetu leelaawaane taasetaawesaate zanede hulate seetoce (yemasekeru) mesekeroceme batatharu gizee 'enebi 'ayebalu (`edaawe) teneshe wayeme teleqe bikxoneme 'eseka gizeewe derase yametetsefute kamakxone 'atesalecu 'enedihe maaderagaacehu 'alaahe zanede bathaame tekekele lamesekerenateme 'aragaagaache laalamatharaatharaacehume bathaame qerebe nawe gene bamakaakalaacehu 'eje baje yameteqabaabalwate negede betekxone baatetsefuwaate banaaneta laaye xaathi'aate yalabaacehume batashaashaathaacehume gizee 'asemasekeru tsahhafime mesekereme (baala gudaayu gaare) 'ayegodaadu (yehenene) beteszarume 'eresu ba'enaaneta (yamithagaa) 'amatse nawe 'alaaheneme feru 'alaaheme yaasaaweqaacexwaale 'alaaheme nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawe

baguzome laaye betekxonunaa tsahhafine baataaganyu yatachabathu matamaamanyaawocene yaazu kafilaacehume kafilune biyaamene yaa yataamanawe sawe 'adaraawene yaaderese 'alaaheneme geetaawene yeferaa mesekerenateneme 'atedabequ yamidabeqaateme sawe 'eresu lebu xaathi'aatanyaa nawe 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe

basamaayaate wesethenaa bamedereme wesethe yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe banafesocaacehu wesethe yaalawene betegaletsu wayeme betedabequte 'alaahe baresu yeqothaatharaacexwaale lamishaaweme sawe yemeraale yamishaaweneme sawe yeqathaale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

maleketanyaawe kageetaawe wada resu batawaradawe 'amana me'emenocume ('enedazihu) hulume ba'alaahe, bamalaa`eketume, bamatsaahhefetume, bamaleketanyocume kamaleketanyocu <<ba'anedeme makaakale 'anelayeme>> (yamilu sikxonu) 'amanu <<samaane; taazazeneme geetaacene hoye! mehheratehene ('eneshaalane) mamalashaame wadaaneta becaa nawe>> 'alume:

'alaahe nafesene kacelotaawaa balaaye 'ayaasegadedaateme laresewaa yaszaraacewe 'alaate baresewaame laaye yaafaraacewe (xathi'ate) 'alabaate (balu) - geetaacene hoye! benerasaa wayeme benesete 'ateyaazane; ('ateqethaane) geetaacene hoye! kabaade shakemene ka'enyaa bafite banabarute laaye 'enedachaanekawe ba'enyaa laaye 'atechaanebene geetaacene hoye! lanyaame baresu celotaa yaleelanene nagare 'ataashakemane ka'enyaame yeqeretaa 'aderege la'enyaame mehherate 'aderege 'ezaneleneme; waabiyaacene 'aneta nahenaa bakahhaadiwoce hhezeboce laayeme 'eredaane
'a.la.ma ('alife laame mime);
'alaahe karesu basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame ('eresu) hheyaawe hulune nagare 'asetanaabaari nawe
karesu bafite yaalutene matsaahhefete yamiyaaragaagethe sikxone matsehhafune (qure'aanene) baaneta laaye kafaafelo ba'ewenate 'awarada taweraatenenaa nejileneme 'aweredwale

(kaqure'aane) bafite lasawoce mari 'aderego ('awaradaacawe) fureqaaneneme 'awarada 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe ta`aameraatoce yakaadu la'enaresu beretu qethaate 'alaacawe 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi yamabaqale baalabeete nawe
'alaahe bamedereme basamaayeme meneme nagare baresu laaye 'ayesawareme
'eresu yaa bamaahhetsanoce wesethe 'enedamishaa 'aderego yamiqaretsaacehu nawe ka'eresu basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'eresu yaa ba'aneta laaye matsehhafune yaawarada nawe ka'eresu (kamatsehhafu) geletse yakxonu 'aneqatsoce 'alelu 'enasu yamatsehhafu maszaratoce naacawe leeloceme tamasaasaayoce 'alelu 'enaziyaamaa balebocaacawe wesethe themate yaalabaacawe sawoce maasaasaatene lamafalagenaa tecetune lamafalage karesu yatamasaasalawene yekataatalaalu (tekekelanyaa) tecetuneme 'alaahe becaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayaaweqaweme ba`eweqateme yathalaqute <<baresu 'amenanaale; hulume kageetaacene zanede nawe>> yelaalu ya'a'emero baalabeetoceme 'eneje (leelaawe) 'ayegasatseme
('enasume yelaalu) - <<geetaacene hoye! qenune manegade kamaraakxane baxwaalaa lebocaacenene 'ataazamebelebene ka'aneta zanede yakxonane cerotaame lanyaa sethane 'aneta bathaame lagaase nahenaa >>
<<geetaacene hoye! 'aneta baresu (lamamethaatu) therethere yaleelabate bakxona qane sawene hulu sabesaabi nahe menegizeeme 'alaahe qatharowene 'ayaafaresemenaa >>
'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce ganezabocaacawenaa lejocaacawe ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneme 'ayaasetheluwaacaweme 'enaziyaame 'enaresu ya'esaate maagadowoce naacawe

(lemaadaacawe hulu) 'enedafare`one beetasabenaa 'eneda'enaziyaa kabafitaacawe 'enedanabarute hhezeboce lemaade nawe ba'aneqatsocaacene 'asetabaabalu 'alaaheme baxaathi'atocaacawe yaazaacawe 'alaaheme qethaataberetu nawe
la'enaziyaa lakaadute sawoce balaacawe - <<baqerebe gizee teshanafulaacehu wada gahanameme tesabasabaalaacehu menethaafitume mene tekafaa!>>

(yabadere qane) batagaathamute hulate cheferoce lanaaneta ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alela 'anedanyaawaa cheferaa ba'alaahe manegade tegaadalaalace leelaayetume kahhaadi naate kahhaadiwocu ('amaanyocune) ba`aayene 'asetayaayate 'ethefaacawene kxonawe yaayuwaacawaale 'alaaheme baredaataawe yamishaawene sawe yaabarataale bazihe wesethe lamaasetawaale baalabeetoce ba'eregethe magasachaa 'alabate

kaseetoce, kawanedoce lejoceme, kawareqenaa kabere, katakaamacu ganezaboceme, katasamaaru farasoceme, kagemale kakabetenaa kafeyaleme, ka'azemaraame yakxonu felaagotocene mawedade lasawoce tashalama yehe hulu yaqerebitu hheyewate mathaqamiyaa nawe 'alaaheme 'eresu zanede malekaame mamalashaa (ganate) 'ala

<<kazihe hulu nagare yamibalethene lenegaraacehune>> balaacawe ('eresume) <<la'enaziyaa latathanaqaqute sawoce bageetaacawe zanede baszeraacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe ganatoce bawesethwa hulegizee nawaariwoce sikxonu netsuhhe yatadaragu misetoceme, ka'alaaheme yakxona wedeetaa 'alaacawe 'alaaheme baarocune tamalekaace nawe >>
('enaresume) 'enaziyaa - <<geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa 'amanene xathi'atocaaceneneme la'enyaa maare; ya'esaateneme qethaate thabeqane>> yamilu naacawe
taagaashoce 'ewenatanyoceme taazaazhoceme lagaasocenaa baleelite macharashaawoce mehheratene lamaanyoce naacawe

'alaahe bamaasetakaakale yaqoma ('asetanaabaari) sikxone ka'eresu basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yaleela makxonune masakara malaa'eketocenaa ya`eweqate baalabeetoceme ('enedazihu masakaru) ka'eresu basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'alaahe zanede (yatawadada) haayemaanote selaame becaa nawe 'enaziyaame matsehhafune yatasathute sawoce bamakaakalaacawe laalawe meqanyenate `eweqatu kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa 'eneje 'aletalayaayume ba'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce yamikede 'alaahe meremaraawe fathaane nawe

bikaraakaruheme - <<fiteene la'alaahe sathahu; yatakatalunyeme sawoce ('enedazihu la'alaahe sathu)>> balaacawe la'enaziyaame matsehhafene latasathute sawocenaa lamahhayemocu - <<salamaacehune>> balaacawe bisalemume ba'eregethe tamaru 'emebi bilume ba'aneta laaye yaalabehe maaderase becaa nawe 'alaaheme baarocune tamalekaace nawe
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yamikedu nabiyaateneme yaala 'agebaabe yamigadelu kasawoceme wesethe 'enaziyaane batekekelanyaanate yamiyaazutene yamigadelu ba'asaamaami qethaate 'abeseraacawe
'enaziyaa baqerebitunaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame szeraawocaacawe yatabalaashu naacawe la'enaresume meneme radaatoce yalwacaweme

wada 'enaziyaa kamatsehhafu (temeherete) `edelene wada tasathute sawoce 'alaayahemene wada 'alaahe matsehhafe bamakaakalaacawe yefarede zanede yetharaalu kaziyaame ka'enasu gamisocu 'enaresu ('ewenatune) yatawu kxonawe yeshashaalu
yekxa 'enaresu <<'esaate yataqotharu qanocene 'eneje 'atenakaaneme>> bamaalataacawe nawe bahaayemaanotaacaweme yeqathaathefute yanabarute nagare 'ataalalaacawe
baresu (mamethaate) therethere yaleelabate bakxonawe qane basabasabenaacawenaa nafese hulu yaszaraacewene szeraa batamolaace gizee 'enedeete yekxonaalu 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
