(muhhamade hoye!) bale - <<yanegesenaa baalabeete yakxoneke 'alaahe hoye! lameteshaawe sawe negeszenaane tesathaalahe kameteshaaweme sawe negeszenaane tegafefaalahe yameteshaaweneme sawe taaleqaalahe yameteshaaweneme sawe taawaaredaalahe malekaame nagare hulu ba'ejehe (bacelotaahe) nawe; 'aneta banagaru hulu laaye caaye nahenaa >>

leelitune baqane wesethe taasegabaalahe qanuneme baleelitu wesethe taasegabaalahe hheyaaweneme kamute wesethe taawathaalahe muteneme kahheyaawe wesethe taawathaalahe lameteshaaweme sawe yaalagemete tesathaalahe

me'emenaane kahhaadiwocene kame'emenaane leelaa radaatoce 'aderegawe 'ayeyaazu yekxeeneneme yamiszaraa sawe ka'alaahe (haayemaanote) bameneme wesethe 'ayedalame ka'enaresu mathethabaqene betethabaqu 'eneji 'alaaheme nafesune (quthaawene) yaasethanaqeqaacexwaale mamalashaame wada 'alaahe becaa nawe

<<badaratocaacehu wesethe yaalawene nagare betedabequ wayeme betegaletzute 'alaahe yaaweqawaale basamaayaate yaalawenenaa bamedereme yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe>> (bale)

nafese hulu kamalekaame nagare yaszaraacewene yaqaraba kxono yametaaganyebatene qane ('asetaawese) kamathefome yaszaraacewe baresewaanaa baresu (baxathi'atewaa) makaakale bathaame yasafaa reqate binore temanyaalace 'alaahe nafesune yaasethanaqeqaacexwaale 'alaaheme labaarocu ruxeruxe nawe
balaacawe - <<'alaahene yametewadu 'enedakxonaacehu takatalunye; 'alaahe yewadaacexwaalenaa xathi'aatocaacehuneme lanaaneta yemeraalenaa 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe >>
<<'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene taazazu beteshashume 'alaahe kahhaadiwocene 'ayewademe>> balaacawe
'alaahe 'adamene, nuhheneme, yaberaahimeneme beetasabe, ya`imeraaneneme beetasabe ba`aalamaate laaye maratha
kafilewaa kakafilu yakxonace zereyaa 'aderego (marathaate) 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

ya`imeraane baalabeete (hhanaa) <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee bahodee wesethe yaalawene (tzenese kaszeraa) natsaa yatadaraga sikxone la'aneta tasaaleku ka'eneeme taqabale 'aneta samiwe `awaaqiwe nahenaa>> baalace gizee ('asetaawese)

bawaladacaateme gizee - <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee seete kxonaa waladexwaate >> 'alaaheme yawaladacewene `awaaqi nawe <<wanedeme 'eneda seete 'ayedalame 'eneeme mareyame beyee seme 'awathaahulaate 'eneeme 'esewaaneme zereyaawaaneme kataragamawe sayethaane ba'aneta 'ethabeqaacawaalahu>> 'alace

geetaawaame badahenaa 'aqabaabale taqabalaate bamalekaame 'asetadaadageme 'afaafaate zakariyaame 'asaadagaate; zakariyaa bareswa laaye bamekxuraabwa bagabaa quthere 'eresewaa zanede sisaayene 'aganya <<mareyame hoye! yehe la'aneci kayate nawe>> 'alaate <<'eresu ka'alaahe zanede nawe 'alaahe lamishaawe sawe sisaayune yaala dekaame yesathaale>> 'alacewe
'eziyaa zanede zakariyaa geetaawene lamana <<geetaayee hoye! ka'aneta zanede malekaame zarene lanee sethanye 'aneta tsalotene saminahenaa>> 'ala

'eresume batsalote maaderashaawe kefele qomo sitsaleye malaa'ekete tharaacewe <<'alaahe bayahheyaa ka'alaahe bakxona qaale yamiyaaragaagethe geetaame denegeleme kadagaagocu nabiyeme sikxone yaabaserehaale>> bamaalate (malaa'ekete tharaacewe)

<<geetaayee hoye! 'enee 'erejenaa ba'eregethe yadarasabenye sekxone baaletabeeteeme mahhane setehone la'enee 'enedeete leje yenoranyaale 'ala (male'akume) 'enedazihu 'alaahe yamishaawene nagare yeszaraale>> 'alawe

<<geetaayee hoye! la'enee meleketene 'aderegelenye>> 'ala <<meleketehe szosete qane batheqeshaa bikxone 'eneje sawocene 'alamaanaagarehe nawe geetaaheneme babezu 'awesaa bamaataanaa bathwateme 'awadesawe>> 'alawe
malaa'eketeme yaalutene ('asetaawese) <<mareyame hoye! 'alaahe ba'eregethe marathasha 'anatsaasheme ba`aalamaate seetoceme laaye marathashe >>
<<mareyame hoye! lageetaashe taazazhi segajime ka'agonebaashocume gaare 'agonebeshi >>

yekxa wada 'aneta yamenaawaredawe yakxona karuqe wareewoce nawe mareyameneme maane 'enedamiyaasaadege bere'ocaacawene (la`ethaa) bathaalu gizee 'enasu zanede 'alenabarekeme bamikaraakarume gizee 'enasu zanede 'alenabarekeme

malaa'ekete yaalutene ('asetaawese) - <<mareyame hoye! 'alaahe karesu bakxonawe qaale semu 'alemasihhe `isaa yamareyame leje bazihe `aalamenaa bamacharashaaweme `aalame yatakabara kabaalamwaloceme bakxona (leje) yaabasereshaale >>
<<bahhetzaanenatunaa bakafanisaanatu sawocune yaanagaageraale kamalekaamocume nawe>> ('alaate)

-geetaayee hoye! sawe yaalenakaanye sekxone lanee 'enedeete leje yenoranyaale 'alace nagaru 'enedaaleshewe nawe 'alaahe yamishaawene yefatheraale 'anedaacene bashaa gizee laresu kxune yelawaale; wadiwenume yekxonaale 'alaate
tsehhefatenenaa thebabeneme taweraatenenaa nejileneme yaasetamerawaale

wada 'eseraa'eeleme lejoce maleketanyaa yaadaregawaale (yelaaleme) - <<'enee kageetaayee zanede bata`aamere wada 'enaaneta mathaahu 'enee lanaaneta kacheqaa 'eneda wafe qeretze 'efatheraalahu baresume 'etanafesebataalahu ba'alaaheme faqaade wafe yekxonaale ba'alaaheme faqaade `ewere kxono yatawaladane, lametsanyaaneme 'adenaalahu mutaaneneme 'asenasaalahu yametebalutenenaa babeetaacehu yametaadalebuteneme hulu 'enageraacexwaalahu yametaamenu 'enedakxonaacehu la'enaaneta bazihe wesethe ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alabate >>

<<kataweraateme ka'enee bafite yaalawene yaaragaagathehu sekxone yaziyaaneme ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yatadaragawene kafile la'enaaneta 'efaqede zanede (mathaaxwaacehu) kageetaacehume bakxona taamere mathaahuwaacehu 'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme >>
<<'alaahe geetaayeenaa geetaacehu nawe; selazihe tagazute; yehe qathetanyaa manegade nawe>> ('alaacawe)

`isaa kanaresu kehedate batasamaaweme gizee - <<wada 'alaahe (tachamerawe) radaatocee 'enamaane naacawe>> 'ala; hhawaareyaate - <<'enyaa ya'alaahe radaatoce nane; ba'alaahe 'amenanaale; 'enyaame tekekelanyaa taazaazhoce makxonaacenene masekere>> 'alu
<<geetaacene hoye! baawaradekxawe 'amanene; maleketanyaaweneme takatalene; kamasekaariwoceme gaare mazegebane>> ('alu)
('ayehudoceme) 'adamu 'alaaheme 'ademaacawene malasabaacawe 'alaaheme ka'ademanyoce hulu balaache nawe

'alaaheme baala gizee ('asetaawese) `isaa hoye! 'enee wasaajihe wada 'eneeme 'aneshihe nanye kanaziyaame kakaadute sawoce 'atherihe nanye 'enaziyaaneme yatakataluhene 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase kanaziyaa kakaadute balaaye 'aderaagi nanye kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada'enee nawe baresu telayaayubateme banabaraacehute nagare bamakaakalaacehu 'efaredaalahu
<<'enaziyaamaa yakaadutene sawoce baqerebitu `aalamenaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame beretune qethaate 'eqathaacawaalahu la'enaresume meneme radaatoce yalwacaweme >>
'enaziyaame yaamanutemaa malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszarute menedaawocaacawene yemolaalaacawaale 'alaaheme badaayocene 'ayewademe
yehe kata`aameraatocenaa thebabene kayaazawe tagesaatse sikxone ba'aneta laaye 'enaanabawaalane
'alaahe zanede ya`isaa mesaalee 'eneda 'adaame bethee nawe ka`afare fatharawe kaziyaame laresu (sawe) <<kxune>> 'alawe; kxoname
yehe kageetaahe zanede yakxona 'ewenate nawe katatharaathaariwocume 'atekxune

`eweqatume kamathaalehe baxwaalaa baresu (ba`isaa) yatakaraakaruhene sawoce <<nu; lejocaacenenenaa lejocaacehune, seetocaacenenenaa seetocaacehuneme, nafesocaacenenenaa nafesocaacehuneme 'enetheraa kaziyaame 'athebeqane 'alaahene 'enelamene; ya'alaaheneme quthaa baweshataamocu laaye 'enaaderege>> balaacawe
yehe 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ewenatanyaa taarike nawe 'amelaakeme ka'alaahe basetaqare meneme yalame 'alaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe
(kamaamane) 'enebi bilume 'alaahe 'athefiwocune ba'eregethe `awaaqi nawe

yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale tekekele wada kxonace qaale nu ('ereswame) 'alaahene 'eneje leelaane laanegazaa, baresume meneneme laanaagaaraa, kafilaaceneme kafilune ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete 'aderego laayeyeze nawe; balaacawe 'emebi bilume - 'enyaa muselimoce makxonaacenene masekeru balwacawe
'enaaneta yamatsehhafu sawoce hoye! baberaahime lamene tekaraakaraalaacehu taweraatenaa nejileme karesu baxwaalaa 'eneje 'aletawaradume lebe 'ataadaregumene balaacawe

nequ! 'enaaneta 'enaziyaa la'enaaneta baresu `eweqate baalaacehu nagare yatakaraakaraacehu naacehu taadiyaa la'enaaneta baresu `eweqate baleelaacehu nagare lamene tekaraakaraalaacehu 'alaaheme yaaweqaale 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme
beraahime yehudaawime keresetiyaaneme 'alenabarame gene wada qathetanyaawe haayemaanote yatazanabala muselime nabara ka'agaariwoceme 'alenabarame
kasawe hulu baberaahime tagabiwocu 'enaziyaa yatakatalutenaa yehe nabiye 'enaziyaame yaamanute naacawe 'alaaheme yame'emenaane radaate nawe
kamatsehhafu baalabeetoce yakxonu cheferoce nafesocaacawene 'eneji yamaayaasaasetu sikxonu liyaasaasetuwaacehu tamanyu gene 'ayaawequme
yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! 'enaaneta yametaawequ setekxonu ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce lamene tekedaalaacehu
<<yamatsehhafu sawoce hoye! 'ewenatune baweshate lamene teqalaaqelaalaacehu 'ewenatuneme 'enaaneta yametaawequ setekxonu lamene tedabeqaalaacehu>>

kamatsehhafu baalabeetoce yakxonu cheferoceme 'alu - <<banaziyaa ba'amanute laaye batawaradawe (qure'aane) baqanu majamariyaa laaye 'emanubate bamacharashaaweme kaadute 'enaresu limalasu yekajalaalenaa >>

'enaaneta yatasathaacehutene bethee 'anedeme sawe masathatune wayeme 'egeetaacehu zanede yamikaraakaruwaacehu makxonene haayemaanotaacehune latakatala sawe bikxone 'eneji 'atemanu ('ategelatsu 'alu) <<mameriyaawe ya'alaahe mameriyaa becaa nawe>> balaacawe <<cerotaa ba'alaahe 'eje nawe lamishaawe yesathawaale 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe
bacerotaawe (banabiyenate) yamishaawene yemarethaale 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe

kamatsehhafu sawoceme babezu ganezabe betaamenawe wadaaneta yamimalese sawe 'alela ka'enasume ba'anede dinaare 'enekwaa betaamenawe; hule gizee baresu laaye yametethabaabaqe kaalekxoneke basetaqare yamaayemalese sawe 'alela <<yehe bamahaayemenaane (bamenaadaregawe) ba'enyaa laaye meneme manegade yalabeneme>> selamilu nawe 'enaresu 'eyaawaqume ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yenaagaraalu
'ayedalame ('alabaacawe 'eneje) baqaale kidaanu yamolaanaa yatathanaqaqa sawe 'alaahe thenequqocene yewadaale

'enazihe ba'alaahe qaale kidaanenaa bamahhalaawocaacawe theqitene waagaa yamilawethu 'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame meneme `edele yalaacaweme bateneszaa'ee qaneme 'alaahe 'ayaanagaageraacaweme wada 'enaresume 'ayemalakateme 'ayaanatsaacawememe lanasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

ka'enasume 'eresu kamatsehhafu yaayedala sikxone kamatsehhafu makxonune 'enedetaasebu bamatsehhafu melaasocaacawene yamiyaathaamemu kefeloce 'alu 'eresu ka'alaahe zanede yaalekxona sikxone <<'eresu ka'alaahe zanede naweme>> yelaalu 'enaresu yamiyaawequ sikxonume ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yenaagaraalu

lamaaneme sawe 'alaahe matsehhafenenaa thebabene nabiyenateneme lisathawenaa kaziyaame lasawoce <<ka'alaahe leelaa la'enee baaroce kxonu>> lile 'ayegabaaweme <<gene matsehhafene yametaasetameru banabaraacehutenaa yametaathanume banabaraacehute ba`eweqataacehu szariwoce kxunu>> (yelaacawaale)
malaa'eketenenaa nabiyaateneme 'amaaleketoce 'aderegaacehu 'enedeteyezu liyaazaacehu ('ayegabaaweme) 'enaaneta muselimoce kakxonaacehu baxwaalaa bakehedate yaazaacexwaalene

'alaahe yanabiyaatene qaale kidaane kamatsehhafenaa kathebabe sathecaacehu kaziyaame <<ka'enaaneta gaare laalawe (matsehhafe) yamiyaaragaagethe maleketanyaa bimathaalaacehu baresu ba'eregethe 'enedametaamenubate ba'eregetheme 'enedeteradute sile bayaaza gizee ('asetaawese) 'aragaagathaacehune baziheme laaye kidaaneene yaazaacehumene>> 'alaacawe <<'aragaagathene>> 'alu <<'enegediyaase masekeru; 'eneeme ka'enaaneta gaare kamasekaariwocu nanye>> 'alaacawe
kaziheme baxwaalaa yashashu sawoce 'enaziyaa 'enasu 'amatsanyocu naacawe
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalu hulu; bawedeme bagedeme laresu yataazazu wadaresume yamimalasu sikxonu (kahhaadiwoce) ka'alaahe haayemaanote leelaane yefalegaalune

<<ba'alaahe 'amanene ba'enyaa laaye batawaradaweme (baqure'aane), baberaahimenaa basemaa`ileme, basehhaaqeme, bayaa`eqobeme, banagadoceme laaye batawaradawe; lamusaanaa la`isaame lanabiyaateme hulu kageetaacawe batasathawe ('amanene) ka'enaresu makaakale 'anedeneme 'anelayeme 'enyaa la'eresu taazaazhoce nane>> bale
kaselaame leelaa haayemaanotene yamifalege sawe fatsemo karesu taqabaaye yalaweme 'eresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame kakasaariwocu nawe

ka'emenataacawenaa maleketanyaaweme 'ewenate makxonune kamasakaru yataberaaru 'aneqatsoceme kamathulaacawe baxwaalaa yakaadune hhezeboce 'alaahe 'enedeete yaaqanaale! 'alaahe badaayoceneme hhezeboce 'ayaaqanaame
'enaziyaa qethaataacawe ya'alaahenaa yamalaa'ekete yasawoceme hulu regemaane ba'enasu laaye makxone nawe
bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sikxonu qethaatume kanasu laaye 'ayeqaalalelaacaweme 'enasume qane 'ayesesathume
'enaziyaa kazihe baxwaalaa nesehhaa yagabunaa (szeraacawene) yaasaamaru siqaru ('enazihenese yemeraacawaale); 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
'enaziyaa ka'emenataacawe baxwaalaa yakaadu kaziyaame kehedatene yachamaru tsatsataacawe fatsemo taqabaaye yalaateme 'enaziyaame yatasaasaatu 'enaresu naacawe

'enaziyaa yakaadunaa 'enaresume bakehedataacawe laaye 'enedaalu yamotu ka'enasu ka'anedaacawe bamedere mulu yakxona wareqe (binorawenaa) baresu bibazhebateme 'enekwaa fatsemo taqabaayene 'ayaaganyeme 'enaziyaa la'enaresu yamiyaasaqaaye qethaate 'alaacawe lanaresume meneme radaatoce yalwacaweme
yametewadutene 'esekametelagesu derase bagone szeraa (waagaawene) 'ataaganyume kameneme nagare betelagesu 'alaahe yaaweqawaale

taweraate kamawaradewaa bafite 'eseraa'eele baraasu laaye 'ereme kaadaragawe nagare basetaqare megebe hulu la'eseraa'eele lejoce yatafaqada nabare 'ewenatanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu taweraatene 'amethu 'anebebuwaateme balaacawe
kaziheme baxwaalaa ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yaqathaathafu sawoce 'enaziyaa 'enaresu badalanyoce naacawe
<<'alaahe 'ewenatene tanaagara yaberaahimeneme manegade wada 'ewenate yaazanabala sikxone takatalu ka'agaariwocume 'alenabarame>> balaacawe
lasawoce (matsalayaa) majamariyaa yatanorawe beete berukenaa la`aalamaate hulu mamariyaa sikxone yaa babakaahe (bamakaa) yaalawe nawe

bawesethu geletse yakxonu ta`aameraatoce yaberaahhimeme maqomiyaa 'alela wada wesethu yagabaa sawe tsathetanyaa yekxonaale la'alaaheme basawoce laaye wadaresu makxeedene bacaala hulu laaye beetune magobenyate gedeetaa 'alabaacawe yakaadame sawe 'alaahe ka`aalamaate hulu yatabeqaaqaa nawe
<<yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu laaye `awaaqi sikxone ba'alaahe ta`aameraate lamene tekedaalaacehu>> balaacawe

<<yamatsehhafu sawoce hoye! 'enaaneta masekaariwoce kxonaacehu ka'alaahe manegade mathemamwane yametefalegwaate setekxonu yaamanane sawe lamene tekalakelaalaacehu 'alaaheme kametesarute nagare hulu zanegi 'ayedalame>> balaacawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kanaziyaa matsehhafune katasathute sawoce kafilune betetaazazu ka'emenataacehu baxwaalaa kahhaadiwoce 'aderegawe yemalesuwaacexwaale

ya'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababu sikxonu maleketanyaaweme bawesethaacehu yaala sikxone 'enaaneta 'enedeete tekedaalaacehu ba'alaaheme yamithabaqe sawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade ba'eregethe tamaraa
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene tagabiwene mathaneqaqe tathaneqaqute 'enaanetame muselimoce kxonaacehu 'eneje 'atemutu

ya'alaaheneme (yamaamane) gamade hulaacehume yaazu 'atelayaayume thabanyoceme banabaraacehu gizee ba'enaaneta laaye (yawaalawene) ya'alaahene tsagaa 'asetaawesu balebocaacehume makaakale 'asemaamaa batsagaaweme wanedemaamaacoce kxonaacehu ba'esaate gudegwaade 'afaafeme laaye nabaraacehu ka'eresewaame 'adaanaacehu 'enedazihu temaru zanede 'alaahe la'enaaneta 'aneqatsocune yaaberaaraale
kanaanetame wada bago nagare yamitharu bamalekaame szeraame yamiyaazu kakefu nagareme yamikalakelu hhezeboce yenuru 'enaziyaame 'enasu yamidenu naacawe
'enedanaziyaame geletse ta`aameraate kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa 'enedatalayaayutenaa 'eneda tachaqaachaqute 'atekxunu 'enaziyaame la'enaresu taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacawe

fitoce yamiyaabarubatene fitoceme yamithaqurubatene qane ('asetaawese) 'enaziyaa fitocaacawe yathaqorutemaa <<ka'emenataacehu baxwaalaa kaadaacehune tekedute banabaraacehute nagare qethaatune qemasu>> (yebaalaalu)
'enaziyaame fitocaacawe yaabarutemaa ba'alaahe cerotaa (ganate) wesethe naacawe 'enaresu bawesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
yehece ba'aneta laaye ba'ewenate yamenaanabaate setekxone ya'alaahe ta`aameraate naate 'alaaheme la`aalamaate badalene yamishaa 'ayedalame
basamaayaate yaalawenaa bamedere yaalaweme hulu ya'alaahe nawe nagaroceme hulu wada 'alaahe becaa yemalasaalu

lasawoce katagalatsace hhezebe hulu balaache kxonaacehu batsedeqe nagare taazaalaacehu; kamathefome nagare taazaalaacehu; ba'alaaheme ('anedenate) taamenaalaacehu yamatsehhafume sawoce baamanu noro lanaresu yatashaala bakxona nabare kanaresu 'amaanyoce 'alu 'abezaanyocaacawe gene 'amatsanyoce naacawe
maasekafaatene 'eneje fatsemo 'ayegoduwaacehume biwaaguwaacehume jarebaawocene yaazurulaacexwaale (yeshashaalu) kaziyaame 'ayeradume

yateme bataganyubate seferaa ka'alaahe bakxona qaale kidaane kasawoceme bakxona qaale kidaane (yatathabaqu) kaalekxonu basetaqare banaresu laaye weredate tamataacebaacawe ka'alaaheme bakxona quthaa tamalasu ba'enaresume laaye dekxenate tamataacebaacawe yekxa 'enaresu ba'alaahe ta`aameraate yekedu sela nabarunaa nabiyaateneme yaala hhege yegadelu selanabaru nawe yehe bamaamatsaacawenaa wasanene yetalaalafu selanabaru nawe
(yamatsehhafu sawoce hulu) 'ekule 'ayedalume kamatsehhafu sawoce qathe yaalu baleelite sa`aatoce 'enaresu yamisagedu kxonawe ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce yamiyaanabu hhezeboce 'alu
ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yaamenaalu batsedeqe nagareme yaazaalu kamathefo nagareme yekalakelaalu babago szeraawoceme yethaadafaalu 'enaziyaame kamalekaamocu naacawe
kabago szeraa maanenyaaweneme biszaru 'ayekaaduteme 'alaaheme thenequqocune `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce ganezabocaacawenaa lejocaacawe ka'alaahe (qethaate) 'enaresune meneneme 'ayaadenuwaacaweme 'enaziyaame ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu ba'eresewaa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe

yaziyaa bazihece baqerebitu hheyewate yamilagesute nagare mesaalee bawesethwa wereche yaalabaate nafaase nafesocaacawene yabadalune hhezeboce 'azemaraa 'enedanakaacenaa 'enedaathafaacewe bethee nawe 'alaaheme 'alebadalaacaweme gene nafesocaacawene yebadelaalu

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'enaaneta leelaa mesethiranyaane 'ateyaazu maabalaashatene 'ayegatulaacehume gudaataacehune yewadaalu thelaacaayetu ka'afocaacawe ba'eregethe tagalatsace lebocaacaweme yamidabequte yebalethe teleqe nawe lebe yametaadaregu 'enedakxonaacehu la'enaaneta maaberaariyaawocene ba'eregethe galatsene

'enaho 'enaaneta 'enaziyaa yametewaduwaacawe naacehu ('enasu) gene 'ayewaduwaacehume bamatsehhafume bahulume taamenaalaacehu baaganyuwaacehume gizee <<'amenanaale>> yelaalu baagalalume gizee kaquchetaacawe yatanasaa ba'enaaneta laaye `atseqocaacawene yenakesaalu <<baquchetaacehu mutu; 'alaahe leboce yaqwaatharutene `awaaqi nawenaa>> balaacawe

dage nagare betenakaacehu taasekafaacawaalace mathefome nagare betaaganyaacehu ba'ereswa yedasataalu betetaagasunaa betethanaqaqume tanekolaacawe meneme 'ayegodaacehume 'alaahe bamiszarute hulu (ba`eweqatu) kabaabi nawenaa
lame'emenocume lawegiyaa szeraawocene yametaazagaaje kxonahe kabeetasabehe bamaaladeke gizee ('asetaawese) 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe
ka'enaaneta hulate cheferoce 'alaahe radaataacawe sikxone lamaferaate baasabu gizee ('asetaawese) ba'alaaheme laaye becaa me'emenaanoce yemaku
babadereme 'enaaneta theqitoce kxonaacehu saala 'alaahe ba'eregethe radaacehu 'alaaheneme taamasagenu zanede ferute
lame'emenaane <<geetaacehu baszosete shihe malaa'ekete yatawaradu sikxonu biradaacehu 'ayebaqaacehumene>> bametele gizee ('asetaawese)
<<'awone betetaagasunaa betethanaqaqu kaziheme fethenataacawe (thalaatocaacehu) bimathubaacehu geetaacehu melekete baalaacawe 'amesete shihe malaa'ekete yeradaacexwaale >>
'alaaheme ('eredaataawene) la'enaaneta beseraatenaa lebocaacehu ba'eresu 'enediraku 'eneji 'alaadaragaweme deleme manesaate 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa kakxonawe 'alaahe zanede 'eneje kaleelaa 'ayedalame
(delene yaagonaatsafaacehu) ka'enaziyaa kakaadute kafilene liqorethe (liyaathafaa) wayeme liyaawaaredaacawenaa yaafaru kxonawe 'enedimalasu nawe
('alaahe) ba'enaresu laaye yeqeretaa 'esekiyaadarege wayeme 'enaresu badaayoce naacawenaa 'esekiqathaacawe derase laaneta kanagaru meneme yalaheme
basamaayaate yaalawe bamedereme yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe lamishaawe sawe yemeraale; yamishaaweneme sawe yeqathaale 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'araathaane yatanabaabaru 'ethefoce sikxonu 'atebelu tedenume zanede 'alaahene feru
yaaceneme lakahhaadiwoce yatadagasacewene 'esaate tathaneqaqu
yetaazanelaacehume zanede 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene taazazu
kageetaacehu wada kxonaceme mehheratenaa sefaatewaa 'eneda samaayaatenaa medere wada kxonace ganate 'alaahene lamifaru yatazagaajace setekxone tacaakolu
la'enaziyaa badeloteme kxona bacegere lamilagesute, qucheteneme gaciwoce kasawoceme yeqeretaa 'aderaagiwoce lakxonute (tadagesaalace) 'alaaheme bago szariwocene yewadaale

la'enaziyaame mathefo szeraane baszaru wayeme nafesocaacawene babadalu gizee 'alaahene yamiyaasetaawesunaa laxathi'atocaacawe mehheratene yamilamenu lakxonute ka'alaaheme leelaa xathi'atocene yamimere 'anedeme yala (basehhetate) baszaruteme laaye 'enaresu yamiyaawequ sikxonu yamaayezawateru lakxonute (tadagesaalace)
'enaziyaa menedaacawe kageetaacawe mehheratenaa bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu baszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe ganatoceme naacawe yaszariwoceme menedaa (ganate) menenyaa 'amaarace!
ka'enaaneta bafite deregitoce ba'eregethe 'alefawaale bamedereme laaye kxidu ya'asetabaabaayoceme fetsaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu
yehe lasawoce galaache; lathenequqoce marinaa gasaache nawe
'enaanetame yabalaayoce setekxonu me'emanaane 'enedakxonaacehu 'atesenafu; 'atezanume

qusele biyaaganyaacehu sawocuneme masalu qusele 'agenyetwacawaale yekxeceneme qanaate basawoce makaakale 'enaazawaaweraataalane ('enedetegasatsunaa) 'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene 'enediyaaweqe ('enedilaye) ka'enaanetame samaa`etaatene 'enediyeze nawe 'alaaheme badaayocene 'ayewademe
'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene (kaxathi'ate) liyaanatsaanaa kahhaadiwoceneme liyaathafaa nawe
ba'ewenatu 'alaahe kanaaneta 'enaziyaane yataagalutene saayaaweqe (saayelaye) taagaashocuneme saayaaweqe ganatene letegabu 'asabaacehune
(bathorenate laaye) mamoteneme saataaganyute bafite baregethe yametemanyute nabaraacehu 'enaanetame yametemalakatu setekxonu baregethe 'ayaacehute (taadiyaa lamene shashaacehu)

muhhamademe kabafitu maleketanyoce ba'eregethe yaalafu yakxona maleketanyaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame taadiyaa bimote wayeme bigadale wada xwaalaacehu tegalabathaalaacehune wadaxwaalaawe yamigalabatheme sawe 'alaahene meneme 'ayegodaame 'alaaheme 'amasegaanyocune ba'eregethe yemanadaale

lamaanenyaayetume nafese ba'alaahe ferede bikxone 'eneje letemote 'ayegabaateme (gizeeweme) tawaseno tatsefwale yaqerebituneme menedaa yamifalege sawe ka'eresewaa 'enesathawaalane yamacharashaayetuneme menedaa yamifalege sawe ka'eresewaa 'enesathawaalane; 'amasegaanyoceneme ba'eregethe 'enemanadaalane

kanabiyeme bezu liqaawenete karesu gaare kxonawe yatawaagu bezu naacawe ba'alaaheme manegade lamidaresebaacawe nagare 'alefarume; 'aledakamumeme (lathalaate) 'aletawaaradumeme 'alaaheme te`egesetanyocene yewadaale

negegeraacaweme <<geetaacene hoye! xaathi'atocaacenenenaa banagaraacene hulu wasane maalafaacenene la'enyaa maare, yezotaaceneneme 'adalaadele, bakahhaadiwoceme hhezeboce laaye 'eredaane>> maalataacawe 'eneje leelaa 'alenabarame
'alaaheme yaqerebitune menedaanaa yamacharashaayetune malekaame menedaa sathaacawe 'alaaheme bago 'aderaagiwocene yewadaale
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaziyaane yakaadutene sawoce betetaazazu wada xwaalaacehu yemalesuwaacexwaale kasaariwoce kxonaacehume tegalabathaalaacehu
('ayeradwacehume); yelequne 'alaahe becaa radaataacehu nawe 'eresume karadaatoce hulu balaache nawe

ba'enaziyaa bakaadute sawoce leboce wesethe 'alaahe ba'eresu 'aseraje yaalaawaradabatene nagare ba'alaahe bamaagaaraataacawe mekeneyaate ferehaatene 'enethelaalane manoriyaacaweme 'esaate naate yabadaayoceme manoriyaa mene tekafaa!

'alaaheme bafaqaadu bametechafachefwacawe gizee kidaanune ba'eregethe 'aragaagathalaacehu yametewaduteneme nagare kaasaayaacehu baxwaalaa bafaraacehu bate`ezaazume batachaqaachaqaacehunaa baamatsaacehu gizee ('eredaataawene kalakalaacehu) ka'enaaneta wesethe qerebitune `aalame yamishaa 'ala ka'enaanetame yamacharashaayetune `aalame yamishaa 'alela kaziyaame limokeraacehu ka'enaresu 'azoraacehu ba'eregetheme ka'enaaneta yeqeretaa 'adaragalaacehu 'alaaheme bame'emenaane laaye yacerotaa baalabeete nawe

maleketanyaawe kaxwaalaacehu yamitharaacehu sikxone reqaacehu bameteshashunaa ba'anedeme laaye yamaatezoru bakxonaacehu gizee ('asetaawesu) baamalathaacehunaa badarasabaacehume nagare 'enedetaazenu bahhasaabe laaye hhasaabene manadaacehu 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

kaziyaame kacheneqe baxwaalaa tsathetaane ka'enaaneta kafilocene yamishafenene 'eneqelefe ba'enaaneta laaye 'awarada kafilocume nafesocaacawe ba'eregethe 'asaasabwacawe 'ewenate yaalekxonawene yamahaayemenatene matharaathare ba'alaahe yetharaatharaalu; <<kanagaru la'enyaa meneme yalaneme>> yelaalu <<nagaru hulume la'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe la'aneta yamaayegaletsutene banafesocaacawe wesethe yedabeqaalu <<kanagaru la'enyaa 'anedaace banabarane noro 'ezihe baaletagadalene nabare>> yelaalu <<babeetaacehu wesethe bakxonaacehume noro 'enaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye magadale yatatsaafabaacawe wada mawedaqiyaacawe bawathu nabare>> balaacawe 'alaahe (feredune lifatsemenaa) badaratocaacehume wesethe yaalawene lifatene balebocaacehume wesethe yaalawene nagare ligaletse (yehene szaraa) 'alaaheme badaratoce wesethe yaalane hulu `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaa hulatu cheferoce bataganaanyu qane ka'enaaneta yashashute sawoce baziyaa baszarute kafile mekeneyaate yaasaasaataacawe sayethaane nawe 'alaaheme kanasu ba'eregethe yeqere 'ala 'alaahe mahhaari baqethaate yamaayecakule nawenaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enedanaziyaa 'eneda kaadutenaa sela wanedemocaacawe bamedere laaye batagwaazu wayeme zamaacoce bakxonu gizee <<'enyaa zanede banabaru noro baalemotume baaletagadalume nabare>> 'enedamilute 'atekxunu 'alaahe yehenene balebocaacawe wesethe tsatsate yaadaregebaacawe zanede (yehenene 'alu) 'alaaheme hheyaawe yaadaregaale; yegadelaaleme 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe
ba'alaaheme manegade betegadalu wayeme; betemotu ka'alaahe yakxonawe mehheratenaa 'ezenate ('enaresu) kamisabasebute habete ba'eregethe balaache nawe
betemotume wayeme betegadalu ba'eregethe wada 'alaahe becaa tesabasabaalaacehu

ka'alaaheme bakxonace cerotaa lazabekelaacawe `amala mathefo leba daraqeme bakxoneke noro kazuriyaahe batabatanu nabare ka'enaresume yeqere bale la'enaresume mehheratene lamenelaacawe banagarume hulu 'amaakeraacawe qurethe hhasaabeme baadaragehe gizee ba'alaahe laaye tamakaa 'alaahe baresu laaye tamakiwocene yewadaalenaa
'alaahe biradaacehu la'enaaneta 'ashanaafi yalame biyaawaaredaacehume yaa karesu (maawaarade) baxwaalaa yamiradaacehu maanawe ba'alaaheme laaye becaa me'emenaane yemaku

lanabiyeme salabaane madabaqe 'ayegabaaweme salabaaneme yamidabeqe sawe bateneszaa'ee qane badabaqawe nagare (tashakemo) yemathaale kaziyaame nafese hulu yaszeraawaane waagaa temolaalace 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
ya'alaahene wedeetaa yatakatala sawe ka'alaahe bakxona quthaa 'eneda tamalasanaa manoriyaawe gahaname 'eneda kxona sawe nawene mamalashaaweme mene yekafaa!
'enaresu 'alaahe zanede baala darajaawoce naacawe 'alaaheme yamiszarutene nagare tamalekaace nawe

'alaahe bame'emenaane laaye kagosaacawe yakxonane; ba'enaresu laaye 'aneqatsocune yamiyaanabe, yamitharaacaweme, matsehhafenenaa thebabene yamiyaasetameraacaweme yakxonane male'eketanyaa bawesethaacawe balaaka gizee; ba'eregethe lagasalaacawe 'enaresume kaziyaa bafite bageletse sehetate wesethe nabaru

hulate betheewocewaane ba'eregethe yaaganyaacehu yakxonace makaraa (mathaqaate) baaganyacaacehu gizee <<yehe kayate nawe>> 'alaacehune <<'eresu kanafesocaacehu zanede nawe >> 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa balaacawe
hulatu cheferoceme batagaathamu qane yadarasabaacehu ba'alaahe faqaade nawe me'emenaaneneme (lifatenenaa) ligaletse nawe

'enaziyaaneme yanafaqutenenaa lanaresu <<nu; ba'alaahe manegade tagaadalu; wayeme takalaakalu;>> yatabaalutene ligaletse nawe <<mawaagaate (manorune) benaaweqe noro batakatalenaacehu nabare>> 'alu 'enaresu yaane gizee ka'emenate yeleqe wada kehedate yaqarabu naacawe balebocaacawe yaleelawene ba'afocaacawe yenaagaraalu 'alaaheme yamidabequtene `awaaqi nawe
'enaziyaa (kategele) yaqaru sikxonu lawanedemocaacawe - <<bataazazune noro baaletagadalu nabare>> yaalu naacawe <<'ewenatanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu kanafesocaacehu laaye motene gafeteru>> balaacawe
'enaziyaane ba'alaahe manegade yatagadalutene mutaane 'aderegahe 'ategametaacawe ba'eregethe 'enaresu 'egeetaacawe zanede hheyaawaane naacawe; yemagabaalu

'alaahe kacerotaawe basathaacawe nagare tadasaacoce sikxonu (yemagabaalu) banaziyaame kaxwaalaacawe ganaa ba'enaresu baaletakatalute ba'enaresu laaye ferehaate baalamanorunaa 'enaresume yamaayaazenu bamakxonaacawe yedasataalu
ka'alaahe bakxona tsagaanaa legesenaa 'alaaheme yame'emenaanene menedaa yamaayaathafu bamakxonu yedasataalu
'enaziyaa maqusale kaaganyaacawe baxwaalaa la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe yataazazute ka'enasu lanaziyaa bago laszarutenaa latathanaqaqute taalaaqe menedaa 'alaacawe

'enaziyaa sawocu la'enaresu - <<sawoce la'enaaneta (thorene) 'akamaacetawaalenaa feruwaacawe>> yeluwaacawenaa (yeheme) 'emenatene yachamaralaacawe <<baqiyaaceneme 'alaahe nawe mene yaamereme mathagiyaa!>> yaalu naacawe
ka'alaaheme bakxona tsagaanaa cerotaa kefu nagare yaalenakaacawe kxonawe tamalasu ya'alaaheneme wedeetaa takatalu; 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe
'enedihe yamilaacehu sayethaane becaa nawe wadaajocune yaasefaraaraacexwaale 'ateferuwaacaweme me'emenaaneme 'enedakxonaacehu ferunye

'enaziyaame bakehedate yamicaakolute 'ayaasaazenuhe kanaresu fatsemo 'alaahene bameneme 'ayegodumenaa 'alaahe bamacharashaayetu `aalame la'enasu `edelene laayaadarege yeshaale la'enaresume taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacawe
'enaziyaa kehedatene ba'emenate yalawathu 'alaahene bameneme nagare fatsemo 'ayegoduteme la'enasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce 'enaresune maazageyataacenene lanafesocaacawe dage nagare nawe belawe 'ayaasebu 'enaresune yamenaazagayaacawe xaathi'aatene 'enedichameru becaa nawe lanasume 'awaaraaje seqaaye 'alaacawe

'alaahe mathefowene kamalekaamu 'esekamilaye derase me'emenaanene 'enaaneta baresu laaye baalaacehubate (kxuneetaa) laaye yamitawe 'ayedalame 'alaaheme ruqune nagare yamiyaasaaweqaacehu 'ayedalame gene 'alaahe kamaleketanyocu yamishaawene yemarethaale ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocume 'emanu betaamenunaa betethanaqaqume lanaaneta taalaaqe menedaa 'alaacehu

'enaziyaame 'alaahe kacerotaawe basathaacawe ganezabe yaminafegu 'eresu la'enasu dage 'ayemesalaacawe yelequneme; 'eresu lanasu mathefo nawe yaanene baresu yanafagubatene bateneszaa'ee qane ('ebaabe kxono) yethalaqaalu yasamaayaatenaa yamedereme werese la'alaahe becaa nawe 'alaaheme bamiszarute hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe

ya'enaziyaane <<'alaahe dekxaa nawe 'enyaa gene kabareteewoce nane>> yaalutene sawoce qaale 'alaahe ba'eregethe samaa yaanene yaalutenenaa nabiyaatene yaala hhege magedalaacawene ba'eregethe 'enetsefaalane <<ya'esaateneme seqaaye qemasu>> 'enelaacawaalane
yaa (seqaaye) 'ejocaacehu baasaalafute szeraa nawe 'alaaheme labaarocu badaaye baalamakxonu nawe

'enaziyaa lamaanenyaaweme maleketanyaa <<'esaate yametebalaawe yakxonane qurebaane 'esekamiyaamathaalene derase laanaamene 'alaahe wadanyaa 'azwale>> yaalu naacawe <<maleketanyoce ka'enee bafite bata`aameraatenaa baziyaame baalaacehute (qurebaane) ba'eregethe mathetawelaacexwaale 'ewenatanyoce kakxonaacehu taadiyaa lamene gadalaacexwaacawe>> balaacawe
biyaasetabaabeluheme ka'aneta bafite bageletse ta`aameraatenaa batsehhufoce, baberuhe matsehhafeme yamathute maleketanyoce ba'eregethe tasetabaabelawaale

nafese hulu motene qamaashe naate menedaawocaacehuneme yametemolute bateneszaa'ee qane becaa nawe ka'esaateme yataraaqanaa ganatene yatagabaa sawe ba'eregethe menyotune 'aganya qerebitume hheyewate yamataalayaa masaariyaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaceme

baganezabocaacehunaa banafesocaacehu ba'eregethe tefatanaalaacehu ka'enaziyaame ka'enaaneta bafite matsehhafene katasathutenaa ka'enaziyaame ka'agaarute bezune maasaqaayate tesamaalaacehu betetaagasunaa betethanaqaqu yehe kathebeqe nagaroce nawe

'alaahe yanaziyaane matsehhafune yatasathutene qaale kidaane lasawoce ba'eregethe taaberaarutaalaacehu 'atedabequtememe bamaalate yayaazabaacawene ('asetaawesu) bajarebaawocaacaweme xwaalaa thaalute baresume theqitene waagaa gazu yamigazuteme nagare kafaa!
'enaziyaane baszarute nagare yamidasatutenenaa baaleszaruteme mamaseganene yamiwadutene 'ataasebe; kaqethaate bamadaane laaye naacawe belahe 'ataasabaacawe la'enasu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa la'alaahe becaa nawe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
samaayaatenenaa mederene bamafethare leelitenaa qaneneme bamatakaakaate labaala 'a'emerowoce ba'eregethe meleketoce 'alu

('enaresume) 'enaziyaa qomawe, taqamethaweme, bagonocaacawe tagaademaweme 'alaahene yamiyaawasu basamaayaatenaa bamedere 'afathaathareme yamiyaasetanatenu - <<geetaacene hoye! yekxane bakanetu 'alefatharekaweme; theraate yegabaahe; ka'esaateme qethaate thabeqane>> yamilu naacawe
<<geetaacene hoye! 'aneta 'esaate yametaagabaawene sawe ba'eregethe 'awaaradekawe; labadalanyoceme meneme radaatoce yaluwaacaweme >>

<<geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa bageetaacehu 'emanu bamaalate wada 'emenate yamitharaane thari samaane 'amaneme geetaacene hoye! xaathi'atocaaceneneme lanyaa maare kefu szeraawocaaceneneme kanyaa 'abese kanetsuhhocume sawoce gaare gedalane;>>
<<geetaacene hoye! bamaleketanyoceheme laaye tasefaa qaale yaadaragekelenene sethane bateneszaa'ee qaneme 'ataawaaredane 'aneta qatharone 'ataafaresemenaa>> (yamilu naacawe)

geetaacaweme <<'enee ka'enaaneta kawanede wayeme kaseete yaszarine szeraa 'alaathafaame kafilaacehu kakafilu nawe; bamaalate lanaresu lemanaacawene taqabala 'enaziyaame yatasadadu ka'agarocaacaweme yatabaararu bamanegadeeme yatathaqu yatagaadalume yatagadalume kefu szeraawocaacawene ka'enaresu ba'eregethe 'abesaalahu baszerocaacaweme wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce ba'eregethe 'agabaacawaalahu ka'alaahe zanede yakxonane menedaa (yemanadaalu) 'alaaheme 'eresu zanede malekaame menedaa 'alela >>
ya'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce ba'agaroce manefalaasase 'ayaataalehe
'anasetanyaa theqeme nawe kaziyaame manoriyaacawe gahaname naate mene tekafaame menethaafe!

gene 'enaziyaa geetaacawene yafaru la'enasu kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe ganatoce bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sikxonu ka'alaahe zanede (yatasathu) masetanegedowoce 'alwacawe 'alaaheme zanede yaalawe (menedaa) labago szariwoce balaache nawe

kamatsehhafume baalabeetoce la'alaahe fariwoce ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoceme theqitene waagaa yamaayelawathu sikxonu ba'alaahenaa baziyaa wada 'enaaneta batawaradawe baziyaame wada'enaresu batawaradawe yamiyaamenu sawoce 'alelu 'enaziyaa la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede menedaacawe 'alaacawe 'alaahe meremaraawe fathaane nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! taagasu tabaraatume (bathore keelaa laaye) tasalafume tedenume zanede 'alaahene feru

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! yaanene ka'anedite nafese (ka'adaame) yafatharaacehune ka'eresewaame maqanaajowaane (hheewaanene) yafatharawene ka'enaresume bezu wanedocenenaa seetoce yabatanawene geetaacehune feru yaaneneme baresu yametethayaayaqubatene 'alaahenenaa zemedenaawoceneme (kamaqurathe) tathaneqaqu 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye tathabaabaaqi nawenaa
yatimoceneme ganezabocaacawene sethu mathefoweneme bamalekaamu 'atelawethu ganezabocaacaweneme wada ganezabocaacehu (bamaqalaaqale) 'atebelu 'eresu taalaaqe xaathi'ate nawenaa

bayatimoceme (maagebaate) 'alamaasetakaakalaacehune betefaru (zemutenenaa katawasanalaacehu balaaye maagebaateneme feru) kaseetoce la'enaaneta yatawaabalaacehune hulate hulate szosete szoseteme 'araate 'araateme 'agebu 'alamaasetakaakaleneme betefaru 'aneditene becaa wayeme 'ejocaacehu neberate yaadaragutene yaazu yehe wada 'alamabadale bathaame yaqaraba nawe
seetoceneme maherocaacawene badasetaa sethu la'enaanetame ka'eresu 'anedaacene nagare nafesocaacawe bilagesu malekaame mesegune sikxone belute

qiloceneme yaacene 'alaahe la'enaaneta matadaadariyaa yaadaragaatene ganezabocaacewene (yayaazaacehulaacawene) 'atesethuwaacawe kareswame magebuwaacawe 'alebesuwaacaweme la'enasume malekaamene negegere tanaagaru

yatimoceneme gaabecaane 'esekadarasu gizee derase fatenuwaacawe ka'enaresume qenenatene betaawequ ganezabocaacawene wada 'enaresu sethu bamaabaakanenaa maadagaacaweneme bamasheqadaadame 'atebelwate (kawaabiwoce) habetaameme yakxona sawe yekalekale dehaame yakxona sawe (ladekaamu) ba'agebaabe yebelaa ganezabocaacaweneme wada 'enaresu basathaacehu gizee ba'enaresu laaye 'asemasekeru tathabaabaaqinateme ba'alaahe baqaa

lawanedoce walaajocenaa yaqerebe zamadoce katawute (neberate) faanetaa (dereshaa) 'alaacawe laseetoceme walaajocenaa yaqerebe zamadoce katawute ka'eresu kaanasawe wayeme kabazaawe faanetaa 'alaacawe yatawasana dereshaa (tadaregwaale)
kefeyaaneme (waraashe yaalekxonu) yazemedenaa baalabeetocenaa yatimoce, mesekinoceme bataganyubate gizee ka'eresu daaregwaacawe malekaameneme negegere tanaagaruwaacawe
'enaziyaame kaxwaalaacawe dakaamocene zereyaawoce bitawe noro ba'enaresu laaye yamifaru (bayatimoce laaye) yethaneqaqu 'alaaheneme yeferu (latanaazaazhu) tekekelanyaaneme qaale yenaagaru
'enaziyaa yayatimocene ganezabe bamabadale yamibalu bahodocaacawe wesethe yamibalute 'esaatene becaa nawe 'esaateneme ba'eregethe yegabaalu

'alaahe balejocaacehu (werese bamikatalawe) yaazaacexwaale lawanedu yahulate seetoce dereshaa bethee 'alawe (hulate wayeme) kahulate balaayeme yakxonu seetoce becaa bikxonu la'enasu (mwacu) katawawe rajate (dereshaa) kaszosete hulate 'eju 'alaacawe 'anediteme betekxone lareswa gemaashu 'alaate la'abaatenaa la'enaatume la'eresu leje 'enedaalawe kahulatu layaanedaanedu kasedesete 'anede 'alaacawe la'eresume leje baayenorawenaa walaajocu biwaresute la'enaatu sisowe 'alaate la'eresume wanedemocenaa 'exetoce binorute lanaatu kasedesete 'anede 'alaate (yeheme yatabaalawe) bareswa katanaazazabaate nuzaazee wayeme ka`edaa baxwaalaa nawe 'abaatocaacehunaa lejocaacehu la'enaaneta bamatheqame maanenyaacawe yebalethe qerebe 'enedakxonu 'ataawequme (yekxeme) ka'alaahe yatadanagaga nawe; 'alaahe `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa

la'enaanetame misetocaacehu katawute neberate la'enaresu leje baayenoraacawe gemaashu 'alaacehu la'enasume leje binoraacawe katawute habete ka'araate 'anede 'alaacehu (yeheme) ba'ereswa kaminaazazubaate nuzaazee wayeme ka`edaa baxwaalaa nawe lanaanetame leje baayenoraacehu katawaacehute neberate la'enaresu (lamisetoce) ka'araate 'anede 'alaacawe la'enaanetame leje binoraacehu katawaacehute neberate la'enaresu kasemenete 'anede 'alaacawe (yeheme bareswa kametenaazazubaate nuzaazee wayeme ka`edaa baxwaalaa nawe ) walaajeme lejeme yaleelawe bagone waraashoce yamiwarese wanede wayeme seete biganye la'eresume (lamwacu) wanedeme wayeme 'exete (ka'enaatu bakule becaa yakxona) binore kahulatu layaanedaanedaacawe kasedesete 'anede 'alaacawe kaziheme (ka'anede) yabazu bikxonu 'enaresu basisowe tagaariwoce naacawe (yeheme waraashocene) yamaayegodaa kxono ba'ereswa kaminaazazubaate nuzaazee wayeme ka`edaa baxwaalaa nawe ka'alaaheme yakxonane nuzaazee (yaazaacexwaale) 'alaaheme `awaaqi caaye nawe

'enazihe ya'alaahe wesaaneewoce naacawe 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamitaazazu sawoce kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu yaagabaacawaale yeheme teleqe `edele nawe
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamiyaametse wasanocuneme yamitalaalafe bawesethwa zawetaari sikxone 'esaatene yaagabaawaale laresume 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alawe

'enaziyaame kaseetocaacehu mathefone szeraa (zemutene) yamiszaru ba'enaresu laaye kanaaneta 'araatene (wanedoce) 'asemasekerubaacawe bimasakerume mote 'esekamidaresebaacawe wayeme 'alaahe la'enaresu manegadene 'esekamiyaadarege derase babeetoce wesathe yaazuwaacawe (thabequwaacawe)

'enaziyaaneme ka'enaaneta wesethe (zemutene) yamiszaruwaatene 'asaqaayuwaacawe bitsatsatunaa szeraacaweneme biyaasaameru ka'enaresu tagatu ('ataasaqaayuwaacawe) 'alaahe tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye nawenaa

tsatsatene maqabale ba'alaahe laaye yamigabaawe la'enaziyaa xathi'atene basehetate lamiszarunaa kaziyaame kaqerebe gizee lamitsatsatute becaa nawe 'enaziyaaneme 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye tsatsatene yeqabalaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

tsatsateneme maqabale la'enaziyaa xathi'atocene lamiszaru 'anedaacaweneme mote bamathaabate gizee <<'enee 'ahune tatsatsateku>> lamilenaa lanaziyaame 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce kxonawe lamimotu 'ayedalaceme 'enaziyaa la'enasu 'asaamaamine qethaate 'azagaajetanaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! seetocene yaasegadadaacehu kxonaacehu letewaresunaa geletsene mathefo szeraa kaaleszaru basetaqare kasathaacexwaacawe kafilune letewasedu letaagulaalwacaweme la'enaaneta 'ayefaqademe bamalekaameme tanwanwaruwaacawe betethaluwaacaweme (taagasu) 'anedaacene nagare betethalu 'alaaheme ba'eresu bezu dage nagarene liyaadarege yecaalaalenaa

bamiseteme seferaa misetene lamalawathe betefalegu la'anedanyaayetu (lametefataawe) bezune ganezabe yasathaacexwaate setekxonu karesu meneneme 'atewesadu bamabadalenaa geletse bakxona xathi'ate tewasedutaalaacehune
kafilaacehu wada kafilu ba'eregethe yadarasa sikxonenaa ka'enaaneta laayeme (seetoce) yathabaqa kidaanene yayaazubaacehu sikxonu 'enedeete tewasedutaalaacehu!
kaseetoceme 'abaatocaacehu yaagabuwaacawene 'ataagebu (teqathubataalaacehu) yaalafawe siqare 'eresu mathefonaa yatathalaa szeraa nawenaa manegadenatume kafaa!

'enaatocaacehu, seete lejocaacehume, 'exetocaacehume, 'akesetocaacehume, yashumeewocaacehume, yawanedeme seetoce lejoceme, ya'exete seetoce lejoceme, 'enaziyaame yaathabuwaacehu 'enaatocaacehu, kamathebaate yakxonuteme 'exetocaacehu, yamisetocaacehume 'enaatoce, 'enaziyaame baguyaawocaacehu yaalute ya'enaziyaa ba'enaresu yagabaacehubaacawe misetocaacehu seetoce lejoce, (letaagabwacawe) ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme tadaragubaacehu ba'enaresume (bamisetocaacehu) yaalegabaacehubaacawe betekxonu (bafataacexwaacawe gizee seetoce lejocaacawene betaagabu) ba'enaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalabaacehume ya'enaziyaa kajarebaawocaacehu yakxonute wanedoce lejocaacehu misetoceme bahulate 'exetemaamaacoceme makaakale masabesabe ('enedazihu 'ereme nawe) gene kazihe bafite yaalafawe siqare ('eresunese tameraacexwaale) 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

kaseetoceme (babaale) thebeqocu 'ejocaacahu (bamereko) yayaazuwaacawe siqaru ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme naacawe (yehene) 'alaahe banaaneta laaye tsaafa kazihaacehume (katakalakalute) wadiyaa thebeqoce kxonaacehu zemutanyoce saatekxonu baganezabocaacehu letefalegu la'enaaneta tafaqada ka'enasume baresu (bamaganaanyate) yatathaqamaacehubaacawene seetoce maherocaacawene gedeetaa sikxone sethwacawe kamawasaneme baxwaalaa batawaadadaacehubate nagare ba'enaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalame 'alaahe `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa

kanaanetame wesethe thebeqoce me'emenaate yakxonutene lamaagebaate habetene yaalecaala sawe 'ejocaacehu neberate kaadaragwaacawe kame'emenaate wathaatocaacehu (baariyaane yaagebaa) 'alaaheme 'emenataacehune `awaaqi nawe kafilaacehu kakafilu (yataraabaa) nawe (baarocene) bageetocaacaweme faqaade 'agebuwaacawe maherocaacaweneme bamalekaame manegade sethwacawe thebeqoce kxonawe zemutanyoce yaalekxonu yasereqoshe wadaajoceneme yaaleyaazu sikxonu ('agebwacawe) bamaagebaate batathabaqume gizee mathefone szeraa biszaru ba'enaresu laaye kaqethaate banatsaawocu laaye yaalawe gemaashe 'alabaacawe yekxa (baariyaane maagebaate) kanaaneta zemutene lafaraa sawe nawe

'alaahe (yahaayemaanotaacehune hhegegaate) liyaaberaaraalaacehu ka'enaaneta bafiteme yanabarutene nabiyaate daneboce limaraacehu ba'enaanetame laaye tsatsatene liqabale yeshaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe
'alaaheme ba'enaaneta laaye tsatsatene liqabale yeshaale 'enaziyaame felaagotaacawene yamikatalute (kawenate) teleqene mazanebale 'enedetezanabalu yefalegaalu
'alaahe ka'enaaneta liyaaqaalelelaacehu yeshaale saweme dakaamaa kxono tafathara

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ganezabocaacehune bamakaakalaacehu yaala 'agebaabe 'atebelu gene ka'enaaneta bamawaadade yakxonacewene negede (belu) nafesocaacehuneme 'ategedalu 'alaahe la'enaaneta 'azaanye nawenaa
wasane bamaalafenaa bamabadaleme yehenene yaszaraa sawe 'esaatene 'enaagabaawaalane yekxame ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe
ka'eresu katakalakalaacehute taalaalaaqocune (xathi'atoce) beterequ (tenaaneshocune) xathi'atocaacehune ka'enaaneta 'enaabesaalane yatakabaraneme seferaa (ganatene) 'enaagabaacexwaalane

'alaaheme kafilaacehune bakafilu laaye ba'eresu yaabalathabatene tsagaa 'atemanyu lawanedoce kaszarute szeraa 'edele 'alaacawe laseetoceme kaszarute szeraa `edele 'alaacawe 'alaaheneme kacerotaawe lamenute 'alaahe banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe

lahulume (lawanedocenaa laseetoce) walaajocenaa yaqerebe zamadoce katawute habete thaqelaaye waraashocene 'adereganaale 'enaziyaaneme (lamaradaadaatenaa lamawaarase) bamahhalaawocaacehu yatawaawaalaacexwaacawene dereshaacawene (kasedesete 'anede) sethwacawe 'alaahe banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe

wanedoce baseetoce laaye qwaamiwoce ('asaadaariwoce) naacawe 'alaahe kafilaacawene bakafilu laaye bamaabelathunaa (wanedoce) kaganezabocaacawe (laseetoce) bamasethataacawe nawe malekaamocume seetoce (labaalocaacawe) taazaazhoce 'alaahe baasethabaqawe nagare ruqene thabaaqiwoce naacawe 'enaziyaaneme maamatsacawene yametefarutene gasetsuwaacawe bamanyetaawoceme talayuwaacawe (saakaa saataadaresu) metuwaacaweme bitaazazwacehume (lamachaqone) ba'enaresu laaye manegadene 'atefalegu; 'alaahe yabalaaye taalaaqe nawenaa

('enaaneta waabiwoce) yamakaakalaacaweneme cheqecheqe betaawequ kabeetasabocu shemaageleene kabeetasabocewaame shemaageleene laaku maasetaaraqene bishu 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe yaasemaamaale 'alaahe geletsene `awaaqi wesetheneme `awaaqi nawenaa

'alaaheneme tagazu ba'eresume meneneme 'ataagaaru bawalaajocenaa baqerebe zemedenaa baalabeeteme, bayatimoceme, bamesekinoceme, baqerebe gorabeeteme, baruqe gorabeeteme, bagone baaledarabaame, bamanegadanyaame, 'ejocaacehume neberate baadaragwaacawe (baaroce), malekaamene (szeru); 'alaahe kuraatanyaa guranyaa yakxonane sawe 'ayewademe
'enaziyaa yamisasetu sawoceneme bamasasate yamiyaazu 'alaaheme kacerotaawe yasathaacawene tsagaa yamidabequ (beretune qethaate yeqathethaalu) lakahhaadiwoceme 'awaaraajene qethaate 'azagaajetanaale
'enaziyaame lasawoce yewelenye silu ganezabocaacawene yamisathu ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaaweme qane yamaayaamenu (yeqathethaalu) sayethaaneme la'eresu gwaadanyaawe yakxona sawe gwaadanyaanatu kafaa!
ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaaweme qane baamanu 'alaahe kasathaacaweme (sisaaye) balagasu noro banaresu laaye mene (gudaate) nabara 'alaaheme banaresu (kxunataa) `awaaqi nawe
'alaahe yabenaanyene kebedate yaahele 'ayebadeleme malekaame szeraa betekxoneme yedaraarebaataale ka'eresume zanede taalaaqene menedaa yesathaale
kahhezeboceme hulu masekaarine baamathaane gizee 'anetaneme ba'enazihe laaye masekaari 'aderegane bamenaamathaahe gizee (yakahhaadiwoce kxuneetaa) 'enedeete yekxone
baziyaa qane 'enaziyaa yakaadutenaa maleketanyaawene yaaletaazazute ba'enasu medere betedafaabaacawe yemanyaalu ka'alaaheme wareene 'ayedabequme

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaaneta yasakaraacehu kxonaacehu yametelutene nagare 'esekametaawequ yarakasaacehume setekxonu manegadene 'alaafiwoce kaalekxonaacehu basetaqare ('akaalaataacehune) 'esekametetaathabu derase segedatene 'ateqerabu bashetanyoce wayeme baguzo laaye betekxonume: wayeneme ka'enaaneta 'anedu ka`aayenamedere bimathaa: wayeneme seetocene betenakaakunaa wehaane baataaganyu, netsuhhe yakxonane yamedere gatse 'asebu fitocaacehunenaa 'ejocaacehuneme (baresu) 'abesu 'alaahe yeqere baaye mahhaari nawenaa
wadanaziyaa kamatsehhafu (`eweqate) `edelene wada tasathute 'alaayahemene thematene (baqenenate) yegazaalu manegadeneme 'enedetesaasaatu yefalegaalu
'alaaheme thalaatocaacehune `awaaqi nawe thabaaqinateme ba'alaahe baqaa radaatenateme ba'alaahe baqaa

kanaziyaa 'ayehudaaweyaane kakxonute sawoce negegerocene kaseferaawocu yamiyaathaamemu 'alelu <<samaaneme 'amatseneme yamaatesamaame setekxone semaa>> yelaalu bamelaasocaacaweme lamaathaamamenaa haayemaanoteneme lamazelafe raa`inaa yelaalu 'enasume <<samaane taazazeneme semaame tamalekataneme>> baalu noro lanasu malekaamenaa tekekelanyaa bakxona nabare gene bakehedataacawe 'alaahe ragamaacawe theqiteneme 'eneje 'ayaamenume

'enaaneta matsehhafune yatasathaacehu hoye! fitocene saanaabesenaa bajarebaawoce laaye saanemalesaacawe wayeme yasanebatene baalabeetoce (yaafarasutene) 'enedaragamene saaneragemaacawe bafite ka'enaaneta gaare yaalawene yamiyaaragaagethe kxono baawaradenawe (qure'aane) 'emanu ya'alaaheme te`ezaaze tafatsaami nawe
'alaahe ba'eresu maagaaraatene bafetsume 'ayemereme kazihe leelaa yaalaweneme (xathi'ate) lamishaawe sawe yemeraale ba'alaaheme yamiyaagaaraa sawe taalaaqene xathi'ate ba'eregethe qathafa
wada'enaziyaa nafesocaacawene wada miyaatharute (yamiyaawadesute) 'alaayahemene 'ayedalame; 'alaahe yamifalegawene yaatharaale yatamere feree kere yaaheleme 'ayebadalume
ba'alaahe laaye weshatene 'enedeete 'enedamiqathaathefu tamalekate geletse wanejaleme baresu (bamaqethafe) baqaa

wada 'enaziyaa kamatsehhafu `edelene wada tasathute 'alaayakxamene badegemetenaa bathaa`ote yaamenaalu la'enaziyaame lakaadute - 'enaaneta bamanegade (bahaayemaanote) ka'enaziyaa kaamanute yebalethe yaqanaacehu naacehu yelaalu
'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaragamaacawe naacawe 'alaaheme yaragamawe sawe la'eresu fatsemo radaatene 'ataaganyelateme
ba'ewenatu la'enasu kanegeszenaawe faanetaa 'alaacawene yaane gizee lasawoce batamere feree laaye yaalacewene nathebe yaahele 'ayesathume nabare

yelequneme sawocene (muhhamadene) 'alaahe kacerotaawe basathaacawe nagare laaye yemaqanyaalune laberaahimeme beetasaboce matsehhafenenaa thebabene ba'eregethe sathane taalaaqeneme negeszenaa sathanaacawe
ka'enasume (kayehudoce) ba'eresu yaamana 'ala ka'enaresume ka'eresu yaafagafa 'ala 'aqaathaayenateme bagahaname baqaa

'enaziyaane bata'ameraataacene yakaadutene ba'eregethe 'esaatene 'enaagabaacawaalane seqaayene 'enediqamesu qodaawocaacawe bataqaathalu quthere leelocene qodaawoce 'enelawethelaacawaalane 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa

'enaziyaaneme yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene kaseraacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce zale`aalame bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu ba'eregethe 'enaagabaacawaalane la'enasu bawesethewaa netsuhhe misetoce 'aluwaacawe yametaasethalelene thelaame 'enaagabaacawaalane

'alaahe 'adaraawocene wada baalabeetocaacawe 'enedetaadaresu yaazaacexwaale basawoceme makaakale bafaradaacehu gizee batekekele 'enedetefaredu (yaazaacexwaale) 'alaahe baresu yamigaszetsaacehu nagare mene yaamere! 'alaahe sami tamalekaace nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene tagazu maleketanyaawenenaa ka'enaanetame yaselethaane baalabeetocene taazazu bamaanenyaaweme nagare betekaraakaru ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yametaamenu betekxonu (yatakaraakaraacehubatene nagare) wada 'alaahenaa wada maleketanyaawe malesute yehe yatashaala macharashaaweme yaamaara nawe

wada 'enaziyaa 'enaresu ba'aneta laaye batawaradawenaa ka'aneta bafiteme batawaradawe 'amenanaale wadamilute; 'alaayahemene ba'eresu 'enedikedu ba'eregethe yataazazu sikxonu wada thaa`ote mafaaradene yefalegaalu sayethaaneme (ka'ewenate) yaraaqane masaasaate liyaasaasetaacawe yefalegaale
la'enaresume - <<'alaahe wada 'awaradawe (qure'aane)naa wada maleketanyaawe nu>> batabaalu gizee manaafeqaane ka'aneta mashashene sishashu taayaacawaalahe

'ejocaacaweme baaseqadamute (thefaate) makaraa badarasacebaacawenaa kaziyaame <<dagene hhasaabenaa maasemaamaatene 'eneje leelaa 'aleshaaneme>> bamaalate ba'alaahe yamimelu kxonawe bamathuhe gizee 'enedeete yekxonaalu

'enazihe 'enaziyaa 'alaahe balebocaacawe wesethe yaalawene hulu yamiyaaweqebaacawe naacawe 'enaresuneme tawaacawe gaszetsaacaweme la'enaresume banafesocaacawe wesethe semeete yaalawene qaale tanaagaraacawe

maaneneme maleketanyaa ba'alaahe faqaade litaazazute 'eneje 'alelaakeneme 'enasume nafesocaacawene babadalu gizee wada 'aneta bimathunaa 'alaaheneme mehheratene balamanu maleketanyaaweme lanaresu mehheratene balamanalaacawe noro 'alaahene tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye kxono baaganyute nabare

bageetaaheme 'emelaalahu bamakaakalaacawe batakaraakarubate ferede 'esekamiyaasefareduhe kaziyaame kafaradekawe nagare banafesocaacawe wesethe cheneqatene 'esekamaayaaganyunaa fetsume mataazazeneme 'esekamitaazazu derase 'ayaamenume; (me'emane 'ayekxonume)

'enyaame ba'enaresu laaye - <<nafesocaacehune gedalu wayeme ka'agarocaacehu wethu>> maalatene batsaafene noro kanasu theqitocu 'eneje baaleszarute nabare 'enaresume ba'eresu yamigasatsubatene nagare baszaru noro lanasu malekaamenaa (ba'emenataacawe laaye) lamaregaateme bathaame yabarataa bakxona nabare
yaane gizeeme ka'enyaa zanede taalaaqene menedaa basathanaacawe nabare
qathetanyaaweneme manegade ba'eregethe bamaraanaacawe nabare

'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamitaazaze sawe 'enaziyaa ka'enaziyaa 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye kalagasaacawe kanabiyaate, katsaadeqaaneme, kasamaa`etaateme, kamalekaamocu gaare yekxonaalu ya'enaziyaame gwaadanyenate 'amaara
yehe cerotaa ka'alaahe nawe 'awaaqinateme ba'alaahe baqaa
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! theneqaaqeeyaacehune yaazu kefelefeleme Nde honaacehu (lazamacaa) wethu wayeme tasabesebaacehu wethu

ka'enaanetame wesethe ba'eregethe (kazamacaa) wada xwaalaa yaminegwaadade sawe 'alela 'adagaame betaaganyaacehu ka'enasu gaare tathaaje baalekxoneku gizee 'alaahe ba'enee laaye ba'eregethe lagasalenye yelaale
ka'alaaheme yakxona cerotaa biyaaganyaacehu ba'enaanetanaa ba'eresu makaakale feqere 'enedaalenabarace hulu <<taalaaqe `edelene 'aganye zanede kanasu gaare bakxoneku waye menyotee!>> yelaale

'enaziyaame qerebwane hheyewate bamacharashaayetu hheyewate yamilawethu ba'alaahe manegade yegaadalu ba'alaaheme manegade yamigaadale, yamigadaleme wayeme yamiyaashanefe taalaaqe menedaane ba'eregethe 'enesathawaalane

ba'alaahe manegadenaa kawanedoce kaseetocenaa kalejoceme yakxonutene dakaamoce 'enaziyaane - <<geetaacene hoye! kazice baalabeetocewaa badaaye kakxonute katamaa 'awethaane ka'anetame zanede la'enyaa 'asaadaarine 'aderegelene ka'aneta zanedeme la'enyaa radaatene 'aderegelene>> yamilutene (lamaadaane) yamaategaadalute la'enaaneta mene 'alaacehu
'enaziyaa yaamanute sawoce ba'alaahe manegade yegaadalaalu 'enaziyaa yakaaduteme bathaa`ote manegade yegaadalaalu yasayethaaneneme cheferoce tagaadalu yasayethaane tanekole dakaamaa nawenaa

wada'enaziyaa la'enaresu - 'ejocaacehune (kamagaadale) sabesebu, solaateneme danebune thabeqaacehu segadu, gedeetaa metsewaateme sethu wada tabaalute 'alaayahemene ba'enaresume laaye magaadale batatsaafa gizee ka'enasu kafilocu wadiyaawenu sawocene 'alaahene 'enedamifaru wayeme yabalatha feraacaane yefaraalu <<geetaacene hoye! ba'enyaa laaye magaadalene lamene danagageke 'eseka qerebe gizee derase 'ataaqoyaneme noro'alene>> yelaalume <<yaqerebitu hheyewate theqeme 'anasetanyaa nawe macharashaayetume `aalame 'alaahene lamifaraa sawe balaache naate batamere feree wesethe yaalane kere yaahele 'enekwaa 'atebadalume>> balaacawe

<<yateme seferaa betekxonu bathanakaru hhenetsaawoce wesethe betekxonume 'enekwaa mote yaaganyaacexwaale dageme nagare betaaganyaacawe yehece ka'alaahe zanede naate>> yelaalu makaraame betaaganyaacawe <<yeheci ka'aneta zanede naate>> yelaalu <<hulume (dagume kefuweme) ka'alaahe zanede nawe>> balaacawe la'enaziheme sawoce negegerene liradu yamaayeqarebute mene 'alaacawe
kadage nagare yamiyaaganyehe ka'alaahe (cerotaa) nawe kamakaraame yamidaresebehe karaasehe (thefaate yatanasaa) nawe lasawoceme hulu maleketanyaa kxonahe laakenehe masekaarime ba'alaahe baqaa
maleketanyaawene yamitaazaze sawe ba'eregethe 'alaahene taazaza kate'ezaazeme yashasha sawe ('ayaasaasebehe) ba'enasu laaye thabaaqi 'aderegane 'alelaakenehemenaa

<<(nagaraacene) mataazaze nawe>> yelaalume; ka'anetame zanede bawathu gizee kanaresu kafilocu kaziyaa (bafitehe) kamilute leelaane (balebocaacawe) yaasaaderaalu 'alaaheme yamiyaasaaderutene nagare yetsefaale selazihe tawaacawe ba'alaaheme laaye tathagaa mathagiyaame ba'alaahe baqaa
qure'aanene 'ayaasetanatenumene ka'alaahe leelaa zanede banabara noro baresu wesethe bezune malayaayate baaganyu nabare

katsathetaa wayeme kaferehaate 'anedaace (waree) bamathaalaacaweme gizee 'eresune yaagaanenaalu wada maleketanyaawenaa ka'enaresu wada te`ezaazu baalabeetoce (wada `awaaqiwocu) bamalasute noro 'enaziyaa ka'enaresu (nagarune) yamiyaawethaathute baawaqute nabare ba'enaanetame laaye ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baalenabara noro katheqitoce basetaqare sayethaanene batakatalaacehu nabare

ba'alaaheme manegade tagaadale raasehene 'eneje leelaane 'ategadademe me'emenaaneneme (bamagaadale laaye) 'adafaafere 'alaahe ya'enaziyaane yakaadutene xayele likalakele yekajalaale 'alaaheme baxayele bamayaazu yabarataa qethaatume yathanakara nawe
malekaame mataadagene yamitaadage sawe la'eresu karesewaa `edele yenorawaale mathefo mataadageneme yamitaadage sawe la'eresu karesewaa dereshaa yenorawaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
basalaametaa batakabaraacehume gizee ka'ereswa yebalethe baamaara (salaametaa) 'akeberu wayeme ('ereswanu) maleswate 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye taqothaathaari nawenaa
'alaahe ka'eresu basetaqare 'amelaake yalame wada teneszaa'ee qane baresu therethere yaleelabate sikxone ba'eregethe yesabasebaacexwaale banegegereme ka'alaahe yebalethe 'ewenatanyaa maanawe

bamanaafeqaaneme (nagare) 'alaahe baszeraawocaacawe wada kehedate yamalasaacawe sikxonu hulate kefeloce yakxonaacehute lanaaneta mene 'alaacehu 'alaahe yaathamamawene sawe letaaqanu taasebaalaacehune 'alaaheme yaasaasaatawene sawe la'eresu manegadene fatsemo 'ataaganyelateme

('enaresu) 'eneda kaadu betekedunaa 'ekule betekxonu tamanyu! ba'alaaheme haayemaanote 'esekamisadadu derase kanasu wadaajocene 'ateyaazu (ka'emenate) biyaafagafegume yaazuwaacawe; (maarekuwaacawe) baaganyaacehubateme seferaa gedaluwaacawe ka'enasume wadaajenenaa radaatene 'ateyaazu

'enaziyaa ba'enaanetanaa ba'enaresu makaakale qaale kidaane wadaalaacawe hhezeboce yamithagunaa wayeme 'enaanetane lamagaadale wayeme waganocaacawene lamagaadale lebocaacawe yatachanaqu kxonawe yamathwawaacehu siqaru; ('enaziyaanese 'ategaadaluwaacawe) 'alaaheme bashaa noro ba'enaaneta laaye xayele basathaacawenaa batagaadaluwaacehu nabare bitawaacehunaa baayegaadaluwaacehume wada 'enaanetame 'ereqene biyaaqarebu 'alaahe la'enaaneta banasu laaye (yamagaadale) manegadene 'alaadaragame

leeloce ka'enaaneta lamadaane kawaganocaacaweme lamadaane yamifalegune taaganyaalaacehu wada 'ewekate 'enedimalasu batatharu quthere bareswa wesethe yemalasaalu baayetawewaacehunaa 'ereqeneme baayaaqarebulaacehu, 'ejocaacaweneme baayesabasebu, baaganyaacexwaacawe seferaa maarekuwaacawe gedaluwaacaweme 'enaziyaaneme la'enaaneta banasu laaye geletse maaserajaane 'adereganaale

lame'emaneme basehhetate kaalekxona baqare me'emanene magedale 'ayegabaaweme me'emaneneme basehetate yagadala sawe yaamanacene chaaneqaa (baariyaa) natsaa maawethaatenaa wada beetasabocume yametesathe gumaa mehherate kaalaadaragulate basetaqare (makefale) 'alabate 'eresu (tagadaayu) me'emane sikxone la'enaaneta thalaate kakxonuteme hhezeboce bikxone yaamanacene chaaneqaa natsaa maawethaate (becaa) 'alabate ba'enaanetanaa ba'enasu makaakale qaale kidaane kaalaacaweme hhezeboce bikxone wada beetasabocu ba'eje yametesathe gumaanaa yaamanacene chaaneqaa natsaa maawethaate 'alabate yaalaaganya saweme takataataayocene hulate waroce matsome 'alabate 'alaahe matsatsatene lamaqabale (danagagalaacehu) 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe
me'emaneneme 'asebo yamigadele sawe qethaatu bawesethwa zawetaari sikxone gahaname naate 'alaaheme baresu laaye taqothaa ragamaweme la'eresume kabaade qethaatene 'azagaaja

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'alaahe manegade (lamagaadale) batagwaazaacehu gizee 'aseragethu salaametaaneme wadanaaneta laaqaraba sawe yaqerebitune hheyewate theqeme yametefalegu kxonaacehu me'emane 'ayedalaheme 'atebalu 'alaaheme zanede bezu zarafaawoce 'alu kazihe bafite 'enedazihu nabaraacehu 'alaaheme ba'enaaneta laaye lagasa selazihe 'asetawelu 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawenaa

kame'emanaane yagudaate baalabeete kakxonute baqare taqamaachocunaa ba'alaahe manegade baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe yamitaagalute 'ayetakaakalume baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe yamitaagalutene 'alaahe bataqamaachocu laaye badarajaa 'abalatha lahulume 'alaahe malekaamitune (ganate) tasefaa satha taagaayocuneme bataqamaachocu laaye 'alaahe bataalaaqe menedaa 'abalatha
ka'eresu zanede bakxonu darajaawoce ('abalatha) mehherateneme 'adaraga 'ezenateme 'azanalaacawe 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

'enaziyaa (la'emenete baalamasadade) nafesocaacawene badaayoce kxonawe malaa'ekete (babadere) yagadaluwaacawe (malaa'ekete lanaresu) <<bamene nagare laaye nabaraacehu>> 'alwacawe <<bamedere wesethe dakaamoce nabarene>> 'alu <<ya'alaahe medere tesadadubaate zanede safi 'alenabaracemene>> 'aluwaacawe 'enaziyaame manoriyaacawe gahaname naate bamamalashaanateme kafaace!
gene kawanedocenaa kaseetoce kahhetzaanoceme sikxonu (lamawethaate) malaane yamaayecelunaa manegadeneme yamaayememaru dakaamoce (qethaate yalabaacaweme)
'enaziyaame 'alaahe ka'enaresu yeqeretaa liyaadarege yeshaale 'alaaheme yeqere baaye mahhaari nawe

ba'alaaheme manegade yamisadade sawe bamedere wesethe bezu masadajaanenaa mecotene yaaganyaale wada 'alaahenaa wada maleketanyaaweme sedatanyaa kxono kabeetu yamiwathaa kaziyaame (bamanegade) mote yamiyaaganyawe sawe menedaawe ba'eregethe 'alaahe zanede taragaagatha 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

bamedereme laaye batagwaazaacehu gizee 'enaziyaa yakaadute yaawekunaale belaacehu betefaru kasolaate (baala 'araate raka`aate yakxonutene) betaasaatheru banaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalame kahhaadiwoce la'enaaneta ba'eregethe geletse thalaatoce naacawenaa

bawesethaacaweme bakxonekenaa solaatene la'enaresu baasegadadekaacawe gizee ka'enasu 'anedite cheferaa kaaneta gaare tequme maszaariyaawocaacaweneme yeyaazu bagenebaaraacaweme batadafu gizee kasetaxwaalaacehu yekxunu ('enazihe yekxidunaa) yaalesagaduteme leelocu cheferoce yemethu ka'anetame gaare yesegadu theneqaaqeeyaacawenenaa maszaariyaawocaacaweneme yeyaazu 'enaziyaa yakaadute kamaszaariyaawocaacehunaa kagwaazocaacehu betezanagunaa ba'enaaneta laaye 'aneditene mazanebale bizanabalu tamanyu kazenaabeme yakxona cegere ba'enaaneta binore wayeme hhemametanyoce betekxonu maszaariyaawocaacehune betaaseqamethu banaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalame theneqaaqeeyaacehuneme yaazu 'alaahe lakahhaadiwoce 'awaaraajene qethaate 'azagaaja

solaateneme bafatsamaacehu gizee qomaacehume taqamethaacehume bagonocaacehume laaye tagaademaacehu 'alaahene 'awesu baragaacehume gizee solaatene ('amwaletaacehu) segadu solaate bame'emenaane laaye bagizeeyaate yatawasanace gedeetaa naatenaa

sawocuneme bamafalage 'atesenafu (seteqoselu) yametetaamamu betekxonu 'enaaneta 'enedametetaamamu 'enasume yetaamamaalu yamaayekajeluteneme ka'alaahe tekajelaalaacehu 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe
'enyaa basawoce makaakale 'alaahe baasaawaqahe letefarede wada 'aneta matsehhafune ba'ewenate 'awaradene lakadaatanyoceme takaraakaari 'atekxune
'alaaheneme mehheratene lamene 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
ka'enaziyaame nafesocaacawene kamibadelute laaye 'atekaraakare 'alaahe kadaatanyaa xaathi'atanyaa yakxonane sawe 'ayewademenaa

kasawe yedabaqaalu 'alaaheme 'eresu (ba`eweqatu) ka'enasu gaare sikxone kanegegere yamaayewadawene nagare (balebocaacawe) bamiyaasaaderu gizee (ka'eresu) 'ayedabaqume 'alaaheme bamiszarute hulu (ba`eweqatu) kabaabi nawe

'enaho 'enaaneta 'enaziyaa baqerebitu hheyewate kanasu yatakaraakaraacehu naacehu bateneszaa'ee qane 'alaahene sela'enasu yamikaraakare maane nawe wayese la'enasu xaalaafinaa mamakiyaa yamikxone maane nawe
mathefome yamiszaraa sawe wayeme nafesune yamibadele kaziyaame (tatsatseto) 'alaahene mehherate yamilamene 'alaahene mahhaari 'azaanye kxono yaaganyawaale
xathi'ateneme yamiszaraa sawe yamiszaraawe thefaate baraasu laaye nawe 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe;
xathi'atene wayeme 'abasaane yamiszaraame sawe kaziyaame ba'eresu netsuhhene sawe yamisadebe qethefatenenaa geletse 'abasaane baqurethe tashakama

ya'alaaheme cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baaneta laaye baalenabara noro ka'enasu yakxonu cheferoce liyaasaasetuhe baasabu nabare nafesocaacaweneme 'eneje leelaane 'ayaasaasetume bameneme 'ayegwaduheme 'alaaheme ba'aneta laaye matsehhafenenaa thebabene 'awarada yamaataaweqaweneme hulu 'asetamaarahe ya'alaaheme cerotaa ba'aneta laaye taalaaqe nawe

kaweyeyetaacawe bametsewaate wayeme babago szeraa wayeme basawoce makaakale bamaasetaaraqe kamiyaazu sawoce weyeyete basetaqare babezuwe wesethe dage nagare yalabateme yekxaneneme (yatabaalawene) ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalage yamiszaraa sawe taalaaqe menedaane 'enesathawaalane

qenume manegade la'eresu katagalatsa baxwaalaa maleketanyaawene yamichaqaachaqenaa kame'emenocu manegade leelaa yakxonane yamikatale sawe (bazihe `aalame) batashomabate (themate) laaye 'eneshomawaalane; gahanameneme 'enaagabaawaalane mamalashaayetume kafaace!
'alaahe baresu yamaagaaraatene (wanejale) 'ayemereme kaziheme wadiyaa yaalawene lamishaawe sawe yemeraale ba'alaaheme yamiyaagaaraa sawe (ka'ewenate) yaraaqane masaasaate ba'eregethe tasaasaata
ka'eresu leelaa 'enesetaatene 'eneje 'ayegazume 'amatsanyaa sayethaaneneme 'eneje leelaane 'ayegegazume
<<'alaahe yaragamawene kabaaroceheme yatawasanane dereshaa ba'eregethe 'eyezaalahu>> yaalawene (sayethaane 'eneje leelaane 'ayekatalume)

ba'eregethe 'athamaacawaalahume (kanetune) 'asemanyaacawaalahume 'azaacawemenaa ya'enesesocene jorowoce yetalatelaalu 'azaacawemenaa ya'alaahene fetherate yelawethaalu; (yaalawene yekatalaalu) ka'alaaheme leelaa sayethaanene radaate 'aderego yamiyeze sawe geletse keseratene ba'aregethe kasara
(yamaayefatsamawene) tasefaa yesathaacawaale yaasemanyaacawaaleme sayethaaneme lamaataalale 'eneje 'ayeqatheraacaweme
'enaziyaa manoriyaacawe gahaname naate karesewaame mashashaane 'ayaaganyume

'enaziyaame yaamanunaa bago szeraawocene yaszaru baszeraacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce zalaalame bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu 'enaagabaacawaalane 'alaahe 'ewenatanyaane tasefaa sathaacawe banegegereme ka'alaahe yebalethe 'ewenatanyaa maane nawe
(nagaru) bamenyotaacehunaa bamatsehhafu sawoce menyote 'ayedalame mathefone yamiszaraa sawe ba'eresu yeqathaale la'eresume ka'alaahe leelaa thabaaqineme radaateneme 'ayaaganyeme
kawanede wayeme kaseete 'eresu 'amaanye kxono kabago szeraawoce 'anedaacene yamiszaraame sawe 'enaziyaa ganatene yegabaalu batamere feree laaye yaalacene nathebe yaakele 'enekwaa 'ayebadalume

'eresu malekaame szari kxono fitune la'alaahe kasathanaa yaberaahimeneme manegade qathetanyaa sikxone katakatala sawe yebalethe haayemaanotu yaamaara maane nawe 'alaaheme beraahimene fetsume wadaaje 'aderegwa yaazawe
basamaayaate yaalawenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu ba`eweqate kabaabi nawe

baseetoceme nagare yaasetacuhaale 'alaahe ba'enaresu yenageraacexwaale yaame bamatsehhafu ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababawe ba'enaziyaa la'enaresu (kawerese) yatatsaafalaacawene bamaatesathwacawenaa letaagabwacawe bamaatefalegute yatimoce seetoce (yehenene 'enedaataadaregu) kahhetzaanaateme lakxonute dakaamoce mabetaacawene 'enedetesathu layatimoceme batekekele 'anedeteqomu (yenageraacexwaale) balaacawe kabagome szeraa maanaacaweneme beteszaru 'alaahe 'eresune `awaaqi nawe

seeteme kabaalewaa thelaacaane wayeme fitune maazorene betaaweqe bamakaakalaacawe masemaamaatene bisemaamu bahulatu laaye xathi'ate yalame mataaraqeme malekaame nawe nafesoceme nefegate tathaalabaacawe malekaameme beteszaru betethanaqaqume 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

baseetoceme makaakale meneme 'enekwaa betegwaagu (bafeqere) lamaasetakaakale 'atecelume 'eneda tanethalathalaceme 'aderegaacehu tetawaate zanede (wadametewadwate) mazanebalene hulu 'atezanebalu betaabajume betethanaqaqume 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
bilayaayume 'alaahe huluneme bacerotaawe yaabeqaaqaacawaale 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi thebabanyaa nawe

basamaayaate yaalawenaa bamedereme yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe 'enaziyaaneme kabafitaacehu matsehhafene yatasathutene 'enaanetaneme 'alaahene feru bamaalate ba'eregethe 'azazene betekedume basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe ('ategwaduteme) 'alaaheme tabeqaaqi mesegune nawe
basamaayaate yaalawenaa bamedereme yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe mamakayaame ba'alaahe baqaa
sawoce hoye!('alaahe) bishaa yaasewagedaacexwaale leeloceneme yaamathaale 'alaaheme bazihe laaye caaye nawe
yaqerebitune `aalame menedaa yamifalege yakxona sawe 'alaahe zanede yaqerebitunaa yamacharashaayetu menedaa 'alela 'alaaheme sami tamalekaace nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! batekekele (fetehhe) qawaamiwoce banafasocaacehu wayeme bawalaajocenaa baqerebe zamadoce laaye bikxoneme 'enekwaa la'alaahe masekaariwoce kxunu habetaame wayeme dekxaa bikxone 'alaahe ba'enaresu (ka'enaaneta) yebalethe tagabi nawe 'enedaataadalume zenebaaleene 'atekatalu betaathamemume wayeme (mamasekarene) betetawe 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe baziyaame bamaleketanyaawe laaye baawaradawe matsehhafe baziyaame kabafitu baawaradawe matsehhafe 'emanu ba'alaahenaa bamalaa'eketume, bamatsehhafocume, bamaleketanyocume, bamacharashaaweme qane, yakaada sawe (ka'ewenate) yaraaqane masaasaate ba'eregethe tasaasaata

'enaziyaa (bamusaa) yaamanunaa kaziyaame (wayefanene bamagazaate) yakaadu kaziyaame (ba'eresu) yaamanu kaziyaame (ba`isaa) yakaadu kaziyaame (bamuhhamade) kehhedatene yachamaru 'alaahe la'enasu yamimeraacawenaa qenune manegade yamimaraacawe 'ayedalame
manaafeqaanene la'enaresu 'asaamaami qethaate yaalaacawe makxonune 'abeseraacawe
'enaziyaa kame'emenaane leelaa kahhaadiwocene wadaajoce 'aderegawe yamiyezu 'enasu zanede leqenaane yefalegaalune leqenaaweme hulu la'alaahe becaa nawe

ba'enaanetame laaye bamatsehhafu wesethe ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce bareswa sikaadebaatenaa bareswame silaagathebaate basamaacehu gizee baleelaa waree wesethe 'esekamigabu derase ka'enasu gaare 'ateqamathu maalatene ba'eregethe 'awarada 'enaaneta yaanegizee betheeyaacawe naacehunaa 'alaahe manaafeqaanene 'enaa kahhaadiwocene bamulu bagahaname wesethe sabesaabi nawenaa

'enaziyaa ba'enaaneta (yagizeene mazawaaware) yamithabaabaqu naacawe la'enaanetame ka'alaahe yakxona 'ashanaafinate <<binoraacehu ka'enaaneta gaare 'alenabarenemene>> yelaalu lakahhaadiwoceme `edele binore <<(ka'ahune bafite) ba'enaaneta laaye 'aletashomenemene ('enaa 'aletawenaacehumene) kame'emenaaneme ('adagaa) 'alekalakalenaacehumene>> yelaalu 'alaaheme bateneszaa'ee qane bamakaakalaacehu yefaredaale 'alaaheme lakahhaadiwoce bame'emenaane laaye manegadene bafetsume 'ayaadaregeme

manaafeqaane 'alaahene yaataalelaalu 'eresume 'ataalaayaacawe nawe (yeqathaacawaale) wada solaateme baqomu gizee taakaacoce sewocene yamiyaasaayu kxonawe yeqomaalu 'alaaheneme theqitene 'eneje 'ayaawasume
bazihe makaakale walaawaayoce kxonawe (yaasaayaalu) wada'enaziheme wada'enaziyaame 'ayedalume 'alaaheme yaasaasaatawene sawe la'eresu (yaqenenate) manegadene bafetzume 'ataaganyelateme
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kame'emenaane leelaa kahhaadiwocene wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu; la'alaahe banaaneta laaye geletse maaserajaawocene letaadaregu tefalegaalaacehune
manaafeqaane ba'eregethe ka'esaate bataacenyaawe 'azaqete wesethe naacawe la'enasume radaatene 'ataaganyelaacaweme

'enaziyaa yatamalasu (szeraacawene) yaasaamarume; ba'alaaheme yatathabaqu; haayemaanotaacaweneme la'alaahe fetsume yaadaragu siqaru 'enaziyaase kame'emenaane gaare naacawe lame'emenaaneme 'alaahe taalaaqene menedaa ba'eregethe yesathaale
betaamasagenunaa betaamenu 'alaahe 'enaanetane bamaqethaate mene yaadaregaale 'alaaheme warataane malaashe `awaaqi nawe
'alaahe kanegegere bakefuwe machohene katabadala sawe (chukxate) baqare 'ayewademe 'alaahe sami `awaaqi nawe
dage nagarene betegaletsu wayeme betedabequte wayeme kamathefo nagare (kabadale) yeqeretaa betaadaregu 'alaahe yeqere baaye xaayaale nawe

'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocu yamikedu, ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocume makaakale malayatene yamifalegu, <<bakafilume 'enaamenaalane bakafilume 'enekedaalane>> yamilu, baziheme makaakale manegadene liyezu yamifalegu;
'enaziyaa bawenate kahhaadiwocu 'enaresu naacawe lakahhaadiwoceme 'awaaraajene qethaate 'azagaajetanaale
'enaziyaame ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocu yaamanu kanaresume ba'anedeme makaakale yaalelayu 'enaziyaa menedaawocaacawene ba'eregethe yesathaacawaale 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

yamatsehhafu sawoce banasu laaye kasamaaye matsehhafene 'enedetaawarede yethayequhaale kaziyaame yakabadane (nagare) musaane ba'eregethe thayeqawaale <<'alaaheneme bageletse 'asaayane>> belawaale babadalaacaweme maberaqe yaazacaacawe kaziyaame ta`aameraatoce kamathulaacawe baxwaalaa wayefanune ('amelaake 'aderegawe) yaazu kaziyaame yeqere 'alene musaaneme geletse selethaanene sathanawe

baqaale kidaanaacaweme mekeneyaate yathurene taraaraa kabalaayaacawe 'anasaane la'enasume <<dajaafune 'agonebaashoce kxonaacehu gebu>> 'alene la'enaresume <<basanebate qane te`ezaazene 'atetalaalefu>> 'alene ka'enasume kabaadene qaale kidaane yaazene

qaale kidaanaacaweneme bamaaferasaacawe, ba'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce bamakaadaacawe, nabiyaateneme yaala 'agebaabe bamagedalaacawenaa <<lebocaacene shefenoce naacawe>> bamaalataacawe mekeneyaate (ragamenaacawe) ba'ewenatu bakehedataacawe mekeneyaate 'alaahe bareswa (balebocaacawa) laaye 'atama selazihe theqitene 'eneje 'ayaamenume
bamakaadaacaweme bamareyame laaye kabaade qethefatene bamanaagaraacaweme mekeneyaate (ragamenaacawe)

<<'enyaa ya'alaahene maleketanyaa yamareyamene leje 'alemasihhe `isaane gadalene>> bamaalataacaweme (ragamenaacawe) 'alegadaluteme 'alesaqalutememe gene la'enasu (yatagadalawe sawe ba`isaa) tamasala 'enaziyaame ba'eresu nagare yatalayaayute ka'eresu (magadale) bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe therethaareene kamakatale basetaqare ba'eresu nagare meneme `eweqate yalaacaweme ba'eregetheme 'alegadaluteme
yelequnese 'alaahe (saane) wadaresu 'anasaawe 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
kamatsehhafume sawoce kamamotu bafite ba'eresu (ba`isaa) ba'eregethe yamiyaamene 'eneje ('anedeme) yalame bateneszaa'eeme qane banasu laaye masekaari yekxonaale

ka'enaziyaa yehudaaweyaane kakxonuteme bataganyawe badale sawoceneme ka'alaahe manegade babezu bamakalekalaacawe mekeneyaate la'enasu tafaqedawe yanabarutene thaafaachoce megeboce ba'enaresu laaye 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe

ka'eresu baqurethe yatakalakalu sikxonu 'araathaaneme bamayaazaacawenaa yasawocene ganezaboce yaala 'agebaabe (bagubo) bamabelaataacaweme mekeneyaate (yatafaqadalaacawene 'ereme 'adaragenebaacawe) ka'enasume lakahhaadiwocu 'asaamaamine qethaate 'azagaajane

gene kanaresu wesethe ba`eweqate yathalaqutenaa me'emenaanocu ba'aneta laaye batawaradawenaa ka'anetame bafite batawaradawe matsehhafe yamiyaamenu sikxonu solaateneme danebune thabeqawe sagaajocene ('enaamasagenaalane) zakaaneme sachiwocu ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawocume qane 'amaanyocu 'enaziyaa taalaaqe menedaane ba'eregethe 'enesathaacawaalane

'enyaa wada nuhhenaa karesu baxwaalaa wada nabarute nabiyaate 'enedaawaradene wada 'anetame 'awaradene wada beraahimeme, wada semaa`ileme, wada sehhaaqeme, wada yaa`eqobeme, wada nagadocume, wada `isaame, wada 'ayubeme, wada yunuseme, wada haarunenaa, wada sulayemaaneme 'awaradene ladaawedeme zaburene sathanawe
kaziheme bafite ba'aneta laaye ba'eregethe yatarakenaacawene maleketanyoce baaneta laayeme yaaletarakenaacawene maleketanyoce ('enedalaakene laakenehe) 'alaaheme musaane maanagaagarene 'anagaagarawe
kamaleketanyocu baxwaalaa lasawoce ba'alaahe laaye 'aseraje 'enedaayenore 'abesaariwocenaa 'asefaraariwoce yakxonune maleketanyoce (laakene) 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
gene 'alaahe baaneta laaye baawaradawe yemasakeraale ba`eweqatu 'awaradawe malaa'eketume yemasakeraalu masekaarime ba'alaahe baqaa
'enaziyaa yakaadute ka'alaaheme manegade yaagadute (ka'ewenate) yaraaqane masaasaate ba'eregethe tasaasaatu
'enaziyaa yakaadu yabadalume 'alaahe yamimeraacawenaa (qene) manegadene yamimaraacawe 'ayedalame
gene bawesethwa zala`aalame zawetaariwoce sikxonu yagahanamene manegade (yemaraacawaale) yeheme ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! maleketanyaawe 'ewenatene kageetaacehu 'amathaalaacehu 'emanume lanaaneta yatashaala (yekxonaale) betekedume ('ategwaduteme) basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawenaa 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu sawoce hoye! bahaayemaanotaacehu wasanene 'atelafu ba'alaaheme laaye 'ewenatene 'eneje 'atenaagaru yamareyame leje 'alemasihhe `isaa ya'alaahe maleketanyaa wada mareyame yathaalaate <<yakxune>> qaalume ka'eresu yakxona manefaseme becaa nawe ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocume 'emanu << ('amaalekete) szosete naacawe>> 'atebalume takalekalu; la'enaaneta yatashaala yekxonaalenaa 'alaahe 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe la'eresu leje yaalawe kamakxone yatharaa nawe basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaala hulu yaresu nawe mamakiyaame ba'alaahe baqaa

'alemasihhe (yasuse) la'alaahe baariyaa kamakxone fatsemo 'ayethayafeme qaraabiwoce yakxonute malaa'eketeme ('ayethayafume) 'eresune kamagazaate yamithayafenaa yamikoraame sawe ('alaahe) huluneme wada 'eresu ba'eregethe yesabasebaacawaale

'enaziyaamaa yaamanute malekaamoceneme yaszarute menedaawocaacawene yemolaalaacawaale kacerotaaweme yechamerelaacawaale 'enaziyaane yatathayafutenenaa yakorutenemaa 'asaamaamine qethaate yeqathaacawaale ka'alaaheme leelaa la'enasu zemedenenaa radaatene 'ayaaganyume
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kageetaacehu zanede ba'eregethe 'aseraje mathaalaacehu; wada'enaanetame galaache yakxonane berehaane (qure'aanene) 'awaradene
'enaziyaamaa ba'alaahe yaamanu baresume yatathabaqu kasu bakxonawe 'ezenatenaa cerotaa wesethe ba'eregethe yaasegabaacawaale wada'eresume qathetanyaa manegadene yemaraacawaale

yethayequhaale balaacawe - <<walaajenaa leje saayenorawe bamiwarase sawe 'alaahe yenageraacexwaale la'eresu leje yaleelawe sawe bimote la'eresume 'exete betenorawe la'eresewaa katawawe rajate gemaashu 'alaate 'eresume lareswa leje yaleelaate 'enedakxonace (bamulu) yewaresaataale hulate ('exetoce wayeme kahulate balaaye) bikxonume katawawe rajate kaszosete hulate 'eju 'alaacawe wanedemoce (naa 'exetoce) wanedocenaa seetoce bikxonume lawanedu yahulate seetoce dereshaa bethee 'alawe 'alaahe 'enedaatesaasaatu la'enaaneta yaaberaaraale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe >>

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! baqaale kidaanoce mulu ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababawe becaa siqare yagemale, yakabete, yabagenaa yafeyale 'enesesaawoce 'enaaneta bahhaje szeraa laaye kxonaacehu maadanene yatafaqada saataadaragu la'enaaneta tafaqadu 'alaahe yamishaawene yefaredaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ya'alaahe (kelekele yaadaragaacawene) meleketoce yatafaqadu 'ataaderegu yatakabaraweneme ware bamagaadale 'atedefaru wada makaa yaminadutene masewaa`etenaa yamitaabatubaacaweneme gamadoce kageetaacawe cerotaanenaa wedeetaane falegawe wada takabarawe beete 'asaabiwoceneme sawoce ('ateneku) kahhajeme szeraa bawathaacehu gizee `adenu katakabarawe masegide selakalakaluwaacehu sawocene mathelaateme (banasu laaye) wasane 'enedetaalefu 'ayegafaafaacehu babago nagarenaa 'alaahene bamaferaateme taradaadu gene baxaathi'atenaa wasanene bamaalafe 'ateradaadu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe qethaata beretu nawenaa
