bakete, fasaashe dameme, ya'eriyaa ('aszaamaa) szegaame, baresu ka'alaahe (seme) leelaa yatanasaabateme, yataanaqaceme, tadabedebaa yatagadalaceme, tanekabaalaa yamotaceme, baqanede tawegetaa yamotaceme, kareswa 'aweree yabalaalaateme (ka'enazihe bahheyewate daresaacehu) yaaradaacehute becaa siqare lathaa`otaateme yataaradawe ba'azelaameme `edelene mafalagaacehu ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme tadaraga yehe deregite 'amatse nawe zaaree 'enaziyaa yakaadute kahaayemaanotaacehu tasefaa qorathu selazihe 'ateferuwaacawe ferunyeme zaaree haayemaanotaacehune lanaaneta molaahulaacehu tsagaayeeneme banaaneta laaye fatsameku la'enaanetame selaamene kahaayemaanote bakule wadadeku baraxaabe waqete wada xaathi'ate yaazanabala saayehone ('ereme yakxonutene lamabelaate) yatagadada saweme (yebelaa) 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

la'enaresu mene 'enedatafaqadalaacawe yethayequhaale balaacawe - <<la'enaaneta malekaamoce hulunaa 'enaziyaame ka'adaanyoce 'asalethaanyoce kxonaacehu yaasetamaaraacexwaacawe (yaadanute) tafaqadalaacehu 'alaahe ka'asetamaaraacehu `eweqate taasetamerwacawaalaacehu la'enaanetame kayaazulaacehu nagare belu baresume laaye ya'alaahene seme 'awesu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe meremaraawe fathaane nawenaa >>

zaaree malekaamoce hulu lanaaneta tafaqadu ya'enaziyaame matsehhafene yatasathute sawoce megebe (yaaradute) la'enaaneta yatafaqada nawe megebaacehume lanasu yatafaqada nawe kame'emanaate thebeqocume ka'enaziyaa ka'enaaneta bafite matsehhafene katasathute seetoce thebeqocume; zamaawiwocenaa (zemutanyoce) yamesethire wadaaje yaazhiwoce saatekxonu thebeqoce kxonaacehu maherocaacawene basathaacexwaacawe gizee (letaagabuwaacawe yatafaqadu naacawe) ka'emenateme yamimalase sawe ba'eregethe szeraawe tabalaasha bamacharashaame qane 'eresu kakasaariwocu nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! wada solaate baqomaacehu (lamaqome baasabaacehu) gizee fitocaacehune, 'ejocaacehuneme 'eseka kerenoce 'ethabu raasocaacehuneme (bawehaa) 'abesu 'egerocaacehuneme 'eseka qurechemechemitoce ('ethabu) (seete gaare bamaganaanyate wayeme baleelaa mekeneyaate <<janaabaa>>) betekxonu (galaacehune) taathabu bashetanyoce wayeme baguzo laaye betekxonume wayeme ka'enaaneta 'anedaacehu ka`aayena medere bimathaa wayeme seetocene betenakaakunaa wehaane baataaganyu netsuhhene yamedere gatse 'asebu kasume fitocaacehunenaa 'ejocaacehune 'abesu 'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye meneme cegere liyaadarege 'ayeshaame gene taamasagenu zanede liyaatharaacehunaa tsagaawene ba'enaaneta laaye limolaa yeshaale

ba'enaanetame laaye (yalagasawene) ya'alaahene tsagaa yaaneneme sametanaale taazanaaleme baalaacehu gizee baresu yaathabaqabaacehune qaale kidaanune 'asetaawesu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe badaratoce wesethe yaalawene hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! la'alaahe qathetanyoce batekekele masekaariwoce kxunu hhezeboceneme mathelaate baalamaasetakaakale laaye 'ayegafaafaacehu 'asetakaakelu 'eresu (maasetakaakale) la'alaahe feraacaa bathaame yaqaraba nawe 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe
'enaziyaaneme yaamanutenenaa bago szeraawocene yaszarutene 'alaahe (ganatene) tasefaa 'adaragalaacawe la'enaresu mehheratenaa taalaaqe menedaa 'alaacawe
'enaziyaame yakaadunaa bata'ameraatocaacene yaasetabaabalu 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! hhezeboce 'ejocaacawene wada 'enaaneta lizaragu baasabunaa 'ejocaacawene ka'enaaneta laaye bakalakalaacehu gizee banaaneta laaye (yawaalalaacehune) ya'alaahene tsagaa 'asetaawesu 'alaaheneme feru me'emanaaneme ba'alaahe laaye yemaku

'alaaheme ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce yathabaqa qaale kidaane ba'eregethe yaazabaacawe kanaresume `aseraa hulatene 'alaqoce 'asenasaane 'alaaheme 'alaacawe; <<'enee kanaaneta gaare nanye; solaatene betaasetakaakelu gedeetaa metsewaateneme betesathu bamaleketanyoceeme betaamenu beteraduwaacaweme la'alaaheme malekaame bederene betaabaderu xathi'atocaacehune kanaaneta ba'eregethe 'abesaalahu kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoceme ba'eregethe 'agabaacexwaalahu kaziheme baxwaalaa ka'enaaneta yakaada sawe qathetanyaawene manegade ba'eregethe tasaasaata >>

qaale kidaanaacaweneme bamaaferasaacawe ragamenaacawe lebocaacaweneme daraqoce 'adaragene qaalaatene kabotaawocaacawe yelawethaalu baresume kataazazubate nagare fanetaane tawe ka'enasume theqitoce siqaru kanaresu yakxonane kedaate yametaaweqebaacawe kamakxone 'atewagademe ka'enaresume yeqeretaa 'aderege 'elafaacaweme 'alaahe malekaame szariwocene yewadaalenaa

ka'enaziyaame 'enyaa keresetiyaanoce nane kaalute yathabaqa qaale kidaanaacawene yaazene ba'eresume kataazazubate nagare fanetaane tawete selazihe 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase bamakaakalaacawe thabenenaa thelaacaane thaalenebaacawe 'alaaheme yeszarute yanabarutene hulu ba'eregethe yenageraacawaale

yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! kamatsehhafu teshashegute kanabaraacehute nagare bezuwene la'enaaneta yamigaletse kabezuweme yamitawe sikxone maleketanyaacene (muhhamade) ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu ka'alaahe zanede berehaanenaa galaache matsehhafe ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu
'alaahe wedeetaawene yatakatalutene sawoce yasalaamene manegadoce ba'eresu yemaraacawaale bafaqaadume kachalamaawoce wada berehaane yaawathaacawaale wada qathetanyaame manegade yemaraacawaale

'enaziyaa 'alaahe 'eresu yamareyame leje 'alemasihhe nawe yaalu ba'eregethe kaadu yamareyamene leje 'alemasihhene 'enaatuneme bamedere yaalaneme hulu lamaathefaate bishaa ka'alaahe maadaanene yamicele maanawe balaacawe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere yamakaakalaacaweme negeszenaa ya'alaahe becaa nawe yamishaawene yefatheraale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'ayehudocenaa keresetiyaanoceme <<'enyaa ya'alaahe lejocenaa wadaajocu nane>> 'alu <<taadiyaa baxaathi'atocaacehu lamene yaasaqaayaacexwaale 'ayedalaacehume 'enaaneta kafatharaacawe sawoce naacehu>> balaacawe lamishaawe sawe yemeraale yamishaaweneme sawe yeqathaale yasamaayaatenaa yamedereme bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe hulu negeszenaa ya'alaahe becaa nawe mamalashaame wadaresu becaa nawe

'enaaneta yamatsehhafu sawoce hoye! <<'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari 'alemathaaleneme>> 'enedaatelu kamaleketanyoce bamaqwaarathe gizee laaye sikxone (hhegaacenene) yamiyaaberaaraa kxono maleketanyaacene ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraarime ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

musaame lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) - <<hhezebocee hoye ya'alaahene tsagaa bawesethaacehu nabiyaatene baadaraganaa nagaszetaateneme baadaragaacehu ka`aalamaateme la'anedeme yaalesathawene cerotaa basathaacehu gizee ba'enaaneta laaye (yaadaragawene tsagaa) 'asetaawesu >>
<<hhezebocee hoye! yaacene 'alaahe la'enaaneta yaadaragaatene yataqadasacewene mareete gebu wada xwaalaacehume 'atemalasu kasaariwoce kxonaacehu temalasaalaacehunaa >>
<<musaa hoye! baresewaa wesethe xayaalaane hhezeboce 'alu karesewaame 'esekamiwathu derase 'enyaa fatsemo 'anegabaateme karesewaame biwathu 'enyaa gabiwoce nane>> 'alu

ka'enaziyaa ('alaahene) kamifarutenaa 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye kalagasalaacawe yakxonu hulate sawoce <<ba'enaresu (baxayaalocu) laaye barune gebu bagabaacehuteme gizee 'enaaneta 'ashanaafiwoce naacehu me'emanaaneme 'enedakxonaacehu ba'alaahe laaye tamaku>> 'alu
<<musaa hoye! bawesethwa 'esekaalu derase 'enyaa fatsemo mene gizeeme 'anegabaateme selazihe kxide 'anetanaa geetaahe tagaadalume 'enyaa 'ezihe taqamaachoce nane>> 'alu
<<geetaayee hoye 'enee raaseenenaa wanedemeene baqare (laasegadede) 'aleceleme ba'enyaanaa ba'amatsanyocume hhezeboce makaakale laye>> 'ala
'eresewaame (yataqadasacewe mareete) ba'enaresu laaye 'arebaa `aamate 'ereme naate bamedera badaa yenekaraatataalu <<ba'amatsanyoceme hhezeboce laaye 'atezane>> 'alawe

banaresume laaye ya'adamene hulate lejoce waree qurebaanene baaqarabunaa ('alaahe) ka'anedanyaacawe taqabelo kaleelaawe baaletaqabala gizee (yakxonawene) ba'ewenate 'anebebelaacawe <<ba'eregethe 'egadelehaalahu>> 'alawe (tagadaayu) <<'alaahe yamiqabalawe 'eko kathenequqocu becaa nawe>> 'ala
<<letegadelanye 'ejehene wadanee betezaragaa 'enee legadelehe 'ejeene wadaaneta yamezaragaa 'ayedalahume 'enee ya`aalamaatene geetaa 'alaahene 'efaraalahunaa>> 'ala
<<'enee baxaathi'ateenaa baxaathi'atehe letemalasenaa ka'esaate gwaadoce letekxone 'eshaalahu; yekxeme yabadalanyoce qethaate nawe>> ('ala)
nafesume wanedemune magedalene laresu shalamacelate;('anasaasaacewe;) gadalaweme kakasaariwocume kxona

yawanedemuneme reesaa 'enedeete 'enedamishashege yaasaayawe zanede 'alaahe mareetene yamichere quraane laakalate <<waye 'enee yawanedemeene reesaa 'eshashege zanede 'enedazihe quraa bethee makxone 'aqaatanyene>> 'ala katsatsatanyoceme kxona

bazihe mekeneyaate ba'eseraa'eele lejoce laaye 'enaho yaala nafese (magedale) wayeme bamedere laaye yaalamaathefaate (kaalehona basetaqare) nafesene yagadala sawe sawocune hulu 'enedagadala nawe; hheyaawe yaadaragaateme sawe sawocune hulu hheyaawe 'enedaadaraga nawe maalatene tsaafene maleketanyocaaceneme bageletse ta`aameraate ba'eregethe mathuwaacawe kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa ka'enasu bezuwocu bamedere laaye wasanene 'alaafiwoce naacawe

ya'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamiwaagu bamedereme laaye lamaathefaate yamitagu sawoce qethaate magadale wayeme masaqale wayeme 'ejocaacawenenaa 'egerocaacawene bamaafaraaraqe maqorathe wayeme ka'agare mabaarare nawe yehe banasu baqerebitu `aalame weredate nawe bamacharashaayetume la'enaresu kabaade qethaate 'alaacawe
'enaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye kamacaalaacehu (kamawasanaacehu) bafite yatatsatsatu siqaru 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye makxonune 'ewaqu
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru wadaresume maqaarabiyaane (malekaame szeraane) falegu tedenu zanedeme ba'eresu manegade taagalu

'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce bamedere laaye yaalawe hulu ka'eresume gaare betheewe kateneszaa'ee qane qethaate ba'eresu libazhubate la'enaresu banoraacawe noro ka'enasu taqabaayene baalaaganyu nabare la'enasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
ka'esaate liwathu yefalegaalu 'enaresume karesewaa wachiwoce 'ayedalume la'enaresume zawetaari qethaate 'alaacawe
saraaqiwenenaa saraaqiyetuneme baszarute nagare laqethaate ka'alaahe yakxonane maqathaachaa 'ejocaacawene qurathu 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
kabadalume baxwaalaa yatatsatsatanaa szeraawene yaasaamara 'alaahe tsatsatune ka'eresu yeqabalawaale 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa yasu (ya'alaahe) becaa makxonune 'alaawaqekemene yamishaawene sawe yeqathaale lamishaaweme sawe yemeraale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'aneta maleketanyaa hoye! 'enaziyaa bakehhedate yamicaakolute ka'enaziyaa lebocaacawe yaalaamanu sikxonu ba'afocaacawe <<'amanene>> kaalutenaa ka'enaziyaame 'ayehude kakxonute sikxonu 'ayaasaazenuhe ('enaresu) weshatene 'adaamaachoce naacawe laleeloce wadaaneta laalemathu hhezeboce 'adaamaachoce naacawe negegerocene kabotaacawe leelaa yaathaamemaalu <<yehenene (yatathaamamawene) betesesathu yaazute baatesesathuteme tathaneqaqu>> yelaalu 'alaaheme mafatanune yamishaabatene sawe la'eresu ka'alaahe (lamakalaakale) meneneme 'ateceleme 'enazihe 'enaziyaa 'alaahe lebocaacawene maatheraatene yaaleshaalaacawe naacawe la'enaresu baqerebitu `aalame weredate 'alaacawe la'enaresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame kabaade qethaate 'alaacawe

weshatene 'adaamaachoce 'eremene balaatanyoce naacawe wada'aneta bimathaame bamakaakalaacawe ferade wayeme tawaacawe betetawaacaweme meneme 'ayegoduheme betefaredeme bamakaakalaacawe batekekele ferade 'alaahe batekekele faraajocene yewadaalenaa

'enaresume zanede taweraate 'eyaalace bawesethwa ya'alaahe ferede yaalabaate setekxone 'enedeete yaasefareduhaale! kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa 'enedeete yeshashaalu! 'enaziyaame bafetsume me'emenaane 'ayedalume

'enyaa taweraatene bawesethewaa mameriyaanaa berehaane yaalabaate setekxone 'awaradene 'enaziyaa te`ezaazene yataqabalute nabiyaate ba'enaziyaa 'ayehudaaweyaane bakxonute laaye bareswa yefaredaalu liqaawenetunaa `awaaqiwocume ka'alaahe matsehhafe 'enedithabequ batadaragutenaa baresume laaye masekaariwoce bakxonute (yefaredaalu) sawoceneme 'ateferu ferunyeme ba'aneqatsoceeme 'anasetanyaane waagaa 'atelawethu 'alaaheme baawaradawe nagare yaalefarada sawe 'enaziyaa kahhaadiwocu 'enaresu naacawe

ba'enaresume laaye bawesethwa <<nafese banafese `aayeneme ba`aayene 'afenechaame ba'afenechaa jorome bajoro thereseme batherese (yeyaazaale) >> quseloceneme maamasaasale 'alabaacawe maalatene tsaafene ba'eresume yamatsawata (yamaara) sawe 'eresu laresu (laszaraawe xaathi'ate) maasetasariyaa nawe 'alaaheme baawaradawe nagare yamaayefarede sawe; 'enaziyaa badalanyocu 'enaresu naacawe

bafalagocaacaweme (banabiyaatocu falage) laaye yamareyamene leje `isaane kataweraate basetafitu yaalawene 'aragaagaache sikxone 'asekatalene nejileneme bawesethu qathetaanaa berehaane yaalabate basetafitu yaalacewene taweraateneme yamiyaaragaagethe lathenequqoceme marinaa gasaache sikxone sathanawe
yanejeleme baalabeetoce bawesethu 'alaahe baawaradawe hhege yeferadu 'alaaheme baawaradawe yamaayefarede sawe 'enaziyaa 'amatsanyoce 'enaresu naacawe

wada 'anetame matsehhafune kabafitu yaalawene matsehhafe 'aragaagaachenaa ba'eresu laaye tathabaabaaqi sikxone ba'ewenate 'awaradene bamakaakalaacaweme 'alaahe baawaradawe hhege ferade 'ewenatume kamathaalehe baxwaalaa zenebaaleewocaacawene 'atekatale ka'enaaneta lahulume hhegenenaa manegadene 'adaragene 'alaaheme bashaa noro 'anede hhezebe baadaragaacehu nabare gene basathaacehu hhegegaate limokeraacehu (layaayaacehu) bago szeraawoceneme (lamaszeraate) tasheqadaadamu; mamalashaacehu bathaqelaalaa wada 'alaahe nawe ba'eresume telayaayubate yanabaraacehutene nagare yenageraacexwaale

bamakaakalaacaweme 'alaahe baawaradawe hhege ferade felaagotocaacaweneme 'atekatale 'alaaheme wada 'aneta kaawaradawe kakafilu 'enedaayaasaasetuhe tathaneqaqaacawe (maalatene 'awaradene) bizorume 'alaahe yamishaawe bakafilu xaathi'ataacawe liqathaacawe makxonune `ewaqe kasawocume bezuwocu 'amatsanyoce naacawe
yamaayemenenatene ferede yefalegaalune lamiyaaragaagethume sawoce ka'alaahe yebalethe feredu yaamaara maane nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'ayehudocenenaa keresetiyaanocene radaatoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu kafilaacawe lakafilu radaatoce naacawe ka'enaanetame wesethe radaatoce yamiyaadaregaacawe sawe 'eresu kanaresu nawe 'alaahe 'amatsanyocene hhezeboce 'ayaaqanaame

'enaziyaaneme balebocaacawe wesethe (yanefeqenaa) bashetaa yaalabaacawene sawoce <<yagizee malawaawathe 'enedaayaaganyane 'enefaraalane yamilu>> sikxonu ba'enaresu (lamaradaate) sicaakolu taayaacawaalahe 'alaaheme dele manesaatene wayeme ka'eresu zanede yakxonane nagare (maagaalathene) liyaamathaa banafesocaacawe wesethe badabaquteme nagare tatsatsaacoce sihonu taragaagatha

'enaziyaame yaamanute sawoce - <<'enaziyaa 'enaresu ka'enaaneta gaare nane belawe yathanakara mahhalaacawene ba'alaahe yamaalute 'enazihe naacawene>> yelaalu szeraawocaacawe tabalaashu kasaariwoceme kxonu

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'enaaneta wesethe kahaayemaanotu yamimalase sawe 'alaahe (ba'enaresu seferaa) yamiwadaacawenenaa yamiwadutene, bame'emanaane laaye tehhutoce, bakahhaadiwoce laaye xayaalaane yakxonune ba'alaahe manegade yamitaagalune yawaqaashene waqasaa yamaayefarune hhezeboce ba'eregethe yaamathaale yekxa ya'alaahe cerotaa nawe; lamishaawe sawe yesathawaale; 'alaaheme cerotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe
radaataacehu 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe 'enaziyaame yaamanute becaa naacawe ('enaresu) 'enaziyaa solaatene badanebu yamisagedu 'enaresume yaagonabasu kxonawe metsewaatene yamisathu naacawe
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene 'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene yamiwadaaje sawe (ka'alaahe cheferoce yekxonaale) ya'alaaheme cheferoce 'enaresu 'ashanaafiwoce naacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'enaziyaa kabafitaacehu matsehhafene katasathute 'enaziyaane haayemaanotaacehune maalaagachaanaa machaawacaa 'aderegawe yayaazutene kahhaadiwoceneme radaatoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu me'emenaaneme 'enedakxonaacehu 'alaahene feru
wada solaateme batharaacehu gizee (theriyetune) masaalaqiyaanaa machaawacaa 'aderegawe yeyezwataale yehe 'enaresu yamaayaawequ hhezeboce bamakxonaacawe nawe

<<yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! ba'alaahenaa wadanyaa batawaradawe bafiteme batawaradawe lamaamanaacene 'abezaanyocaacehume 'amatsanyoce lamakxonaacehu 'eneje (leelaane nagare) kanyaa tethalaalaacehune>> balaacawe

<<'alaahe zanede qethaatu kazihe yakafaa nagare lenegaraacehune>> balaacawe ('eresume) <<'alaahe yaragamawe sawe ba'eresume laaye taqothaabate ka'enaresume zenejarowocenenaa karekarowocene yaadaragawe thaa`oteneme yatagazaa sawe (haayemaanote) nawe 'enaziyaa bathaame bakafaa seferaa naacawe >> kaqathetanyaaweme manegade bathaame yatasaasaatu naacawe

bamathuwaacehume gizee (wada'enaaneta) kakehedate gaare ba'eregethe yagabu 'enaresume karesu gaare ba'eregethe yawathu sikxonu <<'amenanaale>> yelaalu 'alaaheme yedabequte yanabarutene nagare bathaame `awaaqi nawe
ka'enaresume bezuwocune baxaathi'atenaa babadale 'eremeneme bamabelaataacawe yamithaadafu sikxonu taayaalahe yeszarute yanabarute nagare bathaame kafaa!
qasaawesetunaa liqaawenetu kaxaathi'ate negegeraacawenaa 'eremene kamabelaataacawe 'ayekalakelwacaweme noro'alene yeszarute yanabarute nagare bathaame kafaa!

'ayehudoceme <<ya'alaahe 'eje yataasarace naate>> 'alu 'ejocaacawe yetaasaru baaluteme nagare yeragamu 'ayedalame (ya'alaahe) 'ejocu yatazaragu naacawe 'enedamishaa yelagesaale kageetaaheme wada 'aneta yatawaradawe (qure'aane) ka'enasu bezuwocune te`ebitenenaa kehedatene ba'eregethe yechameraacawaale bamakaakalaacaweme thabenenaa thelaacaane 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase thaalene lathore 'esaatene baayaayaazu (baachaaru) quthere 'alaahe yaathafaataale bamedereme wesethe lamaabalaashate yerothaalu 'alaaheme 'abalaashiwocene 'ayewademe
yamatsehhafume baalabeetoce baamanunaa (kakehedateme) batathanaqaqu noro ka'enasu xaathi'aatocaacawene ba'eregethe baabasenenaa yamathaqamiyaa ganatoceneme ba'eregethe baagabaanaacawe nabare

'enaresume taweraatenenaa nejilene kageetaacaweme wada'enasu yatawaradawene matsehhafe baaqwaaqwaamu (baszarubate) noro kabalaayaacawenaa ka'egerocaacawe szere batamagabu nabare ka'enasu wesethe tekekelanyoce hhezeboce 'alelu ka'enasume bezuwocu yamiszarute nagare kafaa!
'aneta maleketanyaa hoye! kageetaahe wadaaneta yatawaradawene 'aderese baateszaraame maleketune 'alaadarasekeme 'alaaheme kasawoce yethabeqehaale 'alaahe kahhaadiwocene hhezeboce 'ayaaqanaamenaa

<<'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! taweraatenenaa nejilene kageetaacehume wada'enaaneta yatawaradawene 'esekametaaqomu ('esekameteszarubaacawe) derase bameneme laaye 'ayedalaacehume>> balaacawe kageetaaheme wada 'aneta yatawaradawe qure'aane ka'enasu bezuwocune te`ebitenenaa kehedatene ba'eregethe yechamerebaacawaale bakahhaadiyaane hhezeboceme laaye 'atezane

'enaziyaa yaamanunaa 'enaziyaame 'ayehudaaweyaane yakxonu, saabiyaanoceme, keresetiyaanoceme (kanaresu) ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yaamananaa malekaamene szeraa yaszaraa sawe banaresu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme 'enaresume 'ayaazenume

ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce yathabaqa qaale kidaane ba'eregethe yaazenebaacawe wada'enasume maleketanyocene laakene nafesocaacawe bamaatewadawe nagare male'eketanyaa bamathaalaacawe quthere kafilune 'asetabaabalu; kafiluneme yegadelaalu

fatanaame 'alamanorewaane tharatharu taawarume, danaqorume, kaziyaame 'alaahe kanaresu laaye tsatsatene taqabala kaziyaame ka'enasu bezuwocu taawaru, danaqorume 'alaaheme yamiszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

'enaziyaa <<'alaahe 'eresu yamareyame leje 'alemasihhe nawe>> yaalu ba'eregethe kaadu 'alemasiheme 'ala - <<ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! geetaayeenenaa geetaacehune 'alaahene tagazu >> 'enaho! ba'alaahe yamiyaagaaraa sawe 'alaahe baresu laaye ganatene ba'eregethe 'ereme 'adaraga manoriyaaweme 'esaate naate labadaayoceme meneme radaatoce yalwacaweme

'enaziyaa <<'alaahe yaszosete szosetanyaa nawe>> yaalu ba'eregethe kaadu ka'amelaakeme 'anede 'amelaake 'eneje leelaa yalame kamiluteme nagare baayekalakalu kanasu 'enaziyaane yakaadutene 'asaamaami qethaate ba'eregethe yenakaacawaale
wada 'alaahe 'ayemalasumenaa mehheratene 'ayelamenutemene 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

yamareyame leje 'alemasihhe kabafitu maleketanyoce ba'eregethe yaalafu yakxona maleketanyaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame 'enaatume bathaame 'ewenatanyaa naate (hulatume) megebene yamibalu nabaru; 'aneqatsocene lanaresu (lakahhaadiwoce) 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraa tamalekate kaziyaame (ka'ewenate) 'enedeete 'enedamimalasu tamalekate
<<ka'alaahe leelaa la'enaaneta magudaatenenaa matheqamene yamaayecelene tegazaalaacehune>> balaacawe 'alaaheme 'eresu samiwe `awaaqi nawe

<<'enaaneta yamatsehhafu baalabeetoce hoye! bahaayemaanotaacehu ka'ewenate leelaa yakxonane (maalafe) wasanene 'atelafu bafiteme ba'eregethe yatasaasaatutenenaa kaqathetanyaawe manegademe ('ahune) yatasaasaatune hhezeboce kanetu zenebaaleewoce 'atekatalu>> balaacawe
ka'eseraa'eele lejoce 'enaziyaa yakaadute badaawedenaa bamareyame leje ba`isaa melaase taragamu yehe te'ezaazene bamathaasaacawenaa wasanene yamiyaalefu bamakxonaacawe nawe
kaszarute mathefo nagare 'ayekalaakalume nabare yeszarute yanabarute nagare ba'eregethe kafaa!

ka'enasu bezuwocune 'enaziyaane yakaadutene siwadaaju taayaalahe ba'enasu laaye 'alaahe yataqothaabaacawe bamakxonu la'enaresu nafesocaacawe yaaseqadamute szeraa bathaame kafaa 'enasume baqethaate wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
ba'alaahenaa banabiyu wadaresume batawaradawe qure'aane yamiyaamenu bakxonu noro wadaajoce 'aderegawe baaleyaazuwaacawe nabare gene kanaresu bezuwocu 'amathanyoce naacawe

'ayehudocenenaa 'enaziyaane yaagaarutene la'enaziyaa la'amanute bathalaatenate kasawoce hulu yebalethe yabaratu kxonawe ba'eregethe taaganyaalahe 'enaziyaaneme <<'enyaa keresetiyaanoce nane>> yaalutene la'enaziyaa la'amanute bawadaajenate ba'eregethe yebalethe yaqarabwacawe kxonawe taaganyaalahe yehe ka'enasu wesethe qasaawesetenaa manakosaate bamanoraacawenaa 'enasume yamaayekoru bamakxonaacawe nawe

wada maleketanyaaweme yatawaradawene (qure'aane) basamu gizee 'ewenatune kamaawaqaacawe yatanasaa `aayenocaacawe 'enebaane siyaafasu taayaalahe <<geetaacene hoye! 'amanene kamasekaariwocume gaare tsaafane >> yelaalu
<<ba'alaahenaa kawenateme bamathaalene nagare yamaanaamene geetaaceneme kamalekaame sawoce gaare liyaasegabaane yamaanekajele lanyaa mene 'alane>> (yelaalu)
baaluteme mekeneyaate 'alaahe baseszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu manadaacawe yeheme yabago szariwoce waagaa nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadunaa ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalu 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahe lanaaneta yafaqadalaacehune thaafaachoce 'ereme 'ataaderegu wasaneneme 'atelafu 'alaahe wasane 'alaafiwocene 'ayewademenaa
'alaaheme kasathaacehu sisaaye yatafaqada thaafaache sikxone belu yaaneneme 'enaaneta baresu 'amaanyoce yakxonaacehubatene 'alaahene feru

'alaahe bamahhalaawocaacehu bawedequ 'ayezaacehume gene mahhalaawocene (baasabaacehute) yeyezaacexwaale maasetasariyaaweme beetasabocaacehune kametemagebute kamakaakalanyaawe (megebe) `aserene mesekinoce maabelaate wayeme 'enasune maalebase wayeme chaaneqaane natsaa maawethaate nawe; (katabaalute 'anedune) yaalaaganyame sawe szosete qanocene matsome nawe; yehe bamaalaacehu gizee yamahhalaawocaacehu maakaakaashaa nawe mahhalaawocaacehuneme thabequ 'enedazihu 'alaahe lanaaneta 'aneqatsocene yaaberaaraale 'enaaneta letaamasagenu yekajalaalenaa
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! yamiyaasakere mathathe qumaareme thaa`otaateme 'azelaameme kasayethaane szeraa yakxonu 'erekuse becaa naacawe ('erekusene) raaquteme letedenu yekajalaalenaa

sayethaane yamifalegawe bamiyaasakere mathathenaa baqumaare bamakaakalaacehu thabenenaa thelaacaane lithele 'alaahene kamaawesaatenaa kasegedateme liyaagedaacehu becaa nawe taadiyaa 'enaaneta (ka'enazihe) takalekaayoce naacehune (takalekalu)
'alaaheneme tagazu maleketanyaaweneme taazazu tathaneqaqume beteshashume; bamaleketanyaacene laaye yaalabate geletse maaderase becaa makxonune `ewaqu

ba'enaziyaa baamanutenaa bago szeraawocene baszarute laaye (kehedatene) batathanaqaqunaa baamanu malekaame szeraawoceneme baszaru kaziyaame (yamiyaasakerenenaa qumaarene) batathanaqaqunaa baamanu kaziyaame (katakalakalawe hulu) batathanaqaqunaa (szeraane) baasaamaru gizee (kamakalekalu bafite) batamagabute nagare xaathi'ate yalabaacaweme 'alaaheme bago szariwocene yewadaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! (bahhaje gizee) 'ejocaacehunaa thorocaacehu bamiyaaganyute taadaanye 'aweree 'alaahe yemokeraacexwaale baruqe kxono yamifaraawene sawe 'alaahe ligaletse (yemokeraacexwaale) kaziyaame baxwaalaa wasanene yaalafanaa yaadana sawe laresu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaanete bahhaje szeraa wesethe setekxonu 'awereene 'ategedalu ka'enaanetame 'eyaawaqa yagadalawe sawe qethaatu ka'enaaneta hulate yatekekelanyaanate baalabeetoce yamifaredubate yakxona wada kaa`ebaa daraashe maszewaa`ete sikxone kabeete 'enesesaawoce yagadalawene nagare bethee masethate wayeme mesekinocene maabelaate wayeme yazihene leke matsome maakaakaashaa nawe (yekxeme) yaszeraawene kabaade qethaate 'enediqamese nawe (saayekalakale bafite) kaalafawe nagare 'alaahe yeqeretaa 'adaraga (wada thefaatume) yatamalasame sawe 'alaahe karesu yebaqalaale 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi yamabaqale baalabeete nawe

yabaahhere taadaanyenaa megebu la'enaanetame lamanegadanyoceme mathaqamiyaa yekxone zanede lanaaneta tafaqada bahhajeme laaye 'esekaalaacehu derase yayabese 'aweree banaaneta laaye 'ereme tadaraga yaaneneme wadaresu yametesabasabubatene 'alaahene feru

ka`ebaane, yatakabarawene beete, kelekele yakxonaweneme ware, masewaa`etunenaa baala meleketocuneme manegaawoce 'alaahe lasawoce maqwaaqwaamiyaa 'adaraga yehe 'alaahe basamaayaate yaalawene hulu bamedereme yaalawene hulu yamiyaaweqe makxonune 'alaaheme nagarune hulu `awaaqi makxonune 'enedetaawequ nawe
'alaahe qethaata beretu makxonune 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye makxonune 'ewaqu
bamaleketanyaawe laaye maaderase 'eneje leelaa yalabateme 'alaaheme yametegaletsutene nagare yametedabequteneme hulu yaaweqaale
<<yamathefowe (ganezabe) bezaate biyaasedaneqaacehume 'enekwaa mathefowenaa theruwe 'ayesetakaakalume baalaleboce hoye! 'alaaheneme feru; 'enaaneta letedenu yekajalaalenaa;>> balaacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! la'enaaneta bigalatsu kamiyaasekafwacehu nagaroce 'atethayequ qure'aaneme bamiwaredebate gizee ka'ereswa betethayequ lanaaneta tegalatsaalace; ka'ereswa 'alaahe yeqeretaa 'adaraga 'alaaheme mahhaari taagaashe nawe
kanaanetame bafite hhezeboce ba'eregethe thayaqwaate kaziyaame ba'ereswa (mekeneyaate) kahhaadiwoce kxonu
kabahhiraa kasaabaame kawasilaame kahhaameme 'alaahe meneneme (hhege) 'alaadaragame gene 'enaziyaa yakaadute ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yeqathaathefaalu 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'ayaawequme

la'enaresume 'alaahe wada 'awaradawenaa wada maleketanyaawe nu batabaalu gizee <<'abaatocaacenene baresu laaye yaaganyanebate nagare yebaqaanaale>> yelaalu 'abaatocaacawe meneme yamaayaawequnaa yamaayemaru bikxonume (yekxanene maalate yebaqaacawaalene)

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! nafesocaacehune (ka'esaate) yaazu; (thabequ) batamaraacehu gizee yatasaasaata sawe 'ayegodaacehume yahulaacehume mamalashaa wada 'alaahe becaa nawe teszaruteme yanabaraacehutene hulu yenageraacexwaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'anedaacehune mote bamathaabate gizee banuzaazee waqete yamakaakalaacehu mesekerenate ka'enaaneta hulate yatekekelanyaanate baalabeetoce yakxonu sawoce wayeme bamedere betegwaazunaa yamote 'adagaa betenakaacehu kaleelocaacehu yakxonu hulate leeloce sawoce (mamasekare) nawe betetharaatharu kasolaate (ka`asure) baxwaalaa taaqomwacawenaa (yamimasakerelate sawe) yazemedenaa baalabeete bikxoneme 'enekwaa <<baresu waagaane 'anegazaame ya'alaaheneme mesekerenate 'anedabeqeme; yaane gizee (dabeqane beneganye) 'enyaa kaxaathi'atanyoce nane>> belawe ba'alaahe seme yemelaalu

'enaresume xaathi'atene (baweshate masekerawe) yatagabu makxonaacawe bitaawaqe ka'enaziyaa (lamwacu) qereboce bamakxone (werese) katagabaacawe yakxonu hulate leeloce sawoce baseferaacawe (bamesekeroce seferaa) yeqomunaa <<mesekerenataacene ka'enasu mesekerenate yeleqe 'ewenate nawe wasaneme 'alaalafeneme yaane gizee 'enyaa kabadaayoce nane>> silu ba'alaahe yemelaalu

yehe mesekerenatene batagabiwaa laaye lamaamethaataacawe wayeme kamahhalaawocaacawe baxwaalaa yamahhalaawocene (wada waraashoce) mamalasene lamaferaate bathaame yaqaraba nawe 'alaaheneme feru semume 'alaaheme 'amatsanyoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraame

'alaahe maleketanyocune yamisabasebebatenenaa <<mene malese tasathaacehu>> yamilebatene qane ('asetaawese) <<la'enyaa meneme `eweqate yalaneme 'aneta ruqocene bathaame `awaaqi 'aneta becaa nahe>> yelaalu

'alaahe bamile gizee ('asetaawese) - <<yamareyame leje `isaa hoye! ba'anetanaa ba'enaatehe laaye (yawaalekulaacehune) tsagaayeene 'asetaawese bahhetzaanenatenaa bakafanisaanate (yabasala sawe kxonahe) sawocene yametenaagare setekxone baqeduse manefase (bagabereele) baabarataahuhe gizee; tsehhefatenenaa thebabeneme taweraatenenaa nejileneme baasetamaarekuhe gizee, kacheqaame yawafe qeretse bethee bafaqaadee bameteszaraanaa bawesethwa bametenafaa bafaqaadeeme wafe bametekxone gizee, `ewereme kxono yatawaladanenaa lametsaameneme bafaqaadee bametaashere gizee, mutaaneneme bafaqaadee (kamaqaaberaacawe) bametaawathaa gizee, ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce bata'ameraate bamathaahebaacawenaa ka'enasu 'enaziyaa yakaadute yehe geletse degemete 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame baalu gizee, (ligadeluhe siyaasebuhe) ka'aneta laaye bakalakalekuleheme gizee (yaadaragehulehene welataa 'asetaawese) >>
wada hhawaareyaateme <<baneenaa bamaleketanyaayee 'emanu>> bamaalate baazazeku gizee ('asetaawese) <<'amanene; 'enyaa muselimoce makxonaacenene masekere>> 'alu

hhawaareyaate - <<yamareyame leje `isaa hoye! geetaahe ba'enyaa laaye kasamaaye maa'edene liyaawaredelene yecelaalene>> baalu gizee ('asetaawese) <<me'emanaane 'eneda kxonaacehu 'alaahene feru>> 'alaacawe
<<ka'ereswa lenebalaa lebocaaceneme liraku 'ewenate yaalekaneme makxonehene lenaaweqenaa ba'ereswame laaye kamasekaariwoce lenekxone 'enefalegaalane>> 'alu

yamareyame leje `isaa 'ala - <<geetaacene 'alaahe hoye! la'enyaa lamajamariyaawocaacenenaa lamacharashaawocaacene baa`ele (madasacaa) yametekxonene ka'anetame ta'amere yakxonacene maa'ede kasamaaye ba'enyaa laaye 'awerede sethaneme 'aneta kasachiwoce hulu balaache nahenaa >>
'alaahe - <<'enee (maa'edewaane) banaaneta laaye 'aweraajewaa nanye baxwaalaame ka'enaaneta yamikede sawe 'enee ka`aalamaate 'anedeneme yamaaleqathaawene qethaate 'eqathaawaalahu>> 'ala

'alaaheme - <<yamareyame leje `isaa hoye! 'aneta lasawocu - 'eneenenaa 'enaateene ka'alaahe leelaa hulate 'amelaakoce 'aderegaacehu yaazu belaahaalene>> bamilawe gizee ('asetaawese) <<theraate yegabaahe; la'enee tagabiyee yaalekxonane nagare maalate lanee 'ayegabaanyeme beyeewe 'eneda kxoname ba'eregethe `aweqakxawaale banafesee wesethe yaalawene hulu taaweqaalahe gene 'aneta zanede yaalawene 'alaaweqeme 'aneta ruqocene hulu bathaame `awaaqi 'aneta becaa nahenaa>> yelaale

<<ba'eresu yaazazekanyene qaale geetaayeenenaa geetaacehune 'alaahene tagazu maalatene 'eneji lanaresu leelaa 'alaalekume bawesethaacaweme 'esekaalahu derase banaresu laaye tathaabaabaqi nabareku batamolaakxanyeme gizee (baanasaakxanye gizee) 'aneta banasu laaye tathabaabaaqi nabareke 'anetame banagaru hulu laaye `awaaqi nahe >>
<<beteqathaacawe 'enaresu baarocehe naacawe lanaresu betemereme 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nahe>> (yelaale)

'alaahe yelaale - <<yehe 'ewenatanyocene 'ewenataacawe yamithaqemebate qane nawe la'enaresu baszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe bawesethaacawe hulegizee zawetaariwoce sikxonu yaminorubaacawe ganatoce 'aluwaacawe 'alaahe ka'enasu wadada; 'enaresume ka'eresu wadadu; yehe taalaaqe `edele nawe >>
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bawesethaacaweme yaalawe hulu negeszenaa ya'alaahe becaa nawe 'esume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

mesegaanaa laziyaa samaayaatenenaa mederene lafatharawe chalamaawocenenaa berehaaneneme laadaragawe la'alaahe yatagabaa nawe kaziyaame 'enaziyaa yakaadute (thaa`otaatene bageetaacawe) yaasetakaakelaalu
'eresu yaa kacheqaa yafatharaacehu kaziyaame (yamote) gizeene yawasana nawe 'eresume zanede (lateneszaa'ee) yatawasana gizee 'alela kaziyaame 'enaaneta (bamaqaseqasaacehu) tetharaatharaalaacehu
'eresume yaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere (ligegazute yamigabaawe) 'alaahe nawe mesethiraacehune geletsaacehuneme yaaweqaale yameteszaruteneme hulu yaaweqaale
kageetaacaweme 'aneqatsoce 'anediteme 'aneqatse 'atemathaacaweme kareswa yamishashu bikxonu 'eneje
ba'ewenatume (qure'aane) bamathaalaacawe gizee ba'eregethe 'asetabaabalu ba'eresume yesaalaqubate yanabarute nagare zeenaawoce (qethaate) ba'eregethe yemathaabaacawaale

kabafitaacawe kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezuwocene maathefaataacenene 'alaayumene la'enaaneta yaalaasemacanawene (la'enaresu) bamedere wesethe 'asemacanaacawe ba'enaresume laaye zenaamene yatakataatala sikxone laakene wanezoceneme baszeraacawe 'enedifasu 'adaragene baxaathi'atocaacaweme 'athafaanaacawe kaxwaalaacaweme leelocene yakefela zamane sawoce 'aseganyane
baanetame laaye bawaraqate yatatsaafane matsehhafe baawaradenenaa ba'ejocaacawe banakute noro 'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce <<yehe geletse degemete 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> baalu nabare
<<ba'eresume (bamuhhamade) laaye male'ake 'ayewaradelateme noro'alene>> 'alu male'akene baawaradeneme noro (baayaamenu bathefaataacawe) nagaru batafarada nabare kaziyaame 'ayeqoyume nabare
(maleketanyaawene) male'akeme baadaragenawe noro wanede (basawe mesele) baadaragenawe nabare ba'enaresume laaye yamiyaamasaaselutene nagare baamasaasalenebaacawe nabare
kaaneta bafiteme bamaleketanyoce ba'eregethe talaagethwale ba'enaziyaame ka'enasu baalaagathute laaye ba'eresu yaalaagethu yanabarute nagare (qethaate) waradabaacawe
<<bamedere laaye kxidu ya'asetabaabaayoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu>> balaacawe

<<basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu yamaane nawe>> balaacawe (leelaa malese yalamenaa) <<ya'alaahe nawe>> bale <<banafesu laaye 'ezenatene tsaafa bateneszaa'ee qane ba'eresu therethere yaleelabate sikxone ba'eregethe yesabasebaacexwaale 'enaziyaa nafesocaacawene yaakasaru naacawe; 'enaresume 'ayaamenume
baleelitenaa baqaneme tsathe yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa nawe 'eresume samiwe `awaaqi nawe >>

<<samaayaatenenaa mederene fathaari kakxonawe 'alaahe 'eresu yamimagebe yamaayemagabeme sikxone leelaane 'amelaake 'eyezaalahune>> balaacawe <<'enee majamariyaa te'ezaazene kataqabala sawe lekxone taazazeku ka'agaariwoceme fatsemo 'atekxune (tabeyaalahu)>> balaacawe
<<'enee bageetaayee baametse yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalahu>> balaacawe
baziyaa qane ka'eresu laaye (qethaate) yamimalaselate sawe ('alaahe) ba'eregethe 'azanalate yeheme geletse maagenyate nawe
'alaaheme bagudaate binakaahe la'eresu (lagudaatu) ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'asewagaaje yalame babagome nagare binakaahe 'eresu banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
'eresume kabaarocu balaaye sikxone 'ashanaafi nawe 'eresume thebabanyaawe wesethe `awaaqiwe nawe

<<bamesekerenate kanagaru hulu yebalethe taalaaqe maanawe>> balaacawe (leelaa malese yalamenaa) <<'alaahe nawe ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale masekaari nawe yeheme qure'aane 'enaanetanenaa yadarasawene sawe hulu baresu laasefaraaraabate wadanee tawarada ka'alaahe gaare leeloce 'amaalekete manoraacawene 'enaaneta temasakeraalaacehune>> balaacawe <<'enee 'alemasakereme>> balaacawe <<'eresu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe 'eneeme kametaagaarute nagare netsuhhe nanye>> balaacawe
'enaziyaa matsehhafene yasathanaacawe lejocaacawene 'enedamiyaawequ (muhhamadene) yaawequtaale 'enaziyaa ka'enaresu wesethe nafesocaacawene yaakasarute 'enaresu 'ayaamenume
ba'alaaheme laaye weshatene kaqathaathafa wayeme ba'aneqatsocu kaasetabaabala sawe yebalethe badalanyaa maanawe 'enaho badalanyoce 'ayedenume

hulaacaweneme yamenesabasebebatenenaa kaziyaame la'enaziyaa (thaa`otaatene) la'agaarute 'enaziyaa (la'alaahe) tagaariwoce naacawe belaacehu taasebwacawe yanabaraacehute tagaariwocaacehu yate naacawe yamenelebatene qane ('asetaawese)
kaziyaame malesaacawe <<bageetaacene ba'alaahe yekxunebene 'agaariwoce 'alenabareneme>> maalate 'eneje leelaa 'atekxoneme
banafesaacawe laaye 'enedeete 'eneda waashunaa yeqathaathefute yanabarute nagare ka'enasu 'enedeete 'eneda tasawara tamalekate

ka'enaresume wada 'aneta yamiyaadaamethe sawe 'alela balebocaacaweme laaye 'enedaayaawequte shifaanocene bajorowocaacaweme laaye denequrenaane 'adaragene ta`aamereneme hulu biyaayu bareswa 'ayaamenume bamathuheme gizee yamikaraakaruhe sikxonu 'enaziyaa yakaadute <<yehe (qure'aane) yaqademowocu sawoce tsehhufe taratoce 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> yelaalu
'enaresume (sawocene) ka'eresu yekalakelaalu ka'eresume yereqaalu nafesocaacaweneme 'eneji leelaane 'ayaathafume; gene 'ayaawequme

ba'esaateme laaye bataqomu gizee menawe (wada medera `aalame) batamalasene bageetaaceneme 'aneqatsoce baalaasetabaabalene kame'emenaaneme bakxonene waa menyotaacene! baalu gizee betaaye noro (yamiyaasadanagethene nagare baayahe nabare)

yelequneme kazihe bafite yedabequte yanabarute hulu la'enaresu tagalatsa (wadamedera `aalame) batamalasume noro ka'eresu wada takalakalute nagare batamalasu nabare 'enasume ba'eregethe weshataamoce naacawe
'ereswame (hheyewate) <<yaqerebitu hheyewataacene 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaceme 'enyaame taqaseqaqaashoce 'ayedalaneme>> 'alu

bageetaacaweme laaye (lameremaraa) bataqomu gizee betaaye noro ('asedanegaachene nagare baayahe nabare) <<yehe 'ewenate 'ayedalamene>> yelaacawaale <<bageetaacene yekxunebene 'ewenate nawe>> yelaalu <<tekedute banabaraacehute mekeneyaate qethaatune qemasu>> yelaacawaale

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe maganaanyate yaasetabaabalu ba'eregethe kasaru sa`aatitume badenegate bamathaacaacawe gizee 'enasu xaathi'aatocaacawene bajarebaawocaacawe laaye yamishakamu sikxonu <<bareswa (bamedera `aalame) baagwaadalenawe nagare laaye waa quchitaacene>> yelaalu nequ! yamishakamute nagare kafaa
yaqerebitume hheyewate chawaataanaa laagethaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaceme yamacharashaayetume 'agare (ganate) la'enaziyaa lamithanaqaqute bathaame balaache naate 'ataawequmene
'enaho yaa yamiluhe nagare 'enedamiyaasaazenehe ba'eregethe 'enaaweqaalane 'enaresume (balebocaacawe) 'ayaasetabaabeluheme gene badaayocu ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yekedaalu

kabafiteheme maleketanyoce ba'eregethe tasetabaabalu batasetabaabalubateme nagarenaa batasaqaayute laaye 'eredaataacene 'esekamathaalaacawe derase taagasu ya'alaaheneme negegeroce lawaache yalame kamaleketanyocume waree (yameteragaagaabate) ba'eregethe mathaalehe

(selaamene) matawaacaweme baaneta laaye kabaade bikxonebehe bamedere wesethe qadaadaane wayeme basamaaye wesethe masalaalene letefalegenaa bata'amere letemathaacawe betecele ('aderege) 'alaaheme bashaa noro baqenu manegade laaye basabasaabaacawe nabare katasaasaatuteme sawoce bafetsume 'atekxune
therihene yamiqabalute 'enaziyaa yamisamute becaa naacawe mutaaneneme 'alaahe yeqasaqesaacawaale kaziyaame wadaresu becaa yemalasaalu
<<kageetaaweme ba'eresu laaye lamene ta`aamere 'aletawaradame>> 'alu <<'alaahe ta'amerene bamaawerade laaye caaye nawe>> balaacawe gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme

kataneqasaaqaasheme bamedere (yamikxeede); bahulate kenefocu yamibareme baraari masalocaacehu hhezeboce 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalume bamatsehhafu wesethe meneneme nagare 'aletaweneme kaziyaame wada geetaacawe yesabasabaalu

'enaziyaame ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasewaashu daneqoroce dedaawoceme bachalamaawoce wesethe yaalu naacawe 'alaahe maathemamune yamishaawene sawe yaathamawaale mameraatune yamishaaweneme sawe baqathetanyaa manegade laaye yaadaregawaale
ya'alaahe qethaate bimathaabaacehu wayeme sa`aatitu (teneszaa'ee) betemathaabaacehu ka'alaahe leelaane tetharaalaacehune 'ewenatanyoce 'eneda kxonaacehu negarunye balaacawe
'ayedalame 'eresune becaa tetharaalaacehu bishaame wadaresu yametetharubatene nagare yaasewagedaale yametaagaaruteneme nagare tetawaalaacehu (balaacawe)
kabafiteheme wada nabarute hhezeboce (maleketanyocene) ba'eregethe laakene 'enediwaadaqume badehenatenaa babashetaa yaazenaacawe
taadiyaa qethaataacene bamathaabaacawe gizee 'ayewaadaqume norwalene gene lebocaacawe daraqu yeszarute yanabaruteneme nagare sayethaane lanasu 'asaamaralaacawe

baresume yegasatsubate yanabarawene nagare batawe gizee ba'enasu laaye yanagarene hulu dajaafoce kafatene ('asemacanaacawe) batasathuteme nagare batadasatu gizee badenegate yaazenaacawe wadiyaawenume 'enaresu tasefaa qoraachoce kxonu
ya'enaziyaame yabadalute hhezeboce macharashaa taqoratha mesegaanaame la`aalamaate geetaa la'alaahe yegabaawe

negarunye 'alaahe masemiyaacehunenaa maayaawocaacehune biwasede balebocaacehume laaye biyaateme ka'alaahe leelaa 'esune yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake maanawe balaacawe 'aneqatsocene 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraa kaziyaame 'enasu 'enedeete 'enedamimalasu tamalekate
<<negarunye ya'alaahe qethaate badenegate wayeme bageletse bimathaabaacehu 'amathanyoce hhezeboce 'eneje leelaa yethafaalene>> balaacawe
maleketanyoceneme 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari 'aderegane 'eneje 'anelekeme yaamanunaa malekaamene yaszaru sawoceme ba'enaresu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayaazenume
'enaziyaame baaneqatsocaacene yaasewaashu yaametsu banabarute mekeneyaate qethaatu yaaganyaacawaale

<<la'enaaneta ya'alaahe gemejaa beetoce 'enee zanede naacawe 'aleleme ruqeneme 'alaaweqeme la'enaanetame 'enee male'ake nanye 'aleleme wada'enee yamiwaredelenyene 'eneje leelaane 'alekataleme>> balaacawe <<`ewerenaa yamiyaaye yesetakaakalaalune 'ataasetanatenumene>> balaacawe
'enaziyaaneme ka'eresu leelaa radaatenaa 'amaalaaje yaleelaacawe sikxonu wada geetaacawe masesabesabene yamifarutene yethanaqaqu zanede baresu (baqure'aane) 'asefaraaraa

'enaziyaane geetaacawene fitune (wedeetaawene) yamishu kxonawe bathwatenaa bamaataa yamitharutene 'ataabaare taabaareraacawenaa kabadalanyoceme tekxone zanede 'enasune maqothaathare baaneta laaye meneme yalabeheme 'anetaneme maqothaathare banasu laaye meneme yalabaacaweme
'enedazihume <<kamakaakalaacene 'alaahe yalagasalaacawe 'enazihe naacawene>> yelu zanede kafilaacawene bakafilu mokarene 'alaahe 'amasegaanyocune `awaaqi 'ayedalamene

'enaziyaame bata'ameraataacene yamiyaamenute (wada 'aneta) bamathu gizee <<salaame ba'enaaneta laaye yekxune geetaacehu banafesu laaye 'ezenatene tsaafa 'enaho ka'enaaneta wesethe basehhetate kefune szeraa yaszaraa sawe kaziyaame ka'eresu baxwaalaa yatatsatsatanaa szeraawene yaasaamara 'eresu ('alaahe) mahhaari 'azaanye nawe>> balaacawe
'enedazihume ('ewenatu 'enedigalatsenaa) yawanejalanyoceme manegade teberaaraa zanede 'aneqatsocene 'enegaletsaalane

<<'enee 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa yametetharuwaacawene kamagazaate takalekeyaalahu>> balaacawe <<zenebaaleeyaacehune 'alekataleme yaane gizee ba'eregethe tasaasaateku 'eneeme katamariwocu 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe

<<'enee kageetaayee bakxonace geletse maaserajaa laaye nanye ba'eresume 'asetabaabalaacehu baresu yametecaakolubate qethaate 'enee zanede 'ayedalame feredu la'alaahe becaa nawe 'ewenatene yefaredaale 'eresume kafaraajoce hulu balaache nawe>> balaacawe
<<ba'eresu yametecaakolubate qethaate 'enee zanede bakxona noro ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale nagaru (qethaataacehu) batafatsama nabare 'alaaheme badalanyocene `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe

yaruqe nagareme makefacaawoce 'eresu zanede naacawe ka'eresu baqare maaneme 'ayaaweqaacaweme bayabesenaa babaahhere yaalaweneme hulu yaaweqaale kaqethaleme 'anediteme 'ateragefeme yamiyaaweqaate bikxone 'eneje kaqenethaateme bamareete chalamaawoce wesethe yalame ka'erethebeme kadaraqeme 'anedeme yalame geletse bakxonawe matsehhafe wesathe (yatamazagaba) bikxone 'eneje

'eresume yaa baleelite yamiyaasetanyaacehu baqaneme yaszaraacehutene hulu yamiyaaweqe kaziyaame yatawasanawe gizee yefatzame zanede ba'eresu (baqane) wesethe yamiqasaqesaacehu nawe kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada 'eresu nawe kaziyaame teszarute yanabaraacehutene hulu yenageraacexwaale

'eresume kabaarocu balaaye sikxone hulune 'ashanafi nawe banaanetame laaye thabaaqiwocene (malaa'ekete) yelekaale 'anedaacehuneme mote bamathaabate gizee (yamote) male'eketanyocaacene 'enaresu (te'ezaazaatene) yamaayaagwaadelu sikxonu yegadelutaale
kaziyaame 'ewenatanyaa wada kxonawe geetaacawe wada 'alaahe yemalasaalu nequ! feredu la'eresu becaa nawe 'eresume kataqothaathaariwoce hulu yebalethe fathaane nawe
kayabesenaa kabaahhere chalamaawoce bageletsenaa bamesethire yametetharute setekxonu <<kanazihe biyaadenane ba'eregethe ka'amasegaanyoce 'enekxonaalane (setelu) yamiyaadenaacehu maanawe>> balaacawe
'alaahe kaswanaa kacheneqeme hulu yaadenaacexwaale kaziyaame 'enaaneta taagaaraalaacehu balaacawe

<<'eresu ('alaahe) kabalaayaacehu wayeme ka'egerocaacehu bataace qethaatene ba'enaaneta laaye lileke wayeme yatalayaayu hhezeboce setekxonu liyaadabaaleqaacehunaa kafilaacehune yakafilune chekaanee liyaaqamese caaye nawe>> balaacawe yaawequ zanede 'aneqatsocene 'enedeete 'enedamenaaberaaraa tamalekate
ba'eresume (baqure'aane) 'esu 'ewenate sikxone hhezebocehe 'asetabaabalu balaacawe - <<banaaneta laaye thabaaqi 'ayedalahume >>
latenebite hulu (yamidaresebate) maregiyaa 'alawe wadafiteme taawequtaalaacehu

'enaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yamigabutene baayahe gizee ka'eresu leelaa bakxona waree 'esekamigabu derase tawaacawe sayethaaneme (makalekalehene) biyaaserasaahe katewesetaa baxwaalaa kabadalanyoce hhezeboce gaare 'ateqamathe
ba'enaziyaame bamithanaqaqute laaye kahhisaabaacawe meneme yalabaacaweme gene yethanaqaqu zanede magasatse ('alabaacawe)

'enaziyaaneme haayemaanotaacawene chawaataanaa laagethaa 'aderegawe yayaazutene qerebitume hheyewate yaataalalacaacawene tawaacawe ba'eresume (baqure'aane) nafese baszaraacewe szeraa 'enedaatethafaa 'asetaawese la'ereswa ka'alaahe leelaa radaatenaa 'amaalaaje yalaateme bamabazhiyaame hulu betebazhe kareswa 'ayewasademe 'enazihe 'enaziyaa baszarute szeraa yatathafute naacawe lanasu yekedu banabarute mekeneyaate kafalaa wehaa mathathenaa 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

<<ka'alaahe leelaa yamaayethaqemanene 'enaa yamaayegodaanene 'enegazaalane 'alaaheme kamaraane gizee baxwaalaa yaxwaalite 'enemalasaalane 'enedaziyaa bamedere laaye yawaalala sikxone sayethaanaate 'enedaasaasaatute la'eresu wadanyaa naa 'eyaalu wada qene manegade yamitharu wadaajoce 'enedaalute ('enedamaayekatalaacaweme) sawe 'enekxonaalane>> balaacawe <<ya'alaahe manegade 'eresu qathetanyaawe manegade nawe la`aalamaate geetaa lenegazaame taazazene>> balaacawe
solaateneme badanebu segadu feruteme; (bamaalate taazazene) 'eresume yaa wadaresu becaa yametesabasabubate nawe

'eresume yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate yafathara nawe <<kxune>> yamilebatenenaa wadiyaaweme yamikxonebatene qane ('asetaawese) qaalu 'ewenate nawe baqanedume baminafaa qane negeszenaawe yaresu becaa nawe ruqunenaa qerebune `awaaqi nawe 'eresume thebabanyaawe wesethe `awaaqiwe nawe

beraahhimeme la'abaatu la'azare <<thaa`otaatene 'amaalekete 'aderegahe teyezaalahene 'enee; 'anetaneme hhezeboceheneme bageletse masaasaate wesethe kxonaacehu 'ayaacexwaalahu>> baala gizee ('asetaawese)
'enedazihume beraahimene ('enediyaaweqenaa) ka'aragaagaachocume yekxone zanede yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene malakote 'asaayanawe
leelitume ba'eresu laaye baachalama gizee kokabene 'aya <<yehe geetaayee nawe>> 'ala bathalaqame gizee - <<thalaaqiwocene 'alewademe>> 'ala
charaqaaneme wachi kxono baaya gizee - <<yehe geetaayee nawe>> 'ala bagabaame gizee - <<geetaayee (qenune manegade) baayemaraanye ba'eregethe katasaasaatute hhezeboce 'ekxonaalahu>> 'ala
tzahhayeneme choraawaane zaregetaa baaya gizee - <<yehe geetaayee nawe yehe bathaame teleqe nawe>> 'ala bagabaaceme gizee - <<waganocee hoye! 'enee kametaagaarute hulu netsuhhe nanye>> 'ala
<<'enee laziyaa samaayaatenenaa mederene lafatharawe ('amelaake) qathetanyaa sekxone fiteene 'azoreku 'eneeme ka'agaariwocu 'ayedalahume>> ('ala)

waganocume takaraakarute <<ba'alaahe ('anedenate) ba'eregethe yamaraanye sikxone tekaraakarunyaalaacehune ba'eresume yametaagaarutene nagare 'alefaraame gene geetaayee nagarene bishaa (yaaganyanyaale) geetaayeeme nagarune hulu `eweqatu safaa 'ateganazabumene>> 'alaacawe

<<ba'enaaneta laaye ba'eresu maaserajaane yaalaawaradabatene 'enaaneta maagaaraataacehune yamaatefaru setekxonu yametaagaarutene (thaa`otaate) 'enedeete 'efaraalahu! yametaawequme betekxonu kahulatu kefeloce batsathetaa yebalethe tagabiwe maanenyaawe nawe>> ('ala)
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa 'emenataacawene babadale yaaleqalaaqalu 'enaziyaa la'enaresu tsathetaa 'alaacawe 'enasume yatamaru naacawe;
yeheceme maaserajaacene naate laberaahime bahhezebocu laaye ('aseraje 'enedetekxone) sathanaate yameneshaawene sawe badarajaawoce kafe 'enaadaregaalane geetaahe thebabanyaa `awaaqi nawenaa

laresume sehhaqene (yaleje lejune) yaa`equbeneme sathanawe huluneme maraane nuhheneme bafite maraane kazarocume daawedene, sulayemaaneneme, 'ayubeneme, yusufeneme, musaaneme, haaruneneme (maraane) 'enedazihume bago sariwocene 'enemanadaalane
zakariyaaneme, yahheyaaneme, `isaaneme, leyaaseneme (maraane) hulume kamalekaamocu naacawe
semaa`ileneme, 'aleyase`eneme, yunuseneme, lutheneme (maraane) huluneme ba`aalamaate laaye 'abalathenaacaweme
ka'abaatocaacaweme, kazarocaacaweme, kawanedemocaacaweme (maraane) marathenaacaweme; wada qathetaaweme manegade maraanaacawe
yehe ya'alaahe mameriyaa nawe ba'eresu kabaarocu yamishaawene sawe yemaraale baagaarume noro yeszarute yanabarute kanasu bataabasa nabare

'enazihe 'enaziyaa matsaahhefetenenaa thebabene, nabiyenateneme yasathanaacawe naacawe 'enazihe (yamakaa kahhaadiwoce) ba'ereswa bikedume ba'ereswa yamaayekedune hhezeboce la'ereswa ba'eregethe 'azagaajetanaale

'enazihe (nabiyaate); 'enaziyaa 'alaahe yamaraacawe naacawe bamanegadaacaweme takatale <<ba'eresu (baqure'ane) laaye meneme waagaa 'alethayeqaacehume 'eresu la`aalamaate geszaatsee 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> balaacawe

<<'alaahe basawe laaye meneme 'alaawaradame>> baalume gizee 'alaahene tagabi keberune 'alaakabaruteme ('enedihe) balaacawe - <<yaanene berehaanenaa lasawoce mari kxono musaa yaamathaawene matsehhafe kefelefeloce yametaadaregute setekxonu maane 'awaradawe (yawadadaacexwaatene) tegaletswataalaacehu bezuweneme tedabeqaalaacehu 'enaanetame 'abaatocaacehume yaalaawaqaacehutene tasetamaaraacehu;>>

<<'alaahe ('awaradawe)>> balaacawe kaziyaame baweshataacawe wesethe yamichaawatu sikxonu tawaacawe yeheme yaawaradenawe yakxona beruke yaaneneme bafitu yanabarawene (matsehhafe) 'aragaagaache matsehhafe nawe yakatamocene 'enaate (makaane) 'enaa bazuriyaawaa yaaluteneme sawoce letaasethanaqeqebate ('awaradenawe) 'enaziyaame bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamiyaamenute 'enaresu basolaataacawe laaye yamithabaabaqu sikxonu baresu yaamenaalu

ba'alaaheme laaye 'ebelatene kaqathaathafa wayeme wadaresu meneme yaaletawaradalate sikxone <<wadanee tawaradalenye>> kaalanaa -<<'alaaheme yaawaradawene bethee ba'eregethe 'awaredaalahu>> kaala sawe yebalethe badaaye maane nawe badalanyoceneme bamote makaraawoce wesethe bakxonu gizee malaa'ekete 'ejocaacawene zaregiwoce kxonawe << (laqethethebe) nafesocaacehune 'awethu; ba'alaahe laaye 'ewenate yaalekxonane nagare tenaagaru banabaraacehutenaa ka'aneqatsocume tekoru banabaraacehute mekeneyaate zaaree yaweredatene qethaate temanadaalaacehu>> (yamilwacawe sikxonu) betaaye noro ('asedanaaqine nagare baayahe nabare)

majamariyaame gizee 'eneda fatharenaacehu kxonaacehu yasathanaacehune hulu bajarebaawocaacehu xwaalaa yatawaacehu setekxonu yasathanaacehune hulu bajarebaawocaacehu xwaalaa yatawaacehu setekxonu layabecaacehu kxonaacehu ba'eregethe mathaacehune 'enaziyaaneme 'enasu ba'enaaneta wesethe (la'alaahe) tagaariwoce naacawe yameteluwaacawene 'amaalaajocaacehune ka'enaaneta gaare 'anaayeme genenyunataacehu ba'eregethe taqwaaratha ka'enaanetame yaa (yaamaaledanaale) yametelute thafaa (yebaalaalu)

'alaahe qenethaatenenaa yafereene 'athenete faleqaaqi nawe hheyaawene kamute yaawathaale; muteneme kahheyaawe 'awechi nawe 'eresu 'alaahe nawe; taadiyaa (ka'emenate) 'enedeete temalasaalaacehu (tereqaalaacehu)
'eresume gohene (kaleelite chalamaa) faleqaaqi leeliteneme maarafiyaa tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme (lagizee) maquthariyaa 'aderaagi nawe yehe ya'ashanaafiwe ya`awaaqiwe ('alaahe) celotaa nawe
'eresume yaa kawaakebetene bayabesenaa babaahhere chalamaawoce wesethe ba'ereswa temaru zanede la'enaaneta yaadaraga nawe lamiyaawequ hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene ba'eregethe zarazarene
'eresume yaa ka'anedite nafese yaaseganyaacehu; nawe (bamaahhetzane) maregiyaanaa (bajarebaa) maqamachaame ('alaacehu) lamiyaawaqu hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene ba'eregethe zarazarene

'eresume yaa kasamaaye wehaane yaawarada nawe baresume yanagarune hulu baqaaye 'awathaane yatadaraarabaneme qenethaate karesu yamenaawathaa yakxonane lamelame ('azemaraa) karesu 'awathaane kazanebaabaame ka'enebuthwa yataqaraarabu yakxonu zalalaawoce 'alu kawayenoceme, kawayeraame, karumaaneme (qethalaacawe) tamasaasaayenaa (fereeyaacawe) yamaayemasaasale sikxonu 'atekeletocene ('awathaane) baafaraa gizee wada fereewenaa wada mabesalu tamalekatu ba'enazihe ta`aameraate lamiyaamenu hhezeboce meleketoce 'alu

la'alaaheme 'agaanenetene yafatharaacawe sikxone (bamataazaze) tagaariwoce 'adaragu wanedoce lejocenenaa seetoce lejoceneme yaala `eweqate la'eresu qathafu ('alaahe) theraate yatagabaawe kamilute nagare yalaaqa nawe
('eresu) samaayaatenenaa mederene yaala bethee fathaari nawe la'eresu misete yaleelacewe sikxone 'enedeete la'eresu leje yenorawaale nagareneme hulu fathara 'eresume nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawe
yehe geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe ka'eresu baqare 'amelaake yalame nagarene hulu fathaari nawe selazihe tagazute 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye tathabaabaaqi nawe
`aayenoce 'ayaaganyuteme; ('ayaayuteme) 'eresume `aayenocene yaayaale 'eresume rexeraaxeewe raqiqu wesetha `awaaqiwe nawe

<<kageetaacehu zanede berehaanoce ba'eregethe mathulaacehu yatamalakatame sawe (theqemu) lanafesu becaa nawe yataawarame sawe (gudaatu) baraasu laaye becaa nawe 'eneeme ba'enaaneta laaye thabaaqi 'ayedalahume>> (balaacawe)
'enedazihume << ('enedigamagemunaa yaalafutene matsaahhefete) 'athenetahaaleme>> 'enedilu lamiyaawequ hhezeboceme (qure'aanene) 'enedenaaberaaraawe 'aneqatsocene 'enegaletsaalane
kageetaahe wada 'aneta yatawaradawene takatale ka'eresu baqare 'amelaake yalame 'agaariwoceneme tawaacawe
'alaaheme bashaa noro baalaagaaru nabare ba'enasume laaye thabaaqi 'alaadarageneheme 'anetame ba'enasu laaye xaalaafi 'ayedalaheme

'enaziyaaneme ka'alaahe leelaa yamigazuwaacawene (thaa`otaatene) 'atesedabu denebarene bamaalafe yaala`eweqate 'alaahene yesadebaalunaa 'enedazihu lahhezeboce hulu szeraacawene dage 'asemasalenelaacawe kaziyaame mamalashaacawe wada geetaacawe nawe yeszarute yanabaruteneme hulu yenageraacawaale

ta`aamereme betemathaalaacawe ba'ereswa baqurethe liyaamenu thebeqe mahhalocaacawene ba'alaahe maalu <<ta`aameraate hulu 'alaahe zanede naate>> balaacawe 'ereswa bamathaace gizeeme 'alamaamanaacawene (wayeme maamanaacawene) mene 'asaawaqaacehu
bamajamariyaame gizee ba'eresu 'enedaalaamanu hulu lebocaacawenenaa `aayenocaacawene 'enaagalaabethaalane bathemataacaweme wesethe yamiwaalelu sikxonu 'enetawaacawaalane

'enyaame wada'enaresu malaa'eketene baawaradene mutaaneme baanagaagaruwaacawe nagaruneme hulu cheferaa cheferaa 'aderegane ba'enasu laaye basabasabene noro 'alaahe kaaleshaa basetaqare yamiyaamenu baalekxonu nabare gene 'abezaanyocaacawe (yehenene) yesetaalu

'enedazihume lanabiyaate hulu kasawenaa kagaaneene yakxonune sayethaanaate thalaate 'adaragene kafilaacawe wada kafilu lamaataalale lebesebesene qaale yethelaalu geetaaheme bashaa noro baaleszarute nabare kaqethefataacaweme gaare tawaacawe

(yamitheluteme liyaataalelunaa) ya'enaziyaame bamacharashaayetu hheyewate yamaayaamenute sawoce leboce wada'eresu 'enediyaazanabelu 'enediwaduteme 'enaresu yeqathefu yanabaruteneme 'enediqathaathefu nawe

'eresu yaa matsehhafune yataberaaraa kxono wada'enaaneta yaawarada sikxone <<ka'alaahe leelaa daanyaane 'efalegaalahune>> (balaacawe) 'enaziyaame matsehhafene yasathanaacawe 'eresu kageetaahe zanede ba'ewenate yatawarada makxonune yaaweqaalu katatharaathaariwocume 'atekxune
yageetaaheme qaalaate 'ewenatanyaanaa tekekelanyaa setekxone tafatsamace laqaalaatu lawaache yalame 'eresume samiwe `awaaqiwe nawe
bamedereme kaalute sawoce 'abezaanyocune betekatale ka'alaahe manegade yaasaasetuhaale therethaareene 'eneje leelaane 'ayekatalume 'enaresume yamiwaashu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume
geetaahe 'eresu kamanegadu yamisaasaatutene `awaaqi nawe 'eresume tamariwocune `awaaqi nawe
ba'aneqatsocume 'amaanyoce 'eneda kxonaacehu (sitaarade) ya'alaahe seme ba'eresu laaye katawasaabate 'enesesaa belu

wadaresume (mabelaate) katagadadaacehubate basetaqare ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yatadaragawene la'enaaneta ('alaahe) ba'eregethe yazarazara sikxone kaziyaa ba'eresu laaye ya'alaahe seme katatharaabate yamaatebalute lanaaneta mene (mekeneyaate) 'alaacehu bezuwocume yaala `eweqate bazenebaaleewocaacawe yaasaasetaalu geetaahe 'eresu wasane 'alaafiwocune `awaaqi nawe
yaxaathi'ateneme geletsuneme debequneme tawewu 'enaziyaa xaathi'atene yamiszaru; yeszarute banabarute nagare ba'eregethe yeqathaalu

ba'eresume laaye ya'alaahe seme kaaletatharaabate nagare 'atebelu 'eresume ba'eregethe 'amatse nawe sayethaanaateme wada wadaajocaacawe (baketene bamabelaate) yekaraakarwacehu zanede yaashokashukaalu betetaazazuwaacaweme 'enaaneta ba'eregethe 'agaariwoce naacehu

mute yanabaranaa hheyaawe yaadaragenawe la'eresume basawoce makaakale ba'eresu yamikxeedebatene berehaane yaadaragenelate sawe bachalamaawoce wesethe kareswa yamaayewathaa kxono 'enedaalela sawe bethee nawene 'enedazihu lakahhaadiwoce yeszarute yanabarute nagare tageethalaacawe
'enedazihume bayakatamaayetu bawesethwa yaaseeru zanede yatanekolanyocewaane taalaalaaqoce 'adaragene banafesocaacaweme laaye 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayaaseerume; gene 'ayaawequme

ta`aamereme bamathaacaacawe gizee - <<ya'alaahe maleketanyoce yatasathutene bethee 'esekenesathe derase bafetsume 'anaameneme>> 'alu 'alaahe maleketune yamiyaadaregebatene seferaa `awaaqi nawe 'enaziyaane yaamatsutene sawoce yedoletu banabarute nagare 'alaahe zanede weredatenaa beretu qethaate yaaganyaacawaale

'alaaheme limaraawe yamishaawene sawe daratune (lebune) laselaame yekafetelataale liyaathamaweme yamishaawene sawe daratune thabaabe cagaaraa wada samaaye lamawethaate 'anedamitaagale yaadaregawaale 'enedazihu 'alaahe ba'enaziyaa bamaayaamenute laaye rekesatene yaadaregaale
yeheme (yaalahebate) qathetanyaa sikxone yageetaahe manegade nawe lamiyaasetaawesu hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene ba'eregethe zarezeranaale
la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede yasalaame 'agare 'alaacawe 'eresume (geetaahe) yeszarute banabarute mekeneyaate radaataacawe nawe

huluneme yamisabasebebaacaweneme qane ('asetaawese) ya'agaanenete cheferoce hoye! kasawoce (cheferaane bamaathemame) ba'eregethe 'abazaacehu (yebaalaalu) kasawoceme yakxonute wadaajocaacawe -<<geetaacene hoye! kafilaacene bakafilu tathaqama yaaneneme la'enyaa yawasanekelenene gizeeyaacenene darasene>> yelaalu 'esaate 'alaahe yashaawe gizee siqare bawesethwa zawetaariwoce setekxonu manoriyaacehu naate yelaacawaale geetaahe thebabanyaa `awaaqi nawenaa
'enedazihume yabadalanyocene kafile bakafilu laaye yeszarute banabarute thefaate mekeneyaate 'eneshomaalane

yagaaneenenaa yasawoce cheferoce hoye! - <<'aneqatsoceene ba'enaaneta laaye yamitareku yaziheneme qanaacehune (qethaate) maagenyatene yamiyaasefaraaruwaacehu ka'enaanetawe yakxonu maleketanyoce 'alemathwacehumene>> (yebaalaalu) <<banafesocaacene laaye masakarene; (mathetawelenaale)>> yelaalu yaqerebitume hheyewate 'ataalalacaacawe banafesocaacaweme laaye 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce yanabaru makxonaacawene masakaru
yehe geetaahe katamocene baalabeetocewaa zanegiwoce kxonawe saalu babadale mekeneyaate 'athefi baalamakxonu nawe
lahulume kaszarute szeraa (yatabalaalathu) darajaawoce 'alelwacawe geetaaheme kamiszarute hulu zanegi 'ayedalame
geetaaheme tabeqaaqi ya'ezenate baalabeete nawe bishaa yaasewagedaacexwaale; (yaathafaacexwaale) kaleeloce hhezeboceme zaroce 'enedaaseganyaacehu kabaxwaalaacehu yamishaawene yetakaale
yameteqatharute hulu ba'eregethe machi nawe 'enaanetame 'amelaachoce 'ayedalaacehume

<<hhezebocee hoye! bacelotaacehu laaye szeru; 'enee (bacelotaayee laaye) szari nanyenaa mesegunitume 'agare (ganate) la'eresu yametekxonelate sawe maane 'enedakxona wada fite taaweqaalaacehu 'enaho badalanyoce 'ayedenume>> balaacawe

la'alaaheme kafatharawe ka'azemaraanaa kagemale, kakabete, kafeyaleme dereshaane 'adaragu bahhasaabaacaweme <<yehe la'alaahe nawe yeheme latagaariwocaacene nawe >> latagaariwocaacaweme <<(lathaa`otaate) yakxonawe nagare wada 'alaahe 'ayedareseme la'alaaheme yakxonawe 'eresu wada tagaariwocaacawe yedaresaale>> 'alu yamifaredute ferede kafaa!

'enedazihume ka'agaariwocu labezuwocu; tagaariwocaacawe liyaathafuwaacawe haayemaano taacaweneme ba'enasu laaye liyaaqalaaqelubaacawe (liyaamasaaselubaacawe) lejocaacawene magedalene 'asaamarulaacawe 'alaaheme bashaa noro baaleszarute nabare kaqethefataacaweme gaare tawaacawe

bahhasaabaacaweme yehece 'ereme yakxonace lamaadaa 'enesesaanaa 'azemaraa naate yameneshaawe sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayebalaateme (yehece) jarebocewaa 'ereme yatadaragace lamaadaa 'enesesaame naate ('atechaaneme) yehece bareswa laaye ya'alaahene seme (setetaarade) yamaayetharubaateme 'enesesaa naate 'alu ba'eresu laaye lamaqethafe (nagarune wada 'alaahe 'asethagu) yeqathefute banabarute nagare ba'eregethe yeqathaacawaale

<<banaziheme 'enesesoce hodoce wesethe yaalawe lawanedocaacene batalaye yatafaqada nawe bamisetocaaceneme laaye 'ereme yatadaraga nawe muteme bikxone (mute kxono biwalade) 'enaresu (wanedocume seetocume) baresu tagaariwoce naacawe>> 'alu bamaqethafaacawe 'alaahe ba'eregethe yeqathaacawaale 'eresu thebabanyaa `awaaqi nawenaa

'enaziyaa yaala `eweqate bamonyenate lejocaacawene yagadalunaa 'alaaheme yasathaacawene (sisaaye) ba'alaahe laaye bamaqethafe 'ereme yaadaragu ba'eregethe kasaru ba'eregethe tasaasaatu tamariwoceme 'alenabarume

'eresume yaa daase yamidaragelaacawenenaa daase yamaayedaragelaacawene 'atekeletoce yafathara nawe zamebaabaaneme (yatamerene zaafe) 'azemaraaneme fereewocu yatalayaayu sikxonu wayeraanenaa rumaaneneme (qethalaacawe) tamasaasaayenaa (thaa`emaacawe) yamaayemasaasale sikxonu (fathara) baafaraa gizee kafereewe belu ba'achadaaweme qane tagabiwene (zakaa) sethu 'ataabaakenume 'eresu 'abaakaanyocene 'ayewademenaa
kalamaadaa 'enesesaawoceme yamichaanutenenaa yamaayechaanutene (fathara) 'alaahe kasathaacehu sisaaye belu yasayethaaneneme 'eremejaawoce 'atekatalu 'eresu la'enaaneta geletse thalaate nawenaa

semenetene `aayenatoce kabage hulatene (wanedenaa seetene) kafeyaleme hulatene (fathara) <<kahulatume kefeloce 'alaahe wanedocune 'ereme 'adaragane wayese seetocune wayese baresu laaye yahulatu seetoce maahhetzanoce yaathaqaalalutene 'ewenatanyoce 'enedahonaacehu ba`eweqate (ba'aseraje) negarunye>> balaacawe

kagemaleme hulatene kakabeteme hulatene (fathara) <<'alaahe (kahulatu) wanedocune 'ereme 'adaragane wayese seetocune wayese yahulatu seetoce maahhetzanoce ba'eresu laaye yaathaqaalalutene ba'ewenatu 'alaahe bazihe baazazaacehu gizee yatathaadaacehu nabaraacehune sawoceneme yaala `eweqate liyaathame ba'alaahe laaye weshateneme kaqathafa sawe yebalethe badalanyaa maane nawe 'alaahe badalanyocene hhezeboce (qenune manegade) 'ayemaraame >>

(muhhamade hoye!) balaacawe - <<wada'enee batawaradawe wesethe bakete wayeme fasaashe dame wayeme ya'asaamaa segaa 'eresu rekuse nawenaa wayeme ba'amatse ka'alaahe seme leelaa ba'eresu laaye yatawasaabate kaalekxona basetaqare bamimagabawe tamagaabi laaye 'ereme yakxonane nagare 'alaaganyeme 'amatsanyaanaa wasane yaalafa saayekxoneme yatagadada sawe (katawasute bibalaa xaathi'ate yalabateme) geetaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa >>

ba'enaziyaame 'ayehudaaweyaane bakxonute laaye baala theferene hulu 'ereme 'adaragene kakabete, kafeyalenaa kabageme moraawocaacawene jarebaawocaacawe wayeme 'anejatocaacawe yatashakamute wayeme ba'athenete yataqalaaqalawe (sebe) siqare banaresu laaye 'ereme 'adaragene yehenene ba'amatsaacawe mekeneyaate qathaanaacawe 'enyaa 'ewenatanyoce nane
biyaasetabaabeluheme - <<geetaacehu yasafi cerotaa baalabeete nawe beretu qethaatume ka'amatsanyoce hhezeboce laaye 'ayemalaseme>> balaacawe

'enaziyaa yaagaarute <<'alaahe bashaa noro 'enyaame 'abaatocaacaneme baalaagaraane nabare 'anedaaceneme nagare 'ereme baalaadaragene nabare yelaalu 'enedazihu ('enazihene 'enedawaashu) 'enaziyaa kabafitaacawe yanabarute beretu qethaataacenene 'esekaqamasu derase 'asetabaabaalu la'enyaa taazalequlene zanede (maagaaraataacehune lamawedadu) 'enaaneta zanede `eweqate 'alane therethaareene 'eneje leelaa 'atekatalume 'enaaneta waashowoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume>> balaacawe
<<yatamwalaawe maaserajaa ya'alaahe nawe bashaame noro hulaacehuneme baaqanaacehu nabare>> balaacawe

<<'enaziyaane 'alaahe yehene 'ereme maaderagune yamimasakerutene mesekerocaacehune 'amethu>> balaacawe bimasakerume ka'enaresu gaare 'atemasekere yanaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalutene yanaziyaaneme 'enaresu bageetaacawe (leelaane) yamiyaasetakaakelu sikxonu bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenutene sawoce zenebaaleewoce 'atekatale

<<nu; geetaacehu ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaregawene nagare (ba'eresume yaazazaacehune) laanebebelaacehu>> balaacawe <<ba'eresu (ba'alaahe) meneneme nagare 'ataagaaru lawalaajoceme bagone szeraa (szeru) lejocaacehuneme kadehenete (feraacaa) 'ategedalu 'enyaa 'enaanetaneme 'enaresuneme 'enemagebaacexwaalanenaa mathefo szeraawoceneme ka'ereswa yatagalatsaweneme yatadabaqaweneme hulu 'ateqerabu yaaceneme 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragaatene nafese bahhege bikxone 'eneje 'ategedalu yehene taawequ zanede ('alaahe) ba'eresu 'azazaacehu >>

<<yayatimeneme ganezabe beretaatune ('akaala mathane) 'esekidarese derase baziyaace 'ereswa malekaame bakxonace kxuneetaa 'eneje 'ateqerabu seferenenaa mizaaneneme batekekelu mulu nafesene celotaawaane 'eneji 'anaasegadedeme batanaagaraacehume gizee bazamadocaacehu laaye bikxoneme 'enekwaa ('ewenatene bamanaagare) 'asetakaakelu ba'alaaheme qaale kidaane mulu 'enaho tegasatsu zanede baresu 'azazaacehu >>

<<yeheme qathetanyaa sikxone manegadee nawe; takataluteme (yathemate) manegadoceneme 'atekatalu ka(qathetanyaawe) manegadu 'enaanetane yelayaayuwaacexwaalenaa 'enaho tethanaqaqu zanede baresu 'azazaacehu >>

kaziyaame lamusaa baziyaa malekaame baszaraawe laaye (tsagaacenene) lamaamwalaate nagareneme hulu lamazarezare matsehhafune (la'eseraa'eele lejoce) marinaa 'ezenate yekxone zanede sathanawe 'enaresu bageetaacawe maganaanyate liyaamenu yekajalaalenaa
yeheme yaawaradenawe yakxona yatabaaraka matsehhafe nawe takataluteme yetaazanelaacehume zanede (kakehedate) tathaneqaqu
<<(yaawaradenaweme) matsehhafe yatawaradawe kafitaacene bahulatu cheferoce laaye becaa nawe 'enyaame kanebaabaacawe zanegiwoce nabarene>> 'enedaatelu nawe

wayeme <<'enyaa matsehhafe ba'enyaa laaye batawarada noro ka'enasu yebalethe yatamaraane 'enekxone nabare>> 'enedaatelu nawe selazihe kageetaacehu geletse maaserajaa, mameriyaame, 'ezenateme ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu ba'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce kaasetabaabalanaa ka'ereswame kazora sawe yebalethe badaaye maane nawe 'enaziyaane 'aneqatsocaacenene yamitawetene yetawete banabarute mekeneyaate beretune qethaate ba'eregethe 'eneqathaacawaalane

malaa'ekete letemathaalaacawe wayeme geetaahe (qethaatu) limathaa wayeme kageetaahe meleketoce kafilu limathaa 'eneji yethabaabaqaalune kageetaahe meleketoce kafilu bamimathaa qane kazihe bafite 'amaanye yaalekxonacene nafese 'emenatewaa wayeme ba'emenatewaa (gizee) bago yaaleszaraacene (nafese tsatsatewaa) 'ayethaqemaateme tathabaabaqu 'enyaa tathabaabaaqiwoce nanenaa balaacawe
'enaziyaa haayemaanotaacawene yalayaayu 'ahhezaabeme yakxonu bameneme ka'enasu 'ayedalaheme nagaraacawe wada 'alaahe becaa nawe kaziyaame yeszarute yanabarutene hulu yenagaraacawaale
bamalekaame szeraa yamathaa sawe la'eresu `aszere betheewocewaa 'alute bakefu szeraame yamathaa sawe betheewaane 'eneje 'ayemanadaame 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
<<'enee geetaayee wada qathetanyaawe manegade tekekelanyaane haayemaanote wada 'ewenate 'azanebaaye sikxone ya'aberehaamene manegade maraanye 'eresume ka'agaariwocu 'alenabarame>> bale
<<segedatee, magazaateeme, hheyewateeme, moteeme la`aalamaate geetaa la'alaahe nawe>> bale
<<la'eresu tagaari yalaweme baziheme (bamaatheraate) taazazeku 'eneeme yamuselimoce majamariyaa nanye>> (bale)

balaacawe <<'eresu ('alaahe) yahulu geetaa sikxone ka'alaahe baqare leelaane geetaa 'efalegaalahune nafeseme hulu baraaswa laaye 'eneje (kefune) 'ateszaraame tashakaamime (nafese) yaleelaayetune shakeme (xaathi'ate) 'ateshakameme kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada geetaacehu nawe wadiyaaweme ba'eresu telayaayubate yanabaraacehutene hulu yenagaraacexwaale >>

'eresume yaa bamedere metekoce yaadaragaacehu basathaacehume tsagaa lifatenaacehu kafilaacehune kakafilu balaaye badarajaawoce kafe yaadaraga nawe geetaahe qethaatu fathaane nawe 'eresume 'ejege mahhaari ruxeruxe nawe
'a.la.ma.sa ('alife; laame;mime; swade)
(yehe) wada 'aneta yatawarada matsehhafe nawe badarateheme wesethe ka'eresu cheneqate 'ayenure (yatawaradaweme) ba'eresu letaasefaraaraabatenaa lame'emenaane magaszachaa 'enedikxone nawe
kageetaacehu wada'enaaneta yatawaradawene takatalu ka'alaaheme leelaa radaatocene 'atekatalu theqitene becaa tegasatsaalaacehu
kakatamaame lenaathafaate yashaanawe wadiyaaweme beretu qethaataacene leelite wayeme qane 'enaresu baqatere 'arefawe saalu yamathaabaacawe bezu naacawe
qethaataaceneme bamathaabaacawe gizee <<tsalotaacawe 'enyaa badalanyoce nabarene>> kamaalate baqare leelaa 'alenabarame
'enaziyaaneme wadanasu yatalaakabaacawene (hhezeboce) ba'eregethe maleketanyocuneme 'enethayeqaalane
ba'enaresume laaye (yanabarubatene hulu) ka`eweqate gaare ba'eregethe 'enetarekelaacawaalane yaraaqeneme 'alenabareneme
tekekelanyaaweme mizaane yaziyaane qane nawe mizaanocaacawe yakabadulaacawe sawoceme 'enaziyaa 'enaresu yafalagutene yaaganyu naacawe
mizaanocaacawe yaqalalubaacawe sawoceme 'enaziyaa 'enaresu ta'ameraatocaacenene yekedu banabarute mekeneyaate nafesocaacawene yaakasaru naacawe
bamedereme laaye ba'eregethe 'asemacanaacehu ba'ereswame laaye lanaaneta manoriyaawocene 'adaragenelaacehu; mesegaanaacehu bathaame theqite nawe
ba'eregetheme fatharenaacehu kaziyaame qaratsenaacehu kaziyaame lamalaa'eketoce <<la'adaame segadu>> 'alene wadiyaaweme sagadu belise (diyaabelose) siqare kasagaajocu 'alekxoname
('alaahe) <<baazazekuhe gizee kamasegade mene kalakalahe>> 'alawe <<'enee karesu yabalatheku nanye ka'esaate fatharekanye 'eresune gene kacheqaa fatharekawe>> 'ala
ka'ereswa werade; ba'ereswa wesethe letekoraa 'ayegabaahemenaa wethaame 'aneta kawaraadocu nahenaa 'alawe
<<'esekamiqasaqasubate qane derase 'aqoyanye>> 'ala
-'aneta kamiqoyute nahe 'alawe
<<sela'athamamekanyeme la'enaresu baqathetanyaawe manegade laaye ba'eregethe 'eqamathebaacawaalahu>> 'ala
<<kaziyaame kasetafitocaacawe kaxwaalaacaweme kaqanyocaacaweme kageraawocaacaweme ba'eregethe 'emathaabaacawaalahu 'abezaanyocaacaweneme 'amasegaanyoce kxonawe 'ataaganyaacaweme>> ('ala)
<<yatathalaahe beraari setekxone ka'ereswa wethaa ka'enaresu yatakatalahe ka'enaaneta kamalaacehume gahanamene ba'eregethe 'emolaataalahu>> 'alawe
<<'adaame hoye! 'anetame miseteheme baganate taqamathu kashaacehuteme seferaa belu gene yehecene zaafe 'ateqerabu (raasaacawene) kamibadelute tekxonaalaacehunaa>> ('alaacawe)

sayethaaneme kahhaferata galaacawe yatashashagawene la'enaresu ligaletsebaacawe badebeqe negegere gotagotaacawe <<geetaacehume male'aakoce 'enedaatekxonu wayeme kazalaalame nawaariwoce 'enedaatekxonu 'eneji kazihece zaafe 'alekalakalaacehume>> 'alaacawe
<<'enee la'enaaneta ba'eregethe kamimakeruwaacehu nanye>> sileme 'amaalalaacawe

bamaataalaleme 'awaaradaacawe kazaafitume baqamasu gizee xaferata galaacawe lahulatume tagalathacelaacawe kaganate qethaleme balaayaacawe laaye yedaretu jamare geetaacaweme <<kazihe zaafe 'alekalakalexwaacehumene sayethaaneme la'enaaneta geletse thalaate nawe 'alaalekwaacehumene>> sile tharaacawe
<<geetaacene hoye! nafesocaacenene badalene la'enyaa baatemere baataazeneleneme ba'eregethe kakasaariwocu 'enekxonaalane>> 'alu
('alaahe) << kafilaacehu lakafilu thalaate sikxone weradu la'enaanetame bamedere laaye 'eseka tawasana gizee derase maregiyaanaa mathaqamiyaa 'alaacehu>> 'alaacawe
<<ba'ereswa laaye tenoraalaacehu ba'ereswame laaye temotaalaacehu ka'ereswame wesethe tewathaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe

ya'adaame lejoce hoye! xaferata galaacehune yamishashegene lebese geetheneme ba'eregethe banaaneta laaye 'awaradene 'alaahene yamaferaateme lebese yehe yatashaala nawe yehe ka'alaahe taameraatoce nawe yegaszatsu zanede ('awaradalaacawe)

ya'adaame lejoce hoye! sayethaane 'abaatenaa 'enaataacehune xaferata galaacawene liyaasaayaacawe lebesocaacawene kanasu yagafafaacawe sikxone kaganate 'enedaawathaacawe hulu 'enaanetane 'ayemokeraacehu 'enaho 'eresu kanasaraawitu kamaataayuwaacawe seferaa yaayuwaacexwaalenaa 'enyaa sayethaanaatene la'enaziyaa lamaayaamenute wadaajoce 'adereganaale

mathefoneme szeraa baszaru gizee ba'ereswa laaye 'abaatocaacenene 'aganyane 'alaaheme ba'ereswa 'azonaale yelaalu <<'alaahe bamathefo nagare 'ayaazeme ba'alaahe laaye yamaataawequtene tenaagaraalaacehune>> balaacawe

geetaayee bamaasetakaakale 'azaza bayamasegidume zanede fitocaacehune ('eresune lamagazaate) 'asetakaakelu haayemaanoteneme la'eresu fetsume 'aderegaacehu tagazute 'enedajamaraacehu temalasaalaacehu>> balaacawe

kafilune wada qene manegade maraa kafilocume ba'enasu laaye themate taragaagethobaacawaale 'enaresu sayethaanaatene ka'alaahe leelaa radaatoce 'aderegawe yezawaalenaa 'enaresume (qenune manegade) yatamaraane nane belawe yaasebaalu
ya'adaame lejoce hoye! (xaferata galaacehune yamishafenutene) geethocaacehune bamasegajaawe hulu zanede yaazu belume; thathume; 'ataabaakenume 'eresu 'abaakaanyocene 'ayewademenaa

<<ya'alaahene geethe yaacene labaarocu yafatharaatene kasisaayeme theruwocune 'ereme yaadaraga maane nawe>> balaacawe <<'ereswa bateneszaa'ee qane la'enaziyaa laamanute becaa setekxone baqerebitu hheyewate tagabiyaacawe naate>> balaacawe 'enedazihu lamiyaawequ hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene 'enaaberaaraalane

<<geetaayee 'ereme yaadaragawe mathefo szeraawocene, kareswa yatagalatsawenenaa yatadabaqawene xaathi'aateneme, yaalaagebaabe mabadaleneme, baresume maaserajaa yaalaawaradabatene (thaa`ote) ba'alaahe maagaaraataacehune, ba'alaaheme laaye yamaataawequtene manaagaraacehune becaa nawe>> balaacawe
lahhezebeme hulu yatawasana gizee 'alaacawe gizeeyaacaweme bamathaa waqete 'aneditene sa`aate 'ayeqoyume (kagizeeyaatu) 'ayeqadamumeme

ya'adaame lejoce hoye! ka'enaaneta wesethe banaaneta laaye 'aneqatsoceene yamiyaanabu malekatanyoce bimathwacehu ka'enaaneta kehhedatene yatathanaqaqunaa malekaameneme yaszaru banasu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme 'enasume 'ayaazenume
'enaziyaame ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalu ka'ereswame yakoru 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enasu bareswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe

ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kaqathafa wayeme ba'aneqatsocu ka'asewaasha sawe yebalethe badaaye maane nawe 'enaziyaa (katatsaafalaacawe) kamatsehhafu wesethe sikxone `edelaacawe yaaganyaacawaale (yamote) maleketanyocaaceneme yamigadelwacawe kxonawe bamathubaacawe gizee <<ka'alaahe leelaa tegazwacawe yanabaraacehute yate 'alu>> yelwacawaale <<ka'enyaa tasawarune>> yelaalu 'enaresume kahaadiyaane 'enedanabaru banafesocaacawe laaye yemasakeraalu

<<kagaaneeneme kasaweme ka'enaaneta bafite ba'eregethe kaalafute hhezeboce gaare kxonaacehu 'esaate wesethe gebu>> yelaacawaale 'aneditu hhezebe wada 'esaate bagabaace quthere (yaasaasaatacaatene) betheewaane teragemaalace malaaweme bawesethwa tasabesebawe bataganaanyume gizee yaxwaalanyaayetu lamajamariyaayetu (takataayoce la'asekataayoce) <<geetaacene hoye! 'enazihe 'asaasaatune ka'esaateme seqaaye 'ethefene sethaacawe>> telaalace ('alaaheme) - lahulume 'ethefe 'alawe gene 'ataawequme yelaacawaale
<<majamariyaayetume laxwaalanyaayetu la'enaaneta ba'enyaa laaye meneme belechaa 'alenabaraacehume>> telaalace <<teszaruteme banabaraacehute qethaatune qemasu>> (yelaacawaale)

'enaziyaa 'aneqatsocaacenene yaasetabaabalu ka'ereswame yakoru la'enaresu yasamaaye dajaafoce 'ayekafatulaacaweme gemale bamarefee qadaadaa 'esekamigabaame derase ganatene 'ayegabume 'enedazihume 'agaariwocene 'eneqathaalane
la'enaresu kagahaname 'esaate (baszeraacawe) menethaafe kabalaayaacaweme (ya'esaate) mashafanyaawoce 'alwacawe 'enedazihume badalanyocene 'eneqathaalane
'enaziyaame yaamanunaa malekaamocene yaszaru nafesene celotaawaane 'eneji 'anaasegadedemenaa; 'enaziyaa yaganate sawoce naacawe 'enaresu bareswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe

badaratocaacawe wesethe yaalaweneme thelaacaa 'enaasewagedaalane wanezoce baszerocaacawe yefasaalu <<laziyaame wadazihe (laadarasane szeraa) lamaraane 'alaahe mesegaanaa yegabaawe 'alaahe baalemaraaneme noro 'anemaraame nabare yageetaacene maleketanyoce ba'ewenate laaye sikxonu ba'eregethe mathetawelenaale>> yelaalu yehece ganate teszarute banabaraacehute tasathaacexwaate bamaalate yetharaalu

yaganateme sawoce ya'esaatene sawoce <<geetaacene qaale yagabaalenene 'ewenate kxono 'aganyane geetaacehu yazaatabaacehunese 'ewenate kxono 'aganyaacehutene>> silu yethaaraalu <<'awone 'aganyane>> yelaalu bamakaakalaacaweme <<ya'alaahe regemaane babadalanyoce laaye yekxune>> sile lafaafi yelafefaale
(badalanyoce) 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe manegade yamikalakelu, (ya'alaaheme manegade) 'enedetethaamameme yamifaleguwaate, 'enaresume bamacharashaawaa `aalame kahhaadiwoce yakxonu naacawe

bamakaakalaacaweme geredoshe 'alela ba'a`eraafeme laaye huluneme bameleketaacawe yamiyaawequ sawoce 'alelu yaganateneme sawoce salaame lanaaneta yekxune bamaalate yethaaraalu 'enaresume (ya'a`eraafe sawoce) yamikajelu sikxonu ganaa 'alegabwateme
`aayenocaacaweme wada 'esaate sawoce 'aqethaachaa batazoru gizee - <<geetaacene hoye! kabadalanyoce gaare 'ataaderegane>> yelaalu

ya'a`eraafeme sawoce bameleketaacawe yamiyaawequwaacawene (taalaalaaqe) sawoce yethaaraalu <<sebesebaacehunaa babezaataacehu yametekoru makxonaacehume ka'enaaneta meneme 'alethaqamaacehu>> yelwacawaale
'enaziyaa 'alaahe bacerotaawe 'ayaaganyaacaweme belaacehu yamaalaacehute (dakaamoce) 'enazihe naacawene <<ganatene gebu ferehaate yalabaacehume 'enaanetame 'ataazenume>> (tabaalu yelwacawaale)

ya'esaateme sawoce yaganatene sawoce <<ba'enyaa laaye kawehaa 'afesesubene wayeme 'alaahe kasathaacehu sisaaye (thaalulene)>> belawe tharuwaacawaale 'enaresume <<'alaahe bakahhaadiwoce laaye 'ereme 'aderegwaacawaale>> yelwacawaale

'enaziyaa haayemaanotaacawene masaalaqiyaanaa machaawacaa 'aderegawe yayaazu yaqerebitume hheyewate yaataalalacaacawe yehenene qanaacawene maganaanyatene 'enedarasu bata'ameraataaceneme yekedu 'enedanabaru zaaree 'enerasaacawaalene
ka`eweqate gaareme yazarazarenawe yakxonane matsehhafe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce mameriyaanaa 'ezenate sikxone ba'eregethe 'amathaanelaacawe

(yazaacaawene) fetsaameewene 'eneji leelaa 'ayethabaabaqume fetsaameewe bamimathaabate qane 'enaziyaa kamamethaatu bafite yarasute sawoce <<yageetaacene maleketanyoce ba'eregethe bawenate mathetawaale la'enyaa yaamaaledume zanede 'amaalaajoce 'alelune wayese kaziyaa 'eneszaraawe kanabarenawe leelaane szeraa 'eneszaraa zanede (wada medera `aalame) 'enemalasaalane>> yelaalu nafesocaacawene ba'eregethe 'akasaru yeqathefute yanabaruteme ka'enaresu thafaacawe

geetaacehu yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene basedesete qanoce wesethe yafathara 'alaahe nawe kaziyaame (selethaanu) ba`areshu laaye tadalaadala ('alaahe) leelitene baqane fatheno yamifalegawe sikxone yeshafenaale tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme kawaakebeteneme bate'ezaazu yatagaru sikxonu (fatharaacawe) nequ! mafetharenaa maazaze ya'eresu becaa nawe ya`aalamaate geetaa 'alaahe (keberu) laaqa
geetaacehune tawaaredaacehu badebeqeme lamenute 'eresu wasane 'alaafiwocene 'ayewademenaa
bamedereme wesethe katabajace baxwaalaa 'ataabalaashu faretaacehunaa kajelaacehume tagazute ya'alaahe cerotaa kabago 'aderaagiwoce qerebe nawenaa
