'eresume yaa nafaasocene kacerotaawe (kazenaame) bafite 'abesaariwoce 'aderego yamileke nawe kabaadaawoceneme damanaawoce batashakamu gizee mute wada kxona 'agare 'enenadaawaalane ba'eresume wehaane 'enaawaredaalane kafereewoceme hulu ba'eresu 'enaawathaalane 'enedazihu teganazabu zanede mutaanene (kamaqaabere) 'enaawathaalane

malekaamume 'agare bageetaawe faqaade baqaayu (yaamaara kxono) yewathaale yaame mathefo yakxonawe (baqaayu) dakaamaa kxono 'eneji 'ayewathaame 'enedazihu lamiyaamasagenu hhezeboce taameraatene 'enaaberaaraalane

nuhhene wada waganocu ba'eregethe laakenawe 'alaacaweme - <<waganocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu la'enaaneta karesu leelaa meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume 'enee ba'enaaneta laaye yakabaade qanene qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahu >>
kahhezebocu (yakaadute) mariwocu - <<'enyaa bageletse masaasaate wesethe kxonahe ba'eregethe 'enaayehaalane>> 'alute
'alaacawe <<waganocee hoye! meneme masaasaate yalabenyeme gene 'enee ka`aalamaate geetaa male'eketanyaa nanye >>
<<yageetaayeene maleketoce 'adareselaacexwaalahu la'enaanetame 'emakeraacexwaalahu ka'alaaheme bakule yamaataawequtene `aweqaalahu >>
<<'alaahene letefarunaa yetaazanelaacehume zanede ka'enaanetawe (gosaa) bakxona sawe laaye 'enediyaasethanaqeqaacehu kageetaacehu gesaatsee bimathaalaacehu tedanaqaalaacehune>> ('alaacawe)

wadiyaaweme 'asetabaabalute 'eresunenaa 'enaziyaaneme ka'eresu gaare yaalutene ('amaanyoce) bataanekwaawaa wesethe 'adaanenaacawe 'enaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalutene 'asathamene 'enaresu (leba) `eweraane hhezeboce nabarunaa
wada `aademe wanedemaacawene hudene laakene <<waganocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume (ya'alaahene qethaate) 'atefarumene>> 'alaacawe
kahhezebocu 'enaziyaa yakaadute mariwoce <<'enyaa bamonyenate laaye kxonahe ba'eregethe 'enaayehaalane 'enyaame kaweshatanyocu nahe belane 'enetharatherehaalane>> 'alute
('eresume) 'alaacawe <<waganocee hoye! 'enee monyenate yalabenyeme gene 'enee ka`aalamaate geetaa yatalaakehu nanye >>
<<yageetaayeene maleketoce 'adareselaacexwaalahu 'eneeme la'enaaneta taamaanye makaari nanye >>

<<kageetaacehu yakxona geszaatsee ka'enaanetawe wesethe baanede sawe laaye yaasethanaqaqaacehu zanede bimathaabaacehu tedanaqaalaacehune kanuhheme hhezeboce baxwaalaa metekoce baadaragaacehunaa bafetharateme gezufenatene bachamaralaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu yashaacehuteneme taaganyu zanede ya'alaahene tsagaawoce 'asetaawesu >>
<<'alaahene becaawene 'enedenegazaa 'abaatocaaceneme yegazute yanabarawene ('amaalekete) 'enedenetawe mathaahebene kawenatanyoce kakxoneke yametaasefaraabenene (qethaate) 'amethaabene>> 'alu

<<kageetaacehu yakxona qethaatenaa quthaa ba'enaaneta laaye ba'ewenate taragaagatha 'enaanetanaa 'abaatocaacehume ('amaalekete belaacehu) batharaacexwaacawe semoce 'alaahe ba'ereswa meneme maaserajaa yaalaawaradabaate setekxone tekaraakarunyaalaacehune tathabaabaaqume 'enee ka'enaaneta gaare katathabaabaaqiwocu nanyenaa>> 'ala

'eresunenaa 'enaziyaaneme 'aberawete yanabarutene ka'enyaa bakxonawe cerotaa (kaqethaate) 'adaanenaacawe ya'enaziyaaneme bata'ameraataacene yaasetabaabalutenenaa 'amaanyoce yaalenabarutene maszarate qorathene

wada samudeme wanedemaacawene swalihene laakene 'alaacawe <<waganocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa la'enaaneta meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume ('ewenatanyaa lamakxonee) kageetaacehu yakxonace melekete ba'eregethe mathetaalaacexwaalace yehece la'enaaneta ta`aamere setekxone ya'alaahe gemale naatenaa tawaate ba'alaahe medere wesethe tebelaa; (tethathaame) bakefu 'atenekwaateme 'asaamaami qethaate yeyezaacexwaalenaa >>

<<ka`aademe baxwaalaa metekoce baadaragaacehunaa bamederitume laaye baaseqamathaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu kameedaawocwa (shakelaa) hhenetsaawocene teganabaalaacehu kataraaraawoceme beetocene tetharebaalaacehu selazihe ya'alaahene tsagaawoce 'asetaawesu bamedereme wesethe 'athefiwoce kxonaacehu 'ataabalaashu >>

kawaganocu 'enaziyaa yakorute mariwoce la'enaziyaa latashanafute kanasu laamanute - <<swalihe kageetaawe malaakune taaweqaalaacehune>> 'alwacawe << ('awone) - 'enyaa 'eresu batalaakabate nagare 'amaanyoce nane>> 'alu
'enaziyaa yakorute - <<'enyaa baziyaa 'enaaneta baresu baamanaacehubate kahhaadiwoce nane>> 'alu
wadiyaaweme gemalitune wagwaate kageetaacaweme te`ezaaze wathu 'alume - <<swalihe hoye! kamaleketanyocu 'enedakxoneke yametaasefaraaraabenene (qethaate) 'amethaabene >>
wadiyaaweme yamedere maneqatheqathe (chukxateme) yaazacaacawe babeetocaacaweme wesethe tanekafererawe 'anagu
(swalihe) ka'enaresume zora ('enediheme) 'ala <<waganocee hoye! yageetaayeene malekete ba'eregethe 'adarasekulaacehu la'enaanetame makarekwaacehu gene makaariwocene 'atewadume >>
lutheneme lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<'aseqayaamine szeraa teszaraalaacehune ba'ereswa ka`aalamaate 'anedeme 'aleqadamaacehume >>
<<'enaaneta kaseetoce leelaa wanedocene bamakajale ba'eregethe temathubaacawaalaacehu ba'ewenatu 'enaaneta wasanene 'alaafiwoce hhezeboce naacehu >>
yahhezebocume malese << (lothenenaa takataayocune) kakatamaacehu 'awethwacawe 'enasu yamitheraaru sawoce naacawenaa>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame
'eresunenaa beetasabocuneme 'adaanenaacawe misetu becaa seteqare 'ereswa (lathefaate) kaqarute kxonace
ba'enasume laaye (ya'esaate) zenaabene 'azanabenebaacawe yaxaathi'atanyoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekate

wada madeyaneme (medeyaane) wanedemaacawene shu`aayebene (laakene); 'alaacawe - <<waganocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu baqare meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume kageetaacehu zanede geletse maaserajaa ba'eregethe mathetaalaacexwaalace seferenenaa mizaanene mulu sawoceneme 'anedaacocaacawene (ganezabocaacawene) 'ataagudelubaacawe bamedereme wesethe katabajace baxwaalaa 'ataabalaashu yehe me'emenaane 'enedakxonaacehu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe >>

<< (sawocene) yametaasefaraarunaa ka'alaaheme manegade ba'eresu yaamanutene yametaagedu mathemamwaneme yametefaleguwaate kxonaacehu bayamanegadu 'ateqamathu theqitoceme banabaraacehunaa baabazaacehu gizee 'asetaawesu ya'athefiwoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu >>
<<ka'enaanetame baziyaa 'enee ba'eresu batalaakehubate yaamanu cheferocenaa yaalaamanu cheferoceme binoru bamakaakalaacene 'alaahe 'esekamifarede taagasu 'eresume kafaraajoce hulu balaache nawe >>

kahhezebocu 'enaziyaa yakorute mariwoce - <<shu`aayebe hoye! 'anetanenaa 'enaziyaane ka'anetagaare yaamanutene kakatamaacene ba'eregethe 'enaasewathaacexwaalane wayeme wada haayemaanotaacene mamalase 'alabaacehu 'alu yathalaaneme benekxone>> 'alaacawe

<<'alaahe ka'ereswa ka'adaanane baxwaalaa wada haayemaanotaacehu benemalase ba'alaahe laaye ba'eregethe weshatene qathafene 'alaahe geetaacene kaaleshaame basetaqare la'enyaa wada'ereswa lenemalase 'ayegabaaneme geetaacene `eweqatu hulune nagare safaa ba'alaahe laaye tathagaane geetaacene hoye! banyaanaa bawaganocaacene makaakale bawenate ferade 'anetame kafaraajocu hulu balaache nahe>> ('ala)
kawaganocume 'enaziyaa yakaadute mariwoce <<shu`aayebene betekatalu 'enaaneta yaane gizee kasaariwoce naacehu>> 'alu
wadiyaaweme yamedere maneqatheqathe (chukxateme) yaazacaacawe bakatamaacaweme wesethe tanekafererawe 'anagu
'enaziyaa shu`aayebene yaasatabaabalute ba'ereswa 'enedaalenabarubaate kxonu 'enazi shu`aayebene yaasetabaabalute 'enaresu kasaariwoce kxonu
ka'enaresume (tetwacawe) zora - <<waganocee hoye! yageetaayeene maleketoce ba'eregethe 'adarasekulaacehu la'enaanetame makareku taadiyaa bakahhaadiwoce sawoce laaye 'enedeete 'azenaalahu>> 'alame
bakatamaa 'anedeneme nabiye 'alelaakeneme sawocewaane yewaadaqu zanede badehenatenaa bagudaate yayaazenaacawe benekxone 'eneji

kaziyaame 'esekabazunaa <<'abaatocaacenene dehenatenaa bashitaa ba'eregethe naketwacawaale (yekxeme yagizee lemaade nawe)>> 'esekaalu derase bamathefowe seferaa bagowene lawathene wadiyaaweme 'enaresu yamaayaawequ kxonawe badenegate yaazenaacawe
yakatamaawaame sawoce baamanunaa batathanaqaqu noro ba'enasu laaye kasamaayeme kamedereme barakatocene bakafatenelaacawe nabare gene 'asetabaabalu yeszarute banabaruteme xaathi'aate yaazenaacawe
yakatamaawaa sawoceme 'enasu yatanyu kxonawe qethaataacene leelite limathaabaacawe 'ayefarumene
yakatamaawaa sawoceme 'enasu yamichaawatu kxonawe saalu qethaataacene qane barafaade limathaabaacawe 'ayefarumene
ya'alaaheneme maazanaagaate 'ayefarumene ya'alaaheneme maazanaagaate kakasaariwoce hhezeboce basetaqare yamitamaamane yalame

la'enaziyaa mederene kabaalabeetocewaa (thefaate) baxwaalaa lamiwaresute beneshaa noro baxaathi'aatocaacawe yameneqathaacawe makxonaacene 'aletagalatsalaacawemene balebocaacaweme laaye 'enaatemaalane selazihe 'enaresu 'ayesamume

'enazihe katamoce (kanuhhe 'eseka shu`aayebe sawoce yatanagarute) kawareewocaacawe baaneta laaye 'enetarekaalane maleketanyocaacaweme bageletse ta`aameraate ba'eregethe mathetawaacawaale kamamethaataacawe bafite baasetabaabaluteme nagare yamiyaamenu 'alekxonume 'enedazihu 'alaahe bakahhaadiyaane leboce laaye yaatemaale
labezuwocaacaweme baqaale kidaanaacawe mamulaatene 'alaaganyaneme 'abezaanyocaacaweneme ba'eregethe 'amatsanyoce kxonawe 'aganyanaacawe
kaziyaame kabaxwaalaacawe musaane wada fare`onenaa wada mamaakeretocu bata`aameraataacene laakenawe ba'ereswame kaadu yaathefiwoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekate
musaame 'ala - <<fare`one hoye! 'enee ka`aalamaate geetaa yatalaakehu maleketanyaa nanye >>
<<>>ba'alaahe laaye ka'ewenate baqare 'alamanaagare tagabiyee nawe kageetaacehu bata`aamere ba'eregethe mathaaxwaacehu ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce ka'enee gaare leqaqe
(fare`oneme <<bata`aamere yamathaahe 'enedakxoneke kawenatanyocu kakxoneke 'ereswane 'amethaate>> 'alawe
bateruneme thaala 'eresewaame wadiyaawenu geletse 'ebaabe kxonace
'ejuneme 'awathaa 'ereswame wadiyaawenu latamalekaacoce nache kxonace
kafare`one sawoce mamaakeretocu - <<yehe ba'eregethe `awaaqi degemetanyaa nawe>> 'alu
<<kamederaacehu liyaawathaacehu yeshaale>> ('alu) <<taadiyaa mene taazaalaacehu>> ('ala)
('enaresume) 'alu <<'eresunenaa wanedemune 'aqoye wada katamocume hulu sabesaabiwocene (zabanyoce) laake >>
<<`awaaqi degemetanyaa yakxonane hulu yaamathulehaalenaa >>
degemetanyocume wada fare`one mathu <<'enyaa 'ashanaafiwoce benekxone la'enyaa ba'eregethe waagaa 'alane>> 'alu
<<'awone 'enaanetame ba'eregethe kabaalamwalocu tekxonaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe
<<musaa hoye (baterehene) wayeme (bafite) tethelaalahe wayeme 'enyaa thaayoce 'enekxonaalane>> 'alute
<<thaalu>> 'alaacawe (gamadocaacawene) bathaalume gizee yasawocune `aayenoce dagamubaacawe 'asefaraaruwaacaweme teleqe degemeteneme 'amathu
wada musaame - <<baterehene thaale>> senele laakene (thaalaateme) wadiyaawenume yamiqathaathefutene (maataalayaa) tewethaalace
'ewenatume tagalatsa yeszarute yanabaruteme (degemete) tabalaasha
'eziyaa zanede tashanafume waraadoceme kxonawe tamalasu
degemetanyocume sagaajoce kxonawe wadaqu
'alu - <<ba`aalamaate geetaa 'amanene >>
<<bamusaanaa bahaarune geetaa >>

fare`one 'ala - <<'enee la'enaaneta saalefaqedelaacehu bafite ba'eresu 'amanaacehune yehe bakatamaayetu wesethe sawocwane ka'ereswa lamaawethaate ba'eregethe yatasemaamaacehubate tanekole nawe wadafiteme (yamidaresebaacehune) taaweqaalaacehu >>
<<'ejocaacehunenaa 'egerocaacehune bamaafaraaraqe ba'eregethe 'eqoraarethaalahu kaziyaame hulaacehuneme ba'eregethe 'esaqelaacexwaalahu >>
'alu - <<'enyaa wada geetaacene tamalaashoce nane >>
<<yageetaaceneme ta`aameraatoce bamathulene gizee kamaamanaacene baqare ka'enyaa 'atethalaame geetaacene hoye! ba'enyaa laaye te`egesetene 'afesese muselimoce kxonane gedalane >>

kafare`oneme sawoce taalaalaaqocu (lafare`one) <<musaanenaa sawocune bamedere laaye 'enediyaabalaashunaa (musaame) 'anetanenaa 'amaaleketocehene 'eneditawe tetawaacawaalahene>> 'alu <<wanedoce lejocaacawene 'enegadelaalane seetocaacaweneme 'enaaseqaraalane 'enyaame kabalaayaacawe nane 'ashanaafiwoce (nane)>> 'ala
musaa lasawocu - <<la'alaahe tagazu taagasume medere la'alaahe naatenaa kabaarocu lamishaawe yaawaresaataale mesagunewaame fetsaamee lathenequqocu naate>> 'alaacawe

<<kamamethaateheme bafite kamathaakxeleneme baxwaalaa tasaqaayane>> 'alute <<geetaacehu thalaatocaacehune liyaathafaa 'enedeete 'enedameteszarume yemalakate zanede bamedere laaye litakaacehu yeshaale>> 'alaacawe
yafare`oneneme beetasaboce 'enedigasatsu badereqe `aamataatenaa kafereewoceme bamaqanase ba'eregethe yaazenaacawe

dagitume nagare (mecote) bamathaacelaacawe gizee <<yehece la'enyaa (tagabi) naate>> yelaalu kefuteme betaaganyaacawe bamusaanaa 'aberawete baalute gadabisenate yaamakaanyaalu nequ! gadabisenataacawe 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocaacawe 'ayaawequme
(lamusaame) <<bamaanenyaayetume ta`aamere ba'ereswa letedagemebene betemathaabene 'enyaa la'aneta yamenaamenelehe 'ayedalaneme>> 'alu
wadiyaame yawahaane maathelaqelaqe 'anebathaaneme naqazeneme 'enequraaritoceneme dameneme yatalayaayu ta`aameraate sikxonu banasu laaye laakene korume tanekolanyoceme hhezeboce nabaru

ba'enaresume laaye qethaatu bawadaqabaacawe gizee <<musaa hoye! geetaahene laaneta qaale kidaane bagabaalehe nagare la'enyaa lamenelene ka'enyaa qethaatune betaanasaalene la'aneta ba'eregethe 'enaamenelehaalane ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce ka'aneta gaare ba'eregethe 'enelaqaalane;>> 'alu
'enaresume daraashocu 'ekxonubate gizee derase qethaatene ka'enasu laaye baanasaane gizee wadiyaawenu 'enaresu qaalaacawene yaafaresaalu
'enaresu bata`aameraataacene sela'asetabaabalume ka'ereswa zanegiwoce selakxonume; ka'enasu tabaqalene babaahhereme wesethe 'asathamenaacawe

'enaziyaaneme dakaamoce yanabarutene hhezeboce yaacene bawesethwa barakate yaadaragenebaatene medere meszeraaqocewaaneme me`eraabocwaneme 'awarasenaacawe yageetaaheme malekaamitu qaale ba'eseraa'eele lejoce laaye bamataagasaacawe tafatsamace fare`onenaa sawocume yeszarute yanabarawene (hhenetsaa) daase yaadareguteme yanabarawene 'afarasene

ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce baahherune 'ashaagarenaacawe la'enaresu bakxonu thaa`otaate (magazaate) laaye bamizawateru hhezeboce laaye 'alafume <<musaa hoye - la'enaresu (lasawocu) 'amaalekete 'enedwalaacawe la'enyaame 'amelaakene 'aderegelene>> 'alute <<'enaaneta yametesaasaatu hhezeboce naacehu;>> 'alaacawe
<<'enazihe 'enaresu bawesethu yaalubate nagare thafi nawe yesarute yanabaruteme beleshu nawe>> ('alaacawe);
<<ka'alaahe leelaa 'eresu ka`aalamaate yaabalathaacehu sikxone (yametegazute) 'amelaakene 'efalegelaacexwaalahune>> 'ala

kafare`oneme beetasaboce beretune qethaate yamiyaaqamesuwaacehu wanedoce lejocaacehune yamigadelu seetocaacehuneme yamitawu sikxonu baadaanaacehu gizee ('asetaawesu) baziheme wesethe kageetaacehu zanede yakxona kabaade fatanaa 'alabate

musaaneme salaasaane leelite (litsomenaa lenaanagaagerawe) qatharenawe ba`asereme (leelite) molaanaate yageetaaweme qatharo 'arebaa leelite sikxone tafatsama musaame lawanedemu haarune <<bahhezebocee laaye tatakaanye 'asaamereme ya'athefiwoceneme manegade 'atekatale>> 'alawe

musaame laqatharwacene bamathaanaa geetaaweme baanagaagarawe gizee - <<geetaayee hoye! (nafesehene) 'asaayanye wada 'aneta 'emalakataalahunaa>> 'ala ('alaaheme) - <<bafetsume 'ataayanyeme gene wada taraaraawe tamalekate baseferaaweme biragaa ba'eregethe taayanyaalahe>> 'alawe geetaawe lataraaraawe batagalatsa gizee 'enekutekute 'adaragawe musaame choho wadaqa ba'anesaraaraame gizee <<theraate yegabaahe wadaaneta tamalaseku 'eneeme (bawaqetu) yame'emenaane majamariyaa nanye>> 'ala
('alaaheme) 'alawe - <<musaa hoye! 'enee bamaleketoceenaa bamaanaagaree basawoce laaye marathekuhe yasathuheneme yaaze ka'amasegaanyocume kxune >>

la'eresume basaleedaawocu laaye kanagaru hulu gesaatseenenaa lanagarume hulu maaberaaraatene tsaafenelate ('aleneme) baberetaateme yaazaate hhezeboceheneme bamalekaamwa 'enediyezu 'ezazaacawe ya'amatsanyocune 'agare ba'eregethe 'asaayaacexwaalahu

'enaziyaane yaala'agebaabe bamedere laaye yamikorutene ka'aneqatsocee ba'eregethe 'azoraacawaalahu ta`aamereneme hulu biyaayu bareswa 'ayaamenume qeneneme manegade biyaayu manegade 'aderegawe 'ayezuteme gene yathematene manegade biyaayu manegade 'aderegawe yeyezutaale yehe 'enaresu ba'aneqatsocaacene sela'asetabaabalunaa ka'ereswame zanegiwoce selakxonu nawe
'enaziyaame ba'aneqatsocaacenenaa macharashaayetune `aalame bamaganaanyate yaasetabaabalute szeraawocaacawe tabalaashu yeszarute yanabarawene 'eneji yemanadaalune

yamusaame hhezeboce ka'eresu (makxeede) baxwaalaa kageethocaacawe wayefanene 'akaalene laresu maagesaate yaalawene ('amelaake 'aderegawe) yaazu 'eresu yamaayaanaageraacawe manegadeneme yamaayemaraacawe makxonune 'ayemalakatumene ('amelaake 'aderegawe) yaazute badaayoceme kxonu
batatsatsatunaa 'enasume ba'eregethe yatasaasaatu makxonaacawene baayu gizee - <<geetaacene baayaazenelenenaa baayemerane ba'eregethe kakasaariwocu 'enekxonaalane>> 'alu

musaame 'eyataqothaanaa 'eyaazana wada hhezebocu batamalasa gizee <<ka'enee baxwaalaa ba'enee laaye yatakaacehute nagare kafaa! yageetaacehune te'ezaaze tacaakolaacehune>> 'alaacawe saleedaawocuneme thaalaacawe yawanedemuneme raase (tsagure) wadaresu yamigotetawe sikxone yaaza (wanedemume) - <<yanaatee leje hoye! hhezebocu naaqunye ligadelunyeme taqaaraabu selazihe ba'enee thalaatocene 'ataasedasetebenye ka'amatsanyoce hhezeboceme gaare 'ataadereganye>> 'alawe
(musaame) - <<geetaayee hoye! la'eneeme lawanedemeeme maare ba'ezenateheme wesethe 'agebaane 'anetame ka'azaanyoce hulu yebalethe 'azaanye nahe>> 'ala
'enaziyaa wayefanune ('amelaake 'aderegawe) yayaazu kageetaacawe zanede quthaa; baqerebitume hheyewate weredate ba'eregethe yaaganyaacawaale 'enedihume qathaafiwocene 'eneqathaalane
'enaziyaame xaathi'atocene yaszaru kaziyaame ka'ereswa baxwaalaa yatatsatsatu yaamanume geetaahe ka'ereswa baxwaalaa ba'eregethe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
kamusaame quthaawe babarada gizee saleedaawocune bagelebaachaacawe wesethe la'enaziyaa 'enaresu geetaacawene yamifaru lakxonute mameriyaanaa 'ezenate yaalabaacawe sikxonu yaaza

musaame kahhezebocu wesethe laqatharowaacene sabaane sawoce maratha beretu yamedere 'eneqetheqaathee bayaazacaacaweme gizee musaa 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! bashaahe noro ka'ahune bafite ba'athafaahaacawe nabare 'eneeneme (baathafaakxanye nabare) ka'enyaa qilocu baszarute nagare taathafaanaalahene 'ereswa (fatanaayetu) yaaneta fatanaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme ba'ereswa yameteshaawene taasaasetaalahe yameteshaaweneme taaqanaalahe 'aneta radaataacene nahenaa la'enyaa mehherate 'aderegelene 'ezaneleneme 'anetame kamahhaariwoce hulu balaache nahe >>

<<la'enyaame bazice baqerebitu `aalame malekaamwane bamacharashaayetume (malekaamwane) tsaafelene 'enyaa wada 'aneta tamalasene >> (sile musaa tsalaya; 'alaaheme) 'ala - <<qethaatee ba'eresu yameshaawene sawe 'eqathaabataalahu cerotaayame nagarune hulu safaace la'enaziyaame lamithanaqaqu, zakaaneme lamisathu, la'enaziyaame 'enasu ba'aneqatsocaacene lamiyaamenu ba'eregethe>> 'etsefaataalahu

la'enaziyaa yaanene 'enasu zanede bataweraatenaa banejile tatsefo yamiyaaganyutene yamaayetsefenaa yamaayaanabe nabiye yakxonawene maleketanyaa yamikatalu lakxonute (ba'eregethe 'etsefelataalahu) babago szeraa yaazaacawaale kakefume nagare yekalakelaacawaale malekaame nagaroceneme lanaresu yefaqedelaacawaale mathefo nagaroceneme ba'enaresu laaye 'ereme yaadaregebaacawaale ka'enasume laaye shakemaacawenenaa 'enaziyaaneme ba'enaresu laaye yanabarutene 'enezaazelaawoce (kabaade hhegegaatoce) yaanasaalaacawaale 'enaziyaame ba'eresu yaamanu yaakabaruteme yaraduteme yaaneneme ka'eresu gaare yatawaradawene berehaane yatakatalu 'enaziyaa 'enasu yamiyaadenu naacawe

(muhhamade hoye!) balaacawe - <<'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enee wadanaaneta wadahulaacehume ya'alaahe maleketanyaa nanye ('eresume) yaa yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa la'eresu becaa yakxona nawe 'eresu 'eneji leelaa 'amelaake yalame hheyaawe yaadaregaale yegadelaaleme ba'alaahe baziyaame ba'alaahenaa baqaalaatocu bamiyaamenawe yamaayetsefe yamaayaanabe nabiye bakxonawe maleketanyaawe 'emanu qeneneme manegade temaru zanede takatalute >>
kamusaame hhezeboce ba'ewenate yamimarute ba'eresume (feredene) yamiyaasetakaakelu cheferoce 'alu

`aszeraa hulate nagadoce hhezeboce 'adereganeme kafaafalenaacawe wada musaame waganocu mathathaatene bafalagubate gizee <<denegaayune babaterehe metaawe>> senele laakene (mataaweme) ka'eresu `aszeraa hulate menechoceme falaqu sawocu hulu mathachaacawene ba'eregethe `awaqu ba'enasume laaye damanaane 'athalalene ba'enasume laaye manaanenaa derechetene 'awaradene <<kasathanaacehume malekaame sisaaye belu>> ('alene; tsagaacenene bamakaadaacawe) 'alebadalunememe gene nafesocaacawene yamibadelu nabaru

la'enaresume batabaalu gizee ('asetaawese) <<bazihece katamaa taqamathu ka'ereswame bashaacehute seferaa belu (yamenefalegawe) yaxaathi'aataacenene maregafe nawe balume yakatamaayetuneme bare 'agonebesaacehu gebu xaathi'aatocaacehune la'enaaneta 'enemeraalanenaa bago laszarute ba'eregethe 'enechameraalane >>

ka'enasume wesethe 'enaziyaa (raasaacawene) yabadalute sawoce kaziyaa la'enaresu katabaalawe leelaa yakxonane qaale lawathu ba'enaresume laaye yebadelu banabarute badale ma`atene kasamaaye laakenebaacawe

kaziyaaceme babaaheru daarecaa kanabaracewe katamaa baqedaamee (qane) wasane baalafu gizee basanebataacawe qane `asaawocaacawe yatakamaacu kxonawe bamimathulaacawe gizee (yakxonawene) thayeqaacawe sanebateneme bamaayaakaberubate (baleelaawe) qane 'ayemathulaacaweme 'enedazihu yaametsubate banabarute mekeneyaate 'enemokeraacawaalane

ka'enasume (kafilocu) hhezeboce <<'alaahe 'athefiyaacawe wayeme baberetu qethaate qachi'acawe yakxonutene hhezeboce lamene tegasetzaatsaalaacehu>> baalu gizee (gasaachocu) <<wada geetaacehu baqi mekeneyaate 'enedikxonenaa 'enaresume bikalakalu belane nawe>> 'alu
ba'eresume yatagasatsubatene nagare batawu gizee 'enaziyaane kakefu yamikalakalutene 'adaanene; 'enaziyaaneme yabadalutene yaametsu banabarute mekeneyaate baberetu qethaate yaazenaacawe
ka'eresume katakalakalute nagare bakoru gizee la'enasu <<waradoce zenejaroce kxunu 'alene;>> (kxonume)

geetaaheme 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane kefu qethaatene yamiyaaqamesaacawene sawe banasu laaye ba'eregethe yamileke makxonune baasetaawaqa gizee ('asetaawesaacawe) geetaahe ba'eregethe qethaata fathaane nawe 'eresume ba'eregethe 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

(ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce) bamedere laaye yatalayaayu hhezeboce 'adereganeme kafaafalenaacawe ka'enasu malekaamoce 'alu ka'enasume kaziyaa leelaa 'alelu yemalasu zanedeme batadelaawoceme bamakaraawoceme mokarenaacawe

kaxwaalaacaweme - matsehhafune yawarasu mathefo metekoce tataku yazihene yaqerebune thafi theqeme yeyezaalu betheeweme theqeme bimathaalaacawe yamiyezute sikxonu << (baszaraanawe) - lanyaa mehherate yedaragelenaale>> yelaalu ba'alaahe laaye ka'ewenate baqare 'enedaayenaagaru ba'enaresu laaye yamatsehhafu qaale kidaane 'aletayaazabaacawemene ba'eresu wesethe yaalaweneme 'alaanababumene yamacharashaayetume 'agare la'enaziyaa geetaacawene lamifarute balaache naate 'ataawequmene
'enaziyaame matsehhafune thabeqawe yamiyezu solaateneme badanebu yasagadu 'enyaa yamalekaame szariwocene waagaa 'anaathafaame

yathurene taraaraa naqelane kabalaayaacawe 'eneda thelaa kxono ba'anasaanawenaa 'eresume banasu laaye wadaaqi makxonune baaragaagathu gizee ('asetaawese) <<yasathanaacehune baberetaate yaazu tethanaqaqume zanede bawesethu yaalawene taganezabu>> ('alene)

geetaaheme ka'adame lejoce kajarebocaacawe zarocaacawene baawathaanaa <<geetaacehu 'ayedalahumene>> sile banafesocaacawe laaye baasemasakaraacawe gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawese) <<geetaacene nahe masakarene>> 'alu <<bateneszaa'ee qane kazihe (kidaane) zanegiwoce nabarene 'enedaatelu >>

wayeme <<(thaa`otaatene) yaagaarute ka'enyaa bafite yanabarute 'abaatocaacene becaa naacawe 'enyaame ka'enasu baxwaalaa yakxone zaroce nabarene 'athefiwocu baszarute taathafaanaalahene>> 'enedaatelu ('asemasakarenaacehu)
'enedazihume ('enediyaasebu) 'enedimalasume 'aneqatsocene 'enaaberaaraalane
yaziyaaneme ta`aameraataacenene yasathanawenenaa ka'ereswa yawathaawene sayethaaneme yaasekatalawene kathamaamocume yakxonawene sawe waree ba'enaresu laaye 'anebebelaacawe

bashaaneme noro ba'ereswa kafe baadaragenawe nabare 'eresu gene wada medere tazanabala felaagotuneme takatala betheeweme betaabaarerawe melaasune 'awetheto yamiyaalakaleke wayeme betetawawe melaasune 'awetheto yamiyaalakaleke 'eneda kxona weshaa nawe yehe ya'enaziyaa ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalute hhezeboce mesaalee nawe yaasetanatenume zanede taarikocene tarekelaacawe
ya'enaziyaa ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalutenaa nafesocaacawene yebadelu yanabarute sawoce mesaalee kafaa!
'alaahe yamiyaaqanaawe sawe qene 'eresu nawe yamiyaathamaweme sawe 'enaziyaa kasaariwocu 'enasu naacawe

kagaaneeneme kasawoceme bezuwocene lagahaname ba'eregethe fatharene la'enaresu baresaacawe yamaayaawequbaacawe leboce 'alwacawe la'enasume basaacawe yamaayaayubaacawe `aayenoce 'aluwaacawe la'enasume basaacawe yamaayesamubaacawe jorowoce 'aluwaacawe 'enaziyaa 'eneda 'enesesaawoce naacawe yelequneme 'enaresu bathaame yatasaasaatu naacawe 'enaziyaa zanegiwocu 'enaresu naacawe;
la'alaaheme malekaame semoce 'alute (setetsaleyu) ba'ereswame therute 'enaziyaaneme semocune yamiyaathaamemutene tawewaacawe yeszarute yanabarutene nagare ba'eregethe yememanadaalu
kafatharenaacaweme sawoce ba'ewenate yamimaru ba'eresume (feredene) yamiyaasetakaakelu hhezeboce 'alelu
'enaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalutene kamaayaawequte seferaa qase baqase (mecotene bamachamare) 'enaazanagaacawaalane
la'enaresume gizee 'esathaacawaalahu thebabee beretu nawenaa
banabiyaacawe (bamuhhamade) meneme `ebedate yaleelabate makxonune 'ayaasetawelumene 'eresu geletse 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame

basamaayaatenaa bamedere gezaate wesethe kamaanenyaawe nagare 'alaahe bafatharaweme hulu yamote gizeeyaacaweme ba'eregethe maqerabu yamifaraa makxonune 'ayaasetawelumene ka'eresume (kaqure'aane) wadiyaa bayatenyaawe negegere yaamenaalu
'alaahe yamiyaathamawe sawe la'eresu meneme 'aqenye yalaweme bathememataacaweme wesethe 'eyawaalalu yetawaacawaale

kasa`aatitu macee 'enedameteragaa ('enedametemathaa) yethayequhaale <<`eweqatwa bageetaayee zanede nawe bagizeewaa 'eresu 'eneji leelaa 'ayegalethaateme basamaayaatenaa bamedereme kabadace badenegate bikxone 'eneji 'atemathaacehume>> balaacawe ka'ereswa 'athebeqahe 'eneda taradaahe 'aderegawe yethayequhaale <<`eweqatwa 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme>> balaacawe

<<'alaahe yashaawene basetaqare la'eraasee theqemeneme gudaateneme maamethaate 'aleceleme ruqeneme (mesethire) yamaaweqe banabareku noro kamalekaame nagare baabazaahunaa kefume nagare baalenakaanye nabare 'enee lamiyaamenu hhezeboce 'asefaraarinaa 'abesaari 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe

'eresu yaa ka'anedite nafese (ka'adame) yafatharaacehu ka'ereswame maqanaajowaane wadareswa yerakaa zanede yaadaraga nawe bataganaanyaateme gizee qalaalene 'eregezenaa 'aragazace 'eresuneme (tzenesune) yezaawe kxeedace bakabadaceme gizee <<dagene leje betesathane ba'eregethe ka'amasegaanyocu 'enekxonaalane;>> silu geetaacawene 'alaahene lamanu
malekaame leje basathaacaweme gizee basathaacawe leje (seme) la'eresu tagaariwocene 'adaragulate 'alaaheme kamiyaagaarute hulu laaqa
meneneme yamaayefatherutenenaa 'enaresume yamifatharutene (ba'alaahe) yaagaaraalune
la'enaresume maredaatene yamaayecelutene nafesocaacaweneme yamaayeradutene (yaagaaraalune)
(thaa`otocune) wada qene manegade betetharuwaacaweme 'ayekataluwaacehume betetharuwaacawe wayeme 'enaaneta zemetanyoceme betekxonu ba'enaaneta laaye 'ekule nawe
'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yametega3cawe betheewocaacehu tagazhiwoce naacawe 'ewenatanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu theruwaacawenaa la'enaaneta yemalesulaacehu; (mamalase gene 'ayecelume)

la'enaresu ba'eresaacawe yamikxeedubaacawe 'egeroce 'aluwaacawene wayese la'enasu baresaacawe yamichabethubaacawe 'ejoce 'aluwaacawene wayese la'enasu ba'eresaacawe yamiyaayubaacawe `aayenoce 'aluwaacawene wayese la'enasu ba'eresaacawe yamisamubaacawe jorowoce 'aluwaacawene <<yaagaaraacexwaacawene theru kaziyaame tatanaakolunye gizeeme 'atesethunye; ('alefaraacehume)>> balaacawe
<<ya'enee radaatee yaa matsehhafune (qure'aanene) yaawaradalenye 'alaahe nawenaa; 'eresume malekaame szariwocene yeradaale>> (balaacawe)
'enaziyaame ka'eresu baqare yametega3cawe liraCcehu 'ayecelume nafesocaacaweneme 'ayeradume
<<wada qeneme manegade ('enedimaruwaacehu) betetharuwaacawe 'ayesamume;>> (balaacawe) 'enaresuneme yamaayaayu sikxonu wada 'aneta simalakatu taayaacawaalahe
garene thabaaye yaaze bamalekaameme 'ezaze baalageewocuneme tawaacawe
kasayethaaneme (bakule) gutegotaa biyaaganyehe ba'alaahe tathabaqe 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa
'enaziyaa yatathanaqaqute kasayethaane yakxona zawaari banakaacawe gizee (geetaacawene) yeganazabaalu wadiyaaweme 'enasu tamalekaacoce yekxonaalu
wanedemocaacaweme thematene yechamerulaacawaale; kaziyaame ('enaresu) 'ayegatume

bata`aamereme baalemathaahaacawe gizee (baraasehe) <<lamene 'atefatheraateme>> yelaalu kageetaayee wadanee yatawaradawene becaa 'ekatalaalahu yehe (qure'aane) kageetaacehu sikxone lamiyaamenu hhezeboce marajaawocenaa mameriyaa 'ezenateme nawe balaacawe
qure'aaneme batanababa gizee 'eresune 'adaamethu tsatheme balu yetaazanelaacexwaalenaa
geetaaheneme bamesethire tawaadeqahenaa faretahe kachukxate bataaceme bakxona qaale bathwateme bamaataame 'awesaawe kazanegiwocume 'atekxune
'enaziyaa 'egeetaahe zanede yaalute (malaa'ekete) 'eresune kamagazaate 'ayekorume yaawadesutaaleme la'eresume becaa yesagedaalu

kathore zarafaa ganezaboce yethayequhaale <<yazarafaa ganezaboce ya'alaahenaa yamaleketanyaawe naacawe >> selazihe 'alaahene feru bamakaakalaacehu yaalaceweneme kxuneetaa 'asaameru 'amaanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene taazazu balaacawe

fetsume me'emenaane 'enaziyaa 'alaahe batawasaa gizee lebocaacawe yamifarute, banasume laaye 'aneqatsocaacene batanababu gizee 'emenatene yamichamerulaacawe, bageetaacaweme laaye becaa yamimakute naacawe
'enaziyaa solaatene danebune 'amwaletawe yamisagedu kasathanaacaweme sisaaye yamilagesu naacawe
'enaziyaa ba'ewenate 'amaanyoce 'enasu becaa naacawe la'enasu bageetaacawe zanede darajaawoce meheratenaa yakabara sisaayeme 'alaacawe
(yehe bazarafaa kefeyaa yakafilu sawe mathelaate) kame'emenaane kafilu yathalu sikxonu geetaahe kabeetehe ba'ewenate laaye kxonahe 'enedaawathaahe nawe
'enaresu 'eyaayu wadamote 'enedaminadu kxonawe ba'ewenatu nagare (bamagaadale gedeetaanate) katagalatsalaacawe baxwaalaa yekaraakaruhaale

'alaaheme kahulatu cheferoce 'anedanyaawaane 'ereswa lanaaneta naate sile tasefaa basathaacehu gizee, yahayele baalabeete yaalekxonaceweme (nagaadeeyetu) lanaaneta letekxone bawadadaacehu gizee, 'alaaheme batasefaa qaalaatu 'ewenatene maaragaagathune ligaletsenaa yakahhaadiwoceneme macharashaa liqorethe bashaa gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawese)
(yeheneneme yaadaragawe) 'agaariwocu bithalume 'ewenatune liyaaragaagethe kehedateneme liyaathafaa nawe
kageetaacehu redaataane bafalagaacehu gizee <<'enee bashihe malaa'ekete takataataayoce sikxonu 'eradaacexwaalahu>> sile lanaaneta yataqabalaacehune ('asetaawesu)

'alaaheme (yekxenene redaataa) labeseraatenaa lebocaacehu baresu lirakubate 'eneji laleelaa 'alaadaragaweme deleme manesaate ka'alaahe zanede 'eneji kaleelaa 'ayedalame 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa

ka'eresu bakxonawe tsathetaa (bathore genebaare) ba'eneqelefe bashafanaacehunaa wehaaweneme ba'eresu liyaatharaacehu, yasayethaaneneme gutegotaa ka'enaaneta liyaasewagedelaacehu, lebocaacehuneme (bate`egesete) liyaathanakerelaacehu, ba'eresume chaamaawocene (ba'ashawaawe laaye) liyaadalaadelelaacehu ba'enaaneta laaye kasamaaye baawaradalaacehu gizee ('asetaawesu)

geetaahe wada malaa'eketu <<>>'enee (ba'eredaataayee) ka'enaaneta gaare nanyenaa 'enaziyaane yaamanutene 'atsenaanu ba'enaziyaa bakaadute leboce wesethe ferehaatene ba'eregethe 'ethelaalahu ka'anegatoceme balaaye (raasocene) metu ka'enasume yaqerenechaafocene malayaaleye hulu metu sile yaawaradawene ('asetaawese)
yehe 'enaresu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene selataqaawamu nawe 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamiqaawame hulu 'alaahe qethaatu beretu nawe
yehe (qethaataacehu nawe) qemasuteme lakahhaadiwoceme ya'esaate qethaate ba'eregethe 'alabaacawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaziyaane yakaadutene sawoce (lathore) sigwaazu baaganyaacexwaacawe gizee jarebaawocene 'ataazurulaacawe

yaane gizeeme lagedeyaa lamazawaaware wayeme wada szaraawite lamaqalaaqale saayekxone jarebaawene yamiyaazorelaacawe sawe ka'alaahe bakxona quthaa ba'eregethe tamalasa manoriyaaweme gahaname naate mamalashaayetume kafaace

'alegadalaacexwaacaweme gene 'alaahe gadalaacawe (chebethene `afare) bawarawarekeme gizee 'aneta 'alewarawarekeme gene 'alaahe warawara (wada `aayenocaacawe 'adarasawe) la'amaanyoceme karesu yakxonane malekaame tsagaa lamasethate (yehene 'adaraga) 'alaahe sami `awaaqi nawenaa
yehe (`ewenate nawe) 'alaaheme yakahhaadiwocene tanekole 'adekaami nawe

fetehhene (feredene) betethayequ fetehhu ba'eregethe mathetolaacexwaale (kehedatenenaa mawaagaatene) betekalakalume 'eresu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe (wada magaadale) betemalasume 'enemalasaalane saraawitaacehume betebazaame 'enekwaa kanaaneta meneme 'atethaqemaacehume 'alaaheme kame'emenaane gaare nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene taazazu 'enaanetame yametesamu setekxonu karesu 'atesheshu
'enedanaziyaame 'enasu yamaayesamu sikxonu samaane 'enedaalute 'atehunu
kataneqasaaqaashoce hulu 'alaahe zanede mathefo tanekolanyoce 'enaziyaa yamaayaawequte, daneqorowocu, didaawocu naacawe

bawesethaacaweme dage manorune 'alaahe baawaqa noro (yamaradaatene masemaate) baasamaacawe nabare (dage yaleelabaacawe makxonune siyaaweqe) baasamaacaweme noro 'enasu 'ewenatene yatawe kxonawe bashashu nabare

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! (maleketanyaawe) hheyaawe wadamiyaadaregaacehu 'emenate batharaacehu gizee la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe taazazu 'alaaheme basaweyawenaa balebu makaakale yamigaarede makxonune wadaresume yametesabasabu makxonaacehune 'ewaqu
kanaanetame wesethe 'enaziyaane yabadalutene becaa layetaa yamaatenakaane fatanaa tathaneqaqu 'alaaheme qethaatu beretu makxonune 'ewaqu

'enaanetame bamedere laaye yatanaaqaacehu theqitoce kxonaacehu saalaacehu sawoce linathequwaacehu yametefaru setekxonu yaasethagaacehune ba'eredaataaweme yaabarataacehune kamalekaamoce sisaayoceme taamasagenu zanede yasathaacehune 'asetaawesu
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene 'atekedu 'adaraawocaacehuneme 'enaaneta 'eyaawaqaacehu 'atekedu
ganezabocaacehunaa lejocaacehume fatanaa becaa makxonaacawenenaa 'alaaheme 'esu zanede taalaaqe menedaa yaalawe makxonune 'ewaqu

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene betefaru ya'ewenate malayaane berehaane yaadaregelaacexwaale kefu szeraawocaacehuneme ka'enaaneta laaye yaabeselaacexwaale la'enaanetame yemeraacexwaale 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe

'enaziyaame yakaadute liyaaseruhe wayeme ligadeluhe wayeme (kamakaa) liyaawathuhe baaneta laaye bamakarubehe gizee ('asetaawese) yemakeraalume 'alaaheme tanekolaacawene yemalesebaacawaale 'alaaheme kamakaariwocu hulu balaaye nawe

'aneqatsocaaceneme banasu laaye batanababu gizee <<ba'eregethe sametanaale; bashaane noro yazihene bethee baalene nabare; yehe yamajamariyaawocu sawoce tsehhufe taratoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> yelaalu

<<geetaacene hoye! yehe 'eresu kaaneta zanede (yatawarada) 'ewenate 'eneda kxona banyaa laaye kasamaaye denegaayocene 'azenebebene wayeme 'asaamaami qethaatene 'amethaabene>> baalume gizee ('asetaawese)
'alaaheme 'aneta bawesethaacawe 'eyaalahe (denegaaye bamaazenabenaa baasaamaami qethaate) yamiqathaacawe 'ayedalame 'alaaheme 'enasu meheratene yamilamenu sikxonu yamiqathaacawe 'ayedalame

'enasu katakabarawe masegide yamikalakelu sikxonume 'alaahe (basayefe) yamaayeqathaacawe lanasu mene 'alelaacawe (yabeetu) thabaaqiwoceme 'alenabarume thabaaqiwocu (kehhedatene) tathaneqaaqiwocu 'eneji leelocu 'ayedalume gene 'abezaanyaawocaacawe 'ayaawequme
babeetu zanedeme (bakaa`ebaa) segedataacawe maafwachatenaa maachabechabe 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame tekedute banabaraacehuteme nagare qethaatene qemasu (yebaalaalu)

'enaziyaa yakaadute ka'alaahe manegade likalakelu ganezabocaacawene yaawathaalu ba'eregetheme yaawathuwaataale kaziyaame ba'enasu laaye tsatsate tekxonebaacawaalace kaziyaame yeshanafaalu 'enaziyaame yakaadute wada gahaname yesabasabaalu

'alaahe mathefowene kamalekaamu lilaye mathefoweneme kafilune bakafilu laaye liyaadaregenaa baanede laaye liyaanabaaberawe bagahaname wesetheme liyaadaregawe (yesabasabaalu) 'enaziyaa 'enasu kasaariwocu naacawe

lanaziyaa lakaadute balaacawe - bikalakalu la'enasu ba'eregethe yaalafawene (szeraa) mehherate yedaragelaacawaale (wada magaadale) bimalasume ('enaathafaacawaalane) yaqademowocu hhezeboce lemaade ba'eregethe 'alefaalacenaa
hukateme 'esekamaateganye haayemaanoteme hulu la'alaahe becaa 'esekamikxone derase tagaadalwacawe bikalakalume 'alaahe yamiszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe
(ka'emenate) bizorume 'alaahe radaataacehu makxonune `ewaqu ('eresu) mene yaamere thabaaqi! mene yaamereme radaate!

kamaanenyaaweme nagare bathore (kakahhaadiwoce) yazarafaacehuteme 'anede 'amesetanyaawe la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe, (lanabiyu) yazemedenaa baalabeetoceme, layatimoceme, lamesekinoceme, lamanegadanyaame yatagabaa makxonune `ewequ, ba'alaahenaa baziyaame 'ewenatenaa weshate batalayabate qane hulatu cheferoce bataganaanyubate (babadere) qane babaariyaacene laaye baawaradenawe yametaamenu 'enedakxonaacehu (yehenene `ewaqu) 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'enaaneta baqerebitu daarecaa kxonaacehu 'enaresume baruqitu daarecaa kxonawe yanagaadeewocume cheferaa kanaaneta bataace sikxonu basafaraacehu gizee (yaadaragenelaacehune 'asetaawesu) bataqaatharaacehume noro baqatharowe batalayaayaacehu nabare gene 'alaahe liszaraawe yamigabaawene nagare lifatseme yamithafaa sawe ka'aseraje baxwaalaa 'enedithafaa hheyaawe yamikxoneme sawe ka'aseraje baxwaalaa hheyaawe 'enedikxone (yaalaqatharo 'agaathamaacehu) 'alaaheme ba'eregethe sami `awaaqi nawe

'alaahe bahhelemehe 'enasune theqite 'aderego baasaayahe gizee ('asetaawese) 'enasune bezu 'aderego baasaayaheme noro bafaraacehunaa banagaru batachaqaachaqaacehu nabare gene 'alaahe 'adaanaacehu 'eresu badaratoce wesethe yaalane hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

'alaaheme liszaraawe yamigabaane nagare yefatseme zanede batagaathamaacehu gizee 'enaresune ba`aayenocaacehu theqite 'aderego yaasaayaacehunenaa ba`aayenocaacaweme laaye yaasaanasaacehune ('asetaawesu) nagarocume hulu wada 'alaahe becaa yemalasaalu
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! saraawitene bagathamaacehu gizee 'eregu; (maketu) 'alaaheneme babezu 'awesu; ba'eregethe tedenaalaacehunaa
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme taazazu 'atechaqaachaqume tefaraalaacehunaa xaayelaacehume tekxeedaalacenaa taagasume; 'alaahe kate`egesetanyoce gaare nawenaa
'enedanaziyaa late`ebitenaa lasawoce yeyulenye silu ka'alaaheme manegade lamaagade ka'agaraacawe 'enedawathute 'atekxunu 'alaaheme bamiszarute hulu (ba`eweqatu) kabaabi nawe

sayethaaneme szeraawocaacawene la'enaresu baasaamaralaacawenaa <<zaaree la'enaaneta kasawoce 'ashanaafi yalaacehume 'eneeme la'enaaneta radaate nanye>> baala gizeeme ('asetaawese) hulatu cheferoceme batayaayu gizee; wadaxwaalaawe 'afagafaga <<'enee kanaaneta netsuhe nanye 'enee 'enaaneta yamaataayutene 'ayaalahu 'enee 'alaahene 'efaraalahu 'alaaheme qethaata beretu nawe>> 'alaacaweme

manaafeqaanenaa 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacawe <<'enazihene (muselimoce) haayemaanotaacawe 'ataalalaacawe>> baalu gizee ('asetaawese) ba'alaaheme laaye yamithagaa (yaashanefaale); 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa

'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene malaa'ekete fitocaacawenenaa jarebaawocaacawene 'eyamatu <<yaqaathaloneme seqaaye qemasu>> ('eyaalu) bamigadelwacawe gizee betaaye noro ('asedanegaachene nagare taaye nabare)
yehe 'ejocaacehu baaseqadamute mekeneyaate 'alaaheme labaarocu badaaye baalamakxonu nawe (yebaalaalu)

(yanaziyaa lemaade) 'eneda fare`one beetasabenaa 'enedanaziyaame ka'enasu bafite 'eneda nabarute lemaade nawe ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce kaadu; 'alaaheme baxaathi'aatocaacawe yaazaacawe; 'alaahe xayelanyaa qethaata beretu nawenaa
yehe (qethaate) 'alaahe bahhezeboce laaye yalagasawene tsagaa banafesocaacawe yaalawene nagare 'esekamilawethu derase yamaayelawethe bamakxonu mekeneyaate nawe 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

'eneda fare`one beetasabocenaa 'eneda'enaziyaame ka'enasu bafite 'eneda nabarute lemaade ('esekamilawethu derase 'ayelawethebaacaweme) bageetaacawe ta'ameraate 'asetabaabalunaa baxaathi'aatocaacawe 'athafaanaacawe yafare`oneneme beetasaboce 'asathamenaacawe hulume badaayoce nabarume
kamineqasaaqasu 'enesesaawoce hulu 'alaahe zanede yebalethe kefuwocu 'enaziyaa zawatere yakaadute naacawe selazihe 'enasu 'ayaamenume
'enaziyaa kanasu qaale kidaane yayaazekebaacawe kaziyaame bayagizeewe qaale kidaanaacawene yamiyaafaresu naacawe 'enasume 'ayethanaqaqume
bathoreme laaye betaaganyaacawe ba'enaresu qethaate mekeneyaate (leelocu kahhaadiwoce) yegasatsu zanede kaxwaalaacawe yaalutene batenebaacawe
kahhezeboceme kedaatene betefaraa (yakidaanune maferase bamaawaqe) bamatakaakale laaye kxonaacehu kidaanaacawene wadanasu thaalelaacawe 'alaahe kadaatanyocene 'ayewademenaa
'enaziyaame yakaadute ka'alaahe qethaate yaamalathu makxonaacawene 'ayaasebu 'enasu 'ayaaqetumenaa

la'enasume kamaanenyaaweme xaayelenaa kataajabu farasoceme yacaalaacehutene hulu ba'eresu ya'alaahene thalaatenaa thalaataacehune leeloceneme ka'enaresu baqare yaalutene yamaataaweqwaacawene 'alaahe yamiyaaweqaacawene (manaafeqaane) yametaashaberubate setekxonu 'azagaajulaacawe kamaanenyaaweme nagare ba'alaahe manegade yametelagesuteme menedaawe wadanaaneta bamulu yesathaale 'enaanetame 'atebadalume
wada `ereqeme biyaazanabelu wada 'ereswa 'azanebele ba'alaaheme laaye tathagaa 'enaho 'eresu sami `awaaqi nawenaa
liyaataaleluheme bifalegu 'alaahe baqihe nawe 'eresu yaa ba'eredaataawenaa bame'emenaane yaabarataahe nawe

balebocaacaweme makaakale yaasemaamaa nawe bamedere yaalawene hulu (habete) balagaseke noro balebocaacawe makaakale baalaasemaamaahe nabare gene 'alaahe bamakaakalaacawe 'asemaamaa 'eresu 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa
'aneta nabiyu hoye! 'alaahe baqihe nawe latakataluheme me'emenaane ('alaahe baqiyaacawe nawe)

'aneta nabiyu hoye! me'emenaanene bamawaagaate laaye 'adafaaferaacawe ka'enaaneta wesethe haayaa taagaashoce noru hulate matone yaashanefaalu ka'enaanetame mato binoru ka'enaziyaa kakaadute 'enasu yamaayaawequ hhezeboce selakxonu shihene yaashanefaalu;

'ahune 'alaahe ka'enaaneta laaye 'aqalalalaacehu ba'enaaneta wesetheme dekemate manorune `awaqa selazihe ka'enaaneta mato taagaashoce binoru hulate matone yaashanefaalu ka'enaanetame shihe binoru ba'alaahe faqaade hulate shihene yaashanefaalu 'alaaheme kataagaashocu gaare nawe

lanabiye bamedere laaye 'esetiyaadakeme derase la'eresu merekonyoce linorute 'ayegabaame yaqerebitune `aalame thafi theqeme tefalegaalaacehu 'alaaheme macharashaayetune yeshaale 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
ka'alaahe yaalafa ferede baalenabara noro bawasadaacehute (beezaa) kabaade qethaate banakaacehu nabare
(kathalaate) kazarafaacehuteme (habete) yatafaqada malekaame sikxone belu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

'aneta nabiyu hoye! kamerekonyoce ba'ejocaacehu laalute balaacawe - <<'alaahe balebocaacehu wesethe bagone nagare ('emenatene) biyaaweqe ka'enaaneta katawasadabaacehu yatashaalane yesathaacexwaale la'enaanetame yemeraacexwaale 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe >>
likaduheme bifalegu kazihe bafite 'alaahene ba'eregethe kadetawaale kanasume 'asemacetohaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'enaziyaa yaamanunaa yatasadadu ba'alaaheme manegade laaye baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe yataagalu 'enaziyaame (sedatanyocune) yaasethagunaa yaradu 'enaziyaa kafilocaacawe lakafilu radaatoce naacawe 'enaziyaame yaamanunaa yaaletasadadu 'esekamisadadu derase kanasu meneme zemedenaa yalaacehume bahaayemaanoteme 'eredaataane bifalegubaacehu ba'enaanetanaa banasu makaakale qaale kidaane baalaacehu hhezeboce laaye kaalekxona basetaqare banaaneta laaye maredaate 'alabaacehu 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadute kafilocaacawe lakafilu radaatoce naacawe (kame'emenaane maradaadaatene kakahhaadiyaane maqoraarathene) baateszarute bamedere laaye hukatenaa taalaaqe thefaate yekxonaale

'enaziyaame yaamanunaa yatasadadu ba'alaaheme manegade laaye yataagalu, 'enaziyaame yaasethagunaa yaradu 'enaziyaa 'enasu ba'ewenate 'amaanyoce naacawe la'enasume mehheratenaa yakabara sisaaye 'alaacawe

'enaziyaame baxwaalaa yaamanunaa yatasadadu, ka'enaanetame gaare kxonawe yataagalu 'enaziyaa kanaanetawe naacawe yazemedenaawoce baalabeetoceme ba'alaahe matsehhafe kafilocaacawe bakafilu (mawerase) yatagabu naacawe 'alaahe banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe
(yehece) ka'alaahenaa kamaleketanyaawe wada'enaziyaa qaale kidaane wada tagaabaacexwaacawe 'agaariwoce yametedarese netsehhenaa naate
bamedere laayeme 'araate warocene (tsathetanyoce setekxonu) kxidu 'enaanetame ka'alaahe (qethaate) yamaataamalethu makxonaacehunenaa 'alaaheme kahhaadiwocene 'awaaraaje makxonune `ewaqu; (balwacawe)

(yehe) ka'alaahenaa kamaleketanyaawe bataalaaqu hhaje qane yawathaa 'alaahe ka'agaariwocu netsuhhe nawe maleketanyaaweme ('enedazihu) (kakehedate) betetsatsatume 'eresu la'enaaneta balaache nawe (ka'emenate) beteshashume 'enaaneta 'alaahene yamaataaqetute makxonaacehune `ewaqu bamaalate wada sawoce yamidarese maasetaawaqiyaa nawe 'enaziyaane yakaaduteneme ba'asaamaami qethaate 'abeseraacawe

ka'agaariwocu 'enaziyaa qaale kidaane yatagaabaacexwaacawenaa kaziyaame meneme yaalaagodalubaacehu banaaneta laayeme 'anedeneme yaaleradubaacehu siqaru; ('enazihene) qaale kidaanaacawene 'esekagizeeyaataacawe (macharashaa) mululaacawe 'alaahe thenequqocene yewadaalenaa

yatakabaruteme waroce baalaqu gizee 'agaariwocune ba'aganyaacehubaacawe seferaa gedaluwaacawe yaazuwaacaweme, kebabuwaacaweme, la'enasume (mathabaabaqe) bayamanegadu taqamathu bitsatsatume, solaateneme badanebu bisagedu, gedeetaa metsewaateneme bisathu manegadaacawene leqaqulaacawe 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
ka'agaariwoceme 'anedu theganyenatene bithayeqe ya'alaahene qaale yesamaa zanede 'asethagaawe kaziyaame wada mathabaqiyaawe seferaa 'aderesawe yehe 'enasu yamaayaawequ hhezeboce bamakxonaacawe nawe

la'agaariwocu 'alaahe zanedenaa 'emaleketanyaawe zanede qaale kidaane 'enedeete yenoraacawaale 'enaziyaa batakabarawe masegide zanede qaale kidaane yatagaabaacexwaacawe becaa siqaru ('enazihe) baqaale kidaanaacawe la'enaaneta qathe 'esekaalulaacehu derase lanaresume qathe balulaacawe 'alaahe thenequqocene yewadaalenaa

ba'enaaneta laaye biyaayelume ba'enaaneta wesethe zemedenaanenaa qaale kidaanene yamaayethabequ sikxonu 'enedeete (qaale kidaane yenoraacawaale) ba'afocaacawe yaasewadedwacexwaale lebocaacaweme 'enebi yelaalu 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amatsanyoce naacawe
ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce theqitene waagaa gazu kamanegadume 'agadu 'enaresu yeszarute yanabarute szeraa kafaa!
bame'emene nagare zemedenaaneme kidaaneneme 'ayethabequme; 'enaziyaame 'enasu wasane 'alaafiwoce naacawe
bitsatsatume, solaateneme bisagedu, zakaaneme bisathu yahaayemaanote wanedemocaacehu naacawe lamiyaawequ hhezeboceme 'aneqatsocene 'enaaberaaraalane

kaqaale kidaanaacawe baxwaalaa mahhaalaawocaacawene biyaafaresu, haayemaanotaacehuneme biyaanaweru, yakehedate mariwocene (kakehedate) yekalakalu zanede tawaaguwaacawe 'enaresu qaale kidaane yalaacawemenaa

mahhaalaawocaacawene yaafarasutene maleketanyaaweneme lamaawethaate yaasabutene hhezeboce 'enasu lamajamariyaa gizee yajamaruwaacehu sikxonu lamene 'atewaaguwaacaweme tefaruwaacawaalaacehune me'emenaane 'eneda kxonaacehume 'alaahe yebalethe letefarute yatagabaawe nawe
tagaadaluwaacawe 'alaahe ba'ejocaacehu yaasaqaayaacawaale yaawaaredaacawaaleme ba'enasume laaye yeradaacexwaale yame'emenaane hhezeboceneme leboce yaasheraale
yalebocaacehuneme quchete yaasewagedaale 'alaaheme kamishaawe sawe laaye tsatsatene yeqabalaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'enaziyaane ka'enaaneta wesethe yataagalutenenaa ka'alaaheme kamaleketanyaaweme kame'emanaaneme leelaa mesethiranyaa wadaaje yaaleyaazutene 'alaahe saayegaletse letetawe taasebaalaacehune 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

lakahhaadiwoce banafesocaacawe laaye bakehedate yamimasakeru sikxonu ya'alaahene masegidoce liszaru 'ayegabaacaweme 'enaziyaa szeraawocaacawe tabalaashu 'enasume ba'esaate wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe

ya'alaahene masegidoce yamiszaraawe ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yaamana, solaateneme badanebu yasagada, gedeetaa metsewaateneme yasatha ka'alaaheme leelaa (maaneneme) yaalefaraa sawe becaa nawe 'enaziyaame katamarute chemere makxonaacawe taragaagatha

kaa`ebaane gobenyewocene maathathaatenenaa yatakabarawene masegide maszeraatene ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane 'enedaamananaa ba'alaahe manegade 'enedataagala sawe ('emenatenaa tegele) 'adaragaacehune 'alaahe zanede 'ayetakaakalume 'alaaheme badaayoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraame

'enaziyaa yaamanute, ka'agaraacaweme yatasadadute, baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacaweme ba'alaahe manegade laaye yataagalute 'alaahe zanede badarajaa bathaame yalaaqu naacawe 'enaziyaame 'enasu felaagotaacawene yaaganyu naacawe
geetaacawe karesu bakxonawe 'ezenatenaa wedeetaa baganatoceme lanasu bawesethewaa yamaayaaqwaarethe mathaqamiyaa yaalabaate setekxone yaabaseraacawaale
bawesethwa zalaalame zawetaariwoce sikxonu (yaabaseraacawaale) 'alaahe 'eresu zanede taalaaqe menedaa 'alanaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'abaatocaacehunaa wanedemocaacehu kehedatene ka'emenate 'abelethawe biwadu wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazuwaacawe ka'enaanetame wesethe wadaaje yamiyaadaregaacawe 'enaziyaa 'enasu badaayoce naacawe;

<<'abaatocaacehunaa wanedoce lejocaacehu, wanedemocaacehume, misetocaacehume, zamadocaacehume, yasabasabaacexwaacawe habetoceme, makesaruwaane yametefaruwaate negedeme, yametewadwacawe manoriyaawoceme 'enaaneta zanede ka'alaahenaa kamaleketanyaawe baresu manegademe kamataagale yebalethe yatawadadu 'enedakxonu 'alaahe te'ezaazune 'esekamiyaamathaa derase tathabaabaqu>> balaacawe 'alaaheme 'amatsanyoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraame

'alaaheme babezu seferaawoce ba'eregethe radaacehu; yahhunayeneme qane bezaataacehu ba'asedanaqacaacehunaa ka'enaanetame meneme baalethaqamacaacehu gizee medereme kasefaatwa gaare bathababacaacehunaa kaziyaame tashanaafiwoce kxonaacehu bazoraacehu gizee (radaacehu)

kaziyaame 'alaahe 'eregaataawene bamaleketanyaawenaa bame'emenaanocu laaye 'awarada yaalaayaacexwaacaweneme saraawite 'awarada 'enaziyaane yakaaduteneme bamagadalenaa bamamaarake 'asaqaaya yeheme yakahhaadiyaane fedaa nawe
kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa 'alaahe bamishaawe sawe laaye tsatsatene yeqabalaale 'alaaheme 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'agaariwoce 'erekusoce becaa naacawe kaziheme `aamataacawe baxwaalaa yatakabarawene masegide 'ayeqerabu dekxenateneme betefaru 'alaahe bishaa kacerotaawe ba'eregethe yaakaberaacexwaale 'alaahe `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa

ka'enaziyaa matsehhafene katasathute sawoce 'enaziyaane ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenutene, 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe 'ereme yaadaraguteneme 'ereme yamaayaadaregutenenaa 'ewenatanyaaweneme haayemaanote yamaayeqabalutene 'enaresu yatawaaradu kxonawe geberene ba'ejocaacawe 'esekamisathu derase tawaaguwaacawe

'ayehude `uzayere ya'alaahe leje nawe 'alace keresetiyaanoceme 'alemasihhe ya'alaahe leje nawe 'alu yehe ba'afocaacawe (yaminaagarute) qaalaacawe nawe ya'enaziyaane kanasu bafite yakaadutene sawoce qaale yaamasaaselaalu 'alaahe yaathefaacawe (ka'ewenate) 'enedeete yemalasaalu!

ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yaleelawene 'anedene 'amelaake ligazu 'eneji yaaletaazazu sikxonu liqaawenetocaacawenenaa manakosaataacawene, yamareyamene leje 'alemasihheneme ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete 'aderegawe yaazu kamiyaagaarute hulu yatharaa nawe
ya'alaahene berehaane ba'afocaacawe lamaathefaate yefalegaalu 'alaaheme kahhaadiwoce bithalume 'enekwaa berehaanune mamulaatene 'eneje leelaane 'ayeshaame
'eresu yaa 'agaariwocu bithalume maleketanyaawene (muhhamadene) baqene manegadenaa ba'ewenatanyaa haayemaanote laaye kahaayemaanote hulu balaaye yefaa yaadaregawe zanede yalaakawe nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kaliqaawenetenaa kamanakosaate bezuwocu yasawocene ganezaboce baweshate ba'eregethe yebalaalu ka'alaaheme manegade yaagedaalu 'enaziyaaneme wareqenenaa berene yamiyaadalebutene ba'alaaheme manegade laaye yamaayaawathwatene ba'asaamaami qethaate 'abeseraacawe

bareswa laaye bagahaname 'esaate wesethe bamigaalebaatenaa genebaarocaacaweme, gonocaacaweme, jarebaawocaacaweme bareswa bamitakosu qane ('asaamaami bakxona qethaate 'abeseraacawe) yehe lanafesocaacehu yaadalabaacehute nawe taadalebute yanabaraacehuteneme qemasu (yebaalaalu)

yawaroce quthere 'alaahe zanede ba'alaahe matsehhafe wesethe samaayaatenenaa mederene bafatharabate qane `aszeraa hulate ware nawe ka'enasu 'araatu yatakabaru naacawe yehe qathetanyaawe haayemaanote nawe ba'enaresu wesetheme nafesocaacehune 'atebadelu 'agaariwoceneme ba'anede laaye kxonawe 'enedamiwaaguwaacehu ba'anede laaye kxonaacehu tagaadaluwaacawe 'alaaheme kamifarute gaare makxonune `ewaqu

ya'anedune ware kebere wada leelaawe maazageyate bakehedate laaye (kehedatene) machamare becaa nawe ba'eresu 'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce yesaasaatubataale ba'anede `aamate yatafaqada yaadaregutaale baleelaawe `aamateme yaawagezutaale (yehe) 'alaahe yaakabaraacawene waroce quthere liyaasetakaakelu, 'alaaheme 'ereme yaadaragawene yatafaqada liyaadaregu nawe yaszeraawocaacawe mathefowe lanaresu tawaabalaacawe 'alaaheme kahhaadiyaane hhezebocene 'ayemaraame

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'alaahe manegade (lamataagale) wethu batabaalaacehu gizee wada medere yametewazafute la'enaaneta mene 'alaacehu yaqerebitune hheyewate kamacharashaayetu yebalethe wadadaacehune yaqerebitume hheyewate theqeme bamacharashaayetu ('anetsaare) theqite 'eneji 'ayedalame
lazamacaa baatewathu ('alaahe) 'asaamaamine qethaate yeqathaacexwaale ka'enaaneta leelaa yakxonuneme hhezeboce yelawethaale bameneme 'ategodutememe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

(nabiyune) baateradute 'enaziyaa yakaadute hhezeboce yahulate (sawoce) hulatanyaa kxono (kamakaa) baawathute gizee 'alaahe ba'eregethe radetotaale hulatume bawaashaawe saalu lagwaadanyaawe 'atezane 'alaahe ka'enyaa gaare nawenaa baala gizee 'alaaheme maragaagaatene ba'eresu laaye 'awarada baalaayaacexwaacaweme saraawite 'abarataawe ya'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene sawoce qaale zeqetanyaa 'adaraga ya'alaaheme qaale la'ereswa kafetanyaa naate 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
qalaaloceme kabaadoceme kxonaacehu zematu ba'alaaheme manegade baganezabocaacehu banafesocaacehume taagalu yehe yametaawequ betekxonu lanaaneta bathaame yatashaala nawe

(yatharaahebaacawe nagare) qerebe theqemenaa makaakalanyaa guzo bakxona noro batakataluhe nabare gene banasu laaye manegaditu raaqacebaacawe <<bacaaleneme noro ka'enaaneta gaare bawathaane nabare>> silu ba'alaahe yemelaalu nafesocaacawene yaathafaalu 'alaaheme 'enasu weshataamoce makxonaacawene ba'eregethe yaaweqaale
'alaahe ka'aneta yeqere 'ala 'enaziyaa 'ewenatanyaawocu laaneta 'esekamigalatsulehenaa weshataamocuneme 'esekametaaweqe derase lanaresu ('enediqaru) lamene faqadekelaacawe
'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamenute baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe kamataagalaacawe (lamaqerate) faqaadene 'ayethayequheme 'alaaheme yamifarutene `awaaqi nawe
faqaadene yamithayequhe 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamaayaamenute lebocaacaweme yatatharaatharute becaa naacawe 'enasume batherethaareeyaacawe wesethe yewaalelaalu
mawethaateneme baasabu noro laresu zegejetene baasanaadu nabare gene 'alaahe (lamawethaate) 'eneqeseqaaseeyaacawene thalaa ('aleshaaweme) 'asanafaacaweme kataqamaachocume gaare taqamathu tabaalu

ka'enaaneta gaare bawathu noro thefaatene 'eneji 'ayechamerulaacehume nabare hukateneme yamifalegulaacehu sikxonu bamakaakalaacehu (bamaasaabaqe) yecaakolu nabare banaanetame wesethe lanasu 'adaamaachoce 'alwacawe 'alaaheme badaayocene `awaaqi nawe
'enaresu thayewoce sikxonu 'ewenatu 'esekamathaanaa ya'alaaheme te`ezaaze 'esekatagalatsa derase kazihe bafite hukatene ba'eregethe falagu nagaroceneme hulu 'agalaabathulehe
kanasume wesethe <<la'enee feqadelenye 'atemokeranyeme>> yamile sawe 'alela nequ! bamakaraa wesethe wadaqu gahanameme kahhaadiwocene ba'eregethe kabaabi naate
malekaame nagare betaaganyehe taasekafaacawaalace makaraame betaaganyehe <<kazihe bafite ba'eregethe theneqaaqeeyaacenene yezanaale>> yelaalu 'enaresume tadasaacoce kxonawe yeshashaalu
<<'alaahe lanyaa yatsaafalene (theqeme) 'eneji leelaa 'ayenakaaneme 'eresu radaataacene nawe ba'alaahe laayeme me'emanaane yemaku>> balaacawe

<<ba'enyaa laaye kahulatu malekaamoce 'anedanyaawaane 'eneji leelaane tethabaabaqaalaacehune 'enyaame 'alaahe ka'eresu bakxonawe qethaate wayeme ba'ejocaacene yamiyaathafaacehu makxonune banaaneta laaye 'enethabaabaqaalane tathabaabaqume 'enyaa ka'enaaneta gaare tathabaabaaqiwoce nanenaa>> balaacawe
<<wadaacehume kxona thaletaacehu lagesu ka'enaaneta taqabaaye yalaacehume 'enaaneta 'amatsanyoce hhezeboce naacehunaa>> balaacawe

legesenaawocaacawene kanasu taqabaaye yamiyaaganyu kamakxone 'enasu ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe yakaadu, solaateneme 'enasu taakaacoce kxonawe basetaqare yamaayesagedu, 'enasume thayewoce kxonawe basetaqare yamaayesathu makxonaacawe 'eneji leelaa 'alekalakalaacaweme

ganezabocaacawenaa lejocaacaweme 'ayedenaquhe 'alaahe yamishaawe baqerebitu hheyewate banaresu (baganezabocaacawenaa balejocaacawe) liqathaacawe nafesocaacaweme 'enasu kahhaadiwoce kxonawe liwathu becaa nawe
'enasume ba'eregethe ka'enaaneta lamakxonaacawe ba'alaahe yemelaalu 'enaresume kanaaneta 'ayedalume gene 'enasu ('agaariwocene yaaganya 'enedaayaaganyaacawe) yamifaru hhezeboce naacawe
mathagiyaane wayeme waashaawocene wayeme magebiyaane (qadaadaa) baaganyu noro 'enaresu 'eyagasagasu wadaresu bashashu nabare
kanasume wesethe bametsewaatoce yamizalefuhe sawoce 'alu kareswame (yamishutene) bisesathu yedasataalu kareswame baayesesathu 'enasu yaane gizee yethalaalu

'enasume 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe yasathaacawene bawadadu, <<'alaaheme baqiyaacene nawe; 'alaahe kacerotaawe ba'eregethe yesathanaale, maleketanyaaweme (yesathanaale), 'enyaa wada 'alaahe kajaayoce nane>> baalu noro (lanasu batashaalaacawe nabare)

gedeetaa metsewaatoce (yamikafalute) ladekxoce, lamesekinoceme, bareswame laaye lamiszaru szaraatanyoce, lebocaacaweme (ba'eselemenaa) lamilamaamadute, chaaneqaawoceneme (babaarenate tagazhiwocene) natsaa bamaawethaate, babaala `edaawoceme, ba'alaahe manegademe bamiszaru, bamanegadanyaame becaa nawe ka'alaahe yatadanagagace gedeetaa naate 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

ka'enasume (kamanaafeqaane) 'enaziyaa nabiyune yamiyaasaqaayu <<'eresume joro nawe>> (waree sami nawe) yamilu 'alelu balaacawe la'enaaneta yabago (waree) sami nawe ba'alaahe yaamenaale, me'emenaaneneme yaamenaacawaale, ka'enaanetame wesethe lanaziyaa laamanute 'ezenate nawe 'enaziyaame ya'alaahene maleketanyaa yamiyaasaqaayu lanasu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene liyaasewadedu tagabiyaacawe sikxone 'enaanetane yaasewadadwacehu zanede ba'alaahe yemelulaacexwaale me'emenaanoce bikxonu ('alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yaasewadedu)
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamikaraakare sawe la'eresu yagahaname 'esaate bawesethwa zawetaari sikxone yatagabaaciwe makxonune 'ayaawequmene yehe taalaaqe weredate nawe
manaafeqaane balebocaacawe wesethe yaalawene nagare yametenageraacawe suraa ba'enaresu laaye maweradwane yefaraalu <<'alaagethu 'alaahe yametefarutene hulu galaache nawe>> balaacawe
ba'eregethe betethayeqaacawe <<'enyaa yamenezabaareqenaa yamenechaawate becaa nabarene>> yelaalu <<ba'alaahenaa ba'aneqatsocu, bamaleketanyaaweme taalaagethu nabaraacehune>> balaacawe
'ataamakaanyu; ka'emenataacehu baxwaalaa ba'eregethe kaadaacehu ka'enaaneta 'anedwane cheferaa benemere (leelaawaane) cheferaa 'enasu xaathi'atanyoce bamakxonaacawe 'eneqathaalane

manaafeqaanenaa manaafeqaate kafilocaacawe kakafilu naacawe bamathefo nagare yaazaalu kadageme nagare yekalakelaalu 'ejocaacaweneme (kalegesenaa) yesabasebaalu 'alaahene rasu; selazihe ('eresu) waacawe manaafeqaane 'amatsanyocu 'enasu naacawe

manaafeqaanenenaa manaafeqaatene, kahhaadiwoceneme 'alaahe yagahanamene 'esaate bawesethwa zawetaariwoce sikxonu qaale gabetolaacawaale 'ereswa baqiyaacawe naate 'alaaheme ragemwacawaale la'enaresume zawetaari qethaate 'alaacawe

'enedanaziyaa kanaaneta bafite 'eneda nabarute naacehu ka'enaaneta yebalethe baxaayele yabaratu baganezaboceme balejoceme yebalethe yabazu nabaru ba`edelaacaweme tathaqamu 'enaziyaame ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarute ba`edelaacawe 'enedatathaqamu ba`edelaacehu tathaqamaacehu 'enedanaziyaame 'enedazabaaraqute zabaaraqaacehu 'enaziyaa szeraawocaacawe baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame tabalaashu 'enaziyaame kasaariwocu 'enasu naacawe

ya'enaziyaa ka'enaaneta bafite yanabarute yanuhhe hhezeboce, ya`aadenaa yasamudeme, yaberaahimeme hhezeboce yamadeyane baalabeetocenaa yatagalebaachocume katamoce waree 'alemathaalaacawemene maleketanyocaacawe bata`aameraate mathwacawe 'alaaheme yamibadelaacawe 'alenabarame gene nafesocaacawene yamibadelu nabaru

me'emenenaa me'emenaateme kafilocaacawe lakafilu radaatoce naacawe badage nagare yaazaalu; kakefume yekalakelaalu solaateneme yesagedaalu zakaaneme yesathaalu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yetaazazaalu 'enaziyaane 'alaahe ba'eregethe yaazenelaacawaale 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa

'alaahe me'emenaanenenaa me'emenaatene kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu bamanoriyaa ganatoceme wesethe malekaame manoriyaa beetocene qaale gabetolaacawaale ka'alaaheme yakxonawe wedeetaa kahulu yabalatha nawe yehe 'eresu taalaaqe 'edele nawe
'aneta nabiyu hoye! kahhaadiwocenenaa manaafeqaanene taagale ba'enasume laaye chakene manoriyaacaweme gahaname naate mamalashaayetume kafaace

meneme yaalaalu lamakxonaacawe ba'alaahe yemelaalu yakehedateneme qaale ba'eregethe 'alu ka'eselemenaacaweme baxwaalaa kaadu yaalaaganyuteneme nagare 'asabu 'alaaheme kacerotaawe maleketanyaaweme ('enedazihu) yaakabaraacawe makxonune 'eneji leelaane 'alethalume bitsatsatume la'enasu yatashaala yekxonaale bishashume 'alaahe baqerebitunaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame 'asaamaamine qethaate yeqathaacawaale la'enasume bamedere wesethe meneme wadaajenaa radaate yalaacaweme
ka'enasume <<'alaahene kacerotaawe bisathane ba'eregethe 'enematsawetaalane kamalekaamocume ba'eregethe 'enekxonaalane>> sile qaale yatagaabaa 'alela
kacerotaaweme basathaacawe gizee ba'eresu sasatu 'enasu (kidaanaacawene) yatawu kxonaweme zoru
'alaaheneme qaale yagabulatene bamaaferasaacawenaa yewaashuteme banabarute mekeneyaate 'esekamiganaanyute qane derase nefeqenaane 'asekatalaacawe
'alaahe mesethiraacawenenaa weyeyetaacawene yamiyaaweqe makxonune 'alaaheme ruqocene hulu bathaame `awaaqi makxonune 'ayaawequmene

'enaziyaa kame'emenaane bametsewaatoce faqaadanyaa yakxonutene, 'enaziyaaneme yacelotaacawene yaakele 'eneje yamaayaaganyutene sawoce yamiyaanaweru, ka'enasume yamisequ 'alaahe kanasu yesaalaqebaacawaale; (yeqathaacawaale) la'enasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

la'enaresu mehheratene lamenelaacawe; wayeme la'enasu mehheratene 'atelamenelaacawe ('ekule nawe) la'enasu sabaa gizee mehheratene betelamenelaacawe 'alaahe lanasu bafetsume 'ayemereme yehe 'enaresu 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawene bamakaadaacawe nawe 'alaaheme 'amatsanyoce hhezebocene 'ayaaqanaame

'enaziyaa kazamacaa yaqarute ka'alaahe maleketanyaa baxwaalaa bamaqamathaacawe tadasatu ba'alaaheme manegade baganezabocaacawenaa banafesocaacawe mataagalene thalu <<bahharure 'atekxidu>> 'alume <<yagahaname 'esaate takwaasaanatu bathaame yabarataa nawe>> balaacawe yamiyaawequ bikxonu noro ('ayeqarume nabare)
theqiteneme yesaaqu yeszarute banabarute waagaa bezune yaalaqesaalu

ka'enasume wada kxonacewe cheferaa 'alaahe bimalesehe (ka'aneta gaare) lamawethaateme biyaasefaqeduhe -<<kanee gaare bafetsume 'atewathume ka'eneeme gaare thalaatene 'atewaagume 'enaaneta bamajamariyaa gizee maqamathene wadaacexwaalenaa kataqamaachocu gaareme taqamathu>> balaacawe
ka'enasume ba'anedeme bamota sawe laaye fatsemo 'atesegade bamaqaaberume laaye 'atequme 'enasu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene kedawaalenaa 'enasume 'amatsanyoce kxonawe motawaalenaa
ganezabocaacawenaa lejocaacaweme 'ayedenaquhe 'alaahe yamishaawe baqerebitu `aalame banasu liqathaacawenaa kahhaadiwoceme kxonawe nafesocaacawe 'enediwathu becaa nawe

ba'alaahe 'emanu kamaleketanyaaweme gaare kxonaacehu taagalu; bamaalate me`eraafe batawaradace gizee kanasu yasafi habete baalabeetoce yakxonute (lamaqerate) faqaade yethayequhaale <<kataqamaachocu gaareme 'enekxune tawane>> yeluhaale
babeete kamiqarute gaare makxonaacawene wadadu balebocaacaweme laaye (zegate) taatamabaacawe selazihe 'enasu 'ayaawequme
gene maleketanyaawe 'enaziyaame karesu gaare yaamanute baganezabocaacaweme banafesocaacaweme taagalu 'enaziyaame malekaamoce hulu lanasu naacawe 'enaziyaame 'enasu menyotaacawene yaaganyu naacawe
la'enasume ganatocene baszeraacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu 'alaahe 'azagaajetolaacawaale yehe taalaaqe maagenyate nawe

ka'a`eraaboceme yeqeretaa falaagiwocu la'enasu 'enedifaqadelaacawe mathu 'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yawaashuteme taqamathu kanasu 'enaziyaane yakaadutene 'asaamaami qethaate ba'eregethe yenakaacawaale

badakaamoce laaye babashetanyoceme laaye banaziyaame yamiyaawathute ganezabe bamaayaaganyute laaye la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe fetsume taazaazhoce kakxonu (baayewathume) xaathi'aate yalabaacaweme babago 'aderaagiwoce laaye (yawaqasaa) manegade meneme yalabaacaweme 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

ba'enaziyaame letechenaacawe bamathuhe gizee <<baresu laaye yamechenaacehu ('agaasase) 'alaaganyeme;>> yaalekaacawe setekxone yamiyaawathute ganezabe baalamaagenyataacawe lamaazanaacawe `aayenocaacawe 'enebaane 'eyaafasasu bazorute laaye (yawaqasaa manegade yalabaacaweme)

(yawaqasaa) manegadu ba'enaziyaa 'enasu baalatsagaawoce kxonawe saalu lamaqerate faqaade bamithayequhe sawoce laaye becaa nawe kaqariwocu gaare makxonaacawene wadadu 'alaaheme balebocaacawe laaye 'atamabaacawe; selazihe 'enasu 'ayaawequme

wada'enasu batamalasaacehu gizee mekeneyaataacawene yaaqarebulaacexwaale 'ataamakaanyu; 'enaanetane fatsemo 'anaameneme 'alaahe kawareewocaacehu ba'eregethe nageronaalenaa 'alaaheme szeraacehune ba'eregethe yaayaale maleketanyaaweme ('enedazihu); kaziyaame ruqenenaa qerebene hulu `awaaqi wada kxonawe ('alaahe) temalasaalaacehu wadiyaaweme teszarute yanabaraacehutene hulu yenageraacexwaale balaacawe

wada'enasu batamalasaacehu gizee 'enedetetawewaacawe la'enaaneta ba'eregethe ba'alaahe yemelaalu 'enasuneme tawaacawe 'enasu 'erekusoce naacawenaa yeszaruteme banabarute waagaa manoriyaacawe gahaname nawe
ka'enasu tewadulaacawe zanede lanaaneta yemelulaacexwaale ka'enasu betewadume 'alaahe 'amatsanyoce hhezebocene 'ayewademe
'a`eraaboce bakehedatenaa banefeqenaa bathaame yabaratu; 'alaaheme bamaleketanyaawe laaye yaawaradawene hhegegaate baalamaawaqe yatagabu naacawe 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

ka'a`eraaboceme (ba'alaahe manegade) yamiwathaawene (ganezabe) `edaa 'aderego yamiyeze ba'enaanetame laaye yagizeene magalabaabathe yamithabaabaqe sawe 'alela ba'enasu laaye thefaatu yezurebaacawe 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

ka'a`eraaboceme ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamene yamisathaacaweneme (metsewaatoce) 'alaahe zanede maqaarabiyaawocenaa wada maleketanyaawe tsalotoce madaarashaa 'aderego yamiyeze sawe 'alela nequ! 'ereswa la'enasu ba'eregethe 'aqaaraabi naate 'alaahe bacerotaawe wesethe (baganatu) ba'eregethe yaasegabaacawaale 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

kasedatanyocunaa karadaatocume sikxonu yamajamariyaawocu qadaamiwoce 'enaziyaame babago szeraa yatakatalwacawe 'alaahe ka'enasu wadwale ka'eresume wadawaale baszerocaacaweme wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zala`aalame nawaariwoce sikxonu la'enaresu 'azagaajetolaacawaale yehe taalaaqe `edele nawe

bazuriyaacehume kaalute ka`arabe zalaanoce manaafeqaane 'alelu kamadinaa sawoceme banefeqenaa laaye bamaamatse yazawataru 'alelu 'ataaweqaacaweme 'enyaa 'enaaweqaacawaalane hulate gizee 'eneqathaacawaalane kaziyaame wadataalaaqe qethaate yemalasaalu
leeloceme baxaathi'atocaacawe yatanaazazu malekaame szeraanenaa leelaane mathefo szeraa yaqalaaqalu 'alelu 'alaahe ka'enasu tsatsataacawene liqabale yekajalaale 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
kaganezabocaacawe setekxone ba'ereswa yametaatharaacawenaa yametaafaafaacawe yakxonacene metsewaate yaaze lanasume tsaleyelaacawe tsalotehe la'enasu 'eregaataa nawenaa 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe
'alaahe 'eresu kabaarocu nesehhaane yamiqabale metsewaatoceneme yamiwasede makxonune 'alaaheme 'eresu tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye makxonune 'ayaawequme

balaacaweme szeru 'alaahe szaraacehune ba'eregethe yaayaalenaa maleketanyaawenaa me'emenaaneme ('enedazihu yaayaalu) ruqunenaa qerebune hulu `awaaqi wada kxonaweme ('alaahe) ba'eregethe temalasaalaacehu teszaruteme yanabaraacehutene hulu yenageraacexwaale
leeloceme la'alaahe te`ezaaze yataqoyu hhezeboce 'alelu waye yeqathaacawaale wayeme kanasu laaye tsatsatene yeqabalaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'enaziyaame (me'emenaanene) lamagudaate, kehedateneme lamaabaretaate, bame'emenaaneme makaakale lamalayaayate, ka'ahune bafite 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yatawaagaaweneme sawe lamathabaabaqe masegidene yaszarute (kanasu naacawe) malekaamene szeraa 'eneji leelaa 'aleshaaneme silume ba'eregethe yemelaalu 'alaaheme 'enasu ba'eregethe weshataamoce makxonaacawene yemasakeraale

ba'eresu wesethe bafetsume 'atesegade kamajamariyaa qane yezo ba'alaahe feraacaa laaye yatamaszaratawe (yaqubaa) masegide bawesethu letesagedebate yeleqe yatagabaawe nawe ba'esu wesethe matheraaraatene yamiwadu wanedoce 'alelu 'alaaheme tatheraariwocene yewadaale

'alaahene bamaferaatenaa wedeetaawene bamafalage laaye genebune yamaszaratawe sawe yebalethaalene wayese gorefe basharasharawe lamanaade bataqaaraba gadale 'afaafe laaye genebune yamaszaratawenaa baresu (yezote) bagahaname 'esaate wesethe yawadaqa (yebalethaale) 'alaaheme badalanyoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraame
yaa yakaabute genebaacawe lebocaacawe (bamote) kaaletaqoraarathu baqare balebocaacawe wesethe yamatharaathare mekeneyaate kamakxone 'ayewagademe 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'alaahe kame'emenaane nafesocaacawenenaa ganezabocaacawene ganate la'enasu becaa yaalaacawe bamakxone gazaacawe ba'alaahe manegade laaye yegaadalaalu yegadelaalume; yegadalaalume bataweraate banejelenaa baqure'aaneme (yatanagarawene) tasefaa ba'eresu laaye 'aragaagatha ka'alaaheme yabalatha bakidaanu yamimolaa maanawe baziyaame ba'eresu batashaashaathaacehubate sheyaachaacehu tadasatu yeheme 'eresu taalaaqe `edele nawe

('enaresu) tatsatsaaciwoce, tagazhiwoce, 'amasegaanyoce, tswamiwoce, 'agonebaashoce, bagenebaare tadafiwoce, babago szeraa 'azaazhoce kakefume kalekaayoce, ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate thabaaqiwoce naacawe me'emenaaneneme 'abesere

lanabiyunaa lanaziyaa laamanute la'agaariwocu yazemedenaa baalabeetoce bikxonume 'enekwaa 'enasu (kahhaadiwocu) ya'esaate gwaadoce makxonaacawe katagalatsalaacawe baxwaalaa mehheratene lilamenu yamigabaa 'alenabarame

yaberaahimeme la'abaatu mehheratene malamane la'eresu gabetolate lanabaracewe qaale (lamamulaate) 'eneji laleelaa 'alenabarame 'eresume ya'alaahe thalaate makxonu la'eresu batagalatsalate gizee karesu raaqa; (tawawe) beraahime ba'eregethe bathaame rexeruxe taagaashe nawenaa

'alaaheme hhezebocene ka'aqanaacawe baxwaalaa yamithanaqaqutene (szeraa) la'enasu 'esekamigaletsalaacawe ('esekamitaweteme) derase thefaatanyaa yamiyaadarege 'ayedalame 'alaahe banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawenaa
'alaahe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negesenaa yaresu becaa nawe hheyaawe yaadaregaale; yegadelaaleme la'enaanetame karesu baqare thabaaqime radaateme yalaacehume

banabiyu banaziyaame bacegeritu gizeeyaate (batabuke zamacaa) ka'enasu yakafilocu leboce (lamaqerate) lizanabalu kataqaarabu baxwaalaa batakatalute sedatanyocenaa radaatoce laaye 'alaahe ba'eregethe tsatsataacawene taqabala kaziyaame ka'enasu nesehhaa magebaataacawene taqabala 'eresu la'enasu rexeruxe 'azaanye nawenaa

ba'enaziyaame baszosetu sawoce laaye medere kasefaatewaa gaare ba'enasu laaye 'eseka thababace, nafesocaacaweme baresaacawe laaye 'esekatathababu, ka'alaaheme wadaresu bikxone 'eneji leelaa mathagiyaa 'alamanorune 'eseka 'aragaagathu derase bataqoyute laaye ('alaahe tsatsatene taqabala) kaziyaame yetsatsatu zanede wada tsatsate maraacawe 'alaahe 'eresu tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye nawenaa
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru; ka'ewenatanyocume gaare kxunu

lamadinaa sawocenaa ka'a`eraabeme bazuriyaacawe laalute sawoce ka'alaahe maleketanyaa wadaxwaalaa liqaru nafesocaacaweneme kanafesu 'abelethawe liwadu 'ayegabaacaweme nabare yehe (kamaqerate makalekale) la'enaresu malekaame szeraa yamitsaafelaacawe bikxone 'eneje ba'alaahe manegade laaye thememe, dekaameme, raxaabeme, yamaayenakaacawe kahhadiwoceneme yamiyaaseqochene seferaa yamaayeragethu, kathalaateme yamigodaane nagare (magedalene mamaarakene mazerafene) yamaayaaganyu bamakxonaacawe nawe 'alaahe yamalekaame szariwocene menedaa 'ayaathafaamenaa
tenesheneme teleqeneme legesenaa 'ayelagesume wanezeneme 'ayaaqwaarethume 'alaahe yeszarute kanabarawe yabalathane menedaa yemanadaacawe zanede la'enasu yamitsaafelaacawe bihone 'eneje

me'emenaaneme (kanabiyu gaare kaalekxona) bamulu liwathu 'ayegabaame ka'enasu wesethe kayakefelu 'anedite cheferaa lamene 'atewathaame (leelocu) haayemaanotene 'enedimaarunaa waganocaacawe wadanaresu batamalasu gizee 'enedithanaqaqu yegasetsuwaacawe zanede (lamene 'ayeqarume)
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaziyaane ba'aqeraabiyaacehu yaalutene kahhaadiwoce tawaagu ka'enaanetame beretaatene yaagenyu 'alaaheme kamithanaqaqute gaare makxonune `ewaqu

suraame (me`eraafe) batawaradace gizee ka'enasu (kamanaafeqaane) wesethe maanenyaacehu nawe yehece (me`eraafe) 'emenatene yachamaracelate yamile sawe 'alela 'enaziyaa yaamanutemaa yamidasatu sikxonu 'emenatene chamaracelaacawe
'enaziyaame balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacawemaa barekesataacawe laaye rekesatene chamaracelaacawe 'enaresume kahhaadiwoce kxonawe motu
baya`aamatu 'anede wayeme hulate gizee 'enaresu yamimokaru makxonaacawene 'ayaayumene kaziyaame 'ayetsatsatumene 'enasume 'ayegasatsumene

('enasune yametaanasaa) me`eraafeme batawaradace gizee 'anede sawe yaayaacexwaalene 'eyaalu kafilocaacawe wada kafilu yemalakataalu kaziyaame (tadabeqawe) yekxeedaalu 'enaresu yamaayaawequ hhezeboce bamakxonaacawe 'alaahe lebocaacawene 'azora
kagosaacehu yahona cegeraacehu ba'eresu laaye tsenu yahona, ba'enaaneta ('emenate) laaye yamigwaagwaa, bame'emenaane (laaye) rexeruxe 'azaanye yakxona maleketanyaa ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu
biyaafagafegume 'alaahe baqiyee nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame ba'eresu laaye tathagaahu 'eresume yataalaaqu `areshe geetaa nawe balaacawe
'a.la.ra ('alife laame raa) yeheci (suraa) thebabe katamalaawe matsehhafe (kaqure'aane) 'aneqatsoce naate

<<sawocene 'asefaraaraa 'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene la'enasu kageetaacawe zanede malekaame menedaa yaalaacawe makxonune 'abesere>> bamaalate kanaresuwe wada kxona 'anede sawe raa'eyene maaweradaacene lasawoce deneqe kxonabaacawene kahhaadiwocu - <<yehe ba'eregethe geletse degemetanyaa nawe>> 'alu

geetaacehu yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene basedesete qanoce wesethe yafathara 'alaahe nawe kaziyaame nagarune hulu yamiyaasetanaabere sikxone ba`areshu laaye (selethaanu) tadalaadala ka'eresu faqaade baxwaalaa bikxone 'eneji 'anedeme 'amaalaaje yalame 'enaho! 'alaahe geetaacehu nawenaa tagazute; 'ategasatsumene

hulaacehume kxonaacehu mamalashaacehu wada 'eresu nawe (yeheme) yataragaagatha ya'alaahe qaale kidaane nawe; 'eresu mafetharene yejameraale kaziyaame 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaame yaszarutene batekekele yemanadaa zanede yemalesawaale 'enaziyaa yakaaduteme yekedute banabarute nagare lanaresu kafalaa wehaa yakxona mathathenaa 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe

'eresu yaa tzahhayene 'anetsaabaaraaqi charaqaaneme 'aberi yaadaraga nawe ya`aamataatene qutherenaa hhisaabene taawequ zanedeme la'eresu masefariyaawocene yalakaa nawe 'alaahe yehenene ba'ewenate 'eneji (bakanetu) 'alefatharaweme lamiyaawequ hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene yaaberaaraale
leelitenaa qane bamatakaakaataacawe 'alaaheme basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe bafatharawe hulu lamithanaqaqu hhezeboce meleketoce 'alu
'enaziyaa maganaanyataacenene yamaayefaru qerebituneme hheyewate yawadadu ba'eswame yaraku 'enaziyaame 'enasu ka'aneqatsocaacene zanegiwoce yakxonu
'enaziyaa yeszarute banabarute mekeneyaate manoriyaacawe ba'esaate wesethe nawe

'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru geetaacawe ba'emenataacawe mekeneyaate (yaganatene manegade) yemaraacawaale kaszeraacawe wanezoce yefasesaalu bamathaqamiyaa ganatoce wesethe yenoraalu

ba'ereswame wesethe tsalotaacawe geetaacene hoye! theraate yegabaahe (maalate) nawe ba'ereswa wesethe makabaabariyaacaweme salaame mabaabaale nawe; yamacharashaa tsalotaacaweme mesegaanaa la`aalamaate geetaa yehune (maalate) nawe

'alaahe lasawoce dagene nagare lamaagenyate 'eneda macaakolaacawe ('athefaane silute) kefune nagare biyaasecakule noro gizeeyaacawe wadanasu batafatsama nabare 'enaziyaaneme maganaanyataacenene yamaayefarutene bathemataacawe wesethe yamiwaalelu sikxonu 'enetawaacawaalane

saweneme gudaate baaganyawe gizee bagonu laaye tagaademo wayeme taqametho wayeme qomo yelamenanaale gudaatuneme ka'esu laaye bagalathenelate gizee wada 'aganyawe gudaate 'enedaaletharaane hono yaalefaale 'enedazihu ladenebare 'alaafiwoce yeszarute yanabarute szeraa tashalamalaacawe

ka'enaaneta bafite yanabaruteneme yakefela zamanaate sawoce maleketanyocaacawe bamaaserajaawoce yamathwacawe sikxonu babadalunaa yamaayaamenume bakxonu gizee ba'eregethe 'athafaanaacawe 'enedazihu tanekolanyocene hhezeboce 'eneqathaalane
kaziyaame 'enedeete 'enedameteszaru lenemalakate ka'enasu baxwaalaa bamedere laaye metekoce 'adaragenaacehu

'aneqatsocaaceneme geletse kxonawe ba'enaresu laaye batanababulaacawe gizee 'enaziyaa maganaanyataacenene yamaayefarute kazihe leelaa yahonane qure'aane 'amethaalene wayeme lawethawe yelaalu 'enee karaasee bakule lelawethawe 'ayegabaanyeme wada'enee yamiwaredawene 'eneji 'alekataleme 'enee kageetaayee baametse yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalahu balaacawe

'alaahe bashaa noro ba'enaaneta laaye baalanababekuteme ('alaahe) 'eresune baalaasaawaqaacehume nabare ba'enaanetame wesethe ka'eresu bafite (meneme saalele) bezune `edemee ba'eregethe noree'alahu; 'ataawequmene
ba'alaaheme laaye 'ebelatene kaqathaathafa wayeme ba'aneqatsocu ka'asetabaabala yebalethe badaaye maane nawe 'enaho 'amatsanyoce 'ayedenume

ka'alaaheme leelaa yamaayegodaacawene yamaayethaqemaacaweneme yegegazaalu <<'enaziheme 'alaahe zanede 'amaalaajocaacene naacawe>> yelaalu <<'alaahene basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yamaayaaweqawe nagare noro tenagerutaalaacehune>> balaacawe kamiyaagaarute hulu tharaa; laaqame
sawoceme 'anede hhezebe 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarume talayaayume kageetaahe yaalaface qaaleme baalenabarace noro ba'eresu bamilayaayubate nagare bamakaakalaacawe ba'eregethe (batolo) batafarada nabare
ba'eresu laayeme kageetaawe yahonace ta`aamere lamene 'atewaradelateme yelaalu <<ruqe nagareme hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe tathabaabaqume; 'enee kanaaneta gaare kamithabaabaqute nanyenaa>> balaacawe

sawoceneme kaaganyaacawe gudaate baxwaalaa 'ezenatene (zenaabenaa mecotene) baaqamasenaacawe gizee wadiyaawenu la'enasu bata`aameraatocaacene (bamaalaagathe) tanekole yenoraacawaale 'alaahe qethaata fathaane nawe <<maleketanyocaacene yametemakerutene nagare ba'eregethe yetsefaalu>> balaacawe
