'eresu ('alaahe) yaa bayabesenaa babaahhere yamiyaasekeedaacehu nawe bamarekaboceme wesethe bahonaacehunaa ba'enaresume bamalekaame nafaase bareswa yatadasatu kxonawe (marekabocu) bataneshaalalu gizee xayelanyaa nafaase temathaabaataalace kayaseferaaweme maa`ebale yemathaabaacawaale 'enasume (lathefaate) yatakababu mahonaacawene yaaragaagethaalu (yaane gizee) 'alaahene kazihece (cheneqate) betaadenane ba'eregethe ka'amasegaanyocu 'enehonaalane silu haayemaanotene laresu becaa yaatharu honawe yelamenutaale

ba'adaanaacaweme gizee 'enasu wadiyaawenu yaala 'agebaabe bamedere laaye wasane yaalefaalu 'enaaneta sawoce hoye! wasane maalafaacehu (thefaatu) banafesocaacehu laaye becaa nawe ('eresume) yaqerebitu hheyewate mathaqamiyaa nawe kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wadanyaa nawe teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme hulu 'enenageraacexwaalane

yaqerebitu hheyewate mesaalee kasamaaye 'enedaawaradenawe wehaa, ba'eresume sawenaa 'enesesaawoce kamibalute yamedere baqaaye taqalaaqelobate ('eneda faafaa) medereme webatewaane bayaazacenaa baageethace gizee baalabeetocewaame bareswa laaye 'enaresu caayoce makxonaacawene baasabu gizee te'ezaazaacene leelite wayeme qane mathetobaate telaanete 'enedaalenabarace yataachadace 'enedaadaragenaate bethee nawe 'enedazihume lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce 'aneqatsocene 'enaaberaaraalane
'alaaheme wada salaame 'agare yetharaale yamishaaweneme sawe wada qathetanyaawe manegade yemaraale

la'enaziyaa malekaame laszarute malekaame nagarenaa chemaarime 'alaacawe fitocaacaweneme thequratenaa weredate 'ayeshafenaacaweme 'enaziyaa yaganate sawoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe

la'enaziyaame xaathi'atocene laszarute yaxaathi'aatitu qethaate babetheewaa 'alacaacawe weredateme teshafenaacawaalace la'enasu ka'alaahe (qethaate) thabaaqi yalaacaweme fitocaacawe kachalama leelite quraachoce 'eneda tashafanu yekxonaalu 'enaziyaa ya'esaate sawoce naacawe 'enaresu bawesethwa zala`aalame nawaariwoce naacawe

huluneme yamenesabasebaacawene kaziyaame la'enaziyaa la'agaarute 'enaanetame tagaariwocehume seferaacehune yaazu yamenelebatene tagaariwocaacaweme 'enyaane tegazu 'alenabaraacehume yamiluwaacawe sikxonu bamakaakalaacawe yamenelayebatene qane ('asetaawese)
<<(thaa`otaatocu la'enyaa) kamagazaataacehu ba'eregethe zanegiwoce lamakxonaaceneme ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale ya'alaahe masekaarinate baqaa>> (yelwacawaale)
baziyaa qane nafese hulu yaasaalafacewene szeraa taaweqaalace ('agaariwoce) wada 'alaaheme 'ewenatanyaa wada honawe geetaacawe yemalasaalu ka'enasume yeqathaathefute yanabarute nagare yethafaacawaale

<<kasamaayenaa kamedere sisaayene yamisathaacehu maane nawe masemiyaawocenenaa maayaawocenese yafathara maane nawe kamuteme hheyaawene yamiyaawathaa kahheyaaweme mutene yamiyaawathaase maane nawe nagarune hulu yamiyaasetanaaberese maane nawe>> balaacawe <<ba'eregetheme 'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<taadiyaa (lamene taagaaraalaacehu) 'atefarutemene>> balaacawe
'eresu 'ewenatanyaa geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe ka'ewenateme baxwaalaa themate 'eneji leelaa mene 'ala (kawenate) 'enedeete tezoraalaacehu
'enedazihu yageetaahe qaale ba'enaziyaa baamatsute laaye 'enaresu yamaayaamenu mahonaacawe taragaagathace

<<kametaagaaruwaacawe (thaa`otaate) wesethe mafetharene yamijamere kazime yamimalesawe 'alane>> balaacawe <<'alaahe mafetharene yejameraale; kaziyaame yemalesawaale taadiyaa (ka'emenate) 'enedeete tezoraalaacehu>> balaacawe

<<kametaagaaruwaacawe; wada 'ewenate yamimaraa 'alane>> balaacawe <<'alaahe wada 'ewenatu yemaraale wada 'ewenate yamimaraawe likatalute yatagabaawe nawene wayese kaaletamaraa basetaqare yamaayemaraawe la'enaanetame mene ('aseraje) 'alaacehu 'enedeete (baweshate) tefaredaalaacehu>> balaacawe
'abezaanyocaacaweme therethaareene 'eneji 'ayekatalume therethaaree ka'ewenate meneme 'ayaabeqaaqaame 'alaahe yamiszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe

yeheme qure'aane ka'alaahe leelaa (kahona fethure) yataqathafa lihone 'ayegabaaweme gene yaanene ka'eresu bafite yaalawene (matsehhafe) yamiyaaragaagethenaa bamatsehhafu wesethe yaalawene yamizarazere ba'eresu therethaaree yaleelabate sihone ka`aalamaate geetaa (yatawarada) nawe

ba'ewenateme <<(muhhamade) qathaathafawe>> yelaalune <<yehe kahona masalune ('anedite) suraa 'amethu ka'alaaheme leelaa yacaalaacehutene hulu (radaate) theru 'ewenatanyoce 'enedahonaacehu (tagaagezaacehu 'amethu)>> balaacawe

yelequneme (kaqure'aane) 'eweqatune baalaadarasute fecume ganaa baalemathaacawe nagare 'asetabaabalu 'enedazihu 'enaziyaa ka'enasu bafite yanabarute 'asetabaabelawaale yabadaayoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekate
ka'enaresume wesethe (wadafite) baresu yamiyaamenu 'alelu ka'enaresume ba'eresu yamaayaamenu 'alelu geetaaheme 'athefiwocune bathaame `awaaqi nawe
<<biyaasetabaabeluheme la'enee szeraayee 'alanye la'enaanetame szaraacehu 'alaacehu 'enaaneta kameszaraawe nagare netsuhhe naacehu 'eneeme kameteszarute nagare netsuhhe nanye>> balaacawe
ka'enasume wada 'aneta yamiyaadaamethu ('enaa yamaayaamenu) 'alelu 'aneta daneqorowocene yamaayaawequ bikxonume taasamaalahene
ka'enasume wada 'aneta yamimalakatu 'alelu 'aneta (leba) `eweraanene yamaayaayu bikxonume temaraalahene
'alaahe sawocene meneme 'ayebadeleme gene sawoce nafesocaacawene yebadelaalu

(kahhaadiwocene) kaqane 'aneditene sa`aate 'eneji 'enedaaleqoyu maselawe bamakaakalaacawe yamitawaawaqu sihonu bamenesabasebaacawe qane ('asetaawese) 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe maganaanyate yaasetabaabalute ba'eregethe kasaru yatamarume 'alenabarume

yaziyaaneme yamenaasefaraaraacawene kafilune (bahheyewatehe) benaasaayehe (malekaame nawe) wayeme (saanaasaayehe) benegadelehe mamalashaacawe wada 'enyaa nawe kaziyaame 'alaahe bamiszarute seraa laaye `awaaqi nawe
lahhezeboceme hulu maleketanyaa 'alaacawe maleketanyaaweme bamathaa gizee (siyaasetabaabelu) bamakaakalaacawe batekekele yefaradaale 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
<<'ewenatanyoceme kahonaacehu yehe (yaqethaatu) qatharo macee nawe>> yelaalu

<<laraasee gudaateneme theqemeneme 'alaahe kashaawe basetaqare 'aleceleme lahhezeboce hulu yatawasana gizee 'alelaacawe gizeeyaacawe bamathaa waqete 'aneditene sa`aate 'ayeqoyume; 'ayeqadamumeme>> balaacawe
<<qethaatu baleelite wayeme baqane bimathaabaacehu; 'agaariwocu karesu yamicaakolubate nagare menedene nawe negarunye>> balaacawe
<<kaziyaame (qethaatu) bawadaqa gizee ba'eresu 'amanaacehubatene ba'eregethe ba'eresu yametecaakolu yanabaraacehu setehonu 'ahune>> (yebaalaalu)
kaziyaame la'enaziyaa labadalute - <<zawetaarine qethaate qemasu teszarute yanabaracehutene waagaa 'eneji 'atemanadume>> yebaalaalu
'eresume <<'ewenate nawene>> (silu) yethayequhaale <<'awone; bageetaayee 'emelaalahu; 'eresu 'ewenate nawe 'enaanetame 'amelaachoce 'ayedalaacehume;>> balaacawe

labadalaceme nafese hulu bamedere laaye yaalawe hulu binoraate noro ba'eregethe batabazhacebate nabare qethaatuneme baayu gizee tsatsatene yegaletsaalu bamakaakalaacaweme batekekele yefaradaale 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
nequ! basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe nequ! ya'alaahe tasefaa qaale 'eregethe nawe gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
'eresu hheyaawe yaadaregaale; yegadelaaleme wada 'eresume temalasaalaacehu
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kageetaacehu gesaatsee badaratoce wesetheme laalawe (yamatharaathare bashetaa) madexaanite lame'emenaaneme berehaanenaa 'ezenate ba'eregethe mathaacelaacehu
<<ba'alaahe cerotaanaa ba'ezenatu (yedasatu) baziheme mekeneyaate yedasatu 'eresu kamisabasebute habete balaache nawe>> balaacawe

<<'alaahe kasisaaye la'enaaneta yaawaradawene ka'eresume 'eremenaa yatafaqada yaadaragaacehutene 'ayaacehune>> balaacawe <<'alaahe (yehenene) la'enaaneta faqadalaacehune wayese ba'alaahe laaye teqathaathefaalaacehu>> balaacawe

ya'enaziyaame ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamiqathaathefu (sawoce) bateneszaa'ee qane (ba'alaahe) therethaareeyaacawe menedene nawe ('ayeqathume yemaselaacawaalene) 'alaahe basawoce laaye (qethaatene baalamaacaakole) yalegesenaa baalabeete nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu 'ayaamasagenume

(muhhamade hoye!) bamaanenyaaweme nagare laaye 'atehoneme, karesume kaqure'aane 'ataanabeme, maanenyaaweneme szeraa ('anetame sawocume) 'ateszarume bagabaacehubate gizee banaaneta laaye tathabaabaaqiwoce benehone 'eneji bamedereme hona basamaaye yabenaanye kebedate yaakele kageetaahe (`eweqate) 'ayereqeme kaziyaame yaanasa yatalaqame yalame; bageletsu matsehhafe wesethe yatatsaafa bihone 'eneji
nequ! ya'alaahe wadaajoce ba'enasu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme; 'enasume 'ayaazenume
('enasume) 'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa yefarute yanabaru naacawe
la'enasu baqerebitu hheyewateme bamacharashaayetume beseraate 'alaacawe; ya'alaahe qaalaate malawathe yalaateme; yehe 'eresu taalaaqe `edele nawe
negegeraacaweme 'ayaasaazenehe xayele hulu bamulu ya'alaahe becaa nawenaa 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawe

nequ! basamaayaate yaalutenaa bamedereme yaalute hulu ba'eregethe ya'alaahe naacawe; 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa tagaariwocene yamitharu menene yekatalaalu therethaareene 'eneji leelaa 'ayekatalume 'enaresume yamiwaashu 'eneji 'ayedalume
'eresu yaa leelitene bawesethu letaarefubate (chalamaa); qaneneme (leteszarubate) berehaane yaadaragalaacehu nawe bazihe wesethe lamisamu hhezeboce ba'eregethe taameraatoce 'alu

<<'alaahe lejene yaaza (walada)>> 'alu (kamilute) theraate tagabaawe 'eresu tabeqaaqi nawe basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu yaresu nawe 'enaaneta zanede bazihe (bametelute) meneme 'aseraje yalaacehume ba'alaahe laaye yamaataawequtene tenaagaraalaacehune
<<'enaziyaa ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamiqathaathefu fatsemo 'ayedenume;>> balaacawe
('enasu) baqerebitu `aalame mathaqame 'alaacawe kaziyaame mamalashaacawe wada'enyaa nawe kaziyaame yekedu banabarute mekeneyaate beretune qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane

yanuhheneme waree ba'enasu laaye 'anebebelaacawe lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<hhezebocee hoye! ba'enaaneta wesethe bezu gizee maqoyatee ba'alaaheme ta`aameraate maasetaawasee ba'enaaneta laaye yakabada bihone; ba'alaahe laaye tathagecaalahu nagaraacehuneme kametaagaaruwaacawe (thaa`otaate) gaare honaacehu qurathu kaziyaame nagaraacehu ba'enaaneta laaye debeqe 'ayehune (gelatsute) kaziyaame (yashaacehutene) wada'enee 'aderesu gizeeme 'atesethunye (kameneme 'aleqotheraacehume) >>
<<beteshashume ('ategodunyeme) kamenedaa meneneme 'alelamenaacehumenaa menedaayee ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame kamuselimoce 'enedehoneme taazezhaalahu >>

'asetabaabaluteme 'eresunenaa ka'eresu gaare yanabaruteneme bataanekwaayetu wesethe 'adaanenaacawe (lathafute) metekoceme 'adaragenaacawe 'enaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalutene 'asathamene yatasefaraaruteme hhezeboce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekate

kaziyaame ka'eresu baxwaalaa maleketanyocene wadayahhezebocaacawe laakene bageletse maaserajaawoceme mathwacawe (kamalaakaacawe) bafite ba'eresu baasetabaabalubateme nagare; yamiyaamenu 'alehonume 'enedazihu bawasane 'alaafiwoce leboce laaye 'enaatemaalane
kaziyaame ka'enasu xwaalaa musaanenaa haarunene wada fare`onenaa wada mamaakeretu bata`aameraataacene laakene korume te`ebitanyoce hhezeboceme nabaru
ka'enyaame zanede 'ewenatu bamathaalaacawe gizee <<yehe ba'eregethe geletse degemete nawe>> 'alu
musaa 'ala - <<'ewenatune bamathaalaacehu gizee degemetanyoce yamaayedenu sikxonu ('eresu degemete nawe) telaalaacehune yehe degemete nawene>>

('enaresume) 'alu - <<'abaatocaacenene ba'eresu laaye kaaganyanebate haayemaanote letaazorane la'enaanetame bamedere wesethe kuraate (shumate) letenoraacehu mathaahebene 'enyaame la'enaaneta 'amaanyoce 'ayedalaneme >>
fare`oneme - <<`awaaqi degemetanyaane hulu 'amethulenye>> 'ala
degemetanyocume bamathu gizee musaa la'enaresu - <<'enaaneta yametethelutene nagare thaalu>> 'alaacawe
(gamadocaacawene) bathaalume gizee musaa 'ala - <<yaa baresu yamathaacehubate nagare degemete nawe 'alaahe ba'eregethe yaafaresawaale 'alaahe ya'athefiwocene szeraa fatsemo 'ayaabajemenaa >>
'alaaheme kahhaadiwoce bithalume 'ewenatene baqaalaatu yaaragaagethaale

lamusaame kafare`onenaa kashumaamenetocaacawe maasaqaayatene kamaferaate gaare kawaganocu yakxonu theqitoce teweledoce 'eneji 'alaamanulateme fare`oneme bamedere laaye ba'eregethe yakoraa nabare 'eresume ba'eregethe wasane kaalafute nabare
musaame 'ala - <<hhezebocee hoye! ba'alaahe 'amenaacehu 'eneda hona baresu laaye tathagu taazaazhoce 'eneda honaacehu (ba'alaahe laaye temakaalaacehu) >>
'alume - <<ba'alaahe laaye tathagaane geetaacene hoye! labadalanyoce hhezeboce mafatanyaa 'ataaderegane >>
ba'ezenateheme kakahhaadiwoce hhezeboce 'adenane
wada musaanaa wada wanedemu - <<lahhezebocaacehu bamesere beetocene szeru beetocaacehuneme masegajaa 'aderegu solaateneme badanebu segadu (lamusaa) me'emenaanocuneme 'abesere>> senele laakene

musaame 'ala - <<geetaacene hoye! 'aneta lafare`onenaa lashumocu baqerebitu hheyewate geethene bezu ganezaboceneme ba'eregethe sathahe geetaacene hoye! kamanegadehe yaasaasetu zanede (sathahaacawe) geetaacene hoye! ganezabocaacawene 'athefaa balebocaacaweme laaye 'ateme 'asaamaamine qethaate 'esekamiyaayu 'ayaamenumenaa >>
('alaaheme) <<tsalotaacehu ba'eregethe tasametaalace qatheme balu ya'enaziyaaneme yamaayaawequtene sawoce manegade 'atekatalu>> 'alaacawe

ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce baahherune 'asaalafenaacawe fare`onenaa saraawitume wasane lamaalafenaa lamabadale takatalwacawe masethameme baaganyawe gizee - <<'amaneku 'enaho kaziyaa ya'eseraa'eele lejoce baresu ka'amanubate basetaqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame 'eneeme kataazaazhocu nanye>> 'ala
ka'ahune bafite ba'eregethe yaamatseke ka'athefiwoceme yanabareke setehone 'ahune ('amaneku telaalahe)
zaareemaa kaxwaalaahe laalute ta`aamere tehone zanede badene honahe (kabaahheru) 'enaawathaahaalane (tabaala) kasawoceme bezuwocu kata`aameraataacene ba'eregethe zanegiwoce naacawe

ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce mesegunene seferaa ba'eregethe 'asafarenaacawe kamalekaame sisaayoceme sathanaacawe `eweqateme (qure'aane) 'esekamathaacawe derase 'aletalayaayume geetaahe baresu yelayaayubate banabarute nagare bateneszaa'ee qane bamakaakalaacawe yefaredaale

wada 'anetame kaawaradenawe bamatharaathare wesethe betehone 'enaziyaane ka'aneta bafite matsehhafune yamiyaanabutene thayeqe 'ewenatu kageetaahe zanede ba'eregethe mathetolehaale katatharaathaariwocume 'atehune
ka'enaziyaame ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce ka'asetabaabalute 'atehune kakasaariwocu tehonaalahenaa
'enaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye yageetaahe qaale yataragaagathabaacawe 'ayaamenume
ta`aamere hulu betemathaalaacaweme 'asaamaamine qethaate 'esekamiyaayu derase ('ayaamenume)

(kayunuse bafite kaalafute katamoce) yaamanacenaa 'emenatewaa yathaqamaate katamaa lamene 'alenoraceme gene yayunuse hhezeboce baamanu gizee baqerebitu hheyewate yaweredatene qethaate ka'enasu laaye 'anasaanelaacawe 'eseka gizeeme derase 'athaaqamenaacawe
geetaaheme bashaa noro bamedere yaalute sawoce hulume yatasabasabu honawe baamanu nabare taadiyaa 'aneta sawocene 'amaanyoce 'enedikxonu taasegadedaalahene
lamaanenyaawaame nafese ba'alaahe faqaade bihone 'eneji letaamene (celotaa) yalaateme ('alaahe lakafilocu 'emenatene yeshaale) ba'enaziyaame bamaayaawequte laaye rekesatene yaadaregaale
<<basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawene (ta`aamere) tamalekatu>> balaacawe ta`aameraatocenaa 'asefaraariwoceme lamaayaamenu hhezeboce 'ayethaqemume
ya'enaziyaane ka'enasu bafite yaalafutene hhezeboce qanoce bethee 'eneji leelaane yethabaabaqaalune <<tathabaabaqu; 'enee kanaaneta gaare kamithabaabaqute nanye>> balaacawe
kaziyaame maleketanyocaacenene 'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene 'enaadenaalane 'enedazihume me'emenaanene (kacheneqe hulu) 'enaadenaalane (yehe) ba'enyaa laaye taragaagatha

<<'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ka'enee haayemaanote bamatharaathare wesethe betehonu 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawene 'alegazaame gene yaanene yamigadelaacehune 'alaahene 'egazaalahu kame'emenaane 'enedehoneme taazezhaalahu>> balaacawe
fiteheneme (wada qathetaa) yaazanabaleke setehone lahaayemaanote qathe 'aderege ka'agaariwocume 'atehune
<<ka'alaaheme baqare yamaayethaqemenenaa yamaayegodaane 'ategazaa beteszaraame 'aneta yaanegizee kabadalanyocu tehonaalahe>> (tabeyaalahu balaacawe)

'alaaheme gudaatene biyaadaresebehe ka'eresu leelaa la'eresu galaache yalaweme bagoneme nagare bishaalehe lacerotaawe malaashe yalame kabaarocu yamishaawene ba'eresu yelayebataale 'eresume mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

<<'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'ewenatu kageetaacehu ba'eregethe mathaalaacehu (ba'eresu) yatamaraame sawe yamimaraawe laraasu nawe yatasaasaatame sawe yamisaasaatawe (gudaatu) baraasu laaye nawe 'eneeme ba'enaaneta laaye tathabaabaqi 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe
wadaanetame yamiwaradawene nagare takatale 'alaaheme (banasu laaye) 'esekamifarede derase taagase 'eresume kafaraajocu hulu balaache nawe
'a.la.ra ('alife laame raa; yehe qure'aane) 'aneqatsocu bathenekaaree yatasakaaku kaziyaame yatazarazaru yahona matsehhafe nawe thebabanyaa wesetha `awaaqi kahonawe zanede (yatawarada) nawe
('enedihe balaacawe) - <<'alaahene 'eneji leelaane 'ategazu 'enee la'enaaneta karesu (yatalaakehu) 'asefaraarinaa 'abesaari nanye >>

geetaacehuneme mehheratene lamenute kaziyaame wada'eresu tamalasu 'esekatawasana gizee derase malekaamene matheqame yethaqemaacexwaalenaa yaterufaateneme baalabeete hulu cerotaawene (menedaawene) yesathawaale beteshashume 'enee ba'enaaneta laaye yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahu
mamalashaacehu wada 'alaahe becaa nawe 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

nequ! 'enasu ka'eresu (ka'alaahe) yedabaqu zanede daratocaacawene yaathefaalu nequ! lebesocaacawene bamikanaanabu gizee yamidabequtene yamigaletsuteneme hulu yaaweqaale 'eresu badaratoce wesethe yaalawene hulu `awaaqi nawenaa
bamedereme laaye meneme taneqasaaqaashe yalaceme megebwa ba'alaahe laaye yaala bikxone 'eneji maarafiyaawaaneme maregiyaawaaneme yaaweqaale hulume geletse bahonawe matsehhafe wesethe nawe

'eresume yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene basedesete qanoce wesethe yafathara nawe `areshume bawehaa laaye nabare yatenyaacehu szeraawe yaamaara mahonune yefatenaacehu zanede (fatharaacawe) <<'enaaneta kamote baxwaalaa ba'eregethe taqaseqaashoce naacehu>> beteleme 'enaziyaa yakaadute yehe geletse degemete 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame yelaalu

qethaatuneme wada taqotharu (theqite) gizeeyaatoce ka'enaresu benaaqoyelaacawe <<(kamawerade) yamikalakelawe menedene nawe>> yelaalu nequ! bamimathaabaacawe qane ka'enasu laaye tamalaashe 'ayedalame ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabaruteme (qethaate) ba'enaresu laaye yewaredebaacawaale
saweneme ka'enyaa cerotaane benaaqamesawe kaziyaame karesu benewasedaate 'eresu ba'eregethe tasefaa qoraache kehedata beretu nawe
kaaganyaceweme cegere baxwaalaa tsagaawocene benaaqamesawe <<cegeroce kanee laaye ba'eregethe tawagadu>> yelaale ('ayaamasageneme) 'eresu tadasaace guranyaa nawenaa
gene 'enaziyaa yataagasu malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru 'enaziyaa la'enasu mehheratenaa taalaaqe menedaa 'alelaacawe

ba'eresu laaye yaganezabe delebe lamene 'aletawaradame wayeme karesu gaare male'ake lamene 'alemathaame maalataacaweneme bamaferaate wada 'aneta kamiwaredawe kafilune letetawe ba'eresume lebehe thabaabe likxone yefaraalehaale 'aneta 'asefaraari becaa nahe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu tathabaabaaqi nawe

yelequneme <<(qure'aanene) qathaathafawe>> yelaalune - <<'ewenatanyoce 'enedahonaacehu betheewe yahonune `asere yataqathaathafu suraawoce 'amethu ka'alaaheme leelaa yacaalaacehutene (radaate) theru>> balaacawe
la'enaanetame (theriwene) baayeqabalwacehu yatawaradawe ba'alaahe 'eweqate becaa mahonunenaa ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake 'alamanorune `ewaqu taadiyaa 'enaaneta yametesalemu naacehune (selamu balaacawe)
qerebitune hheyewatenaa geethwane yamishu yahonutene sawoce szeraawocaacawene (menedaawaane) ba'ereswa wesethe wadanasu 'enemolaalaacawaalane 'enasume bareswa wesethe meneme 'ayegodelebaacaweme;

'enaziyaa 'enaresu bamacharashaayetu `aalame la'enaresu ka'esaate baqare yaleelaacawe naacawe yaszaruteme szeraa bareswa wesethe tabalaasha (baqerebitu `aalame) yeszarute yanabaruteme bago szeraa beleshu nawe

kageetaawe ka'aseraje gaare yakxona sawe; ka'eresume (ka'alaahe) yakxona masekaari yamikatalawe, ka'eresu bafiteme yamusaa matsehhafe marinaa 'ezenate sikxone (yamasakaralate) yaqerebitune hheyewate 'enedamishaawe sawe nawene 'enaziyaa ba'eresu (baqure'aane) yaamenaalu ka'ahhezaabocume ba'eresu yamikede sawe 'esaate mamalashaawe naate ka'eresume bamatharaathare wesethe 'atehune 'eresu kageetaahe yahona 'ewenate nawe gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaamenume

ba'alaahe laaye 'ebelatene kamiqathaathefeme yebalethe badaaye maanawe 'enaziyaa bageetaacawe laaye yeqarebaalu masekaariwocume <<'enazihe bageetaacawe laaye yawaashute naacawe>> yelaalu nequ! ya'alaahe regemaane babadaayoce laaye yehune
('enasume) 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe manegade yamikalakelu mathemamwaneme yamifalegwaate naacawe 'enasume macharashaayetune `aalame 'enasu kahhaadiwoce naacawe;

'enaziyaa bamedere wesethe (ka'alaahe) yamiyaamalethu 'alenabarume ka'alaaheme leelaa la'enaresu radaatoce 'alenabarwacaweme la'enasu qethaatu yedaraarabelaacawaale ('ewenatene) masemaatene yamicelu 'alenabarume yamiyaayume 'alenabarume
'enaziyaa 'enaresu nafesocaacawene yaakasaru ka'enasume yeqathaathefute yanabarute nagare yathafaacawe naacawe
'enaresu bamacharashaayetu `aalame bathaame kasaariwocu 'enasu mahonaacawe therethere yalaweme
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa bago szeraawocene yaszarute wada geetaacaweme yatawaaradute 'enaziyaa yaganate sawoce naacawe 'enasu bawesethwa zalaalame zawetaariwoce naacawe
yahulatu kefeloce mesaalee 'eneda `ewerenaa 'eneda daneqoro 'enedamiyaayenaa 'enedamisamaame bethee nawe bamesaalee yetakaakalaalune 'ategasatsumene
nuhheneme wada hhezebocu ba'eregethe laakene ('alaacaweme) - <<'enee la'enaaneta geletse 'asefaraari ('asethaneqaaqi) nanye >>
<<'alaahene 'eneji leelaane 'ategazu 'enee ba'enaaneta laaye ya'asaamaamine qane qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahunaa >>

kahhezebocume 'enaziyaa yakaadute mariwocu betheeyaacene sawe honahe 'eneji 'anaayeheme 'enaziyaame 'enasu hhasaaba thereewoce yahonute waraadocaacene 'eneji leelaa takatelohe 'anaayeheme la'enaanetame ba'enyaa laaye meneme belechaane 'anaayeme katoweneme weshataamoce mahonaacehune 'enetharatheraacexwaalane 'alu

<<hhezebocee hoye! negarunye kageetaayee bageletse maaserajaa laaye behone ka'eresume zanede yahonane cerotaa (nabeyenate) bisathanyenaa ba'enaaneta laaye betedabaqebaacehu 'enaaneta larevwa thayewoce setehonu 'erevwane (bamaqabale) 'enaasegadedaacexwaalane>> 'alaacawe

<<hhezeboceeme hoye! baresu (batalaakehubate maaderase) laaye ganezabene 'alethayeqaacehume menedaayee ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame 'eneeme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene 'abaaraari 'ayedalahume 'enaresu geetaacawene yamiganaanyu naacawenaa gene 'eneeme yametesaasaatu hhezeboce honaacehu 'ayaacexwaalahu >>
<<hhezeboceeme hoye baabaareraacawe ka'alaahe (qethaate) yamiyaadenanye maane nawe 'ategasatsumene>>

<<la'enaanetame 'enee zanede ya'alaahe gemejaa beetoce 'alelu ruqeneme `aweqaalahu 'alelaacehume 'eneeme male'ake nanye 'alelaacehume la'enaziyaame `aayenocaacehu lamiyaawaaredwacawe 'alaahe dage nagarene ('emenatene) 'ayesathaacaweme 'aleleme 'alaahe banafesocaacawe wesethe yaalawene nagare 'awaaqi nawe 'enee yaane gizee kabadalanyoce 'ehonaalahunaa>> ('alaacawe)
<<nuhe hoye! ba'eregethe takaraakarekane 'enyaane makaraakareheneme 'abazaakxawe ka'ewenatanyocume 'enedahoneke yametaasefaraaraabenene qethaate 'amethaawe>> 'alu
<<'eresune yamiyaamathaabaacehu yashaa 'eneda hona 'alaahe becaa nawe 'enaanetame yametaaqetu 'ayedalaacehume>> 'alaacawe
<<la'enaanetame lemakeraacehu beshaa 'alaahe liyaathamaacehu sheto 'eneda kxona mekeree 'ayethaqemaacehume 'eresu geetaacehu nawe wada 'eresume temalasaalaacehu>> ('alaacawe)
<<yelequneme qathafawe yelaalune beqathefawe xaathi'aatee (qethaatu) banee laaye nawe 'eneeme kametaathafute (thefaate) netsuhhe nanye>> balaacawe
wada nuhheme 'enaho <<kahhezebocehe ba'eregethe kaamanute basetaqare (wadafite) 'ayaamenume yeszaruteme banabarute (kehedate) 'atezane maalate tawarada >>
('alaaheme) <<bathebaqaacenenaa bate'ezaazaaceneme honahe marekabitune szeraa ba'enaziyaame babadalute sawoce nagare 'ataanaageranye 'enasu ba'eregethe samaachoce naacawenaa>> ('alawe)

kawaganocume mariwocu ba'eresu 'athagabe baalafu quthere ka'eresu 'eyatasaalaqu marekabitune yeszaraale <<ka'enyaa betesaalaqu 'enyaame 'enedatasaalaqaacehubene kanaaneta 'enesaalaqebaacexwaalane>> 'alaacawe
<<yamiyaawaaredawe qethaate yamimathaabatene ba'eresume laaye zawetaari qethaate yamisaferebate sawe (maane 'eneda hona) wadafite taaweqaalaacehu>> ('alaacawe)

te'ezaazaaceneme bamathaanaa 'etonume baganafala gizee <<ba'ereswa wesethe kaya`aayenatu hulu hulate hulate (wanedenaa seete); beetasaboceheneme qaale yaalafabate becaa siqare yaamananeme sawe hulu chaane>> 'alenawe ka'eresume gaare theqitoce 'eneji 'alaamanume
<<maheedwame maqomwame ba'alaahe seme nawe 'eyaalaacehume bawesethwa tasaafaru geetaa mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa>> 'alaacawe

'ereswame 'eneda taraaraawoce bahona maa`ebale wesethe ba'enaresu (yezaacawe) yameteneshaalale setehone (ba'alaahe seme taqamathubaate) nuhheme lejune kamarekabitu yaraaqa hono saala <<lejee hoye! kanyaa gaare tasaafare kakahhaadiwocume 'atehune>> sile tharaawe

(lejume) <<kawehaawe wadamithabeqanye taraaraa 'ethagaalahu>> 'ala ('abaatume) - <<zaaree ka'alaahe te`ezaaze meneme thabaaqi yalame ('eresu) yaazanalate kaalehona baqare>> 'alawe maa`ebalume bamakaakalaacawe gaarada kasathaamiwocume hona

tabaalame - <<medere hoye! wehaashene waachi samaayeme hoye (zenaabeshene) yaazhi wehaaweme saraga qethaatume tafatsame judiye bamibaaleme taraaraa laaye (marekabitu) tadalaadalace lakahhaadiwoceme sawoce thefaate tagabaacawe (thafu)>> tabaala
nuhheme geetaawene tharaa 'alame <<geetaayee hoye! lejee kabeetasabee nawe kidaaneheme 'ewenate nawe 'anetame kafaraajoce hulu yebalethe `awaaqi nahe >>

('alaaheme) <<nuhhe hoye! 'eresu kabeetasabehe 'ayedalame; 'eresu malekaame yaalehona szeraa nawe; baresu `eweqate yaleelaheneme nagare 'atethayeqanye; 'enee kamisaasaatute sawoce 'enedaatehone 'egasetsehalahu>> 'ala
<<geetaayee hoye! ba'eresu la'enee `eweqate yaleelanyene nagare yamethayeqehe kamahone 'enee baaneta 'ethabaqaalahu la'eneeme baatemeranyenaa baataazenelenye kakasaariwocu 'ehonaalahu>> 'ala

<<nuhhe hoye! ka'enyaa bahona salaame baaneta laayenaa 'anetame gaare baalute hhezeboce (tewelede) laaye bahonu barakatoceme yatagonaatsafeke honahe werade (ka'enasuwe zaroce yahonu) hhezeboceme baqerebitu `aalame ba'eregethe 'enaasemacaacawaalane kaziyaame kanyaa yahona 'asaamaami qethaate yenakaacawaale>> tabaala
yeheci karuqu wareewoce naate wada 'aneta 'enaawaredaataalane 'anetame hhezeboceheme kazihe bafite yametaaweqwaate 'alenabaraacehume taagaseme; mesegune yahonacewe fetsaamee lamithanaqaqute naatenaa
wada `aademe wanedemaacawene hudene (laakene) 'alaacawe - <<waganocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume 'enaanetame qathaafiwoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume
<<hhezebocee hoye! ba'eresu (bamaaderasee) laaye menedaane 'alethayeqaacehume menedaayee bazihe bafatharanye laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame 'ataawequmene

<<hhezeboceeme hoye! geetaacehune mehheratene lamenute kaziyaame wadaresu tatsatsatu zenaabene ba'enaaneta laaye takataataaye 'aderego yelekelaacexwaalenaa wada xaayelaacehume xaayelene yechamerelaacexwaale 'amatsanyoceme honaacehu 'atesheshu >>
'alu - <<hude hoye! ba'aseraje 'alemathaaheleneme 'enyaame laaneta negegere belane 'amaaleketocaacenene yamenetawe 'ayedalaneme 'enyaame la'aneta 'amaanyoce 'ayedalaneme

<<kafilocu 'amaaleketocaacene bakefu nagare (ba`ebedate) lakefawehaale 'eneji leelaane 'aneleme>> ('alu) <<'enee 'alaahene 'asemasakeraalahu kametaagaaruteme 'enee netsuhhe mahoneene masekeru>> 'alaacawe
ka'eresu leelaa ('amaaleketene kametaagaarute netsuhe nanye) hulaacehume honaacehu tanekolene szerubenye; kaziyaame 'ataaqoyunye

<<'enee bageetaayeenaa bageetaacehu ba'alaahe laaye tathagaahu bamedere laaye meneme taneqasaaqaashe yalaceme 'eresu 'anaatewaane yayaazaate betehone 'eneji geetaayee (qaalume szeraaweme) baqathetanyaawe manegade laaye nawe>> ('alaacawe)

<<betezorume ba'eresu wada'enaaneta yatalaakehubatene nagare ba'eregethe 'aderesheelaacexwaalahu geetaayee ka'enaaneta leelaa hhezebeme yetakaale meneme 'ategodutememe geetaayee banagaru hulu laaye tathabaabaaqi nawenaa>> ('alaacawe)
te`ezaazaaceneme bamathaa gizee hudenenaa 'enaziyaane ka'esu gaare yaamanutene ka'enyaa bahonawe cerotaa 'adaane kaberetu qethaateme 'adaanaacawe
yehece (nagade) `aade naate bageetaacawe taameraate kaadu maleketanyocuneme 'amatsu; yaxaayaale mogadanyaane hulu te`ezaazeme takatalu

bazihece baqerebitu `aalameme 'eregemaane 'enedikatalaacawe tadaragu bateneszaa'eeme qane ('enedazihu) nequ! `aadoce geetaacawene kaadu nequ! yahude hhezeboce lahonute `aadoce (ka'ezenate) maraaqe yegabaacawe

wada samudoceme wanedemaacawene swalihene (laakene) <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa la'enaaneta 'amelaake yalaacehume 'eresu kamedere fatharaacehu bawesethwa 'enedetaalamwateme 'adaragaacehu mehheratuneme lamenute kaziheme wada'eresu tamalasu geetaayee qerebe (lalamanawe) taqabaaye nawenaa>> 'alaacawe

<<swalihe hoye! kazihe bafite ba'enyaa wesethe (mari letehone) ba'eregethe yametekajele nabareke 'abaatocaacene yamigazutene kamagazaate tekalakelanaalahene 'enyaame wadaresu kametetharaane nagare ba'eregethe 'awalaawaaye bahona matharaathare wesethe nane>> 'alu

<<hhezebocee hoye! negarunye kageetaayee bahona maaserajaa laaye behone ka'eresume yahonane cerotaa (nabiyenate) bisathanyenaa baaletaazazawe ka'alaahe (qethaate) yamiyaadenanye maanawe kamaasaasaateme basetaqare meneme 'atechamerulenyeme>> 'alaacawe

hhezeboceeme hoye! yeheci la'enaaneta ta`aamere setehone ya'alaahe gemale naate tawewaateme ba'alaahe medere wesethe tebelaa bakefume 'atenekwaate qerebe yahona qethaate yeyezaacexwaalenaa>> ('alaacawe)
wagetawe gadalwateme (swalihe) <<ba'agaraacehume sosetene qanaate (becaa) tathaqamu yehe yamaayewaashe qatharo nawe>> 'alaacawe

te`ezaazaaceneme bamathaa gizee swalihenenaa 'enaziyaane kasu gaare yaamanutene ka'enyaa bahonawe 'ezenate 'adaane kaziyaame qane weredate ('adaanenaacawe) geetaahe 'eresu beretuwe 'ashanaafiwe nawenaa
'enaziyaaneme yabadalutene chukxate yaazaacawe babeetocaacaweme wesethe yatanebarakaku honawe motawe 'anagu
ba'eswa wesethe 'enedaalenorubaate honu nequ! samudoce geetaacawene ba'eregethe kaadu nequ! lasamudoce (ka'alaahe 'ezenate) maraaqe tagabaacawe
maleketanyocaaceneme beraahimene ba(leje) beseraate ba'eregethe mathute salaame 'alute salaame 'alaacawe theqiteme saayeqoye wadiyaawenu yatathabasane yawayefane segaa 'amathaa
'ejocaacaweme wada 'eresu yamaayedaresu makxonacawene baaya gizee shashaacawe kanasume ferehaate tasamaawe <<'ateferaa 'enyaa wada luthe hhezeboce talekanaalenaa>> 'alute
misetume yaqomace setekxone ('ateferaa 'alute) saaqaceme basehhaqeme 'abasarenaate kasehhaqeme baxwaalaa (baleju) bayaa`eqube ('abasarenaate)
('ereswame) waalenye! 'enee 'arogite yeheme baalee shemaagelee hono saala 'ewaledaalahune yehe ba'eregethe 'asedanaaqi nagare nawe 'alace
<<ka'alaahe te`ezaaze tedanaqiyaalashene ya'alaahe cerotaanaa barakatocu ba'enaaneta baberaahime beetasaboce laaye yehune 'eresu mesegune lagaase nawenaa>> 'alu
kaberaahime feraacaawe baleedalatenaa beseraate bamathaacelateme gizee baluthe hhezeboce (nagare) yekaraakarane jamare
beraahime ba'eregethe taagaashe 'aleqaashaa malaasaa nawenaa
<<beraahime hoye! kazihe (kerekere) tawe 'enaho yageetaahe te`ezaaze ba'eregethe mathetwale 'enasume yamaayemalase qethaate yamimathaabaacawe naacawe>> ('alute)
maleketanyocaaceneme luthene bamathute gizee banasu (mekeneyaate) 'azana lebume banasu tachanaqa <<yehe beretu qane naweme>> 'ala

hhezebocume wadaresu 'eyatathaadafu mathute kaziheme bafite mathefo szeraawocene yeszaru nabare <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enyehe seetoce lejocee naacawe 'enasu la'enaaneta yeleqe bathaame yatsadu naacawe; ('agebwacawe) 'alaaheneme feru ba'enegedoceeme 'ataasaaferunye ka'enaaneta wesethe qene sawe yalamene>> 'alaacawe
<<kaseetoce lejocehe la'enyaa meneme gudaaye yalaneme 'anetame yameneshaawene ba'eregethe taaweqaalahe>> 'alute
<<ba'enaaneta laaye lanee xayele banoranye wayeme wada beretu wagane bethagaa noro (yameszaraawene baszaraahu nabare)>> 'alaacawe

<<luthe hoye! 'enyaa yageetaahe maleketanyoce nane (hhezebocehe) wada 'aneta (bakefu) 'ayedaresubeheme beetasabeheneme yezahe kaleelitu bakafilu wesethe lide ka'enaanetame 'anedeme (wadaxwaalaawe) 'ayegalaamathe misetehe becaa seteqare 'enaho 'ereswane ('enasune) yamiyaaganyaacawe seqaaye yaaganyaataalenaa qatharwacawe 'enegaatu laaye nawe negaatu qerebe 'ayedalamene>> 'alute
82|te`ezaazaaceneme bamathaa gizee (katamaayetune) laayewaane kataacewaa 'adaragene (galabathenaate) takataataayeme yahonane yashakelaa denegaaye bareswa laaye 'azanabene
kageetaahe zanede melekete yatadaragabaate setehone ('azanabenaate) 'ereswame kabadalanyocu ruqe 'ayedalaceme

wada madeyaneme wanedemaacawene shu`ayebene (laakene) 'alaacawe <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa lanaaneta 'amelaake yalaacehume seferenenaa mizaaneneme 'ataagudelu; 'enee batsagaa laaye honaacehu 'ayaacexwaalahu 'eneeme ba'enaaneta laaye yakabaabine qane qethaate 'efaraalahu
<<hhezeboceeme hoye! seferenenaa mizaanene batekekele mulu sawoceneme meneme nagaraacawene 'ataagudelubaacawe bamedereme wesethe 'athefiwoce honaacehu 'ataabalaashu
'alaahe yaaseqaralaacehu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe me'emanaane 'enedahonaacehu ('alaahe basathaacehu wedadu) 'eneeme (makaari 'eneje) banaaneta laaye tathabaabaaqi 'ayedalahume >>

<<shu`ayebe hoye! segedatehe 'abaatocaacene yamigazutene thaa`otaate 'enedenetawe wayeme baganezabocaacene yameneshaawene maszeraatene ('enedenetawe) taazehaalacene 'aneta ba'eregethe taagaashu qenu 'aneta nahenaa>> 'alute

<<hhezebocee hoye! negarunye; kageetaayee bahona 'aseraje laaye behonenaa ka'eresume yahonane malekaame sisaaye bisathanye (baqethefate leqalaaqelawe yegabaalene) ka'eresu wada kalakalekwaacehume nagare lelayaacehu 'aleshaame batacaalanye yaakele maabajatene 'eneji 'aleshaame (ladage szeraa) magathameeme ba'alaahe 'eneji baleelaa 'ayedalame ba'eresu laaye tamakaahu wada'eresume 'emalasaalahu;>> 'alaacawe

<<waganoceeme hoye! 'eneene makaraakaraacehu yanuhhene hhezeboce wayeme yahudene hhezeboce wayeme yaswalihhene hhezeboce yaaganyaacawe (qethaate) bethee 'enediyaaganyaacehu 'ayegafaafaacehu yalutheme hhezeboce ka'enaaneta ruqe 'ayedalume
<<geetaacehuneme mehheratene lamenute kaziyaame wadaresu tamalasu geetaayee 'azaanye wadaade nawenaa ('alaacawe)

<<shu`ayebe hoye! kametelawe nagare bezuwene 'anaaweqaweme 'enyaame 'anetane ba'enyaa wesethe dakaamaa honahe 'enaayehaalane gosaawoceheme baalenoru noro bawagarenehe nabare; 'anetame ba'enyaa laaye yatakabareke 'ayedalaheme>> 'alute

<<hhezebocee hoye! gosaawocee ba'enaaneta laaye ka'alaahe yeleqe yakabaru naacawene ('alaahene) kaxwaalaacehu wada jarebaa 'aderegaacehume yaazaacehute geetaayee bameteszarute hulu kabaabi nawe>> 'alaacawe

<<hhezeboceeme hoye! bacelotaacehu leke szeru 'enee szari nanyenaa yamiyaawaaredawe qethaate yamimathaabatenaa 'eresu weshataame yahonawe maane 'enedakxona wada fite taaweqaalaacehu thabequme 'enee kanaaneta gaare tathabaabaaqi nanyenaa>>('alaacawe)

te`ezaazaaceneme bamathaa gizee shu`ayebenenaa 'enaziyaane karesu gaare yaamanutene ka'enyaa bahonawe cerotaa 'adaane 'enaziyaane yabadaluteneme (yajiberile) chukxate yaazacaacawe babeetocaacaweme wesethe tanekafererawe 'adaru
ba'ereswa wesethe 'enedaalenabaru honu nequ! samude (ka'alaahe 'ezenate) 'eneda raaqace madeyaneme teraaqe
musaaneme bata`aameraataacenenaa bageletse berehaane ba'eregethe laakenawe
wada fare`onenaa wada sawocu (laakenawe) yafare`oneneme nagare (hhezebocu) takatalu yafare`one nagareme qathetanyaa 'alenabarame
bateneszaa'ee qane hhezebocune yeqademaale wada 'esaateme yaawaredaacawaale yamigabuteme 'agabaabe menenyaa kafaa!
baziceme (baqerebitu `aalame) 'eregemaanene 'asekatalenaacawe bateneszaa'eeme qane ('enedazihu) yatasathute sethotaa menenyaa kafaa!
yehe (yatanagarawe) kakatamocu wareewoce nawe baaneta laaye 'enetarekawaalane ka'ereswa faanaawe yaqaranaa mulu bamulu yatadamasasa 'ala

'enyaame 'alebadalenaacaweme gene nafesocaacawene badalu ya'alaaheme te'ezaaze bamathaa gizee 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yamigazuwaacawe 'amaaleketocaacawe bameneme 'alaadaanwacaweme kamaakesareme baqare meneme 'alechamarulaacaweme
yageetaaheme qethaate yakatamocene sawoce 'enasu badaayoce sihonu baqathaacawe gizee 'enedazihe nawe qethaatu ba'eregethe 'asaamaami beretu nawe
bazihe wesethe yamacharashaawene qane qethaate lamifaru hulu magasachaa 'ala yehe (yateneszaa'ee qane) sawoce baresu yamisabasabubate qane nawe yeheme yamithaadute qane nawe
(yehenene qane) lataqotharame gizee 'eneji 'anaaqoyaweme
bamimathaa qane maanenyaawaame nafese ba'eresu faqaade bihone 'eneji 'atenaagareme kanasume manaathinaa `edelanyaame 'alela
'enaziyaa manaathi yahonutemaa ba'esaate wesethe naacawe la'enaresu ba'ereswa wesethe maanaafaatenaa manesaqesaqe 'alaacawe
geetaahe kashaawe (chemaaree) leelaa samaayaatenaa medere 'eseka zawataru derase bawesethwa zawetariwoce sikxonu (ba'esaate yenoraalu) geetaahe yamishaawene szari nawenaa

'enaziyaame `edelanyocumaa geetaahe kashaawe (chemaaree) leelaa samaayaatenaa medere 'eseka zawataru derase bawesethwa zawetaariwoce kxonawe baganate wesethe yenoraalu yamaayeqwaarathe sethotaane tasathu

'enazihe (kahhaadiwoce) kamigazute thaa`ote bamatharaathare wesethe 'atehune; 'abaatocaacawe kazihe bafite 'enedamigegazute 'eneji 'ayegegazume 'enyaame ('enazihene) fanetaacawene yamaayegwaadale sihone yamenemolaalaacawe nane

lamusaame matsehhafene ba'eregethe sathanawe ba'eresume talayaayubate kageetaaheme yaalaface qaale baalenabarace noro bamakaakalaacawe ('ahune) yefarade nabare 'enasume ka'eresu (kaqure'aane) 'awalaawaaye bahona matharaathare wesethe naacawe
huluneme geetaahe szeraawocaacawene (menedaacawene) ba'eregethe yemolaalaacawaale 'eresu bamiszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawenaa
'eneda taazazekaweme qathe bale ka'aneta gaare yaamanuteme (qathe yebalu) wasaneneme 'atelafu; 'eresu yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawenaa
wada'enaziyaame wada badalute 'atethagu 'esaate tenakaacexwaalacenaa ka'alaaheme leelaa thabaaqiwoce yalwacehume kaziyaame 'ateradedume
solaateneme baqane chaafoce kaleeliteme kefeloce fatseme malekaame szeraawoce xathi'atocene yaasewagadedaalunaa yehe latagasaachoce gesaatsee nawe
taagaseme; 'alaahe yabago szariwocene menedaa 'ayaathafaamenaa

ka'enaanetame bafite kanabarute kakefela zamanaate sawoce wesethe bamedere laaye kamaabalaashate yamikalakelu yamalekaame qari szeraawoce baalabeetoce lamene 'alenabarume gene ka'enasu yaadaanenaacawe theqitocu (kalakalunaa daanu) 'enaziyaame yabadalute sawoce ('alekalakalume) ba'eresu yataqamaathalubatene tadelaa takatalu 'amatsanyoceme nabaru
geetaaheme katamocene baalabeetocaacawe malekaame szariwoce honawe saalu bamabadale yamiyaathafaacawe 'alenabarame
geetaaheme bashaa noro sawocene hulu 'anede hhezebe baadaragaacawe nabare yatalayaayume kamahone 'ayewagadume
geetaahe yaazanalate becaa siqare; (kamalayaayate 'ayewagadume) lazihume fatharaacawe yageetaaheme qaale gahanamene ka'agaanenetenaa kasawoce kahulume ba'eregethe 'emolaataalahu bamaalate tafatsamace

kamaleketanyocume zeenaawoce (tafalaagiwene) huluneme lebehene baresu yamenaarakaabatene 'enetarekelehaalane baziheceme (suraa) 'ewenatu nagare lame'emenaane gesaatseenaa maasetaawashaa mathetolehaale
la'enaziyaame lamaayaamenute baalaacehubate huneetaa laaye szeru; 'enyaa szariwoce nanenaa balaacawe
tathabaabaqume 'enyaa tathabaabaaqiwoce nanenaa (balaacawe)
basamaayaatenaa bamedereme yaalawe mesethire hulu ya'alaahe nawe nagaru hulume wadaresu yemalasaale selazihe tagazaawe ba'eresume laaye tathagaa geetaaheme kamiszarute hulu zanegi 'ayedalame
'a.la.ra ('alife laame raa) 'enazihe yagalaachu matsehhafe 'aneqatsoce naacawe
'enyaa (fecune) taawequ zanede `arabenyaa qure'aane sihone ba'eregethe 'awaradenawe

'enyaa yehenene qure'aane wada 'aneta bamaaweradaacene bathaame malekaame zeenaawocene ba'aneta laaye 'enetarekelehaalane 'enaho ka'eresu bafite (kaalafute hhezeboce taarike) ba'eregethe kazanegiwocu nabareke
yusufe la'abaatu - <<'abaatee hoye! 'enee `aseraa 'anede kawaakebetene tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme (bahhelemee) 'ayahu la'enee sagaajoce honawe 'ayaxwaacawe>> baala gizee ('asetaawese)
('abaatume) 'ala <<lejee hoye! hhelemehene lawanedemocehe 'ataaweraa laaneta tanekolene yesarubehaalenaa sayethaane lasawe geletse thalaate nawenaa >>

<<'enedazihume ('enedaayakxawe) geetaahe yemarethehaale kanegegeroceme fece yaasetamerehaale tsagaaweneme ka'ahune bafite bahulatu 'abaatocehe baberaahimenaa basehhaqe laaye 'enedaamwalaate ba'aneta laayenaa bayaa`eqobe zaroceme laaye yemolaataale geetaahe `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa >>
bayusufenaa bawanedemocu (taarikoce) wesethe lathayaaqiwoce hulu ba'eregethe 'asedanaaqi meleketoce nabaru
(wanedemocu) baalu gizee ('asetaawese) <<'enyaa cheferoce senehone yusufenaa wanedemu (beneyaame) wada 'abaataacene ka'enyaa yebalethe yatawadadu naacawe 'abaataacene bageletse sehetate wesethe nawe
<<yusufene gedalu wayeme ba(ruqe) medere laaye thaalute yaabaataacehu fite la'enaaneta yagele yekxonaalenaa ka'eresume baxwaalaa malekaame hhezeboce tehonaalaacehunaa>> (tabaabaalu)
ka'enasu 'anede tanaagaari <<yusufene 'ategedalu gene bagudegwaade 'azaqete chalamaa wesethe thaalute; katagwaazhiwoce 'anedu yaanasaawaalenaa szariwoce betekxonu (bazihu tabeqaaqu) 'alaacawe
('enasume) 'alu <<'abaataacene hoye! bayusufe laaye lamene 'ataamenaneme 'enyaame la'eresu ba'eregethe 'azaanyoce nane >>
<<naga ka'enyaa gaare laakawenaa yedasate; yechaawateme 'enyaame la'eresu thabaaqiwoce nane >>
<<'enee 'eresune (yusufene) yezaacehu maleedaacehu ba'eregethe yaasaazenanyaale 'enaanetame ka'eresu zanegiwoce setehonu takulaa yebalaawaale beyee 'efaraalahu>> 'alaacawe
<<'enyaa cheferaawoce honane saalane takulaa bibalaawemaa 'enyaa yaane gizee ba'eregethe kasaariwoce nane>> 'alute

'eresuneme yezawete baleedunaa bagudegwaadu chalamaa 'azaqete wesethe 'enediyaadaregute baqorathu gizee (hhasaabaacawene fatsamubate) wada'eresume 'enasu yamaayaawequ sihonu yehenene szeraacawene ba'eregethe tenageraacawaalahe senele laakenebate
'abaataacaweneme bameshete 'eyaalaqasu mathute

<<'abaataacene hoye! 'enyaa (laruchaanaa lawerewaraa) lenesheqadaadame leedene yusufeneme `eqaacene zanede tawenawe wadiyaaweme takulaa balaawe 'anetame 'ewenatanyoce benehoneme yametaamenane 'ayedalaheme>> 'alu

baqamisume laaye yaweshatene dame 'amathu ('abaataacawe) <<'ayedalame; nafesocaacehu (weshate) nagarene la'enaaneta shalamulaacehu selazihe malekaame te`egesete (maaderage 'alabenye) bameteluteme nagare laaye mataagazhaawe 'alaahe becaa nawe>> 'ala

manegadanyoceme mathu wehaa qajiyaacaweneme laaku 'akoliweneme (wada gudegwaadu) sadada <<yameseraace! yehe wathaate leje nawe>> 'ala shaqathe 'aderegaweme dabaqute 'alaaheme yamiszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe
barekaashe waagaame bamiqotharu direhaamoce shathute ba'eresume kacaletanyocu nabaru

yaame kamesere yagazaawe sawe lamisetu <<manoriyaawene 'akeberi lithaqemane wayeme leje 'aderegane leneyezawe yekajalaalenaa>> 'alaate 'enedazihume layusufe (gazhe lenaadaregawenaa) yahhelemoceneme fece lenaasetamerawe bamedere laaye 'asemacanawe 'alaaheme banagaru laaye 'ashanaafi nawe; gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
thenekaareeweneme badarasa gizee thebabenenaa `eweqatene sathanawe 'enedazihume malekaame szariwocene hulu 'enemanadaalane

yaacime 'eresu babeetwa yanabarabaate seete kanafesu 'abaabalacewe dajaafocuneme zagaace; <<laaneta tazagaajeceelehaalahunaa tolo naame>> 'alacewe <<ba'alaahe 'ethabaqaalahu 'eresu (yagazaanye) geetaayee nuroyeene yaasaamaralenye nawenaa; ('alekadaaweme) 'enaho! badalanyoce 'ayedenume>> 'alaate

ba'eresume ba'eregethe 'asabace ba'ereswame 'asaba; yageetaawene maaserajaa baalaaya noro (yatafathero felaagotune baarakaa nabare;) 'enedazihu mathefo nagarenenaa xathi'atene ka'eresu laaye lenemaleselate ('aserajaacenene 'asaayanawe) 'eresu katamarathute baarocaacene nawenaa

baruneme tasheqadaadamu qamisuneme kabasetaxwaalaawe qadadacewe geetaawaaneme (baalabeetwane) 'ebaru 'athagabe 'aganyute (qadame belaa) <<babaalabeetehe mathefone yaasaba sawe qethaatu mataasare wayeme 'asaamaami seqaaye 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alacewe
(yusufeme) <<'ereswa kanafesee 'abaabalacenye>> 'ala kabeetasabocwame masekaari ('enedihe sile) masakara <<qamisu kabasetafite taqadedo 'enedahona 'ewenate tanaagarace 'eresume kaweshataamocu nawe
<<qamisume kabasetaxwaalaa taqadedo 'enedahona waashace 'eresume ka'ewenatanyocu nawe >>
qamisuneme kabasetaxwaalaa taqadedo baaya gizee <<'eresu (yatanaagareshiwe) katanekolaacehu nawe (seetoce) tanekolaacehu ba'eregethe beretu nawenaa>> 'alaate
<<yusufe hoye! kazihe (waree) takalekale laxaathi'atesheme maaretaane lamenyi 'aneci kasehetatanyocu honashaalenaa>> ('ala)

bakatamaawe yaalu seetoceme <<ya`azize misete belaateenaawaane kanafesu taabaabelawaalace ba'ewenatu feqeru lebwane matwataale 'enyaa bageletse sehetate wesethe honaa ba'eregethe 'enaayaataalane>> 'alu

hameetaacaweneme basamaace gizee wadanasu laakacebaacawe megebeneme la'enaresu 'azagaajacelaacawe ka'enasu layaanedaanedaacaweme bilaawaane sathace ba'enasume laaye <<wethaa>> 'alacewe baayuteme gizee 'adanaqute 'ejocaacaweneme qorathu 'alaaheme theraate yegabaawe yehe sawe 'ayedalame yehe yaamaara male'ake 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame 'alu
<<taadiyaa yehe yaa baresu (feqere) yazalafaacehunye nawe ba'eregetheme kanafesu 'abaabalekute 'emebi 'alame yamaazaweneme nagare baayeszaraa ba'eregethe yetaasaraale kawaraadocume yehonaale>> 'alace

<<geetaayee hoye! wadaresu kamitharunye nagare (kazemute) yeleqe mataasare la'enee yatawadada nawe tanekolaacaweneme ka'enee laaye baatemaleselenye wadanasu 'ezanabalaalahu kasehetatanyocume 'ehonaalahu>> 'ala
geetaaweme tsalotune taqabalawe tanekolaacaweneme ka'eresu malasalate 'enaho! 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa
kaziyaame maaserajaawocune kaayu baxwaalaa 'esekagizee derase 'enediyaaserute lanasu taayaacawe

ka'esume gaare hulate gobazoce 'esere beetu gabu 'anedanyaacawe <<'enee bahelemee yawayene thajene sethameqe 'ayahu>> 'ala leelaaweme - <<'enee baraasee laaye 'enejaraane tashakemee ka'esu baraari ('amoraa) setebalaa 'ayahu fecune negarane 'enyaa ka'asaamaariwoce honahe 'enaayehaalanenaa>> 'alute

(yusufeme) 'ala - <<maanenyaaweme yametesesathute megebe lanaaneta kamamethaatu bafite fecune yamenageraacehu bihone 'eneji 'ayemathaalaacehume yekxa geetaayee kaasaawaqanye nagare nawe; 'enee ba'alaahe yamaayaamenune 'enaresume macharashaayetune `aalame 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce yahonutene hhezeboce haayemaanote tecaalahu

<<ya'abaatoceeneme yaberaahimenenaa yasehhaqene, yayaa`eqobeneme haayemaanote takateyaalahu la'enyaa ba'alaahe meneneme maagaaraate 'ayegabaaneme yaa ('alamaagaaraate) ba'enyaa laayenaa basawocu laaye ya'alaahe cerotaa nawe gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaamasagenume
<<ya'esere beete gwaadanyocee hoye! yatalayaayu 'amelaakoce yeshaalaalune wayese 'ashanaafiwe 'anedu 'alaahe

<<ka'eresu leelaa 'enaanetanaa 'abaatocaacehu ('amaalekete belaacehu) yatharaacexwaacawene semoce 'eneje 'ategazezume 'alaahe ba'ereswa meneme 'aseraje 'alaawaradame feredu ya'alaahe 'eneje yaleelaa 'ayedalame 'eresune 'eneje leelaane 'enedaategazu 'azwale yehe tekekelanyaawe haayemaanote nawe gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaawequme

<<yawaheni beete gwaadanyocee hoye! 'anedanyaacehumaa geetaawene (neguszune) thaje yaathathaale leelaawemaa yesaqalaale karaasume baraari ('amoraa) tebalaalace yaa fecune yametethayequte nagare tafatsama;>> ('alaacawe)

laziyaame kahulatu 'eresu yamidene mahonune latatharaatharawe 'egeetaahe zanede 'asetaawesanye 'alawe geetaaweneme kamaasetaawase sayethaane 'aserasaawe latheqite `aamataateme bawaheni beetu wesethe qoya

neguszume <<'enee sabaatene yasabu laamoce sabaate kasitaawoce sibalwacawe sabaateneme lamelame zalalaawoce leeloceneme daraqocene (sithamathamubaacawe bahhelemee) 'ayaalahu 'enaaneta taalaalaaqe sawoce hoye! hhelemene yametefatu 'enedahonaacehu hhelemeene fetulenye>> 'alaacawe
<<yahhelemoce qezhatoce naacawe 'enyaame yahhelemocene fece `awaaqiwoce 'ayedalaneme>> 'alute
yaame kahulatu yadaanawenaa kabezu gizee baxwaalaa (yusufene) yaasetaawasawe sawe <<'enee fecune 'enageraacexwaalahunaa laakunye>> 'ala; (wada yusufe leedame)

<<'aneta 'ewenatanyaawe yusufe hoye! sabaatene yasabu laamoce sabaate kasitaawoce laamoce sibaluwaacawe sabaatene lamelame zalalaawoceme leeloceneme daraqoce (banasu laaye sithamathamubaacawe yaayane sawe hheleme fece) tacelene yaawequ zanede wada sawocu lemalase 'ekajelaalahunaa>> ('alawe)
('eresume) 'ala - <<sabaatene yatakataatalu `aamataate tezaraalaacehu yaachadaacehuteneme hulu kametebalute theqite basetaqare bazalalaawe wesethe tawute
<<kaziyaame ka'enaziyaa baxwaalaa kaadalabaacehute theqite siqare la'enasu yaadalabaacehutene hulu yamibalu sabaate yacegere `aamataate yemathaalu
<<kaziyaame ka'enaziyaa baxwaalaa sawocu baresu yamizanabubate baresume (wayenene) yamichamequbate `aamate yemathaale >>

neguszume <<'eresune 'amethulenye>> 'ala maleketanyaaweme (yusufene) bamathaawe gizee <<wadageetaahe tamalase yaziyaaneme 'ejocaacawene yaqorathutene seetoce huneetaa thayeqawe geetaayee tanekolaacawene `awaaqi nawenaa>> 'alawe

(neguszume) - <<yusufene kanafesu baabaabalaacehute gizee nagaraacehu menedene nawe>> 'alaacawe <<la'alaahe theraate yegabaawe ba'eresu laaye meneme mathefone nagare 'alaawaqeneme>> 'alute ya`azize misete -<<'ahune 'ewenatu tagalatsa 'enee kanafesu 'abaabalekute 'eresume ka'ewenatanyocu nawe>> 'alace
(yusufe) <<yehe (geetaayee) ruqe hono saala yaalekadaahute mahoneene 'alaaheme yakadaatanyocene tanekole yamaayaaqaanaa mahonune 'enediyaaweqe nawe;>> ('ala)
<<nafeseeneme (kasehhetate) 'alaatharaame nafese hulu geetaayee yathabaqaate kaalehonace basetaqare bamathefo nagare ba'eregethe 'azaazhe naatenaa geetaayee bathaame mahhaari 'azaanye nawe>> ('ala)
neguszume <<'eresune 'amethulenye laraasee gelanyaa 'adaregawaalahunaa>> 'ala baanaagaraweme gizee <<'aneta zaaree 'enyaa zanede baalamwale taamaanye nahe>> 'alawe
<<bamedere gemejaa beetoce laaye (shume) 'adereganye 'enee thabaaqi 'awaaqi nanyenaa>> 'ala
'enedazihume layusufe bamedere laaye ka'ereswa bafalagawe seferaa yamisafere sihone 'asemacanawe bacerotaacene yameneshaawene sawe 'enelayaalane yabago szariwoceneme waagaa 'anaathafaame
yamacharashaayetume `aalame menedaa la'enaziyaa laamanutenaa yethanaqaqu lanabarute yabalatha nawe
yayusufe wanedemoceme mathu ba'eresume laaye gabu 'enasume 'eresune yasaatute sihonu `awaqaacawe

(gudaayaacawene fatsemo) seneqaacaweneme baazagaajalaacawe gizee 'ala - <<ka'abaataacehu bakule yahonawene wanedemaacehune 'amethulenye 'enee ka'asetanaagaajoce hulu balaache sehone; seferene yamemolaa mahoneene 'ataayumene
'eresuneme baataamathulenye 'enee zanede la'enaaneta sefere yalaacehume; 'ateqarebunyememe >>
<<sela'eresu 'abaatune bathebeqe 'enethayeqaalane 'enyaame (yehenene) ba'eregethe szariwoce nane>> 'alute
la'ashekarocume <<shaqathaacawene wada beetasabocaacawe batamalasu gizee yaaweqwaate zanede bayagwaazocaacawe wesethe 'aderegulaacawe limalasu yekajalaalenaa>> 'alaacawe

wada 'abaataacaweme batamasalu gizee - <<'abaataacene hoye! (wanedemaacenene 'esekamenewasede) sefere ka'enyaa takalekelwale selazihe wanedemaacenene ka'enyaa gaare laakawe yesaferelenaalenaa 'enyaame laresu thabaaqiwoce nane>> 'alu

<<ka'ahune bafite bawanedemu laaye 'enedaamanekwaacehu 'eneji ba'eresu laaye 'amenaacexwaalahune 'alaaheme bathabaaqinate (kahulu) yabalatha nawe 'eresume ka'azaanyoce hulu yebalethe 'azaanye nawe;>> 'alaacawe

`eqaacaweneme bakafatu gizee shaqathaacawe wada'enaresu tamalesaa 'aganyu -<<'abaataacene hoye! mene 'enefalegaalane yeheci shaqathaacene naate wadanyaa tamalesaalenaalace; ('eneradaabaataalane) labeetasabocaaceneme 'eneshametaalane wanedemaaceneneme 'enethabeqaalane yagemaleneme chenate 'enechameraalane yehe (baneguszu laaye) qalaale sefere nawe>> 'alu

<<kaaletakababaacehu basetaqare 'eresune ba'eregethe yametaamathulenye lamahonaacehu ka'alaahe yahonane qaale kidaane matamaamanyaa 'esekametesathunye derase ka'enaaneta gaare fatsemo 'alelekaweme>> 'alaacawe matamaamanyaacaweneme basathute gizee <<'alaahe bamenelawe hulu laaye mesekere nawe>> 'alaacawe

'alame <<lejocee hoye! ba'anede bare 'ategebu gene batalayu baroce gebu ka'alaaheme (ferede) bameneme 'alethaqemaacehume; ('alemaleselaacehume) feredu ya'alaahe 'eneje yaleelaa 'ayedalame ba'eresu laaye tamakaahu tamakiwoceme hulu ba'eresu becaa yemaku >>

'abaataacaweme kaazazaacawe seferaa bagabu gizee ka'alaahe (ferede) meneme nagare kanaresu yamikalakelelaacawe 'alenabarame gene bayaa`eqobeme nafese wesethe yanabarace gudaaye naate fatsamaate 'eresume selaasaawaqenawe ya`eweqate baalabeete nawe; gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
bayusufe laaye bagabu gizeeme wanedemune wadaresu 'asethagaawe <<'enaho 'enee wanedemehe nanye yeszarute banabaruteme hulu 'ateqolaache>> 'alawe
`eqaacaweneme baazagaajalaacawe gizee; waanechaayetune bawanedemu `eqaa wesethe 'adaraga kaziyaame <<'enaaneta baala gemaloce hoye! 'enaaneta ba'eregethe leeboce naacehu sile thari tathaaraa >>
wadanasu zoraweme <<menedene thafaacehu>> 'alu
<<yaneguszu masefariyaa thafetonaale 'eresuneme laamathaa sawe yagemale chenate 'alawe 'eneeme ba'eresu tayaazhe nanye>> 'ala
<<ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane bamedere laaye lamaathefaate 'enedaalemathaane ba'eregethe `aweqaacexwaale leeboceme 'alenabareneme>> 'alu
<<weshataamoce betehonu qethaatu menedene nawe>> 'alwacawe
<<qethaatu (bayaa`eqobe hhege) `eqaawe bagwaazu wesethe yataganyabate sawe (raasu mawasade) nawe 'eresume qethaatu nawe 'enedazihu badalanyocene 'eneqathaalane>> 'alu

(meremaraawene) kawanedemume `eqaa bafite ba`eqaawocaacawe jamara kaziyaame (waanechaayetune) kawanedemu `eqaa wesethe 'awathaate 'enedazihu layusufe belehaatene 'asetamaarenawe 'alaahe baaleshaa noro baneguszu hhege wanedemune liyeze 'ayegabaaweme nabare yameneshaawene sawe badarajaawoce kafe 'enaadaregaalane ka`eweqate baalabeetoce hulu balaayeme `awaaqi 'alela

<<bisareqe ka'ahune bafite yaresuwe wanedeme ba'eregethe sareqwaale>> 'alu yusufeme (yehecene negegere) banafesu wesethe dabaqaate la'enasume 'alegalathaateme (balebu) <<'enaaneta szeraacehu yakafaa nawe 'alaaheme yametelutene hulu yebalethe `awaaqi nawe>> 'ala
'aneta yatakabarekawe hoye! <<la'eresu ba'eregethe taalaaqe shemaagelee 'abaate 'alawe selazihe ba'eresu seferaa 'anedanyaacenene yaaze 'enyaa kamalekaame szariwoce honahe 'enaayehaalanenaa>> 'alute
<<`eqaacenene 'eresu zanede yaaganyanebatene sawe 'eneji leelaane kamayaaze ba'alaahe 'enethabeqaalane 'enyaa yaane gizee ba'eregethe badaayoce nane>> 'ala

karesume tasefaane baqorathu gizee yamimakaakaru honawe galale 'alu taalaaqaacawe 'ala <<'abaataacahu banaaneta laaye ka'alaahe yahonane mataamanyaa kidaane ba'eregethe yayaazabaacehu mahonune kaziheme bafite bayusufe laaye gefe yaszaraacehutene 'ataawequmene selazihe 'abaatee la'enee 'esekamifaqedelenye wayeme 'alaahe lanee 'esekamifaredelenye derase yameserene medere 'alelayeme 'eresume kafaraajoce hulu balaache nawe
<<wada 'abaataacehu tamalasu baluteme - 'abaataacene hoye! lejehe saraqa baawaqenaweme nagare 'eneji 'alemasakareneme ruquneme nagare (mesethirune) `awaaqiwoce 'alenabareneme
<<yaaceneme bawesethwa yanabarenebaatene katamaa yaaceneme bawesethwa yamathaanawene baala gemale gwaade thayeqe 'enyaame ba'eregethe 'ewenatanyoce nane >>

(yaa`eqobe) <<'ayedalame nafesocaacehu 'anedaace nagarene la'enaaneta shalamulaacehu (szaraacehuteme) malekaameme te'egesete (maaderage) 'alabenye 'enaresune (szosetuneme) yatasabasabu honawe 'alaahe liyaamathaalenye yekajalaale 'enaho 'eresu `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa>> 'alaacawe
ka'enasume zaware 'alanaa'aa<<bayusufe laaye waa hhazanee!>> 'ala `aayenocume kahhazane (laqeso) yatanasaa nathu 'eresume batekaazee yatamalaa nawe
('enaresume) <<ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane lathefaate yaqarabeke 'esekametehone wayeme kathafiwocu 'esekametehone derase yusufene kamaawesaate 'atewagademe>> 'alu
<<cheneqateenenaa hhazaneenenaa yamaasamutawe wada 'alaahe becaa nawe ka'alaaheme bakule yamaataawequtene nagare `aweqaalahu>> 'alaacawe
<<lejocee hoye! lidu; kayusufenaa kawanedemume (waree) tamaraamaru ka'alaaheme 'ezenate tasefaa 'atequrathu 'enaho ka'alaahe 'ezenate kahhaadiwoce hhezeboce 'eneji tasefaa 'ayeqoretheme>> ('ala)

ba'eresume laaye bagabu gizee <<'aneta yatakabarekawe hoye! 'enyaaneme beetasabocaaceneneme gudaate darasabene rekaashe shaqatheme yezane mathetanaale sefereneme lanyaa mulaalene banyaame laaye matsewete 'alaahe matsewaacocene yemanadaalenaa>> 'alute
<<'enaaneta yamaataawequ banabaraacehu gizee bayusufenaa bawanedemu laaye yasaraacehutene gefe `awaqaacehune>> 'alaacawe

<<'aneta ba'eregethe 'aneta yusufe nahene>> 'alute <<'enee yusufe nanye yeheme wanedemee nawe 'alaahe banyaa laaye ba'eregethe lagasalene 'enaho! yamithanaqaqenaa yamitaagase sawe ('alaahe yekesawaale) 'alaahe yabago 'aderaagiwocene waagaa 'ayaathafaamenaa>> 'ala
<<ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane 'alaahe banyaa laaye ba'eregethe 'abalathahe 'enyaame ba'eregethe 'athefiwoce nabarene>> 'alu
<<zaaree banaaneta laaye waqasaa yalabaacehume 'alaahe la'enaaneta yemeraale 'eresume ka'azaanyoce hulu yebalethe 'azaanye nawe>> 'alaacawe;
<<yehenene qamiseene yezaacehu lidu ba'abaatee fiteme thaalute yamiyaaye hono yemathaalenaa beetasabocaacehuneme sabesebaacehu 'amethulenye>> ('alaacawe)
gemale chaanyocume (meserene) batalayu gizee 'abaataacawe <<'enee yayusufene shetaa ba'eregethe 'aganyaalahu baataaqeelunye noro (taamenunye nabare)>> 'ala
<<ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane 'aneta ba'eregethe baqademowe sehetatehe wesethe nahe>> 'alute
'abesaariweme bamathaa gizee (qamisune) bafitu laaye thaalawe wadiweme yamiyaaye kxona <<'enee la'enaaneta - ka'alaahe bakule yamaataawequtene `aweqaalahu 'alaalekwaacehumene>> 'alaacawe
<<'abaataacene hoye! laxathi'atocaacene mehheratene lamenelene 'enyaa thefaatanyoce nabarenenaa>> 'alu
<<wadafite la'enaaneta geetaayeene mehheratene 'elamenelaacexwaalahu 'enaho! 'eresu mahhaariwe 'azaanyu nawenaa>> 'alaacawe;
bayusufe laayeme bagabu gizee walaajocune wadaresu 'asethagaacawe <<ba'alaaheme faqaade thebeqoce setekxonu meserene gebu>> 'alaacawe

walaajocuneme bazufaanu laaye 'awathaacawe la'eresume sagaajoce kxonawe waradulate <<'abaateeme hoye! yehe fite yaayaxwaate hhelemee fece nawe geetaa ba'eregethe 'ewenate 'adaragaate kawaheni beeteme baawathaanyenaa sayethaaneme ba'eneenaa bawanedemocee makaakale ka'abalaasha baxwaalaa 'enaanetane kagathare baamathaacehu gizee ba'eregethe lanee malekaame waalalenye geetaayee lamishaawe nagare 'ezenatu raqiqe nawe 'enaho 'esu `awaaqiwe thebabanyaawe nawe>> 'ala

<<geetaayee hoye! kanegeszenaa ba'eregethe sathakxanye kahhelemoceme fece 'asetamaarekanye yasamaayaatenaa yamedere fathaari hoye! 'aneta baqerebitunaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame radaatee nahe muselime honya gedalanye bamalekaamocume 'asethagaanye>> ('ala)
(muhhamade hoye) yehe wadaaneta yamenaawaredawe sikxone; karuqe wareewoce nawe 'anetame 'enaresu (bayusufe) yamimakeru kxonawe nagaraacawene baqorathu gizee 'enasu zanede 'alenabarekeme
'abezaanyaawocume sawoce (lamaamanaacawe) betegwaagwaame yamiyaamenu 'ayedalume
ba'eresume (baqure'ane) laaye meneme waagaa 'atethayeqaacaweme 'eresu la`aalamaate gesaatsee 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame
basamaayaatenaa bamedereme kaalacewe melekete bezuyetu 'enasu kareswa zanegiwoce kxonawe bareswa laaye yaalefaalu
'abezaanyocaacaweme; 'enasu 'agaariwoce kxonawe 'eneji ba'alaahe 'ayaamenume
ka'alaahe qethaate shafaanye 'adagaa yametemathaabaacawe wayeme sa`aatitu 'enasu yamaayaawequ sikxonu badenegate yametemathaabaacawe makxonuwaane 'ayefarumene
<<yehece manegadee naate wada 'alaahe 'etharaalahu 'eneeme yatakatalanyeme sawe bageletse maaserajaa laaye nane theraateme la'alaahe yegabaawe 'eneeme ka'agaariwocu 'ayedalahume>> bale

kaaneta bafiteme kakatamoce sawoce wadanaresu raa'eye yamenaawaredelaacawe yakxonune wanedocene 'eneji 'alelaakeneme bamedere laaye 'ayekxeedumenaa ya'enaziyaane ka'enasu bafite yanabarutene sawoce macharashaa 'ayemalakatumene yamacharashaayetume 'agare la'enaziyaa latathanaqaqute ba'eregethe yatashaalace naate; 'ataawequmene

maleketanyocume tasefaa baqorathunaa 'enaresu ba'eregethe yatawaashu makxonaacawene batatharaatharu gizee 'eredaataacene mathaalaacawe ('enyaa) yameneshaaweme sawe 'enedidene tadaraga qethaataaceneme ka'agaariwocu hhezeboce laaye 'ayemalaseme

bataarikaacawe wesethe la'a'emero baala beetoce ba'eregethe magasachaa nabara (yehe qure'aane) yamiqathaathafe waree 'ayedalame gene yaanene basetafitu yaalawene 'aragaagaache lanagareme hulu galaache lamiyaamenu hhezeboceme marinaa cerotaa nawe
'a.la.ma.ra ('alife laame mime raa) yehece ('anaaqetse) kamatsehhafu 'aneqatsoce naate yaame kageetaahe wadaaneta yatawaradawe 'ewenate nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaamenume

'alaahe yaa samaayaatene yametaayuwaate 'a`emaade saatenore yaanasaate kaziyaame ba`areshu (zufaanu) laaye (selethaanu) yatadalaadala tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme yagaraa nawe hulume latawasana gizee yerothaalu nagarune hulu yaasetanaaberaale bageetaacehu maganaanyate taaragaagethu zanede ta`aameraatocene yezarazeraale

'eresume yaa mederene yazaragaa baswame taraaraawocenenaa wanezocene yaadaraga bawesethwame kafereewoce hulu hulate hulate `aayenatocene yaadaraga nawe leelitene baqane yeshafenaale baziheme wesethe lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce meleketoce 'alu

bamedereme yatagoraabatu quretheraachoce 'alelu kawayenoceme 'atekeletoce 'azere`etoceme manetaawocenaa manetaawoce yaalekxonu zanebaabaawoceme 'alelu ba'anede wehaa yethathaalu; (bathaa`ememe yelayaayaalu) kafiluwaaneme bakafilu laaye bamibalaawe sabele 'enaabalethaalane baziheme wesethe lamiyaawequ hhezeboce ta`aameraate 'alabate

betedanaqeme `afare bakxonene gizee 'enaa 'adise fetherate 'enekxonaalane maalataacawe (taalaaqe) deneqe nawe 'enazihe 'enaziyaa bageetaacawe yakaadute naacawe 'enaziheme 'enezaazelaawoce ba'anegatocaacawe laaye yaalubaacawe naacawe 'enazihame ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enasu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce naacawe

ka'enasu bafite yamasalocaacawe qethaatoce ba'eregethe yaalafu sikxonu kamalekaamu bafite bamathefowe yaasecakuluhaale geetaaheme lasawoce kamabadalaacawe gaare ba'eregethe yameherate baalabeete nawe geetaaheme ba'eregethe qethaata beretu nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadute ba'eresu laaye kageetaawe ta`aamere lamene 'aletawaradalateme yelaalu 'aneta 'asefaraari becaa nahe lahhezebeme hulu mari 'alaacawe
'alaahe seete hulu yametaaragezawene yaaweqaale maahhetsanoceme yamiyaagodelutene yamichameruteneme (yaaweqaale) nagarume hulu 'eresu zanede baleke yatawasana nawe;
ruqunenaa qerebune `awaaqi taalaaqe yalaaqa nawe
ka'enaaneta wesethe qaalune zeqe yaadaraga sawe ba'eresu yachokxame sawe 'eresu baleelite tadabaaqime baqane (tagaletso) kxiyaajeme yakxona sawe ('eresu zanede) 'ekule nawe

la'eresu (lasawe) kasetafitume kaxwaalaaweme ba'alaahe te`ezaaze (kakefu) yamithabequte tatakaakiwoce (malaa'ekete) 'alute 'alaahe bahhezeboce zanede yaalawene tsagaa banafesocaacawe yaalawene (kxuneetaa) 'esekamilawethu derase 'ayelawetheme 'alaaheme basawoce laaye kefune bashaa gizee la'eresu mamalase yalaweme la'enaresume ka'eresu leelaa meneme takalaakaaye yalaacaweme
'eresu yaa yametefarunaa yametekajelume setehonu belechetaane yamiyaasaayaacehu kabaadoce damanaawoceneme yamiyaaseganye nawe

nagodegwaademe 'alaahene bamaamasegane yaatharaale malaa'eketeme 'eresune lamaferaate (yaatharutaale) maberaqoceneme yelekaale 'enaresume (kahhaadiwoce) ba'alaahe yamikaraakaru sihonu ba'ereswa yamishaawene sawe yemataale 'eresume xayela beretu nawe

la'eresu (la'alaahe) ya'ewenate matheriyaa 'alawe 'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa yamigazuwaacawe (thaa`otaate) wada 'afu yedarese zanede wada wehaa madaafocune (baruqe hono) 'enedamizaragaa (sawe malese) 'eneji lanaresu bameneme 'ayemalesulaacaweme 'eresume wada 'afu daraashe 'ayedalame yakahhaadiwoceme theri bakanetu 'eneji 'ayedalame
basamaayaatenaa bamedereme yaalute hulu bawedeme hona bagede la'alaahe yesagedaalu thelaawocaacaweme bathwatocenaa baszarekoce yesagedaalu

<<yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa maane nawe>> balaacawe <<'alaahe nawe>> bale <<lanafesocaacawe theqemeneme gudaateneme yamaayecelune radaatoce karesu leelaa yaazaacehune>> balaacawe <<`ewerenaa yamiyaaye yesetakaakalaalune wayese chalamaawocenaa berehaane yesetakaakalaalune wayese la'alaahe 'enedaresu 'afathaathare yafatharune tagaariwoce 'adaragulatenaa fetheratu ba'enasu laaye tamasaasalabaacawene>> bale; <<'alaahe hulamanaawene fathaari nawe 'eresume 'anedu 'ashanaafiwe nawe>> bale

kasamaaye wehaane 'awarada shalaqowocume bamathanaacawe fasasu gorefume 'asafaafiwene korafaate tashakama lageethe wayeme la`eqaa felaagote ba'eresu laaye 'esaate yamiyaanadubateme (maa`edene) betheewe yakxona korafaate 'alelawe 'enedazihu 'alaahe la'ewenatenaa laweshate mesaaleene yaadaregaale korafaatumaa gebesebese kxono yethafaale lasawoce yamithaqemawemaa bamedere laaye yeqoyaale 'enedazihu 'alaahe mesaaleewocene yegaletzaale

la'enaziyaa lageetaacawe lataazazute malekaame nagare (ganate) 'alelaacawe 'enaziyaame la'eresu yaaletaazazute la'enasu bamedere yaalawe hulu ka'eresume gaare betheewe binoraacawe noro ba'eresu batabazhubate nabare 'enaziyaa la'enasu kefu meremaraa 'alabaacawe manoriyaacaweme gahaname naate feraashaacaweme kafaace!
kageetaahe wadaaneta yatawaradawe 'ewenate makxonune yamiyaaweqe sawe 'enedaziyaa 'eresu `ewere 'enedakxonawe sawe nawene yamigaszatsute ya'a'emero baalabeetoce becaa naacawe
'enaziyaa ba'alaahe qaale kidaane yamimolu yathabaqaweneme kidaane yamaayaafaresu naacawe
'enaziyaame 'alaahe 'enediqathale ba'eresu yaazazawene nagare yamiqathelu geetaacaweneme yamiyaakaberu mathefoneme quthethere yamifaru naacawe

'enaziyaame yageetaacawene wedeetaa lamafalage yataagasu, solaateneme 'azaweterawe yasagadu, 'enyaa kasathanaacawe sisaayeme bamesethireme kxona bageletse yamatsawatu, kefuweneme nagare babago yamigafateru naacawe 'enaziyaa la'enasu macharashaayetu mesegune 'agare 'alacaacawe

('ereswame) yamanoriyaa ganatoce naate yegabubaataale ka'abaatocaacaweme, kamisetocaacaweme, kazereyaacaweme malekaame yaszaraa sawe (yegabaataale) malaa'eketeme ba'enaresu laaye kayadajaafu hulu yegabaalu
<<salaame la'enaaneta yekxune (yehe menedaa) bamataagasaacehu nawe yamacharashaayetume 'agare mene taamere!>> (yelwacawaale)

'enaziyaame ya'alaahene qaale kidaane kathabaqa baxwaalaa yamiyaafaresu 'alaaheme 'enediqathale ba'eresu yaazazawene nagare yamiqorethu bamedereme laaye yamiyaabalaashu 'enaziyaa lanasu 'eregemaane 'alabaacawe la'enasume mathefo 'agare (gahaname) 'alaacawe

'alaahe lamishaawe sawe sisaayene yaasafaale; yaathabaaleme (kahhaadiwoce) baqerebitume hheyewate tadasatu yaqerebitume hheyewate bamacharashaayetu 'anetsaare (teneshe) mathaqamiyaa 'eneji meneme 'ayedalaceme
'enaziyaame yakaadute <<ba'eresu laaye kageetaawe ta`aamere lamene 'aletawaradame>> yelaalu <<'alaahe yamishaawene yaathamemaale yatamalasaweneme sawe wadaresu yemaraale>> balaacawe
('enasume) 'enaziyaa yaamanu lebocaacaweme 'alaahene bamaawesaate yamiraku naacawe nequ! 'alaahene bamaawesaate leboce yerakaalu
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarute la'enasu dage nuro malekaame mamalashaame 'alaacawe

'enedazihu kabafitewaa bezu hhezeboce ba'eregethe yaalafu wadakxonacewe hhezebe 'enaresu ba'alerahhemaane yamikedu sikxonu yaanene wada 'aneta yaawaradenawene qure'aane ba'enaresu laaye taanabelaacawe zanede laakenehe <<'eresu ('alerahhemaane) geetaayee nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame baresu laaye tathagaahu mamalashaayame wadaresu becaa nawe>> balaacawe

qure'aaneme ba'eresu taraaraawoce batanadubate wayeme ba'eresu medere bataqoraarathacebate wayeme ba'eresu mutaane 'enedinaagaru batadaragubate noro (yamakaa kahhaadiwoce baalaamanu nabare) ba'ewenatu nagaru hulu ya'alaahe nawe 'enaziyaa yaamanute sawoce 'enaho 'alaahe bashaa noro sawocene bamalaa ba'eregethe yemaraacawe 'enedanabara 'ayaawequmene 'enaziyaame yakaadute baszeraacawe mekeneyaate ('athefi) `adagaa yametaaganyaacawe kamakxone wayeme ya'alaahe qatharo 'esekimathaa ba'agaraacawe 'aqeraabiyaa ('aneta) yametesaferebaacawe kamakxone 'ayewagadume 'alaahe qatharowene 'ayaafaresemenaa
ka'aneta bafite banabaruteme maleketanyoce ba'eregethe talaagethobaacawaale la'enaziyaame lakaadute gizeene sathaxwaacawe kaziyaame (baqethaate) yaazekuwaacawe qethaateeme 'enedeete nabare!

'eresu banafese hulu laaye baszaraacawe szeraa tathabaabaaqi yakxonawe ('alaahe 'enedazihe 'enedaalekxonawe thaa`ote bethee nawene) la'alaaheme tagaariwocene 'adaragu therwacawe <<'alaahene bamedere wesethe yamaayaaweqawe noro tenagerutaalaacehune wayese kaqaale bageletse (feci baleelawe kanetu qaale tagaariwoce bamaalate tetharuwaacawaalaacehune)>> balaacawe ba'ewenatu la'enaziyaa lakaadute tanekolaacawe tashalamalaacawe ka'ewenatu manegademe taagadu 'alaaheme yaathamamawe sawe la'eresu meneme 'aqenyi yalaweme
la'enasu baqerebitu hheyewate qethaate 'alaacawe yamacharashaayetume (`aalame) qethaate bathaame yabarataa nawe la'enasume ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneme thabaaqi yalaacaweme

yaace thenequqocu tasefaa yatasathwate ganate methaaneewaa ('enedaminagaraacehu nawe) kaszerewaa wanezoce yefasesaalu megebwa (hulegizee) yamaayeqwaarathe; nawe thelaawaame ('enedazihu) yehece ya'enaziyaa yatathanaqaqute macharashaa naate yakahaadiwoceme macharashaa 'esaate naate

'enaziyaame matsehhafune yasathanaacawe wadaaneta batawaradawe yedasataalu ka'ahhezaabeme kafilune yamikedu sawoce 'alelu <<'enee yataazazekute 'alaahene becaa 'enedegazaa ba'eresume 'enedadaalaagaaraa nawe wada'eresu 'etharaalahu; mamalashaayeeme wada'eresu nawe>> balaacawe
'enedazihu ba`arabenyaa yatanagara fetehhe sikxone 'awaradenawe `eweqatu kamathaaleheme baxwaalaa zenebaaleewocaacawene betekatale ka'alaahe qethaate meneme radaateme thabaaqime yalaheme

ka'aneta bafiteme maleketanyocene ba'eregethe lekanaale la'enaresume misetocenenaa lejocene 'adereganaale lamaanenyaaweme maleketanyaa ba'alaahe faqaade 'eneji ta`aamere liyaamathaa 'ayegabaaweme lagizeewe hulu tsehhufe 'alawe
'alaahe yamishaawene yaabesaale; yaatsadeqaaleme yamatsehhafu maszarateme 'eresu zanede nawe
yaziyaaneme yaasefaraaraanaacawene kafilune benaasaayehe (malekaame nawe) wayeme benegadelehe (waqasaa yalabeheme) ba'aneta laaye yaalabehe maaderase becaa nawe meremaraaweme banyaa laaye nawe;
'enyaa mederene kachaafocewaa yamenaagodelaate kxonane yamenemathaabaate makxonaacenene 'alaayumene 'alaaheme yefaredaale laferedume galebaache yalaweme 'eresume meremaraawe fathaane nawe

'enaziyaame ka'enasu bafite yanabarute ba'eregethe makaru 'azanegetome yamayaazu zadee bamulu ya'alaahe nawe nafese hulu yameteszaraawene yaaweqaale kahhaadiwoceme yamacharashaayetu 'agare lamaane 'enedametekxone wadafite yaaweqaalu
'enaziyaame yakaadute sawoce <<maleketanyaa 'ayedalaheme>> yelaalu <<ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale masekaari ba'alaahenaa 'eresu zanede yamatsehhafu `eweqate baalawe sawe baqaa>> balaacawe

'a.la.ra ('alife laame raa; yehe qure'ane) sawocene bageetaacawe faqaade kachalamaawoce wada berehaane 'ashanaafi mesegune wada kxonawe geetaa manegade taawathaa zanede wadaaneta yaawaradenawe matsehhafe nawe
'alaahe yaa basamaayaate yaalawe bamedereme yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa yakxona nawe; lakahhaadiwoceme kaberetu qethaate wayolaacawe
'enaziyaa yaqerebitune hheyewate kamacharashaayetu hheyewate yebalethe yamiwadu ka'alaaheme manegade yamiyaagedu mathemamwaneme yamifaleguwaate naacawe 'enaziyaa baruqe sehhetate wesethe naacawe

kamaleketanyaa maanenyaaweneme la'enaresu yaaberaaraalaacawe zanede bawaganocu qwaaneqwaa 'eneji baleelaa 'alelaakeneme 'alaaheme yamishaawene yaathamaale yamishaaweneme yaaqanaale 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

musaaneme waganocehene kachalamaawoce wada berehaane 'awethaa 'alaaheneme qanoce 'aseganezebaacawe bamaalate bata`aameraataacene ba'eregethe laakenawe bazihe wesethe babezu taagaashenaa babezu 'amasegaanye lakxonute hulu ba'eregethe ta`aameraatoce 'alu

musaame lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese); kafare`one beetasaboce mathefone qethaate yamiyaaqamesuwaacehu wanedoce lejocaacehuneme yamiyaaredu seetocaacehuneme yamitawu sikxonu ba'adaanenaacehu gizee ba'enaaneta laaye (yawaalalaacehune) ya'alaahene tsagaa 'asetaawesu baziheme kageetaacehu yakxona taalaaqe fatanaa 'alabate
geetaacehume <<betaamasagenu ba'eregethe 'echamerelaacexwaalahu betekedume ('eqathaacexwaalahu) qethaatee ba'eregethe beretu nawenaa>> bamaalate baasetaawaqa gizee ('asetaawesu)
musaame 'ala <<'enaanetame bamedere yaalaweme hulu bamalaa betekedu 'alaahe ba'eregethe tabeqaaqi mesegune nawe >>

ya'enaziyaa kanaaneta bafite yanabarute yanuhhe hhezeboce ya`aademe yasamudeme ya'enaziyaame ka'enasu baxwaala yanabarute ka'alaahe basetaqare leelaa yamaayaaweqaacawe (hhezeboce) waree 'alemathaalaacehumene maleketanyocaacawe bamaaserajaawoce mathwacawe 'ejocaacaweneme (baquchete linakesu) wada 'afocaacawe malasu 'alume <<'enyaa 'enaaneta baresu batalaakaacehubate nagare kaadene 'enyaame wadaresu kametetharune nagare 'awalaawaaye bakxona therethaaree wesethe nane >>

maleketanyocaacawe <<kaxathi'atocaacehu 'enedimeraacehu wada tawasana gizeeme (yaala qethaate) 'enediyaaqoyaacehu yamitharaacehu sikxone samaayaatenenaa mederene fathaari bakxonawe 'alaahe (bamanoru) therethaaree 'alane>> 'alwacawe (hhezebocume) <<'enaaneta betheeyaacene sawe 'eneji 'ayedalaacehume 'abaatocaacene yegazute kanabarute letekalakelune teshaalaacehu geletseneme 'aseraje (kaamathaacehute leelaa) 'amethulene>> 'alu

maleketanyocaacawe la'enaresu 'alu <<'enyaa betheeyaacehu sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaneme gene 'alaahe kabaarocu bamishaawe sawe laaye yelagesaale la'enyaame ba'alaahe faqaade 'eneji maaserajaane lenaamathaalaacehu 'ayegabaaneme ba'alaaheme laaye me'emenaanoce yethagu

<<manegadaaceneneme ba'eregethe yamaraane sikxone ba'alaahe laaye yamaanemakaa la'enyaa mene 'alane bamaasaqaayataacehume laaye ba'eregethe 'enetaagasaalane ba'alaaheme laaye tamakiwoce hulu yemaku >>

'enaziyaame yakaadute lamaleketanyocaacawe <<kamederaacene ba'eregethe 'enaawathaacexwaalane; wayeme wada haayemaanotaacene ba'eregethe temalasaalaacehu>> 'alu wada'enaresume geetaacawe 'enedihe sile laaka <<kahhaadiwocene ba'eregethe 'enaathafaalane
<<ka'enasume baxwaalaa mederitune ba'eregethe 'enaaseqamethaacexwaalane yekxa bafitee maqomune lamifaraa zaacaayeeneme lamifaraa sawe nawe >>
'eredaataaneme (ka'alaahe) falagu; (taradume) chakaanye mogadanyaa yakxoname hulu 'afara
kasetafitu gahaname 'alabate 'ezhe kakxoname wehaa yegaataale
yegonachawaale; liwethaweme 'ayeqarebeme moteme kayaseferaawe hulu yemathaabataale; 'eresume yamimote 'ayedalame kasetafitume kabaade qethaate 'ala

ya'enaziyaa bageetaacawe yakaadute sawoce mesaalee (malekaame) szeraawocaacawe banafaashaa qane nafaase baresu 'eneda barataacebate 'amade nawe baszarute szeraa bameneme laaye (lithaqamu) 'ayecelume yehe 'eresu ruqe thefaate nawe
'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate yafathara makxonune 'ataayemene bishaa yaathafaacexwaale 'adise fethureneme yaamathaale
yeheme ba'alaahe laaye 'asecagaari 'ayedalame

yatasabasabume kxonawe la'alaahe yegalatsaalu (hhasaaba) dakaamaawocume (takataayoce) la'enaziyaa lakorute <<'enyaa la'enaaneta takataayoce nabarene; 'enaaneta ka'alaahe qethaate kanyaa laaye 'anedaacene nagare takalaakaayoce naacehune>> yelaalu ('asekataayocume) <<'alaahe baaqanaane noro ba'eregethe bamaraanaacehu nabare>> yelwacawaale <<benebasaache wayeme benetaagaseme ba'enyaa laaye 'ekule nawe la'enyaa meneme mathagiyaa yalaneme>> yelaalu

nagarume batafatsama gizee sayethaane yelaacawaale <<'alaahe 'ewenatanyaawene qaale kidaane gabaalaacehu qaale kidaaneme gabaahulaacehu; 'afarasekubaacehume la'eneeme ba'enaaneta laaye meneme selethaane 'alebaranyeme gene tharaaxwaacehu la'eneeme taazazaacehu selazihe 'ateweqasunye; nafesocaacehuneme weqasu 'enee yameradaacehu 'ayedalahume 'enaanetame yameteradunye 'ayedalaacehume 'enee ka'ahune bafite la'alaahe tagaari ba'adaragaacehute nagare kaadeku badaayocu la'enaresu ba'eregethe 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe >>

'enaziyaame yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu bageetaacawe faqaade 'enedigabu yedaragaalu bawesethaacawe makabaabariyaacawe salaame (la'enaaneta yekxune mabaabaale) nawe

'alaahe malekaamene qaale szerewaa (bamedere wesethe) yatadalaadalace qerenechaafewaame wada samaaye (yarazamace) 'enedahonace malekaame zaafe 'aderego mesaaleene 'enedeete 'enedagalatsa 'alaayakxemene
megebwane (fereewaane) bageetaawaa faqaade bayagizeewe tesathaalace 'alaaheme lasawoce yegasatsu zanede mesaaleewocene yegaletsaale
yamathefome qaale mesaalee kamedere balaaye yatagolasasace la'ereswa meneme madalaadale yaleelaate 'enedakxonace mathefo zaafe nawe

'alaahe 'enaziyaane yaamanutene baqerebitume hheyewate bamacharashaayetume (bamaqaabere) bataragaagathawe qaale laaye yaaragaacawaale kahhaadiwoceneme 'alaahe yaasaasetaacawaale 'alaaheme yamishaawene yeszaraale
wada'enaziyaa ya'alaahene tsagaa bakehedate wada lawathute hhezebocaacaweneme bathefaate 'agare wadaasafarute (wada qurayeshoce) 'alaayahemene
('agaritume) yamigabwate setekxone gahaname naate mene tekafaame maregiyaa!
la'alaaheme kamanegadu yaasaasetu zanede baalaanethaawocene 'adaragulate <<(theqitene) tathaqamu mamalashaacehume wada 'esaate nawe>> balaacawe

la'enaziyaa laamanute baarocee ba'eresu wesethe sheyaachenaa wadaajinate yaleelabate qane kamamethaatu bafite solaatene badanebu yesagedaalu kasathanaacaweme sisaaye bamesethireme bageletseme yelagesaalu (segadu lagesume) balaacawe

'alaahe yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathara kasamaayeme wehaane yaawarada ba'eresume kafereewoce sisaayene la'enaaneta yaawathaa marekaboceneme bafaqaadu babaahhere laaye yeneshaalalu zanede lanaaneta yagaraa wanezoceneme lanaaneta yagaraa nawe
tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme zawatere kxeeyaajoce sikxonu la'enaaneta yagaraa leelitenenaa qaneneme la'enaaneta yagaraalaacehu nawe
kalamanaacehuteme hulu yasathaacehu nawe ya'alaaheneme tsaagaa beteqotheru 'atezaleqwaateme sawe bathaame badalanyaa kahhaadi nawe
beraahimeme baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<geetaayee hoye! yehenene 'agare (makaane) tsathetanyaa 'aderegawe 'eneeneme lejoceeneme thaa`otaatene kamagazaate 'areqane
<<geetaayee hoye! 'enaresu (thaa`otaate) kasawoce bezuwocene 'asaasetawaalenaa yatakatalanyeme sawe 'eresu kanee nawe te'ezaazeeneme yathaasa sawe 'aneta mahhaari 'azaanye nahe

<<geetaacene hoye! 'enee 'azemaraa baleelawe shalaqo wesethe batakabarawe beete (bakaa`ebaa) 'athagabe kazarocee 'aseqamatheku geetaacene hoye! solaatene yaaqwaaqumu zanede ('aseqamathekwaacawe) kasawoceme lebocene wada'enasu yaminaafequ 'aderege yaamasagenuheme zanede kafereewoce sethaacawe
<<geetaacene hoye! 'aneta yamenedabeqaweneme yamenegaletsaweneme hulu ba'eregethe taaweqaalahe ba'alaaheme laaye bamedereme basamaayeme meneme nagare 'ayedabaqeme
<<la'eziyaa kashemegelenaa baxwaalaa semaa`ilene sehhaqeneme la'enee lasathanye 'alaahe mesagaanaa yegabaawe geetaayee lemanaane ba'eregethe sami nawenaa
<<geetaayee hoye! salaatene 'azaweteree yamesagede 'adereganye kazaroceeme ('aderege) geetaacene hoye! tsaloteeneme taqabalanye;
<<geetaacene hoye! la'eneeme lawalaaceeme lame'emanaaneme hulu meremaraa bamidaragebate qane maare >>
'alaaheneme badalanyoce kamiszarute gefe zanegi 'aderegahe 'ataasebe yamiyaaqoyaacawe `aayenoce ba'eresu 'esekamifathubate qane derase becaa nawe
(wada thariwe male'ake) cakwaayoce raasocaacawene 'anegaathaachoce kxonawe (`aayenocaacawe yefathaalu) `aayenocaacawe wadanaresu 'ayemalasume lebocaacaweme baadowoce naacawe

sawoceneme qethaatu yamimathaabaacawene qane 'asefaraaraacawe 'enaziyaame yabadalute <<geetaacene hoye! wada qereba gizee derase 'aqoyane therihene 'eneqabalaalanenaa maleketanyocuneme 'enekatalaalanenaa>> yelaalu <<ka'ahune bafite (bamedera `aalame) la'enaaneta meneme mawagade yalaacehume bamaalate yamaalaacehu 'alenabaraacehumene>> (yebaalaalu)
