<<ba'enaziyaame nafesocaacawene babadalute sawoce manoriyaa wesethe taqamathaacehu ba'enasume 'enedeete 'enedaszaraanebaacawe la'enaaneta tagalatsalaacehu la'enaanetame mesaaleewocene galatsenelaacehu >>
(banabiyu laaye) seeraacaweneme ba'eregethe 'aseeru seeraacaweme (qethaatu) 'alaahe zanede nawe seeraacaweme korabetaawoce (hhegegaatoce) ba'eresu yamiwagadubate 'alenabarame
'alaaheneme maleketanyocune (yagabaalaacawene) qaale kidaanune 'aferaashe 'aderegahe 'ataasebe 'alaahe 'ashanaafi yamabaqale baalabeete nawe
medere baleelaa medere yametelawathebatene samaayaateme ('enedazihu) 'anede 'ashanaafi lakxonawe 'alaaheme (fethuraane hulu) yamigalatsubate qane ('asetaawesu)
'amatsanyoceneme baziyaa qane basanesalatoce taqoraanyetawe taayaacawaalahe
qamisocaacawe kakaateraame naacawe fitocaacaweneme 'esaate teshafenaacawaalace
'alaahe nafesene hulu yaszaraacewene yemanadaa zanede (yehenene 'adaraga) 'alaahe meremaraawe fathaane nawe
yehe (qure'aane) lasawoce galaache nawe (limakarubate), ba'eresume lisefaraarubate, 'eresume 'anede 'amelaake becaa makxonune liyaawequbate, ya'a'emero baalabeetoceme ligasatzubate (yatawarada) nawe
'a.la.ra ('alife laame raa) yehece ('anaaqetse) kamatsehhafu 'aneqatsocenaa galaache kakxonawe qure'aane naate
'enaziyaa yakaadute (bateneszaa'ee qane) muselimoce bakxonu noru babezaate yemanyaalu
tawaacawe yebelu; yethaqamume tasefaame yaazanaagaacawe ba'eregetheme (mathefo fetsaameeyaacawene) yaaweqaalu
maanenyaayetuneme katamaa la'ereswa yatawasana matsehhafe (gizeeyaate) yaalaate kxonaa 'eneji 'alaathafaaneme
maanenyaayetume hhezebe gizeewaane meneme 'ateqadememe (ka'eresu) 'ayeqoyumeme
<<'aneta yaa ba'eresu laaye qure'aane yatawaradalate hoye! 'aneta ba'eregethe `ebede nahe>> 'alume
<<ka'ewenatanyocu 'eneda kxoneke bamalaa'ekete (masekaari) lamene 'atemathaaneme>> ('alu)
malaa'eketene ba'ewenate (baqethaate) 'eneji 'anaawaredeme yaane gizeeme yamiqoyu 'ayedalume
'enyaa qure'aanene 'enyaawe 'awaradenawe 'enyaame la'eresu thabaaqiwocu nane
ka'anetame bafite banabarute bamajamariyaawocu hhezeboce wesethe (maleketanyocene) ba'eregethe lekanaale
maanenyaaweme male'eketanyaa ba'eresu yamiyaalaagethubate kxonawe 'eneje 'ayemathaacaweme nabare
'enedazihu (maasetabaabalene) ba'amatsanyocu leboce wesethe 'enaagabaawaalane
ba'eresu 'ayaamenubateme yaqademowocume deregite ba'eregethe 'alefaalace; ('enedathafu yethafaalu)
ba'enaresume laaye kasamaaye dajaafene bakafatenelaacawenaa ba'eresu siwathu bawaalu noro;
<<yatazagute `aayenocaacene naacawe 'enediyaaweme 'enyaa yatadagamabene sawoce nane>> baalu nabare
basamaayeme laaye burejocene ba'eregethe 'adereganaale latamalekaacoceme (bakawaakebete) 'agithanaataale
katabaarara sayethaaneme hulu thabeqanaataale
gene (waree) masemaatene yamisareqe wadiyawenu 'aberi cebo yekatalawaale (yaaqaathelawaale)
medereneme zaragaanaate bawesethwame korabetaawocene thaalenaabaate bawesethwame (yatalakaane) baqaaye hulu 'abaqalenebaate
ba'ereswame wesethe la'enaaneta manoriyaawocenenaa la'eresu magaabiwocu yaalekxonaacehuteneme ('enesesaatene) 'adaragenelaacehu
makaazinocume (makefacaacawe) 'enyaa zanede yaalehona meneme nagare yalame batawasaname leke 'eneji 'anaawaredaweme
nafaasoceneme (damanaane) tashakaamiwoce 'aderegane laakene kasamaayeme (kadamanaa) zenaabene 'awaradene 'eresuneme 'athathaanaacehu 'enaanetame la'eresu 'adelaabiwoce 'ayedalaacehume
'enyaame hheyaawe yamenaadaregenaa yamenegadele 'enyaawe becaa nane 'enyaame (fethurene hulu ) yamenewarese (qari) nane
ka'enaanetame taqadaamiwocune ba'eregethe `aweqanaale wada xwaalaame qariwocune ba'eregethe `aweqanaale
geetaaheme 'eresu yesabasebaacexwaale 'eresu thebabanyaa `awaaqi nawenaa
saweneme kamiqechalachale shakelaa kamigamaa thequre cheqaa ba'eregethe fatharenawe
jaaneneme (kasawe) bafite ka'esaate nabalebaale fatharenawe
geetaaheme lamalaa'ekete baalagizee ('asetaawese) 'enee sawene kamiqechalachale shakelaa kamigamaa cheqaa 'efatheraalahu
(fetheratune) baasetakaakalekutenaa bawesethu kamanefasee banafaahubateme gizee la'eresu sagaajoce kxonaacehu wedaqu
malaa'eketeme malaaweme tasabesebawe sagadu
belise (diyaabelose) becaa siqare kasagaajocu gaare kamakxone 'enebi 'ala
('alaaheme) <<belise hoye! kasagaajocu gaare yamaatekxone laaneta mene mekeneyaate 'alahe>> 'alawe
<<kamiqechalachale shakelaa kageme cheqaa lafatharekawe sawe lesagede 'ayegabaanyeme>> 'ala
('alaahe) 'alawe <<kareswame wethaa 'aneta yatabaarareke 'eregume nahenaa >>
<<baaneta laayeme 'eseka feredu qane derase 'eregemaane 'alabehe >>
<<geetaayee hoye! 'enegediweyaase (sawoce) 'esekamiqasaqasubate qane derase 'aqoyanye>> 'ala
('alaaheme) 'ala <<'aneta kamiqoyute nahe
<<'esekataawaqawe waqete qane derase >>
(belise) 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! 'eneene bamaathemamehe yekxunebenye lanaresu bamedere laaye (xathi'atene) 'eshalemelaacawaalahu huluneme 'athamaacawaalahume >>
<<kanaresu fetsumocu baarocehe becaa siqaru >>
('alaaheme) 'ala <<yehe ba'enee laaye (mathabaqu yatagabaa) qathetanyaa manegade nawe >>
<<'enaho baarocee ba'enasu laaye laaneta selethaane yalaheme kathamaamocu yatakatalahe sawe becaa siqare >>
<<gahanameme (laresunaa latakatalute) lamalaaweme ba'eregethe qatharwacawe naate
<<la'ereswa sabaate dajaafoce 'alwate layadajafume hulu ka'enasu yatakafala faanetaa 'ala
<<'enaziyaa (kaxathi'ate) yatathanaqaqute ba'atekeletocenaa bamenechoce wesethe naacawe
<<tsathetanyoce kxonaacehu basalaame gebwate (yebaalaalu)
<<baalegaawoceme laaye fite lafite yamiqethaachu wanedemaamaacoce kxonawe badaratocaacawe wesethe kaqime yaalawene hulu 'enaasewagedaalane
<<ba'ereswame wesethe dekaame 'ayenakaacaweme 'enasume ka'ereswa yamiwathu 'ayedalume >>
baaroceene 'enee mahhaariwe 'azaanyu 'eneewe becaa makxoneene negaraacawe
qethaateeme 'eresu 'asaamaami qethaate makxonune (negaraacawe)
kaberaahime 'enegedoceme (waree) negaraacawe
ba'eresu laaye bagabunaa salaame baalute gizee yakxonawene ('asetaawese) ('eresume) <<'enyaa ka'enaaneta fariwoce nane>> 'alaacawe
<<'ateferaa; 'enyaa `awaaqi bakxona wanede leje 'enaabaserehaalane>> 'alute
<<'erejenaa yadarasabenye kamakxonee gaare 'abasaraacehunyene bamene taabaserunyaalaacehu>> 'ala
<<ba'ewenate 'abasarenehe katasafaa qoraachoceme 'atekxune>> 'alu
<<kathamaamaawoceme basetaqare kageetaawe 'ezenate tasefaane yamiqorethe maanawe>> 'ala
<<'enaaneta maleketanyoce hoye! 'wara lamakxonu nagaraacehu menedene nawe>> 'ala
<<'enyaa 'amatsanyoce wada kxonu hhezeboce talekanaale>> 'alute
<<yaluthe beetasaboce becaa siqaru ('enaresune) 'enyaa hulaacaweneme ba'eregethe yamenaadenaacawe nane
<<misetu becaa seteqare 'ereswane (baqethaatu wesethe) kamiqarute makxonwane wasananaale>> ('alu)
maleketanyocume yaluthene beetasaboce bamathubaacawe gizee;
(luthe) <<'enaaneta yatasaataacehu hhezeboce naacehu>> 'alaacawe
<<'ayedalame 'enyaa hhezebocehe baresu yetharaatharubate banabarute qethaate mathaanehe>> 'alute
<<'ewenateneme yezane mathaanehe 'enyaame ba'eregethe 'ewenatanyoce nane
kabeetasabeheme gaare baleelitu kafile kxide kaxwaalaacaweme takatale ka'enaanetame 'anedeme sawe wada xwaalaawe 'ayegalaamathe wada taazazaacehubateme seferaa 'elafu>> ('alute)
wadaresume yaanene te'ezaaze 'awaradene ('eresume) ya'enazihe (hhezeboce) macharashaa yaanagu sikxonu (szeraacawe) maqorathe nawe
yakatamaayetume sawoce yamibasaasaru kxonawe mathu
(lutheme) 'ala <<'enazihe 'enegedocee naacawenaa 'ataagaalethunye
<<'alaaheneme feru; 'ataasaaferunyeme >>
<<ka`aalamaate (maaneneme 'enedaataasetanaagede) 'alekalakalenehemene>> 'alute
(lutheme) <<'enanyehe seetoce lejocee naacawe szariwoce betekxonu ('agebwacawe)>> 'ala
ba`edemeehe 'enemelaalane 'enasu ba'eregethe basekaraacawe wesethe yewaalelaalu
chukxatitume tzahhaye yawathaacebaacawe sikxonu yaazacaacawe
laayewaaneme kataacewaa 'adaragene ba'enasume laaye yashakelaa danegiyaawocene 'azanabenebaacawe
bazihe wesethe latamalekaacoce ba'eregethe magamegamiyaawoce 'alubate
'eswame (katamaayetu) baqathetaa manegade laaye naate
bazihe wesethe ba'eregethe lame'emenaane magasachaa 'ala
'enaho ya'ayekate sawoceme ba'eregethe badaayoce nabaru;
kanasume tabaqalene hulatume (yaluthenaa ya'ayekate hhezeboce katamoce) ba'eregethe bageletse manegade laaye naacawe
yahhijereme sawoce maleketanyocune ba'eregethe 'asetabaabalu
ta`aameraataaceneneme sathanaacawe ka'ereswame zanegiwoce nabaru
kakorabetaawoceme beetocene tsathetanyoce kxonawe yetharebu nabare
yaanagume sikxonu chukxate yaazacaacawe; (wadamu)
yeszaruteme yanabarute hhenetsaa meneme 'alethaqamaacaweme
samaayaatenenaa medereneme bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu ba'ewenate 'eneji (balaagethaa) 'alefathareneme sa`aatitume ba'eregethe machi naate malekaameneme yeqeretaa 'aderegelaacawe
geetaahe 'eresu (yaalenabarane) fathaariwe `awaaqiwe nawe
kamidagaagamu yakxonune sabaatenenaa taalaaquneme qure'aane (bamulu) ba'eregethe sathanehe
ka'enaresu (kakahhaadiwoce) bezuwocene waganoce ba'eresu wada 'athaaqamenebate tsagaa `aayenocehene 'atezaregaa ba'enasume laaye (baayaamenu) 'atezane kenefeheneme lame'emenaane 'alazebe
baleme <<'enee geletse 'asefaraariwe 'enee nanye >>
(sawocene lamaagade yamakaane baroce) batakafaafalute laaye 'eneda 'awaradenawe (bakxona qethaate 'asafaraariyaacehu nanye bale)
('enaresume) 'enaziyaa qure'aanenene kefelefeloce yaadaragu naacawe
bageetaaheme 'enemelaalane hulaacaweneme 'enethayeqaacawaalane;
yeszarute kanabarute nagare hulu
yataazazekebateneme nagare bayefaa gelatse 'agaariwoceneme tawaacawe
tasaalaaqiwocene hulu 'enyaa baqetanehaale
('enasume) 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaakene yaadaragu naacawe ba'eregetheme (fetsaameeyaacawene) wadafite yaaweqaalu
'anetame bamilute nagare lebehe yamithabe makxonune ba'eregethe 'enaaweqaalane
geetaaheneme kamaamasegane gaare 'atheraawe kasagaajocume kxune
'ewenatume (mote) 'esekimathaahe derase geetaahene tagazaa
ya'alaahe te`ezaaze mathaa; selazihe 'ataasecakulute; kamaayegabaawe hulu tharaa kamiyaagaaruteme hulu laaqa;

kabaarocu bamishaawe sawe laaye malaa'eketene karaa'eye gaare bafaqaadu yaawaredaale (kahhaadiwocene baqethaate) 'asethaneqequ; 'enaho kanee baqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame; ferunyeme maalatene ('asetaawequ bamaalate yaawaredaale)
samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate fathara kamiyaagaarute hulu tharaa
sawene kafetewate thabetaa fatharawe kaziyaame 'eresu wadiyaawenu (teneszaa'eene bamakaade) geletse takaraakaari yekxonaale
gemalene, kabetene, feyaleneme bareswa (berede makalaakayaa) muqate theqemoceme yaalubaate setekxone la'enaaneta fatharalaacehu kareswame tebalaalaacehu
la'enaanetame ba'ereswa wada maarafiyaawaa bametemaleswate gizee bametaasamaaruwaateme gizee webate 'alaacehu
gwaazocaacehuneme banafesoce cegere 'eneji wadamaatedaresubate 'agare teshakamaalace geetaacehu ba'eregethe ruxeruxe 'azaanye nawenaa
farasoceneme, baqelowoceneme, 'aheyoceneme leteqamathuwaacawenaa letaageethubaacawe (fatharalaacehu) yamaataawequteneme deneqe nagare yefatheraale
ba'alaaheme laaye (bacerotaawe) qathetanyaawene manegade magelatse 'alabate ka'ereswame (kamanegade) thamaamaa 'alela bashaame noro hulaacehuneme ba'eregethe baaqanaacehu nabare
'eresu yaa kasamaaye wehaane yaawarada nawe ka'eresu la'enaaneta mathathe 'alaacehu ka'eresume ('enesesaawocene) ba'eresu yametaasamaarubate zaafe (yebaqelebataale)

ba'eresu la'enaaneta 'azemaraane, (yazayete) wayeraaneme, zamebaabaawoceneme (tamerene), wayenoceneme, kafereewoceme hulu yaabaqelelaacexwaale bazihe wesethe lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aamere'alela
la'enaanetame leelitenenaa qanene, tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme garaalaacehu kawaakebeteme bafaqaadu yatagaru naacawe bazihe wesethe lamiyaawequ hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aameraatoce 'alelu
bamedereme laaye malekocu yatalayaayu kxono la'enaaneta yafatharalaacehune hulu (garaalaacehu) bazihe wesethe lamigasatsu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alela

'eresume yaa baahherene ka'eresu 'erethebe segaane letebalunaa ka'eresume yametelabesutene geethaageethe taawathu zanede yagaraa nawe marekaboceneme bawesethu (wehaawene) qadaajoce kxonawe (sineshaalalu) taayaalahe kacerotaawe letefalegunaa letaamasagenume (garaalaacehu)
bamedereme wesethe ba'enaaneta 'enedaataaragarege taraaraawocene thaalabaate jiratoceneme, manegadoceneme temaru zanede ('adaraga)
meleketoceneme ('adaraga) bakawaakebeteme 'enasu yememaraalu
yamifathere 'enedamaayefathere nawene 'ategasatsumene
ya'alaaheneme tsagaa beteqotheru 'atezaleqwaateme 'alaahe ba'eregethe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
'alaaheme yametedabequtenenaa yametegaletsutene hulu yaaweqaale
'enaziyaame ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazwacawe meneneme 'ayefatherume 'enaresume yefatharaalu;
hheyaawe yaalekxonu mutaane naacawe macee 'enedamiqasaqasume 'ayaawequme
'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe 'enaziyaame bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenute lebocaacawe kahhaadiwoce naacawe 'enasume yakoru naacawe; ('ayaamenume)
'alaahe yamidabequtenenaa yamigaletsutene hulu yamiyaaweqe lamakxonu therethaaree yalabateme 'eresu kuruwocene 'ayewademe
la'enaresume <<geetaacehu (bamuhhamade laaye) menene 'awarada>> batabaalu gizee <<('eresu) yamajamariyaawocu hhezeboce taratoce nawe>> yelaalu

(yeheneneme yamilute) bateneszaa'ee qane xathi'aatocaacawene bamulu ka'enaziyaame yaala `eweqate kxonawe kamiyaathamwacawe sawoce xathi'atoce kafilune lishakamu nawe nequ! yamishakamute xaathi'aate menenyaa kafaa!

'enaziyaa ka'enasu (kaqurayeshoce) bafite yanabarute ba'eregethe makaru 'alaaheme hhenetsaawocaacawene kamaszaratocaacawe 'afarasa thaariyaaweme ba'enasu laaye kabalaayaacawe wadaqabaacawe qethaatume kamaayaawequte szeferaa mathaabaacawe

kaziyaame bateneszaa'ee qane yaawaaredaacawaale 'enaziyaame <<ba'enasu (gudaaye) tekaraakarunye yanabaraacehute tagaariwocee yate naacawe>> yelaacawaale <<'enaziyaa `eweqatene yatasathute zaaree hhaferatunaa qethaatu ba'eregethe bakahhaadiwoce laaye nawe>> yelaalu

('enaresu) <<'enaziyaa nafesocaacawene badaaye kxonawe malaa'ekete yamigadelwacawe naacawe kakefu szeraa meneme nagare yameneszaraame 'alenabarene>> (silu) taazaazhenataacawene yegaletsaalu <<ba'ewenate 'alaahe tesarute yanabaraacehutene nagare `awaaqi nawe>> (yebaalaalu)
<<yagahanameneme dajaafoce bawesethwa zawetaariwoce setekxonu gebu>> (yebaalaalu) yakuruwoceme manoriyaa (gahaname) ba'eregethe kafaace!

la'enaziyaame latathanaqaqute <<geetaacehu menene nagare 'awarada>> tabaalu <<malekaamene nagare>> 'alu la'enaziyaa dage laszarute bazihace baqerebitu `aalame malekaame nuro 'alaacawe yamacharashaayetume 'agare ba'eregethe balaache naate yathenequqocume 'agare mene taamere!
('ereswame) yamigabuwaatenaa baszerewaa wanezoce yamifasubaate setekxone yamanoriyaa 'atekeletoce naate la'enasume bawasethwa yamishute hulu 'alaacawe 'enedazihu 'alaahe thenequqocene yemanadaale
'enaziyaa bamalekaame kxuneetaa laaye kxonawe malaa'ekete <<salaame ba'enaaneta laaye>> 'eyaalu yamigadelwacawe naacawe <<teszarute banabaraacehute szeraa ganatene gebu>> (yebaalaalu)

(kahhaadiwoce) malaa'ekete wada 'enasu mamethaatene wayeme yageetaahe te'ezaaze mamethaatune 'eneji 'ayethabaabaqume ka'enasu bafite yanabarute 'enedazihe szaretawaale 'alaaheme 'alebadalaacaweme; gene nafesocaacawene yamibadelu nabaru
yaszaruwaacaweme xathi'atoce (qethaate) 'aganyaacawe ba'eresume yesaalaqubate yanabarute hulu banasu laaye waradabaacawe

'enaziyaame (thaa`otaatene) yaagaarute <<'alaahe bashaa noro ka'eresu leelaa 'enyaame 'abaatocaaceneme meneneme baaletagazaane nabare; yaala'eresume (te'ezaaze) meneneme 'ereme baalaadaragene nabare 'alu >> 'enaziyaame kanasu bafite yanabarute 'enadazihu szaru bamaleketanyocume laaye geletze maaderase becaa 'eneji leelaa yalabaacaweme

bayahhezebume hulu wesethe <<'alaahene tagazu; thaa`oteneme raaqu>> bamaalate maleketanyaane ba'eregethe lekanaale ka'enasume wesethe 'alaahe yaaqanaawe sawe 'alela ka'enasume wesethe ba'eresu laaye themate yataragaagathabate sawe 'alela bamedereme laaye kxidu; ya'asetabaabaayoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekatu
bamaqenaataacawe laaye betegwaagwaa (meneme letaadarege 'ateceleme) 'alaahe yamithamawene sawe 'ayaaqanaawemenaa la'enasume karadaatoce meneme yalaacaweme

mahhaalocaacawemene 'alaahe yamimotene sawe 'ayaasenasaame silu ba'alaahe seme maalu hhasate nawe (yaasenasaacawaale) ba'eresu laaye qaale kidaane gabetwale 'aragaagethwale; gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
(yamiqasaqesaacaweme) la'enasu yaanene ba'eresu yamilayaayubatene ligaletselaacawe; 'enaziyaa yakaaduteme 'enasu weshataamoce yanabaru makxonaacawene 'enediyaawequ nawe
lamaanenyaaweme nagare (makxonune) bashaanawe gizee qaalaacene la'eresu <<kxune>> maalate becaa nawe; wadiweme yekxonaale

'enaziyaame katabadalu baxwaalaa ba'alaahe (manegade laaye) yatasadadute baqerebitu `aalame malekaamitune 'agare (madinaane) ba'eregethe 'enaasaferaacawaalane yamacharashaayetume `aalame menedaa taalaaqe nawe (kahhaadiwoce) biyaawequ noro (batakatalwacawe nabare)
('enaresu) 'enaziyaa yataagasute bageetaacaweme laaye yamithagute naacawe
ka'anetame bafite wada'enasu wahheyene (raa'eyene) yamenaawaredelaacawene sawocene 'eneji leelaane 'alelaakeneme yamaataawequme betekxonu ya`eweqatene baalabeetoce thayequ
bageletse maaserajaawocenaa bamatsaahhefete (laakenaacawe) wada 'anetame lasawoce wada'enasu yatawaradawene (fece) letegaletselaacawenaa yaasetanatenume zanede qure'aanene 'awaradene
'enaziyaa mathefowocene yadolatu 'alaahe ba'enasu mederene yamigalabethebaacawe wayeme kamaayaawequte seferaa qethaate yamimathaabaacawe makxonune 'ayefarumene
wayeme (kaagare wada 'agare) bamizaawarubate gizee yamiyezaacawe makxonune ('ayefarumene) 'enasume 'ashanaafiwoce 'ayedalume
wayeme qase baqase bamaagudale laaye yamiyezaacawe makxonune ('ayefarumene) geetaacehume ba'eregethe rexeruxe 'azaanye nawe
wadaziyaa kamaanenyaaweme nagare 'alaahe wada fatharawe thelaawocu 'enaresu yatawaaradu sikxonu la'alaahe sagaajoce kxonawe kaqanyenaa kageraawoce wadamizaawarute 'alaayumene
la'alaaheme basamaayaate yaalawe kataneqasaaqaasheme bamedere yaalawe hulu, malaa'eketeme yesagedaalu 'enaresume 'ayekorume
geetaacawene kabalaayaacawe sikxone yefarutaale yataazazuteneme hulu yeszaraalu
'alaaheme 'ala <<hulate 'amaaleketene 'ateyaazu 'eresu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe 'eneeneme becaa feru >>
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa nawe magazaateme zawatere sikxone laresu becaa nawe ka'alaaheme leelaa yaalane tefaraalaacehune
maanenyaaweme ba'enaaneta laaye yaalawe tsagaa ka'alaahe nawe kaziyaame cegere badarasabaacehu gizee wadaresu becaa techohaalaacehu
kaziyaame ka'enaaneta laaye cegerene baanasaalaacehu gizee ka'enaanetawe yakxonu cheferoce wadiyaawenu bageetaacawe (thaa`otene) yaagaaraalu
(yamiyaagaaruteme) basathanaacawe likedu nawe tathaqamume wada fiteme (yamidaresebaacehune) ba'eregethe taaweqaalaacehu
lamaayaawequteme (thaa`otaate) kasathanaacawe sisaaye fanetaane yaadaregaalu ba'alaahe 'emelaalahu; teqathaathefute kanabaraacehute hulu ba'eregethe tethayaqaalaacehu
la'alaaheme (kamalaa'ekete) seetoce lejocene yaadaregaalu theraate tagabaawe la'enaresume yamifalegutene (wanedoce lejocene) yaadaregaalu
'anedaacaweme baseete leje batabasara gizee 'eresu yataqocha kxono fitu thaquro yewelaale

ba'eresu katabasarabate nagare mathefonate baweredate laaye kxono yeyaazawene wayese ba`afare wesethe yedabeqawene (bamaalate 'eyaametaataa) kasawoce yedabaqaale nequ! yamifaredute (ferede) menenyaa kafaa!
la'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame lamaayaamenute mathefo thabaaye 'alaacawe la'alaaheme taalaaqe baahhereye 'alawe 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'alaaheme sawocene babadalaacawe bayaazaacawe noro bareswa (bamedere laaye) kataneqasaaqaashe meneneme baaletawa nabare gene 'eseka tawasana gizee derase yaaqoyaacawaale gizeeyaacaweme bamathaa waqete 'aneditene sa`aate 'ayeqoyume; 'ayeqadamumeme

la'alaaheme yamithalutene nagare yaadaragaalu la'enasume malekaamitu ('agare) 'alacaacawe bamaalate melaasocacawe weshatene yenaagaraalu la'enasu 'esaate yaalacaacawe makxonaacawenaa 'enasume (wadareswa) baqedemiyaa yaminadu makxonaacawe therethere yalabateme

ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane; kaaneta bafite wada nabarute hhezeboce ba'eregethe (maleketanyocene) lekanaale sayethaaneme la'enaresu szeraawocaacawene shalamalaacawe 'eresume zaaree radaataacawe nawe la'enasume (xwaalaa) 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
baanetame laaye matsehhafune 'alaawaradeneme; yaanene baresu yatalayaayubatene lanaresu letaaberaaraalaacawenaa lamiyaamenuteme hhezeboce marinaa 'ezenate likxone 'eneji
'alaaheme kasamaaye wehaane 'awarada ba'eresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe 'adaraga bazihe wesethe lamisamu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alela
lanaanetame bagemale, bakabete, bafeyale ba'eregethe magamegamiyaa 'alelaacehu bahodocu wesethe kaalawe kafarasenaa kadame makaakale theru watatene lathachiwoce tawaache sihone 'enaathathaacexwaalane
kazamebaabaawocenaa kawayenoceme fereewoce ('enemagebaacexwaalane) ka'eresu thajenenaa malekaame megebeneme teszaraalaacehu baziheme wesethe lamiyaasebu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alela
geetaaheme wada nebe 'enedihe sile 'asetaawaqa <<kataraaraawoce, kazaafeme, (sawoce) kamiszaruteme (qafo) beetocene yaazhi

<<kaziyaame kafereewoce hulu beye yageetaasheneme manegadoce (laaneci) yatagaru sikxonu gebi >> kahodocewaa malekocu yatalayaayu mathathe yewathaale ba'eresu wesethe lasawoce madexaanite 'alabate bazihe wesethe lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aamere 'alelabate
'alaaheme fatharaacehu; kaziyaame yegadelaacexwaale ka'enaanetame ka`ewaqete baxwaalaa meneneme nagare 'enedaayaaweqe wada waraadaa `edemee yamimalase sawe 'alela 'alaahe `awaaqi caaye nawe

'alaaheme kafilaacehune bakafilu laaye basisaaye 'abalatha 'enaziyaame balaache yatadaragute sisaayaacawene 'ejocaacawe bayaazuwaacawe (baaroce) laaye 'enasu ba'eresu yetakaakalu zanede malaashoce 'ayedalume taadiyaa ba'alaahe tsagaa (la'eresu tagaari bamaaderage) yekedaalune

'alaaheme kanafesocaacehu (kagosocaacehu) la'enaaneta misetocene 'adaraga la'enaanetame kamisetocaacehu wanedoce lejocene, yaleje lejoceneme 'adaragalaacehu kamalekaamoceme tsagaawoce sathaacehu taadeyaa baweshate (bathaa'ote) yaamenaalune ba'alaaheme tsagaa 'enasu yekedaalune
ka'alaaheme leelaa kasamaayaateme kamedereme meneneme sisaaye yamaayesathwacawene (meneneme) yamaayeceluteneme yegegazaalu
la'alaaheme 'amesaayaawocene 'ataaderegu 'alaahe (masaaye 'enedaleelawe) yaaweqaale 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme

bameneme laaye yamaayecelawene bayezotaa yaalawene baariyaanaa ka'enyaa malekaame sisaayene yasathanawene 'eresume ka'eresu (kasathanawe) bamesethirenaa bageletse yamilagesawene (natsaa) sawe 'alaahe (lathaa`otenaa laresu) mesaalee 'adaraga (hulatu) yetakaakalaalune mesegaanaa la'alaahe yekxune ba'ewenatu 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme

'alaaheme hulatene wanedoce (lakahhaadinaa lame'emane) mesaalee 'adaraga 'anedanyaacawe bameneme nagare laaye yamaayecele didaa nawe 'eresume bageetaawe laaye shakeme nawe wada yateme biyaazorawe badage nagare 'ayemathaame 'eresunaa yaa 'eresu baqathetanaawe manegade laaye kxono bamaasetakaakale yamiyaazawe sawe yesetakaakalaalune

basamaayaatenaa bamedereme yaalawe ruqe mesethire ya'alaahe nawe yasa`aatitume nagare (mamethaatwa) 'eneda`aayene qetsebate 'eneji 'ayedalame waye 'eresu yebalethe yaqaraba nawe 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
'alaaheme ka'enaatocaacehu hodoce meneme yamaataawequ honaacehu 'awathaacehu taamasagenume zanede la'enaaneta masemiyaane maayaawoceneme leboceneme 'adaragalaacehu

wada baraariwoce basamaaye 'ayare wesethe (lamaberare) yatagaru sikxonu (kamawedaqe) 'alaahe 'eneji leelaa yamaayezaacawe kxonawe 'ayemalakatumene bazihe wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce ba'eregethe ta`aameraatoce 'alu

'alaaheme kabeetocaacehu la'enaaneta maregiyaane 'adaragalaacehu ka'enesesaawoceme qodaawoce baguzwacehu qane bamaqamachaacehume qane yametaaqalelaacawene beetoce lanaaneta 'adaragalaacehu kabagewaa sufoce, kagemalewaame thaguroce, kafeyalewaame thaguroce yabeete `eqaawocene 'eseka gizeeme derase mathaqaaqamiyaane ('adaragalaacehu)

'alaaheme kafatharawe nagare la'enaaneta thelaawocene 'adaragalaacehu kagaaraawoceme la'enaaneta makalayaawocene 'adaragalaacehu hharureneme (beredeneme) yamithabeqwaacehune lebesoce yathoraacehuneme 'adagaa yamithabeqwaacehune theruroce la'enaaneta 'adaragalaacehu 'enedazihu tesalemu zanede tsagaawene ba'enaaneta laaye yemolaale
(kaselaame) bishashume baaneta laaye yaalabehe geletse maaderase becaa nawe
ya'alaahene tsagaa yaaweqaalu kaziyaame yekedwataale 'abezaanyocaacaweme kahhaadiwocu naacawe
kayahhezebume hulu masekaarine yameneqasaqesebatene qane ('asetaawese) kaziyaame la'enaziyaa lakaadute (negegere) 'ayefaqadelaacaweme 'enasume bawaqasaa 'ayetaalafume
'enaziyaame yabadalute qethaatune baayu gizee ka'enasu (qethaatu) 'ayeqalalelaacaweme 'enasume gizee 'ayesesathume

'enaziyaame yaagaarute yamiyaagaaruwaacawene baayu gizee <<geetaacene hoye! 'enazihe ka'aneta leelaa 'enegazaacawe yanabarenawe tagaariwocaacene naacawe>> yelaalu ('amaaleketoce) <<'enaaneta ba'eregethe weshataamoce naacehu>> yamaalateneme qaale wada'enasu yethelaalu
('agaariwocu) baziyaa qaneme taazaazhenataacawene wada 'alaahe yaaqarebaalu yeqathaathefute yanabaruteme hulu ka'enaresu yethafaacawaale
'enaziyaa yakaadu, ka'alaaheme manegade yakalakalu yaathafu banabarute mekeneyaate qethaatene baqethaate laaye chamarenebaacawe

bayahhezebume hulu wesethe kagosaacawe ba'enasu laaye masekaarine yameneqasaqesebatene 'anetaneme ba'enazihe (hhezeboce) laaye masekaari 'aderegane yamenaamathaahene qane ('asetaawese) matsehhafuneme lahulu nagare 'aberaari, marime, 'ezenateme, lamuselimoceme 'abesaari kxono baaneta laaye 'awaradenawe

'alaahe bamaasetakaakale, bamaasaamareme, lazemedenaa baalabeete bamasethateme yaazaale ka'asekafime (kamaamanezare), kamithalaame nagare hulu, kamabadaleme yekalakelaale teganazabu zanede yegasetsaacexwaale

qaale kidaaneme bagabaacehu gizee ba'alaahe qaale kidaane mulu mahhaalocaacehuneme ka'athanakaraacexwaate baxwaalaa 'alaahene ba'enaaneta laaye ba'eregethe masekaari yaadaragaacehu setekxonu 'ataaferesu 'alaahe yameteszarutene hulu yaaweqaalenaa

(qaale kidaanaacehune bamaaferase 'aneditu) hhezebe 'ereswa ka(leelaayetu) hhezebe yabazaace lamakxonewaa bamakaakalaacehu mahhaalocaacehune (lakedaate) magebiyaa 'aderegaacehu yameteyezu setekxonu 'enedaziyaace fatelewaane kathanakara baxwaalaa tereteroce 'aderegaa 'enedaafarasacewe (seete) 'atekxunu 'alaahe ba'eresu yemokeraacexwaale; bateneszaa'ee qaneme ba'eresu telayaayubate yanabaraacehutene nagare la'enaaneta ba'eregethe yaaberaaraalaacexwaale
'alaaheme bashaa noro 'anedite hhezebe baadaragaacehu nabare gene yamishaawene sawe yaathamaale yamishaaweneme sawe yaaqanaale teszarute kanabaraacehuteme hulu ba'eregethe tethayaqaalaacehu

chaamaawoce katadalaadalu baxwaalaa 'enedaayenedaalathu ka'alaaheme manegade bamakalekalaacehu mekeneyaate qethaatene 'enedaateqamesu mahhaalocaacehune bamakaakalaacehu lakedaate magebiyaa 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazu la'enaanetame (yaane gizee) taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacehu
ba'alaaheme qaale kidaane theqitene waagaa 'ategezu yametaawequ betekxonu 'alaahe zanede yaalawe menedaa 'eresu la'enaaneta balaache nawenaa
'enaaneta zanede yaalawe hulu yaaleqaale 'alaahe zanede yaalawe gene (zala`aalame) qari nawe 'enaziyaaneme yataagasutene yeszarute banabarute bamalekaamu menedaacawene 'enemanadaacawaalane
kawanede wayeme kaseete 'eresu 'amaanye kxono bagone yasaraa malekaame nurone ba'eregethe 'enaanorawaalane yeszaruteme kanabarute nagare bamalekaamu menedaacawene 'enemanadaacawaalane
qure'aaneneme baanababehe gizee 'eregume kakxonawe sayethaane ba'alaahe tathabaqe
'eresu ba'enaziyaa baamanutenaa bageetaacawe laaye bamithagute laaye la'eresu selethaane yalawemenaa
selethaanu ba'enaziyaa bamitaazazute laayenaa ba'enaziyaame 'enaresu ba'eresu (mekeneyaate) 'agaariwoce bakxonute laaye becaa nawe
ba'aneqatseme seferaa 'aneqatsene balawathene gizee 'alaaheme yamiyaawaredawene nagare 'awaaqi nawe <<'aneta qathaafi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme>> yelaalu ba'ewenatu 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
'enaziyaane yaamanutene lamaaragaagaate muselimocuneme lamameraatenaa lamaabesare (qure'aanene) qedusu manefase (jiberile) 'ewenatanyaa sikxone kageetaahe 'awaradawe balaacawe

'enaresume <<'eresune (qure'aanene) yamiyaasetamerawe sawe becaa nawe>> maalataacawene ba'eregethe 'enaaweqaalane yaziyaa wadaresu yamiyaasethagubate sawe qwaaneqwaa `ajame nawe yehe (qure'ane) gene geletse `arabenyaa qwaaneqwaa nawe
'enaziyaane ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yamaayaamenutene 'alaahe 'ayemaraacaweme; lanasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
weshatene yamiqathaathefute 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yamaayaamenute becaa naacawe 'enaziyaame weshataamocu 'enasu becaa naacawe

ka'emenatu baxwaalaa ba'alaahe yakaada sawe (beretu qethaate 'alelawe) lebu ba'emenate yaragaa kxono (bakehedate qaale bamanaagare) yatagadada sawe becaa siqare gene lebaacawene bakehhedate yakafatu sawoce banasu laaye ka'alaahe quthaa 'alabaacawe la'enasume taalaaqe qethaate 'alelaacawe
yehe (qethaate) 'enasu qerebitune hheyewate kamacharashaayetu bamamerathaacawe mekeneyaatenaa 'alaaheme kahhaadiwocene hhezeboce yamaayaaqanaa bamakxonu nawe
'enaziyaa 'enaresu balebocaacawe, ba`aayenocaacaweme, bajorowocaacaweme laaye 'alaahe yaatamabaacawe naacawe 'enaziyaame zeneguwocu 'enasu naacawe;
'enaresu bamacharashaayetu `aalame kasaariwocu 'enasu lamakxonaacawe therethere yalame

kaziyaame geetaahe la'enaziyaa katafatanu baxwaalaa latasadadute kaziyaame lataagalutenaa lataagasute (mahhaari 'azaanye nawe) geetaahe ka'ereswa (kafatanaawaa) baxwaalaa ba'eregethe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
nafese hulu karaaswa laaye yametekaraakare kxonaa yametemathaabatene nafeseme hulu yaszaraacewene (waagaa) yameteqabalebatene qane ('asetaawese) 'enaresume 'ayebadalume

'alaahe tsathetanyaa, yarakaace, sisaayewaa safi kxono kayaseferaawe yemathaalaate yanabaracewenenaa ba'alaahe tsagaawoce yakaadacewene 'alaaheme yeszarute banabarute xaathi'aate yaraxaabenenaa yaferehaatene qethaatoce yaaqamasaatene katamaa (makaane) mesaalee 'adaraga
ka'enaresu wesethe yakxona maleketanyaame ba'eregethe mathaalaacawe 'asetabaabaluteme 'enasume badaayoce kxonawe qethaatu yaazaacawe
'alaaheme kasathaacehu sisaaye yatafaqada netsuhhe sikxone belu ya'alaaheneme tsagaa 'eresune yametegazute betehonu 'amasegenu

ba'enaaneta laaye 'ereme yaadaragawe baketenenaa damene, ya'asaamaaneme segaa, yaaneneme (bamataarade gizee) ba'eresu ka'alaahe seme leelaa yatanasaabatene becaa nawe 'amatsanyaame wasane 'alaafime saayekxone (lamabelaate) yatagadada sawe (yefaqadelataale) 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
ba'alaaheme laaye weshatene leteqathaathefu melaasocaacehu bamimathenute weshate <<yehe yatafaqada nawe; yeheme 'ereme nawe>> 'atebalu 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yamiqathaathefu 'ayedenume
theqite mathaaqame 'alaacawe la'enasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
ba'enaziyaame yehudaaweyaane bakxonute laaye ka'ahune bafite ba'aneta laaye yatarakenawene nagare 'ereme 'adereganebaacawaale 'enyaame 'alebadalenaacaweme gene nafesocaacawene yebadelu nabaru
kaziyaame geetaahe la'enaziyaa basehhetate mathefone laszarunaa kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa latatsatsatu szeraacaweneme laabaju geetaahe ka'ereswa baxwaalaa ba'eregethe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
beraahime la'alaahe taazaazhe wada qathetanyaa haayemaanote tazanebaaye hhezebe nabare ka'agaariwocume 'alenabarame
latsagaawocu 'amasegaanye nabare; marathawe wada qathetanyaaweme manegade maraawe
baqerebitume `aalame bagone nagare sathanawe 'eresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame ba'eregethe kamalekaamocu nawe
kaziyaame wada 'aneta yaberaahimene haayemaanote qathetanyaa sikxone takatale; ka'agaariwocume 'alenabarame maalate 'awaradene
sanebate (kelekele) yatadaragawe ba'enaziyaa ba'eresu batalayaayubate sawoce laaye becaa nawe geetaaheme bateneszaa'ee qane yelayaayubate banabarute nagare bamakaakalaacawe ba'eregethe yefaredaale

wada geetaahe manegade babelehaatenaa bamalekaame gesaatsee (balazabetaa qaale) theraa baziyaaceme 'ereswa malekaame bakxonacewe (zadee) takaraakaraacawe geetaahe 'eresu kamanegadu yatasaasaatawene sawe `awaaqi nawe 'eresume qene yakxonutene sawoce `awaaqi nawe
betebaqalume baresu bataqathaacehubate bethee tabaqalu betetaagasume 'eresu lataagaashoce ba'eregethe balaache nawe
taagaseme; mataagaseheme ba'alaahe (maasecaale) 'eneji 'ayedalame ba'enaresume laaye (baayaamenu) 'atetakeze (baaneta laaye) kamimakeruteme tanekole bacheneqate wesethe 'atekxune
'alaahe ka'enaziyaa kamifarutenaa ka'enaziyaame 'enasu malekaame szariwoce kakxonute gaare nawenaa

yaa baariyaawene katakabarawe masegide wadaziyaa zuriyaawene wada baarakenawe wada ruqu masegide baleelite wesethe yaasekxeedawe (geetaa) theraate yegabaawe kata`aameraatocaacene lenaasaayawe ('asekxeedenawe) 'enaho 'eresu ('alaahe) samiwe tamalekaaciwe nawe
musaaneme matsehhafune sathanawe la'eseraa'eeleme lejoce mari 'adaragenawe ka'enee leelaa mathagiyaane 'ateyaazu; ('alenaacaweme)
'enaaneta kanuhhe gaare (bamarekabitu) yachaanaacawe zaroce hoye! ('alaahene tagazu) 'eresu babezu 'amasegaanye baariyaa nabarenaa
wada 'eseraa'eeleme lejoce bamatsehhafu wesethe ('enedihe bamaalate) 'awaradene bamedere laaye ba'eregethe hulate gizee taathafaalaacehu teleqeneme kuraate tekoraalaacehu

kahulatu (gizeeyaatoce) yamajamariyaayetu qatharo bamathaame gizee la'enyaa yakxonune baaroce yaberetu xaayele baalabeetoce yakxonutene ba'enaaneta laaye 'enelekaalane babeetoceme makaakale yemalaalasaalu; (yebaraberutaale ) yehe tafatsaami qatharome nabare
kaziyaame (baxwaalaa) la'enaaneta ba'enasu laaye delene malasenelaacehu baganezabocenaa bawanedoce lejoceme chamarenelaacehu bawaganeme yabazaacehu 'adaragenaacehu

malekaame beteszaru lanafesocaacehu malekaamene szaraacehu mathefoneme beteszaru banaresu (banafesocaacehu) laaye nawe; ('alene) yaxwaalanyaayetume (gizee) qatharo bamathaa gizee fitocaacehune liyaasekafu, masegiduneme bamajamariyaa gizee 'enedagabute ligabu, yaashanafuteneme hulu (fatsemawe) maathefaatene 'enediyaathafu ('enelekaacawaalene)
(bamatsehhafume 'alene) <<betetsatsatu - geetaacehu liyaazenelaacehu yekajalaale (wada maathefaate) betemalasume 'enemalasaalane gahanameneme lakahhaadiwoce maasariyaa 'adareganaale
yehe qure'aane wadaziyaace 'ereswa qathetanyaa wada kxonacewe manegade yemaraale 'enaziyaaneme bago yamiszarutene me'emanaane la'enasu taalaaqe menedaa yaalaacawe makxonune yaabaseraale
'enaziyaame bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenute la'enasu 'asaamaami qethaatene 'azagaajetanelaacawaale;
sawe malekaamene nagare 'enedamilamene hulu; mathefoneme nagare yelamenaale saweme cakwaalaa nawe

leelitenenaa qaneneme (lacelotaacene) meleketoce 'adaragene yaleelitene meleketeme 'abasene yaqanene meleketeme yametaasaaye 'adaragene (yeheme yakxonabate) kageetaacehu terefene letefalegu ya`aamataateneme qutherenaa hhisaabeneme taawequ zanede nawe nagaruneme hulu layaayetane zarazarenawe
saweneme hulu baraariwene (szeraawene) ba'anegatu 'aseyaazenawe la'eresume bateneszaa'ee qane yatazaragaa kxono yamiyaaganyawe yakxonane matsehhafe 'enaawathaalataalane
<<matsehhafehene 'anebebe zaaree baaneta laaye taqothaathaarinate banafesehe baqaa>> (yebaalaale)

yatamaraa sawe yamimaraawe laraasu becaa nawe yatasaasaatame sawe yamisaasaatawe (gudaatu) ba'ereswa laaye nawe tashakaamime (nafese) yaleelaayetune xaathi'aate 'ateshakameme male`eketanyaaneme 'esekameneleke derase yameneqathaa 'ayedalaneme
katamaaneme lamaathefaate bafalagene gizee baala tsagaawocewaane 'enaazaalane bawesethwame yaametsaalu ba'ereswame laaye qaalu (qethaatu) yefatsamebaataale maathefaateneme 'enaathafaataalane
kanuhheme baxwaalaa kakefela zamanaate sawoce yaathafaanaacawe bezuwoce naacawe yabaarocuneme xaathi'aatoce wesetha `awaaqi tamalekaace makxone bageetaahe baqaa

cakwaayetune `aalame (baszeraawe) yamifalege sawe la'eresu bareswa wesethe yashaanawene (tsagaa) lameneshaawe sawe 'enaasecakulelataalane kaziyaame la'eresu gahanamene (manoriyaa) 'adereganelataale tawaqaashe beraari kxono yegabaataale
macharashaayetuneme `aalame yafalaga sawe 'eresu 'amaanye kxono lareswa (tagabi) szeraawaane yaszaraame sawe 'enazihe szeraacawe yatamasagana yekxonaale
huluneme 'enazihenenaa 'enaziyaane kageetaahe sethotaa (bazihe `aalame) 'enechamerelaacawaalane yageetaaheme sethotaa (bazice `aalame) kelekele 'ayedalame
kafilaacawene bakafilu laaye 'enedeete 'enedaabalathene tamalekate yamacharashaayaatume 'agare bamaa`eragoce bathaame yakabaracenaa bamabelatheme yatalaqace naate
ka'alaahe gaare leelaane 'amelaake 'ataaderege yatawaqaseke radaate yaleelahe tekxonaalahenaa;

geetaaheme ('enedihe sile) 'azaza - 'eresune 'eneji leelaane 'ategazu bawalaajocaacehume malekaamene szeru ba'aneta zanede kxonawe 'anedaacawe wayeme hulataacawe 'erejenaane bidaresu fohe 'atebalaacawe 'ategalaamethaacaweme la'enaresume malekaamene qaale tanaagaraacawe
lahulatume ka'ezenatehe yamawaaradene kenefe zeqe 'aderegelaacawe <<geetaayee hoye! bahhetzaanenatee (barexeraaxee) 'enedaasaadagunye 'ezanelelaacaweme>> bale
geetaacehu banafesocaacehu wesethe yaalawene hulu 'awaaqi nawe taazaazhoceme betekxonu (bamasaasaateme betaathafu) 'eresu latamalaashoce mahhaari nawe
lazemedenaa baalabeeteme mabetune sethe lamesekinenaa lamanegadanyaame (sethe) maabaakaneneme 'ataabaakene
'abaakaanyoce yasayethaanaate wanedemoce naacawenaa sayethaaneme lageetaawe beretu kahhaadi nawe
kageetaaheme yametekajelaatene tsagaa lamaathaate ka'enaresu betezore la'enasu lezebene qaale tanaagaraacawe
'ejeheneme wada 'anegatehe yataasarace 'ataaderege mazaregaateneme hulu 'atezaregaate; yatawaqaseke yataqochakxe tekxonaalahenaa
geetaahe sisaayene lamishaawe sawe yaasafaale; yaathabaaleme 'eresu babaarocu kxuneetaa wesetha `awaaqi tamalekaace nawenaa
lejocaacehuneme dekxenatene lamaferaate 'ategedalu 'enyaa 'enemagebaacawaalane 'enaanetaneme ('enemagebaalane) 'enaresune magedale taalaaqe xaathi'aate nawenaa
zemuteneme 'ateqerabu 'eresu ba'eregethe mathefo szeraa nawenaa manegadenatume kafaa!

yaacineme 'alaahe yaawagazaatene nafese yaala hhege 'ategedalu yatabadalame kxono yatagadala sawe lazamadu (bagadaayu laaye) ba'eregethe selethaanene 'adereganaale bamagedaleme wasanene 'ayelafe; 'eresu yataradaa nawenaa
yayatimeneme ganezabe yaberetaatune gizee 'esekidarese derase baziyaace 'ereswa malekaame bakxonace kxuneetaa 'eneji 'ateqerabu bakidaanaacehume mulu kidaane yamithayaqubate nawenaa
basafaraacehume gizee seferene mulu batekekelanyaawe mizaaneme mazenu yehe malekaame nagare nawe macharashaaweme yaamaara nawe
la'anetame baresu `eweqate yaleelahene nagare 'atekatale masemiyaa, maayaame, lebeme 'enazihe hulu (baalabeetaacawe) ka'enasu tathayaaqi nawenaa
bamedereme laaye yatanebathaararake honahe; 'atehide 'aneta fatsemo mederene 'atesaragudemenaa barezemateme fatsemo gaaraawocene 'atedaresemenaa
yehe hulu mathefowe ('aszeraa hulatu kelekeloce) 'egeetaahe zanede yatathalaa nawe
yehe geetaahe kathebabu wada 'aneta kaawaradawe nagare nawe ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane 'amelaake 'ataaderege yatawaqaseke yatabaarareke kxonahe bagahaname wesethe tethaalaalahenaa
geetaacehu bawanedoce lejoce marathaacehunaa kamalaa'ekete seetocene (lejoce) yaazene 'enaaneta kabaadene qaale ba'eregethe tenaagaraalaacehu
yegasatsume zanede bazihe qure'aane wesethe dagaagemane ba'eregethe galatsene mabaregageneme 'eneji leelaane 'ayechamarelaacaweme
(muhhamade hoye) balaacawe <<'enedametelute ka'eresu gaare 'amaalekete banabaru noro yaane gizee wada `areshu baalabeete manegadene bafalagu nabare >>
theraate yegabaawe kamiluteme nagare hulu kafe yaalane leqenaa laaqa

sabaatu samaayaatenaa medereme bawesethaacaweme yaalawe hulu la'eresu yaatharaalu kanagareme hulu kamaamasegane gaare yamiyaatharaawe 'eneji 'anedeme yalame gene maatheraataacawene 'ataawequteme 'eresu taagaashe mahhaari nawe
qure'aaneneme baanababeke gizee baanetanaa ba'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame bamaayaamenute sawoce makaakale yamishashagene geredoshe 'adereganaale

'enedaayaawequteme balebocaacawe laaye shefaanene bajorocaacaweme wesethe denequrenaane 'adaragene geetaaheneme becaawene kxono baqure'aane baawasaakxawe gizee yamishashu kxonawe bajarebaawocaacawe laaye yezoraalu

'enyaa wada 'aneta bamiyaadaamethu gizee 'enasume bamineshokaashoku gizee badaayoce ('erese baresaacawe) yatadagamabatene sewe 'eneji 'atekatalume bamilu geezee ba'eresu yamiyaadaamethubatene mekeneyaate `awaaqi nane
mesaaleewocene la'aneta 'enedeete 'enedaadaragulehenaa 'eneda tasaasaatu tamalekate (wada 'ewenatu lamaderase) manegadeneme 'ayecelume
'alume <<'enedeete 'athenetocenaa besebesoce bakxone gizee 'enyaa 'adise fetherate kxonane ba'eregethe taqaseqaashoce nane>>
balaacawe <<denegaayocene wayeme beratene hunu>>

<<wayeme balebocaacehu wesethe yamitaleqene fetherate (kxunu maqaseqasaacehu 'ayeqareme) >> <<yamimalesaneme maanawe>> yelaalu yaa bamajamariyaa gizee yafatharaacehu nawe>> balaacawe wada 'anetame raasocaacawene yenaqaneqaalu <<'eresume macee nawe>> yelaalu <<('eresu) qerebe likxonane yecaalaale balaacawe
('eresume) yamitharaacehunaa ('alaahene) 'amasegaanyocu kxonaacehu theriwene yameteqabalubate theqiteneme (qanoce) 'eneji yaaleqoyaacehu makxonaacehune yametetharaatharubate qane nawe; (balaacawe)
labaaroceeme balaacawe - yaacene 'ereswa malekaame yakxonacewene (qaale) yenaagaru sayethaane bamakaakalaacawe yaabalaashaalenaa sayethaane lasawe geletse thalaate nawenaa
geetaacehu ba'enaaneta (kxuneetaa) `awaaqi nawe bishaa yaazenelaacexwaale; wayeme bishaa yeqathaacexwaale ba'enasume laaye xaalaafi kxonahe 'alaakeneheme ('ataasegadedaacaweme)
geetaaheme basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawene hulu `awaaqi nawe kafiluneme nabiyaate bakafilu laaye ba'eregethe 'abelethanaale daawedeneme zaburene sathetanawaale
<<'enaziyaane ka'eresu leelaa ('amaalekete) yametelwacawene theru ka'enaanetame laaye gudaatene maasewagadene (wada leelaa) maazoreneme 'ayecelume>> balaacawe;

'enaziyaa 'enaresu yamigegazwacawe maanenyaacaweme (wada 'alaahe) bathaame qaraabiyaacawe wada geetaacawe maqaarabiyaane (szeraa) yefalegaalu 'ezenatuneme yekajelaalu qethaatuneme yefaraalu yageetaahe qethaate yamifaraa nawenaa
'anediteme katamaa yalaceme 'enyaa kateneszaa'ee qane bafite 'athefiwocewaa wayeme beretune qethaate qachewocewaa benekxone 'eneji yehe bamatsehhafu yatatsaafa nawe

taameraatoceneme kamalaake yaqademowocu sawoce ba'ereswa maasetabaabalenaa (mathefaate) 'eneji leelaa 'alekalakalaneme lasamudeme gemalene geletse ta`aamere kxonaa sathanaacawe ba'ereswame badalu ta`aameraatoceneme lamaasefaraaraate 'eneji 'anenelekeme

laanetame geetaahe (`eweqatu) basawocu kababa baalenehe gizee ('asetaawese) yaaceneme (baleelitu guzo ba`aayenehe) yaasaayanehene tere`eyete lasawoce fatanaa 'eneji 'alaadaragenaateme baqure'aaneme yataragamacewene zaafe ('enedazihu fatanaa 'eneji 'alaadarageneme) 'enaasefaraaraacawaalaneme; taalaaqeneme themate 'eneji 'ayechamerelaacaweme
lamalaa'eketeme la'adame segadu baalenaacawe gizee ('asetaawese) wadiyaaweme sagadu; belise becaa siqare <<kacheqaa lafatharekawe sawe 'esagedaalahune>> 'ala
<<negaranye yehe yaa ba'enee laaye yaabalathekawe nawene 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase betaaqoyanye zarocune theqitoce siqaru wada sehetate ba'eregethe 'esebaacawaalahu>> 'ala
('alaaheme) 'alawe <<kxide; ka'enasume yatakatalahe gahaname yatamwalaace qethaate setekxone fedaacehu naate

<<ka'enasu yacaalekaweneme sawe bademetsehe 'ataale ba'enasume laaye bafarasanyocehe, ba'egeranyoceheme kxonahe lalebe baganezabocaacaweme, balejocaacaweme tagaaraacawe, tasefaa qaaleme gebaalaacawe sayethaaneme maataalalene 'eneji tasefaa qaalene 'ayegabaalaacaweme
<<baarocee ba'enasu laaye fatsemo laaneta selethaane yalaheme mathagiyaame bageetaahe baqaa >>
geetaacehu yaa kacerotaawe tefalegu zanede marekabocene babaahhere laye la'enaaneta yaminadaalaacehu nawe 'enaho 'eresu lanaaneta 'azaanye nawenaa

babaahherume wesethe gudaate baaganyaacehu gizee yametetharuwaacawe ('amaalekete) hulu ka'eresu (ka'alaahe) baqare yethafaalu wada yabeseme bamaaderase baadaanaacehu gizee ('emenatene) tetawaalaacehu saweme bathaame kahhaadi nawe
yayabesune bakule (mederene) ba'enaaneta magalebathune wayeme thatharene yayaaza nefaasene ba'enaaneta laaye malaakune kaziyaame la'enaaneta thabaaqi 'alamaagenyataacehune 'atefarumene

wayese leelaa gizee wada 'eresu (wada baahhere) yamimalesaacehu wadiyaaweme ba'enaaneta laaye beretune nafaase yamileke bakehhedataacehume mekeneyaate yamiyaasathemaacehu makxonune kaziyaame banyaa laaye ba'eresu takataayene (radaatene) la'enaaneta yamaataaganyu makxonaacehune 'atefarumene

ya'adameneme lejoce ba'eregethe (kaleelaawe fethure) 'akabarenaacawe bayabesenaa babaahereme 'asaafarenaacawe kamalekaamoceme (sisaayoce) sathanaacawe kafatharenaacaweme fethuroce babezuwocu laaye maabelathene 'abalathenaacawe

sawocene hulu bamariyaacawe yamenetharaabatene qane ('asetaawese) matsehhafuneme baqanyu yatasatha sawe 'enaziyaa matsehhafaacawene yaanabaalu batamere feree senetheqe laaye yaalawene kere yaakele 'enekwaa 'ayebadalume
baziheceme `aalame (leba) `ewere yakxona sawe 'eresu bamacharashaayetume (`aalame) yebalethe `ewere nawe manegadeneme bathaame yatasaasaata nawe;
'enaho kaziyaame wada 'aneta kaawaradenawe leelaane ba'enyaa laaye tewaashe zanede lifatenuhe ba'eregethe taqaarabu yaane gizeeme wadaaje 'aderegawe bayaazuhe nabare
baalaaragaaneheme noro wadanasu theqitene (zenebaalee) letezanabale ba'eregethe bataqaarabeke nabare
yaane gizee yahheyewatene derebe (qethaate) yamoteneme derebe (qethaate) baaqamasenehe nabare kaziyaame laaneta banyaa laaye radaatene 'ataaganyeme nabare
kamederitume (ka`aarabe medere) kareswa yaawathuhe zanede liyaashaberuhe ba'eregethe taqaarabu yaane gizeeme ka'aneta baxwaalaa theqitene gizee 'eneji 'ayeqoyume nabare
kamaleketanyocaacene kaaneta bafite ba'eregethe 'enedalaakenaacawe sawoce lemaade bethee (yethafu nabare) lalemaadaaceneme malawathene 'ataaganyeme
solaatene katzahhaye mazanebale 'eseka leelite chalamaa derase segade yagoheneme solaate segade yagohe solaate (malaa'ekete) yamithaadute nawenaa
kaleeliteme laaneta tachamaari yakxonacene solaate ba'eresu (baqure'aane) segade geetaahe mesegune bakxona seferaa ba'eregethe yaaqomehaale
baleme geetaayee hoye! yatawadadane maagebaate 'agebaanye yatawadadaneme maawethaate 'awethaanye la'eneeme ka'aneta zanede yataradaane selethaane 'aderegelenye
baleme <<'ewenate mathaa weshateme tawagada; 'enaho weshate tawagaaje nawenaa >>
kaqure'aaneme lame'emanaane madexanitenaa 'ezenate yakxonane 'enaawaredaalane badaayoceneme kasaaraane 'eneji leelaa 'ayechamerelaacaweme
basaweme laaye tsagaacenene balagasene gizee (kamesegaanaa) yezoraale gonuneme (ka'ewenate) yaareqaale cegereme banakaawe gizee tasefaa qoraache yekxonaale
<<hulume bamimaselawe manegadu laaye yeszaraale geetaacehume 'eresu manegadu qathetanyaa yakxonawene sawe `awaaqi nawe balaacawe
karuhheme yethayequhaale <<ruhhe kageetaayee nagare nawe ka`eweqateme theqitene 'eneji 'aletasathaacehume>> balaacawe
beneshaame yaanene wadaaneta yaawaradenawene ba'eregethe 'enaasewagedaalane kaziyaame laaneta ba'enyaa laaye baresu (lamaasemalase) tayaazhine 'ataaganyeme
gene kageetaahe bakxonawe 'ezenate (thabaqenawe) cerotaawe baaneta laaye taalaaqe nawenaa;
<<sawoceme gaaneenoceme yazihene qure'aane bethee bamaamethaate laaye bisabasabu kafilaacawe lakafilu radaate bihoneme 'enekwaa betheewene 'ayaamathume>> balaacawe
baziheme qure'aane wesethe kamesaaleewe hulu lasawoce ba'eregethe malaalasene 'abezaanyocume sawoce kehedatene 'eneji leelaane 'emebi 'alu
'alume <<lanyaa kamedere menechene 'esekametaafanadaane la'aneta 'anaameneme >>
<<wayeme kazamebaabaawocenaa kawayene yakxonace 'atekelete la'aneta 'esekametenorehenaa bamakaakalewaame jiratocene babezaate 'esekametaanebwabwa
<<wayeme 'enedametelawe kasamaaye quraachocene banyaa laaye 'esekametaawadeqe; wayeme 'alaahenenaa malaa'eketene bageletse 'esekametaamathaa

<<wayeme kawareqe yakxona beete laaneta 'esekaminorehe; wayeme basamaaye 'esekametewathaa; lamawethaateheme ba'enyaa laaye yamenaanabawe yakxonane matsehhafe 'esekametaawaredelene derase fatsemo 'anaameneleheme>> ('alu) <<geetaayee theraate yegabaawe; 'enee sawe maleketanyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe
sawoceneme mari (qure'aane) bamathaalaacawe gizee kamaamane <<'alaahe sawene maleketanyaa 'aderego laakane>> maalataacawe 'eneji leelaa 'alekalakalaacaweme
<<bamedere laaye ragetawe yamikxeedu malaa'ekete banabaru noro ba'enasu laaye (kagosaacawe) yamale'akene maleketanyaa baawaradene nabare>> balaacawe
<<ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale masekaari ba'alaahe baqaa 'eresu babaarocu (nagare) wesethe `awaaqi tamalekaace nawenaa>> balaacawe

'alaaheme yaaqanaawe sawe qenu 'eresu becaa nawe yaathamamaacaweme sawoce ka'eresu leelaa la'enaresu fatsemo radaate 'ataaganyelaacaweme bateneszaa'ee qaneme `eweroce, didaawoceme daneqorowoceme kxonawe bafitocaacawe laaye ('eyatagotatu) 'enesabasebaacawaalane manoriyaacawe gahaname naate (nadidewaa) badakamace quthere maneqaleqalene 'enechamerebaacawaalane;
yehe (qethaate); 'enaresu ba'aneqatsocaacene sela kaadunaa <<'athenetocenaa besebesoce bakxone gizee 'enyaa 'adise fetherate kxonane taqaseqaashoce nane>> selaalume fedaacawe nawe

yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathara 'alaahe betheeyaacawene bamafethare laaye caaye makxonune ba'eresu therethaaree yaleelabateme gizee (lamoteme lateneszaa'eeme) la'enaresu yawasana makxonune 'alaawaqumene badalanyoceme kakehedate baqare 'emebi 'alu
<<'enaaneta yageetaayeene yacerotaa makaazinoce beteyezu noro yaane gizee bamaawethaataacehu maalaqwaane bamaferaate bachabathaacehu nabare saweme bathaame qothaabi nawe >>

lamusaame geletse yakxonune zathanye ta`aameraatoce ba'eregethe sathanawe bamathaacaweme gizee ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce (kafare`one 'enedilaqaqu) thayeqe ('alenawe) fare`oneme <<musaa hoye! 'enee yatadagamabehe makxonehene ba'eregethe 'etharatheraalahu>> 'alawe

(musaame) <<'enazihene (ta`aameraatoce) magasachaawoce sikxonu yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa 'eneji leelaa 'enedaalaawaradaacawe ba'eregethe `aweqahaale 'eneeme fare`one hoye! yametethafaa makxonehene ba'eregethe 'etharatherehaalahu>> 'alawe
kamedereme liqasaqesaacawe 'asaba 'eresunenaa ka'eresu gaare yanabaruteneme sawoce huluneme 'asathamenaacawe
ka'eresume baxwaalaa la'esaraa'eele lejoce <<mederitune taqamathubaate yaxwaalanyaayetume (sa`aate) qatharo bamathaa gizee 'enaanetane yatakamaacaacehu setekxonu 'enaamathaacexwaalane>> 'alenaacawe
(qure'aanene) bawenateme 'awaradenawe ba'ewenateme warada 'anetaneme 'abesaarinaa 'asethaneqaaqi 'aderegane 'eneji 'alelaakeneheme
qure'aaneneme basawoce laaye bazegetaa laaye kxonahe taanabawe zanede kafaafalenawe qase baqase maaweradeneme 'awaradenawe
<<ba'eresu 'emanu wayeme 'atemanu>> balaacawe; 'enaziyaa ka'eresu bafite `eweqatene yatasathute ba'enasu laaye batanababa gizee sagaajoce kxonawe bashanegobatocaacawe laaye yewadeqaalu;
yelaalume <<geetaacene theraate yegabaawe! 'enaho yageetaacene tasefaa tafatsaami nawe >>
'eyaalaqasume bashanegobatocaacawe laaye yewadeqaalu ('alaahene) maferaateneme yechameraalaacawaale

<<'alaahene theru; wayeme 'alerahhemaanene theru; (kahulatu) maanenyaaweneme betetharu (malekaame nawe) la'eresu malekaame semoce 'alutenaa>> balaacawe basegedateheme (setaanabe) 'atechuhe ba'ereswame demetsehene zeqe 'ataaderege baziheme makaakale manegadene falege
<<mesegaanaa la'alaahe laziyaa lejene laaleyaazawe, la'eresume banegeszenaawe tagaari laleelawe, la'eresume kaweredate radaate laleelawe yegabaawe baleme maakebareneme 'akeberawe >>
mesegaanaa la'alaahe laziyaa matsehhafune bawesethu mathaamamene yaalaadaragabate sihone babaariyaawe laaye laawaradawe yegabaawe

qathetanyaa sihone ka'eresu zanede yakxonane beretune qethaate liyaasefaraaraabate, 'enaziyaaneme bago szeraawocene yamiszarutene me'emanaane lanasu malekaame menedaa yaalaacawe makxonune liyaabaserebate; ('awaradawe)
ba'eresu wesethe zala`aalame yamiqoyubate sikxonu (yaalaacawe makxonune)
'enaziyaaneme <<'alaahe lejene yezwale>> yaalutene liyaasefaraaraabate ('awaradawe)
la'enasume la'abaatocaacaweme baresu meneme 'eweqate yalaacaweme ka'afocaacawe yametewathaawene qaale mene 'akabadaate! weshatene 'eneji 'ayenaagarume
baziheme negegere (baqure'aane) baayaamenu bafalagocaacawe laaye baquchete nafesehene 'athefi letehone yefaraalehaale
'enyaa maanenyaacawe szeraawe yaamaara makxonune lenefatenaacawe bamedere laaye yaalane hulu la'ereswa geethe 'adaragene;
'enyaame ba'ereswa laaye yaalawene (bamacharashaa) ba'eregethe baqaaye yaleelabate melethe `afare 'aderaagiwoce nane
yawaashaawenaa yasaleedaawe baalabeetoce kata`aameraatocaacene sihonu gerume mahonaacawene 'asabekene
gobazocu wada waashaawe batathagunaa <<geetaacene hoye! ka'aneta zanede 'ezenatene sethane; la'enyaame kanagaraacene qenene 'azagaajelene>> baalu gizee ('asetaawese)
bawaashaaweme wesethe yataqotharune `aamataate bajorowocaacawe laaye mataanebaacawe
kaziyaame kahulatu kefeloce laqoyute gizee leke yaaragaagathawe maanenyaawe mahonune lenaaweqe 'asenasaanaacawe
'enyaa wareeyaacawene ba'aneta laaye ba'ewenate 'enetarekaalane 'enasu bageetaacawe yaamanu gobazoce naacawe mamaraateneme chamarenelaacawe

(baneguszaacawe fite) baqomunaa <<geetaacene yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaakene 'anegazaame yaane gizee (leelaane benaamaleke) wasane yaalafane (negegere) ba'eregethe tanaagarene >> baalu gizee lebocaacawene 'athanakarene

<<'enazihe hhezebocaacene ka'eresu leelaa 'amaaleketene yaazu; ('ewenatanyoce kakxonu) ba'enaresu laaye geletse maaserajaane lamene 'ayaamathume ba'alaaheme laaye weshatene kamiqathaathefe yebalethe badaaye maanawe>> ('alu)

<<'enaresunenaa yaanene ka'alaahe leelaa yamigegazutene batalayaacehu gizee wada waashaawe tathagu geetaacehu la'enaaneta kacerotaawe yezaragaalaacexwaalenaa; kanagaraacehume la'enaaneta mathaqaaqamiyaane yaazagaajelaacexwaale>> (tabaabaalu)

tzahhayeneme bawathaace gizee kawaashaacawe wada qanye gone setaazanabele taayaataalahe bagabaaceme gizee 'enaresu ka'eresu basafiwe seferaa wesethe kxonawe saalu wada geraa bakule tetawaacawaalace yehe ka'alaahe ta`aameraatoce nawe 'alaahe yamiyaaqanaawe sawe qenu 'eresu becaa nawe yamiyaathamaweme sawe laresu 'aqenyene radaate 'ataaganyelateme

'enasume yatanyu honawe saalu (`aayenocaacawe bamakafataacawe) nequwoce naacawe belahe taasebaacawaalahe wada qanye gonenaa wada geraa goneme 'enaagalaabethaacawaalane weshaacaweme hulate kenedocune bawaashaawe bare laaye zaregetwale ba'enasu laaye zaleqahe betaaye noro yameteshashe kxonahe bazoreke nabare ka'enasume ba'eregethe ferehaatene batamalaahe nabare

'enedihume bamakaakalaacawe 'enedithayaayaqu qasaqasenaacawe ka'enasu 'anede tanaagaari <<mene yaakele qoyaacehu>> 'ala <<'anedene qane wayeme yaqanene kafile qoyane>> 'alu <<geetaacehu yaqoyaacehutene gizee leke `awaaqi nawe kaziheceme beraacehu gaare 'anedaacehune wada katamaayetu laaku kamegebocwa yatenyaawaa netsuhhe mahonwaneme yemalekate ka'eresume (kanetsuhhu) megebene yaamethaalaacehu qaseme yebale ba'enaanetame 'anedeneme sawe 'ayaasaaweqe>> 'alu
<<'enasu ba'enaaneta laaye bizalequ yeqathaqethwacexwaalenaa wayeme wada haayemaanotaacawe yemaleswacexwaale yaanegizeeme bafetsume felaagotaacehune 'ataaganyume>> (tabaabaalu)

'enedazihume ya'alaahe qatharo 'eregethanyaa mahonune sa`aatitume bareswa therethaaree yaleela mahonune yaawequ zanede ba'enaresu laaye (sawocene) 'asaawaqene ('amaanyocunaa kahhaadiwocu) nagaraacawene bamakaakalaacawe sikaraakaru (yahonawene 'asetaawese; kahhaadiwocu) - <<ba'enasu laayeme genebene ganebu>> 'alu geetaacawe ba'enasu yebalethe `awaaqi nawe 'enaziyaa banagaraacawe laaye yaashanafute (me'emanaane) <<ba'enasu laaye ba'eregethe masegidene 'eneszaraalane>> 'alu

baruqe warewaariwoce honawe (batherethaaree) <<szosete naacawe; 'araatanyaacawe weshaacawe nawe>> yelaalu <<'amesete naacawe; sedesetanyaacawe weshaacawe naweme>> yelaalu <<sabaate naacawe; semenetanyaacaweme weshaacawe nawe>> yelaalume <<geetaayee qutheraacawene `awaaqi nawe theqite (sawe) 'eneji 'ayaaweqaacaweme>> balaacawe ba'enasume nagare geletsene kerekere 'eneji (thaleqahe) 'atekaraakare ba'enasume gudaaye kanasu (kamatsehhafu sawoce) 'anedeneme 'atethayeqe
lamaanenyaaweme nagare <<'enee yehenene naga szari nanyeme>> 'atebale
<<'alaahe yashaa 'eneda hona ('esaraawaalahu)>> betele 'eneji barasaaheme gizee geetaahene 'awesaa <<geetaayeeme kazihe yebalethe laqathetaa yaqarabane limaraanye yekajalaale>> balaacawe
bawaashaacaweme wesethe sosete mato `aamataatene qoyu zathanyeneme chamaru

<<'alaahe yaqoyutene leke `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere mesethire ya'esu becaa nawe 'eresu mene yaaye! mene yesamaame! la'enaresu ka'eresu baqare meneme radaate yalaacaweme baferedume 'anedeneme 'ayaagaaraame
kageetaaheme matsehhafe wada 'aneta yatawaradawene 'anebebe laqaalaatocu lawaache yalaacaweme ka'eresume baqare mathagiyaane bafetsume 'ataaganyeme

nafeseheneme; ka'enaziyaa geetaacawene fitune (wedeetaawene) yamishu kxonawe bathwatenaa bamaataa kamigegazute gaare 'asetaagese yaqerebituneme hheyewate shelemaate yameteshaa honahe `aayenocehe ka'enasu (wada leelaa) 'ayelafu lebuneme 'enyaane kamaasetaawase yaazanagaanawene felaagotuneme yatakatalawene nagarume hulu wasane maalafe yahonawene sawe 'atetaazaze

<<'ewenatume kageetaacehu nawe yashaame sawe yemane; yashaame sawe yekaade>> balaacawe 'enyaa labadalanyoce 'atherwa ba'enasu yakababa yakxonacewene 'esaate 'azagaajetanaale (katheme) 'eredaataaneme bifalegu 'eneda zayete zeqaache baala fitocene bamithabese wehaa yeradaalu mathathu kafaa! madagafiyaayetume menenyaa 'asekafaace!
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru 'enyaa szeraane yaasaamarane sawe menedaa 'anaathafaame

'enaziyaa la'enasu yamanoriyaa ganatoce kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe 'alwacawe ba'ereswa wesethe kawareqe yakxonune 'anebaaroce yeshalamaalu kaqachene hharenaa kawaferaame hhareme 'aranegwaadeene lebesoce yelabesaalu bawesethwa babaala 'agobare 'alegaawoce laaye yatadagafu kxonawe (yeqamathaalu) menedaacawe mene yaamere! madagafiyaayetume menenyaa 'amaarace!

la'enasume yahulatene sawoce mesaalee gelatselaacawe la'anedanyaacawe (lakahhaadiwe) kawayenoce yakxonune hulate 'atekeletoce 'adaragenelate bazamebaabaame 'akababenaacawe bamakaakalaacaweme 'azemaraane 'adaragene
hulatume 'atekeletoce sabelaacawene sathu ka'eresume meneme 'alaagodalume bamakaakalaacaweme wanezene 'afasasene

la'eresume (ka'atekeletocu leelaa fereeyaamaa) habete nabarawe lagwaadanyaaweme (la'amaanyu) 'eresu yamiwadaadarawe sikxone <<'enee kaaneta baganezabe yebalethe yabazaahu bawaganeme yebalethe yabarataahu nanye>> 'alawe
'eresume nafesune badaaye kxono wada 'atekeletu gabaa <<yehece zala`aalame tethafaalace beyee 'aletharathereme>> 'ala
<<sa`aatituneme qwaami (xwaanye) naate beyee 'aletharathereme ('enedametelawe) wada geetaayeeme bemalase ka'ereswa yabalathane mamalashaa ba'eregethe 'aganyaalahu>> ('alawe)
gwaadanyaawe ('amaanyu) 'eresu la'eresu yamimalaalasawe sikxone <<baziyaa ka`afare, kaziyaame kafetewate thabetaa kafatharahe, kaziyaame sawe baadaragahe ('amelaake) kaadekene>> 'alawe
<<'enee gene 'eresu 'alaahe geetaayee nawe; ('elaalahu) bageetaayeeme 'anedeneme 'alaagaaraame
<<'atekeleteheneme bagabaahe gizee 'alaahe yashaawe yekxonaale; ba'alaahe bikxone 'eneji xayele yalame; 'ateleme norwalene 'eneene baganezabeme balejeme kaaneta bathaame yaanaseku honyee betaayanye
<<geetaayee ka'atekeletehe yabalathane lisathanye bareswame (ba'atekeletehe) laaye kasamaaye maberaqocene lilekebaatenaa yametaanedaalethe melethe medere letekxone yecaalaale
wayeme wehaawe szaraagi likxone (yecelaale) yaane gizee laresu mafalagene fatsemo 'ateceleme>> ('alawe)

habetume tathafaa 'ereswa badaasocwa laaye yawadaqace kxonaa ba'ereswa baawathaawe ganezabe laaye ('eyatatsatsata) madaafocune yamiyaagalaabethenaa <<waye tsatsatee! bageetaayee 'anedeme baalaagaaraahu>> yamile kxona
la'eresume ka'alaahe leelaa yamiradute cheferoce 'alenabaruteme tarajime 'alenabarame
'eziyaa zanede (bateneszaa'ee qane) selethaanu 'ewenatanyaa lakxonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe 'eresu bamamanedaate yabalatha fetsaameeneme bamaasaamare yabalatha nawe

la'enasume yaqerebitune hheyewate mesaalee 'awesaalaacawe ('ereswa) kasamaaye 'enedaawaradenawe wehaa ba'eresume yamedere baqaaye 'eneda taqalaaqalabate (katawaaba baxwaalaa dareqo) nafaasoceme yamiyaabanute daqaaqe 'eneda kxona bethee naate 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
ganezabenaa wanedoce lejoce yaqerebitu hheyewate geethoce naacawe malekaamocume qariwoce (szeraawoce) 'egeetaahe zanede bamenedaa balaache naacawe batasefaame balaache naacawe;
taraaraawoceneme yamenaasekxeedebatene qane ('asetaawese) medereneme geletse kxonaa taayaataalahe 'enesabasebaacawaalaneme ka'enasume 'anedeneme 'anetaweme

yatasalafume kxonawe bageetaahe laaye yeqarabaalu (yebaalaalume) <<bamajamariyaa gizee 'eneda fatharenaacehu (raaqutaacehune) ba'eregethe mathaacehune ba'ewenatu la'enaaneta (lamaqaseqashaa) gizeene 'anaadaregeme maselwacehu nabare >>

(lasawe hulu) matsehhafume yeqarebaale wadiyaaweme kahhaadiwocene bawesethu kaalawe nagare fariwoce kxonawe taayaacawaalahe <<waa thefaataacene! lazihe matsehhafe (kaszeraa) tenesheneme teleqeneme yaqotharaate bikxone 'eneji yamaayetawawe mene 'alawe>> yelaalume yasaruteneme nagare hulu qaraabi kxono yaaganyutaale geetaaheme 'anedeneme 'ayebadeleme

lamalaa'eketeme la'adame segadu baalenaacawe gizee (yakxonawene 'asetaawese) wadiyaaweme sagadu; belise becaa siqare kagaaneene (gosaa) nabare kageetaaweme te'ezaaze wathaa 'eresunenaa zarocune 'enaresu la'enaaneta thalaatoce sikxonu ka'enee laaye radaatoce 'aderegaacehu teyezaalaacehune labadaayoce lewaachenatu kafaa!
yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene 'afathaathare 'alaasaayaxwaacaweme yanafesocaacaweneme 'afathaathare ('enedazihu) 'asaasaacoceneme radaatoce 'aderegee yameyeze 'ayedalahume

<<'enaziyaaneme ('amelaake) yametelwacawene tagaariwoceene theru>> yamilebatene qane ('asetaawese) yetharwacawaaleme gene 'ayemalesulaacaweme bamakaakalaacaweme mathefiyaane seferaa (gahanamene) 'adaragene
kahhaadiwoceme 'esaatene yaayaalu 'enaresume bawesethwa wadaaqiwoce makxonaacawene yaaragaagethaalu ka'ereswame mashashaane 'ayaaganyume
baziheme qure'aane wesethe kayamesaaleewe hulu lasawoce malaalesane galatsene saweme kanagaru hulu yebalethe kerekera bezu nawe

sawoceneme mameriyaa bamathaalaacawe gizee kamaamanenaa geetaacaweneme mehheratene kamalamane yamajamariwocu (hhezeboce) lemaade (mathefaate) letemathaabaacawe wayeme qethaatu bayaayenatu limathaabaacawe (mathabaabaqe) 'eneji leelaa 'alekalakalaacaweme

maleketanyoceneme 'abesaariwocenaa 'asefaraariwoce kxonawe 'eneji 'anelekeme 'enaziyaa yakaaduteme baweshate 'ewenatune ba'esu liyaabalaashu yekaraakaraalu 'aneqatsoceenenaa ba'eresu yatasefaraarubateneme nagare maalaagachaa 'aderegawe yaazu

bageetaaweme 'aneqatsoce katagasatsanaa ka'ereswa kazora 'ejocume yaaseqadamutene nagare karasaa sawe yebalethe badaaye maanawe 'enyaa balebocaacawe laaye 'enedaayaawequte shifaanocene bajorowocaacaweme wesethe denequrenaane 'adaragene wada mamaraateme betetharaacawe yaane gizee fatsemo 'ayememarume

geetaaheme bathaame mahaariwe ya'ezenate baalabeetu nawe baszarute szeraa biyezaacawe noro qethaatune la'enasu baasecakolabaacawe nabare gene la'enasu ka'eresu leelaa mathagiyaane fatsemo yamaayaaganyubate qatharo 'alaacawe
'enazihe katamoceme babadalu gizee 'athafaanaacawe lamathefiyaacaweme yatawasana gizeene 'adaragene
musaame lawathaatu <<yahulatune baahheroce maganaanyaa 'esekamedarese wayeme bezune gizee 'esekamekxeede derase (kamagwaaze) 'alewagademe>> yaalawene ('asetaawese)
yahulatune maganaanyaa badarasume gizee `aszaacawene rasu (`aszaawe) manegaduneme babaaheru wesethe qadaadaa 'aderego yaaza
baalafume gizee lawathaatu <<mesaacenene sethane kazihe guzwacene ba'eregethe dekaamene 'agenyetanaalenaa>> 'ala

<<'ayahene wada qwaathenyewaa batathagaane gizee 'enee `aszaawene rasaahu maasetaawasuneme sayethaane 'eneji leelaa 'alaaserasaanyeme babaahherume wesethe manegadune 'asedanaaqi (manegade) 'aderego yaaza>> 'ala
(musaame) yehe 'enefalegawe yanabarenawe nawe 'alawe bafalagocaacaweme laaye 'eyatakatalu tamalasu
kabaarocaaceneme ka'enyaa zanede cerotaane yasathanawene ka'enyaame zanede `eweqatene yaasetamaarenawene 'anedene baariyaa (kxaderene) 'aganyu
musaa la'eresu <<katamaarekawe nagare qathetanyaane (`eweqate) taasetameranye zanede lekatalehene>> 'alawe
(baariyaaweme) 'ala <<'aneta ka'enee gaare mataagasene bacheraashe 'ateceleme
<<ba`eweqateme ba'eresu baalaadaarasekawe nagare laaye 'enedeete tetaagasaalahe>>
(musaa) <<'alaahe yashaa 'eneda kxona taagaashenaa laaneta te`ezaazene yamaalethese kxonyee taaganyanyaalahe>> 'alawe
<<betekatalanyeme la'aneta ka'eresu maawesaatene 'esekamejamerelehe derase kameneme nagare 'atethayeqanye>> 'alawe
kxeedume bamarekabitume batasaafaru gizee qadadaate <<baala beetocwane letaasatheme qadadekaatene teleqe nagarene ba'eregethe szaraahe>> 'alawe
<<'aneta kanee gaare te'egeszetene fatsemo 'ateceleme 'alaalekumene>> 'ala
<<barasaahute nagare 'ateyaazanye kanagareeme cegerene 'ataashakemanye>> 'alawe
(waredawe) tagwaazume wathaateneme leje baaganyunaa bagadalawe; <<gizee yaala nafese (magedale) netsuhhene nafese gadalekene ba'eregethe mathefone nagare szeraahe>> 'alawe
<<'aneta kanee gaare te'egeszetene fatsemo 'ateceleme 'alaalekuhemene>> 'ala
<<kareswa (ka'ahunitu gizee) baxwaalaa kameneme nagare bethayeqehe 'ategodaanyanye ka'enee yayeqeretaane macharashaa ba'eregethe daresahaale>> 'alawe

kxeedume wada 'anedite katamaa sawoce bamathume gizee nawaariwocwane megebene thayaqu kamaasetanaagadaacaweme 'emebi 'alu ba'ereswame wesethe lamawedaqe yataqaarabane gedegedaa 'aganyu (kxadere) 'aqomaweme (musaame) <<bashaahe noro ba'eresu laaye waagaane bataqabaleke nabare>> 'alawe
(kxadere) 'ala <<yehe ba'eneenaa ba'aneta makaakale malayaayaa nawe ba'eresu laaye mataagasene yaalecaalekebatene fece 'enagerehaalahu
<<marekabitumaa babaahhere lamiszaru mesekinoce nabarace kaxwaalaacaweme marekabene hulu baqemiyaa yamiyeze negusze nabaranaa; ('enedaayeqamaacawe) laanaweraate faqadeku
<<wathaatume lejemaa walaajocu me'emanaane nabaru (biyaadege) te'ebitenenaa kehedateneme yamiyaasegadedaacawe makxonune faraane
<<geetaacaweme banetsuhhenate ka'eresu balaachene ba'ezenateme ka'eresu bathaame qaraabine leje lilawethelaacawe falagene

<<gedegedaawemaa bakatamaayetu wesethe yanabaru yahulate yatimoce wathaatoce nabare baszerume la'enaresu yakxona (yataqabara) delebe nabara 'abaataacaweme malekaame sawe nabare geetaaheme la'akaala mathane 'enedidaresunaa kageetaahe cerotaa delebaacawene 'enediyaawathu faqada bafaqaadeeme 'aleszaraahuteme yehe ba'eresu laaye mataagasene yaalecaalekawe nagare fece nawe>> ('alawe)
kazuleqarenayeneme yethayequhaale <<ba'enaaneta laaye ka'eresu wareene 'anabaalahu;>> balaacawe
'enyaa la'eresu bamedere 'asemacanawe kanagarume hulu (madaarashaa) manegadene sathanawe
manegadeneme (wada me`eraabe) takatala

wada tzahhaye magebiyaame badarasa gizee thequre cheqaa baalaate meneche wesethe setethaleqe 'aganyaate baathagabwame hhezebocene 'aganya <<zuleqarenayene hoye! wayeme (bamagedale) teqathaalahe wayeme ba'enaresu malekaame nagarene (mamaarakene) teszaraalahe>> 'alenawe;
<<yabadalawene sawemaa wadafite 'eneqathaawaalane kaziyaame wada geetaawe yemalasaale beretuneme qethaate yeqathaawaale>> 'ala
<<yaamaname sawemaa malekaameneme szeraa yaszaraa la'eresu kamenedaa bakule malekaamitu (ganate) 'alacewe la'eresume kate'ezaazaacene garene nagare 'enaazawaalane>> ('ala)
kaziyaame manegadene (wada meszeraaqe) qathala
wada tzahhaye mawechaa badarasame gizee la'enasu kabataacewaa makalayaane baalaadaragenelaacawe hhezeboce laaye setewathaa 'aganyaate
(nagaru) 'enedazihu nawe 'eresume zanede baalawe nagare hulu ba'eregethe ba`eweqate kababene
kaziyaame (wada sameene 'aqethaachaa) manegadene qathala
bahulatu gaaraawoceme makaakale badarasa gizee ba'aqeraabiyaacawe negegerene lamaawaqe yamaayeqaarabu hhezebocene 'aganya
<<zuleqarenayene hoye! ya'ejujenaa ma'ejuje bamedere laaye 'abalaashiwoce naacawenaa ba'enyaanaa ba'enasu makaakale gedebene taadaregelene zanede geberene 'enaaderegelehene>> 'alu
'ala <<geetaayee ba'eresu yaasemacanye habete (kanaaneta gebere) balaache nawe selazihe bagulebate 'egazunye ba'enaanetanaa ba'enasu makaakale beretune gedebe 'adaregaalahunaa

<<yaberatene taalaalaaqe quraachoce sethunye>> ('alaacawe) bahulatu korabetaawoce (chaafe) makaakaleme baasetakaakala gizee 'anaafu 'alaacawe (beratune) 'esaateme baadaragawe gizee <<yaqalathawene nahhase sethunye; baresu laaye 'afasebataalahunaa>> 'alaacawe
(ya'ejujenaa ma'ejuje) liwathuteme 'alecaalume la'eresu mashaneqoreneme 'alecaalume
<<yehe (gedebe) kageetaayee cerotaa nawe yageetaayame qatharo bamathaa gizee tekekele medere yaadaregawaale yageetaayeeme qatharo taragaagatha nawe>> 'ala
baziyaame qane kafilaacawene bakafilu yamiqalaaqalu 'aderegane 'enetawaacawaalane baqanedume yenafaale masabesabeneme 'enesabasebaacawaalane;
gahanameneme baziyaa qane lakahhaadiwoce bathaame maaqerabene 'enaaqarebaataalane
laziyaa `aayenocaacawe kagesaatseeyee bashifaane wesethe lanabarutenaa masemaateneme yamaayecelu lanabarute ('enaaqarebaataalane)
'enaziyaa yakaadute baaroceene ka'enee leelaa 'amaalekete 'aderegawe mayaazaacawene (yamaayaaseqothaanye 'aderegawe) 'asabune 'enyaa gahanamene lakahhaadiwoce masetanegedo 'azagaajetanaale
<<baszeraawoce bathaame kasaariwocune 'enenegaraacehune>> balaacawe
'enaziyaa 'enasu szeraane yamiyaasaameru yamimaselaacawe sihonu baqerebitu hheyewate szeraacawe yathafaabaacawe naacawe
'enaziyaa 'enaresu bageetaacawe maaserajaawocenaa bamaganaanyatu yakaadute naacawe szeraawocaacaweme tabalaashu la'enasume bateneszaa'ee qane (thaqaami) mizaanene 'anaaqomelaacaweme
(nagaru) yehe nawe bakehedataacawe 'aneqatsoceenenaa maleketanyoceeneme masaalaqiyaa 'aderegawe bamayaazaacawe fedaacawe gahaname nawe
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru yafiredawese ganatoce la'enasu masefariyaa naacawe
ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce ka'ereswa mazaawarene yamaayefalegu sikxonu; (masefariyaacawe nawe)
<<baahheru lageetaayee qaalaate (matsaafiyaa) qalamocene bahona noro betheewene chemaari benaamathaame 'enekwaane yageetaayee qaalaate kamaalaqwaa bafite baahheru baalaqa nabare>> balaacawe

<<'enee 'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe maalate wadanee yamiwaradelenye bitheeyaacehu sawe becaa nanye yageetaaweneme maganaanyate yamifalege sawe; malekaame szeraane yeszeraa bageetaaweme magazaate 'anedeneme 'ayaagaaraa>> balaacawe
ka.ha.ya.`a.tsa (kaafe haa yaa `aayene swade)
(yehe) geetaahe baariyaawene zakariyaane bacerotaawe yaawasaabate nawe
geetaawene yamesethirene theri batathaaraa gizee ('asetaawese)
'ala <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee 'athenetee dakama; raaseeme bashibate taneqalaqala; 'anetame bamalamanee geetaayee hoye! (menegizeeme) `edela bise 'alehonekume
<<'eneeme kabaxwaalaayee zamadoceene ba'eregethe faraahu miseteeme makaane nabarace selazihe ka'aneta zanede lanee lejene sethanye
<<yamiwaresanye kayaa`eqobe beetasaboceme yamiwarese yahonane (leje) geetaayee hoye! tawadaajeme 'aderegawe >>
<<zakariyaa hoye! 'enyaa bawanede leje semu yahheyaa bakxona kazihe bafite mokesheene baalaadaragenelate 'enaabaserehaalane>> ('alawe)
<<geetaayee hoye! misetee makaane yanabarace setekxone 'eneeme ka'erejenaa dereqatene ba'eregethe yadaraseku sekxone 'enedeete leje yenoranyaale!>> 'ala
(jeberile) 'ala <<(nagaru) 'enedazihu nawe geetaahe - ka'ahune bafite meneme yaalenabarekawene yafatharekuhe sekxone 'eresu ba'enee laaye qalaale nawe>> 'ala
<<geetaayee hoye! ('enegediyaawese) la'enee meleketene 'aderegelenye 'ala meleketehe theenaamaa honahe saalahe szosete leelitene (kanaqanaacawe) sawocene lamaanagaagare 'alamacaalehe nawe>> 'alawe
kamekuraabume bahhezebocu laaye wathaa baxtenaa bamaataa (geetaacehune) 'awadesu bamaalateme wadanasu thaqasa
<<yahheyaa hoye! matsehhafune bathebeqe yaaze!>> ('alenawe) thebabeneme bahhetzaanenatu sathanawe
ka'enyaame yahonane rexeraaxee netsehhenaaneme (sathanawe) thenequqeme nabare
lawalaajocume bago szari nabare te`ebitanyaa 'amatsanyaame 'alenabarame
batawaladabate qanenaa bamimotebateme qane, hheyaawe hono baminasaabateme qane salaame ba'esu laaye yehune
bamatsehhafu wesethe mareyameneme kabeetasabwa wada meszeraaqaawi seferaa batalayece gizee (yahonawene taarikwaane) 'awesaa
ka'enasume magaarajaane 'adaragace manefasaacenememe (jiberilene) wadareswa laakene la'ereswame tekekelanyaa sawe hono tamasalalaate
<<'enee ka'aneta ba'alerahhemaane 'ethabaqaalahu geetaahene fari 'eneda honeke ('ateqerabanye)>> 'alace
<<'enee netsuhhene leje la'aneci lesatheshe yageetaashe maleketanyaa nanye>> 'alaate
<<(bagaabecaa) sawe yaalenakaanye honyee 'amanezeraame saalehone la'enee 'enedeete leje yenoranyaale!>> 'alace

'alaate <<(nagaru) 'enedaziheshe nawe >> geetaashe <<'eresu ba'enee laaye gare nawe lasawoceme taamere ka'enyaame cerotaa lenaadaregawe (yehenene szaraane) yatafaradame nagare nawe>> 'ala; (nafaabaateme)
wadiyaawenume 'aragazacewe ba'eresume (bahodwa yezaawe) wada ruqe seferaa galale 'alace
methume wada zanebaabaayetu genede 'asethagaate <<waa menyotee! menawe kazihe bafite bamoteku taraseceeme yaqarahu bahoneku>> 'alace
kabataacwame 'enedihe sile tharaate <<'atezanye geetaashe kabataaceshe teneshene waneze ba'eregethe 'aderegwaale
<<yazamebaabaayetuneme genede wadaaneci wazewezhaate baaneci laaye yabasalane yatamere 'eshate taaragefeleshaalacenaa
<<beyeme, thacheme, tadasaceme 'enee la'alerahhemaane zemetaane taseyaalahu; zaareeme sawene bafetsume 'alaanagaagereme>> baye
ba'eresume yatashakamaciwe honaa wada zamadocwa mathaace <<mareyame hoye! kabaadene nagare ba'eregethe szaraashe>> 'alwate
<<yahaarune 'exete hoye! 'abaateshe mathefo sawe 'alenabarame 'enaatesheme 'amanezeraa 'alenabaraceme>> 'alwate
wadaresume thaqasace <<ba'aneqalebaa yaalane hhetsaane 'enedeete 'enaanaageraalane!>> 'alu
(hhetzaanume) 'ala <<'enee ya'alaahe baariyaa nanye matsehhafene sathetonyaale nabiyeme 'aderegonyaale >>
<<bayateme seferaa behone beruke 'aderegonyaale bahheyewateme 'esekaalahu solaatene bamasegade zakaaneme bamasethate 'azonyaale >>
<<la'enaateeme taazaazhe ('aderegonyaale) te`ebitanyaa 'emebitanyaame 'alaadaraganyeme
<<salaameme ba'enee laaye nawe batawaladehu qane, bamemotebateme qane, hheyaawe kxonyee bameqasaqasebateme qane >>
yehe yamareyame leje `isaa nawe yaa baresu yamitharaatharubate 'ewenatanyaa qaale nawe
la'alaahe lejene mayaaze 'ayegabaaweme (kagudelate hulu) tharaa nagarene bashaa gizee laresu yamilawe <<kxune>> nawe wadiyaaweme yekxonaale
(`isaa 'ala) <<'alaaheme geetaayee geetaacehume nawenaa tagazute yehe qathetanyaa manegade nawe >>
kamakaakalaacaweme 'ahhezaabocu ba'eresu nagare talayaayu la'enaziyaame lakaadute sawoce kataalaaqu qane magaafathe wayolaacawe
bamimathune qane mene sami menese tamalekaace 'adaragaacawe! gene 'amatsanyoce zaaree (bazihe `aalame) bageletse sehetate wesethe naacawe;
'enasume ('ahune) bazenegaatee laaye kxonawe saalu 'enasume yamaayaamenu sikxonu nagaru bamifaradebate gizee yaqulechetune qane 'asefaraaraacawe
'enyaa mederene ba'ereswame laaye yaalawene hulu 'enyaa 'enewaresaalane wadanyaame yemalasaalu
bamatsehhafu wesethe beraahimeneme 'awesaa 'eresu bathaame 'ewenatanyaa nabiye nabarenaa
la'abaatu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<'abaatee hoye! yamaayesamaanenaa yamaayaayene ka'anetame meneneme yamaayethaqemehene (thaa`ote) lamene tegegazaalahe
<<'abaatee hoye! 'enee ka`eweqate yaalemathaalehe nagare ba'eregethe mathetolenyaalenaa takatalanye qathetanyaawene manegade 'emaraahaalahunaa
<<'abaatee hoye! sayethaanene 'ategegazaa sayethaane la'alerahhemaane 'amatsanyaa nawenaa
<<'abaatee hoye! 'enee ka'alerahhemaane qethaate liyaaganyehe lasayethaaneme gwaadanyaa letekxone 'efaraalahu >>
('abaatume) <<beraahime hoye! 'aneta 'amelaakoceene tetahe yametezore nahene baatekalakale ba'eregethe 'ewagerehaalahu razheme gizeeneme tawanye>> 'ala
<<dahenaa kxune wadafite kageetaayee mehheratene 'elamenelehaalahu 'eresu lanee bathaame rexeruxe nawenaa>> 'ala
<<'enaanetaneme ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazuteneme 'ereqaalahu geetaayeeneme 'egegazaalahu geetaayeene bamagazaate yamaafere 'alamakxoneene 'ekajelaalahu >>
'enaresuneme ka'alaahe leelaa yamigegazuteneme baraaqa gizee la'eresu sehhaqenenaa yaa`eqobene sathanawe huluneme nabiye 'adarageneme
la'enasume kacerotaacene sathanaacawe la'enaresume kafe yaala mesegune zenaane 'adaragenelaacawe
bamatsehhafu wesethe musaaneme 'awesaa 'eresu merethe nabarenaa maleketanyaa nabiyeme nabare
kathure qanye gone bakuleme tharaanawe yaanagaagarenaweme sikxone 'aqarabenawe
kacerotaaceneme wanedemune haarunene nabiye 'aderegane sathanawe
bamatsehhafu semaa`ileneme 'awesaa 'eresu qatharone 'akebaari nabaranaa maleketanyaa nabiyeme nabare
beetasabocuneme basolaatenaa bazakaa yaaze nabare 'egeetaaweme zanede tawadaaje nabare
bamatsehhafu deriseneme (heenokene) 'awesaa 'eresu 'ewenatanyaa nabiye nabarenaa
wada kafetanyaame seferaa 'anasaanawe

'enazihe (`aszeru) 'enaziyaa 'alaahe ba'enasu laaye yalagasalaacawe kanabiyaate ka'adaame zare kanuhhe gaare (bamarekabitu laaye) kachaanaacaweme (zaroce) kaberaahimenaa ka'eseraa'eeleme zaroce kamaraanaacawenaa kamarathenaacaweme yakxonute ya'alerahhemaane 'aneqatsoce banasu laaye batanababu gizee sagaajocenaa 'aleqaashoce kxonawe yewadeqaalu
ka'enasume baxwaalaa solaatene yaagwaadalu (yatawu) felaagotoceneme yatakatalu mathefo metekoce tataku! yagahanameneme shalaqo ba'eregethe yaaganyaalu
gene yatatsatsatanaa yaamaname bagoneme szeraa yaszaraa sawe 'enazihe ganatene yegabaalu 'anedaaceneme 'ayebadalume
yamanoriyaane ganatoce yaacene 'alerahhemaane labaarocu baruqe kxonawe saalu tasefaa qaale yagabaalaacawene (yegabaalu) 'eresu tasefaawe tafatsaami nawenaa;
ba'ereswa salaamene 'eneji wedeqene nagare 'ayesamume la'enasume bareswa wesethe thwateme maataame sisaayaacawe 'alaacawe
yehece yaaci kabaarocaacene thenequqoce lakxonute yamenaawaresaate ganate naate
(jiberile 'ala) <<bageetaaheme te'ezaaze 'eneje 'anewaredeme bafitaacene yaalawe, baxwaalaaceneme yaalawe baziheme makaakale yaalawe hulu yaresu nawe geetaaheme rashi 'ayedalame
('eresu) yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bahulatume makaakale laalawe hulu geetaa nawenaa tagazaawe 'eresune bamagazaateme laaye taagase la'eresu mokesheene taaweqaalahene
saweme <<bamoteku gizee wadafite hheyaawe kxonyee (kamaqaabere) 'ewathaalahune>> yelaale
sawe ka'ahune bafite meneme nagare yaalenabara sikxone 'enyaa yafatharenawe makxonune 'ayaasetaawesemene
bageetaahe 'enemelaalane sayethaanaate gaare ba'eregethe 'enesabasebaacawaalane kaziyaame bagahaname zuriyaa yatanebarakaku kxonawe; ba'eregethe 'enaaqarebaacawaalane
kaziyaame kayacheferocu hulu ka'enaresu yaanene ('eresu) ba'alerahhemaane laaye badeferate bathaame beretu yakxonawene 'enaawathaalane
kaziyaame 'enyaa 'enaziyaane 'enaresu ba'ereswa lamagebaate tagabi yakxonutene 'enaaweqaalane
ka'enaanetame wada 'ereswa waraaje 'eneji 'anedeme yalame (maweradume) geetaahe yafaradawe gedeetaa nawe
kaziyaame 'enaziyaane yatathanaqaqutene 'enaadenaalane 'amatsanyocuneme yatanebarakaku kxonawe bawesethwa 'enetawaacawaalane

ba'enasume laaye 'aneqatsocaacene geletse maserajaawoce kxonawe batanababu gizee 'enaziyaa yakaadute la'enaziyaa laamanute <<kahulatu kefeloce manoriyaawe yamibalethawenaa shanegoweme yebalethe yamiyaamerawe maanenyaawe nawe>> yelaalu
ka'enasume bafite kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce 'enasu baqusaaqusenaa batereteme bathaame yaamaarutene bezuwocene 'athefetanaale

<<basehhetate wesethe yakxona sawe 'alerahhemaane la'eresu maazageyatene yaazagayawaale yamizaatebaacaweneme wayeme qethaatune wayeme sa`aatitune baayu gizee 'eresu seferaawe mathefonaa saraawitu dakaamaa yakxonawe sawe maane 'enedakxona ba'eregethe yaaweqaalu>> balaacawe
'enaziyaaneme yaqanutene sawoce 'alaahe qenenatene yechamerelaacawaale malekaamocu qariwoce (szeraawoce) 'egeetaahe zanede bamenedaa balaache naacawe bamamalashaame yatashaalu naacawe
yaaneneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yakaadawene <<(bateneszaa'ee qane) ganezabeme lejeme ba'eregethe 'esesathaalahu yaalaweneme 'ayahene>>
ruqune mesethire `awaqane wayese 'alerahhemaane zanede qaale kidaanene yaaza
yekalekale ('ayesathaweme) yamilawene hulu ba'eregethe 'enetsefaalane la'eresume kaqethaate chemaareene 'enechamerelataalane
('alelanye) yamilaweneme hulu 'enewaresawaalane becaaweneme kxono yemathaanaale
