ka'alaaheme leelaa 'amaaleketene la'enasu makabariyaa ('amaalaaje) 'enedikxonuwaacawe yaazu
yekalekalu; magazaataacawene ba'eregethe yekedwacawaale ba'enasume laaye taqaaraani yekxonubaacawaale
'enyaa sayethaanaatene bakahhaadiwoce laaye (bamathefo szeraa) maawabaaraatene yamiyaawabaaruwaacawe sikxonu yalaakene makxonaacenene 'alayahemene
ba'enasume (maqathaate) laaye 'atecaakole la'enasu (qanene) maqutharene 'eneqotherelaacawaalanenaa
me'emenaanene yatakabaru cheferoce kxonawe wada 'alerahhemaane yamenesabasebebatene qane ('asetaawese)
kahhaadiwoceneme yatathamu kxonawe wada gahaname yamenenadaabatene (qane 'asetaawese)
'alerahhemaane zanede qaale kidaanene yayaaza sawe bikxone 'eneji maamaaladene 'ayecelume
<<'alerahhemaaneme lejene yaaza (walada)>> 'alu
kabaade mathefone nagare ba'eregethe 'amathaacehu
ka'eresu (kanegegeraacawe) samaayaate liqadadu, medereme letesanathaqe, gaaraawoceme tanedawe liwadequ yeqaarabaalu
la'alerahhemaane leje 'alelawe sela'alu
la'alerahhemaane lejene mayaaze 'ayegabaaweme
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu (bateneszaa'ee qane) la'aleraahhemaane baariyaa kxonawe yamimathu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume
ba'eregethe (ba`eweqatu) kabwacawaale maquthareneme qotherwacawaale
hulume bateneszaa'ee qane layabecaa kxonawe wadaresu machiwoce naacawe
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa bago szeraawocene yaszaru 'alerahhemaane la'enasu wedeetaane yesathaacawaale
bamelaaseheme (qure'aanene) yaagaraanawe ba'eresu thenequqocune letaabaserebate ba'eresume takaraakaariwocene hhezeboce letaasefaraaraabate nawe
ka'enasume bafite kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezuwocene 'athefetanaale ka'enasu 'anedene 'enekwaa taayaalahene wayese la'enasu shukeshuketaane tesamaalahene
tha.ha. (thaa haa)
qure'aanene baaneta laaye 'enedetecagare 'alaawaradeneme
gene 'alaahene lamifaraa sawe magasachaa yekxone zanede ('awaradenawe)
mederenenaa yalaayenyaawocune samaayaate kafathara 'amelaake tawarada
('eresu) 'alerahhemaane nawe ba`areshu laaye (selethaanu) tadalaadala
basamaayaate yaalawe, bamedereme yaalawe, bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe, ka`afare bataaceme yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa nawe
banegegere betechohe ('alaahe kachukxatu yatabeqaaqaa nawe) 'eresu mesethirene bathaame yatadabaqaneme yaaweqaalenaa
'alaahe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame la'eresu malekaamoce yakxonu semoce 'alelute
yamusaame waree ba'eregethe mathetohaale
'esaatene baayanaa labeetasabocu - ('ezihe) <<qoyu; 'enee 'esaatene 'ayahu ka'ereswa cebone laamathaalaacehu; wayeme 'esaatitu zanede marine laaganye 'ekajelaalahu>> baalagizee ('asetaawese)
bamathaateme gizee <<musaa hoye>> bamaalate tatharaa
<<'enee geetaahe 'enee nanye machaamiyaawoceheneme 'aweleqe 'aneta bataqadasawe shalaqo bathuwaa nahenaa
<<'eneeme marathekuhe; yamiwaradeleheneme nagare 'adaamethe
<<'enee 'alaahe 'enee nanye yaala 'enee 'amelaake yalamenaa tagazaanye solaateneme (ba'ereswa) 'eneene lamaawesaate segade
<<sa`aatitu ba'eregethe machinaate ledabeqaate 'eqaarabaalahu nafese hulu bameteszaraawe nagare temanadaa zanede (mache naate)
<<ba'ereswa yamaayaamenawenaa zenebaaleewene yatakatalaweme sawe ka'ereswa 'ayaagedehe tethafaalahenaa;
<<musaa hoye! yeheceme baqanye 'ejehe yaalacewe menedene naate>> (tabaala)
<<'ereswa bateree naate ba'ereswa laaye 'edagafebaataalahu, ba'ereswame lafeyalocee qethalene 'aragefebaataalahu, la'eneeme ba'ereswa leeloce gudaayoce 'alunye>> 'ala
('alaaheme) <<musaa hoye! thaalaate>> 'alawe
thaalaateme wadiyaaweme 'ereswa yameterothe 'ebaabe kxonace
<<yaazaate; 'ateferaame wada majamariyaa thabaayewaa 'enemalesaataalane>> 'alawe
<<'ejeheneme wada bebetehe 'agebaa leelaa ta`aamere setekxone yaalanawere nache kxonaa tewathaalacenaa
<<kata`aameraatocaacene taalaaqwaane 'enaasaayehe zanede (yehene szaraane)
<<wada fare`one kxide 'eresu wasane 'alefwalenaa >>
(musaame) 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! lebeene 'asefaalenye
<<nagareeneme la'enee 'ageraalenye
<<kamelaaseeme makolaatafene fetaalenye
<<negegereene yaaweqaalunaa
<<kabeetasaboceeme la'enee radaatene 'aderegelenye
<<haarunene wanedemeene
<<xeyeleene ba'eresu 'abaretaalenye
<<banagareeme 'agaaraawe
<<babezu 'enaatharaahe zanede
<<babezume 'enedenaawasaahe
<<'aneta ba'enyaa nagare `awaaqi nahenaa >>
('alaaheme) 'ala <<musaa hoye! lemanaahene ba'eregethe tasathahe
<<baleelaame gizee baaneta laaye ba'eregethe lagesanaale
<<wadanaatehe balebe yamifasene nagare baasaawaqene gizee

<<(hhetzaanune) basaathenu wesethe thaayewe 'eresuneme (saathenune) babaahhere laaye thaayewe baahherume badaarecaawe yethaalawe la'enee thalaate la'eresume thalaate yakxona sawe yeyezawaalenaa bamaalate (baasaawaqene gizee lagasenelehe) baaneta laayeme ka'enee yakxonane mawadade thaalekubehe (letewadadenaa) ba'eneeme thebaqaa taadege zanede

<<'exeteheme bametekxeedenaa yamiyaasaadegawene sawe laamalaaketaacehune bametele gizee (mawadadene thaalekubehe) wada 'enaateheme `aayenewaa 'enediragaa ('ereswa) 'enedaataazeneme malasenehe nafeseneme gadaleke kacheneqeme 'adaanenehe fatanaawoceneme fatanehe bamadeyane beetasaboceme wesethe (bezu) `aamataatene taqamatheke kaziyaame musaa hoye! batawasana gizee laaye mathaahe
<<lanafeseeme (bamale'eketee) marathekuhe
<<'anetame wanedemeheme bata`aameraatocee kxidu 'eneeneme kamaawesaate 'atebozenu
<<wada fare`one kxidu 'eresu wasane 'alefwalenaa
<<'eresume yegasatse wayeme yefaraa zanede; la'eresu lezebene qaale tanaagarute >>
<<geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa ba'enyaa laaye kefaate bamaszeraate macakolune wayeme kuraatene machamarune 'enefaraalane>> 'alu
('alaaheme) 'ala <<'ateferu 'enee ba'eregethe ka'enaaneta gaare nanyenaa 'esamaalahu; 'ayaalahume

<<wadaresume kxidu; baluteme - <'enyaa yageetaahe maleketanyoce nane > ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce kanyaa gaare leqaqe 'ataasaqaayaacaweme kageetaahe bakxonawe ta`aamere ba'eregethe mathetanehaalenaa salaameme qathetaane batakatala sawe laaye yekxune
<<'enyaa qethaatu baasetabaabalanaa 'emebi baala sawe laaye nawe maalate ba'eregethe tawaradalene >>
(fare`oneme) <<musaa hoye! geetaacehu maanawe>> 'ala
<<geetaacene yaa lafetheratu nagarene hulu (yamiyaasefalegawene) yasatha kaziyaame yamaraawe nawe>> 'alawe
(fare`oneme) <<yamajamariyaayetu zamanaate hhezeboce kxuneetaa menedene nawe>> 'ala
(musaame) <<`eweqatewaa 'egeetaayee zanede bamatsehhafe yatamazagaba nawe geetaayee 'ayesaasaateme 'ayerasaameme>> 'alawe

('eresu) yaa mederene la'enaaneta menethaafe yaadaragalaacehu, ba'ereswame wesethe la'enaaneta manegadene yaagaraalaacehu, wehaaneme kasamaaye yaawarada nawe ('ala) baresume katalayaaya baqaaye `aayenatocene 'awathaanelaacehu
belu 'enesesaawocaacehuneme 'agethu; (baayoce kxonane 'awathaanelaacehu) bazihe wesethe la'a'emero baalabeetoce ba'eregethe ta`aameraate 'alabate
ka'ereswa (kamedere) fatharenaacehu ba'ereswame wesethe 'enemalesaacexwaalane ka'ereswame baleelaa gizee 'enaawathaacexwaalane
ta`aameraatocaaceneneme hulwaneme (lafare`one) ba'eregethe 'asaayanawe 'asetabaabalame 'emebime 'ala
<<kamederaacene badegemetehe letaawathaane mathaahebene musaa hoye!>> 'ala
<<masaluneme degemete 'enaamathaabehaalane ba'enyaanaa baanetame makaakale 'enyaame 'anetame yamaanethesawe yakxona qatharone bamakaakalanyaa seferaa 'aderegelene>> 'ala
<<qatharwacehu bamaageechaawe qane sawocume barafaade bamisabasabubate nawe>> 'ala
fare`oneme zora tanekoluneme sabasaba kaziyaame mathaa
musaa la'enasu 'alaacawe <<wayolaacehu ba'alaahe laaye weshatene 'ateqethafu baqethaate yaathafaacexwaalenaa yaqathafame sawe ba'eregethe 'afara >>
(degemetanyocu) bamakaakalaacaweme nagaraacawene tachaqaachaqu weyeyeteneme dabaqu
<<'enazihe ba'eregethe dagaamiwoce naacawe kamederaacehu badegemetaacawe liyaawathwacehu balaachituneme manegadaacehune liyaasewagedubaacehu yeshaalu>> 'alu
<<tanekolaacehuneme 'athanekeru kaziyaame tasalefaacehu nu zaaree yaashanafame sawe menyotune 'aganya>> (tabaabaalu)
<<musaa hoye! waye tethelaalahe wayeme bamajamariyaa yamenethele 'enekxonaalane>> (merathe) 'alu
<<'ayedalame thaalu>> 'alaacawe wadiyaaweme gamadocaacawenaa zanegocaacawe kadegemetaacawe yatanasaa 'enaresu yamirothu ('ebaaboce) kxonawe wadaresu tamalasu
musaame banafesu wesethe ferehaatene 'asaadara
<<'ateferaa 'aneta yabalaayu 'aneta nahenaa>> 'alenawe
<<baqanye 'ejehe yaalacaweneme batere thaale yaanene yaszarutene tewethaalacenaa yaa yaszarute hulu yadegemetanyaa tanekole nawenaa degemetanyaame bamathaabate seferaa hulu 'ayeqanaaweme>> ('alene)
degemetanyocume sagaajoce kxonawe wadaqu <<bahaarunenaa bamusaa geetaa 'amanene>> 'alu

(fare`oneme) <<la'enaaneta saalefaqedelaacehu bafite la'eresu 'amanaacehune 'eresu ba'eregethe yaa degemetene yaasetamaaraacehu teleqaacehu nawe 'ejocaacehunenaa 'egerocaacehune bamaanaagaate (geraanaaqanyene bamaafaraaraqe) 'eqoraarethaacexwaalahu bazamebaabaame genedoce laye 'esaqelaacexwaalahu maanenyaaceneme qethaatu bathaame beretu yamiqoyeme makxonune taaweqaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe
kamathulene taameraatoce kaziyaame kafatharane('amelaake) fatsemo 'anemaretheheme; 'anetame yametefaredawene ferade; yametefaredawe bazice ba'anasetanyaayetu hheyewate becaa nawe 'alu

<<xaathi'atocaacenenenaa kadegemeteme ba'eresu laaye yaasegadadekanene la'enyaa yemerane zanede 'enyaa bageetaacene 'amenanaale 'alaaheme bathaame balaache nawe; (qethaatume) bathaame yamizawatere nawe>> 'alu
'enaho kahhaadi kxono wada geetaawe yamimathaa sawe la'eresu gahaname 'alacewe bawesethwame 'ayemoteme hheyaaweme 'ayekxone
bago szeraawocene ba'eregethe yaszaraa me'emane kxono yamathaaweme sawe 'enaziyaa la'enasu kafetanyaa darajaawoce 'alwacawe
kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yamanoriyaa ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu ('alwacawe) yeheme yatatheraaraa sawe menedaa nawe
wada musaame <<baaroceene yezahe baleelite kxide la'enasume babaahhere wesethe daraqe manegadene 'aderegelaacawe maganyatene 'ateferaa (kamasethame) 'atechanaqeme >> senele ba'eregethe laakenebate
fare`oneme kasaraawitu gaare kxono takatalaacawe kabaaherume yamishafene shafanaacawe
fare`oneme hhezebocune 'asaasaataacawe qenuneme manegade 'alemaraacaweme
ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! kathalaataacehu ba'eregethe 'adaanenaacehu bathureme qanye gone qatharo 'adaragenelaacehu ba'enaanetame laaye manaanenaa derechetene 'awaradenelaacehu
kasathanaacehu sisaaye; kamalekaamu belu ba'eresume wasanene 'atelafu quthaayee ba'enaaneta laaye yewaredebaacexwaalenaa ba'eresume laaye quthaayee yamiwaredebate sawe ba'eregethe yethafaale
'eneeme latatsatsata, laamaname, malekaameneme laszaraa, kaziyaame latamaraa sawe ba'eregethe mahhaari nanye
<<musaa hoye! kahhezebocehe mene 'asecakolaheme>> (tabaala)
<<'enasu 'enazihe; badukaayee laaye yaalu naacawe geetaayee hoye! tewadeleneme zanede wada 'aneta cakoleku>> 'ala
('alaahe) <<'enyaame ka'aneta baxwaalaa sawocehene ba'eregethe fatetane saameraawiweme 'asaasaataacawe>> 'alawe

musaame wada sawocu yataqothaa yaazana kxono tamalasa <<hhezebocee hoye! geetaacehu malekaame tasefaane 'aleqatharaacehumene qatharowe ba'enaaneta laaye razamabaacehune>> wayese ba'enaaneta laaye kageetaacehu qethaate liwaredebaacehu falagaacehunaa qatharoyane 'afarasaacehune 'alaacawe
<<qatharohene bafaqaadaacene 'alethaaseneme gene 'enyaa kahhezebocu geethe shakemocene tachaane (ba'esaate laaye) thaalenaateme saameraawiweme 'enedazihu thaala>> 'alute
la'enasume 'akaale yakxona thejaane la'eresu magwaagore yaalawene 'awathaalaacawe (takataayocu) <<yehe 'amelaakaacehu yamusaame 'amelaake nawe gene rasaawe>> 'alume
wada'enasu negegerene yamaayemalese la'enasume gudaatenenaa theqemene yamaayecele makxonune 'ayaayumene
haaruneme kazihe bafite ba'eregethe 'alaacawe - <<hhezebocee hoye! (yehe) ba'eresu yatamokaraacehubate becaa nawe geetaacehume 'alerahhemaane nawe takatalunyeme te`ezaazeeneme semu >>
<<musaa wada'enyaa 'esekamimalase ba'eresu (magazaate) laaye kamaqoyate fatsemo 'anewagademe>> 'alu
(musaa) 'ala - <<haarune hoye! tasaasetawe baayahaacawe gizee mene kalakalehe
<<'eneene kamakatale te`ezaazeene thaasekene>>
<<ya'enaatee leje hoye! thimeeneme raaseeneme 'ateyaaze 'enee ba'eseraa'eele lejoce makaakale layaayahe; qaaleeneme 'alethabaqeheme maalatehene faraahu>> 'alawe
(musaa) <<saameraawiwe hoye! nagareheme menedene nawe>> 'ala
yaalaayutene nagare 'ayahu kamaleketanyaawe (kafarasu kotee) dukaame chebethe 'afarene zaganeku (baqeretsu laaye) thaalekwaateme 'enedazihume nafesee shalamacelenye>> 'ala

'alawe <<kxide; laanetame bahheyewatehe (la'ayakxawe sawe hulu) manakaakaate yalame maalate 'alahe la'anetame fatsemo yamaatethaasawe qatharo 'alahe wadaziyaame ba'eresu laaye tagazhiwe kxonahe wada qoyahebate 'amelaakehe tamalekate ba'eregethe 'enaaqaathelawaalane kaziyaame babaahheru wesethe mabatanene 'enebatenawaalane >>
geetaacehu yaa ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yaleela yakxonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe 'eweqatu nagarene hulu 'adaarasa
'enedazihu ba'eregethe kaalafute wareewoce baaneta laaye 'enetarekaalane ka'enyaame zanede qura'aanene ba'eregethe sathanehe
ka'eresu yaafagafaga sawe 'eresu bateneszaa'ee qane kabaadene qethaate yeshakamaale
ba'eresu wesethe zawetaariwoce kxonawe (yeshakamaalu) bateneszaa'eeme qane la'enasu yakxonawe shakeme kafaa!
baqanedu baminafaa qane (shakemaacawe kafaa); kahhaadiwoceneme baziyaa qane (`aayenocaacawe) samaayaawiwoce honawe 'enesabasebaacawaalane
<<`aszerene (qane) 'eneji 'aleqoyaacehume>> bamabaabaale bamakaakalaacawe yeneshokaashokaalu
bahhasaabe qathetanyaawe <<'anedene qane 'eneje 'aleqoyaacehume>> bamile gizee yamilutene nagare 'enyaa `awaaqiwoce nane
kagaaraawoceme yethayequhaale; balaacawe <<geetaayee mabatanene yebatenaacawaale
<<tekekele meedaame kxonaa yetawaataale
<<bareswa zeqetaanaa kafetaane 'ataayeme >>
baziyaa qane (lamasabesabe) thariwene la'eresu mathaamame yaleelawene makatale yekatalaalu demetsoceme la'alerahhemaane tsathe yelaalu selazihe shukeshuketaane 'eneji 'atesamaame
baziyaa qane la'eresu 'alerahhemaane yafaqadalatenenaa la'eresume qaalene yawadadalatene sawe bikxone 'eneje melejaa ('anedeneme) 'atethaqememe
basetafitaacawe yaalawene basetaxwaalaacaweme yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale ba'eresume `eweqatene 'ayaakaabebume; ('ayaawequme)
fitoceme hulu hheyaawe 'asetanaabaari lakxonawe ('alaahe) tawaaradu badaleneme yatashakama sawe ba'eregethe kasara
'eresu 'amaanye kxono kamalekaame szeraawoceme yaszaraa sawe badaleneme magudaleneme 'ayefaraame
'enedazihume `arabenyaa qure'aane kxono 'awaradenawe 'alaaheneme yefaru zanede wayeme la'enasu geszaatseene yaadeselaacawe zanede kazaacaa dagaagemane bawesethu galatsene
'ewenatanyaawe neguse 'alaaheme (kahhaadiwoce kamilute) laaqa wada 'aneta mawaradume kamafatsamu bafite bamaanebabe 'atecakule <<geetaayee hoye! `eweqateneme chamerelenye>> bale
wada 'adameme kazihe bafite kidaanene ba'eregethe 'awaradene rasaame la'eresume qoraathenatene 'alaaganyanelateme
lamalaa'eketeme la'adaame segadu baalene gizee ('asetaawese) sagadume; belise becaa siqare 'emebi 'ala
'aleneme <<'adame hoye! yehe laanetame lamiseteheme ba'eregethe thalaate nawe selazihe kaganate 'ayaawethaacehu; telafaalahenaa
la'aneta ba'ereswa wesethe 'alamaraabenaa 'alamataaraze 'alahe
'anetame bareswa wesethe 'atethamaame; tzahhayeme 'atetakoseme
sayethaaneme wadaresu gotagota <<'adame hoye! bamazawetariyaa zaafe bamaayethafaa negeszenaame laaye laamalaaketehene 'alawe

ka'ereswame balelu la'enaresume xaferata galaacawe tagalatsace kaganateme qethale balaayaacawe laaye yelathefu jamare 'adameme yageetaawene te'ezaaze (raseto) thaasa (kafalagawe mazawetare) tasaasaatame
kaziyaame geetaawe marathawe ka'eresume tsatsatune taqabalawe maraaweme
'alaacawe <<kafilaacehume lakafilu thalaate sikxone hulaacehume ka'ereswa weradu ka'eneeme yakxona mari bimathaalaacehu mariyane yatakatala 'ayesaasaateme 'ayecagarememe
<<kageszaatseeyeeme yazora sawe la'eresu thabaabe nuro 'alawe bateneszaa'eeme qane `ewere kxono 'eneqasaqesawaalane
<<geetaayee hoye! lamene `ewere 'aderegahe 'asenasaakxanye ba'eregethe yamaaye yanabareku sekxone>> yelaale
(nagaru) 'enedazihu nawe <<taameraataacene mathaacelehe tawekaateme 'enedazihume zaaree tetawaalahe>> yelawaale
'enedazihume yaagaaraanenaa bageetaawe 'aneqatsoce yaalaamanane sawe 'eneqathaawaalane yamacharashaayetume `aalame qethaate bathaame beretu hulegizee zawetaarime nawe

(qurayeshoce) ka'enasu bafite kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezuwocene yaathafaane makxonaacene bamanoriyaawocaacawe yamikxeedu kxonawe saalu la'enaresu 'aletagalatsalaacawemene bazihe wesethe la'a'emero baalabeetoce ba'eregethe maleketoce 'alubate
kageetaahe yaalaface qaalenaa yatawasana gizee baalenabara noro (qethaatu 'ahununu) yamiyezaacawe yekxone nabare

bamiluteme laaye taagase geetaaheneme tzahhaye kamawethaatewaa bafite kamagebaatewaame bafite yametaamasagene kxonahe 'atheraawe; (segade) kaleelite sa`aatoceme baqane chaafoceme 'atheraawe (bamisathehe menedaa) letewade yekajalaalenaa
`aayenoceheneme ka'enaresu (kasawocu) kefelocene ba'eresu lenefatenaacawe wada 'athaaqamenebate; wada qerebitu hheyewate geethoce 'atezaregaa yageetaahe sisaayeme bathaame balaache zawetaarime nawe
beetasabeheneme basegedate 'ezaze ba'ereswame laaye zawetere;(tsenaa) sisaayene 'anethayeqeheme 'enyaa 'enesathehaalane malekaamitu macharashaame lathenequqocu naate
<<kageetaaweme bakxona ta`aamere 'ayemathaanemene>> 'alu bamajamariyaawocu tsehhufoce wesethe yaalacewe maaserajaa 'alemathaacaacawemene

'enyaame ka'eresu (kamuhhamade malaake) bafite baqethaate baathafaanaacawe noro <<geetaacene hoye! kamawaaradaacenenaa kamaafaraacene bafite 'aneqatsocehene 'enekatale zanede wadanyaa malekatanyaane 'atelekeme nabarene>> baalu nabare
<<hulume tathabaabaaqi nawe tathabaabaqume yaqathetaaweme manegade baalabeetoce 'enamaane 'enedahonu 'enamaaneme 'eneda tamaru wada fite taaweqaalaacehu>> balaacawe
lasawoce 'enaresu bazenegaatee wesethe (masanaadaatene) yatawe kxonawe saalu meremaraacawe qaraba
kageetaacawe 'adise yatawarada qure'aane 'ayemathaalaacaweme 'enasu yamiyaalaagethu honawe yamiyaadamethute bihonu 'eneji

lebocaacawe zeneguwoce kxonawe (yamiyaadaamethute bikxonu 'eneje) 'enaziyaame yabadalute sawoce maneshokaashokene dabaqu <<yehe betheeyaacehu sawe 'eneje leelaa nawene 'enaanetame yametaayu setekxonu degemetene lamaqabale temathaalaacehune>> ('alu)
(muhhamademe) <<geetaayee qaalene hulu basamaayenaa bamedere wesethe yaala sikxone yaaweqaale 'eresume samiwe `awaaqiwe nawe>> 'ala
<<ba'ewenatu (qure'aanu) yahhelemoce qezhatoce nawe yelequneme qathafawe 'enediyaaweme 'eresu qeneene gathaami nawe yaqademowocume 'enedatalaaku (maleketanyaa kakxona) bata`aamere yemethaabene>> 'alu
ka'enasu bafite yaathafaanaate katamaa 'alaamanaceme taadiyaa 'enasu yaamenaalune
ka'anetame bafite wada'enasu yamenaawaredelaacawe yakxonane sawocene 'eneji leelaane 'alaakeneme yamaataawequme betekxonu yamatsehhafune baalabeetoce thayequ
megebene yamaayebalu 'akaaleme 'alaadaragenaacaweme zawetaariwoceme 'alenabarume
kaziyaame qatharone molaanelaacawe 'adaanenaacaweme yameneshaaweneme sawe ('adaane) wasane 'alaafiwocuneme 'athafaane
keberaacehu bawesethu yaalabatene matsehhafe wada'enaaneta ba'eregethe 'awaradene 'ataawequmene
badaayeme kanabarace katamaa yaathafaanaatenaa kaxwaalaawaame leelocene hhezeboce yaaseganyanawe bezu naate
qethaataaceneme batasamaacawe gizee 'enaresu wadiyaawenu ka'ereswa (lamashashe) yegaszageszaalu
'ategaszegeszu; telamanume yekxonaalenaa ba'eresu wada taqamaathalaacehubate tsagaa wada manoriyaawocaacehume tamalasu (yebaalaalu)
<<waa thefaataacene! 'enyaa ba'eregethe badaayoce nabarene>> yelaalu
yataachadu reesaawoceme 'esekaadaragenaacawe derase yeheci thariyaacawe kamakxone 'aletawagadaceme
samaayenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu qalaajoce kxonane 'alefathareneme
machaawacaane (misetenaa lejene) leneyeze bashaane noro ka'enyaa zanede bayaazenawe nabare (gene) szariwoce 'ayedalaneme

ba'eregethe 'ewenatene baweshate laaye 'enethelaalane 'anegolune yaafaresawaaleme wadiyaaweme 'eresu thafi nawe la'enaanetame kaziyaa (misetenaa leje 'alawe bamaalate) kametemathenute nagare beretu qethaate 'alaacehu; (wayolaacehu)
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulume ya'eresu nawe 'eresu zanede yaaluteme (malaa'ekete) 'eresune kamagazaate 'ayekorume 'ayesalacumeme
baleelitenaa baqaneme yaatharutaale; 'ayaarefume
yelequneme kamedere yakxonune 'enaresu mutaanene yamiyaasenasune 'amaalekete yaazune (yalame)
bahulatu (basamaayaatenaa bamedere) wesethe ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete banabaru noro batabalaashu nabare ya`areshu geetaa 'alaaheme kamilute hulu tharaa
kamiszaraawe hulu 'ayethayaqeme 'enaresu (fetheratocu) gene yethayaqaalu

yelequneme ka'eresu leelaa 'amaaleketene yaazune <<'aserajaacehune 'amethu yehe (qure'aane) 'enee zanede yaalawe hhezebe magasachaa ka'enee bafiteme yanabarute hhezeboce magasachaa nawe>> balaacawe bawenatu 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ewenatune 'ayaawequme selazihe 'enasu 'emebitanyoce naacawe
ka'aneta bafiteme 'enaho ka'enee leelaa 'amelaake yalamenaa tagazunye bamaalate wadaresu yamenaawaredelate bikxone 'eneje kamaleketanyaa 'anedeneme 'alelaakeneme
<<'alerahhemaaneme (kamalaa'ekete) lejene yaaza>> 'alu theraate tagabaawe 'ayedalame (malaa'ekete) yatakabaru baaroce naacawe
banegegere 'ayeqademuteme; (yaalaalawene 'ayelume) 'enaresume bate'ezaazu yeszaraalu
bafitaacawe yaalawenenaa baxwaalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu yaaweqaale lawadadaweme sawe 'eneje laleelaawe 'ayaamaaledume 'enaresume 'eresune kamaferaataacawe yatanasaa tachanaaqiwoce naacawe
ka'enasume <<'enee ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake nanye>> yamile yaanene gahanamene 'enemanadaawaalane 'enedazihu badaayocene 'enemanadaalane
'enaziyaame yakaadute samaayaatenaa medere yatathaabaqu yanabarunaa yalayaayanaacawe makxonaacenene 'ayaawequmene hheyaawe yakxonaneme nagare hulu kawehaa fatharene 'ayaamenumene
bamedereme wesethe ba'enasu 'enedaataaragarege gaaraawocene 'adaragene yemarume zanede ba'ereswa wesethe safaafi manegadocene 'adaragene
samaayeneme (kamawedaqe) yatathabaqa thaaraa 'adaragene 'enaresume kata`aameraatocwa zanegiwoce naacawe
'eresume leelitenenaa qanene, tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme yafathara nawe hulume bafalakaacawe wesethe yewaanyaalu
(muhhamade hoye!) kaaneta bafite lamaaneme sawe zala`aalame manorene 'alaadarageneme taadiyaa betemote 'enasu zawetaariwoce naacawene
nafese hulu motene qamaashe naate lamafataneme bakefume babagome 'enemokeraacexwaalane wadanyaame temalasaalaacehu

'enaziyaame yakaadute sawoce baayuhe gizee masaalaqiyaa 'aderegawe 'eneji 'ayeyezuheme 'enasu ba'alerahhemaane mawasaate 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce sihonu <<yaa 'amaaleketocaacehune (bakefu) yamiyaanasaawe yehe nawene>> (yelaalu)
sawe cakwaaye hono tafathara ta`aameraatoceene ba'eregethe 'asaayaacexwaalahunaa 'ataacaakulunye
<<yehe qatharome macee nawe 'ewenatanyoce kakxonaacehu ('amethute)>> yelaalu
'enaziyaa yakaadute kafitocaacawenaa kajarebaawocaacawe laaye 'esaatene yamaayekalakelubatene 'enasume yamaayeradaadubatene gizee biyaawequ noro (yehenene 'ayelume nabare)
yelequneme (sa`aatitu) badenegate temathaacawaalace; taawaalelaacawaalaceme mamalaswaneme 'ayecelume 'enasume 'ayeqoyume
ka'aneta bafiteme yanabarute maleketanyoce ba'eregethe taqaladabaacawe ba'enaziyaame ka'enasu yeqaledu banabarute baresu yesaalaqubate yanabarute (qethaate) safarabaacawe
<<ka'alerahhemaane (qethaate) baleelitenaa baqane yamithabeqaacehu maanawe>> balaacawe ba'ewenatu 'enasu kageetaacawe gesaatsee (kaqure'ane) zanegiwoce naacawe
la'enasu ka'enyaa leelaa yametekalaakalelaacawe 'amaalekete 'alacaacawene nafesocaacawene maredaatene 'ayecelume 'enaresume (kahhaadiwocu) ka'enyaa 'ayethabaqume

ba'ewenate 'enazihenenaa 'abaatocaacawene ba'enasu laaye `edemee 'eseka razamabaacawe derase 'athaaqamenaacawe (tataalalume) 'enyaa mederene kachaafocewaa yamenaagolaate kxonane senemathaabaate 'ayaayumene 'enasu 'ashanaafiwoce naacawene
<<yamaasefaraaraacehu batawaradalenye becaa nawe gene daneqorowoce bamisefaraaru gizee therine 'ayesamume>> balaacawe
kageetaahe qethaateme walaafane betenakaacawe <<waa thefaataacene! 'enyaa badaayoce nabarene>> yelaalu

bateneszaa'eeme qane tekekelanyaa mizaanocene 'enaaqomaalane maanenyaayetume nafese meneneme 'atebadaleme (szeraawe) yasanaafeche qenethaate yaakele bikxoneme 'ereswane 'enaamathaataalane taqothaathaariwoceme banyaa baqaa
lamusaanaa lahaaruneme 'ewenatenenaa weshatene yamilayene berehaaneneme lathenequqoceme magasachaane ba'eregethe sathanaacawe
la'enaziyaa geetaacawene baruqe lamifarute 'enasume kasa`aatitu tachanaaqiwoce lakxonu (magasachaane sathane)
yeheme (qure'aane) yaawaradenawe yakxona beruke magasachaa nawe taadiyaa 'enaaneta la'eresu kahhaadiwoce naacehune
laberaahimeme kaziyaa bafite qene manegadune ba'eregethe sathanawe 'enyaame ba'eresu (tagabinate) `awaaqiwoce nabarene
la'abaatunaa lahhezebocu <<yeheci qeretsaa qeretse yaaci 'enaaneta la'ereswa tagazhiwoce yakxonaacehute menedene naate>> baala gizee (maraanawe)
<<'abaatocaacenene la'ereswa tagazhiwoce kxonawe 'aganyane>> 'alute
<<'enaanetame 'abaatocaacehume ba'eregethe bageletse sehetate wesethe nabaraacehu>> 'alaacawe
<<bameru mathaahelene wayenese 'aneta kamiqaledute nahe>> 'alute
<<'ayedalame geetaacehu yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa yaa yafatharaacawe nawe 'eneeme bazihe laaye kamasekaariwocu nanye>> 'ala
<<ba'alaaheme 'emelaalahu zwariwoce kxonaacehu kaheedaacehu baxwaalaa thaa`otocaacehune tanekole 'eszaraabaacawaalahu>> ('ala)
(zaware silu) sebereberoceme 'adaragaacawe la'enasu yakxona 'anede taalaaqe (thaa`ote) becaa siqare wadaresu yemalasu zanede ('eresune tawawe)
<<ba'amaaleketocaacene yehenene yaszaraa maanawe 'eresu ba'eregethe kabadalanyoce nawe>> 'alu
<<beraahime yamibaale gobaze (bamathefo) siyaanasaacawe sametanaale>> tabaabaalu
<<yemasakerubate zanede basawocu `aayene (fite) laaye 'amethute>> 'alu
<<beraahime hoye! ba'amaaleketocaacene yehenene yaszaraahe 'aneta nahene>> 'alute
<<'ayedalame yehe taalaaqaacawe szaraawe yenaagarume 'eneda kxona thayeqwaacawe>> 'ala
wada nafesocaacaweme tamalasu <<'enaaneta (bamathayaqaacehu) badaayocu 'enaanetawe naacehume>> tabaabaalu
kaziyaame baraasocaacawe laaye tagalabathu <<'enazihe yaminaagaru 'alamakxonaacawene ba'eregethe `aweqahaale;>> ('alu)
<<taadiyaa la'enaaneta meneme yamaayethaqemaacehunenaa yamaayegodaacehune nagare ka'alaahe leelaa tegazaalaacehune>> 'alaacawe
<<fohe! la'enaaneta ka'alaahe leelaa lametegazuteme nagare; 'ataawequmene>> ('ala)
<<szariwoce 'eneda kxonaacehu 'aqaathelute 'amaaleketocaacehuneme 'eredu>> 'alu (ba'esaate laaye thaaluteme)
<<'esaate hoye! baberaahime laaye qazeqaazaa; salaameme hunyi>> 'alene
ba'eresume tanekolene 'asabu bathaame kasaariwoceme 'adaragenaacawe
'eresunenaa lutheneme wadaziyaace; bawesethwa la`aalamaate barakatene wada 'adaragenebaate medere (bamawesade) 'adaane
la'eresume sehhaqene yaa`eqobeneme tachamaari 'aderegane sathanawe huluneme malekaamoce 'adaragene;

bate`ezaazaaceneme wada bago szeraa yamimaru mariwoce 'adaragenaacawe wada'enasume malekaame szeraawocene maszeraatene, solaateneme masegadene, zakaaneme masethatene 'awaradene la'enyaa tagazhiwoceme nabaru
lutheneme feredenenaa `eweqatene sathanawe kaziyaaceme mathefo szeraawocene teszaraa kanabaracewe katamaa 'adaanenawe 'enasu kefu sawoce 'amatsanyoce nabarunaa
bacerotaaceneme wesethe 'agabaanawe 'eresu kamalekaamocu nawenaa
nuhheneme kaziyaa bafite (geetaawene) batharaa gizee ('asetaawese) la'eresume (theriwene) taqabalenawe 'eresuneme beetasabocuneme kakabaade cheneqe 'adaane
kanaziyaame bataameraatocaacene ka'asetabaabalute hhezeboce (tanekole) thabaqenawe 'enasu kefu hhezeboce 'amatsanyoce nabarunaa huluneme 'asathamenaacaweme
daawedenenaa sulayemaaneneme ba'azemaraawe nagare bamifaredu gizee yahhezebocu feyaloce leelite baresu wesethe batasamaaru gizee ('asetaawese) feredaacaweneme `awaaqiwoce nabarene

lasulayemaaneme (tekekelanyaayetune ferede) 'asaawaqenaate lahulume thebabenenaa `eweqatene sathane taraaraawocene kadaawede gaare yamiyaawadesu sikxonu garaane 'a'ewaafeneme ('enedazihu garaane) szariwoceme nabarene
yaberate lebeseneme szeraa la'enaaneta kathoraacehu tethabeqaacehu zanede 'asetamaarenawe 'enaaneta 'amasegaanyoce naacehune

lasulayemaaneme nafaasene baxayele yametenafese bate`ezaazu wadaziyaace ba'ereswa wesethe barakatene wada 'adaragenebaate medere (wada shaame) yametefase setekxone (garaanelate) banagaru hulume `awaaqiwoce nabarene
kasayethaanaateme la'eresu (lulene lamaawethaate) yamithalemunenaa kaziyaame leelaa yaalane szeraa yamiszarune (garaanelate) la'enasume tathabaabaaqiwoce nabarene
'ayubeneme (yobene) geetaawene <<'enee makaraa 'aganyanye 'anetame ka'azaanyoce hulu yebalethe 'azaanye nahe>> sile batathaaraa gizee ('asetaawese)

la'eresume theriwene taqabalenawe kagudaateme ba'eresu laaye yanabarawene hulu 'asewagadene beetasabocuneme ka'enasume gaare masalaacawene ka'enyaa zanede lacerotaanaa latagazhiwoce lamaaseganezabe sathanawe
semaa`ileneme deriseneme zulekifeleneme ('asetaawese) hulume kataagaashocu naacawe
kacerotaaceneme wesethe 'agabaanaacawe 'enasu kamalekaamocu naacawenaa

ya`aasaaweneme baalabeete taqotheto bakxeeda gizee ('asetaawese) ba'eresume laaye fatsemo yamaanefaredebate makxonaacenene tharathara (`aasaame waathawe) bachalamaawoceme wesethe kxono ka'aneta baqare leelaa 'amelaake yalame theraate yegabaahe 'enee ba'eregethe kabadaayocu nabareku bamaalate tathaaraa
laresume theriwene taqabalenawe kacheneqeme 'adaanawe 'enedazihume me'emanaanene 'enaadenaalane
zakariyaaneme <<geetaayee hoye! becaayeene 'atetawanye 'anetame kawaraashoce hulu balaache nahe sile>> geetaawene batathaaraa gizee ('asetaawese)

la'eresume theriwene taqabalenawe la'eresume yahheyaane sathanawe la'eresume misetune 'abajanelate 'enaresu babago szeraawoce yamicaakolu kajaayocenaa fariwoce kxonawe yamilamenuneme nabaru la'enyaa tawaaraajoceme nabaru
yaaceneme beletwane yathabaqaciwene bareswame wesethe kamanefasaacene yanafaanebaatene 'ereswaneme lejewaaneme ('enedazihu) la`aalamaate ta`aamere yaadaragenaatene (mareyamene 'asetaawese)
yehece (hhegegaate) 'anedite manegade setehone ba'eregethe haayemaanotaacehu naate 'eneeme geetaacehu nanyenaa tagazunye
bahaayemaanotaacaweme nagare bamakaakalaacawe talayaayu hulume wadanyaa tamalaashoce naacawe
'eresu yaamana kxono kabago szeraawoce maanenyaaweneme yamiszaraame sawe; menedaawene 'ayenafageme 'enyaame la'eresu mazegaabiwoce nane
baathafaanaateme katamaa laaye 'enasu (wadanyaa) yamaayemalasu makxonaacawe 'ebelate nawe; (yemalasaalu)
ya'ejujenaa ma'ejujeme 'enaresu kayatarataru yaminedaradaru sikxonu (gedebaacawe) batakafatace gizee:

'ewenatanyaaweme qatharo baqaraba gizee: yaane gizee 'enaho ya'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce `aayenoce yefathethaalu <<waa thefaataacene! kazihe (qane) ba'eregethe bazenegaatee laaye nabarene; ba'ewenateme badaayoce nabarene>> (yelaalu)
'enaaneta ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazwacaweme (thaa`otaate) yagahaname maagadowoce naacehu 'enaaneta la'ereswa waraajoce naacehu
'enazihe (thaa`otaate) 'amaalekete banabaru noro 'ayegabwawaateme nabare gene hulume ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
la'enaresu ba'ereswa wesethe manesaqesaqe 'alaacawe 'enaresume bawesethwa (meneneme) 'ayesamume
'enaziyaa ka'enyaa malekaamwa qaale la'enaresu yaalafacelaacawe 'enaziyaa kareswa yataraaqu naacawe
demetsewaane 'ayesamume 'enaresume nafesocaacawe bamishute nagare wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
taalaaqu denegaathee 'ayaasetakezaacaweme malaa'eketeme yehe yaa teqatharu yanabaraacehute qanaacehu nawe; 'eyaalu yeqabalwacawaale

lamatsehhafoce yakxonu gatsoce 'enedamithaqalalu samaayene yamenethaqalelebatene qane ('asetaawese) yamajamariyaane fetherate 'eneda jamarene 'enemalesawaalane (mafatsamu) ba'enyaa laaye yakxonane qatharo qatharene 'enyaa (yaqatharenawene) szariwoce nane
medeneme malekaamocu baarocee yewareswataale maalatene kamatsehhafu (katathabaqawe saleedaa) baxwaalaa bamatsehhafocu ba'eregethe tsefanaale
bazihe (qure'aane) wesethe latagazhiwoce hhezeboce baqinate 'alela
(muhhamade hoye!) la`aalamaateme 'ezenate 'aderegane 'eneje 'alelaakeneheme
<<yaa wadanee yamiwaradawe 'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe maalate nawe; taadiyaa 'enaaneta fetsume taazaazhoce naacehune>> balaacawe
'emebime bilu (bamaawaqe) ba'ekulenate laaye kxonane (yataazazekutene) 'asetaaweqexwaacehu <<yametesefaraarubateme nagare qerebe wayeme ruqe makxonune 'alaaweqeme;>> balaacawe
'eresu kanegegere chukxatene yaaweqaale yametedabequteneme hulu yaaweqaale
'eresume (qethaatene maaqoyate) menaalebaate la'enaaneta fatanaanaa 'eseka gizeewe mathaqaaqamiyaa 'enedahoname 'alaaweqeme; (balaacawe)
<<geetaayee hoye! ba'ewenate ferade; geetaaceneme 'ejege bathaame ruxeruxe bametelute nagare laaye mataagazhaa nawe>> 'ala
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehune feru yasa`aatitu 'eneqetheqaathee bathaame kabaade nagare nawenaa

bametaayuwaate qane 'athebi hulu ka'athabaacewe leje tefazezaalace ya'eregezenaa baalabeete yakxonaceme hulu 'ereguzwane techanagefaalace sawocuneme (badenegaathee beretaate) yasakaru kxonawe taayaalahe 'enaresume (kamathathe) yasakaru 'ayedalume gene ya'alaahe qethaate beretu nawe
kasawocume yaala `eweqate ba'alaahe nagare yamikaraakare; mogadanyaa sayethaaneneme hulu yamikatale sawe 'alela
'enaho! yatakatalawene sawe 'eresu yaathamawaale wada nadaaje 'esaate seqaayeme yemaraawaale maalate baresu laaye tatsefwale

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! kamaqaseqase bamatharaathare wesethe 'eneda honaacehu ('afathaatharaacehune tamalekatu) 'enyaame ka`afare fatharenaacehu, kaziyaame kafetewate thabetaa, kaziyaame karagaa dame, kaziyaame kaquraache szegaa, fetheratewaa mulu kahonacenaa mulu kaalehonace (celotaacenene) lanaaneta lenegaletselaacehu fatharenaacehu yameneshaaweneme 'eseka tawasana gizee derase bamaahhetzane wesethe 'enaaragaawaalane kaziyaame hhetzaane honaacehu 'enaawathaacexwaalane kaziyaame mulu thenekaariyaacehune tedaresu zanede ('enaasaadegaacexwaalane) ka'enaanetame yamimote sawe 'alela ka'enaanetame ka`eweqate baxwaalaa meneneme 'enedaayaaweqe wada waraadaa `edemee yamimalase sawe 'alela medereneme daraqe honaa taayaataalahe ba'ereswame laaye wehaane baawaradene gizee telaawasaalace tenafaafaalaceme webate kaalawe gosaa hulu taabaqelaalaceme
yehe 'alaahe 'eresu manoru yataragaagatha, 'eresume mutaanene hheyaawe yamiyaadarege, 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye bamahonu nawe
sa`aatitume machi, ba'ereswa fatsemo therethaaree yaleelabaate bamahonwa, 'alaaheme bamaqaaberoce wesethe yaalane hulu yamiqasaqese bamahonu nawe
kasawoceme wesethe yaala `eweqate, yaala maaserajaame, yaala 'aberaari matsehhafeme ba'alaahe nagare yamikaraakare sawe 'alela
gonune yaathafa hono ka'alaahe manegade liyaasaasete (yekaraakaraale) baqerebitu `aalame la'eresu weredate 'alelawe batenesaa'ee qaneme 'aqaathaayene qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane
yehe 'ejocehe baaseqadamute xathi'ate 'alaaheme labaarocu fatsemo badaaye baalamahonu nawe (yebaalaale)

kasawoceme (kahaayemaanote) bachaafe laaye hono 'alaahene yamigegazaa sawe 'alela taadiyaa malekaame nagare biyaaganyawe ba'eresu yeragaale makaraame betaaganyawe bafitu laaye yegalabathaale yaqerebitune `aalameme yamacharashaayetuneme kasara yehe 'eresu geletse kasaaraa nawe
ka'alaahe leelaa yamaayegodaawenenaa yamaayethaqemawene yegegazaale yehe 'eresu (ka'ewenate) yaraaqa sehetate nawe
yaanene katheqemu yeleqe gudaatu yamiqarebene yegegazaale radaatu menenyaa kafaa!
'alaahe 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene baszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce yaagabaacawaale 'alaahe yamishaawene nagare ba'eregethe yeszaraale

'alaahe (maleketanyaawene) baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame 'ayeradaaweme belo yamiyaasebe sawe gamadene wada samaaye yezaregaa kaziyaame (tenefaashu 'esekiqorathe) yetaanaqe tanekolu yamiyaaseqochawene nagare yaasewagedelate 'enedahoname yemalekate
'enedazihume (qure'aanene) yataberaaru 'aneqatsoce 'aderegane 'awaradenawe 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe yemaraale

'enaziyaa yaamanute, 'enaziyaame yehudaaweyaane yahonu, saabiyaanoceme, keresetiyaanoceme, majusoceme 'enaziyaame (thaa`otaatene ba'alaahe) yaagaaru 'alaahe bateneszaa'ee qane bamakaakalaacawe baferede yelayaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye ba'eregethe `awaaqi nawenaa

'alaahe basamaayaate yaalawe hulu, bamedereme yaalawe hulu, tzahhayenaa charaqaame, kawaakebeteme, taraaraawoceme, zaafoceme, taneqasaaqaashoceme kasawoce bezuwoceme, laresu yamisagedulate mahonune 'ataawequmene bezuweme baresu laaye qethaate taragaagathabate 'alaahe yamiyaawaaredaweme sawe la'eresu meneme 'akebaari yalaweme 'alaahe yashaawene yeszaraalenaa
'enazihe bageetaacawe yatakaraakaru hulate baalaagaaraawoce naacawe 'enaziyaame yakaadute la'enaresu ya'esaate lebesoce talaketawelaacawaale karaasocaacawe balaaye yafalaa wehaa yemebwabwacawaale
bahodocaacawe wesethe yaalu qodaawocaacaweme ba'eresu yeqalathaalu
la'enasume (maqechaa) kaberate yahonu madoshaawoce 'alelu
kacheneqate beretaate yatanasaa ka'ereswa lamawethaate bafalagu quthere ka'ereswa wesethe 'enedimalasu yedaragaalu <<bathaame yamiyaaqaatheleneme qethaate qemasu>> (yebaalaalu)

'alaahe 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene sawoce baszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasesubaacawene ganatoce yaagabaacawaale ba'ereswa wesethe kawareqe yahonune 'anebaarocenaa lulene yeshalamaalu ba'ereswa wesethe lebesocaacaweme hhare naacawe
kanegegereme wada malekaamu tamaru wada meseguneme manegade tamaru

'enaziyaa yakaadu ka'alaaheme manegadenaa kaziyaame lasawoce bawesethu nawaari lahonuteme, karuqe lamimathuteme 'ekule kaadaragenawe katakabarawe masegide (sawocene) yamikalakelu ('asaamaamine qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane) ba'eresume wesethe (katekekelanyaa manegade) bamazanebale badaaye hono (maanenyaaweneme nagare) yamifalege sawe ka'asaamaami qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane

laberaahimeme yabeetune (yakaa`ebaane) seferaa mamalashaa baadaragenelate gizee <<ba'enee meneneme 'ataagaaraa, beeteeneme lamizorutenaa lamiqomubate lamiyaagonabesutenaa bagenebaaraacaweme lamidafute netsuhhe 'aderegelaacawe>> (baalenawe gizee 'asetaawese)
('alenaweme) - basawoceme wesethe bahhaje te`ezaaze theraa 'egeranyoce kayaruqe manegade bamimathu kasitaa gemaloceme hulu laaye honawe yemathuhaalenaa

la'enasu yahonu theqemocene yethaadu zanede bataawaqu qanoceme wesethe kalamaadaa 'enesesaawoce basathaacawe sisaaye laaye ya'alaahene seme yaawasu zanede (yemathuhaale) kareswame belu cegeranyaa dehaaneme 'abelu
kaziyaame ('eneda thagurenaa thefere yaalutene) terefe 'akaalaacawenenaa `edefaacawene yaasewagedu selatocaacaweneme yemulu; bathenetaawiweme beete yezuru

(nagaru) yehe nawe ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate yamiyaakabere sawe 'eresu geetaawe zanede la'eresu bathaame yatashaala nawe yabeete 'enesesaateme (gemale kabete bagenaa feyale) banaaneta laaye ('ereme mahonu) kaminababelaacehu basetaqare la'enaaneta tafaqedaalaacexwaalace kathaa`otaateme rekesate tathaneqaqu hhasateneme qaale raaqu

la'alaahe taazaazhoce ba'eresu yamaataagaru honaacehu (kahhasate raaqu) ba'alaaheme yamiyaagaaraa sawe; kasamaaye 'eneda wadaqanaa baraari 'enedametenatheqawe, wayeme nafaase 'eresune baruqe seferaa 'enedametethelawe bethee nawe
(nagaru) yehe nawe ya'alaaheneme yahaayemaanote meleketoce yamiyaakabere sawe 'ereswa kaleboce yakxonace theneqaaqee naate
la'enaaneta ba'ereswa 'eseka tawasana gizee derase theqemoce 'alwacehu kaziyaame (yamaarajaa) seferaawaa 'ethenetaawiwe beete 'athagabe nawe

lahhezebeme hulu (wada 'alaahe) masewaa`ete maaqerabene danagagene kabeete 'enesesaate basathaacawe sisaaye laaye ya'alaahene seme becaa yaawasu zanede ('azazenaacawe) 'amelaakaacehume 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe la'eresume becaa taazazu la'alaahe tawaaraajoceneme 'abeseraacawe

'enaziyaane 'alaahe batawasaa gizee lebocaacawe yamichanaqutene, badarasabaacaweme (makaraa) laaye taagaashocene, solaateneme 'asetakaakelawe sagaajocene, kasathanaacaweme sisaaye yamilagesutene ('abesere)

gemaloceneme la'enaaneta ka'alaahe haayemaanote meleketoce 'adaragenaacawe ba'ereswa la'enaaneta malekaame theqeme 'alaacehu ba'ereswame laaye (setaaredwate) basosete 'egerocewaa qomaa yatasalaface honaa ya'alaahene seme 'awesu gonocaacaweme bawadaqu gizee ka'ereswa belu lamaanyeneme lalemanaa yamiyaagadaademeneme 'abelu 'enedazihu taamasagenu zanede la'enaaneta garaanaate

'alaahene szegaawocwame damocwame fatsemo 'ayedaresaweme gene ka'enaaneta yahonawe feraacaa yedaresawaale 'enedazihu 'alaahene bamaraacehu laaye letaakaberute la'enaaneta garaate bago szariwoceneme 'abesere
'alaahe ka'enaziyaa kaamanute laaye yekalaakalelaacawaale 'alaahe kadaatanyaane welataabisene hulu 'ayewademe
la'enaziyaa lamigadalute (me'emanaane) 'enaresu yatabadalu bamakxonaacawe (magaadale) tafaqadalaacawe 'alaaheme 'enaresune bamaredaate laaye ba'eregethe caaye nawe

la'enaziyaa <<geetaacene 'alaahe nawe>> kamaalataacawe basetaqare yaala 'agebaabe ka'agaraacawe yatabaararu lahonute (tafaqada) 'alaahe sawocene kafilaacawene bakafilu magafetaru baalenabara noro gadaamaate, beetakeresetiyaanoceme, mekuraaboceme bawesethaacawe ya'alaahe seme babezaate yamiwasaabaacawe masegidoceme; batafarasu nabare 'alaaheme haayemaanotune yamiradaawene sawe ba'eregethe yeradaawaale 'alaahe beretu 'ashanaafi nawenaa

('enaresume) 'enaziyaa bamedere laaye benaasemacaacawe solaatene 'enedamigabaa yamiyaasetakaakelu, zakaaneme yamisathu, badage nagareme yamiyaazezu, kamathefo nagareme yamikalakelu naacawe yanagarocume hulu macharashaa wada 'alaahe nawe
biyaasetabaabeluheme ka'enasu bafite yanuhhe hhezeboce `aadenaa samudeme ba'eregethe 'asetabaabelawaale
yaberaahimeme hhezeboce yalutheme hhezeboce ('asetabaabelawaale)
yamadeyaneme sawoce ('asetabaabelawaale) musaame tasetabaabelwale lakahhaadiwocume gizee sathaxwaacawe kaziyaame yaazecawe thelaacaayeeme 'enedeete nabara!

kakatamaame 'ereswa badalanyaa honaa yaathafaanaatenaa 'ereswa bathaariyaawocwa laaye wadaaqi yahonacewe bezu naate kataraaqotaceme yawehaa gudegwaade kataganabaame hhenetzaa (yaathafaanawe bezu nawe)

la'enaresume ba'enaresu yamiyaawequbaacawe leboce wayeme ba'enaresu yamisamubaacawe joroce yenorwacawe zanede bamedere laaye 'ayeheedumene 'enaho `aayenoce 'ayetaawarume gene 'enaziyaa badaratoce wesethe yaalute leboce yetaawaraalu
'alaaheme qatharowene bafetsume yamaayethese sihone baqethaate yaacaakuluhaale 'egeetaaheme zanede 'anedu qane kameteqotherute (qane) 'eneda shihhe `aamate nawe
kakatamaa 'ereswa badaaye honaa la'ereswa gizee yasathaxwaatenaa kaziyaame yayaazekwaate bezu naate mamalashaame wadanee becaa nawe
<<'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enee la'enaaneta geletse 'asethaneqaaqi becaa nanye>> balaacawe
'enaziyaame yaamanu malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru la'enaresu meheratenaa yaamaara sisaaye 'alaacawe
'enaziyaame yamiyaamalethu maselwacawe ta`aameraatocaacenene bamaneqafe yatagu 'enasu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe

kamaleketanyaanaa kanabiyeme ka'aneta bafite 'anedeneme 'alaakeneme baanababa ('enaa zeme baala) gizee sayethaane banebaabu laaye (maathemamiyaane qaale) yamithele bihone 'eneje wadiyaaweme 'alaahe sayethaane yamithelawene yaasewagedaale kaziyaame 'alaahe 'aneqatsocune yaathanakeraale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

sayethaane yamithelawene nagare la'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa laalabaacawe lebocaacaweme daraqoce lahonute fatanaa liyaadarege (yethelaale) badaayoceme ka'ewenate baraaqa cheqecheqe wesethe naacawe

'enaziyaame `eweqatene yatasathute 'eresu (qure'aane) kageetaahe yakxona 'ewenate makxonune 'enediyaawequnaa ba'eresu 'enediyaamenu lebocaacaweme la'eresu 'enediraku (yaathanakeraale) 'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene wada qathetanyaawe manegade ba'eregethe mari nawe

'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce sa`aatitu badenegate 'esekametemathaabaacawe wayeme (kadage nagare) makaane yahonawe qane qethaate 'esekamimathaabaacawe derase ka'eresu (kaqure'aane) bamatharaathare wesethe kamahone 'ayewagadume
baziyaa qane negeszenaawe ya'alaahe becaa nawe bamakaakalaacawe yefaredaale 'enaziyaame yaamanute malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszarute bamadasacaa ganatoce wesethe naacawe
'enaziyaame yakaadute ba'aneqatsocaaceneme yaasetabaabalute 'enaziyaa la'enaresu 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alaacawe
'enaziyaame ba'alaahe haayemaanote yatasadadu kaziyaame yatagadalu wayeme yamotu 'alaahe malekaamene sisaaye ba'eregethe yesathaacawaale 'alaaheme 'eresu kasachiwoce hulu balaache nawe
yamiwadutene magebiyaa (ganatene) ba'eregethe yaagabaacawaale 'alaaheme ba'eregethe `awaaqi taagaashe nawe
(nagaru) yehe nawe ba'esu batabadalabateme bethee yatabaqala sawe kaziyaame ba'eresu laaye gefe yatawaalabate 'alaahe ba'eregethe yeradaawaale 'alaahe yeqere baaye mahhaari nawenaa
yehe 'alaahe leelitene baqane wesethe yamiyaasegabaa qaneneme baleelite wesethe yamiyaasegabaa (caaye) 'alaaheme sami tamalekaace bamahonu nawe
yehe 'alaahe 'eresu 'ewenate bamahonu ka'eresume leelaa yamigegazute nagare 'eresu fetsume weshate bamahonu 'alaaheme 'eresu yahulu balaaye taalaaqe bamakxonu nawe
'alaahe kasamaaye wehaane maaweradunenaa medere yametelamaleme makxonwane 'ataayemene 'alaahe ruxeruxe wesetha `awaaqi nawe
basamaayaate wesethe yaalawenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawe hulu yaresu becaa nawe 'alaaheme 'eresu tabeqaaqiwe mesegunu nawe

'alaahe bamedere wesethe yaalane hulu la'enaaneta yagaraalaacehu, marekaboceneme babaahhere wesethe bafaqaadu yamineshaalalu sikxonu (yagaraalaacehu) makxonune, samaayeneme bafaqaadu kaalekxona bamedere laaye 'enedaatewadeqe yamiyezaate makxonune 'alaayahemene 'alaahe lasawoce ba'eregethe ruxeruxe 'azaanye nawe
'eresume yaa hheyaawe yaadaragaacehu nawe kaziyaame yegadelaacexwaale kaziyaame hheyaawe yaadaregaacexwaale sawe ba'eregethe bathaame kahhaadi nawe

layahhezebu hulu 'enasu yamiszarubate yakxonane szere`aata haayemaanote 'adereganaale selazihe banagaru 'ayekaraakaruhe wada geetaahe manegademe theraa 'aneta ba'eregethe baqenu manegade laaye nahenaa
bikaraakaruheme <<'alaahe yametesarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe
'alaahe bateneszaa'ee qane baziyaa ba'eresu telayaayubate banabaraacehute hulu bamakaakalaacehu yefaredaale
'alaahe basamaayenaa bamedere wesethe yaalane hulu ba'eregethe yamiyaaweqe makxonune 'ataaweqemene yehe bamatsehhafe wesethe (yatamazagaba) nawe yehe ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe
ka'alaahe leelaame ba'eresu maaserajaane yaalaawaradabatene la'enaresume ba'eresu `eweqate yaleelaacawene nagare yegegazaalu labaadaayoceme meneme radaate yalaacaweme

'aneqatsocaaceneme yataberaaru kxonawe ba'enasu laaye baminababu gizee ba'enaziyaa bakaadute sawoce fitoce laaye thelaacaane taaweqaalahe ba'enaziyaa ba'enasu laaye 'aneqatsocaacenene bamiyaanabute laaye baxaayele lizalelubaacawe yeqaarabaalu <<kazihe yeleqe yakafaane nagare lenegaraacehune>> balaacawe <<('eresume) 'esaate naate 'alaahe la'enaziyaa lakaadute sawoce qatherwataale mene tekafaame mamalashaa!>>

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'asedanaaqi mesaalee tagalatsalaacehu la'eresume 'ademethute 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazwacawe (thaa`otaate) zenebene fatsemo 'ayefatherume 'eresune (lamafethare) bisabasabume 'enekwaane ('ayecelume) 'anedaaceneme nagare zenebu binatheqaacawe ka'eresu 'ayaasetheluteme falaagiweme tafalaagiweme dakamu
'alaahene tagabi keberune 'alaakabaruteme 'alaahe bathaame xaayaale 'ashanaafi nawe
'alaahe kamalaa'ekete wesethe maleketanyocene yemarethaale kasawoceme ('enedazihu); 'alaahe sami tamalekaace nawe
basetafitaacawe yaalane basetaxwaalaacaweme yaalane hulu yaaweqaale wada 'alaaheme nagaroce hulu yemalasaalu
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu sawoce hoye! (basegedataacehu) 'agonebesu, bagenebaaraacehume tadafu, geetaacehuneme tagazu, bagoneme nagare szeru, letedenu yekajalelaacexwaalenaa

ba'alaaheme haayemaanote tagabiwene tegele taagalu 'eresu marethwacexwaale banaanetame laaye bahaayemaanotu wesethe meneme cegere 'alaadaragabaacehume ya'abaataacehune yaberaahimene haayemaanote takatalu 'eresu kazihe bafite muselimoce belo sayemwacexwaale baziheme (qure'aane); maleketanyaawe ba'enaaneta laaye masekaari 'enedihone 'enaanetame basawocu laaye masekaariwoce 'enedetekxonu (muselimoce belo sayemwacexwaale) solaateneme 'asetakaakelaacehu segadu, zakaaneme sethu, ba'alaaheme tathabaqu, 'eresu radaataacehu nawe ('eresu) mene yaamere thabaaqi! mene yaamereme radaate!
me'emenaane felaagotaacawene hulu ba'eregethe 'aganyu (daanu)
'enaziyaa 'enaresu basegedataacawe wesethe ('alaahene) fariwoce
'enaziyaame 'enaresu kawedeqe negegere raaqiwoce
'enaziyaame 'enaresu zakaane sachewoce
'enaziyaame 'enaresu beletocaacawene thabaaqiwoce yahonute ('aganyu)
bamisetocaacawe wayeme 'ejocaacawe bayaazwacawe (baariyaawoce) laaye siqare 'enaresu (banazihe) yamaayewaqasu naacawenaa
kaziheme wadiyaa yafalagu sawoce 'enaziyaa 'enaresu wasane 'alaafiwoce naacawe
'enaziyaame 'enaresu la'adaraawocaacawenaa laqaale kidaanaacawe thabaaqiwoce
'enaziyaame 'enasu basegedatocaacawe laaye yamithabaabaqu yakxanute ('aganyu)
'enaziyaa waraashocu 'enaresu naacawe
'enaziyaa firedawesene (laa`elaaye ganatene); yamiwaresu naacawe 'enaresu ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
ba'eregetheme sawene kanathara cheqaa fatharenawe
kaziyaame batathabaqa maregiyaa wesethe yafetewate thabetaa 'adaragenawe

kaziyaame thabetaawaane (ba'arebaa qane) yaragaa dame 'aderegane fatharene yaragaaweneme dame quraache szegaa 'aderegane fatharene quraachwaneme szegaa 'athenetoce 'aderegane fatharene 'athenetocuneme szegaane 'alabasenaacawe kaziyaame (nafesene bamazeraate) leelaa fetheratene 'aderegane 'aseganyanawe kasa`aaliwoceme hulu balaache yahonawe 'alaahe laaqa
kaziyaame 'enaaneta kazihe baxwaalaa ba'eregethe mwacoce naacehu
kaziyaame 'enaaneta bateneszaa'ee qane teqasaqasaalaacehu
ba'eregetheme kabalaayaacehu sabaatene samaayaate fatharene kafetheratocume zanegiwoce 'ayedalaneme
kasamaayeme wehaane baleke 'awaradene bamedereme wesethe 'aseqamathenawe 'enyaame 'eresune bamaasewagade laaye ba'eregethe caayoce nane
ba'eresume kazamebaabaawocenaa kawayenoce yakxonune 'atekeletoce la'enaaneta 'aseganyanelaacehu bawesethwa la'enaaneta bezu feraafereewoce 'alwacehu ka'ereswame tebalaalaacehu
kasinaa taraaraame yametewathaane zaafe baqebaatenaa labayewoceme mabaayaa bamikxone (zayete) taqalaaqelaa yametebaqelene ('aseganyanelaacehu)

la'enaanetame bagemale, bakabete, bafeyalenaa babage magamegamiyaa 'alelaacehu bahodocewaa wesethe kaalawe (watate) 'enaathathaacexwaalane la'enaanetame ba'ereswa bezu theqemoce 'alwacehu ka'ereswame tebalaalaacehu
ba'ereswame laaye bamarekabeme laaye techaanaalaacehu
nuhheneme wada hhezebocu ba'eregethe laakenawe wadiyaaweme <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa meneme 'amelaake yalaacehume 'atethanaqaqumene>> 'alaacawe

kahhezebocume 'enaziyaa taalaalaaqocu sawoce 'alu <<yehe betheeyaacehu sawe 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame ba'enaaneta laaye mabelathene yefalegaale 'alaaheme bashaa noro malaa'eketene baawarada nabare yeheneneme (yamilawene) bamajamariyaawocu 'abaatocaacene 'alesamaaneme
<<'eresu ba'eresu `ebedate yaalabate sawe 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame ba'eresume 'eseka gizee (motu) derase tathabaabaqu>> ('alu)
(nuhheme) <<geetaayee hoye! baasetabaabalunye mekeneyaate 'eredaanye>> 'ala

wadaresume ('enedihe senele) laakene <<batamalekaacenataacenenaa bate'ezaazaaceneme taanekwaane szeraa bamathaanaa 'etonu bafalaqa gizee bawesethwa kahulume hulate `aayenatocene beetasaboceheneme kanasu (thafi bamakxone) qaale yaalafabate becaa siqare; 'agebaa ba'enaziyaame babadalute sawoce nagare 'ataanagaageranye 'enasu tasathaamiwoce nacawenaa
'anetame 'aberawehe kaalute gaare bataanekwaayetu laaye batadalaadaleke gizee <<mesegaanaa laziyaa kabadalanyoce hhezeboce laadaanane 'alaahe yegabaawe>> bale
baleme <<geetaayee hoye! beruke yakxonane maawerade 'aweredanye 'anetame ka'aweraajoce hulu balaache nahe >>
bazihe wesethe (lakahaalinataacene) melekatoce 'alelubate 'enaho! (yanuhhene sawoce) ba'eregetheme fatetaanyoce nabarene
kaziyaame kaxwaalaacawe leelocene yakefela zamane hhezeboce 'aseganyane
bawesethaacaweme ka'enasu yakxonane maleketanyaa 'alaahene tagazu ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalaacehume 'atethanaqaqumene bamaalate laakene

kahhezebocume 'enaziyaa yakaadute bamacharashaayetume qane maganaanyate yaasetabaabalute baqerebitume hheyewate yaaqamaathalenaacawe taalaalaaqe sawoce <<yehe betheeyaacehu sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame karesu kametebalute megebe yebalaale kametethathuteme wehaa yethathaale>> 'alu
<<betheeyaacehume yakxonane sawe betetaazazu 'enaaneta yaane gizee ba'eregethe yatamonyaacehu naacahu>> ('alu)
<<'enaaneta bamotaacehunaa `afarenaa 'athenetoceme bakxonaacehu gizee 'enaaneta (kamaqaabere) tewathaalaacehu bamaalate yaasefaraaraacexwaalene
<<yaa yametesefaraarubate nagare raaqa; bathaame raaqa
<<'ereswa (hheyewate) qerebitu hheyewataacene 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme 'enemotaalane; (lejocaacene selamitaku) hheyaaweme 'enekxonaalane 'enyaame taqaseqaashoce 'ayedalaneme
<<'eresu ba'alaahe laaye weshatene yaqathafa sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame 'enyaame la'eresu 'amaanyoce 'ayedalaneme>> ('alu)
(maleketanyaaweme) <<geetaayee hoye! selaasetabaabalunye 'eredaanye>> 'ala
('alaaheme) <<katheqite gizee baxwaalaa (bathefaataacawe) ba'eregethe tatsatsaacoce yekxonaalu>> 'alawe
wadiyaaweme (yathefaate) chukxatitu ba'ewenate yaazacaacawe 'eneda gorefe gebesebaasheme 'adaragenaacawe labadalanyoce hhezeboceme (ka'ezenate) maraaqe tagabaacawe
kaziyaame ka'enasu baxwaalaa leelocene yakefela zamanaate hhezeboce 'aseganyane
maanenyaayetume hhezebe gizeeyaawaane 'ateqadememe; 'ayeqeqoyumeme

kaziyaame maleketanyocaacenene yamikataatalu kxonawe laakene maanenyaayetuneme hhezebe maleketanyaawaa bamathaalaate quthere 'asetabaabalute kafilaacaweneme bakafilu (bathefaate) 'asekataatalane wareewoceme 'adaragenaacawe lamaayaamenume hhezeboce (ka'ezenataacene) maraaqe tagabaacawe
kaziyaame musaanenaa wanedemune haarunene bata`aameraataacenenaa bageletse 'aseraje laakene
wada fare`onenaa wada cheferocu (laakenaacawe) korume yatanebathaararu hhezeboceme nabaru
<<betheeyaaceneme lakxonu hulate sawoce hhezebocaacawe la'enyaa tagazhiwoce kxonawe saalu 'enaamenaalane>> 'alu
'asetabaabaluwaacaweme kathafiwocume kxonu
musaaneme (nagadocu) yememaru zanede matsehhafene ba'eregethe sathanawe
yamareyamene lejenaa 'enaatuneme ta`aamere 'adaragenaacawe yamadalaadalenaa yameneche baalabeete wada kxonace kafetanyaa seferaame 'asethagaanaacawe
'enaaneta maleketanyoce hoye! katafaqadute megeboce belu bago szeraaneme szeru 'enee yametaszarutene hulu `awaaqi nanye
yeheceme (ba'anede 'amelaake yamaamane hhegegaate) 'anede manegade setekxone haayemaanotaacehu naate 'eneeme geetaacehu nanyenaa ferunye
(kaziyaa takataayocaacawe) yahaayemaanote nagaraacaweneme bamakaakalaacawe kefelefeloce 'aderegawe qoraarathu hhezebe hulu 'enaresu zanede baalawe haayemaanote tadasaacoce naacawe
'eseka gizeeyaacaweme derase bathememataacawe wesethe tawaacawe
kaganezabenaa kalejoce ba'eresu yamenechamerelaacawene yaasebaalune
babago nagaroce yamenecaakolelaacawe makxonene (yaasebaalune) 'ayedalame; (lamaazanegaate makxonune) 'ayaawequme
'enaziyaa 'enaresu geetaacawene kamaferaate yatanasaa tachanaaqiwoce yakxonute
'enaziyaame 'enaresu bageetaacawe ta`aameraatoce kamiyaamenute
'enaziyaame 'enaresu bageetaacawe (thaa`otene) yamaayaagaarute
'enaziyaame yamisathutene nagare 'enaresu wada geetaacawe tamalaashoce makxonaacawene lebocaacawe yamifaru kxonawe yamisathute
'enaziyaa bamalekaame szeraawoce yethaadafaalu 'enasume lareswa qadaamiwoce naacawe
maanenyaayetuneme nafese celotaawaane 'eneji 'anaasegadedaateme 'enyaame zanede ba'ewenate yaminaagare matsehhafe 'alela 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
ba'ewenatu (kahhaadiwoce) lebocaacawe kaziyaa (matsehhafe) bazenegaatee wesethe naacawe la'enasume kazihe leelaa 'enasu lareswa szariwocewaa yakxonu (mathefo) szeraawoce 'alwacawe
qemethelocaacaweneme baqethaate bayaazenaacawe gizee wadiyaawenu 'enaresu yewatawetaalu
zaaree 'atewatewetu; 'enaaneta ka'enyaa zanede 'ateradume
'aneqatsocu ba'enaaneta laaye ba'eregethe yenababulaacehu nabare batarakazocaacehume laaye wada xwaalaacehu temalasu nabaraacehu
ba'eresu (bakelelu beete) kuruwoce leelite tachaawaacoce (qure'aaneneme) yametetawe kxonaacehu (temalasu nabaraacehu yebaalaalu)
(yaqure'aanene) negegeruneme 'ayaasetanatenumene wayese lamajamariyaawocu 'abaatocaacawe yaalemathaa nagare mathaabaacawene
wayese maleketanyaacawene 'alaawaqumene selazihe 'enaresu la'eresu kahhaadiwoce naacawene
wayese ba'eresu `ebedate 'alabate yelaalune 'ayedalame 'ewenatene yezo mathaalaacawe 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'ewenatene thayewoce naacawe

'alaaheme zenebaaleewocaacawene batakatala noro samaayaatenaa medere bawesethaacaweme yaalawe hulu ba'eregethe batabalaasha nabare yelequneme keberaacawe yaalabatene qure'aane 'amathaanelaacawe 'enaresume kakeberaacawe zanegiwoce naacawe
wayese geberene tethayeqaacawaalahene yageetaaheme cerotaa balaache nawe 'eresume kasachiwoce hulu balaache nawe
'anetame wada qathetanyaawe manegade ba'eregethe tetharaacawaalahe
'enaziyaame bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenute katekekelanyaawe manegade tazanebaayoce naacawe
baazanenelaacawenaa kagudaateme ba'enaresu yaalawene baanasaanelaacawe noro bathemataacawe wesethe yamiwaalelu kxonawe yezawateru nabare
ba'eregetheme baqethaate yaazenaacawe taadiyaa lageetaacawe 'aletanaanasume 'ayewaadaqumeme
ba'enasume laaye yaberetu qethaate baalabeete yakxona dajaafene bakafatenebaacawe gizee 'enaresu yaane gizee ba'eresu tasefaa qoraachoce naacawe
'eresume yaa masemiyaawocenenaa maayaawocene leboceneme la'enaaneta yafatharalaacehu nawe theqitene 'eneje 'ataamasagenume
'eresume yaa bamedere wesethe yabatanaacehu nawe wadaresume tesabasabaalaacehu
'eresume yaa hheyaawe yamiyaadarege yamigadeleme nawe yaleelitenaa yaqane matakaakaateme ya'eresu nawe 'ataawequmene
yelequneme (yamakaa kahhaadiwoce) yafitanyocu hhezeboce 'enedaalute bethee 'alu
<<bamotenenaa `afarenaa 'athenetoce bakxone gizee 'enyaa taqaseqaashoce nane>> 'alu
<<yehenene 'enyaame ka'enyaa bafiteme yanabarute 'abaatocaacene ba'eregethe taqatheranaale yehe yamajamariyaawocu sawoce taratoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> ('alu)
<<mederenaa bawesethewaa yaalawe hulu yamaane nawe yametaawequ betekxonu (negarunye)>> balaacawe
<<ba'eregethe ya'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<taadiyaa 'ategasatsumene>> balaacawe
<<yasabaatu samaayaate geetaanaa yataalaaqu `areshe geetaa maane nawe>> balaacawe
<<ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<'enegediyaa 'atefarutemene>> balaacawe
<<yanagaru hulu gezaate ba'eju yakxona 'eresu yamithabeqe ba'eresu laaye yamaayethabaqe maane nawe yametaawequ 'enedakxonaacehu (malesulenye)>> balaacawe
<<ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<taadiyaa 'enedeete tetaalalaalaacehu>> balaacawe
yelequneme 'ewenatene 'amathaanelaacawe 'enaresume (bamakaadaacawe) weshataamoce naacawe

'alaahe meneme lejene 'aleyaazame ('alewaladame) ka'eresume gaare 'anedeme 'amelaake yalame yaane gizee (leelaa 'amelaake banabara) 'amelaake hulu bafatharawe nagare batalaya nabare kafilaacaweme bakafilu laye balaaqa nabare 'alaahe kamimathenute hulu tharaa
ruqunenaa qerebuneme hulu `awaaqi nawe (ba'eresu) kamiyaagaaruteme hulu kafe 'ala
(muhhamade hoye!) bale <<geetaayee hoye! yamiyaasefaraarubatene (qethaate) betaasaayanye
<<geetaayee hoye! babadalanyoce hhezeboce wesethe 'ataadereganye >>
'enyaame yamenaasefaraaraacawene nagare lenaasaayehe ba'eregethe caayoce nane
baziyaace 'eresewaa malekaame bakxonacewe (thabaaye) mathefoyetune nagare gafetere 'enyaa yamilutene hulu `awaaqiwoce nane
baleme <<geetaayee ho! kasayethaanaate gutetagotaawoce ba'aneta 'ethabaqaalahu
<<baanetame geetaayee hoye! (banagarocee) wada'enee kamathaadaacawe 'ethabaqaalahu >>
'anedaacaweneme mote bamathaabate gizee 'enedihe yelaale <<geetaayee hoye! (wada medera `aalame) malesunye

<<batawekute nagare bagone szeraa leszaraa 'ekajelaalahunaa >> (yehene kamaalate) yekalekale 'eresewaa 'eresu tanaagaariwaa yakxonace kanetu qaale naate kasetafitaacaweme 'esekamiqasaqasubate qane derase geredo 'alela
baqanedume batanafaa gizee baziyaa qane bamakaakalaacawe zemedenaa yalame 'ayethayaayaqumeme
mizaanocume yakabadulate sawe 'enaziyaa 'enaresu felaagotaacawene yaaganyu naacawe
mizaanocume yaqalalubate sawe 'enaziyaa 'enaresu nafesocaacawene yaakasaru naacawe bagahaname wesethe zamawetaariwoce naacawe
fitocaacawene 'esaate tegarefucawaalace 'enaresume ba'ereswa wesethe kanefarocaacawe yatakomaataru naacawe
<<'aneqatsocee ba'enaaneta laaye yaminababulaacehunaa ba'enaresu yametaasetabaabelu 'alenabaraacehumene>> (yebaalaalu)
yelaalu <<geetaacene hoye! ba'enyaa laaye manaathinataacene 'ashanafacene thamaamaawoceme hhezeboce nabarene
<<geetaacene hoye! ka'ereswa 'awethaane (wada kehedate) benemalaseme 'enyaa badayoce nane >>
('alaaheme) <<waraadoce kxonaacehu bawesethewaa 'eregu 'ataanaagerunyeme>> yelaacawaale
'enaho kabaarocee <<geetaacene hoye! 'amenanaalenaa maarane 'ezaneleneme 'anetame ka'azaanyoce hulu yebalethe 'azaanye nahe>> yamilu kefeloce nabaru
'eneeneme maawesaatene 'esekaaseraswacehu deraseme maalaagachaa 'aderegaacehu yaazaacexwaacawe ba'enaresume yametesequ nabaraacehu
'enee zaaree bate`egesetaacawe mekeneyaate 'enasu felaagotaacawene yamiyaaganyute 'enaresu becaa bamakxone manadaaxwaacawe; (yelaacawaale)
<<bamedere wesethe ka`aamataate quthere senetene qoyaacehu>> yelaacawaale
<<'anede qanene wayeme kafile qanene qoyane qothaariwocuneme thayeqe>> yelaalu
<<'enaaneta (yaqoyaacehutene mathane) yametaawequ betekxonu noro (ba'esaate wesethe bameteqoyute 'anetzaare) theqitene gizee 'eneji 'aleqoyaacehume>> yelaacawaale
<<yafatharenaacehu lakanetu makxonune 'enaanetame wadanyaa yamaatemalasu makxonaacehune tharatharaacehune>> (lakanetu yafatharenaacehu masalaacehune)
ya'ewenatume neguse 'alaahe kafetanyaanate tagabaawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame yamiyaamerawe `areshe geetaa nawe
ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane 'amelaake la'eresu ba'eresu maaserajaa yaleelawene yamigazaa sawe meremaraawe 'egeetaawe zanede becaa nawe 'enaho kahhaadiwoce 'ayedenume
baleme <<geetaayee hoye maare; 'ezaneme 'anetame ka'azaanyoce hulu balaache nahe >>
(yehece) yaawaradenaatenaa yadanagagenaate me`eraafe naate ba'ereswame wesethe tegasatzu zanede geletsocene 'aneqatsoce 'aweredanaale

zemutanyaayetunaa zemutanyaawe kahulatu 'eyaanedaanedaacawene (yaalaagabu 'enedakxonu) mato gerefaatene gerafuwaacawe; ba'enaresume ba'alaahe ferede rexeraaxee 'ateyaazaacehu ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yametaamenu 'enedakxonaacehu ('ateraaru) qethaataacaweneme kame'emenaane cheferoce yeganyubate
zemutanyaawe zemutanyaayetune wayeme 'agaariyetune 'eneji 'ayaagabaame zemutanyaayetuneme zemutanyaa wayeme 'agaari 'eneji 'ayaagabaateme yeheme bame'emenaane laaye takalekelwale

'enaziyaame thebeqocene seetoce (bazemute) yamisadebu kaziyaame 'araatene mesekeroce yaalaamathu samaaniyaane gerefaate gerafwacawe ka'enaresume mesekerenatene hulegizee 'ateqabalu 'enaziyaame 'enasu 'amatsanyoce naacawe
'enaziyaa kazihe baxwaalaa yatatsatsatunaa szeraacawene yaasaamaru siqaru 'alaahe bathaame mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

'enaziyaame misetocaacawene (bazemute) yamisadebu la'enasume kanafesocaacawe basetaqare mesekeroce yaleelwacawe yakxonu ya'anedaacawe mesekerenate 'eresu kawenatanyoce lamakxonu ba'alaahe seme 'araate gizee melo mamasekare nawe
'amesetanyaayetume kaweshataamoce bikxone ba'eresu laaye ya'alaahe 'eregemaane yenurebate (belo mamasekare) nawe
'eresume kaweshataamoce nawe belaa 'araate gizee mamasekarocene ba'alaahe seme mamasekarewaa ka'eresewaa laaye qethaatene yegafaterelaataale
'amesetanyaayetume 'eresu kawenatanyoce bikxone ba'eresewaa laaye ya'alaahe quthaa yenurebaate (belaa mamasekarewaa) nawe
ba'enaanetame laaye ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baalenabara 'alaaheme tsatsatene taqabaaye thebabanyaa baalekxona noro (weshataamune yegaletsawe nabare)

'enaziyaa mathefone weshate yaamathu kanaanetawe yakxonu cheferoce naacawe la'enaaneta kefu nagare nawe belaacehu 'ataasebute ba'ewenatu 'eresu la'enaaneta malekaame nagare nawe ka'enaresu (kacheferocu) layaanedaanedu sawe kaxathi'ate yaszaraawe szeraa waagaa 'alawe yaame ka'enasu telequne xathi'ate yatashakamawe la'eresu kabaade qethaate 'alawe
(weshatune) basamaacehute gizee me'emenaanenaa me'emenaate bagosocaacawe lamene dagene nagare 'aletharatharume lamenese yehe geletse weshate nawe 'alaalume
ba'eresu laaye lamene 'araatene mesekeroce 'alaamathume mesekerocuneme kaalaamathu 'enaziyaa 'alaahe zanede weshataamocu 'enasu naacawe

baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame ba'enaaneta laaye ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baalenabara noro bawesethu bagabaacehubate waree mekeneyaate taalaaqe qethaate ba'eregethe badarasabaacehu nabare

bamelaasocaacehu bameteqebabaalute gizee la'enaanetame ba'eresu `eweqate baleelaacehu nagare ba'afocaacehu batanaagaraacehunaa 'eresu 'alaahe zanede kabaade xathi'ate kxono saala qalaale 'aderegaacehu baasabaacehute gizee (kabaade qethaate banakaacehu nabare)
basamaacehuteme gizee bazihe lenenaagare la'enyaa 'ayegabaaneme theraate yegabaahe yehe kabaade qethefate nawe; 'atelume nabarene
me'emanaane 'enedakxonaacehu wada betheewe bafetzume 'enedaatemalasu 'alaahe yegasetsaacexwaale
la'enaanetame 'alaahe 'aneqatsocene yegaletselaacexwaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

'enaziyaa ba'enaziyaa baamanute sawoce wesethe mathefo waree 'enedetesefaafaa yamiwadu la'enasu baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe 'alaaheme yaaweqaale 'enaaneta gene 'ataawequme
ba'enaanetame laaye ya'alaahe cerotaawenaa 'ezenatu baalenabara 'alaaheme ruxeruxenaa 'azaanye baalekxona noro (tolo baathafaacehu nabare)

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! yasayethaanene 'eremejaawoce 'atekatalu yasayethaaneneme 'eremejaawoce yamikatale sawe (xathi'atene tashakama) 'eresu bamathefonaa bamithalaa nagare yaazaalenaa ba'enaanetame laaye ya'alaahe cerotaanaa 'ezenatu baalenabara noro kanaaneta 'anedeme fatsemo baaletharaa nabare gene 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe yaatharaale 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

ka'enaanetame yacerotaanaa yakeberate baalabeetoce yakxonute laqerebe zamadocenaa ladekxoce ba'alaaheme manegade latasadadu sawoce laayesathu 'ayemaalu yeqeretaame yaaderegu (thefaatanyocune) yelafume 'alaahe la'enaaneta limere 'atewadumene 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
'enaziyaa thebeqocune kazemute zanegiwocune me'emenaate yamisadebu; baqerebitume bamacharashaayetume `aalame taragamu la'enaresume taalaaqe qethaate 'alaacawe
ba'enasu laaye melaasocaacawe, 'ejocaacawenaa 'egerocaacaweme yeszarute banabarute nagare bamimasakerubaacawe qane (kabaade qethaate 'alaacawe)
baziyaa qane 'alaahe 'ewenatanyaa waagaacawene yemolaalaacawaale 'alaaheme 'eresu manoru yataragaagatha (hulune nagare) galaache makxonune yaaweqaalu

mathefowocu seetoce lamathefowoce wanedoce mathefowocu wanedoceme lamathefowocu seetoce yatagabu naacawe theruwocu seetoceme latheruwocu wanedoce theruwocu wanedoceme latheruwocu seetoce yamigabu naacawe 'enaziyaa (mathefowocu) kamilute nagare netsuhhe yatadaragu naacawe la'enaresu meheratenaa malekaame sisaaye 'alaacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'esekametaasefaqedunaa babaalabeetocwa laaye salaametaane 'esekametaaqarebu derase kabeetocaacehu leelaa yakxonune beetoce 'ategebu yehe la'enaaneta malekaame nawe 'enaaneta teganazabu zanede (bazihe taazazaacehu)

bawesethwame 'anedeneme sawe baataaganyu la'enaaneta 'esekamifaqadelaacehu derase 'ategebwate la'enaaneta tamalasu betebaalume tamalasu 'eresu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe

manoriyaa yaalekxonune beetoce bawesethaacawe la'enaaneta theqeme yaalaacehune (saataasefaqedu) betegabu ba'enaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalabaacehume 'alaaheme yametegaletsutenenaa yametedabequtene hulu yaaweqaale
lame'emanaane negaraacawe - `aayenocaacawene (yaaletafaqadane kamaayate) yekalekelu; beletocaacaweneme yethabequ; yehe lanasu yatashaala nawe; 'alaahe bamiszarute hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe

lame'emenaateme negaraacawe - `aayenocaacawene yekalekelu beletocaacaweneme yethabequ geethaacaweneme ka'ereswa geletse kakxonawe basetaqare 'ayegelathu gufetaawocaacaweneme ba'anegategeewocaacawe laaye yaathaafu (yawesethe) geethaacaweneme labaalocaacawe wayeme la'abaatocaacawe wayeme labaalocaacawe 'abaatoce wayeme lawanedoce lejocaacawe wayeme labaalocaacawe wanedoce lejoce wayeme lawanedemocaacawe wayeme lawanedemocaacawe wanedoce lejoce wayeme la'ehetocaacawe wanedoce lejoce wayeme laseetocaacawe wayeme 'ejocaacawe layaazute (baariyaa) wayeme kawanedoce laseete gudaaye yaleelaacawe lakxonu takataayoce wayeme lanaziyaa baseetoce hhaferata galaa laaye laalaawaqu hhetzaanoce kaalekxona basetaqare 'ayegelatsu kageethaacaweme yamishafenute yetaawaqe zanede ba'egerocaacawe 'ayemetu me'emanaanoce hoye! tedenu zanede hulaacehume wada 'alaahe (bamamalase) tatsatsatu

kanaanetame tedaare yaleelaacawene 'agaabu kawanedoce baarocaacehunaa kaseetoce baarocaacehume lagaabecaa bequ yakxonutene ('agaabu) dekxoce bikxonu 'alaahe kacerotaawe yaakaberaacawaale 'alaaheme sethotaawe safi `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaame yamaagebiyaane thaathaa yamaayaaganyu 'alaahe kacerotaawe 'esekamiyaakaberaacawe derase yethabaqu 'enaziyaaneme 'ejocaacehu kachabathwacawe 'agalegaayoce (ganezabe sathetawe natsaa lamawethaate) matsaatsaafene yamifalegutene ka'enasu malekaamene nagare betaawequ tatsaatsaafuwaacawe ka'alaaheme ganezabe kaziyaa kasathaacehu sethwacawe seetoce baarocaacehuneme mathethabaqene bifalegu yaqerebitune hheyewate theqeme lamafalage belaacehu bazemute laaye 'ataasegadeduwaacawe yamiyaasegadedaacaweme sawe 'alaahe kamagadadaacawe baxwaalaa (latagadadute) mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
wada'enaanetame 'aberaari yakxonune 'aneqatsoce ka'enaziyaa kabafitaacehu kaalafuteme (mesaaleewoce `aayenate) mesaaleene lathenequqocu magasachaaneme ba'eregethe 'awaradene

'alaahe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere 'aberi nawe yaberehaanu mesaalee bawesethwa maberaate 'enedaalabaate (zege) masekote, maberaatu baberecheqo wesethe yakxona, berecheqoyetu fetzume lulaawi kokabe yametemasale, meszeraaqaawiwe me`eraabaawime kaalekxonace katabaarakace yawayeraa zaafe zayetwa 'esaate baayenakaaweme 'enekwaa liyaabaraa yamiqarebe kakxonace (zayete) yamiqaathale 'eneda hona (maberaate) nawe (yehe) baberehaane laaye yakxona berehaane nawe 'alaahe wada berehaanu yamishaawene sawe yemaraale 'alaaheme lasawoce mesaaleewocene yaaqarebaale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe
'alaahe 'enedetekabarenaa semu bawesethwa 'enediwasaa baazazawe beetoce wesethe ('awadesute) bawesethwa bathwatenaa bamaataa la'eresu yaatharaalu

'alaahene kamaawesaatenaa solaatene kamasegade zakaaneme kamasethate negedeme sheyaacheme yamaayaataalelaacawe lebocenaa `aayenoce ba'eresu yamigalaabathubatene qane yamifaru yakxonu sawoce (yaatharutaale)
'alaahe yaszarutene szeraa malekaamune limanadaacawe kacerotaaweme lichamarelaacawe (yaatharutaale) 'alaaheme lamishaawe sawe yaala gemete yesathaale

'enaziyaame yakaadute sawoce szeraawocaacawe (malekaamocu) babarahaa meedaa 'enedaala siribedu yathamaawe sawe wehaa nawe belo 'enedamiyaasebawe bamathaaweme gizee meneme nagare kxono 'enedamaayaaganyawe nawe (kahhaadiwe) 'alaaheneme 'eszaraawe zanede yaaganyawaale meremaraaweneme (qethaatune) yemolaalataale 'alaaheme meremaraawe fathaane nawe

wayeme (mathefo szeraawocaacawene) kabalaayu damanaa yaalabate maa`ebale bamishafanawe theleqe baahere wesethe 'enedaalu chalamaawoce nawe ('enaziyaa) kafilaacawe kakafilu balaaye dereberebe yakxonu chalamaawoce naacawe (bazihece) yatamokara (sawe) 'ejune baawathaa gizee liyaayaate 'ayeqarebeme 'alaaheme la'eresu berehaanene yaalaadaragalate sawe la'eresu meneme berehaane yalaweme

'alaahe basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaala hulu baraariwoceme kenefocaacawene (ba'ayare laaye) yaanesaafafu kxonawe la'eresu yamiyaatharu (yamiyaawadesu) makxonaacawene 'alaawaqehemene hulume segedatunenaa maatheraatune ba'eregethe `awaqa 'alaaheme yamiszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedereme gezaate ya'alaahe nawe mamalashaame wada 'alaahe nawe

'alaahe damanaane yaminadaa makxonune 'alaayahemene kaziyaame kafilune kakafilu yaaganaanyaale kaziyaame yatadaraaraba yaadaregawaale zenaabuneme kamakaakalu yamiwathaa kxono taayawaalahe kasamaayeme (kadamanaa) bawesethwa kaalute gaaraawoce baradone yaawaredaale ba'eresume yamishaawene sawe (bagudaate) yenakaale kamishaaweme sawe laaye yemalesawaale yabelechetaawe berehaane `aayenocene liwasede yeqarebaale
'alaahe leelitenenaa qanene yaagalaabethaale baziheme labaala wesethe `aayenoce ba'eregethe maaserajaa 'alelabate

'alaaheme taneqasaaqaashene hulu kawehaa fathara ka'enasume bahodu laaye yamikxeede 'alela ka'enasume bahulate 'egeroce laaye yamikxeede 'alela 'alaahe yamishaawene hulu yefatheraale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa
'aberaarine 'aneqatsoce ba'eregethe 'awaradene 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe wada qathetanyaa manegade yemaraawaale
ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaaweme 'amenanaale taazanaaleme yelaalu kaziyaame kazihe baxwaalaa ka'enasu kafilu yeshashaale 'enaziyaame me'emenaane 'ayedalume;
wada 'alaahenaa wada maleketanyaaweme bamakaakalaacawe lifarede batatharu gizee ka'enasu kafilu wadiyaawenu yeshashaalu
'ewenatume (hhaqu) la'enasu bikxone wadaresu taazaazhoce kxonawe yemathaalu

balebocaacawe wesethe bashitaa 'alane wayese (banabiyenatu) tatharaatharune wayese 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe ba'enasu laaye yamibadelu makxonene yefaraalune yelequneme; 'enaziyaa 'enasu badaayocu naacawe

yame'emenaane qaale yanabarawe wada 'alaahenaa wada maleketanyaawe bamakaakalaacawe lifarede batatharu gizee samaane; taazazeneme maalate becaa nawe 'enaziheme 'enasu yafalagutene yamiyaaganyu naacawe
'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamitaazazeme sawe, 'alaaheneme yamifaraanaa yamithanaqaqawe sawe; 'enaziyaa 'enaresu felagotaacawene yamiyaaganyu naacawe

(lazamacaa) betaazaacaweme ba'eregethe liwathu yathanakaru mahhaalocaacawene ba'alaahe seme yemelaalu <<'atemaalu; yataawaqace (yanefeqenaa) mataazaze naatenaa 'alaahe bameteszarute nagare hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe

<<'alaahene tagazu maleketanyaaweneme taazazu; beteshashume ('ategoduteme) ba'eresu laaye yaalabate yatagadadawene maaderase becaa nawe ba'enaanetame laaye yaalabaacehu yatagadadaacehute (mataazaze) becaa nawe betetaazazuteme tememaraalaacehu bamale'eketanyaaweme laaye geletse maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabateme>> balaacawe

'alaahe 'enaziyaane ka'enaaneta yaamanutenenaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszarutene 'enaziyaane ka'enasu bafite yanabarutene 'enedatakaa bamedere laye ba'eregethe litakaacawe, la'enasume yaanene yawadadalaacawene haayemaanotaacawene liyaadalaadelelaacawe, kaferehaataacaweme baxwaalaa tsathetaane lilawethelaacawe tasefaane qaale sathetwacawaale ba'enee meneneme yamaayaagaaru kxonawe yegegazunyaale kaziyaame baxwaalaa yakaada sawe 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'amatsanyoce naacawe
solaateneme 'asetakaakelaacehu segadu metsewaateneme sethu maleketanyaaweneme taazazu la'enaaneta litaazanelaacehu yekajalaalenaa
'enaziyaane yakaadutene bamedere wesethe yamiyaaqetu 'aderegahe 'ataasebe manoriyaacaweme 'esaate naate ba'eregetheme yakafaace mamalashaa naate

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'enaziyaa 'ejocaacehu yachabathwacawe (baaroce) 'enaziyaame ka'enaaneta la'akaalaa mathane yaaledarasute kagohe segedate bafite, baqatereme lebesocaacehune bametaawalequ gizee kameshete segedateme baxwaalaa szosete gizeeyaate (lamagebaate sifalegu) yaasefaqedwacehu ('enazihe) la'enaaneta yakxonu szosete yahhaferata galaa magalachaa gizeeyaatoce naacawenaa ka'enazihe baxwaalaa ba'enaanetame ba'enaresume laaye (yaalafaqaade bamagebaate) xathi'ate yalame ba'enaaneta laaye (lamaagalegale) zuwaariwoce naacawenaa kafilaacehu bakafilu laaye zuwaari nawe 'enedazihu 'alaahe la'enaaneta hhegegaatene yegaletselaacexwaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

ka'enaanetame hhetzaanaatocu 'aqema 'adaamene badarasu gizee 'enaziyaa ka'enasu bafite yanabarute (taalaalaaqocu) 'enedaasefaqadu yaasefaqedu 'enedazihu 'alaahe la'enaaneta 'aneqatsocune yaaberaaraale; 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

kaseetoceme 'enaziyaa gaabecaane yamaayefalegute taqamaachoce (baaleteetoce); bageethe yatagalatzu saayekxonu yalaaye lebesocaacawene bithelu ba'enasu laaye xathi'ate yalabaacaweme gene mathabaqaacawe la'enaresu yatashaala nawe 'alaaheme sami `awaaqi nawe

(kasawoce gaare bamabelaate) ba`ewere laaye xathi'ate yalabateme ba'anekaasaame laaye xathi'ate yalabateme babashetanyaame laaye xathi'ate yalabateme banafesocaacehume laaye kabeetocaacehu wayeme ka'abaatocaacehu beetoce wayeme ka'enaatocaacehu beetoce wayeme kawanedemocaacehu beetoce wayeme ka'exetocaacehu beetoce wayeme ka'agotocaacehu beetoce wayeme ka'akesetocaacehu beetoce wayeme kayashumocaacehu beetoce wayeme kayashumeewocaacehu beetoce wayeme makefacaawocune kayaazaacehute beete wayeme kawadaajaacehu beete (betebalu) xathi'ate yalabaacehume tasabesebaacehu wayeme talayaayetaacehu betebalu ba'enaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalabaacehume beetoceneme bagabaacehu gizee; ka'alaahe zanede yakxonacene yatabaarakace malekaame salaametaa banafesocaacehu laaye salaame balu 'enedazihu 'alaahe 'aneqatsocene la'enaaneta yaaberaaraale letaawequ yekajalaalenaa

me'emanaane maalate 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe yaamanute; ka'eresu gaare bamisabasabe gudaaye laaye bakxonu gizee 'esekamiyaasefaqedu derase yamaayekxeedute becaa naacawe 'enaziyaa yamiyaasefaqeduhe 'enaresu 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe yamiyaamenute naacawe lagele gudaayaacaweme faqaade bathayaquhe gizee ka'enasu lashaakxawe sawe feqadelate la'enasume 'alaahene mehheratene lamenelaacawe 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

bamakaakalaacehu yamaleketanyaawene theri kafilaacehu kafilune 'eneda matheraate 'ataaderegute ka'enaaneta wesethe 'enaziyaane 'eyatakalalu bamaselakelake yamiwathutene 'alaahe ba'eregethe yaaweqaacawaale 'enaziyaame te`ezaazune yamithesu makaraa 'enedaatedaresebaacawe wayeme 'asaamaami qethaate 'enedaayaaganyaacawe yethaneqaqu

nequ! basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe becaa nawe 'enaaneta ba'eresu laaye yaalaacehubatene kxuneetaa ba'eregethe yaaweqaale wada'eresu yamimalasubatene qaneme (yaaweqaale) yaszaruteneme hulu yenageraacawaale 'alaaheme nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawe
yaa fureqaanene babaariyaawe laaye la`aalamaate 'asefaraari yekxone zanede yaawaradawe ('amelaake) keberenaa theraate tagabaawe
('eresu) yaa yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa ya'eresu becaa yakxona, lejeneme yaaleyaaza, banegeszenaaweme tagaari yaleelawe, nagaruneme hulu yafatharanaa batekekeleme yaazagaajawe nawe

(kahhaadiwoce) ka'eresume leelaa meneneme yamaayefatherune, 'enaresume yamifatharune, lanafesocaacaweme gudaatene lamakalaakale theqemeneme lamaamethaate yamaayecelune motenenaa hheyewateneme maqaseqaseneme yamaayecelune, 'amaalekete yaazu
'enaziyaame yakaadute yehe (qure'aane muhhamade) yaqathafawe ba'eresume laaye leeloce hhezeboce yaagazute yakxona weshate 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame 'alu ba'eregetheme badalenenaa 'ebelatene szaru
'alume <<yamajamariyaawocu sawoce taratoce naate 'asetsaafaate 'ereswame ba'eresu laaye thwatenaa maataa tenababelataalace >>
<<yaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalane mesethire yamiyaaweqawe 'awaradawe 'eresu mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa>> balaacawe

laziheme maleketanyaa megebene yamibalaa, bagabayaawoceme yamikxeede sikxone mene (maleketanyaanate) 'alawe karesu gaare 'asefaraari yekxone zanede wadaresu male'ake (gahaade) 'ayewarademe norwalene 'alu

<<wayeme wada'eresu delebe 'ayethaalelatemene wayeme ka'ereswa yamibalaalaate 'atekelete la'eresu 'atenorawemene>> ('alu) badaayocume (laamanute) <<yatadagamabatene sawe 'eneji leelaa 'atekatalume>> 'alu
laaneta mesaaleewocene 'enedeete 'enedaadaragulehenaa 'enedatasaasaatu tamalekate (wada 'ewenate lamaderase) manegadeneme 'ayecelume
yaa bishaa kazihe (kaalute) yatashaalane kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene 'atekeletoce laaneta yamiyaadaregelehe hhenetsaa beetoceneme laaneta yamiyaadaregelehe geetaa cerotaawe bazaa
yelequneme bateneszaa'ee 'asetabaabalu bateneszaa'ee laasetabaabalame sawe hulu nadaajene 'esaate 'azagaajetanaale
karuqe seferaa baayacaacawe gizee la'ereswa yaquchete maganefalenenaa maanaafaatene yesamaalu
'eje kafeneje yataaszaru kxonaweme ka'ereswa bathabaabe seferaa batathaalu gizee baziyaa seferaa thefaatene yetharaalu; (waa thefaataacene yelaalu)
-zaaree 'anedene thefaate becaa 'atetheru bezuneme thefaate theru (yebaalaalu)
('enedihe) balaacawe <<yehe yatashaala nawene wayese thenequqocu tasefaa yatasathwate yazala`aalamwa ganate>> la'enaresu menedaanaa mamalashaa kxonace
la'enasu bawesethwa zawetaariwoce kxonawe yamifalegute hulu 'alelaacawe (yeheme) tasefaa kageetaahe talamaanye tasefaa nawe
