'enaresunenaa ka'alaahe leelaa yamigegazwacaweneme yamisabasebebaacawenenaa <<'enaaneta 'enazihene baaroceene 'asaasaataacehune wayese 'enasuwe manegadene saatu>> yamilebatene qane ('asetaawese)

<<theraate yegabaahe; kaaneta leelaa radaatocene leneyeze la'enyaa tagabiyaacene 'alenabarame gene 'enaresuneme 'abaatocaacaweneme maganezabene 'esekatawu derase 'athaaqamekaacawe thafi hhezeboceme kxonu>> yelaalu
bameteluteme ('amaaleketocaacehu) 'asewaashuwaacehu qethaateene magafetareneme maredaateneme 'atecelume ka'enaanetame yamibadelawene taalaaqene qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane; (yebaalaalu)

ka'aneta bafiteme kamaleketanyoce 'enasu ba'eregethe megebene yamibalu bagabayaawoceme yamikxeedu kxonawe basetaqare 'alelaakeneme kafilaacehuneme lakafilu fatanaa 'adereganaale tetaagasaalaacehune geetaaheme tamalekaace nawe

'enaziyaame maganaanyataacenene yamaayefarute ba'enyaa laaye lamene malaa'ekete 'alewaradame wayeme geetaacenene lamene 'anaayeme 'alu banafesocaacawe wesethe ba'eregethe koru taalaaqeneme 'amatse 'amatzu
malaa'eketene bamiyaayubate qane baziyaa gizee la'amatsanyoce meseraace yalaacaweme <<yatakalakala kelekeleme 'aderegane>> yelaalu
kaszeraame wada szarute 'enaasebaalane yatabatana tebiyaame 'enaadaregawaalane
yaganate sawoce baziyaa qane bamaregiyaa yatashaalu bamaarafiyaame bathaame yaamaaru naacawe
samaayeme badamanaa yameteqadadebatenenaa malaa'eketeme mawaradene yamiwaredebatene qane ('asetaawese)
'ewenatanyaawe negeszenaa baziyaa qane la'aleraahhemaane becaa nawe bakahhaadiwoceme laaye 'asecagaari qane nawe
badaayeme <<kamaleketanyaawe gaare qathetanyaane manegade yezhee bakxona waa menyotee!>> 'eyaala (batsatsate) hulate 'ejocune yaminakesebatene qane ('asetaawese)
<<waa thefaatee! 'egaleene wadaaje baaleyaazeku noro 'emanyaalahu
(ya'emenate qaalene) kamathaalenye baxwaalaa kamaasetaawase ba'eregethe 'asaasaatanye>> (yelaale) sayethaaneme lasawe 'agaalaache nawe
maleketanyaaweme <<geetaayee hoye! hhezebocee yehenene qure'aane yatatawa nagare 'aderegawe yaazute>> 'ala
'enedazihume lanabiyu hulu ka'amatsanyoce yakxona thalaatene 'adereganaale marinaa radaateme bageetaahe baqaa

'enaziyaa yakaaduteme <<qure'aane ba'eresu laaye lamene bathaqelaalaa 'anede gizee 'aletawaradame>> 'alu 'enedazihu ba'eresu lebehene lenaaragaa (kafaafelane 'awaradenawe) qase baqase malayaayateneme layanawe
batheyaaqeeme 'ayemathubeheme 'ewenatanyaawene (malese) malekaamene feceme yamenaamathaalehe benekxone 'eneje
'enaziyaa bafitocaacawe laye ('eyatagotatu) wada gahaname yamisabasabu naacawe 'enaziyaa seferaacawe yakafaa manegadaacaweme yathamama naacawe
ba'eregetheme lamusaa matsehhafene sathanawe ka'eresume gaare wanedemune haarunene radaate 'adaragenelate
<<wada'enaziyaame bata`aameraatocaacene wada 'asetabaabalute hhezeboce kxidu>> 'alenaacawe ('asewaashwacaweme) maathefaateneme 'athafaanaacawe
yanuhhene sawoceme maleketanyocene baasetabaabalu gizee 'asathamenaacawe lasawoceme magasachaa 'adaragenaalacawe labadalanyoceme 'asaamaamine qethaate 'azagaajetanaale
`aadeneme samudeneme yarasene sawoceme bazihe makaakale yanabaruteneme bezune yakefela zamanaate hhezeboce ('athafaane)
huluneme (gaszatsene) la'enasu mesaaleewocene galatsene huluneme maathefaatene 'athafaanaacaweme
baziyaaceme kefu zenaamene batazanamacewe katamaa laaye (yamakaa kahhadiwoce) ba'eregethe mathetawaale yamiyaayuwaate 'alenabarumene ba'ewenatu maqaseqasene yamaayefaru nabaru
baayuheme gizee yaa 'alaahe male'eketanyaa 'aderego yalaakawe yehe nawene 'eyaalu masaalaqiyaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayaadareguheme

<<'enaho ba'ereswa laaye mataagasaacene baalenabara noro ka'amaaleketocaacene liyaasaasetane qarebo nabare>> (silume yesaalaqaalu) wadafiteme qethaatune bamiyaayu gizee manegadene bathaame tasasaacu maane 'enedakxona ba'eregethe yaaweqaalu
felaagotune 'amelaaku 'aderego yayaazawene sawe 'ayahene 'aneta ba'eresu laaye thabaaqi tekxonaalahene

yelequneme 'abezaanyaawocaacawe yamisamu wayeme yamiyaawequ makxonaacawene taasebaalahene 'enaresu 'eneda 'enesesaawoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume katoweneme 'enasu yeleqe manegadene yatasaasaatu naacawe
wada geetaahe (szeraa) thelaane 'enedeete 'eneda zaragaa 'alaayahemene bashaame noro yaragaa baadaragawe nabare kaziyaame tzahhayene ba'eresu laaye melekete 'adaragene
kaziyaame qase baqase wada'enyaa sabesabenawe
'eresume yaa la'enaaneta leelitene lebese 'eneqelefeneme maarafiyaa yaadaraga; qaneneme mabatanyaa yaadaragalaacehu nawe
'eresume yaa nafaasocene 'abesaariwoce sikxonu kazenaamu basetafite yalaaka nawe kasamaayeme 'atheri wehaane 'awaradene
ba'eresu yamotacene 'agare hheyaawe lenaadaregebate kafatharenaweme fethure 'enesesaawocenenaa bezu sawoceneme lenaathathaawe ('awaradenawe)
(tsagaacenene) yeganazabume zanede bamakaakalaacawe kafaafalenawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce kehedatene 'eneji 'enebi 'alu
bashaaneme noro bayakatamaayetu 'asefaraarine balaakene nabare
kahhaadiwoceneme 'atetaazazaacawe ba'eresume (baqure'aane) taalaaqene tegele taagalaacawe

'eresume yaa hulatune baahheroce 'agoraabeto yalaqaqa nawe yehe themene yamiqorethe thaafaache nawe yeheme yamimaragege chawe nawe bamakaakalaacaweme (kamaqalaaqale) malayaanenaa yatakalalane kelele yaadaraga nawe
'eresume yaa kawehaa sawene yafathara, yazemedenaanaa ya'amaaceme baalabeete yaadaragawe nawe geetaaheme caaye nawe
ka'alaaheme leelaa yamaayethaqemaacawenenaa yamaayegodaacawene yegegazaalu; kahhaadime bageetaawe laaye (bamaamatse lasayethaane) radaate nawe
'abesaarinaa 'asefaraarime 'aderegane 'eneji 'alelaakeneheme
<<ba'eresu laaye waagaane bafetsume 'alethayeqaacehume gene wada geetaawe (malekaame) manegadene lamayaaze yashaa sawe (yeszeraa)>> balaacawe
baziyaame bamaayemotawe hheyaawe 'amelaake laaye tamakaa kamaamaseganeme gaare 'atheraawe babaarocu xathi'aatoceme wesetha `awaaqi ba'eresu baqaa

yaa samaayaatenaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu basedesete qanoce wesethe yafathara, kaziyaame ba`areshu laaye (szelethaanu) yatadalaadala 'alerahhemaane nawe ka'eresume `awaaqine thayeqe
la'enaresume la'alerahhemaane segadu batabaalu gizee 'alerahhemaane maanawe lametaazane ('enaa lamaanaaweqawe) 'enesagedaalane yelaalu (yehe) maraaqeneme chamaraacawe
yaa basamaaye burujocene yaadaraganaa ba'ereswame 'anetsabaaraaqine (tzahhaye) 'aberi charaqaaneme yaadaraga geetaa keberu bathaame laaqa
'eresume yaa (yaamalathawene szeraa) maasetaawasene lamifalege wayeme maamaseganene lamifalege sawe leelitenenaa qanene tatakaaki yaadaraga nawe
ya'alerahhemaaneme baaroce 'enaziyaa bamedere laaye bazegetaa yamikxeedute, baalageewoceme (bakefu) baanagaagaruwaacawe gizee salaame yamilute naacawe
'enaziyaame lageetaacawe bagenebaaraacawe tadafiwocenaa qwaamiwoce kxonawe yamiyaaderute naacawe
'enaziyaame <<geetaacene hoye! yagahanamene qethaate ka'enyaa laaye maleselene qethaatwa yamaayelaqe nawenaa>> yamilute naacawe
'ereswa maregiyaanaa maqamachaa bamakxone kafaace! (yelaalu)
'enaziyaame balagasu gizee yamaayaabaakenu yamaayeqothebuteme naacawe baziheme makaakale (legesenaacawe) tekekelanyaa yakxona nawe

'enaziyaame ka'alaahe gaare leelaane 'amelaake yamaayegazute, yaaceneme 'alaahe 'ereme yaadaragaatene nafese yaala hhege yamaayegadelute, yamaayaamanazeruteme naacawe yeheneneme yamiszaraa sawe qethaatene yaaganyaale
bateneszaa'ee qane qethaatu la'eresu yedaraarabaale ba'eresume wesethe yatawaarada kxono yenoraale

tatsatseto yatamalasanaa yaamana malekaameneme szeraa yaszaraa sawe becaa siqare 'enaziyaame 'alaahe mathefo szeraawocaacawene bamalekaame szeraawoce yelawethaale 'alaaheme 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
tatsatseto yatamalasame sawe malekaameneme yaszaraa 'eresu yatawadadane mamalase wada 'alaahe yemalasaale
'enaziyaame 'ebelatene yamaayemasakeru; bawedeqe qaaleme (tanaagaari 'athagabe) baalafu gizee yakabaru kxonawe yamiyaalefute naacawe
'enaziyaame bageetaacawe 'aneqatsoce batagasatsu gizee (yataradu taqabaayoce kxonawe 'eneji) daneqorowocenaa `eweroce kxonawe ba'ereswa laaye yamaayedafute naacawe
'enaziyaame <<geetaacene hoye! kamisetocaacenenaa kazarocaacene la`aayenoce maregiyaane la'enyaa sethane 'alaahene lamifaruteme mari 'aderegane>> yamilute naacawe
'enaziyaa bamataagasaacawe yaganatene saganatoce yememanadaalu ba'ereswame wesethe wedaaseenenaa salaametaane yesesathaalu
ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce kxonawe (yesesathaalu) maregiyaanaa manoriyaayetu 'amaarace
<<tsalotaacehu baalenabara noro geetaayee 'enaanetane kameneme 'ayeqotheraacehume nabare ba'eregetheme 'asetabaabalaacehu; wada fiteme (qethaatu) yaazhaacehu yekxonaale>> balaacawe
tha.sa.ma. (thwa sine mime)
yehece geletse kakxonawe matsehhafe 'aneqatsoce naate
'amaanyoce baalamakxonaacawe; (baquchete) nafesehene gadaaye makxone yefaraalehaale
beneshaa ba'enasu laaye kasamaaye ta`aamerane 'enaawaredenaa 'anegatocaacawe (mariwocaacawe) la'ereswa tawaaraajoce yekxonaalu
ka'alerahhemaaneme zanede 'aadise yatawarada qure'aane 'ayemathaalaacaweme; ka'eresu yamishashu bikxonu 'eneji
ba'eregetheme 'asetabaabalu yaziyaame ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabarute wareewoce (fetsaamee) yemathaabaacawaale
wada medereme bawesethwa kamalekaame (baqaaye) gosaa hulu bezune 'enedaabaqalene 'alaayumene
bazihe 'asedanaaqi melekete 'alelabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafi 'azaanye nawe
geetaaheme musaane <<wada badalanyocu hhezeboce kxide>> bamaalate batharaawe gizee ('asetaawese)
<<wada fare`one hhezeboce (kxide) 'alaahene 'ayefarumene>> ('alawe)
(musaame) 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee liyaasetabaabelunye 'efaraalahu
<<lebeeme yethabebaale melaaseeme 'ayefataame selazihe wada haarune laake
<<la'enaresume ba'enee laaye (yadame) wanejale 'alela selazihe 'enedaayegadelunye 'efaraalahu >>
('alaahe) 'ala <<tawe! ('ayenakuheme) bata`aameraatocaaceneme kxidu 'enyaa ka'enaaneta gaare samiwoce nanenaa
<<wada fare`oneme kxidu baluteme - 'enyaa ya`aalamaate geetaa maleketanyoce nane
<<ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce ka'enyaa gaare leqaqe >>
(fare`oneme) 'ala <<leje kxonahe ba'enyaa wesethe 'alaasaadagenehemene ba'enyaa wesetheme ka`edemeehe bezu `aamataatene 'aletaqamathekemene
<<yaaceneme yaszaraahaatene szeraahene 'aleszaraahemene 'anetame kawelataa bisocu nahe>> ('ala)
(musaame) 'ala <<yaane gizee 'eneeme katasaasaatute kxonyee szaraaxwaate
<<bafaraaxwaacehume gizee ka'enenaata shashahu geetaayame la'enee thebabene sathanye kamaleketanyocume 'adaraganye
<<yeheceme ya'eseraa'eelene lejoce baariyaa bamaaderagehe ba'enee laaye yametematsaadaqebaate tsagaa nate >>
fare`one 'ala <<(laakanye yametelawe) ya`aalamaateme geetaa menedenawe>>
(musaa) <<yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe hulu geetaa nawe yametaaragaagethu betekxonu (nagaru yehe nawe);>> 'alawe
(fare`oneme) bazuriyaawe laalute sawoce <<'atesamumene>> 'ala
(musaa) <<geetaacehunaa yamajamariyaawocu 'abaatocaacehume geetaa nawe>> 'alawe
(fare`one)	<<yaa wada'enaaneta yatalaakawe maleketanyaacehu ba'eregethe `ebede nawe>> 'ala
(musaa) <<yameszeraaqenaa yame`eraabe bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe nagare hulu geetaa nawe taawequ 'enedakxonaacehu ('emanubate)>> 'alawe
(fare`one) <<ka'enee leelaa 'amelaakene beteyeze bawenatu ka'eseranyocu 'adaregehaalahu>> 'ala
(musaa) <<bageletse 'aseraje bemathaaheme 'enekwaa>> 'alawe
<<'enegediyaawese ka'ewenatanyoce 'enedakxoneke ('aserajune) 'amethaawe>> 'ala
bateruneme thaala 'ereswame wadiyaawenu geletse 'ebaabe kxonace
'ejuneme 'awathaa wadiyaaweme 'ereswa latamalekaacoce (yametaabaraa) nache kxonace
(fare`one) bazuriyaawe laalute mamaakerete <<yehe ba'eregethe `awaaqi degemetanyaa nawe>> 'ala
<<kamederaacehu badegemetu liyaawathaacehu yefalegaalenaa menene taazaalaacehu>> ('alaacawe)
'alute <<'eresune wanedemuneme 'aqoyenaa bayakatamocu sabesaabiwocene laake
<<bathaame `awaaqi degemetanyocene hulu yaamathulehaalenaa >>
degemetanyocume bataawaqa qane qatharo tasabasabu
lasawocume <<'enaaneta tasabesebaacexwaalene>> tabaala
<<degemetanyocune 'enasu 'ashanaafiwoce bikxonu 'enekatale zanede>> (tabaala)
<<degemetanyocume bamathu gizee lafare`one 'enyaa 'ashanaafiwoce benehone la'enyaa ba'eregethe waagaa 'alane>> 'alute
<<'awone; 'enaanetame yaane gizee kabaalamwalocu tekxonaalaacehu>> 'alaacawe
musaa <<la'enaresu 'enaaneta yametethelutene thaalu>> 'alaacawe
gamadocaacawenenaa baterocaacaweneme thaalu <<bafare`oneme kebere yekxunebene 'enyaa ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwocu 'enyaa nane>> 'alu
musaame baterune thaala wadiyaaweme 'ereswa yamiyaasemaselutene hulu tewethaalace
degemetanyocume sagaajoce kxonawe wadaqu
('enasume) 'alu <<ba`aalamaate geetaa 'amanene
<<bamusaanaa bahaarune geetaa >>

(fare`oneme) <<la'enaaneta saalefaqedelaacehu bafite la'eresu 'amanaacehune 'eresu yaa degemetene yaasetamaaraacehu taalaaqaacehu nawe wadafiteme (yamiyaaganyaacehune) ba'eregethe taaweqaalaacehu 'ejocaacehunenaa 'egerocaacehune (qanyenaa geraane) bamaanaagaate 'eqorarethaalahu hulaacehuneme 'esaqelaacexwaalahume>> 'ala
('enaresume) 'alu <<gudaate yalabeneme 'enyaa wada geetaacene tamalaashoce nane
<<'enyaa yame'emenaane majamariyaa bamakxonaacene geetaacene xathi'atocaacenene la'enyaa limere 'enekajelaalane >>
wada musaame <<baaroceene yezahe leelite kxide 'enaaneta yamikataluwaacehu naacehunaa>> senele laakene
fare`oneme bayakatamocu sabesaabiwocene ('enedihe sile) laaka
<<'enazihe theqitoce chefaroce naacawe
<<'enaresume la'enyaa 'aseqochiwoce naacawe
<<'enyaame bezuwoce thenequqoce nane;>> ('ala)
'awathaanaacaweme ka'atekeletocenaa kamenechoce
kadeleboceme kamalekaame maqamachaawoceme
'enedazihu la'eseraa'eele lejoce 'awarasenaateme
tzahhayewaa setewathaame takataluwaacawe
hulatu cheferoceme batayaayu gizee yamusaa gwaadoce <<'enyaa(yafare`one sawoce) yamidaresubene nane>> 'alu
(musaa) <<tawuwu! geetaayee ka'enee gaare nawe ba'eregethe yemaraanyaale>> 'ala
wada musaame <<baahherune babaterehe metaawe>> senele laakenebate (mataawenaa) takafalame kefelume hulu 'eneda taalaaqe gaaraa kxona
'eziyaame zanede leelocene 'aqarabene
musaaneme ka'eresu gare yaaluteneme sawoce huluneme 'adaane
kaziyaame leelocune 'asathamene
bazihe wesethe taalaaqe taamere 'alabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme 'amaanyoce 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
ba'enasume (bahhezebocehe) laaye yaberaahimene waree 'anebebelaacawe
la'abaatunaa lahhezebocu <<menene tegegazaalaacehu>> baala gizee
<<thaa`otaatene 'enegazaalane; 'ereswaneme bamagazaate laaye 'eneqoyaalane>> 'alu
('eresume) 'ala <<batharaacexwaacawe gizee yesamwacexwaalene
<<wayese yethaqemwacexwaalene wayese yegodwacexwaalene>>
<<yalame! 'abaatocaacene 'enedazihu siszaru 'aganyane>> 'alute
<<tegegazute yanabaraacehutene 'asetawaalaacehune
<<'enaanetame yaqademowocu 'abaatocaacehume (yatagegazaacehutene) >>
<<'enasume (thaa`otocu) la'enee thalaatoce naacawe gene ya`aalamaate geetaa siqare ('eresu wadaajee nawe)
<<('eresu) yaa yafatharanye nawe 'eresume yemaraanyaale
<<yaame 'eresu yamiyaabalaanyenaa yamiyaathathaanye nawe
<<bataamamekume gizee 'eresu yaasheranyaale
<<yaame yamigadelanye kaziyaame hheyaawe yamiyaadareganye nawe
yaame baferedu qane xathi'ateene la'enee limere yamekajelawe nawe
geetaayee hoye! `eweqatene sethanye! badagaagocume sawoce 'asethagaanye
baxwaalanyocume hhezeboce wesethe la'enee malekaame zenaane 'aderegelenye
yatsagaayetune ganate kamiwaresuteme 'adereganye
la'abaateeme maare 'eresu katasaasaatute nabaranaa
bamiqasaqasubate qaneme 'ataawaaredanye
ganezabeme lejoceme bamaayethaqemubate qane
wada 'alaahe banetsuhe lebe yamathaa sawe bikxone 'eneje >>
ganateme lafariwoce bameteqarabebate (qane)
gahanameme lathamamoce bametegalatsebate (qane)
la'enasume bamibaale qane <<tegegazwacawe yanabaraacehute yate naacawe>>
<<ka'alaahe leelaa sikxonu yeraduwaacexwaalene wayese (laraasaacawe) yereradaalune>>
bawesethwame 'enasunaa thamaamocu bafitocaacawe tathelawe yenekabaalalaalu
yasayethaaneme saraawitoce malaaweme (yethaalaalu)
'enaresume ba'ereswa wesethe yamikaraakaru kxonawe yelaalu -
ba'alaahe 'enemelaalane; 'enyaa bageletse masaasaate wesethe nabarene
(thaa`otocune) ba`aalamaate geetaa baasetakaakalenaacehu gizee
'amatsanyocume 'eneje leelaa 'alaasaasaataneme
ka'amaalaajoceme la'enyaa meneme yalaneme
'azaanye wadaajime (yalaneme)

<<'eneeme 'amaanyocene 'abaaraari 'ayedalahume
<<'enee geletse 'asefaraari 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalahume >>
<<nuhhe hoye! (kametelawe) baatekalakale ba'eregethe kamiwagarute tekxonaalahe>> 'alute
('eresume) 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! hhezebocee 'asetabaabalunye
<<ba'eneenaa ba'enaresume makaakale (tagabi) feredene ferade 'adenanyeme ka'enee gaare yaaluteneme me'emenaane >>

wanedemaacawe hude lanaresu baalaacawe gizee <<'atethanaqaqumene
<<'enee lanaaneta taamaanye maleketanyaa nanye
<<'alaaheneme feru taazazunyeme
<<ba'eresume laaye meneme waagaa 'alamenaacehume waagaayee ba`aalamaate geetaa laaye 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame
<<yametechaawatu kxonaacehu bakafetanyaa seferaa hulu laaye meleketene teganabaalaacehune
<<yawehaa maatharaaqamiyaawocenenaa hhenetzaawoceneme zalaalame manorene yametekajelu kxonaacehu teszaraalaacehune
<<baqathaacehume gizee chakaanyoce kxonaacehu teqathaalaacehune
<<'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme
<<yaaneneme bametaawequte (tsagaa) yaathaaqamaacehune feru
<<ba'enesesaawocenaa balejoce yaathaaqamaacehune
<<ba'atekeletocenaa bamenechoceme
<<'enee ba'enaaneta laaye yataalaaqene qane qethaate 'efaraalahunaa >>
('enaresume) 'alu <<betegasetseme wayeme kagasaachocu baatekxoneme ba'enyaa laaye 'ekule nawe; (yaalanebatene 'anelaqeme)
<<yehe yafitanyocu sawoce tzabaaye 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame
<<'enyaame yameneqeqathaa 'ayedalaneme>> ('alu)
'asetabaabaluteme 'athafaanaacaweme baziheme wesethe 'eregethanyaa gesaatsee 'alabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme me'emanaane 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
samude maleketanyocene 'asetabaabalace
wanedemaacawe swalihe la'enaresu baalaacawe gizee <<'atethanaqaqumene
<<'enee la'enaaneta taamaanye maleketanyaa nanye
<<'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme
<<ba'eresume laaye meneme waagaa 'alelamenaacehume waagaayee ba`aalamaate geetaa laaye 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame
<<baziyaa 'ezihe baalawe (tsagaa) wesethe yarakaacehu kxonaacehu tetawaalaacehune
<<ba'atekeletocenaa bamenechoce wesethe
<<ba'azemaraawoceme fereewaa yabasala bakxonace zanebaabaame; (wesethe tetawaalaacehune)
<<belehoce kxonaacehu kagaaraawoce beetoceneme tetharebaalaacehu
<<'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme
<<yawasane 'alaafiwoceneme te`ezaaze 'atekatalu
<<ya'enaziyaane bamedere laaye yamiyaathafutenenaa yamaayaabajutene >>
('enasume) 'alu <<'aneta babezu katadagamabaacawe sawoce becaa nahe
<<'aneta betheeyaacene sawe 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaheme ka'ewenatanyocume 'enedakxoneke ta`aamerene 'amethaa >>
('eresume) 'ala <<yehece gemale naate la'ereswa yamathathe faanetaa 'alaate la'enaanetame yataawaqa qane faanetaa 'alaacehu
<<bakefume 'atenekwaate yataalaaqe qane qethaate yeyezaacexwaalenaa >>
wagwaateme wadiyaaweme tatsatsaacoce kxonawe 'anagu
qethaatume yaazaacawe baziheme wesethe gesaatzee 'alelabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme me'emanaane 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
yaluthe hhezeboce maleketanyocene 'asetabaabaalu
wanedemaacawe luthe la'enaresu baala gizee <<'atethanaqaqumene
<<'enee la'enaaneta taamaanye maleketanyaa nanye
<<'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme
<<ba'eresume laaye meneme waagaa 'alelamenaacehume waagaayee ba`aalamaate geetaa laaye 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame
<<ka`aalamaate sawoce wanedocene temathaalaacehune
<<kamisetocaacehume geetaacehu lanaaneta yafatharalaacehune tetawaalaacehune ba'ewenatu 'enaaneta wasane 'alaafiwoce hhezebo naacehu >>
('enaresume) 'alu <<luthe hoye! baatekalakale ba'eregethe (ka'agare) kamiwathute tekxonaalahe >>
('eresume) 'ala <<'enee szeraacehune kamithalute sawoce nanye
<<geetaayee hoye! 'eneeneme beetasaboceeneme kamiszarute szeraa (qethaate) 'adenane >>
'eresuneme beetasabocuneme bathaqelaalaa 'adaanenaacawe
baqariwocu wesethe yakxonace 'arogite becaa seteqare ('ereswa thafaace)
kaziyaame leelocune 'athafaane
ba'enasume laaye (yadenegaayene) zenaamene 'azanamenebaacawe yatasefaraariwocume zenaame (menenyaa) kafaa
bazihe wesethe 'asedanaaqi ta`aamere 'alelabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme me'emanaane 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
ya'ayekate sawoce maleketanyocene 'asetabaabalu;
shu`eyebe la'enaresu baalaacawe gizee <<'atethanaqaqumene
<<'enee la'enaaneta taamaanye maleketanyaa nanye
<<'alaaheneme feru; taazazunyeme
<<baresume laaye meneme waagaa 'alethayeqaacehume waagaayee ba`aalamaate geetaa laaye 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame
<<seferene mulu ka'agudaayocume 'atekxunu
<<batekekelanyaa mizaaneme mazenu
<<sawoceneme nagarocaacawene 'ataagudelubaacawe bamedereme laaye 'athefiwoce kxonaacehu 'ataabalaashu
<<yaaneneme yafatharaacehune yaqademowocuneme fethuroce (yafatharawene) feru >>
'alu <<'aneta babezaate katadagamabaacawe sawoce nahe
<<'anetame betheeyaacene sawe 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaheme 'enaho kaweshataamoce nahe belane 'enetharatherehaalane
<<ka'ewenatanyocume 'enedakxoneke ba'enyaa laaye kasamaaye quraachene thaalebene >>
<<geetaayee yameteszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe;>> 'alaacawe
'asetabaabaluteme yathelaayetwa qane qethaateme yaazaacawe 'eresu yakabaade qane qethaate nabarenaa
bazihe wesethe 'asedanaaqi ta`aamere 'alelabate 'abezaanyocaacaweme me'emenaane 'alenabarume
geetaaheme 'eresu ba'eregethe 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
'eresume (qure'aane) ba'eregethe ka`aalamaate geetaa yatawarada nawe
'eresune taamaanyu manefase (jiberile) 'awaradawe;
ka'asefaraariwocu (nabiyaate) tekxone zanede balebehe laaye ('awaradawe)
geletse bakxona `arabenyaa qwaaneqwaa
'eresume (qure'aane) baqademowocu matsaahhafete wesethe (yatawasaa nawe)
ya'eseraa'eele lejoce liqaawenete yamiyaawequte makxonu la'enaresu (lamakaa kahhaadiwoce) melekete 'ayekxonaacawemene
ka'a`ejamoce baanedu laaye baawaradenaweme noro;
ba'enaresu laaye baanababaweme ba'eresu 'amaanyoce 'ayekxonume nabare
'enedazihu (maasetabaabalene) batanekolanyoce leboce wesethe 'asegabaanawe
'asaamaami qethaatene 'esekamiyaayu derase ba'eresu 'ayaamenume
'enaresu yamaayaawequ sikxonu (qethaatu) denegate 'esekamimathaabaacaweme derase ('ayaamenume)
(bamathaabaacawe gizee) <<'enyaa yameneqoye nane>> 'esekamilume ('ayaamenume)
baqethaataacene yaacaakulaalune
'ayahene bezu `aamataatene benaathaaqemaacawe;
kaziyaame yaa yesefaraarubate yanabarute bimathaabaacawe;
yethaaqamubate yanabarute hulu ka'enasu meneme 'ayaabeqaaqaacaweme
'anediteneme katamaa la'ereswa 'asefaraariwoce yaalwate ('enaa yaasetabaabalace) kxonaa 'eneje 'alaathafaaneme
(yehece) gesaatzee naate badaayoceme 'alenabareneme
sayethaanaateme 'eresune (qure'aanene) 'alaawaraduteme
la'enaresume 'ayegabaacaweme; 'ayecelumeme
'enaresu (yamalaa'eketene negegere) kamasemaate takalakalu naacawe
ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane 'amelaake 'ategegazaa; kamiqathute tekxonaalahenaa
qereboce zamadoceheneme 'asethaneqeqe
kame'emenaaneme latakataluhe sawoce kenefehene zeqe 'aderege; (lezebe kxune)
<<'enebi>> biluheme <<'enee kameteszarute netsuhhe nanye>> balaacawe
'ashanaafi 'azaanye bakxonawe (geetaahe) laayeme tathagaa
baziyaa lasolaate bameteqome gizee bamiyaayehe
basagaajoce wesethe mazawaawareheneme (bamiyaayawe geetaahe laaye tathagaa)
'enaho 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa
sayethaanaate bamaane laaye 'enedamiwaredu lenegaraacehune
baweshataame xathi'atanyaa hulu laaye yewaredaalu
yasamutene (wada thaneqwaayoce) yethelaalu 'abezaanyocaacaweme weshataamoce naacawe
baala qeneewoceneme thamaamaawocu yekataluwaacawaale
'enaresu ba(negegere) shalaqo hulu yamiwaalelu makxonaacawene 'ataayemene
'enasume yamaayeszarutene nagare yaminaagaru makxonaacawene ('ataayemene);

'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru 'alaaheneme babezaate yaawasu katabadalume baxwaalaa (baqenee) yatakalaakalu siqaru; ('enaresu 'ayewaqasume) 'enaziyaame yabadalu (kamotu baxwaalaa) 'enedeete yaalane mamalase 'enedamimalasu ba'eregethe yaaweqaalu
tha.sa (thaa sine) yeheci kaqure'aanunaa kagalaachu matsehhafe 'aneqatsoce naate
lame'emenaane marinaa beseraate naate
la'enaziyaa solaatene lamisagedute zakaaneme lamisathute 'enasume bamacharashaayetu hheyewate 'enasu yamiyaaragaagethu lakxonute
'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenute la'enasu (kefu) szeraawocaacawene shalamenelaacawe selazihe 'enaresu yewaalelaalu
'enaresu 'enaziyaa kefu qethaate la'enaresu yaalaacawe naacawe 'enaresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame 'enaresu bathaame kasaariwocu naacawe
'anetame qure'aanene thebabanyaanaa `awaaqi kakxonawe (geetaahe) zanede ba'eregethe tesesathaalahe
musaa labeetasabocu <<'enee 'esaatene 'ayahu ka'ereswa wareene 'amathaalaacexwaalahu wayeme temoqu zanede yatalakosa cebone 'amathaalaacexwaalahu>> baala gizee (yakxonawene 'awesaalaacawe)
bamathaateme gizee 'enedihe bamaalate tatharaa; <<ba'esaatitu yaalawe sawenaa bazuriyaawaa yaalume hulu tabaaraku ya`alamaateme geetaa 'alaahe theraate yegabaawe >>
<<musaa hoye! 'enaho 'enee 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe 'alaahe nanye

<<batereheneme thaale>> (tabaala thaalame) 'ereswa 'eneda teneshe 'ebaabe bafethenate seteselakalake baayaateme gizee; wada xwaalaa zoro shasha 'aletamalasameme <<musaa hoye! 'atefaraa; 'enee maleketanyocu 'enee zanede 'ayefarumenaa
<<gene yabadala sawe kaziyaame kamathefo szeraawe baxwaalaa malekaamene yalawatha 'enee mahhaari 'azaanye nanye

<<'ejeheneme ba'anegategeehe wesethe 'agebaa yaalanawere (yaala lametse) nache kxonaa tewathaalacenaa bazathanye ta`aameraate wada fare`onenaa wada hhezebocu (kxide) 'enaresu 'amatsanyoce hhezeboce naacawenaa
ta`aameraataaceneme geletse kxonaa bamathaacaacawe gizee <<yehe geletse degemete nawe>> 'alu
nafesocaacaweme yaaragaagathwate sikxonu labadalenaa lakuraate ba'ereswa kaadu ya'amatsanyoceme fetsaamee 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekate
ladaawedenaa lasulayemaaneme `eweqatene ba'eregethe sathanaacawe 'alume - <<mesegaanaa la'alaahe la'eziyaa kame'emenaane baarocu babezuwocu laaye laabalathane yegabaawe >>
sulayemaaneme daawedene warasa 'alame <<sawoce hoye! yabaraarine negegere (yawafene qwaaneqwaa) tasetamaarene kanagarume hulu tasathane yehe 'eresu ba'eregethe geletse yakxona cerotaa nawe >>
lasulayemaaneme saraawitocu kagaaneene, kasaweme, kabaraarime yakxonute tasabasabu 'enasume yekamakamaalu
bagunedaaneme shalaqo bamathu gizee 'anedite gunedaane <<'enaaneta gunedaanoce hoye! wada manoriyaawocaacehu gebu sulayemaanenaa saraawitu 'enaresu yamaayaawequ sikxonu 'ayesabaaberuwaacehu>> 'alace

kanegegerewaame 'eyasaaqa theresune fagage 'adaraga <<geetaayee hoye! yaacine ba'eneenaa bawalaajocee laaye yalagasekaatene tsagaahene 'enedaamasagene yametewadaweneme bago szeraa 'enedeszaraa meraanye bacerotaaheme bamalekaamocu baarocehe wesethe 'agebaanye>> 'ala
baraariwocuneme tamalakata; 'alame <<hudehudene lamene 'alaayaweme! ba'ewenatu karaaqute nabarene
<<beretune qethaate ba'eregethe 'eqathaawaalahu wayeme ba'eregethe `aredawaalahu; wayeme geletse bakxona 'aseraje yemathaanyaale>> ('ala)
(wafu) `eruqe yaalekxonaneme gizee qoyee 'alame <<yaalaawaqekawene nagare 'awaqeku kasaba'eme 'eregethanyaane waree 'amathaahulehe
<<'enee yametegazaacawe yakxonucene seete kanagarume hulu yatasathacenye 'aganyahu la'ereswame taalaaqe zufaane 'alelaate

<<'eresewaaneme hhezebocewaaneme ka'alaahe leelaa latzahhaye sisagedu 'aganyaxwaacawe sayethaaneme la'enasu szeraawocaacawene shalemolaacawaale ka'ewenatanyaaweme manegade 'agedwacawaale selazihe 'enasu (wada 'ewenate) 'ayememarume >>
laziyaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere yatadabaqawene lamiyaawathaawe, yameteshashegutenenaa yametega letsuteneme hulu lamiyaaweqawe 'alaahe 'enedaayesagedu (sayethaane 'agedwacawaale)
'alaahe karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalame yataalaaqu `areshe (zufaane) geetaa nawe
(sulayemaaneme) 'ala <<'ewenate 'eneda tanaagareke wayeme kaweshataamocu 'eneda kxoneke wadafite 'enaayaalane
<<yehenene dabedaabeeyeene yezahe kxide wada'enaresume thaalawe kaziyaame ka'enasu zaware bale mene 'anedamimalesume tamalekate >>
('ereswame badarasaate gizee) 'alace <<'enaaneta mamaakeretoce hoye! 'enee kebere yaalawe tsehhufe wadanee tathaala
<<'eresu kasulayemaane nawe 'eresume ba'alaahe seme 'ejege bathaame ruxeruxe bathaame 'azaanye bakxonawe
<<ba'enee laaye 'atekuru taazaazhoceme kxonaacehu wadanee nu; (yamile nawe)
<<'enaaneta mamaakeretoce hoye! banagaree (yamibajawene) negarunye 'esekameteganyulenye derase 'anedeneme nagare qoraache 'ayedalahumenaa>> 'alace
<<'enyaa yaxayele baalabeetoce yaberetu thoreme baalabeetoce nane gene te`ezaazu wada 'aneci nawe mene 'enedametaazhime 'asetaweyi;>> 'alwate
('ereswame) 'alace <<neguszoce katamaane (baxayele) bagabubaate gizee yaabalaashuwaataale yatakabaru sawocewaaneme waraadoce yaadaregaalu 'enedazihume ('enazihe) yeszaraalu
<<'eneeme wada'enaresu gatsa barakatene yamelekenaa maleketanyocu bamene 'enedamimalasu yamethabaabaqe nanye >>
(maleketanyaawe) sulayemaaneneme bamathaawe gizee 'ala <<baganezabe teradunyaalaacehune 'alaaheme yasathanye kasathaacehu yabalatha nawe yelequneme 'enaaneta bagatsa barakataacehu tedasataalaacehu >>
<<wada'enasu tamalase la'enaresume ba'ereswa celotaa baleelaacawe saraawite 'enemathaabaacawaalane ka'ereswame 'enaresu yatawaaradu kxonawe ba'eregethe 'enaawathaacawaalane>> ('ala)
<<'enaaneta makwaanenetoce hoye! muselimoce kxonawe saayemathunye bafite zufaanewaane yamiyaamathaalenye maanenyaacehu nawe>> 'ala
kagaaneene xayelanyaawe <<kacelotehe kamanasaatehe bafite 'enee 'eresune 'amathaalehaalahu 'eneeme ba'eresu laaye beretu taamaanye nanye>> 'ala

yaa 'eresu zanede kamatsehhafu `eweqate yaalawe sawe (yatagalatsawe) <<`aayenehe wada 'aneta kamamalasu bafite 'enee 'eresune 'amathaalehaalahu>> 'ala; ('enedazihume 'adaraga) 'eresu zanede rageto baayaweme gizee <<yehe kageetaayee cerotaa nawe yamaamasagene wayeme yamekede makxoneene limokeranye (caralenye) yaamasaganame sawe yamiyaamasagenawe laraasu nawe yakaadame sawe geetaayee ka'eresu tabeqaaqi care nawe>> 'ala
<<zufaanewaane la'ereswa 'asaasetu taaweqawe 'enedakxona wayeme ka'enaziyaa kamaayaawaqute tekxone 'enedahona; 'enaayaalane;>> 'alaacawe
bamathaace gizee - <<zufaaneshe 'enedazihe nawene>> tabaalace <<'eresu leke 'eresu nawe masalanye>> 'alace (sulayemaane) <<ka'ereswa bafiteme `eweqatene tasathane muselimoceme nabarene;>> ('ala)
ka'alaahe leelaa tegegazaawe yanabaraceweneme kalakalaate 'ereswa kakahhaadiwoce hhezeboce nabaracenaa

hhenetsaawene gebi tabaalace baayaciweme gizee baahhere nawe belaa tharatharacewe kabaatocewaame galathace <<'eresu kamasetawaate yatalasalasa hhenetsaa nawe>> 'alaate <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee nafeseene badaleku kasulayemaaneme gaare honyee la`aalamaate geetaa la'alaahe taazazeku>> 'alace
wada samudeme wanedemaacawene swalihhene 'alaahene tagazu bamaalate ba'eregethe laakenawe wadiyaaweme 'enasu yaminataaraku hulate cheferoce kxonu
<<hhezebocee hoye! kamalekaamu bafite bakefuwe (qethaatene 'amethaabene bamaalate) lamene taasecakulaalaaceha yetaazanelaacehu zanede 'alaahene mehheratene 'atelamenumene>> 'alaacawe
<<baanetanaa ka'anetame gaare baalute sawoce mekeneyaate gadabisoce kxone>> 'alute <<gadabisenataacehu 'alaahe zanede nawe; yelequneme 'enaaneta yametefatanu hhezeboce naacehu>> 'alaacawe
bakatamaayetume wesethe bamedere wesethe yamiyaabalaashunaa yamaayaasaameru zathanye sawoce nabaru
<<'eresunenaa beetasabocune leelite lenegadele kaziyaame lazamadu yabeetasabocune thefaate (magadalaacawene) 'alaayaneme; 'enyaame 'ewenatanyoce nane lenele ba'alaahe tamaamaalu>> 'alu
tanekoleneme makaru 'enaresume yamaayaawaqu sikxonu batanekolaacawe 'athafaanaacawe
yatanekolaacaweme macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'enyaa 'enaresuneme hhezebocaacaweneme bamulu 'enedeete 'enedaathafaanaacawe tamalekate
'enyiheme babadalaacawe mekeneyaate baadowoce sihonu beetocaacawe naacawe baziheme wesethe lamiyaawaqu hhezeboce 'asedanaaqi ta`aamere 'alabate
'enaziyaaneme yaamanutenenaa kakehhedate yethanaqaqu yanabarutene 'adaane
lutheneme lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese); <<'enaaneta yametaayu setekxonu tzayaafene nagare teszaraalaacehune
<<'enaaneta kaseetoce 'alefaacehu wanedocene lamakajale temathaalaacehune ba'ewenatu 'enaaneta yametesaasaatu hhezeboce naacahu >>
yahhezebocume malese yaluthene beetasaboce <<kakatamaacehu 'awethu 'enaresu yamitheraaru sawoce naacawenaa>> maalate 'eneje leelaa 'alenabarame
'eresunenaa beetasabocuneme 'adaane misetu; becaa seteqare (bathefaatu wesethe) kaqariwocu 'adaragenaate
ba'enaresume laaye (yadenegaaye) zenaabene 'azanabenebaacawe yatasefaraariwocume zenaabe kafaa
(muhhamade hoye) bale <<mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegebaawe ba'enaziyaame bamarathaacawe baarocu laaye salaame yewerade 'alaahe balaache nawene wayese yaa yamiyaagaarute (thaa`ote)

wayeme yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yafatharanaa kasamaayeme la'enaaneta wehaane yaawaradawe (yebalethaale wayese yamiyaagaarute) ba'eresume baalawebate yakxonutene yataatharu 'atekeletocene zaafewaane letaabaqelu lanaaneta celotaa yaalenabaraacehune 'abaqalene ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'alane (yalame) gene 'enaresu (ka'ewenate) yamiyaazanabelu hhezeboce naacawe

wayeme yaa mederene maregiyaa yaadaraganaa bamakaakalwame wanezocene yaadaraga, la'ereswame gaaraawocene yaadaraga, bahulatu baahheroceme (bathaafaachunaa bachawe baahhere) makaakale geredone yaadaraga (yebalethaalene wayese yamiyaagaarute) ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'alane gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme

wayeme yaa cegeranyaane balamanawe gizee yamiqabale, makaraaneme yamiyaasewagede, bamedereme laaye metekoce yamiyaadaragaacehu; (yebalethaalene wayese yamiyaagaarute) ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'alane theqiteneme 'ategaszatsume

wayeme yaa bayabesenaa babaahhere chalamaawoce wesethe yamimaraacehu nafaasoceneme kazenaamu bafite 'abesaari kxonawe yamileke (yebalethaalene wayese yamiyaagaarute) ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'alane 'alaahe (ba'eresu) kamiyaagaaruwaacawe hulu laaqa

wayeme yaa mafetharene yamijamere kaziyaame yamimalesawe kasamaayenaa kamedereme sisaayene yamisathaacehu 'amelaake (yebalethaalene wayese yamiyaagaarute) ka'alaahe gaare leelaa 'amelaake 'alane <<'ewenatanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu; 'aserajaacehune 'amethu>> balaacawe
<<basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ruqene mesethire 'ayaaweqeme gene 'alaahe (yaaweqawaale) macee 'enedamiqasaqasume 'ayaawequme>> balaacawe
ba'ewenate yamacharashaayetune `aalame (kxuneetaa) maawaqaacawe tamwalaane 'ayedalame 'enaresu ka'ereswa bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe ba'ewenateme 'enaresu ka'ereswa `eweroce naacawe
'enaziyaame yakaadute 'alu <<'enyaame 'abaatocaaceneme `afare bakxone gizee 'enyaa (kamaqaabere) yamenewathaa nane
<<yehenene 'enyaame kafite yanabarute 'abaatocaaceneme ba'eregethe taqatheranebataale yehe yamajamariyaawocu sawoce taratoce 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> ('alu)
<<bamedere laaye kxidu ya'amatsanyoceme macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekatu>> balaacawe
ba'enasume laaye 'atezane kamimakerubeheme nagare bacheneqate wesethe 'atekxune
<<'ewenatanyoceme 'eneda kxonaacehu yehe qatharo macee nawe>> yelaalu
<<yaziyaa yametecaakolubate kafilu la'enaaneta yaqaraba makxonu taragaagethwale>> balaacawe
geetaaheme basawoce laaye ba'eregethe yacerotaa baalabeete nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocaacawe 'ayaamasagenume
geetaaheme lebocaacawe yamidabequtenenaa yamigaletsutene yaaweqaale
basamaayenaa bamedere wesethe meneme yatadabaqa nagare yalame galaache bakxonawe matsehhafe wesethe yaala bikxone 'eneje
yehe qure'aane ba'eseraa'eele lejoce laaye ya'enaziyaane 'enaresu ba'eresu yamilayaayubatene 'abezaanyaawene yenageraale
'eresume lame'emenaane mameriyaanaa 'ezenate nawe
geetaahe bamakaakalaacawe batekekele feredu yefaredaale 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe `awaaqiwe nawe
ba'alaaheme laaye tathagaa 'aneta geletse bakxonawe 'ewenate laaye nahenaa
'aneta mutaanene 'ataasamaame daneqorowoceneme yamitawe kxonawe bazoru gizee therine 'ataasamaame
'anetame (leba) `ewerocene kathemataacawe 'aqenyi 'ayedalaheme ba'aneqatsocaacene yamiyaamenutene basetaqare 'ataasamaame 'enaresu fetsume taazaazhoce naacawenaa
ba'enaresume laaye (yaqethaate) qaalu bataragaagatha gizee sawocu ba'aneqatsocaacene yamaayaaragaagethu 'enedanabaru yametenageraacawene 'enesesaa la'enaresu kamedere 'enaawathaalane
kahhezebocume hulu baaneqatzocaacene yamiyaasetabaabelutene cheferoce yamenesabasebebatene qane ('asetaawese) 'enasume yekamakamaalu
bamathume gizee ('alaahe) yelaacawaale <<ba'aneqatsocee 'ereswane bamaawaqe yaalaadaarasaacehu setehonu 'asetabaabalaacehune wayese menene teszaru nabaraacehu>>
bamabadalaacaweme ba'enaresu laaye qaalu yefatsamebaacawaale 'enaresume 'ayenaagarume
'enyaa leelitene ba'eresu wesethe 'enediyaarefubate qaneneme yamiyaasaaye 'enedaadaragene 'ayaayumene lamiyaamenu hhezeboce bazihe wesethe ta`aameraatoce 'alubate

baqanedume baminafaa qane basamaayaate wesethe yaalutenaa bamedereme wesethe yaalute hulu 'alaahe yashaawe nagare becaa siqare bamidanagethu gizee (yamikxonawene 'asetaawese) hulume yatanaanasu kxonaweme wadaresu yemathaalu

gaaraawoceneme 'ereswa 'eneda damanaa 'asetalaalafe yametaalefe setekxone yaqomace naate belahe yametaasebaate honaa taayaataalahe yaziyaane nagarune hulu yaathanakarawene ya'alaahene thebabe (tamalekate) 'eresu bameteszarute hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe
bamalekaame szeraa yamathaa sawe la'eresu ka'eresewaa yabalatha menedaa 'alelawe 'enaresume baziyaa qane kadenegaathee tsathetanyoce naacawe
bamathefome yamathu sawoce fitocaacawe ba'esaate wesethe yedafaalu <<teszarute yanabaraacehutene 'eneje 'atemanadume>> (yebaalaalu)
yataazazekute yazihecene 'agare geetaa yaanene kelele yaadaragaatene 'enedegegazaa becaa nawe nagaruneme hulu ya'eresu nawe kamuselimoceme 'enedekxone taazezhaalahu (balaacawe)
qure'aaneneme 'enedaanabe (taazezhaalahu) yatamaraame sawe yamimaraawe la'eraasu becaa nawe yatasaasaatame sawe <<'enee ka'asethaneqaaqiwoce nanye 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balawe
mesegaanaame la'alaahe nawe ta`aameraatocune wadafite yaasaayaacexwaale <<taaweqwaateme'alaacehu>> balaacawe geetaaheme kameteszarute hulu zanegi 'ayedalame
tha.sa.ma (thaa sine mime)
yeheci galaache kahonawe matsehhafe 'aneqatsoce naate
kamusaanaa kafare`one zeenaa 'ewenatanyoce senekxone lamiyaamenu hhezeboce baaneta laaye 'enaanabaalane

fare`one bamedere laaye tanebathaarara nawaariwocwaneme yatakafaafalu gwaadoce 'adaragaacawe ka'enaresu cheferocene yaadaakemaale wanedoce lejocaacawene babezaate yaaredaale seetocaacaweneme yetawaale; 'eresu kamiyaabalaashute sawoce nabarenaa
ba'enaziyaame bamedere wesethe batachaqonu laaye lenelagese, mariwoceme lenaadaregaacawe waraashoceme lenaadaregaacawe 'eneshaalane
la'enaresume bamedere laaye lenaasemace fare`onenenaa haamaaneneme saraawitocaacaweneme ka'enasu yefarute yanabarutene nagare lenaasaayaacawe ('eneshaalane)

wada musaame 'enaate <<'athebiwe, baresume laaye bafaraashe gizee babaahheru wesethe thaayewe 'atefarime, 'atezanyeme, 'enyaa wadaaneci malaashocunaa kamaleketanyocume 'aderaagiwocu nanenaa>> maalatene 'amalakatene
yafare`one beetasaboceme (macharashaawe) la'enaresu thalaate hhazaneme yehone zanede 'anasute fare`onenaa haamaaneme saraawitocaacaweme hathi'atanyoce nabaru

yafare`oneme misete <<la'enee ya`aayenee maregiyaa nawe la'anetame 'ategedalute lithaqemane wayeme leje 'aderegane leneyezawe yekajalaalenaa>> 'alace 'enaresume (fetsaameewene) yamaayaawequ honawe ('anasute)
yamusaame 'enaate lebe baado hona kame'emenaane tehone zanede balebwa laaye baalaathanakarene noro letegaletsawe qarebaa nabare
la'exetume takataatayewe 'alacaate 'eresuneme 'enasu yamaayaawequ sihonu baruqe honaa 'ayacewe

(wadanaatu kamamalasu) bafiteme 'athebiwocene (mathebaatene) ba'eresu laaye 'ereme 'adaragene ('exetu) <<la'enaaneta yamiyaasaadegulaacehune 'enaresume la'eresu qene 'agalegaayoce yahonune beetasaboce laamaleketaacehune>> 'alaceme
wada'enaatume `aayenewaa 'enedeteragaa, 'enedaataazeneme, ya'alaaheme yatasefaa qaale 'eregethe mahonune 'enedetaaweqe malasenawe gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
beretaatuneme badarasanaa batasetakaakala gizee thebabenenaa `eweqatene sathanawe 'enedihume malekaame szariwocene 'enemanadaalane

katamaayetuneme sawocwa bazenegaatee gizee laaye honawe saalu gabaa ba'ereswame wesethe yamigaadalune hulate sawocene 'aganya yehe kawaganu nawe; yeheme kathalaatu nawe yaame kawaganu yahonawe sawe baziyaa kathalaatu bahonawe sawe laaye 'eredaataane thayaqawe musaame bathuchaa mataawe gadalaweme yehe kasayethaane szeraa nawe 'eresu geletse 'asaasaace thalaate nawenaa 'ala
<<geetaayee hoye! 'enee nafeseene badaleku la'eneeme maare 'ala >> la'eresume mehherate 'adaragalate 'eresu mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
<<geetaayee hoye! ba'enee laaye bamalagasehe yehunebenye (kasehetatee 'etsatsataalahu); la'amatsanyoceme fatsemo radaate 'alehoneme 'ala

bakatamaayetume wesethe fari yamithabaabaqe hono 'adara badenegateme yaa telaanete 'eredaataane yathayaqawe sawe bachukxate 'eredaataane yethayeqawaale musaa laresu <<'aneta ba'eregethe geletse thamaamaa nahe>> 'alawe

(musaa) yaanene 'eresu lahulatume thalaate yahonawene sawe baxaayele liyezawe bafalagame gizee <<musaa hoye! batelaanetenaawe qane nafesene 'eneda gadaleke letegadelanye tefalegaalahene bamedere laye chakaanye mahonene 'eneje leelaa 'atefalegeme kamalekaame szariwoceme mahonene 'atefalegeme>> 'alawe
kakatamaayetume daarecaa 'anede sawe 'eyarotha mathaa <<musaa hoye! shumaamenetocu ligadeluhe baaneta yemakaakaraalunaa wethaa 'enee laaneta kamakaariwoce nanyenaa>> 'alawe
yafaraanaa yamithabaabaqe honome ka'ereswa wathaa <<geetaayee hoye! kabadalanyocu hhezeboce 'adenanye>> 'ala
wada madeyane 'aqethaachaa fitune baazora gizeeme <<geetaayee qathetanyaawene manegade limaraanye 'ekajelaalahu>> 'ala

wada madeyaneme wehaa bamathaa gizee ba'eresu laaye kasawoce cheferocene (manegaawocaacawene) yamiyaathathu honawe 'aganya ka'enaresu bataaceme (kawehaawe manegocaacawene) yamikalakelune hulate seetoce 'aganya <<nagaraacehu menedene nawe>> 'alaacawe <<'eranyocu hulu (manegaawocaacawene) 'esekamimalesu 'anaathathaame 'abaataaceneme teleqe shemaagelee nawe>> 'alute
lahulatume 'athathaalaacawe kaziyaame wada thelaawe zaware 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee kamalekaame nagare wadanee lametaawaredawe falaagi nanye>> 'ala

kahulatu 'anedanyaayetume kahhaferate gaare yametekxeede honaa mathaacewe <<'abaatee la'enyaa yaathathaahelenene waagaa lisathehe yetharaahaale>> 'alacewe wada'eresu bamathaanaa wareewene ba'eresu laaye batarakalateme gizee <<'ateferaa kabadalanyocu hhezeboce denahaale>> 'alawe
kahulatu 'anedanyaayetume <<'abaatee hoye qetharawe kaqatharekawe sawe hulu balaachu beretuwe taamaanyu nawenaa>> 'alacewe

<<semenetene `aamataate letaagalagelanye 'enee ka'enazihe hulate seetoca lejocee 'aneditune laagaabaahe 'eshaalahu `aserene betemolaame ka'aneta nawe baaneta laaye maasecagareneme 'aleshaame 'alaahe yashaa 'eneda kxona kamalekaamocu sawoce kxonyee taaganyanyaalahe>> 'alawe

(musaame) <<yehe (welataa) ba'eneenaa baaneta makaakale (ragi) nawe kahulatu gizeeyaatoce maanenyaaweneme befatseme ba'enee laaye wasane maalafe yalame 'alaaheme bamenelanawe laaye mesekere>> nawe 'ala

musaame gizeewene bacharasanaa kabeetasabocu gaare bakxeeda gizee kathure taraaraa gone 'esaatene 'aya labeetasabu ('ezihe) <<qoyu 'enee 'esaatene 'ayahu ka'ereswa wareene wayeme temoqu zanede ka'esaate tenetaagene 'amathaalaacexwaalahu>> 'ala
bamathaateme gizee kashalaqowe qanye daarecaa kazaafitu bakule batabaarakacewe seferaa wesethe <<musaa hoye! 'enee ya`aalamaate geetaa 'alaahe 'enee nanye>> bamaalate tatharaa

<<batereheneme thaale>> (tabaala) 'eneda teneshe 'ebaabe seteselakalake baayaateme gizee wada xwaalaa zoro shasha; 'aletamalasameme <<musaa hoye! tamalase 'ateferaame; 'aneta kathebeqocu nahenaa>> (tabaalame)

<<'ejehene ba'anegategeehe wesethe 'agebaa yaala nawere nache honaa tewathaalacenaa kenefeheneme kaferehaate (lamadaane) wadaaneta 'athaabeqe 'enaziheme kageetaahe yahonu wada fare`onenaa wada makwaanenetocu yamidaresu hulate 'aserajewoce naacawe 'enaresu 'amatsanyoce hhezeboce nabarunaa >>
(musaa) 'ala <<geetaayee hoye! 'enee ka'enaresu nafesene gadeyaalahu selazihe 'enedaayegadelunye 'efaraalahu
<<wanedemeeme haarune 'eresu melaasu ka'enee yatabaa nawe 'ewenatanyaanateeneme yamiyaaragaagethelenye radaate kxono ka'enee gaare laakawe 'enee liyaasetabaabelunye 'efaraalahunaa >>

('alaaheme) <<thunecaahene bawanedemehe ba'eregethe 'enaabarataalane lahulataacehume selethaanene 'enaadaregaalane wada'enaanetame (bamathefo) 'ayedaresume bata`aameraatocaacene (kxidu) 'enaanetanaa yatakatalaacehume hulu 'ashanaafiwoce naacehu>> 'alaacawe
musaame bataameraatocaacene geletse kxonawe bamathaabaacawe gizee <<yehe yataqathafa degemete 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame yeheneneme bamajamariyaawocu 'abaatocaacene wesethe 'alesamaaneme>> 'alu
musaame <<geetaayee ka'eresu zanede baqathetaawe manegade yamathaawene sawe mesegunitume 'agare la'eresu yametekxonelatene sawe `awaaqi nawe 'enaho badalanyocu 'ayedenume>> 'ala

fare`oneme <<'enaaneta cheferoce hoye! ka'enee leelaa la'enaaneta 'amelaakene meneme 'alaawaqehume haamaaneme hoye! cheqaane la'enee 'aqaathelelenye; (thube szeraalenye) la'eneeme kafetanyaa hhenetsaane szeraalenye wada musaa 'amelaake lewathaa 'ekajelaalahunaa 'eneeme kaweshataamocu makxonune 'etharatherawaalahu>> 'ala
'eresume saraawitocume bamedere laaye yaala 'agebaabe koru 'enaresume wada'enyaa yamaayemalasu makxonaacawene tharatharu
'eresuneme saraawituneme bathebeqe yaazenaacawe babaahhereme wesethe thaalenaacawe yabadalanyoce macharashaame; 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekate
wada 'esaate yamitharu mariwoceme 'adaragenaacawe bateneszaa'eeme qane 'ayereradume
bayeheceme baqerebitume `aalame wesethe 'eregemaanene 'asekatalenaacawe bateneszaa'eeme qane 'enasu kamibaararute naacawe
yafitanyocune yakefela zamanaate hhezeboceme ka'athafaane baxwaalaa lasawoce yalebe berehaane marime 'ezenateme sikxone yegasatsu zanede lamusaa matsehhafune ba'eregethe sathanawe
wada musaame te`ezaazene baawaradenelate gizee (kataraaraawe) bame`eraabaawiwe gone 'alenabarekeme katathaaduteme 'alenabarekeme

gene 'enyaa (ka'eresu baxwaalaa) yakefela zamanaatene sawoce 'aseganyane ba'enasume laaye `edemeewoce taraazamu bamadeyaneme sawoce wesethe taqamaache ba'enasu laaye 'aneqatsocaacene yametaanabe 'alenabarekeme gene 'enyaa laakiwocehe kxonene

batharaanaweme gizee bathure gone 'alenabarekeme gene ka'aneta bafite meneme 'asefaraari yaalemathaacawene hhezeboce taasefaraaraa zanede kageetaahe bakxona cerotaa (laakenehe) ligasatsu yekajalaalenaa

'ejocaacaweme baasaalafute mekeneyaate makaraa yametenakaacawenaa <<geetaacene hoye! 'aneqatsocehene 'enedenekatale kame'emenaaneme 'enedenekxone wadanyaa maleketanyaane 'atelekeme norwalene>> yamilu baalekxonu noro ('anelekeme nabare)

'ewenatume ka'enyaa zanede bamathaalaacawe gizee <<lamusaa yatasathawe bethee 'ayesesathaweme norwalene>> 'alu <<kazihe bafite musaa batasathawe 'alekaadumene yataradaadu hulate degemetoce naacawe>> 'alu <<'enyaa bahulume kahhaadiwoce naneme>> 'alu
<<ka'alaahe zanede yakxonane matsehhafe 'eresu kahulatume yebalethe qene yakxonane 'amethu 'ewenatanyoce 'eneda kxonaacehu (betaamathute) 'ekatalawaalahu>> balaacawe

'eshi baayeluheme; yamikatalute; zenebaaleewocaacawene becaa makxonune `ewaqe ka'alaaheme yakxona mamariyaa saayenorawe zenebaaleewene katakatala sawe yebalethe yathamama 'anedeme yalame 'alaahe badalanyoce hhezebocene 'ayemaraamenaa
yegasatsume zanede qaalene (qure'aanene bayaayenatu) la'enaresu ba'eregethe 'asekataatalene
'enaziyaa ka'eresu bafite matsehhafene yasathanaacawe 'enaresu ba'eresu yaamenaalu
ba'enasu laaye baminababelaacaweme gizee <<ba'eresu 'amenanaale 'eresu kageetaacene yakxona 'ewenate nawe 'enyaa karesu bafite muselimoce nabarene>> yelaalu
'enaziyaa bamataagasaacawe waagaacawene hulate gizee yesesathaalu kefuweneme nagare babago megebaare yegafateraalu kasathanaacaweme sisaaye yelagesaalu
wedeqeneme qaale basamu gizee ka'eresu yereqaalu <<la'enyaa szeraawocaacene 'alune lanaanetame szeraawocaacehu 'alwacehu salaame ba'enaaneta laaye (yekxune) baalageewocene 'anefalegeme>> yelaalu
'aneta yawadadekawene sawe fatsemo 'ataaqanaame gene 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe yaaqanaale 'eresume qenocune `awaaqi nawe

<<ka'aneta gaare qenene manegade benekatale kamederaacene 'enebaararaalane>> 'alume ka'enyaa zanede (yatasatha) sisaaye sihone yanagaru hulu fereewoce wada'eresu yaminadubatene tsathetanyaa kelele (makaane) la'enasu 'alaasemacanaacawemene gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme

kakatamaame nurowaane (mecotwane) yakaadacene (katamaa) yaathafaanaate bezu naate 'enaziheme ka'enasu baxwaalaa theqite gizee 'eneje yaaletanorabaacawe sikxonu manoriyaawocaacawe naacawe 'enyaame (ka'enaresu) waraashoce nabarene

geetaaheme katamocene bawaanaawaa (katamaa) wesethe 'aneqatsocaacenene ba'enasu laaye yamiyaanabe maleketanyaane 'esekamileke derase 'athefi 'alenabarame katamoceneme baalabeetocwa badaayoce honawe 'eneje 'athefiwoce 'alenabareneme
kamaanenyaaweme nagare yatasathaacehute; yaqerebitu hheyewate theqemenaa geethwa nawe 'alaahe zanede yaalaweme (menedaa) bathaame balaachenaa zawetaari nawe 'ataawequmene

malekaamene tasefaa qaale yagabaanelatenaa 'eresume 'agenyiwe yahona sawe yaqerebitune hheyewate theqeme 'enedaasemacanawenaa kaziyaame 'eresu bateneszaa'ee qane (la'esaate) kamiqarabute 'eneda kxonawe sawe nawene
('alaahe) yamitharaabaacawenenaa 'enaziyaa tagaariwocee telwacawe yanabaraacehute yate naacawe yamilebatene qane ('asetaawese)

'enaziyaa ba'enaresu laaye qaalu yataragaagathabaacawe yelaalu <<geetaacene hoye! 'enazihe 'enaziyaa yaathamamenaacawe naacawe 'enedathamamene 'athamamenaacawe (ka'enasu) wadaaneta tatheraaraane 'enyaane yegegazu 'alenabarume
<<(la'alaahe) yametaagaarwacaweneme theru>> yebaalaalu; yetharwacawaaleme gene la'enaresu 'ayemalesulaacaweme qethaatuneme yaayaalu 'enaresu yemaru banabaru noro ('ayaayuteme nabare)
<<yamitharaabaacawenenaa lamaleketanyocume menene malasaacehu>> yamilebatene qane ('asetaawese)
baziyaame qane wareewocu hulu ba'enaresu laaye yesawerubaacawaale 'enaresume 'ayethayaayaqume
yatatsatsatanaa yaamana sawemaa malekaameneme yaszaraa kamidenute likxone yekajalaale
geetaaheme yamishaawene yefatheraale; yemarethaaleme la'enaresu (lasawocu) merechaa yalaacaweme 'alaahe kamaayegegabaawe hulu tharaa kamiyaagaarwacaweme laaqa
geetaaheme lebocaacawe yamidabequtenenaa yamigaletsutene hulu yaaweqaale
'eresume 'alaahe nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame mesegaanaa bamajamariyaayetume bamacharashaayetume `aalame la'eresu becaa nawe feredume ya'eresu becaa nawe wada'eresume temalasaalaacehu

'ayaacehune (negarunye) <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye leelitene 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase zawetaari biyaadaregawe ka'alaahe leelaa berehaanene yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake maanawe 'atesamumene>> balaacawe

'ayaacehune <<'alaahe ba'enaaneta laaye qanene 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane derase zawetaari biyaadaregawe ka'alaahe leelaa bawesethu yametaarefubatene leelite yamiyaamathaalaacehu 'amelaake maane nawe (negarunye) 'ataasetawelumene>> balaacawe
kacerotaaweme la'enaaneta leelitenenaa qanene bawesethu letaarefubate, katerufaatume letefalegubate, 'amaseganyoceme letekxonu 'adaragalaacehu
yamitharaabaacaweneme qanenaa <<'enaziyaa tagaariwocee telwacawe yanabaraacehute yate naacawe>> yamilebatene ('asetaawese)
kahhezeboceme hulu masekaarine 'enaawathaalane (yaane gizee) 'ewenatanyaaweme 'amelaakenate la'alaahe becaa makxonune yaaweqaalu yeqathaathefute yanabaruteme ka'enaresu yethafaacawaale

qaarune kamusaa nagadoce nabare ba'enaresume laaye 'amatsa kadeleboceme yaanene makafacaawocu becaa yaxaayele baalabeetoce yakxonu cheferocene (shakemu) yamikabedene sathanawe waganocu la'eresu 'atekuraa; 'alaahe kuraatanyocene 'ayewademenaa baalute gizee ('asetaawese)

<<'alaaheme basathahe habete yamacharashaayetune 'agare falege kaqerebitume `aalame faanetaahene 'ateresaa 'alaaheme wada 'aneta malekaamene 'enedaadaragalehe (lasawoce) malekaamene 'aderege bamedereme wesethe maathefaatene 'atefalege 'alaahe 'athefiwocene 'ayewademenaa>> ('alute)

(habetune) <<yatasathahute 'enee zanede baalawe 'eweqate becaa nawe 'ala 'alaahe ka'eresu bafite kakefela zamanaate sawoce baxayele ka'eresu yebalethe yabaratutene (habetene) bamasabesabeme yebalethe yabazutene ba'eregethe yaathafaa makxonune 'ayaaweqemene 'amatsanyoceme kaxathi'aatocaacawe (mehherate yamikatalawene theyaaqee) 'ayethayaqume

bahhezebocume laaye bageethu wesethe kxono wathaa 'enaziyaa qerebitune hheyewate yamifalegute <<waye menyotaacene! qaarune yatasathawe bethee menawe la'enyaa banorane; 'eresu yataalaaqe `edele baalabeete nawenaa>> 'alu
'enaziyaame `eweqatene yatasathute <<wayolaacehu! ya'alaahe menedaa la'amana sawe malekaameneme laszaraa balaache nawe taagaashoceme 'eneje leelaawe 'ayaaganyaateme>> 'alu
ba'eresume babeetume mederene darabaane la'eresume ka'alaahe leelaa yamiradute cheferoce meneme 'alenabaruteme kamireraduteme 'alenabarame

'enaziyaame batelaanetenaawe qane seferaawene yemanyu yanabarute <<waye gude! lakaa 'alaahe kabaarocu lamishaawe sawe sisaayene yaasafaale; yaathabaaleme 'alaahe ba'enyaa laaye (ba'emenate) baalelagasalene noro mederene ba'enyaa laaye bagalabathabene nabare waye gude! kahhaadiwoce 'ayedenume>> yamilu kxonawe 'anagu
yehece yamacharashaayetu 'agare la'enaziyaa bamedere wesethe kuraatenenaa maamatzene lamaayefalegute 'enaadaregaataalane mesegunitume macharashaa lathenequqocu naate
badage szeraa yamathaa sawe la'eresu ka'ereswa balaache menedaa 'alelawe bakefume szeraa yamathu sawoce 'enazihe mathefowocene yaszaru yeszarute yanabarutene 'eneje 'ayemanadume

yaa qure'aanene yatakafaafala kxono baaneta laaye yaawaradawe ('amelaake) wada mamalashaa (wadamakaa) ba'eregethe malaashehe nawe <<geetaayee baqene manegade yamathaawene sawenaa 'eresume bageletse sehhetate wesethe yakxonawene sawe `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe
matsehhafu wadaaneta mawaradune tasefaa yametaadarege 'alenabarekeme gene kageetaahe cerotaa (tawaradalehe) lakahhaadiwoceme bafetsume radaate 'atekxune
ka'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce wadaaneta katawaradu gizee baxwaalaa 'ayaageduhe wada geetaaheme (sawocene) theraa ka'agaariwocume 'atekxune;
ka'alaaheme gaare leelaane 'amelaake 'ategegazaa ka'eresu baqare 'amelaake yalame nagaru hulu ka'alaahe baqare thafi nawe feredu yaresu; becaa nawe wada'eresume temalasaalaacehu
'a.la.ma ('alife laame mime)
sawocu 'amenanaale bamaalataacawe becaa 'enasu saayefatanu yamitawe makxonaacawene tharatharune
'enaziyaaneme ka'enasu bafite yanabarutene ba'eregethe fatenanaale 'enaziyaaneme 'ewenate yatanaagarutene 'alaahe ba'eregethe yaaweqaale weshataamocuneme yaaweqaale
yelequneme 'enaziyaa mathefowocene szeraawoce yamiszarute liyaamalethune yetharatheraalune yaa yamifaredute (ferede) kafaa
ya'alaahene maganaanyate tasefaa yamiyaadarege sawe (yezagaaje) ya'alaahe qatharo ba'eregethe machi nawenaa 'eresume samiwe `awaaqiwe nawe
yataagala saweme yamitaagalawe lanafesu nawe 'alaahe ka`aalamaate ba'eregethe tabeqaaqi nawenaa
'enaziyaame yaamanu; malekaamoceneme yaszaru mathefowocune szeraawocaacawene ka'enasu laaye 'enaabeselaacawaalane baziyaame yeszarute banabarute malekaame szeraa ba'eregethe 'enemanadaacawaalane

saweneme bawalaajocu malekaame 'aderaagotene 'azazenawe laanetame ba'eresu `eweqate yaleelahene (thaa`ote) ba'enee 'enedetaagaaraa bitaagaluhe 'atetaazazaacawe mamalashaacehu wadanee nawe teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme hulu 'enageraacexwaalahu
'enaziyaaneme yaamanu; malekaame szeraawoceneme yaszaru badagaagocu wesethe ba'eregethe 'enaagabaacawaalane

kasawoceme ba'alaahe 'amanene yamile sawe 'alela ba'alaaheme (bamaamanu) batasaqaaya gizee yasawocene maasaqaayate 'eneda 'alaahe qethaate yaadaregaale kageetaaheme 'eredaataa bimathaa 'enyaa ba'eregethe ka'enaaneta gaare nabarene yelaalu 'alaahe ba`aalamaate hhezebe leboce wesethe yaalawene hulu `awaaqi 'ayedalamene
'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutene ba'eregethe yaaweqaale manaafeqocuneme yaaweqaale

'enaziyaame yakaadute sawoce la'enaziyaa laamanute <<manegadaacenene takatalu; xathi'atocaacehuneme 'eneshakamaalane>> 'alu 'enaresume kaxathi'atocaacawe meneneme tashakaamiwoce 'ayedalume 'enaresu ba'eregethe weshataamoce naacawe
shakemocaacawenenaa kashakemocaacawe gaare (leeloce) shakemoceneme ba'eregethe yeshakamaalu bateneszaa'eeme qane yeqathefute kanabarute ba'eregethe yethayaqaalu
nuhheneme wada hhezebocu ba'eregethe laakenawe bawesethaacaweme shihe `aamatene 'amesaa `aamate siqare taqamatha 'enaresu badaayoce kxonaweme yawehaawe maathelaqelaqe yaazaacawe
nuhhenenaa yamarekabituneme gwaadoce 'adaanaacawe 'ereswaneme la`aalamaate ta`aamere 'adaragenaate
beraahimeneme lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<'alaahene tagazu feruteme yehe yametaawequ betehonu la'enaaneta balaache nawe

<<ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazezute thaa`otaatene becaa nawe weshateneme teqathaathefaalaacehu 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazuwaacawe la'enaaneta sisaayene lisathwacehu 'ayecelume selazihe sisaayene ka'alaahe zanede becaa falegu tagazuteme la'eresume 'amasagenu wada'eresu temalasaalaacehu
<<betaasetabaabelume kafitaacehu yanabarute hhezeboce ba'eregethe 'asetabaabelawaale bamaleketanyaaweme laaye geletse maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabateme >>
'alaahe mafetharene 'enedeete 'enedamijamare kaziyaame 'enedeete 'enedamimalesawe 'ayemalakatumene yehe ba'alaahe laaye qalaale nawe
<< --bamedere laaye kxidu; mafethareneme 'enedeete 'eneda jamara tamalekatu kaziyaame; 'alaahe yamacharashaayetune manasaate yaasenasaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa>> balaacawe
yamishaawene sawe yeqathaale yamishaaweneme sawe yaazenelataale wada'eresume temalasaalaacehu
'enaanetame bamedereme kxona basamaaye yametaaqetu 'ayedalaacehume ka'alaaheme leelaa radaateme takalaakaayeme meneme yalaacehume
'enaziyaame ba'alaahe 'aneqatsocenaa bamaganaanyatu yakaadu 'enaziyaa ka'ezenatee tasefaane qorathu 'enaziyaame la'enasu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
yahhezebocume malese - <<gedalute; wayeme 'aqaathelute>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame ka'esaatitume 'alaahe 'adaanawe bazihe wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce ta`aameraatoce 'alubate

(beraahime) 'alame <<ka'alaahe leelaa thaa`otaatene ('amaalekete) yayaazaacehute baqerebitu hheyewate bamakaakalaacehu lamawaadade becaa nawe kaziyaame bateneszaa'ee qane kafilaacahu bakafilu yekedaale kafilaacehume kafilune yeragemaale manoriyaacehume 'esaate naate la'enaanetame karadaatoce meneme yalaacehume >>
lutheme la'eresu 'amana; (beraahime) <<'enee wada geetaayee tasadaaje nanye 'enaho 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawenaa>> 'alame
la'eresume sehhaqenenaa yaa`eqobene sathanawe bazarume wesethe nabeyenatenenaa matsehhafene 'adaragene menedaaweneme baqerebitu `aalame sathanawe 'eresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame kadagaagocu nawe
lutheneme lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<'enaaneta thayaafene seraa teszaraalaacehune ba'ereswa ka`aalamaate 'anedeme 'aleqadamaacehume

<<'enaaneta ba'eregethe wanedocene temathaalaacehune manegadeneme teqorethaalaacehune bashanegwaacehume yaminawarene nagare teszaraalaacehune>> ('alaacawe) yahhezebocume malese <<ka'ewenatanyocu 'eneda honeke ya'alaahene qethaate 'amethaabene>> maalate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabarame
<<geetaayee hoye! ba'amatsanyoce hhezeboce laaye 'eredaanye>> 'ala
maleketanyocaaceneme beraahimene babeseraate bamathute gizee <<'enyaa yazihecene katamaa sawoce 'athefiwoce nane sawocwa badaayoce nabarunaa>> 'alute

<<ba'ereswa wesethe luthe 'ala 'eko>> 'alaacawe <<'enyaa bawesethwa yaalawene yebalethe `awaaqi nane ('eresune) ba'eregethe 'enaadenawaalane beetasabocuneme chemere misetu becaa seteqare 'ereswa bathefaatu wesethe kamiqarute naate>> 'alute

maleketanyocaaceneme luthene bamathute gizee ba'enasu mekeneyaate 'azana ba'enaresume lebu tachanaqa <<'ateferaa; 'atezaneme 'enyaa 'adaanyocehe nane beetasaboceheneme; misetehe becaa seteqare 'ereswa bathefaatu wesethe kaqariwocu naate>> 'aluteme
<<'enyaa bazihece katamaa sawoce laaye yaametsu banabarute mekeneyaate kasamaaye qethaatene 'aweraajoce nane >>
ba'eregetheme lamiyaasebu sawoce ka'ereswa geletse meleketene tawene ('aseqarane)
wada madeyaneme wanedemaacawene shu`ayebene (laakene) <<hhezebocee hoye! 'alaahene tagazu, yamacharashaaweneme qane feru, bamedereme wesethe yametaathafu honaacehu 'ataabalaashu 'alaacaweme
'asetabaabaaluteme yamedere maneqatheqathe yaazacaacawe bahaagaraacaweme wesethe tanekafererawe 'anagu

`aadenenaa samudeneme ('athafaane) kamanoriyaawocaacaweme (fereseraashoce bakule mathefaataacawe) la'enaaneta ba'ewenate tagalathalaacehu sayethaaneme szeraawocaacawene la'enaresu shalamalaacawe kamanegademe 'agadaacawe yamaasetawaaleme baalabeetoce nabaru; (gene 'alaasetawaalume)
qaaruneneme fare`oneneme haamaaneneme ('athafaane) musaame bata`aameraatoce ba'eregethe mathaabaacawe bamedereme laaye koru 'amelaachiwoceme 'alenabarume

huluneme baxethi'aatu yaazenawe ka'enasume wesethe thatharene yaazala nafaasene yalaakenebate 'alela ka'enasume wesethe chukxate yayaazacewe 'alela ka'enaresume wesethe ba'eresu mederene yadarabaanebate 'alela ka'enasume wesethe yaasathamenewe 'alela 'alaaheme yamibadelaacawe 'alenabarame gene nafesocaacawene yamibadelu nabaru

ya'enaziyaa ka'alaahe leelaa radaatocene (thaa`otaatene) yayaazu sawoce mesaalee beetene 'eneda szaraace shararite bethee nawe kabeetoceme hulu bathaame dakaamaawe yashararite beete nawe biyaawequ noro ('amaalekete 'aderegawe 'ayegegazwacaweme nabare)
'alaahe yaanene ka'eresu leelaa yamigegazutene maanenyaaweneme yaaweqaale 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe
'enaziheneme mesaaleewoce lasawoce 'enegaletsaacawaalane kaliqaawenetocume basetaqare leelocu 'ayaaweqwaateme
<<'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene 'ewenatanyaa hono fathara >> bazihe wesethe lame'emenaane ta`aamere 'alabate

kamatsehhafe wada 'aneta yatawaradawene 'anebebe solaateneme danebune thabeqahe segade solaate kamathefonaa kamithalaa nagare hulu tekalakelaalacenaa 'alaaheneme maawesaate kahulu nagare balaache nawe; 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu yaaweqaale

yamatsehhafune baalabeetoceme baziyaace 'ereswa malekaame bakxonacewe kerekere 'eneji 'atekaraakaru ka'enaresu 'enaziyaane yabadalutene siqare balume <<baziyaa wadanyaa batawaradawe wadanaanetame batawaradawe 'amanene 'amelaakaaceneme 'amelaakaacehume 'anede nawe 'enyaame la'eresu taazaazhoce nane >>

'enedazihume wadaaneta matsehhafene 'awaradene 'enaziyaame matsehhafene yasathanaacawe; ba'eresu yaamenaalu ka'enaziheme (kamakaa sawoce) ba'eresu yamiyaamenu 'alelu bata`aameraatocaaceneme kahhaadiwocu 'eneji maaneme 'ayekedeme
ka'eresu bafiteme matsehhafene yametaanabe baqanyeheme yametetsefawe 'alenabarekeme yaane gizee 'athefiwocu ba'eregethe batatharaatharu nabare
'ayedalame 'eresu (qure'aane) ba'enaziyaa `eweqatene batasathute sawoce leboce wesethe (yathalaqa) geletsoce 'aneqatsoce nawe ba'aneqatsocaaceneme badaayocu 'eneji leelaawe 'ayekedeme
<<ba'eresu laayeme kageetaahe zanede ta`aameraatoce lamene 'aletawaradume>> 'alu <<ta`aameraatoce 'alaahe zanede becaa naacawe 'eneeme geletse 'asefaraari becaa nanye>> balaacawe
'enyaa matsehhafune ba'enasu laaye yaminababe kxono baaneta laaye maaweradaacene 'ayebaqaacawemene bazihe wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce cerotaanaa gesaatsee 'alabate

<<ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale masekaari ba'alaahe baqaa basamaayaatenaa bamedereme yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale>> balaacawe 'enaziyaame babelaashe nagare yaamanu ba'alaaheme yakaadu 'enaziyaa 'enasu kasaariwoce naacawe
baqethaateme yaasecakuluhaale yatawasaname gizee baalenabara noro qethaatu bamathaabaacawe nabare 'enaresu yamaayaawequ sikxonume badenegate ba'eregethe yemathaabaacawaale
baqethaate yaasecakuluhaale gahanameme kahhaadiwocene ba'eregethe kabaabi naate
qethaatu kabalaayaacawe, ka'egerocaacaweme szere bamishafenaacawe qane teszarute yanabaraacehutene qemasu bamilaacaweme (qane tekabaacawaalace)
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu baarocee hoye! mederee ba'eregethe safi naate; (betecagaru tasadadu) 'eneeneme becaa tagazunye
nafese hulu motene qamaashe naate kaziyaame wadanyaa temalasaalaacehu

'enaziyaame yaamanunaa malekaame szeraawocene yaszaru kaganate baszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene saganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu ba'eregethe 'enaasaferaacawaalane yaszaraatanyoce menedaa menenyaa 'amaara!
('enasu) 'enaziyaa yataagasu bageetaacaweme laaye yamimaku naacawe
kataneqasaaqaasheme megebwane lamashakame yamaatecelawe bezu naate 'alaahe yemagebaataale 'enaanetaneme (yemagebaale) 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa
samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathara tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme yagaraa maane 'enedakxona betethayeqaacawe <<ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale taadeyaa 'enedeete yemalasaalu
'alaahe kabaarocu lamishaawe sisaayene yaasafaale la'eresume yaathabebaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

kasamaayeme wehaane yaawaradanaa ba'eresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe yaadaragaate maane 'enedakxona betethayeqaacawe <<'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<mesegaanaa la'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme

yeheceme yaqerebitu hheyewate mataalayaanaa chawaataa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaceme yamacharashaayetume 'agare 'ereswa ba'eregethe yazalaalame hheyewate 'agare naate yamiyaawequ bikxonu noro; (thafiyetune hheyewate 'ayemarethume nabare)

bamarekaboce wesethe batasaafaru gizeeme 'alaahene magazaatene la'eresu becaa yaatharu kxonawe yetharutaale wada yabese (bamaawethaate) baadaanaacawe gizeeme wadiyaawenu 'enaresu (thaa`otene) yaagaaraalu
basathanaacawe tsagaa likedunaa lithaqaaqamu (yaagaaraalu) wadafiteme (yamithabeqaacawene) yaaweqaalu
sawocu kazuriyaacawe sinathaqu 'enyaa ('agaraacawene ) tsathetanyaa kelele maaderagaacenene 'ayaayumene bawedeqe nagare yaamenaalune ba'alaaheme tsagaa yekedaalune
ba'alaahe laayeme weshatene kaqathaathafa sawe wayeme 'ewenatu bamathaalate gizee ka'asewaasha yebalethe badaaye maanawe bagahaname wesethe lakahhaadiwoce manoriyaa yalamene
'enaziyaame ba'enyaa manegade yataagalu manegadaacenene ba'eregethe 'enemaraacawaalane 'alaaheme ba'eregethe kabago szariwoce gaare nawe
'a.la.ma ('alife laame mime)
rume tashanaface
bathaame qerebe bahonacewe medere 'enaresume kamashanafaacawe baxwaalaa ba'eregethe yaashanefaalu
batheqite `aamataate wesethe (yaashanefaalu) te`ezaazu bafiteme baxwaalaame ya'alaahe nawe baziyaa qaneme me'emanaane yedasataalu
ba'alaahe 'eredaataa (yedasataalu) yamishaawene sawe yeradaale; 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawe
'alaahe 'eredaataane qathara 'alaahe qatharowene 'ayaafareseme gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
kaqerebitu heyewate geletsune becaa yaaweqaalu 'enaresume kaxwaalanyaayetu `aalame 'enaresu zanegiwoce naacawe

banafesocaacawe (huneetaa) 'ayaasetawelumene? samaayaatenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu 'alaahe ba'ewenatenaa batawasana gizee 'eneji 'alefatharaacaweme kasawocume bezuwocu bageetaacawe maganaanyate kahhaadiwoce naacawe

bamedere laaye 'ayekxeedumenaa ya'enaziyaane kabafitaacawe yanabarutene sawoce fetsaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara 'ayemalakatumene? baxayele ka'enaresume yebalethe yathanakaru nabaru medereneme 'arasu ('enazihe) ka'alamwateme yabazaa 'alamwate male`eketa nyocaacaweme bata`aameraatoce mathubaacawe; ('asetabaabalumenaa thafu) 'alaaheme yamibadelaacawe 'alenabarame; gene nafesocaacawene yebadelu nabaru
kaziyaame ya'enaziyaa yaathafute sawoce macharashaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce bamaasetabaabalaacawenaa ba'ereswa yamisaalaqu bamakxonaacawe mekeneyaate mathefo qethaate honace
'alaahe mafetharene yejameraale kaziyaame yemalesawaale; kaziyaame wadaresu temalasaalaacehu
sa`aatitume bameteqomebate qane 'amatsanyoce cheche yelaalu
la'enaresume kamiyaagaaruwaacawe (thaa`otaate) 'amaalaajoce 'ayenorwacaweme; bamiyaagaarwacaweme (thaa`otaate) kahhaadiwoce yekxonaalu
sa`aatitu bameteqomebate qaneme baziyaa qane yelayaayaalu
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaamocene szeraawoce yaszarutemaa 'enaresu baganate chafee wesethe yedasataalu
'enaziyaame yakaadutemaa ba'aneqatsocaacenenaa baxwaalanyaayetume `aalame maganaanyate yaasetabaabalute 'enaziyaa baqethaatu wesethe yamithaadu naacawe
'alaaheneme bametaamashu gizee bametaanagume gizee 'atherute; (segadulate)
mesegaanaame basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe laresu becaa (yatagabaawe) nawe basarekeme; baqatere wesethe bametegabume gizee; ('atherute)
hheyaawene kamute yaawathaale mutaaneme kahheyaawe yaawathaale medereneme kamotace baxwaalaa heyaawe yaadaregaataale 'enedazihume (kamaqaabere) tewathaalaacehu
'enaanetaneme ka`afare mafetharu kaziyaame 'enaaneta wadiyaawenu yametebataatanu sawoce makxonaacehu ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe

la'enaanetame kanafesocaacehu (kagosocaacehu) misetocene wada'enaresu teraku zanede mafetharu, bamakaakalaacehume feqerenenaa 'ezenatene maaderagu ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe bazihe wesethe lamiyaasetawelu hhezeboce ta`aameraatoce 'alelu
samaayaatenenaa medereneme mafetharu, yaqwaaneqwaawocaacehunaa yamalekocaacehume malayaayate, ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe bazihe wesethe la`awaaqiwoce ta`aameraatoce 'alelubate
baleelitenaa baqaneme matanyaataacehu, kacerotaaweme mafalagaacehu kameleketocu nawe bazihe wesethe lamisamu hhezeboce ta`aameraatoce 'alelubate

belechetaaneme fariwocenaa kajaayoce setehonu la'enaaneta maasaayatu, kasamaayeme wehaane maaweradu, ba'eresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe maaderagu ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe bazihe wesethe lamiyaasebu hhezeboce ta`aameraatoce 'alelubate

samaayenaa medereme (yaalamesaso) bate`ezaazu maqomaacawe, kaziyaame (male'aku lateneszaa'ee) kamedere therine batharaacehu gizee 'enaaneta wadiyaawenu yametewathu mahonaacehu ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'eresu becaa nawe hulume la'eresu taazaazhoce naacawe

'eresume yaa mafetharene yamijamere kaziyaame yamimalesawe nawe 'eresume (mamalasu) ba'eresu laaye bathaame gare nawe la'eresume basamaayaateme bamedereme kafetanyaa baahhereye ('anedenatenaa la'eresu bethee yaleelawe makxone) 'alelawe 'eresume 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe

la'enaaneta kanafesocaacehu yahonane mesaalee 'adaragalaacehu ('eresume) 'ejocaacehu kayaazwacawe (baaroce) wesethe basathanaacehu tsagaa la'enaaneta tagaariwoce 'alwacehune? taadiyaa 'enaanetanaa 'enaresu ba'eresu tekekele naacehune? nafesocaacehune (betheewocaacehune) 'enedametefaru tefarwacawaalaacehune? 'enedazihu lamiyaasetawelu hhezeboce; 'aneqatsocene 'enegaletsaalane
yelequneme 'enaziyaa yabadalu sawoce yaala `eweqate zenebaaleewocaacawene takatalu 'alaaheme yaathamamawene sawe yamiyaaqanaawe maanawe? la'enaresume karadaatoce meneme yalaacaweme

wada 'ewenate tazanebaaye kxonaheme fitehene lahaayemaanote qathe 'aderege ya'alaahene fetherate yaacene 'alaahe sawocene ba'eresewaa laaye yafatharabaatene (haayemaanote yaazwate) ya'alaahene fetherate malawathe yalame yehe qathetanyaa haayemaanote nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
wada'eresu tamalaashoce honaacahu (ya'alaahene haayemaanote yaazu) feruteme solaateneme 'asetakaakelaacehu segadu ka'agaariwocume 'atehunu
ka'enaziyaa haayemaanotaacawene kalayaayutenaa kefelefeloceme kahonute ('atehunu) hhezebe hulu 'enasu zanede baalawe nagare tadasaacoce naacawe

sawoceneme cegere baaganyaacawe gizee geetaacawene wadaresu tamalaashoce honawe yetharutaale kaziyaame ka'eresu cerotaane baaqamasaacawe gizee ka'enaresu kafilocu wadiyaawenu bageetaacawe (thaa`otene) yaagaaraalu
basathanaacawe tsagaa likedu (yaagaaraalu) tathaaqamume; ba'eregetheme (macharashaacehune) wadafite taaweqaalaacehu
ba'enaresu laaye 'aseraje 'awaradene? taadiyaa 'eresu baziyaa ba'eresu yaagaaru banabarute nagare yenaagaraalene;(yalame)
sawoceneme cerotaane baaqamasenaacawe gazee ba'ereswa yedasataalu 'ejocaacaweme baasaalafute mekeneyaate makaraa betaaganyaacawe wadiyaawenu 'enaresu tasefaa yeqorethaalu
'alaahe lamishaawe sawe sisaayene yamiyaasafaa yamiyaathabeme mahonune 'ayaayumene bazihe wesethe lamiyaamenu hhezeboce 'asedanaaqi meleketoce 'alelubate

yazemedenaane baalabeete tagabiwene sethawe ladekxaame lamanegadanyaame ('eredaa) yehe la'enaziyaa ya'alaahene fite (wedeetaawene) lamishu malekaame nawe 'enaziyaame 'enaresu yafalagutene yamiyaaganyu naacawe

kabarakateme basawoce ganezaboce wesethe yechamare zanede yametesathute 'alaahe zanede 'ayechamereme kametsewaateme ya'alaahene fite yameteshu honaacehu yametesathute 'enaziyaa (sachiwoce) 'abarekaacoce 'enaresu naacawe

'alaahe yaa yafatharaacehu, kaziyaame sisaayene yasathaacehu, kaziyaame yamigadelaacehu kaziyaame hheyaawe yamiyaadaregaacehu nawe kametaagaarwacawe (thaa`otaate) wesethe kazihe nagare 'anedaacene yamiszaraa 'alane la'alaahe theraate yegabaawe (ba'eresu) kamiyaagaaruteme hulu laaqa
yasawoce 'ejoce baszarute xaathi'aate mekeneyaate yaziyaane yaszarutene kafilune yaaqamesaacawe zanede makaraawe bayabesenaa babaahhere tagalatha; (tasaraacha) 'enaresu limalasu yekajalaalenaa
<<bamedere laaye kxidu ya'enaziyaaneme bafite yanabarutene sawoce macharashaa 'enedeete 'enedanabara tamalekatu>> balaacawe 'abezaanyocaacawe 'agaariwoce nabaru
laresu mamalase yaleelawe qane (yateneszaa'ee qane) ka'alaahe saayemathaa bafite fitehene wada qathetanyaawe haayemaanote qathe 'aderege baziyaa qane (wada ganatenaa wada 'esaate) yelayaayaalu
yakaada sawe kehedatu (thanequ) ba'eresuwe laaye nawe malekaameme yaszaru lanafesocaacawe (maarafiyaawocene) yaazagaajaalu
'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamoceneme yaszarutene kacerotaawe yemanadaa zanede (yelayaayaalu) 'eresu kahhaadiwocene 'ayewademenaa

nafaasoceneme (bazenaabe) letaabaseraacehu, kacerotaaweme (ba'ereswa) liyaaqamesaacehu, marekaboceme bate`ezaazu 'enedineshaalalu, kacerotaaweme 'enedetefalegu, taamasagenuteme zanede malaaku ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe

ka'aneta bafiteme maleketanyocene wadayahhezebocaacawe ba'eregethe laakene bageletse maaserajaawoceme mathubaacawe ka'enaziyaa kaamatsuteme tabaqalene me'emanocuneme maredaate ba'enyaa laaye tagabi hona

'alaahe yaa nafaasocene yamileke nawe damanaaneme yeqasaqesaalu basamaaye laayeme 'enedamishaa yezaragaawaale quretheraachoceme yaadaregawaale zenaabuneme kadamanaawe makaakale siwathaa taayaalahe ba'eresume kabaarocu yamishaawene balaya gizee wadiyaawenu 'enasu yedasataalu
ba'enaresume laaye kamawaradu bafite ka'eresu bafite ba'eregethe tasefaa qoraachoce nabaru

medereneme kamotace baxwaalaa 'enedeete hheyaawe 'enedamiyaadaregaate wada 'alaahe cerotaa falagoce tamalekate yehe ('aderaagi) mutaaneneme ba'eregethe hheyaawe 'aderaagi nawe 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
nafaaseneme (ba'azemaraawoce laaye) benelekenaa garetheto biyaayute ka'eresu baxwaalaa ba'eregethe (cerotaawene) yamikedu yehonaalu
'anetame mutaanene 'ataasamaame daneqorowoceneme zwariwoce honawe bashashu gizee therine 'ataasamaame
'aneta `eweroceneme kathemataacawe yametaaqanaa 'ayedalaheme ba'aneqatsocaacene yamiyaamenutene sawoce 'eneji leelaane 'ataasamaame 'enaresume taazaazhoce naacawe

'alaahe yaa kadakaamaa (fetewate thabetaa) yafatharaacehu nawe kaziyaame kadakaamaanate baxwaalaa xayelene 'adaraga kaziyaame kaberetunate baxwaalaa dakaamaanatenenaa shebatene 'adaraga yamishaawene yefatheraale 'eresume `awaaqiwe caayu nawe
sa`aatitu bametehonebate qane kahhaadiwoce <<ka'anedite sa`aate basetaqare (bamaqaabere) 'aleqoyaneme>> belawe yemelaalu 'enedazihu (ka'ewenate) yemalasu nabaru

'enaziyaaneme `eweqatenenaa 'emenatene yatasathute <<ba'alaahe matsehhafe (ferede) 'eseka teneszaa'ee qane ba'eregethe qoyaacehu yeheme (yakaadaacehute) yateneszaa'ee qane nawe gene 'enaaneta yamaataawequ nabaraacehu>> yelwacawaale
baziyaame qane 'enaziyaane yabadalutene maamakaanyataacawe 'ayethaqemaacaweme 'enaresume bawaqasaa 'ayetaalafume

baziyaame qure'aane wesethe kamesaalee hulu lasawoce ba'eregethe galatsene bata`aamereme betemathaabaacawe 'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce <<'enaaneta 'abalaashiwoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume>> yelaalu
'enedazihu 'alaahe ba'enaziyaa bamaayaawequte sawoce leboce laaye yaatemaale
selazihe taagase ya'alaahe qatharo 'ewenate nawenaa 'enaziyaame bateneszaa'ee yamiyaaragaagethute 'ayaaqeleluhe
'a.la.ma. ('alife laame mime)
yehece thebabe katamalaawe matsehhafe 'aneqatsoce naate
labago 'aderaagiwoce marinaa 'ezenate setekxone
la'enaziyaa solaatene 'asetakaakelawe lamiyaadaresute, zakaaneme lamisathute, 'enaresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame 'enaresu yamiyaaragaagethu lahonute
'enaziyaa kageetaacawe bahona qene manegade laaye naacawe 'enaziyaame 'enaresu menyotaacawene yaaganyu naacawe
kasawoceme yaala `eweqate hono ka'alaahe manegade liyaasaasetenaa maalaagachaa 'aderego liyezaate 'ataalaaye wareene yamigazaa 'alela 'enaziyaa la'enaresu 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alaacawe
'aneqatsocaaceneme ba'eresu laaye baminababu gizee 'enedaalesamaatenaa bajorocu denequrenaa 'enedaalabate yakoraa hono yezoraale ba'asaamaami qethaateme 'abeserawe
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaamoceneme yaszaru la'enaresu yatsagaa ganatoce 'alwacawe
ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce sihonu; 'alaaheme 'ewenatanyaane tasefaa qaale gabaalaacawe 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

samaayaatene yaalametaayuwaate 'a`emaade (mesasowoce) fathara bamedereme wesethe ba'enaaneta 'enedaataaragarege taraaraawocene thaala ba'ereswame laaye kataneqasaaqaashe hulu batana kasamaayeme wehaane 'awaradene ba'ereswame wesethe kamalekaame `aayenate hulu 'abaqalene
yehe ya'alaahe fethure nawe 'enaziyaa ka'eresu leelaa yaalute menene 'enedafatharu 'eseki 'asaayunye ba'ewenatu badaayocu bageletse themate wesethe naacawe

laluqemaaneme thebabene ba'eregethe sathanawe ('alenaweme) - <<'alaahene 'amasegene >> yaamasaganame sawe yamiyaamasagenawe laraasu becaa nawe yakaadame sawe (baraasu laaye nawe) 'alaahe tabeqaaqi mesegune nawenaa
luqemaaneme laleju 'eresu yamigaszetsawe sikxone <<lejee hoye! ba'alaahe (thaa`otene) 'ataagaaraa maagaaraate taalaaqe badale nawenaa>> yaalawene ('asetaawese)

saweneme bawalaajocu (bago 'enediyaadarege) bathebeqe 'azazenawe 'enaatu kadekaame balaaye bahona dekaame 'aragazacewe thute mathaayaaweme bahulate `aamate wesethe nawe la'eneeme lawalaajoceheme 'amasegene bamaalate ('azazenawe) mamalashaawe wadanee nawe

la'aneta ba'eresu `eweqate yaleelahene nagare ba'enee 'enedetaagaaraa bitaagaluheme 'atetaazazaacawe baqerebitume `aalame; bamalekaame szeraa tawadaajaacawe wada'eneeme yatamalasane sawe manegade takatale kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada'enee nawe teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme hulu 'enageraacexwaalahu; ('alenawe)

(luqemaaneme 'ala) <<lejee hoye! 'ereswa yasanaafeche qenethaate kebedate yaahele betehonenaa baqwaathenye wesethe wayeme basamaayaate wesethe wayeme bamedere wesethe betehone 'alaahe yaamathaataale 'alaahe ruxeruxe wesethe `awaaqi nawenaa
<<lejee hoye! solaatene 'asetakaakelahe segade babago nagareme 'ezaze kamithalaame hulu kalekele bamiyaaganyeheme makaraa laaye taagase yehe bamere kamiyaazu nagaroce nawe
<<gunecheheneme (bakuraate) kasawoce 'ataazure bamedereme laaye tanebathererahe 'atehide 'alaahe tanebatheraarine guranyaane hulu 'ayewademenaa
<<ba'akaakxeedeheme makaakalanyaa kxune kademetseheme zeqe 'aderege kademetsoce hulu 'asekafiwe ya'aheyoce demetse nawenaa >>

'alaahe basamaayaate yaalawenenaa bamedereme yaalawene hulu la'enaaneta yaagaraalaacehu tsagaawocuneme geletseme debeqeme sikxonu yamolaalaacehu makxonune 'ataayumene? kasawoceme yaala `eweqatenaa yaala mari, yaalageletse matsehhafeme ba'alaahe yamikaraakare 'alela

la'enaresume 'alaahe yaawaradawene takatalu batabaalu gizee 'ayedalame ba'eresu laaye 'abaatocaacenene yaaganyanebatene 'enekatalaalane yelaalu sayethaane wada 'esaate qethaate yamitharaacawe bihoneme (yekataluwaacawaalene?)
'eresu malekaame szari hono fitune wada 'alaahe yamisatheme sawe thanekaaraane gamade ba'eregethe chabatha yanagarume hulu fetsaamee wada 'alaahe nawe
yakaadame sawe kehedatu 'ayaasaazenehe mamalashaacawe wadanyaa nawe; yaszaruteneme hulu 'enenageraacawaalane 'alaahe baleboce wesethe yaalane hulu yaaweqaalenaa
theqitene 'enaathaaqemaacawaalane kaziyaame wada beretu qethaate 'enaasegadedaacawaalane
samaayaatenenaa medereneme yafathara maane 'enedahona betethayeqaacawe ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe yelaalu mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegabaawe balaacawe yelequneme 'abezaanyaawocu 'ayaawequme
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'alaahe nawe 'alaahe 'eresu tabeqaaqi mesegune nawe

kazaafeme bamedere yaalawe hulu be'eroce bihonu noro baahherume ka'eresu (maalaqe) baxwaalaa sabaate baaheroce yamichamarulate hono (qalame bihonenaa bitsaafebaacawe) ya'alaahe qaalaate baalaalaqace nabare 'alaahe 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawenaa
'enaanetane mafetharenaa 'enaanetane maqaseqase 'eneda 'anedite nafese 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame 'alaahe sami tamalekaace nawenaa
