'alaahe leelitene baqane wesethe yamiyaasegabaa, qaneneme baleelite wesethe yamiyaasegabaa, tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme yagaraa mahonune 'ataayemene? hulume 'eseka tawasana gizee derase yerothaalu 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe
yehe 'alaahe 'eresu 'ewenate ka'eresume leelaa yamigegazute (thaa`ote) weshate bamahonunaa 'alaaheme 'eresu yabalaaye taalaaqe bamahonu nawe

ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu liyaasaayaacehu marekaboce ba'alaahe cerotaa babaahere wesethe yamineshaalalu mahonaacawene 'ataayemene? bazihe wesethe bathaame taagaashe 'amasegaanye lahonu hulu ta`aameraatoce 'alubate

'eneda thelaawoceme yahona maa`ebale bashafanaacawe gizee 'alaahene haayemaanotene la'eresu becaa yaatharu honawe yetharutaale wada yabeseme baadaanaacawe gizee ka'enasu tekekelanyaame 'alela (ka'enaresume yamikede 'ala) ba'aneqatsocaaceneme 'ataalaaye kadaatanyaa hulu 'eneji leelaawe 'ayekedeme

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! geetaacehune feru walaajeme kaleju (bameneme) yamaayethaqemebatene; tawalaajeme 'eresu walaajene bameneme thaqaami yamaayehonebatene qane feru ya'alaahe qatharo 'ewenate nawenaa qerebitume hheyewate 'ateshanegelaacehu ba'alaaheme (mataagase) 'ataalaayu (sayethaane) 'ayaataalelaacehu

'alaahe yasa`aatitu `eweqate 'eresu zanede becaa nawe zenaabeneme yaawaredaale bamaahhetzanoceme wesethe yaalane hulu yaaweqaale maanenyaayetu nafeseme naga yameteszaraawene 'ataaweqeme maanenyaayetu nafeseme bayatenyaawe medere 'enedametemote 'ataaweqeme 'alaahe `awaaqi wesetha `awaaqi nawe
'a.la.ma ('alife laame mime)
yamatsehhafu mawarade therethere yalabateme ka`aalamaate geetaa nawe

yelequneme <<qathafawe>> yelaalune? 'ayedalame 'eresu kageetaahe zanede yahona 'ewenate nawe ba'eresu ka'aneta bafite ka'asefaraari (nabiye) yaalemathaabaacawene hhezeboce letaasefaraaraabate (yaawaradalehe nawe) 'enaresu limemaru yekajalaalenaa

'alaahe yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawene hulu basedesete qanoce wesethe yafathara kaziyaame ba`areshu laaye (selethaanu) yatadalaadala nawe ka'eresu leelaa la'enaaneta radaateme 'amaalaajeme meneme yalaacehume; 'ategasatsumene?
nagarune hulu kasamaaye wada medere yaazagaajaale kaziyaame kameteqotherute (zamane) leku shihe `aamate bahona qane wesethe wadaresu yewathaale (yemalasaale)
yehe (yehenene yaszaraawe) ruquneme qerebuneme hulu `awaaqiwe 'ashanaafiwe, 'azaanyu (geetaa) nawe
yaa yafatharawene nagare hulu yaasaamarawe yasaweneme fetherate kacheqaa yajamarawe nawe
kaziyaame zarocune katanethaalala, kadakaamaa wehaa yaadaraga nawe

kaziyaame (qeretsune) 'asetakaakalawe ba'eresu wesetheme kamanefasu nafaabate; (nafese zaraabate) la'enaanetame jorowocene, `aayenocenenaa leboceneme 'adaragalaacehu bathaame theqitene becaa taamasagenaalaacehu
<<bamedereme wesethe (basebesane) bathafaane gizee 'enyaa ba'adise mafathare wesethe 'enehonaalane?>> 'alu ba'ewenatu 'enaresu bageetaacawe maganaanyate kahhaadiwoce naacawe
<<ba'enaaneta yatawakalawe male'aka mote yegadelaacexwaale kaziyaame wada geetaacehu temalasaalaacehu>> balaacawe

'amatsanyoceme bageetaacawe zanede raasocaacawene yaaqaraqaru honawe <<geetaacene hoye! 'ayane, samaaneme malekaamene 'eneszaraalanenaa (wada medera `aalame) malesane 'enyaa 'aragaagaachoce nane >> (yamilu sihonu) betaaye noro ('asedanegaachene nagare taaye nabare)
bashaaneme noro nafesene hulu qenenatwane ('emenatwane) basathanaate nabare gene gahanamene ka'agaanenetenaa kasawoce yatasabasabu honawe ba'eregethe 'emolaalahu maalate qaalu ka'enee taragaagethwale
yeheneneme qanaacehune maganaanyatene bamaresaataacehu mekeneyaate (qethaatene) qemasu! 'enyaa tawenaacehu teszarute banabaraacehuteme thefaate zawetaarine qethaate qemasu (yebaalaalu)

ba'aneqatsocaacene yamiyaamenute 'enaziyaa ba'ereswa batagasatsu gizee sagaajoce honawe yamiwadequtenaa 'enaresume yamaayekoru honawe bageetaacawe mesegaanaa (tagonaatsefawe) yamiyaawadesute becaa naacawe
geetaacawene lamaferaatenaa lamakajale yamitharute honawe gonocaacawe kamagaadamiyaa seferaawoce yeraaraaqaalu kasathanaacaweme (tsagaa) yelagasaalu
yeszaruteme banabarute lamamanedaate ka`aayenoce maregiyaa la'enaresu yatadabaqalaacawene (tsagaa) maanenyaayetume nafese 'ataaweqeme
'amaanye yahona sawe 'amatsanyaa 'eneda hona sawe nawene? 'ayesetakaakalume
'enaziyaa yaamanunaa malekaamocene yasarumaa la'enaresu yeszarute banabarute mekeneyaate masetanegedo sihonu manoriyaa ganatoce 'alwacawe

'enaziyaa yaamatsutemaa; manoriyaacawe 'esaate naate ka'ereswa mawethaatene bafalagu quthere ba'ereswa wesethe yemalasaalu la'enaresume <<yaanene ba'eresu taasetabaabelubate yanabaraacehutene ya'esaate qethaate qemasu>> yebaalaalu
yemalasu zanedeme katelequ qethaate bafite (bazihe `aalame) kateneshu qethaate ba'eregethe 'enaaqamesaacawaalane
bageetaaweme 'aneqatsoce katagasatsanaa kaziyaame katawaate sawe yebalethe badalanyaa maanawe? (yalame); 'enyaa katanekolanyocu tabaqaayoce nane
musaaneme matsehhafene ba'eregethe sathanawe 'eresune kamaganaanyateheme bamatharaathare wesethe 'atehune la'eseraa'eele lejoceme mari 'adaragenawe
bataagasunaa bata`aameraatocaacene yamiyaaragaagethu bahonume gizee ka'enaresu bate`ezaazaacene yamimaru mariwoce 'adaragene
geetaahe 'eresu baziyaa ba'eresu yelayaayubate banabarute nagare bateneszaa'ee qane bamakaakalaacawe (baferede) yelayaale
kakefela zamanaate sawoce bezuwocene yaathafaane mahonaacene bamanoriyaawocaacawe yamiheedu sihonu la'enaresu 'aletagalatzalaacawemene? bazihe wesethe meleketoce 'alute; 'ayesamumene?
'enyaa wehaane wada daraqe medere yamenenadaa 'enesesocaacawenaa nafesocaacawe ka'eresu yamibalulateneme 'azemaraa ba'eresu yamenaawathaa makxonaacenene 'ayaayumene? 'ayemalakatumene?
<<ka'ewenatanyoceme 'enedahonaacehu yehe ferede macee nawe?>> yelaalu
<<baferede qane 'enaziyaane yakaadutene sawoce 'emenataacawe 'ayethaqemaacaweme 'enaresume gizeene 'ayesathume;>> balaacawe
'enaresuneme tawaacawe tathabaabaqeme; 'enaresu tathabaabaaqiwoce naacawenaa
'aneta nabiyu hoye! 'alaahene feraa kahhaadiwocenenaa manaafeqaaneneme 'atetaazaze 'alaahe `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawenaa
kageetaaheme wada 'aneta yamiwaradawene takatale 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesatha 'awaaqi nawenaa
ba'alaaheme laaye tamakaa mamakiyaame ba'alaahe baqaa

'alaahe la'anede sawe bahodu wesethe hulatene leboce 'alaadaragame misetocaacehuneme 'enaziyaane ka'enaresu 'enedanaatocaacehu jarebaawoce yehunubene yametelwacawene 'enaatocaacehu 'alaadaragame leje bamaaderage yametaasethagwaacaweneme lejocaacehu 'alaadaragame yehe ba'afocaacehu yametelute nawe 'alaaheme 'ewenatune yenaagaraale 'eresume tekekelanyaawene manegade yemaraale

la'abaatocaacawe (bamaasethagaate) therwacawe 'eresu 'alaahe zanede tekekelanyaa nawe 'abaatocaacaweneme baataawequ bahaayemaanote wanedemocaacehunaa zamadocaacehu naacawe ba'eresu batasaasaataacehubate nagareme ba'enaaneta laaye xathi'ate yalabaacehume gene lebocaacehu `aweqawe baszarute (xathi'ate 'alabaacehu) 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

nabiyu bame'emenaane kanafesocaacawe yebalethe tagabi nawe misetocume 'enaatocaacawe naacawe yazemedenaa baalabeetoceme kafilaacawe bakafilu (werese) ba'alaahe matsehhafe wesethe kame'emenaanenaa kasedatanyocu yeleqe yatagabaacawe naacawe gene wada wadaajocaacehu (banuzaazee) malekaamene betesaru (yefaqadaale) yehe bamatsehhafu wesathe yatamazagaba nawe
kanabiyoceme yathabaqa kidaanaacawene ka'anetame, kanuhheme, kaberaahhimeme, kamusaame kamareyame leje `isaame bayaazene gizee ('asetaawase) ka'enaresume yakabadane qaale kidaane yaazene
('alaahe) 'ewenatanyocene kawenataacawe lithayeqe (yehenene szaraa) lakahhaadiwoceme 'asaamaamine qethaate 'azagaaja

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! bezu saraawite bamathaacebaacehunaa ba'enaresu laaye nafaasenenaa yaalaayaacexwaatene saraawite balaakene gizee ba'enaaneta laaye (yaadaragalaacehune) ya'alaahene tsagaa 'asetaawesu 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

kabalaayaacehume kanaaneta bataaceme bamathubaacehu gizee, `aayenoceme baqaabazu, leboceme laaneqaawoce badarasunaa ba'alaaheme therethaareewocene batharatharaacehu gizee (yaadaragalaacehune 'asetaawesu)
'eziyaa zanede me'emenaane tamokaru beretune maneqatheqatheme taneqathaqathu
manaafeqocenaa 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacaweme <<'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe maataalalene 'eneji leelaane 'aleqatharuneme>> bamilu gizee (yaadaragalaacehune 'asetaawesu)

ka'enaresume yahonu cheferoce <<yayaseribe sawoce hoye! la'enaaneta seferaa yalaacehumenaa tamalasu>> baalu gizee ('asetaawesu) ka'enaresume <<kafilocu 'ereswa naweranyaa saatehone beetocaacene naweranyaa naacawe>> yamilu honawe nabiyune (kathoru lamamalase) faqaadene yethayeqaalu mashashene 'eneji leelaa 'ayefalegume
ba'enaresume laaye (beetocaacawe) kayaqabaleewaa batagabaabaate kaziyaame kaselaame mamalasene batathayaqu noro baszarwate nabare ba'ereswame theqitene gizee 'eneji 'ayeqoyume nabare
jarebaawoceneme laayaazoru kaziyaa bafite ba'eregethe 'alaahene qaale kidaane yatagaabu nabaru ya'alaaheme qaale kidaane yamithayaqubate nawe
kamote wayeme kamagadale beteshashu mashashaacehu fatsemo 'ayethaqemaacehume yaane gizeeme theqitene 'eneji yametethaaqamu 'atedaragume balaacawe

<<('alaahe) ba'enaaneta kefune nagare bishaa yaa ka'alaahe yamithabeqaacehu maanawe? wayeme la'enaaneta cerotaane bishaa; (bakefu yaminakaacehu maanawe?)>> balaacawe; ka'alaaheme leelaa la'enaresu wadaajeme radaateme 'ayaaganyume
ka'enaaneta wesethe yamiyaasaanefutene, lawanedemocaacaweme <<wadanyaa nu>> yamilutene, wegiyaaneme theqitene 'eneji yamaayemathutene ba'eregethe 'alaahe yaaweqaacawaale

ba'enaaneta laaye ('eredaataane) yanafagu honawe 'eneje (yamaayemathutene), sheberume bamathaa gizee 'enedaziyaa kamote (makaraa) baresu laaye yamishafene `adagaa 'enedawadaqabate `aayenocaacawe wadiyaanaa wadihe yametezore kxonaa wadaaneta simalakatu taayaacawaalahe sheberume bakxeeda gizee baganezabe laaye yamisaasu kxonawe batabu melaasoce yenadefwacexwaale 'enaziyaa 'alaamanume selazihe 'alaahe szeraawocaacawene 'abalaasha yeheme ba'alaahe laaye garenawe

(manaafeqoce) 'ahhezaabene 'alekxeedume belawe yaasebaalu 'ahhezaabocume bimathu 'enaresu bazalaanoce wesethe bagathare (yaraaqu) lihonu yemanyaalu kawareewocaacehu yethayeqaalu ba'enaaneta wesethe banabarume noro theqitene 'eneji 'ayewaagume nabare
la'enaaneta 'alaahenenaa yamacharashaawene qane yamikajele lahona sawe, 'alaaheneme babezu lamiyaawasaa ba'alaahe male`eketanyaa malekaame makatale 'alelaacehu

'amaanyocume 'ahhezaabene baayu gizee <<yehe 'alaahenaa maleketanyaawe yaqatharune nawe 'alaahenaa maleketanyaaweme 'ewenatene tanaagaru>> 'alu (yehe) 'emenatenenaa mataazazeneme 'eneji leelaane 'alechamaralaacaweme

ka'amaanyocu ba'eresu laaye la'alaahe qaale kidaane yagabubatene ba'ewenate yafatsamu wanedoce 'alelu kanaresume selatune yafatsama (lahaayemaanotu yatagadala) 'alela; kanaresume ganaa yamithabaabaqe 'alela (yagabubatene qaale) malawatheneme 'alelawathume

'alaahe 'ewenatanyocene bawenatanyaanataacawe limanadaa manaafeqaaneneme bishaa liqathaa wayeme (bimalasu) ba'enaresu laaye tsatsataacawene liqabale (yehene 'adaraga) 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa
'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene baquchetaacawe yatamalu malekaamene nagare yaalaaganyu honawe 'alaahe malasaacawe 'amaanyocuneme 'alaahe magaadalene baqaacawe 'alaaheme beretu 'ashanaafi nawe

'enaziyaaneme kamatsehhafu baalabeetoce ('ahhezaabocene) yaradwacawene (qurayezwane) kameshegocaacawe 'awaradaacawe balebocaacaweme wesethe mabaabaatene thaalabaacawe kafilune tegadelaalaacehu kafiluneme temaarekaalaacehu
mederaacaweneme, beetocaacaweneme, ganezabocaacaweneme ganaa yaaleragathaacexwaateneme medere 'awarasaacehu 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'aneta nabiye hoye! lamisetocehe ('enedihe) balaacawe <<qerebitune hheyewatenaa geethwane yametefalegu 'eneda honaacehu nu; 'athaaqemaacexwaalahunaa malekaameneme maasamaaraate (bamafetaate) 'asamaaraacexwaalahunaa
<<'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamacharashaayetune 'agareme yametefalegu betehonume; 'enaho 'alaahe ka'enaaneta lamalekaame szariwocu teleqene menedaa 'azagaajetwale >>
yanabiyu seetoce hoye! ka'enaaneta wesethe geletse yahonane mathefo szeraa yameteszaraa la'ereswa qethaatu hulate 'ethefe hono yenabaabarebaataale yeheme ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe
ka'enaanetame la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe yametetaazaze malekaame szeraaneme yameteszaraa menedaawaane hulate gizee 'enesathaataalane la'ereswame yakabarane sisaaye 'azagaajetanelaataale

yanabiyu seetoce hoye! kaseetoce 'enedamaanaacawe 'ayedalaacehume 'alaahene betefaru (tebalethaalaacehu) yaa balebu wesethe bashetaa yaalabate 'enedaayekajele banegegere 'atelaselesume malekaameneme negegere tanaagaru

babeetocaacehume wesethe 'eregu 'eneda fitanyaayetu mahaayemenate gizee magalatheme bamaageethe 'ategalathu solaateneme badanebu segadu zakaaneme sethu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme taazazu yanabiyu beetasaboce hoye! 'alaahe yamishaawe ka'enaaneta laaye 'erekesatene liyaasewagedenaa maatheraateneme liyaatharaacehu becaa nawe
ka'alaahe 'aneqatsocenaa kathebabume babeetocaacehu yaminababawene 'asetaawesu 'alaahe 'ezenatu raqiqe wesetha `awaaqi nawenaa

muselimoce wanedocenaa muselimoce seetoce, me'emenaanenaa me'emenaateme, taazaazhoce wanedocenaa taazaazhoce seetoceme, 'ewenatanyoce wanedocenaa 'ewenatanyoce seetoceme, taagaashoce wanedocenaa taagaashoce seetoceme, 'alaahene fariwoce wanedocenaa 'alaahene fariwoce seetoceme, matsewaacoce wanedocenaa matsewaacoce seetoceme, tswamiwoce wanedocenaa tswamiwoce seetoceme, (kaaletafaqada szeraa) beletocaacawene thabaaqiwoce wanedocenaa thabaaqi seetoceme, 'alaahene babezu 'aweshiwoce wanedocenaa 'aweshiwoce seetoceme, 'alaahe la'enaresu mehheratenenaa taalaaqene menedaa 'azagaajetolaacawaale

'alaahenaa maleketanyaaweme nagarene bafaradu gizee lame'emenaanenaa lame'emenaate kanagaraacawe la'enaresu merechaa linoraacawe 'ayegabaame! ya'alaahenenaa yamaleketanyaaweneme te'ezaaze yathaasa sawe geletse yahonane masaasaate ba'eregethe tasaasaata

la'eziyaame 'alaahe ba'eresu laaye lalagasalatenaa ('anetame natsaa bamaawethaate) ba'eresu laaye lalagasekelate sawe (lazayede) 'alaahe galaachu yahonane nagare banafesehe wesethe yametedabeqenaa 'alaahe letefaraawe yeleqe yatagabaawe sihone sawocene yametefaraa honahe <<misetehene baaneta zanede yaaze; (kamafetaate) 'alaaheneme feraa>> bametele gizee ('asetaawese) zayedeme ka'ereswa gudaayene bafatsama gizee bame'emenaanoce laaye leje 'aderegawe baasethaguwaacawe (sawoce) misetoce ka'enaresu gudaayene bafatsamu gizee (bamaagebaate) cegere 'enedaayenorebaacawe 'ereswane 'agaabaanehe ya'alaaheme te'ezaaze tafatsaami nawe
banabiyu laaye 'alaahe la'eresu bafaradawe nagare meneme cegere linorebate 'ayegabaame ba'enaziyaa kaziyaa bafite baalafute (nabiyaate) 'alaahe danagagawe ya'alaaheme te'ezaaze yatafarada ferede nawe
la'enaziyaa ya'alaahene male'eketoce lamiyaadaresunaa lamifarute ka'alaahe basetaqareme 'anedeneme lamaayefarute (tadanagaga) taqothaathaarime ba'alaahe baqaa
muhhamade kawanedocaacehu ya'anedeme sawe 'abaate 'ayedalame gene ya'alaahe maleketanyaanaa yanabiyoce madamedamiyaa nawe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene bezu maawesaatene 'awesute
baqanu majamariyaanaa macharashaame 'atherute

'eresu yaa ba'enaaneta laaye 'ezenatene yamiyaawarede nawe malaa'eketocume ('enedazihu mehheratene yamilamenulaacehu naacawe) kachalamaawoce wada berehaane yaawathaacehu zanede (yaazenelaacexwaale) la'amaanyoceme bathaame 'azaanye nawe
bamiganaanyute qane makabaabariyaacawe salaame mabaabaale nawe la'enaresume yakabarane menedaa 'azagaajetolaacawaale
'aneta nabiyu hoye! 'enyaa masekaari, 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraarime 'aderegane laakenehe
wada 'alaaheme bafaqaadu thari, 'aberi berehaaneme ('aderegane laakenehe)
'amaanyoceneme ka'alaahe zanede la'enaresu taalaaqe cerotaa yaalaacawe makxonune 'abeseraacawe
kahhaadiwocenenaa manaafeqaaneneme 'atetaazazaacawe maasaqaayataacaweneme (la'alaahe) tawe ba'alaaheme laaye tathagaa mathagiyaame ba'alaahe baqaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! me'emenaatene baagabaacehunaa kaziyaame saatenakuwaacawe bafite bafataacexwaacawe gizee la'enaaneta ba'enaresu laaye yameteqotheruwaate `idaa meneme yalaacehume 'athaaqemwacaweme; (gureshaa sethwacawe) malekaame maasanaabateneme 'asanaabetwacawe

'aneta nabiyu hoye! 'enyaa 'enaziyaane maherocaacawene yasathahaacawene misetocehene, 'alaahe baaneta laaye kamalasaleheme 'enaziyaane 'ejehe yachabathacaacawene merekonyoce, 'enaziyaaneme ka'aneta gaare yatasadadutene ya'agotehene seetoce lejoce, ya'akesetoceheneme seetoce lejoce, yayashumaaheneme seetoce lejoce, yayashumeewoceheneme seetoce lejoce (maagebaatene) la'aneta faqedanelehaale ya'amanaceneme seete nafeswane (raaswane) lanabiyu betesathe nabiyu liyaagabaate yafalaga 'eneda kxona kame'emenaane leelaa laaneta becaa yatharaace setekxone (faqadenelehe) ba'enaresu (bame'emenaane) laaye bamisetocaacawenaa 'ejocaacawe bachabathwacawe (baaroce nagare) gedeetaa yaadaragenebaacawene ba'eregethe `aweqanaale baaneta laaye cegere 'enedaayenore (yaalafutene faqadenelehe) 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

ka'enaresu yameteshaatene taaqoyaalahe yameteshaaweneme wada 'aneta taasethagaalahe (bamafetaate) ka'araaqehaateme yafalagehaatene (bamamalase betaasethagaa) ba'aneta laaye xathi'ate yalabeheme yehe `aayenocaacawe wada maregaate, wada 'alamaazanaacaweme, lahulume basathahaacawe nagare wada mawedadaacaweme bathaame yaqaraba nawe 'alaaheme balebocaacehu wesethe yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi taagaashe nawe

ka'enazihe baxwaalaa 'ejehe kachabathacaacawe (baaroce) basetaqare seetoce la'aneta 'ayefaqaduleheme kamisetoceme malekaacawe bidaneqeheme 'enekwaa ba'enaresu letaalaawethe ('ayefaqadaleheme) 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye tathabaabaaqi nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! maderasune yamaatethabaabaqu setekxonu wada megebe kaaletafaqadalaacehu basetaqare yanabiyune beetoce (bameneme gizee) 'ategebu gene batatharaacehu gizee gebu batamagabaacehume gizee wadiyaawenu tabatanu lawage yametechaawatu kxonaacehume ('ateqoyu) yehe nabiyune ba'eregethe yaasecageraale ka'enaanetame yaaferaale gene 'alaahe ka'ewenate 'ayaafereme `eqaaneme (lamawaase) bathayaqaacexwaacawe gizee kamagaarajaa xwaalaa kxonaacehu thayeqwaacawe yehe lalebocaacehu; lalebocaacaweme yabalatha netsehhenaa nawe ya'alaaheneme maleketanyaa letaasecageru misetocuneme ka'eresu baxwaalaa menegizeeme letaagabu la'enaaneta 'ayegabaacehume yehe 'alaahe zanede kabaade (xathi'ate) nawe
maanenyaaweneme nagare betegaletsu wayeme betedabequte (baresu yemanadaacexwaale) 'alaahe nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

(yanabiyu misetoce) ba'abaatocaacawe, bawanedoce lejocaacaweme, bawanedemocaacaweme, wanedemocaacawe wanedoce lejoceme, ba'exetocaacawe wanedoce lejoceme, (me'emenaate bakxonute) baseetocaacaweme, 'ejocaacawe bachabathwacaweme baaroce ('athagabe bamagalathe) ba'enaresu laaye xaathi'ate yalabaacaweme (seetoce hoye! taazazu) 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye masekaari nawenaa
'alaahenaa malaa'eketu banabiyu laaye ya'akeberote 'ezenatene yaawaredaalu 'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'eresu laaye ya'akeberote 'ezenatene 'aweredu yamaakebareneme salaametaa salaame balu
'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamiyaasekafu baqerebitu `aalame bamacharashaayetume 'alaahe ragemwacawaale la'enaresume 'awaaraajene qethaate dagesolaacawaale
'enaziyaaneme me'emenaanenenaa me'emenaanatene baalesarute nagare (bamazelafe) yamiyaasaqaayu `ebelatenenaa geletse xaathi'atene ba'eregethe tashakamu

'aneta nabiyu hoye! lamisetocahe, laseetoce lejoceheme, lame'emenaane misetoceme kamakanaanabiyaawocaacawe balaayaacawe laaye 'enedilaqu negaraacawe yehe 'eneditaawaqunaa (babaalageewoce) 'enedaayedafaru lamakxone bathaame yaqaraba nawe 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

manaafeqaanenaa 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe (ya'amanezeraanate) bashetaa yaalabaacawe bamadinaame wesathe (bawaree) 'ashabaariwocu (kazihe szeraacawe) baayekalakalu ba'enaresu laaye ba'eregethe 'eneqasaqesehaalane kaziyaame ba'ereswa wesethe theqitene 'eneji 'ayegoraabatuheme
yataragamu kxonawe 'eneji ('ayegoraabatuheme) bayateme seferaa biganyu yeyaazaalu magadaleneme yegadalaalu
(yeheci) ba'enaziyaa bafite baalafute (laaye yadanagagaate) ya'alaahe denegaagee naate la'alaaheme denegaagee fatsemo malawathene 'ataaganyeme
sawoce kasa`aatitu yethayequhaale <<`eweqatewaa 'alaahe zaneda becaa nawe;>> balaacawe yamiyaasaawaqeheme menedene nawe! sa`aatitu baqerebe gizee letekxone yekajalaale
'alaahe kahhaadiwocene ba'eregethe ragemwacawaale la'enaresume yatagaagaamacene 'esaate 'azagaajetwale
ba'ereswa wesethe zala`aalame zawetaariwoce sikxonu; wadaajeme radaateme 'ayaaganyume
fitocaacawe ba'esaate wesathe bamigalabaabathu qane <<waa menyotaacene! 'alaahene batagazaane maleketanyaaweneme bataazazene noro>> 'eyaalu yetsatsataalu
yelaalume <<geetaacene hoye! 'enyaa geetocaacenenenaa taalaalaaqocaacenene taazazene manegaduneme 'asaasaatune
<<geetaacene hoye! kaqethaatu 'ethefene sethaacawe taalaaqene 'eregemaaneme 'eregamaacawe >>
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'eneda'enaziyaa musaane 'enedaasaqaayute sawoce 'atekxunu kaaluteme nagare hulu 'alaahe 'atharaawe 'alaaheme zanede baalamogase nabare
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru tekekelanyaaneme negegere tanaagaru
szeraawocaacehune la'enaaneta yaabajelaacexwaalenaa xathi'atocaacehuneme la'enaaneta yemerelaacexwaale 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamitaazazeme sawe ba'eregethe taalaaqene 'edele 'aganya
'enyaa 'adaraane basamaayaatenaa bamedere, bataraaraawoceme laaye 'aqarabenaate mashakamwaneme 'enebi 'alu ka'ereswame faru saweme tashakamaate 'eresu bathaame badalanyaa tasaasaace nawenaa

manaafeqaanenenaa manaafeqaatene, wanedoce 'agaariwocenenaa seetoce 'agaariwoceneme 'alaahe liqathaanaa bame'emenaanenaa bame'emenaateme laaye 'alaahe nesehhaane liqabale ('adaraawaane sawe tashakamaate) 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

mesegaanaa laziyaa basamaayaateme yaala bamedereme yaala hulu yaresu lakxonawe la'alaahe yegabaawe bamacharashaayetume `aalame mesegaanaa la'eresu becaa nawe 'eresume belehaatanyaawe wesetha `awaaqiwe nawe
bamedere wesethe yamigabaawene hulu ka'ereswame yamiwathaawene kasamaayeme yamiwaredawene ba'ereswame wesethe yamiyaaregawene hulu yaaweqaale 'eresume 'azaanyu mahhaariwe nawe

'enaziyaa yakaaduteme <<sa`aatitu 'atemathaabeneme>> 'alu balaacawe <<'ayedalame; ruqune hulu `awaaqi bakxonawe geetaayee 'emelaalahu ba'eregethe temathaabaacexwaalace yabenaanye kebedate yaakele 'enekwaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe ka'eresu 'ayereqeme kazihe yaanasame kxona yabalatha yalame bageletsu matsehhafe wesethe yatamazagaba bikxone 'eneje >>
'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene limanadaa (sa`aatitu temathaabaacexwaalace); 'enaziyaa la'enaresu meheratenaa yakabara sisaaye 'alaacawe
'enaziyaame yamiyaamalethu maselwacawe 'aneqatsocaacenene lamaaferase yathaaru 'enaziyaa la'enaresu kamathefo qethaate yakxona 'asaamaami seqaaye 'alaacawe
'enaziyaame `eweqatene yatasathute yaanene kageetaahe wadaaneta yatawaradawene 'eresu 'ewenatenaa 'ashanaafi mesegune wada kxonawe 'alaahe manegade yamimaraa makxonune yaaweqaalu
'enaziyaame yakaadute <<(mutaacehu) mabathaathasene hulu batabathaathasaacehu gizee 'enaaneta ba'adise mafathare wesethe tekxonaalaacehu belo yaminageraacehune sawe 'enaasaayaacehune?>> 'alu

ba'alaahe laaye weshatene qathafane? wayese ba'eresu `ebedate 'alabatene? ('alu) 'enedaalute 'ayedalame 'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu (`aalame) yamiyaamenute (ba'ereswa) baqethaate wesethe ('ahune) baraaqa sehetateme wesethe naacawe

kasamaayenaa kamedere bafitaacawenaa baxwaalaacawe wadaalawe hulu 'ayemalakatumene? beneshaa ba'enaresu mederene 'enedarabaabaacawaalane wayeme ba'enaresu laaye kasamaaye quraachene 'enethelebaacawaalane; bazihe wesethe (wada geetaawe) tamalaashe lakxona baariyaa hulu melekete 'alabate
ladaawedeme ka'enyaa yakxonane cerotaa ba'eregethe sathanawe ('aleneme) -<<taraaraawoce hoye! ka'eresu gaare wedaaseene malaalesu baraariwoceneme (garaanelate) berateneme la'eresu 'alazabenelate >>
safaafiwocene theruroce szeraa ba'aszaraarewaame mathene malekaameneme szeraa szeru 'enee yameteszarutene nagare hulu tamalekaace nanyenaa ('alenawe)

lasulayemaaneme nafaasene yaqatere bafite guzowaa yaware manegade yaqatere baxwaalaa guzowaame yaware manegade sikxone garaanelate yanahhaseneme meneche la'eresu 'afasasenelate kagaaneenoceme bageetaawe faqaade bafitu yamiszarune ('adaragenelate) kanaresume wesethe kate'ezaazaacene zenefe yamile kanadide 'esaate qethaate 'enaaqamesawaalane

kamekuraaboce, kameseloceme 'eneda ganedaa kakxonu gabataawoceme, katadalaadalu taalaalaaqe desetoceme yamishaawene hulu yeszarulataale ('alenaacaweme) <<yadaawede beetasaboce hoye! 'amasegaanyoce kxonaacehu (lageetaacehu) szeru >> kabaarocee bathaame 'amasegaanyocume theqitoce naacawe

ba'eresume laaye motene bafatsamenebate gizee mamotune baterune yametebalaa taneqasaaqaashe mesethe 'eneji leelaa 'alaamalakataacaweme bawadaqa gizeeme gaaneenoce ruqene mesethire yamiyaawaqu bakxonu noro ba'awaaraaje seqaaye wesethe yamaayeqoye 'enedanabaru taradu

lasaba'e bamanoriyaacawe ba'ewenate 'asedanaaqi melekete nabaraacawe kageraanaa kaqanye hulate 'atekeletoce (nabarwacawe) <<kageetaacehu sisaaye belu la'eresume 'amasegenu ('agaraacehu) webe 'agare naate (geetaacehu) mahhaari geetaame nawe>> (tabaalu)

(kamaamasegane) zorume ba'enaresume laaye yagedebune gorefe laqaqenebaacawe ba'atekeletocaacaweme hulate 'atekeletoce, baalamaregaagaa fereewocene, baalathadacaanaa kaqurequraame baalatheqite zaafocene lawathenaacawe
bamakaadaacawe yehenene manadaanaacawe; ('enedihe yaalawene qethaate) bathaame kahhaadine 'eneji leelaawene 'eneqathaalane?

ba'enaresunaa baziyaace bawesethwa barakatene baadaragenebaate 'agare (bashaame) makaakaleme qethelethele katamocene 'adaragene ba'ereswame guzone wasanene <<tsathetanyoce kxonaacehu baleelitoceme baqanoceme tagwaazu;>> ('alene)

<<geetaacene hoye! baguzowocaacene makaakale 'araareqelene>> 'alume nafesocaacaweneme badalu (magaramiyaa) wareewoceme 'adaragenaacawe mabataataneneme hulu bataatanenaacawe bazihe wesethe bathaame taagaashenaa 'amasegaanye lahona hulu magasachaawoce 'alubate
beliseme ba'enaresu laaye menyotune ba'eregethe fatsama; ka'amanuteme yahonute cheferoce basetaqare takatalute

bamacharashaayetume `aalame yamiyaamenawene kaziyaa 'eresu ka'ereswa bamatharaathare wesethe kahonawe sawe layetane 'enedenaaweqe 'eneje ba'enaresu laaye la'eresu meneme selethaane 'alenabaraweme geetaaheme banagaru hulu laaye tathabaabaaqi nawe

<<'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa ('amaalekete belaacehu) yametaasebwacawene theru basamaayaateme bamedereme wesethe yabenaanye kebedate yaakele meneneme 'ayecelume la'enaresume bahulatume wesethe meneme sherekenaa yalaacaweme ka'enaresume la'eresu meneme 'agaazhe yalaweme;>> balaacawe

melejaame 'eresu lafaqadalate sawe becaa bihone 'eneji 'eresu zanede meneme 'atethaqememe kalebocaacawe laaye denegaatheewe batagalatsame gizee (tamaalaajocu) <<geetaacehu mene 'ala?>> yelaalu ('amaalaajocu) <<'ewenatene 'ala; 'eresume kafetanyaawe taalaaqu geetaa nawe>> yelaalu

<<kasamaayaatenaa kamedere (zenaabenenaa baqaayene) yamisathaacehu maanawe?>> balaacawe <<'alaahe nawe 'enyaa wayeme 'enaaneta batekekelanyaawe manegade laaye wayeme bageletse masaasaate wesethe nane>> balaacawe
<<ka'athafaanawe thefaate 'atethayaqume kameteszaruteme szeraa 'anethayaqeme>> balaacawe
<<geetaacene bamakaakalaacene yesabasebaale kaziyaame bamakaakalaacene ba'ewenate yefaredaale 'eresume batekekele faraaju `awaaqiwe nawe>> balaacawe
<<'enaziyaane tagaariwoce 'aderegaacehu ba'eresu yaasethagaacexwaacawene (thaa`otaate) 'asaayunye tawu ('ataagaaru); ba'ewenatu 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe belehaatanyaawe 'alaahe nawe>> balaacawe
'anetaneme lasawoce hulu bamalaa 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari 'aderegane bihone 'eneji 'alaakeneheme gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
<<'ewenatanyoceme 'eneda honaacehu yehe qatharo macee nawe?>> yelaalu
<<la'enaaneta ka'eresu 'anediteneme sa`aate yamaatezagayubate yamaateqademubateme yaqatharo qane 'alaacehu>> balaacawe

'enaziyaa yakaaduteme bazihe qure'aane baziyaa kabafitu baalaweme (matsehhafe) bacheraashe 'anaameneme 'alu badaayoceme kafilaacawe wada kafilu negegerene yamimalaalasu honawe bageetaacawe zanede bamiqomu gizee betaaye noro; ('asedanaaqine nagare taaye nabare) 'enaziyaa yatawaaradute la'enaziyaa lakorute <<'enaaneta baalenabaraacehu noro 'amaanyoce bakxone nabare>> yelaalu
'enaziyaa yakorute la'enaziyaa latawaaradute <<katekekelanyaawe 'emenate kamathaalaacehu baxwaalaa 'enyaa kalakalenaacehune? 'ayedalame ('enaanetawe) kahhaadiwoce nabaraacehu>> yelwacawaale

'enaziyaame yatawaaradute la'enaziyaa lakorute <<'ayedalame; ba'alaahe 'enedenekedenaa la'eresu baalaanethaawocene 'enedenaadarege setaazune (yakalakalane) yaleelitenaa yaqane dulataacehu nawe>> yelaalu qethaatuneme baayu gizee tsatsatene yegaletsaalu ba'enaziyaame bakaadute 'anegatoce laaye 'enezaazelocene 'enaadaregaalane yeszarute yanabarutene 'eneji leelaane yemanadaalune?
bakatamaame 'asefaraarine 'alelaakeneme nawaariwocewaa <<'enyaa baziyaa baresu batalaakaacehubate kahhaadiwoce nane>> yaalu bikxonu 'eneji
<<'enyaame baganezabocenaa balejoce yebalethe yabazaane nane 'enyaame yameneqathaa 'ayedalaneme>> 'alu
balaacawe <<geetaayee sisaayene lamishaawe sawe yaasafaale; yaathabaaleme gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme >>

ganezabocaacehunaa lejocaacehume yaace 'enyaa zanede maqerabene yametaaqarebaacehu 'ayedalaceme yaamananaa malekaamene yaszaraa becaa siqare 'enaziyaa la'enaresu baszarute malekaame szeraa 'ethefe menedaa 'alelaacawe 'enaresume baganate saganatoce wesethe tsathetanyoce naacawe
'enaziyaame yamiyaaqetu maselwacawe 'aneqatsocaacenene lamaabalaashate yamitherute 'enaziyaa baqethaatu wesethe yamithaadu naacawe

<<geetaayee sisaayene kabaarocu lamishaawe sawe yaasafaale la'eresume yaathabebaale kamaanenyaaweme nagare yametelagesutene 'eresu yetakaawaale 'eresume kasisaaye sachiwoce hulu balaache nawe>> balaacawe
huluneme bamisabasebaacawenaa kaziyaame lamalaa'eketocu <<'enazihe 'enaanetane yegegazu nabarune?>> bamilaacawe qane (yamikxonawene 'asetaawese)

(malaa'eketocume) <<theraate yegabaahe ka'enaresu leelaa radaataacene 'aneta becaa nahe ('enedamilute) 'ayedalame yelequneme gaaneenene yegegazu nabaru 'abezaanyocaacawe ba'enaresu 'amaanyoce naacawe>> yelaalu

zaareeme kafilaacehu lakafilu matheqameneme kxona magudaatene 'ayecelume la'enaziyaame labadalute <<yaacene ba'ereswa taasetabaabelubaate yanabaraacehutene ya'esaate qethaate qemasu>> 'enelaacawaalane

ba'enaresume laaye 'aneqatsocaacene geletse kxonawe batanababulaacawe gizee <<yehe 'abaatocaacehu yegegazute kanabarute nagare likalakelaacehu yamifalege sawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alu <<yeheme (qure'aane) yataqathaathafa weshate nawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alu 'enaziyaame yakaadute 'ewenatu bamathaalaacawe gizee <<yehe geletse degemete nawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> 'alu
yamiyaathanuwaacawe yakxonu matsehhafetoceneme meneme 'alesathanaacaweme ka'aneta bafiteme 'asefaraari nabiyene wada'enaresu 'alelaakeneme

'enaziyaame ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute 'asetabaabelawaale yasathanaacaweneme ka`asere 'anedune ('enazihe) 'aledarasume maleketanyoceeneme 'asetabaabalu; (naqafekwaacaweme) maneqafeeme 'enedeete nabare!

<<yamegasetsaacehu baanedite nagare becaa nawe ('ereswame) hulate hulate 'anede 'anedeme kxonaacehu la'alaahe 'enedetenasu kaziyaame bagwaadanyaacehu (bamuhhamade) meneme `ebedate yaleelabate makxonune maremeraacehu 'enedetereradu nawe 'eresu la'enaaneta kaberetu qethaate basetafite 'asethaneqaaqi nawe 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame>> balaacawe
<<kawaagaa maanenyaaweme yathayaqexwaacehu binore 'eresu la'enaanetawe nawe; waagaayee ba'alaahe laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayedalame 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe
<<geetaayee 'ewenatene yaawaredaale ruqe yakxonutene mesethiroce hulu `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe
<<'ewenatu mathaa weshateme manashaame maderashaame yalaweme (tawagada)>> balaacawe
<<besaasaate yamesaasaatawe baraasee laaye becaa nawe bemaraame geetaayee wadanee bamiyaawaredawe nawe 'eresu sami qerebe nawenaa>> balaacawe
badanagathunaa maamelachaa baleelaacawe gizee kaqerebe seferaame batayaazu gizee (kxuneetaacawene) betaaye noro ('asedanaaqine nagare baayahe nabare)
<<ba'eresume ('ahune) 'amanene>> yelaalu la'enaresume karuqe seferaa ('emenatene) baqalaale maagenyate kayataacawe?
bafiteme ba'eresu ba'eregethe kedawaale karuqe seferaame bagemete negegerene yethelaalu
kazihe qadame bamasalocaacawe 'eneda taszaraaweme bethee ba'enaresunaa bamifalegute makaakale tagaarada 'enaresu ba'eregethe ba'awalaawaaye therethaaree wesethe nabarunaa

mesegaanaa samaayaatenenaa mederene fathaari, malaa'eketene baala hulate hulate, baala sosete soseteme, baala 'araate 'araateme kenefoce yakxonu maleketanyoce 'aderaagi lakxonawe 'alaahe yegabaawe bafetheratu wesethe yamishaawene yechameraale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa
'alaahe lasawoce kacerotaa yamikafetaate la'ereswa meneme 'agaaje yalaateme yamiyaagedaweme ka'eresu baxwaalaa la'eresu meneme laqaaqi yalaweme 'eresume 'ashanafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ba'enaaneta laaye (yaalawene) ya'alaahene tsagaa 'asetaawesu ka'alaahe leelaa fathaari 'alane? kasamaayenaa kamedereme sisaayene yamisathaacehu 'alane? ka'eresu basetaqare 'amelaake (sachime) yalame taadiyaa wadeete tezoraalaacehu
biyaasetabaabeluheme ka'aneta bafite yanabaru maleketanyoce ba'eregethe tasetabaabelawaale wada 'alaaheme nagaroce hulu yemalasaalu
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! ya'alaahe qatharo 'ewenate nawe yaqerebitume hheyewate 'ataataalaacehu 'ataalaayume (sayethaane) ba'alaahe (mataagase) 'ayaataalaacehu
sayethaane lanaaneta thalaate nawe selazihe thalaate 'aderegaacehu yaazute takataayocune yamitharaawe ka'esaate gwaadoce 'enedikxonu becaa nawe
'enaziyaa yakaadute la'enaresu beretu qethaate 'alelaacawe 'enaziyaame yaamanutenaa bago seraawocene yaszarute la'enaresu mehheratenaa taalaaqe menedaa 'alelaacawe

mathefo szeraawe yatashalamalatenaa malekaame 'aderego yaayawe sawe ('alaahe 'enedaaqanaawe sawe nawene?) 'alaaheme yamishaawene sawe yaathamemaale yamishaaweneme yaaqanaale selazihe ba'enaresu laaye (baalamaqenaataacawe) selamaqolaachate nafesehe 'atethefaa 'alaahe yamiszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

'alaaheme yaa nafaasocene yalaaka nawe damanaawoceneme teqasaqesaalace; wada mute (dereqe) 'agareme 'enenadaawaalane ba'eresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe 'enaadaregaataalane mutaaneneme maqaseqase 'enedazihu nawe

maashanafene yamifalege yakxona sawe 'ashanaafinate la'alaahe becaa nawe; ('eresune bamagegazaate yefalegawe) malekaame negegere wadaresu yewathaale bago szeraame kafe yaadaregawaale 'enaziyaame mathefo szeraawocene yamidoletu la'enasu beretu qethaate 'alelaacawe ya'enaziyaame tanekole 'eresu yethafaale

'alaaheme ka`afare, kaziyaame kafetewate thabetaa fatharaacehu kaziyaame gosaawoce 'adaragaacehu seeteme 'ataaragezeme 'atewaledememe ba`eweqatu bikxone 'eneji `edemeewe kamirazameme 'anedeme 'ayerazameme ka`edemeeweme 'ayegodaleme bamatsehhafu wesethe yaala bikxone 'eneji yehe ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe

hulatu baahheroceme 'ayetakaakalume! yehe thaafaache, themene qoraache, mathathu bagare tawaache nawe yehenyaaweme chawe maregaagaa nawe 'erethebe segaaneme kahulume tebalaalaacehu (kachawe baahhere) yametelabeswateneme geethe taawathaalaacehu kacerotaawe letefalegunaa letaamasagenume marekabocene ba'eresu wesethe wehaawene qadaajoce kxonawe (sineshaalalu) taayaalahe

leelitene baqane wesethe yaasegabaale qaneneme baleelite wesathe yaasegabaale; tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme garaa hulume 'etawasana gizee derase yerothaalu yehe geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe negeszenaawe ya'eresu becaa nawe 'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa yametegegazwacawe yatamere feree shefaane 'enekwaa 'ayenoraacaweme

betetharuwaacawe theriyaacehune 'ayesamume bisamume noro la'enaaneta 'ayemalesulaacehume bateneszaa'eeme qane ('enaresune ba'alaahe) maagaaraataacehune yekedaalu 'eneda wesetha `awaaqiwe maaneme 'ayenagereheme
'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enaaneta (hule gizee) wada 'alaahe kajaayoce naacehu 'alaaheme 'eresu tabeqaaqiwe mesegunu nawe
bishaa yaasewagedaacexwaale 'adiseneme fethure yaamathaale
yeheme ba'alaahe laaye meneme 'asecagaari 'ayedalame

xathi'atene tashakaamime (nafese) yaleelaawaane shakeme 'ateshakameme yatakabadaceme (nafese) wada shakemwa betethaaraa (tathariwe) yaqerebe zemedenaa baalabeete bikxoneme 'enekwaa ka'ereswa 'anedaacene yamishakamelaate 'ataaganyeme yametaasethanaqeqawe 'enaziyaane geetaacawene baruqe yamifarutene, solaateneme 'asetakaakelawe yaadarasutene becaa nawe yatatheraaraame sawe yamitheraaraawe laraasu becaa nawe mamalashaame wada 'alaahe becaa nawe
`ewerunaa yamiyaayaweme 'ayesetakaakalume
chalamaawocenaa berehaaneme; ('enedazihu)
thelaanaa hharureme
hheyaawaanenaa mutaaneme 'ayesetakaakalume 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe yaasamaale 'anetame bamaqaabere wesethe yaalutene 'asami 'ayedalaheme
'aneta 'asethaneqaaqi 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaheme
'enyaa 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari 'aderegane ba'ewenatu (mameriyaa) laakenehe maanenyaayetume hhezebe bawesethwa 'asefaraari yaalaalafabaate yalaceme
biyaasetabaabeluheme 'enaziyaa kabafitaacawe yanabarute ba'eregethe 'asetabaabelawaale maleketanyocaacawe bageletse maaserajaawocene, batsehhufoceme, 'aberaari bakxona matsehhafeme mathetawaacawaale
kaziyaame 'enaziyaane yakaadutene yaazekwaacawe qethaateeme 'enedeete nabare! (baseferaawe nawe)

'alaahe kasamaaye wehaane maaweradune 'alaayahemene? ba'eresume `aayenatocaacawe yatalayaayu fereewocene 'awathaane kagaaraawoceme malekocaacawe yatalayaayu nachoce, qayoceme, bathaame thequroceme yakxonu manegadoce 'alelu

kasawoceme, kataneqasaaqaashoceme, kabeete 'enesasaawoceme 'enedazihu malekocaacawe yatalayaayu 'alelu 'alaahene kabaarocu wesethe yamifarute `awaaqiwocu becaa naacawe 'alaahe 'ashanaafi mahhaari nawe

'enaziyaa ya'alaahene matsehhafe yamiyaanabu, solaateneme 'asetakaakelawe yaadarasu, kasathanaacaweme sisaaye bamesethireme kxona bageletse yalagasu, bafetsume yamaatekaserene negede tasefaa yaadaregaalu
menedaawocaacawene limolaalaacawe, kacerotaaweme lichamerelaacawe (tasefaa yaadaregaalu) 'eresu bathaame mahhaari 'amasegaanye nawenaa
yaame kamatsehhafu wadaaneta yaawaradenelehe kabafitu laalawe 'aragaagaache sikxone 'eresu 'ewenate nawe 'alaahe baregethe babaarocu wesethe `awaaqi tamalekaace nawe

kaziyaame 'enaziyaane kabaarocaacene yamarathenaacawene matsehhafune 'awarasenaacawe ka'enaresume nafesune badaaye 'alela ka'enaresume makaakalanyaa 'alela ka'enasume ba'alaahe faqaade babago szeraawoce qadaami 'alela yaa (maawerase); 'eresu taalaaqe cerotaa nawe
yamanoriyaa ganatocene bawesethwa yawareqe 'anebaarocene, luleneme yamishalamu kxonawe yegabubaataale ba'ereswa wesethe 'alebaasaataacaweme hhare nawe
yelaalume <<mesegaanaa la'eziyaa ka'enyaa laaye hhazanene laasewagadalene 'alaahe yegabaawe geetaacene bathaame mahhaari 'amasegaanye nawenaa
('eresume) yaa kacerotaawe yazalaalame manoriyaane 'agare yaasafarane nawe ba'ereswa wesethe makaraa 'ayenakaaneme ba'ereswame wesethe dekaame 'ayenakaaneme >>

'enaziyaa yakaaduteme la'enaresu yagahaname 'esaate 'alelaacawe yemotu zanede ba'enaresu laaye (bamote) 'ayefarademe kaqethaatwame ka'enaresu 'ayeqalalelaacaweme 'enedazihu kahhaadine hulu 'enemanadaalane

'enaresume bareswa wesethe 'eredaataane bamafalage baxayele yechohaalu <<geetaacene hoye! ka'eziyaa 'eneszaraawe kanabarenawe leelaa bago szeraane 'eneszaraa zanede 'awethaane>> (yelaalu) <<ba'eresu wesethe yaasetaawasa sawe yamigasatsebatene `edemee 'alaaqoyanaacehumene? 'asethaneqaaqiweme mathetolaacexwaale ('asetabaabelaacexwaaleme) selazihe qemasu labadalanyoceme meneme radaate yalaacaweme>> (yebaalaalu)
'alaahe yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene mesethire ba'eregethe `awaaqi nawe 'eresu baleboce wesethe yaalane hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

'eresu yaa bamedere wesethe metekoce yaadaragaacehu nawe yakaadame sawe kehedatu ba'eresuwe laaye becaa nawe kahhaadiwoceneme kehhedataacawe kageetaacawe zanede mathalaatene 'eneji leelaa 'ayechamarelaacaweme kahhaadiwoceneme kehhedataacawe kasaaraane 'eneji 'ayechamerelaacaweme

balaacawe <<'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazwacawene tagaariwocaacehune 'ayaacehune? kamedere menene 'eneda fatharu 'asaayunye wayese la'enaresu basamaayaate wesethe sherekenaa 'alaacawene? wayese matsehhafene sathanaacawenaa 'enaresu karesu bageletse 'aseraje laaye naacawene? 'ayedalame badalanyoce kafilaacawe kafilune maataalalene 'eneji 'ayeqatherume >>
'alaahe samaayaatenenaa mederene 'enedaayewagadu yeyezaacawaale biwagadume ka'eresu leelaa 'anedeme yamiyezaacawe yalame 'enaho 'eresu taagaashe mahhaari nawenaa

'asefaraarime bimathaalaacawe kahhezebocu hulu ka'anedanyaawaa yebalethe yatamaru likxonu yamahhaalaacawene dekaa 'aderesawe ba'alaahe maalu 'asefaraarime bamathaalaacawe gizee mabaregagene 'eneji leelaa 'alechamaralaacaweme

bamedere laaye kuraatenenaa bakefu (tanekole) madolateneme ('eneji 'alechamaralaacaweme kefu tanekoleme babaalabeetu laaye 'eneji baleelaa laaye 'ayesafereme yaqademowocune danebe 'eneji yethabaabaqaalune? la'alaahe danebeme malelawathene 'ataaganyeme la'alaahe danebeme mazaawarene 'ataaganyeme

bamedere laaye 'ayekxeedumenaa ya'enaziyaane ka'enaresu bafite yanabarutene sawoce macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara 'ayemalakatumene? ka'enaresume baxayele yabaratu nabaru 'alaaheme basamaayaateme kxona bamedere wesethe meneme nagare yamiyaaqetawe 'ayedalame 'eresu `awaaqi caaye nawenaa

'alaaheme sawocene baszarute xathi'ate biyeze noro bawalalwa (bamedere) laaye meneme taneqasaaqaashe baaletawa nabare gene 'etawasana gizee derase yaaqoyaacawaale gizeeyaacaweme bamathaa waqete (baxathi'ataacawe yeqathaacawaale) 'alaahe babaarocu (kxuneetaa) tamalekaace nawenaa
ya.sa.(yaa sine)
thebabe batamalaabate qure'aane 'emelaalahu
'aneta ba'eregethe kamaleketanyocu nahe
baqathetaame manegade laaye nahe
'ashanaafi 'azaanye kahonawe 'amelaake mawaradene tawarada
'abaatocaacawe yaaletasefaraarutene hhezeboce letaasethanaqeqebate (tawarada) 'enaresu zanegiwoce naacawenaa
ba'abezaanyocaacawe laaye qaalu ba'ewenate taragaagatha selazihe 'enaresu 'ayaamenume
'enyaa ba'anegatocaacawe laaye 'enezaazelaawocene 'adaragene 'ereswame ('enezaazelaayetu) wada 'agachocaacawe daraashe naate 'enaresume raasocaacawene yaanegaathathu naacawe
kasetafitaacaweme geredone kasetaxwaalaacaweme geredone 'adaragene shafanenaacaweme selazihe 'enasu 'ayaayume
betaasathanaqeqaacaweme baataasethanaqeqaacaweme ba'enaresu laaye 'ekule nawe 'ayaamenume
yametaasethanaqeqawe gesaatseene yatakatalanenaa 'alerahhemaanene baruqe yafaraane sawe becaa nawe bamehheratenaa bamalekaame menedaame 'abeserawe
'enyaa mutaanene 'enyaa ba'eregethe hheyaawe 'enaadaregaalane yaaseqadamuteneme szeraa falagocaacaweneme 'enetsefaalane nagaruneme hulu galaache mari bakxona matsehhafe wesethe 'athaqaalalenawe
la'enaresume yakatamaayetune (ya'anetsokiyaane) sawoce mesaalee maleketanyocu bamathwate gizee (yakxonawene) gelatselaacawe
wada'enaresu hulatene sawoce balaakenenaa baasetabaabaluwaacawe gizee basosetanyaame ba'abarataanenaa 'enyaa wada 'enaaneta maleketanyoce nane baalwacawe gizee (yakxonawene mesaalee gelatselaacawe)
'enaaneta masalaacene sawoce 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume 'alerahhemaaneme meneme nagare 'alaawaradame 'enaaneta yametewaashu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalaacehume 'aluwaacawe
(maleketanyocume) 'alu <<geetaacene yaaweqaale 'enyaa wada'enaaneta ba'eregethe maleketanyoce nane
<<ba'enyaa laayeme geletse yakxona maaderase 'eneji leelaa yalabeneme >>
(hhezebocume) <<'enyaa ba'enaaneta gada bisoce kxone baatekalakalu ba'eregethe 'enewageraacexwaalane ka'enyaame 'asaamaami qethaate ba'eregethe yaaganyaacexwaale>> 'alu
<<gada bisenataacehu ka'enaanetawe gaare nawe betegasatsu (tezetaalaacehune?) ba'ewenatu 'enaaneta wasane 'alaafiwoce hhezeboce naacehu>> 'alwacawe
kakatamaayetume ruqe daarecaa yamirothe sawe mathaa <<waganocee hoye! maleketanyocune takatalu>> 'ala
<<'enaresu qenune manegade yatamaru sikxonu waagaane yamaayathayequwaacehune sawoce takatalu>> ('alaacawe)
<<yaaneneme yafatharanyene; wadaresume yametemalasubatene (geetaa) yamaalegazaa la'enee mene 'alanye?>> ('ala)
<<ka'eresu leelaa 'amaaleketene 'eyezaalahune? 'alerahemaane bagudaate bishaanye melejaacawe ka'enee (lamamalase) meneme 'atethaqemanyeme; 'ayaadenunyememe
<<'enee yaane gizee bageletse sehetate wesethe nanye
<<'enee bageetaacehu 'amaneku; semunyeme;>> ('ala)
<<ganatene gebaa>> tabaala ('eresume) 'ala - <<waganocee biyaawequ 'emanyaalahu
<<geetaayee la'enee mehherate yaadaragalenyenaa katakabaruteme yaadaraganye makxonune >>
ka'eresume baxwaalaa bahhezebocu laaye (lenaathafaacawe) saraawitene kasamaaye 'alaawaradeneme (bamaaneme laaye) 'awaraajoceme 'alenabareneme
(qethaataacawe) 'anedite chukxate 'eneji leelaa 'alenabaraceme wadiyaawenume 'enaresu thafiwoce kxonu
babaarocu laaye waa qulechete! kamaleketanyaa 'anedeme 'ayemathaacaweme ba'eresu yamisaalaqubate bikxonu 'eneje
ka'enaresu bafite kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezuwocene maathefaataacenenenaa 'enaresu wadanaresu yamaayemalasu makxonaacawene 'alaawaqumene?
hulume 'enyaa zanede yamisabasabu yamiqarabu 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalume
yamotaceweme medere la'enaresu melekete naate! hheyaawe 'adaragenaate ka'ereswame fereene 'awathaane; karesume yebalaalu
ba'ereswame wesathe kazamebabaawocenaa kawayenoce yakxonu 'atekeletocene 'adaragene ba'ereswame wesethe menechocene 'afalaqene
kafereewenaa 'ejocaacawe kaszaruteme yebalu zanede (yehene 'adaragene); 'ayaamasagenumene?

<<'amaaleketocune 'anede 'amelaake 'adaragaacawene? yehe 'asedanaaqi nagare nawe>> ('alu)
ka'enaresume makwaanenetocu <<hidu; ba'amaaleketocaacehume (magegazaate) laaye taagasu yehe (ka'enyaa) yamifalage nagare nawenaa>> 'eyaalu 'azagamu
<<yeheneneme baxwaalanyaayetu haayemaanote 'alesamaaneme yehe weshatene mafethare 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> ('eyaalume)
<<kamakaakalaacene ba'eresu laaye qure'aane tawaradane?>> ('alu) ba'ewenate 'enaresu kagesaatseeyee (kaqure'aane) bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe ba'eregetheme qethaateene ganaa 'aleqamasume
yelequneme ya'ashanaafiwenaa yalagaasu geetaahe yacerotaawe magaazanoce 'enaresu zanede naacawene?
wayese yasamaayaatenaa yamedere yamakaakalaacaweme negeszenaa ya'enaresu nawene? (nawe bilu) bamasalaaloceme yewethu
'eziyaa zanede ka'ahhezaabe yahonu tashanaafi saraawite naacawe
ka'enaresu bafite yanuhhe hhezeboce, `aademe, yacekaaloce baalabeete yahonawe fare`oneme 'asetabaabalu
samudeme, yaluthe sawoceme, ya'ayekate sawoceme ('asetabaabalu) 'enazihe 'ahhezaabocu naacawe
hulume maleketanyocune yaasewaashu 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalume qethaateeme taragaagathabaacawe
'enaziheme la'ereswa mamalase yaleelaatene 'aneditene chukxate 'eneje leelaane 'ayethabaabaqume
<<geetaacene hoye! kameremaraawe qane bafite matsehhafaacenene 'asecakulelene>> 'alume
bamilute nagare laaye taagase yaxayele baalabeete yahonawene baariyaaceneneme daawedene 'awesaalaacawe 'eresu bathaame malaasaa nawenaa
'enyaa taraaraawocene kaqatere baxwaalaanaa barafaademe ka'eresu gaare yamiyaawadesu sihonu garaanelate
baraariwoceneme ('a'ewaafene) yamisabasabu honawe (garaanelate) hulume la'eresu (maawadase) yamimalaalase nawe
manegeszetuneme 'abarataanelate thebabeneme negegerene malayateneme sathanawe
yatakaraakaariwocume waree mathetolehaalene? mekuraabune batanethalaathalu gizee

badaawede laayeme bagabu gizee ka'enaresume badanagatha gizee <<'ateferaa; ('enyaa) kafilaacene bakafilu laaye wasane yaalafa hulate takaraakaariwoce nane bamakaakalaaceneme ba'ewenate ferade 'ataadaalaame wada makaakalanyaaweme manegade meraane;>> 'alute
<<yehe wanedemee nawe; la'eresu zathanaa zathanye seetoce bagoce 'alute laneeme 'anedite seete bage 'alacenye 'ereswaneme `edelee 'aderegaate 'alanye banegegereme 'ashanafanye>> 'alawe

<<seete bagehene wada bagocu (lamaqalaaqale) bamathayaqu ba'eregethe badalahe katagaariwoceme bezuwocu kafilaacawe bakafilu laaye wasane yaalefaalu 'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaamocene yaszarute becaa siqaru 'enaresume bathaame theqitoce naacawe>> 'ala daawedeme yafatanenawe makxonune `awaqa geetaaweneme mehheratene lamana sagaaje kxono wadaqame bamatsatsate tamalasame
la'eresume 'enyaa zanede maqerabe (kebere) malekaame mamalashaame 'alawe

daawede hoye! 'enyaa bamedere laaye meteke 'adereganehaalenaa basawoce makaakale ba'ewenate ferade zenebaaleehaneme 'atekatale;ka'alaahe manegade yaasaasaatehaalenaa 'enaziyaa ka'alaahe manegade yamisaasaatu yameremaraawene qane bamaresaataacawe la'enaresu beretu qethaate 'alaacawe
samaayenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawene hulu lakanetu 'alefathareneme yehe ya'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce therethaaree nawe la'enaziyaame lakaadute sawoce ka'esaate wayolaacawe!
ba'ewenatu 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene bamedere wesethe 'enedamiyaathafute 'enaadaregaalane? wayese 'alaahene firawocune 'eneda kahhaadiwocu 'enaadaregaalane?
(yehe) wadaaneta yaawaradenawe beruke matsehhafe nawe 'aneqatsocune 'enediyaasetanatenunaa ya'a'emerowoce baalabeetoceme 'enedigasatsu ('awaradenawe)
ladaawedeme sulayemaanene sathanawe mene yaamere baariyaa! (sulayemaane), 'eresu malaasaa nawe
ba'eresu laaye kaqatere baxwaalaa baszosete 'egerocenaa ba'araatanyaawaa kotee chaafe yamiqomu choleewoce farasoce bataqarabulate gizee ('asetaawese)
'alame <<'enee (tzahhaye) bageredo 'eseka tadabaqace derase kageetaayee maasetaawase faanetaa farasene mawedadene maratheku >>
<<ba'enee laaye maleswate>> ('ala) 'agaadocewaanenaa 'anegatocewaaneme maabase yaaza
sulayemaaneneme ba'eregethe fatanenawe bamanebarume laaye 'akaalene thaalene kaziyaame bamatsatsate tamalasa
<<geetaayee hoye! la'enee maare ka'enee baxwaalaa la'anedeme yamaayegabaaneme negeszenaa sethanye 'aneta lagaasu 'aneta becaa nahenaa>> 'ala
nafaaseneme bate'ezaazu wadafalagabate seferaa lezebe kxonaa yametefase setekxone garaanelate
sayethaanaateneme ganebiwocenenaa sathaamiwocene hulu (garaanelate)
leeloceneme bafenejoce taqoraanyocene (garaanelate)
<<yehe sethotaacene nawe yaalagemete lagese; wayeme chabethe>> ('alenawe)
la'eresume 'enyaa zanede maqerabe; malekaame mamalashaame ba'eregethe 'alelawe
baariyaacenene 'ayubeneme 'awesaalaacawe <<'enee sayethaane bagudaatenaa baseqaaye nakaanye>> sile geetaawene batathaaraa gizee
<<ba'egerehe (mederene) metaa yehe qazeqaazaa mataathabiyaa mathatheme nawe>> (tabaala)
la'eresume ka'enyaa zanede lacerotaa baala'a'emerowoceneme lamagaszatse beetasabocune ka'enaresume gaare masalaacawene sathanawe
<<ba'ejeheme chebethe 'arechumeene yaaze ba'eresume (misetehene) metaa maalaaheneme 'ataaferese>> ('alenawe) 'enyaa taagaasha kxono 'aganyanawe mene yaamere baariyaa 'eresu bathaame malaasaa nawe
baarocaaceneneme beraahimene, sehhaqenenaa yaa`eqobaneme, yaxeyelenaa yamaasetawaale baalabeetoce yakxonune 'awesaalaacawe
'enyaa theru bakxonace thabaaye marathenaacawe ('ereswame) yamacharashaayetune 'agare maasetaawase naate
'enaresume 'enyaa zanede kamalekaamocu merethoce naacawe
semaa`ileneme, 'aleyasa`eneme, zulekifeleneme 'awesaa hulume kabalaachocu naacawe
yehe malekaame zenaa nawe la'alaahe fariwoceme ba'eregethe webe yakxona mamalashaa 'alaacawe
barocaacawe la'enaresu yatakafatu sikxonu yamanoriyaa ganatoce 'alwacawe
ba'ereswa wesethe yatadagafu kxonawe bawesethwa babezu 'eshatocenaa bamathatheme yaazezaalu
'enaresu zanedeme `aayenocaacawene (babaalocaacawe laaye) 'asaathaariwoce 'ekuyaawoce (seetoce) 'alelu
yehe lameremaraawe qane yameteqatharute tasafaa nawe
yehe sisaayaacene nawe la'eresu meneme maalaqe yalaweme
yehe (la'amaanyoce nawe) lathamaamoceme bathaame yakafaa mamalashaa 'alaacawe
yamigabwate setekxone gahaname ('alacaacawe) menethaafitume menenyaa kafaace
yehe (lakahhaadiwoce nawe) yeqemasuteme yafalaa wehaanaa 'ezhe nawe
leelaame kamasalu `aayenatoce 'alelu
yehe ka'enaaneta gaare bamagaafathe gabi cheferaa nawe; (yebaalaalu) la'enaresu 'ayesefaacawe 'enaresu 'esaatene gabiwoce naacawenaa (yelaalu)
(takataayocu) yelaalu <<yelequne 'enaaneta 'ayesefaacehu 'enaaneta (kehedatune) la'enyaa 'aqarabaacehute maregiyaayetume (gahaname) kafaace >>
<<geetaacene hoye! yehenene yaaqarabalenene sawe ba'esaate wesethe 'ethefene qethaate chamerelate>> yelaalu
yelaalume <<la'enyaa mene 'alane? kamathefowoce 'eneqotheraacawe yanabarutene sawoce ('ezihe) 'anaayemesaa >>
<<maqalajaa 'aderegane yaazenaacawene? wayese `aayenocaacene ka'enasu waalalu?>>
yehe ba'eregethe 'emenate nawe ('eresume) ya'esaate sawoce (ya'erese ba'erese) makaasase nawe
<<'enee 'asefaraari becaa nanye xayaale 'anede kakxonawe 'alaahe baqare meneme 'amelaake yalame>> balaacawe
<<yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe hulu geetaa 'ashanaafiwe mahhaariwe nawe >>
balaacawe <<'eresu (qure'aane) taalaaqe zeenaa nawe
<<'enaaneta ka'eresu zanegiwoce naacehu
(ba'adame nagare) <<bamikaraakaru gizee balaayenyaawe saraawite la'enee meneme `eweqate 'alenabaranyeme
<<wada'eneeme 'asefaraari galaache makxonee 'eneji leelaa 'ayewaradelenyeme>> (bale)
geetaahe <<lamalaa'ekete 'enee sawene kacheqaa fathaari nanye baala gizee>> ('asetaawese)
<<fetheratuneme baasetakaakalekunaa kamanefasee banafaahubate gizee la'eresu sagaajoce kxonaacehu wedaqu>> ('aleku)
malaa'eketeme malaaweme baanedenate sagadu
belise becaa siqare koraa; kakahhaadiwocume nabare
('alaaheme) <<belise hoye! bahulate 'ejocee (baxaayelee) lafatharekute kamasegade mene kalakalahe? ('ahune) koraahene? wayese (fitunu) kate`ebitanyocu nabareke?>> 'alawe
<<'enee ka'eresu balaache nanye ka'esaate fatharekanye; kacheqaame fatharekawe>> 'ala
('alaahe) 'alawe <<ka'ereswa wethaa; 'aneta yatabaarareke nahenaa >>
<<'eregemaaneeme 'eseka feredu qane derase baaneta laaye yekxune >>
<<geetaayee hoye! 'esekamiqasaqasubate qane derase 'aqoyanyeme>> 'ala
('alaaheme) 'alawe <<'aneta kamiqoyute nahe >>
<<'eseka taawaqawe waqete qane derase >>
('eresume) 'ala <<ba'ashanaafinatehe yekxunebenye; bamalaa 'asaasetaacawaalahu >>
<<ka'enaresu merethe yakxonute baarocehe becaa siqaru >>
('alaahe) 'alawe <<'ewenatume (kanee nawe) 'ewenateneme 'elaalahu
ka'anetanaa ka'enaresu wesethe katakataluhe baanede laaye gahanamene ba'eregethe 'emolaataalahu >>
balaacawe <<ba'eresu laaye meneme waagaa 'alethayeqaacehume; 'eneeme katagedaredaariwocu 'ayedalahume
<<'eresu (qure'aane) la`aalamaate magaszachaa 'eneji leelaa 'ayedalame
<<tenebituneme ('ewenate makxonune) kagizee baxwaalaa ba'eregethe taawequtaalaacehu >>
yamatsehhafu mawarade 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe kakxonawe 'alaahe nawe
'enyaa wada 'aneta matsehhafune ba'ewenate (yatamalaa) sikxone 'awaradenawe 'alaaheneme haayemaanotene la'eresu becaa yaatharaahe kxonahe tagazaawe

nequ! fetsume theru yakxonawe haayemaanote ya'alaahe becaa nawe 'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa (thaa`otaatene) radaatoce yayaazute <<wada 'alaahe maaqaarabene 'enediyaaqarebune 'eneje laleelaa 'anegazaacaweme>> (yelaalu) 'alaahe baziyaa 'enaresu ba'eresu bamilayaayubate nagare bamakaakalaacawe yefaredaale 'alaahe 'eresu weshataame kahhaadi yakxonane sawe 'ayaaqanaame
'alaahe lejene mayaaze bafalaga noro kamifatherawe wesethe yamishaawene yemarethe nabare theraate tagabaawe 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe 'anedu 'alaahe nawe

samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewanate fathara leelitene baqane laaye yethaqalelaale qaneneme baleelite laaye yethaqalelaale; tzahhayenenaa charaqaaneme garaa hulume latawasana gizee yerothaalu nequ! 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe mahhaariwe nawe

ka'anedite nafese fatharaacehu kaziyaame ka'ereswa maqanaajowaane 'adaraga la'enaanetame kagemalenaa kakabete, kafeyale, kabage semenete `aayenatocene (wanedenaa seete) 'awarada ba'enaatocaacehu hodoce wesethe baszosete chalamaawoce wesethe kamafethare baxwaalaa (mulu) mafetharene yefatharaacexwaale yehe geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe selethaanu yaresu becaa nawe ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame taadiyaa wadeete tezoraalaacehu

betekedu 'alaahe ka'enaaneta yatabeqaaqaa nawe labaariyaawocume kahedatene 'ayewademe betaamasagenume; 'eresune yewadelaacexwaale maanenyaayetume xaathi'aatene tashakaami nafese yaleelaayetune xaathi'aate 'ateshakameme kaziyaame mamalashaacehu wada geetaacehu nawe teszarute yanabaraacehuteneme yenageraacexwaale 'eresu baleboce wesethe yaalutene `awaaqi nawenaa

saweneme gudaate baaganyawe gizee geetaawene wadaresu tamalaashe kxono yetharaale kaziyaame ka'eresu zanede tsagaane basathawe gizee yaanene kaziyaa bafite wadaresu yetsaleyebate yanabarawene (makaraa) yerasaale kamanegadu lamaasaasaateme la'alaahe baalaanethaawocene yaadaregaale <<bakehedatehe theqitene tathaaqame 'aneta ba'eregethe ka'esaate gwaadoce nahe>> balawe

'eresu yamacharashaayetune `aalame (qethaate) yamifaraa yageetaaweneme cerotaa yamikajele sikxone baleelite sa`aatoce sagaajenaa qwaami kxono lageetaawe yamigegazaa sawe ('eneda tasefaa bisu kahhaadi nawene? balawe) <<'enaziyaa yamiyaawequnaa 'enaziyaa yamaayaawequ yesetakaakalaalune?>> balaacawe yamiganazabute baala 'a'emerowocu becaa naacawe

(geetaacehu) <<'enaaneta yaamanaacehu baarocee hoye! geetaacehune feru lanaziyaa bazihece baqerebitu `aalame malekaame laszarute malekaame menedaa 'alaacawe ya'alaahe medereme safi naate; (betecagaru tasadadu) taagaashocu menedaacawene yamisathute yaalagemete nawe>> (yelaale) balaacawe
bale <<'enee 'alaahene haayemaanotene laresu yaatharaahu kxonyee 'enedegegazaawe taazazeku
<<yamuselimoceme majamariyaa 'enedekxone taazazeku >>
<<'enee kageetaayee baametse yataalaaqune qane qethaate 'efaraalahu>> bale
'alaahene <<haayemaanoteene la'eresu yaatharaahu kxonyee 'egegazaawaalahu>> bale
<<ka'eresu leelaa yashaacehutene tagazu kasaariwoce maalate 'enaziyaa bateneszaa'ee qane nafesocaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene yaakasaru naacawe nequ! yehe 'eresu geletse kasaaraa nawe>> balaacawe

la'enaresu kabalaayaacawe ka'esaate yakxonu (dereberebe) thelaawoce 'alelwacawe kabataacaacaweme thelaawoce 'alelwacawe. yehe 'alaahe baarocune ('enedithanaqaqu) ba'eresu yaasefaraaraabataale <<baarocee hoye! selazihe ferunye >>
'enaziyaame thaa`otaatene yamigegazwate kamakxone yaraaqu wada 'alaaheme yazoru la'enaresu beseraate 'alelaacawe selazihe baaroceene 'abesere
'enaziyaane negegerene yamiyaadaamethutenenaa malekaamune yamikatalutene ('abesere) 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'alaahe yamaraacawe naacawe 'enaziyaame 'enaresu baala'a'emerowocu naacawe
ba'eresu laaye yaqethaate qaale yataragaagathacebatene sawe (temaraawaalahene?) 'aneta ba'esaate wesethe yaalane sawe taadenaalahene?

gene 'enaziyaa geetaacawene yafaru la'enaresu kabalaayaacawe yataanatsu saganatoce yaalwacawe saganatoce kaserocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawe yakxonu 'alelwacawe (yehenene) 'alaahe qaale gabaalaacawe 'alaahe qaalune 'ayaafareseme

'alaahe kasamaaye wehaane 'enedaawaradanaa bamedereme wesethe menechoce 'aderego 'enedaasegabaawe 'alaayahemene? kaziyaame ba'eresu `aayenatocu yatalayaayune 'azemaraa yaawathaale kaziyaame yedareqaale garethetome taayawaalahe kaziyaame seberebere yaadaregawaale bazihe wesethe labaala 'a'emerowoce geszaatsee 'alabate

'alaahe daratune la'eselemenaa yaasefaalatenaa 'eresume kageetaawe zanede baberehaane laaye yakxona sawe (lebu 'eneda daraqa sawe nawene?) lebocaacaweme ka'alaahe mawasaate ladaraqu sawoce wayolaacawe 'enaziyaa bageletse masaasaate wesethe naacawe

'alaahe kazeenaa hulu malekaamene, tamasaasaaye, tadagaagaami yakxonane matsehhafe 'awarada ka'eresu (geszaatsee) ya'enaziyaa geetaacawene yamifarute sawoce qodaawoce yekomaataraalu kaziyaame qodaawocaacawenaa lebocaacawe wada 'alaahe (tasefaa) maasetaawase yelazebaalu yehe ya'alaahe mameriyaa nawe ba'eresu yamishaawene sawe yemaraabataale 'alaaheme yamiyaathamawe sawe la'eresu meneme 'aqenyi yalaweme
bateneszaa'ee qane kefune qethaate bafitu yamimakete sawe (kaqethaate 'enedamidene nawene?) labadaayoceme <<teszarute yanabaraacehutene (qethaatune) qemasu>> yebaalaalu
ka'enasu bafite yanabarute 'asetabaabalu qethaatume kamaayaawequte bakule mathaabaacawe
'alaaheme baqerebitu hheyewate weredatene 'aqamasaacawe yamacharashaayetume `aalame qethaate bathaame teleqe nawe yamiyaawequ bikxonu noro ('ayaasetabaabelume nabare)
baziheme qure'aane wesethe lasawoce yegaszatsu zanede kayamesaaleewe hulu ba'eregethe 'aberaaraane
mazaabaate yaleelabate `arabenyaa qure'aane sikxone ('aberaaraanawe) lithanaqaqu yekajalaalenaa

'alaahe ba'eresu tachaqaachaaqiwoce yakxonu tagaariwoce yaalutene baariyaanaa la'anede sawe becaa netsuhhe yakxonane baariyaa (lamiyaagaaraanaa baanedenatu lamiyaamene sawe) mesaalee 'adaraga bamesaalee yesetakaakalaalune? mesegaanaa la'alaahe yegabaawe ba'ewenatu 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
'aneta mwace nahe; 'enaresume mwacoce naacawe
kaziyaame 'enaaneta bateneszaa'ee qane 'egeetaacehu zanede tekaraakaraalaacehu
ba'alaaheme laaye kawaasha 'ewenatuneme bamathaalate gizee ka'asetabaabala sawe yebalethe badaaye maane nawe? bagahaname wesethe lakahhaadiwoce manoriyaa yalamene? ('ala 'eneje)
yaame ba'ewenate yamathaawe ba'eresu yaamanaweme 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'alaahene firiwoce naacawe
la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede yamishute hulu 'alelaacawe yehe yabago 'aderaagiwoce menedaa nawe
'alaahe yaanene (basehhetate) yaszarutene mathefo szeraa ka'enaresu lisareyelaacawe baziyaame yeszarute banabarute bamalekaamu szeraa menedaacawene limanadaacawe (yehenene 'adaraga)
'alaahe baariyaawene baqi 'ayedalamene? ba'enaziyaa ka'eresu leelaa bakxonuteme (thaa`otaate) yaasefaraaruhaale 'alaahe yamiyaathamaweme sawe laresu meneme 'aqenyi yalaweme
'alaahe yamiyaaqanaaweme sawe la'eresu meneme 'athemaami yalaweme 'alaahe 'ashanaafi yamabaqale baalabeete 'ayedalamene?

samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathara maane 'eneda kxona betethayeqaacawe <<'alaahe nawe>> yeluhaale <<ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazwacawene (thaa`otaate) 'ayaacehune? (negarunye) 'alaahe bagudaate bifaleganye 'enaresu gudaatune galaachoce naacawene? wayese bacerotaawe bifaqedanye 'enaresu cerotaawene 'agaajoce naacawene?>> balaacawe <<'alaahe baqiyee nawe ba'eresu laaye tamakiwoce yemakaalu>> bale
(muhhamade hoye!) balaacawe <<hhezebocee hoye! baalaacehubate kxuneetaa laaye szeru 'enee szari nanyenaa wadafiteme taaweqaalaacehu >>
yaanene yamiyaasaaferawe qethaate yamimathabatenenaa ba'eresu laaye zawetaari qethaate yamisaferebatene (taaweqaalaacehu)

'enyaa matsehhafune baaneta laaye lasawoce (theqeme) ba'ewenate 'awaradenawe yatamaraame sawe lanafesu nawe yathamamame sawe yamithamemawe (gudaatu) ba'ereswa laaye nawe 'anetame (taasegadedaacawe zanede) ba'enaresu laaye thabaaqi 'ayedalaheme

'alaahe nafesocene bamotaacawe gizee yewasedaale yaaceneme yaalemotacewene ba'eneqelefwa gizee (yewasedaataale) taadiyaa yaacene motene yafaradabaatene yeyezaataale leelaayetuneme 'eseka tawasana gizee derase yelaqeqaataale bazihe wesethe lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce meleketoce 'alelubate
yelequneme (qurayeshoce) ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalaajocene yaazu <<'enaresu meneneme yamaayecelunaa yamaayaawequ bikxonume?>> balaacawe
<<melejaa malaaweme ya'alaahe becaa nawe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere szelethaane ya'eresu becaa nawe kaziyaame wada'eresu temalasaalaacehu>> balaacawe

'alaaheme becaawene batawasaa gizee ya'enaziyaa bamacharashaayetu `aalame yamaayaamenute sawoce leboce yeshamaaqaqaalu; (yedanaberaalu) 'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa yakxonute (thaa`otaate) batawasu gizee 'enaresu wadiyaawenu yedasataalu
<<samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathareke ruquneme qerebuneme `awaaqi yakxoneke 'alaahe hoye! 'aneta babaarocehe makaakale ba'eziyaa ba'eresu yelayaayubate banabarute nagare tefaredaalahe>> bale

la'enaziyaame labadalute bamedere yaalawe hulu malaaweme ka'eresu gaare masalume binoraacawe noro bateneszaa'ee qane kaqethaatu kefaate yatanasaa ba'eresu nafesocaacawene batabazhubate nabare la'enaresume ka'alaahe zanede yaasebute yaalenabarute hulu yegalatselaacawaale
la'enaresume yaszaruwaacawe mathefowocu yegalatsulaacawaale ba'enaresume laaye ba'eresu yaalaagethubate yanabarute qethaate yesaferebaacawaale

saweme gudaate baaganyawe gizee yetharaanaale kaziyaame ka'enyaa yakxonawene tsagaa basathanawe gizee <<'eresune yatasathahute; ba`eweqate becaa nawe>> yelaale yelequneme 'ereswa (tsagaayetu) mafatanyaa naate gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
'enaziyaa ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute hhezeboce ba'eregethe belawaataale yeszarute yanabaruteme nagare ka'enaresu 'alethaqamaacaweme
yaszaruwaacaweme mathefowoce (qethaate) 'aganyaacawe ka'enaziheme 'enaziyaa yabadalute yaszaruwaacawe mathefowoce (fedaa) ba'eregethe yenakaacawaale 'enaresume 'amelaachoce 'ayedalume
'alaahe sisaayune lamishaawe sawe yamiyaasafaa yamiyaathabeme makxonune 'ayaawequmene? bazihe wesethe lamiyaamenute hhezeboce geszaatseewoce 'alubate

balaacawe <<'enaaneta banafesocaacehu laaye denebare yaalafaacehu baarocee hoye! ka'alaahe 'ezenate tasefaa 'atequrathu 'alaahe xaathi'aatocene bamalaa yemeraalenaa 'enaho 'eresu mahhaariwe 'azaanyu nawenaa
<<qethaatume wada'enaaneta kamamethaatunaa kaziyaame yamaatereradu kamakxonaacehu bafite wada geetaacehu (bamatsatsate) tamalasu la'eresume taazazu
<<'enaaneta yamaataawequ setekxonume qethaatu badenegate saayemathaabaacehu bafite kageetaacehu wadanaaneta yatawaradawene malekaamune (matsehhafe) takatalu >>
(yakaadace) nafese <<'enee kamisaalaqute yanabareku sekxone ba'alaahe bakule baagwaadalekute waa tsatsatee>> maalatwane (lamaferaate);
wayeme <<'alaahe bamaraanye noro kamithanaqaqute 'ekxone nabare>> maalatwane (lamaferaate)
wayeme qethaatune bametaaye gizee <<la'enee (wada medera `aalame) 'anede gizee mamalase banoranyenaa kabago 'aderaagiwocu bakxoneku>> maalatwane (lamaferaate malekaamune takatalu)
yalame tamaretahaale 'aneqatsocee ba'eregethe mathetawelehaale ba'enaresume 'asetabaabelahaale koretahaaleme kakahhaadiwocume kxonahaale; (yebaalaale)
bateneszaa'ee qaneme 'enaziyaane ba'alaahe laaye yawaashutene fitocaacawe yathaqoru kxonawe taayaacawaalahe bagahaname wesethe late`ebitanyoce manoriyaa yalamene?
'enaziyaaneme yatathanaqaqutene bamaagenyaacawe seferaa kxonawe 'alaahe yaadenaacawaale kefu nagare 'ayenakaacaweme 'enaresume 'ayaazenume
'alaahe yanagaru hulu fathaari nawe 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye 'asetanaabaari nawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere (delebe) makefacaawoce ya'eresu becaa naacawe 'enaziyaame ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yakaadute 'enaziyaa 'enasu kasaariwocu naacawe
<<'enaaneta mahaayemaane hoye! ka'alaahe leelaane 'enedegegazaa taazunyaalaacehune?>> balaacawe
betaagaaraa szeraahe ba'eregethe yetaabasaale ba'eregetheme kakahhaadiwocu tekxonaalahe maalate wada 'anetame wada'enaziyaame kaaneta bafite wadanabarute ba'eregethe tawaredwale
yeleqe 'alaahene becaa tagazaame ka'amasegaanyocume kxune

'alaaheneme bateneszaa'ee qane medere bamalaa chebethu setekxone; samaayaateme baxayelu yamithaqalalu sikxonu (karesu gaare leelaane bamaagaaraataacawe) tagabi keberune 'alaakabaruteme kamiyaagaarute tharaa; laaqame

baqanedume yenenafaale basamaayaate wesethe yaalawe fethurenaa bamedereme wesethe yaalawe fethure hulu 'alaahe yashaawe siqare badenegaathee yemotaale kaziyaame ba'eresu leelaa (manenafaate) yenenafaale wadiyaaweme 'enaresu (yamiszaraabaacawene) yamithabaabaqu kxonawe qwaamiwoce yekxonaalu
medereme bageetaawaa berehaane taabaraalace matsehhafume yeqeqarabaale nabiyaatunaa mesekerocume yemathaalu bamakaakalaacaweme ba'ewenate yefaradaale 'enaresume 'ayebadalume
nafeseme hulu yaszaraacewene szeraa temolaalace; (tesafaraalace) 'eresume yamiszarutene hulu `awaaqi nawe

'enaziyaa yakaaduteme yatakafaafalu cheferoce kxonawe wada gahaname yenenadaalu bamathwateme gizee dajaafocewaa yekafataalu zabanyocewaame <<ka'enaaneta yakxonu maleketanyoce yageetaacehune 'aneqatsoce banaaneta laaye yamiyaanabulaacehu yaziheneme qane maganaanyate yamiyaasethanaqeqwaacehu 'alemathuwaa cehumene?>> yelwacawaale <<yalame mathetawenaale; gene yaqethaatitu qaale bakahhaadiwoce laaye taragaagathace>> yelaalu
<<yagahanamene dajaafoce bawesethwa zawetaariwoce setekxonu gebu yate`ebitanyoceme manoriyaa mene tekafaa!>> yebaalaalu

'enaziyaame geetaacawene yafarute yatakafaafalu cheferoce kxonawe wada ganate yenenadaalu bamathwateme gizee dajaafocewaa yatakafatu sikxonu zabanyocewaame la'enaresu <<salaame banaaneta laaye yekxune tawaabaacehu zawetaariwoce kxonaacehu gebwate>> balwacawe gizee (yegabwataale)
<<mesegaanaa la'alaahe laziyaa tasefaa qaalune lamolaalene yaganatene medere bameneshaawe seferaa yamenesafere senekxone laawarasane yegabaawe>> yelaalume yaszariwoceme menedaa mene yaamere!

malaa'eketeneme bageetaacawe mesegaanaa qalaaqelawe yamiyaatharu sikxonu ba`areshu zuriyaa kabaabiwoce kxonawe taayaalahe bamakaakalaacawe ba'ewenate yefaradaale yebaalaaleme; <<mesegaanaa la'alaahe la`aalamaate geetaa yegabaawe >>
hha.ma (hhaa.mime);
yamatsehhafu mawarade 'ashanaafi `awaaqi kahonawe 'alaahe nawe
xathi'atene mahhaari, tsatsateneme taqabaaye, qethaata beretu, yalegesenaa baalabeete kakxonawe ('alaahe yawarada nawe) ka'eresu baqare 'amelaake yalame mamalashaawe wadaresu becaa nawe
ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce 'enaziyaa yakaadute bikxonu 'eneje maaneme (bamazelafe) 'ayekaraakareme bayaagaroceme wesethe mazawaawaraacawe 'ayeshanegelehe

ka'enaresu bafite yanuhhe hhezeboce kaxwaalaacaweme 'ahhezaabocu 'asetabaabaalu hhezeboceme hulu maleketanyaacawene liyezu 'asabu baweshateme ba'eresu 'ewenatene liyaathafubate takaraakaru yaazekwaacaweme taadiyaa qethaatee 'enedeete nabare?
'enedazihume yageetaahe qaale ba'enaziyaa bakaadute laaye 'enaresu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe maalate taragaagathace

'enaziyaa `areshune yamishakamute 'enaziyaame bazuriyaawe yaalute bageetaacawe mesegaanaa yaawadesaalu ba'eresume yaamenaalu <<geetaacene hoye! nagarune hulu ba'ezenatenaa ba`eweqate kabahaale selazihe la'enaziyaa latatsatsatute manegadeheneme latakatalute mehherate 'aderegelaacawe ya'esaateneme qethaate thabeqaacawe >> 'eyaalu la'enaziyaa laamanute mehheratene yelamenaalu

<<geetaacene hoye! 'enaresuneme, ka'abaatocaacawenaa kamisetocaacaweme, kazereyocaacaweme, yabajawene hulu 'enaziyaane qaale yagabaahelaacawene yamanoriyaa ganatoce 'agebaacawe 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe 'aneta nahenaa
<<kaqethaatoceme thabeqaacawe baziyaa qaneme yametethabeqaawene sawe ba'eregethe 'azanekelate >> yeheme 'eresu taalaaqe maagenyate nawe
'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce <<wada 'emenate bametetharunaa bametekedu gizee 'alaahe ('enaanetane) mathelaatu nafesocaacehune (zaaree) kamathelaataacehu yabalatha nawe>> bamaalate yethetharaalu
<<geetaacene hoye! hulatene mote 'amotekane hulateneme hheyewate hheyaawe 'adaragekane baxaathi'aatocaaceneme masakarene taadiyaa (ka'esaate) wada mawethaate manegade 'alane?>> yelaalu
<<yehe 'enaho 'alaahe becaawene batatharaa gizee sela kaadaacehu ba'eresume tagaari bidarage yametaamenu sela kxonaacehu nawe selazihe feredu kafetanyaa taalaaqe lakxonawe 'alaahe becaa nawe >>
'eresu yaa (la'amelaakenatu) meleketocune yamiyaasaayaacehu la'enaanetame kasamaaye sisaayene yamiyaawaredelaacehu nawe wada'eresume yamimalase sawe bikxone 'eneji leelaawe 'ayegasatseme
'alaaheneme kahhaadiwoce bithalume haayemaanotene la'eresu 'atheriwoce kxonaacehu tagazute
('eresu) darajaawocene kafe 'aderaagi ya`areshu baalabeete nawe yamaganaanyaawene qane yaasefaraaraa zanede kabaarocu bamishaawe sawe laaye kate`ezaazu manefasene (raa'eyene) yaawaredaale

'enaresu (kamaqaabere) bamiwathubate qane ba'alaahe laaye ka'enaresu meneme nagare 'ayedabaqeme <<negeszenaawe zaaree lamaane nawe?>> (yebaalaale;) <<la'ashanaafiwe la'anedu 'alaahe becaa nawe>> (yebaalaale)
<<zaaree nafese hulu baszaraacewe szeraa tememanadaalace zaaree badale yalame 'alaahe ba'eregethe meremaraawe fathaane nawe>> (yebaalaale)
qerebituneme (yateneszaa'eene) qane leboce cheneqatene yatamalu kxonawe laaneqaawoce zanede yamidaresubatene gizee 'asethaneqeqaacawe labadaayoce meneme wadaajenaa tasami 'amaalaaje yalaacaweme
('alaahe) ya`aayenocene kedaate leboceme yamidabequtene hulu yaaweqaale
'alaaheme ba'ewenate yefaredaale 'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa yamigegazwacawe bameneme 'ayefaredume 'alaahe 'eresu samiwe tamalekaacu nawe

ya'enaziyaane ka'enaresu bafite yanabarutene hhezeboce fetsaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara yemalakatu zanede bamedere laaye 'ayekxeedumene? baxayelenaa bamedere laaye batawaacawe meleketoce; ka'enaresu yebalethe yabaratu nabaru 'alaaheme baxathi'atocaacawe yaazaacawe la'enaresume ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneme thabaaqi 'alenabaraacaweme
yehe (mayaaze) 'enaresu maleketanyocaacawe bata`aameraatoce yemathubaacawe selanabarunaa sela kaadu nawe 'alaaheme yaazaacawe 'eresu xayaale qethaata beretu nawenaa
musaaneme bata`aameraatocaacenenaa bageletse maaserajaa ba'eregethe laakenawe
wada fare`onenaa wada haamaane; wada qaaruneme (laakenawe) <<degemetanyaa weshataame nawe>> 'alume

ka'enyaa zanede 'ewenatene yezo bamathaalaacaweme gizee <<ya'enaziyaane ka'eresu gaare yaamanutene sawoce wanedoce lejoce gedalu; seetocaacaweneme 'aseqaru>> 'alu yakahhaadiwoceme tanekole bathefaate wesethe 'eneje 'ayedalame
fare`oneme <<tawunye; musaane legedale geetaaweneme yetheraa yaadenawe 'enedakxona 'enee haayemaanotaacehune lilawethe; wayeme bamedere wesethe thefaatene liyaasaraache 'efaraalahunaa>> 'ala
musaame <<'enee bameremaraawe qane kamaayaamene te`ebitanyaa hulu bageetaayeenaa bageetaacehu tathabaqehu>> 'ala

kafare`oneme beetasaboce 'anede 'emenatune yamidabeqe me'emane sawe 'ala - <<saweyawene kageetaacehu bata`aameraatoce ba'eregethe yamathaalacehu sikxone <geetaayee 'alaahe nawe> selamile tegadelaalaacehune? weshataameme bikxone weshatu baresuwe laaye nawe 'ewenatanyaa bikxone gene yaziyaa yamiyaasafaraaraacehu kafilu yaaganyaacexwaale 'alaahe yaanene 'eresu denebare 'alaafi weshataame yakxonawene 'ayemaraamenaa

<<waganocee hoye! bamedere laaye 'ashanaafiwoce setekxonu zaaree manegesetu ya'enaaneta nawe taadiyaa ka'alaahe qethaate bimathaabene yamiyaadenane maane nawe?>> ('ala) fare`one <<yamaayawene nagare 'eneje; 'alaamalaketaacehume qenuneme manegade 'eneje 'alemaraacehume>> 'alaacawe
yaame yaamanawe sawe 'ala <<'enee banaaneta laaye ya'ahhezaabocune qane bethee 'efaraalaacexwaalahu
<<yanuhhene hhezeboce, ya`aadenenaa yasamudeneme, ya'enaziyaaneme kaxwaalaacawe yanabarutene lemaade bethee ('efaraalaacexwaalahu) 'alaaheme labaarocu mabadalene yamishaa 'ayedalame
<<waganocee hoye! 'enee ba'enaaneta laaye yamatharaariyaane qane 'efaraalahu >>
wada xwaalaa zoraacehu bameteshashubate qane; lanaaneta ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneme thabaaqi yalaacehume 'alaaheme yamiyaathamawe sawe laresu meneme 'aqenyi yalaweme

yusufeme kazihe bafite geletse maaserajaawocene ba'eregethe 'amathaalaacahu kaziyaame 'eresu kaamathaalaacehu nagare kamatharaathare 'aletawagadaacehume bathafaame gizee <<'alaahe ka'eresu xwaalaa maleketanyaane bacheraashe 'ayelekeme>> 'alaacehu 'alaahe 'enedazihu denebare 'alaafi tatharaathaari yakxonane sawe yaasaasetaale

'enaziyaa; yamathaalaacawe 'aseraje saayenore ba'alaahe ta`aameraatoce yamikaraakaru (kerekeraacawe) 'alaahe zanedenaa 'enaziyaame 'amanute zanede mathalaatu bathaame talaqa 'enedazihu 'alaahe bakuru chakaanye (sawe) lebe hulu laaye yaatemaale
fare`oneme 'ala <<haamaane hoye! manegadocene 'edarese zanede razhime hhenetsaane la'enee kaabelenye

<<yasamaayaatene manegadoce ('edarese zanede), wada musaame 'amelaake 'emalakate zanede 'eneeme weshataame nawe beyee ba'eregethe 'etharatherawaalahu>> ('ala) 'enedazihume lafare`one mathefo szeraawe tashalamalate kaqene manegademe taagada yafare`oneme tanekole bakasaaraa wesethe 'eneje 'ayedalame
yaame yaamanawe 'ala <<waganocee hoye! takatalunye qathetaawene manegade 'emaraacexwaalahunaa
<<waganocee hoye! yeheci qerebitu hheyewate (theqite) mathaaqamiyaa becaa naate macharashaayetume `aalame 'ereswa maregiyaa 'agare naate >>

<<mathefone yaszaraa sawe betheewaane 'eneje 'ayememanadaame 'eresu me'emane kxono kawanede wayeme kaseete bagone yaszaraame sawe 'enaziyaa ganatene yegabaalu ba'ereswa wesethe yaala quthethere yemagabaalu
<<waganoceeme hoye! wada madaane yametharaacehu sekxone wada 'esaateme yametetharunye setekxonu lanee mene 'alanye!
<<ba'alaahe lekedenaa ba'eresume la'enee `eweqate yaleelanyene nagare ba'eresu 'enedaagaaraa tetharunyaalaacehu 'eneeme wada 'ashanaafiwe; mahhaariwe ('alaahe) 'etharaacexwaalahu

<<ba'eregethe wada'eresu yametetharubenye (thaa`ote) la'eresu baqerebitume kxona bamacharashaayetu `aalame (tasami) theri yalaweme mamalashaaceneme ba'eregethe wada 'alaahe nawe wasane 'alaafiwocume 'enasu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe
<<wada fiteme la'enaaneta yamelaacehune mekere (qethaatene bametaayu gizee) taasetaawesaalaacehu nagareeneme hulu wada 'alaahe 'asethagaalahu 'alaahe baarocune tamalekaace nawenaa >>
kamakaruwaacaweme mathefowoce 'alaahe thabaqawe bafare`one beetasaboceme laaye kefu qethaate safarabaacawe
'esaate bathwatenaa bamaataa ba'ereswa laaye yeqarebaalu sa`aatitume bametekxonebate qane <<yafare`onene beetasaboce beretune qethaate (gahanamene) 'agebuwaacawe>> (yebaalaale)

ba'esaateme wesethe yamikaraakarubatene gizee ('asetaawese) dakaamaawocume la'enaziyaa lakorute <<'enyaa la'enaaneta takataayoce nabarenenaa 'enaaneta ('ahune) ka'esaate kafilune ka'enyaa laaye gafetaariwoce naacehune?>> yelaalu
'enaziyaame yakorute <<'enyaa hulaaceneme bawesethwa nane 'alaahe babaarocu makaakale ba'eregethe farada>> yelaalu
'enaziyaame ba'esaate wesathe yaalute lagahaname zabanyoce <<geetaacehune lamenulene; ka'enyaa laaye kaqethaatu 'anedene qane yaaqaalelene>> yelaalu

(zabanyocume) <<male'eketanyocaacehu bata`aameraatoce yemathulaacehu 'alenabarumene?>> yelaalu (kahhaadiwocume) <<'enedeetaa mathetawenaale 'eneje; (gene 'asetabaabalenaacawe)>> yelaalu <<'enegediyaawese tsaleyu yakahhaadiwoceme tsalote bakanetu 'eneje 'ayedalame>> yelwacawaale
'enyaa maleketanyocaacenene, 'enaziyaaneme yaamanutene baqerebitu hheyewate mesekeroceme bamiqomubate qane ba'eregethe 'eneradaalane
badalanyocene mekeneyaataacawe bamaayethaqemaacawe qane ('eneradaalane) la'enaresume regemaane 'alelaacawe la'enaresume mathefo 'agare 'alelaacawe
musaaneme mameriyaane ba'eregethe sathanawe ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce matsehhafune 'awarasenaacawe
labaala 'a'emerowoce marinaa gasaache sikxone
(muhhamade hoye!) taagaseme ya'alaahe tasefaa 'ewenate nawenaa lasehetateheme mehheratene lamene kaqatere baxwaalaame bamaaladaame geetaahane kamaamasegane gaare 'atheraawe

'enaziyaa yamathaalaacawe 'aseraje saayenore ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yamikaraakaru balebocaacawe wesethe 'enaresu daraashocu yaalekxonute kuraate becaa 'eneje meneme yalame ba'alaaheme tathabaqe 'enaho 'eresu samiwe tamalekaacu nawenaa
samaayaatenenaa mederene mafethare sawocene kamafethare yeleqe taalaaqe nawe gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme
`ewerenaa yamiyaaye 'enaziyaame 'amenawe malekaamocene yaszarunaa mathefo szariwe 'ayesetakaakalume bathaame theqitene becaa tegasatsaalaacehu
sa`aatitu ba'eregethe machi naate ba'ereswa therethere yalame gene 'abezaanyocu sawoce 'ayaamenume
geetaacehume 'ala <<lamenunye; 'eqabalaacexwaalahunaa 'enaziyaa 'eneene kamagegazaate yamikorute tawaaraajoce kxonawe gahanamene ba'eregethe yegabaalu

'alaahe yaa la'enaaneta leelitene bawesethu letaarefubate (chalamaa) qaneneme (leteszarubate) yamiyaasaaye yaadaragalaacehu nawe 'alaahe basawoce laaye ba'eregethe yacerotaa baalabeete nawenaa gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaamasagenume
yehaacehu geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe; yanagaru hulu fathaari nawe; karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalame; taadiyaa (ka'emenate) wadeete temalasaalaacehu
'enedazihu 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yekedu yanabarute (ka'emenate) yemalasaalu

'alaahe yaa mederene maregiyaa samaayeneme thaariyaa yaadaragalaacehu nawe yaqaratsaacexume qeretsaacehuneme yaasaamara kathaafaachoceme sisaayoce yasathaacehu nawe yehaacehu geetaacehu 'alaahe nawe ya`aalamaateme geetaa 'alaahe laaqa

'eresu becaa (hule gizee) hheyaawe nawe; karesu leelaa 'amelaake yalame; haayemaanoteneme la'eresu yaatharaacehu setekxonu <<mesegaanaa la`aalamaate geetaa la'alaahe yekxune>> yametelu kxonaacehu tagazute
<<'enee kageetaayee 'aserajiwoce bamathulenye gizee 'enaziyaane ka'alaahe leelaa yametegazuwaacawene 'enedaalegazaa takalekeyaalahu la`aalamaate geetaame 'enedegazaa taazezhaalahu>> balaacawe

'eresu yaa ka`afare kaziyaame kafetewate thabetaa kaziyaame karagaa dame yafatharaacehu nawe kaziyaame hhetsaanaate 'aderego yaawathaacexwaale kaziyaame thenekaareeyaacehune tedaresu zanede; kaziyaame shemaageleewoce tekxonu zanede (yaaqoyaacexwaale) ka'enaanetame wesethe kazihe bafite yamimote 'alela (yeheneneme yaadaragawe letenorunaa) yatawasana gizeeneme letedaresu taawequme zanede nawe
