'eresu yaa hheyaawe yamiyaadarege yamigadeleme nawe 'anedaacene nagare bashaame gizee la'eresu yamilawene <<kxune>> nawe; wadiyaaweme yekxonaale
wada'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce wadamikaraakarute (ka'emenate) 'enedeete 'enedamimalasu 'ataayemene?
wada'enaziyaa bamatsehhafu baziyaame maleketanyocaacenene ba'eresu balaakenebate wadaasetabaabalute ('ataayemene?) wadafiteme yaaweqaalu
'enezaazelaawocunaa sanesalatocu ba'anegatocaacawe laaye batadaragu gizee (ba'ereswa) yegotataalu
bagahaname wesethe (yegotataalu); kaziyaame ba'esaate wesethe yemaagadaalu
kaziyaame la'enaresu yebaalaalu (ba'alaahe) <<taagaarwacawe yanabaraacehute yataalu?>>
<<ka'alaahe leelaa (yametaagaaruwaacawe); kanyaa tasawarune?>> <<kato kazihe bafite meneneme yamenegazaa 'alenabareneme>> yelaalu; 'enedazihu 'alaahe kahhaadiwocene yaasaasetaale
yehe (qethaate) yaalaagebaabe bamedere wesathe tedasatu banabaraacehutenaa tenebathaararu banabaraacehute nawe (yebaalaalu)
yagahanamene baroce bawesethwa zawetaariwoce setekxonu gebu (yebaalaalu) yate`ebitanyoceme manoriyaa (gahaname) mene tekafaa!
taagaseme ya'alaahe qatharo 'ewenate nawenaa yaziyaaneme yamenaasefaraaraacawene kafilune (bahheyewatehe) benaasaayehe (malekaame nawe) wayeme benegadelehe wadanyaa yemalasaalu

kaaneta bafiteme maleketanyocene ba'eregethe lekanaale ka'enaresu baaneta laaye yatarakenelehe 'alela ka'enaresume baaneta laaye yaaletarakenawe 'alela lamaanenyaaweme maleketanyaa ba'alaahe faqaade kaalekxona ta`aamerene liyaamathaa 'ayegabaaweme ya'alaaheme te'ezaaze bamathaa gizee ba'ewenate yefaradaale 'eziyaa zanedeme 'athefiwocu yekaseraalu
'alaahe yaa la'enaaneta gemalene kabetenenaa feyalene ka'ereswa (kafilwane) letegaalebu yafatharalaacehu nawe ka'ereswame tebalaalaacehu

la'enaanetame ba'ereswa wesethe theqemoce 'alelwacehu ba'ereswame laaye ('eqaane bamachaane) balebocaacehu yaasabaacehutene gudaaye tedaresu zanede (fatharalaacehu) ba'ereswame laaye bamarekaboceme laaye tesaafaraalaacehu
ta`aameraatuneme yaasaayaacexwaale taadiyaa ka'alaahe ta`aameraate yatenyaawene tekedaalaacehu?

ya'enaziyaane ka'enaresu bafite yanabarutene hhezeboce fetsaamee 'enedeete 'enedanabara yemalakatu zanede bamedere laaye 'ayekxeedumene? ka'enaresu yebalethe bezuwoce baxayelenaa bamedere laaye batawaacawe meleketoceme bathaame beretuwoce nabaru yaame yeszarute yanabarute ka'enaresu meneme 'alethaqamaacaweme
maleketanyocaacaweme ta`aameraatocene baamathulaacawe gizee 'enaresu zanede baalawe `eweqate tadasatu ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabarute qethaateme ba'enaresu laaye safarabaacawe
beretu qethaataaceneneme baayu gizee <<ba'alaahe 'anede sikxone 'amenanaale; ba'eresume 'enaagaaraa banabarenawe (thaa`otaate) kedanaale>> 'alu
beretu qethaataacenene baayu gizee maamanaacaweme yamithaqemaacawe 'alenabarame ya'alaahene danebe yaacene babaarocu wesethe yaalafacewene (tathaneqaqu) baziyaa gizeeme kahhaadiwoce kasaru
hha.ma.(hhaa mime)
(yehe qure'aane) 'ejege bathaame ruxeruhe bathaame 'azaanye kahonawe ('alaahe) yatawarada nawe
'aneqatsocu yataberaaru yakxona matsehhafe nawe `arabenyaa qure'aane sikxone lamiyaawequ hhezeboce (yataberaaraa) nawe
'abesaarinaa 'asefaraari sikxone (tawarada) 'abezaanyaawocaacaweme tawute 'enaresume 'ayesamume

'alume <<lebocaacene ka'eziyaa wada'eresu kametetharaane 'emenate bamashafanyaawoce wesethe naacawe bajorowocaaceneme laaye denequrenaa 'alela; ba'enyaanaa baanetame makaakale geredoshe 'alela (bahaayemaanotehe) szeseraame; 'enyaa szariwoce nanenaa >>

('enedihe) balaacawe <<'enee masalaacehu sawe becaa nanye 'amelaakaacehu 'anede 'amelaake becaa nawe wada'eresume qathe balu mehherateneme lamenute maalate wada'enee yewaradelenyaale la'agaariwocume wayolaacawe
la'enaziyaa zakaane lamaayesathute 'enaresume bamacharashaayetu `aalame 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce lakxonute (wayolaacawe)
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa bago szeraawocene yaszarute la'enaresu yamaayeqorathe menedaa 'alelaacawe

balaacawe <<'enaaneta baziyaa mederene bahulate qanoce wesethe bafatharawe 'amelaake ba'eregethe tekedaalaacehune? la'eresume baalanethaawocene taadaregaalaacehune? yaa (yehenene yaszaraawe) ya`aalamaate geetaa nawe

ba'ereswame kabalaayewaa yaragu gaaraawocene 'adaraga ba'ereswame barakatene 'adaraga bawesethwame megebocewaane (kaalafute hulate qanoce gaare) ba'araate qanaate wesathe lathayaaqiwoce tekekele sikxonu wasana
kaziyaame wada samaaye 'ereswa chese kxonaa saalace 'asaba la'ereswame lamedereme <<wadaacehume kxona wayeme thaletaacehu nu>> 'alaacawe <<taazaazhoce kxonane mathaane>> 'alu

bahulate qanoceme wesethe sabaate samaayaate 'adaragaacawe basamaayetume hulu nagarwane 'azagaaja qerebituneme samaaye bamaberaatoce 'ageethene (kasayethaanaate) mathabaqeneme thabaqenaate yehe ya'ashanaafiwe ya`awaaqiwe (geetaa) wesaanee nawe
(ka'emenate) 'enebi <<bilume 'eneda `aadenaa samude maqesafete bethee yakxonane maqesafete 'asethanaqeqaacexwaalahu>> balaacawe

maleketanyocu 'alaahene 'eneje leelaane 'ategegazu bamaalate kasetafitaacaweme kasetaxwaalacaweme bamathubaacawe gizee <<geetaacene bashaa noro malaa'eketene baawarada nabare selazihe 'enyaa baziyaa ba'eresu batalaakaacehubate kahhaadiwoce nane>> 'alu

`aademe bamedere laaye yaala 'agebaabe koru <<ka'enyaa yebalethe baxayele beretu maane nawe?>> 'alume yaa yafatharaacawe 'alaahe 'eresu baxayele ka'enaresu yebalethe yabarataa makxonune 'ayaayumene? bata`aameraataaceneme yekedu nabaru

baqerebitu hheyewate yaweredatene qethaate lenaaqamesaacaweme ba'enaresu laaye yamineshaashaane beretu nafaase manaathiwoce bakxonu qanaate wesethe laakenebaacawe yamacharashaayetume (`aalame) seqaaye bathaame 'awaaraaje nawe 'enaresume 'ayeradume
samudocemaa maraanaacawe `ewerenateneme baqenenate laaye marathu yeszaruteme banabarute xaathi'aate 'asaanaashe yakxonacewe yamaberaqe qethaate yaazacaacawe
'enaziyaaneme yaamanutenenaa yethanaqaqu yanabarutene 'adaanenaacawe
ya'alaaheme thalaatoce wada 'esaate yamisabasabubatene qane ('asetaawese) 'enaresume yamikamakamu kxonawe yenadaalu
bamathwateme gizee jorowocaacawe, `aayenocaacawenaa qodaawocaacaweme yeszarute banabarute nagare ba'enaresu laaye yemasakerubaacawaale

laqodaawocaacaweme <<ba'enyaa laaye lamene masakaraacehubene?>> yelaalu <<yaa 'anedaacune nagare hulu yaanaagarawe 'alaahe 'anaagarane 'eresume bamajamariyaa gizee fatharaacehu wada'eresume temalasaalaacehu>> yelwacawaale
jorowocaacehu `aayenocaacehunaa qodaawocaacehume ba'enaaneta laaye kamamasekaraacawe yametedabaqu 'alenabaraacehume gene 'alaahe kameteszarute bezuwene 'ayaaweqeme belaacehu tharatharaacehu
yeheme yaa bageetaacehu yatharatharaacehute therethaariyaacehu 'athafaacehu kakasaariwocume kxonaacehu (yebaalaalu)
bitaagasume 'esaate la'enaresu manoriyaacawe naate wadamiwadute mamalaseneme bithayequ 'enaresu taqabaaye yamiyaaganyu 'ayedalume

la'enaresume quraanyaawocene 'azagaajanelaacawe bafitaacawe yaalawenenaa baxwaalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu la'enaresu shalamulaacawe kagaaneenenaa kasaweme ka'enaresu bafite ba'eregethe kaalafute hhezeboce gaare kxonawe qaalu ba'enaresu laaye taragaagathabaacawe 'enaresu ba'eregethe kasaariwoce nabarunaa
'enaziyaame yakaadute <<yehenene qure'aane 'ataadaamethu taashanefume zanede (sinababe) ba'eresu wesathe tanechaachu>> 'alu
'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene beretune qethaate 'enaaqamesaacawaalane ya'eziyaaname yeszarute yanabarutene mathefowene (fedaa) ba'eregethe 'enemanadaacawaalane
yehe ya'alaahe thalaatoce fedaa nawe 'esaate bawesethwa la'enaresu yazalaalame manoriyaa 'agare 'alelaacawe ka'aneqatsocaacene yekedu banabarute menedaane (yememanadaalu)

'enaziyaame yakaadute (ba'esaate wesethe kxonawe) <<geetaacene hoye! 'enaziyaane kagaaneenenaa kasawe yaasaasaatunene 'asaayane kataacenyocu yekxonu zanede kachaamaawocaacene szere 'enaadaregaacawaalanenaa>> yelaalu

'enaziyaa <<geetaacene 'alaahe nawe>> yaalu kaziyaame qathe yaalu <<'ateferu; 'atezanume; baziyaaceme tasefaa qaale tedaragelaacehu banabaraacehute ganate tabasaru>> bamaalate banasu laaye malaa'ekete yewaredaalu

<<'enyaa baqerebitume hheyewate bamacharashaayetume radaatocaacehu nane! la'enaanetame ba'ereswa wesethe nafesocaacehu yamishute hulu 'alelaacehu la'enaanetame ba'ereswa wesethe yametefalegute hulu 'alelaacehu
<<mahhaari 'azaanye kakxonawe 'alaahe masetanegedo sikxone>> (yebaalaalu)
wada 'alaahe katharaanaa malekaameneme kaszaraa, <<'enee kamuselimoce nanye>> kaalame sawe yebalethe qaalu yaamaara maane nawe?

malekaamitunaa kefuyetume (tsabaaye) 'ayetakaakalume baziyaace 'ereswa malekaame bakxonacewe tsabaaye (mathefoyetune) gafetere yaane gizee yaa baanetanaa ba'eresu makaakale thabe yaalawe sawe 'eresu leke 'eneda 'azaanye zamade yekxonaale
(yeheceneme thabaaye) 'enaziyaa yataagasute 'eneje leelaawe 'ayaaganyaateme yateleqeme `edele baalabeete 'eneje maaneme 'ayegathamaateme
kasayethaaneme gutegotaa biyaaganyehe (kamalekaame thabaayeme bimalesehe) ba'alaahe tathabaqe 'enaho 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa

leelitenaa qaneme tzahhayenaa charaqaame kameleketocu naacawe latzahhayenaa lacharaqaa 'atesegadu la'eziyaame lafatharaacawe 'alaahe segadu 'eresune becaa yametegegazu 'eneda kxonaacehu (laleelaa 'atesegadu)
bikorume 'enaziyaa bageetaahe zanede yaalute (malaa'ekete) baqaneme baleeliteme la'eresu yaawadesaalu 'enaresume 'ayesalacume

'aneta mederene daraqe kxonaa maayateheme kameleketocu nawe ba'ereswame laaye wehaane baawaradene gizee (babuqaayaawocewaa) telaawasaalace tenafaalaceme yaa hheyaawe yaadaragaate geetaa ba'eregethe mutaanene hheyaawe 'aderaagi nawe 'enaresu banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa

'enaziyaa 'aneqatsocaacenene yamiyaathaamemu ba'enyaa laaye 'ayedabaqume (yamiyaathaamemenaa) ba'esaate wesethe yamithaalawe sawe yebalethaalene? wayese bateneszaa'ee qane tsathetanyaa kxono yamimathaawe sawe? yashaacehutene szeru (waagaacehune taaganyaalaacehu) 'eresu yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawenaa
'enaziyaa baqure'aane 'eresu 'ashanaafi matsehhafe sikxone bamathaalaacawe gizee yakaadute (thafiwoce naacawe)
kaxwaalaaweme kafitume weshate 'ayemathaabateme thebabanyaa mesegune kakxonawe geetaa yatawarada we
kaaneta bafite lanabarute maleketanyoce yatabaalawe bethee 'eneje la'aneta leelaa 'ayebaaleme geetaahe yameherate baalabeetenaa ya'asaamaami qethaate baalabeete nawe

ba'ajamenyaa yakxona qure'aane baadaragenawe noro 'aneqatsocu <<(bamenaaweqawe qwaaneqwaa) 'ayeberaarume norwalene? (qure'aanu) 'ajamenyaanaa (maleketanyaawe) `arabaawi yekxonaalene?>> baalu nabare 'eresu la'enaziyaa la'amanute mameriyaanaa mafawashaa nawe 'enaziyaame yamaayaamenute bajorowocaacawe wesethe denequrenaa nawe ('ayesamuteme) 'enaresume ba'enaresu laaye 'ewerenate nawe 'enaziyaa karuqe seferaa 'enedamithetharu naacawe

musaaneme matsehhafune ba'eregethe sathanawe ba'eresume talayaayubate kageetaaheme yaalaface qaale baalenabarace noro bamakaakalaacawe batafarada nabare 'enaresume ka'eresu 'awalaawaaye bakxona therethaaree wesethe naacawe
malekaame yaszaraa sawe lanafesu nawe yaathafaame sawe ba'ereswa laaye nawe geetaaheme labaarocu badaaye 'ayedalame

gizeeyetune maawaqe wada'eresu yemalasaale kafereewoceme kashefaanocaacawe 'ayewathume kaseeteme 'anediteme 'ataaragezeme, 'atewaledememe ba`eweqatu bikxone 'eneje <<tagaariwocee yate naacawe?>> bamaalate bamitharaacawe qaneme <<ka'enyaa wesethe (baalaanethaa 'alela belo) meneme masekaari 'alamanorune 'asetaawaqenehe>> yelaalu
yaame bafite yegegazute yanabarute (thaa`ote) ka'enaresu yethafaacawaale la'enaresume meneme mashashaa yaleelaacawe makxonune yaaragaagethaalu
sawe bago nagarene kamalamane 'ayesalaceme kefume biyaaganyawe wadiyaawenu bathaame tasefaa qoraache tabasaache yekxonaale

kaaganyaceweme makaraa baxwaalaa ka'enyaa yakxonane 'ezenate benaaqamesawe <<yehe la'enee (baszeraayee yatagabaanye) nawe sa`aatitume machi naate beyee 'alaasebeme wada geetaayame bemalase la'enee 'eresu zanede malekaamitu (ganate) ba'eregethe 'alacenye>> yelaale 'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene szeraawocaacawene ba'eregethe 'enenageraacawaalane kaberetuweme seqaaye ba'eregethe 'enaaqamesaacawaalane
basaweme laaye tsagaacenene balagasene gizee (kamaamasegane) yezoraale bagonume yereqaale makaraame baaganyawe gizee yabezu lemanaa baalabeete yekxonaale
balaacawe <<negarunye (qure'aanu) ka'alaahe zanede bikxone kaziyaame ba'eresu betekedu (kawenate) baraaqa cheqecheqe laaye kakxona sawe yebalethe yatasaasaata maane nawe?>>

'eresume (qure'aane) 'ewenate makxonu la'enaresu 'esekamigalatzelaacawe derase ba'atsenaafocu wesethenaa banafesocaacaweme wesethe yaalutene ta`aameraatocaacenene ba'eregethe 'enaasaayaacawaalane geetaaheme 'eresu banagaru hulu laaye `awaaqi makxonu 'ayebaqaacawemene?
nequ! 'enaresu kageetaacawe maganaanyate bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe nequ! 'eresu banagaru hulu (`eweqatu) kabaabi nawe
hha.ma (hha mime)
`a.sa.qa (`aayene sine qaafe);
'enedazihu (bazihece suraa wesethe 'enedaalawe) 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe 'alaahe wadaaneta yaawaredaale wada'enaziyaame ka'aneta bafite wada nabarute hhezeboce ('aweredwale)
basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'eresu nawe 'eresume yabalaayu taalaaqu nawe

(ka'alaahe feraacaa) samaayaate kabalaayaacawe liqadadu yeqarebaalu malaa'eketeme geetaacawene 'eyaamasaganu yaawadesaalu bamedereme laalawe fethure mehheratene yelamenaalu nequ! 'alaahe 'eresu mahhaariwe 'azaanyu nawe
'enaziyaame ka'eresu leelaa (yathaa`otaate) radaatocene yayaazu; 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye tathabaabaaqi nawe 'anetame ba'enaresu laaye xalaafi 'ayedalaheme

'enedazihume yakatamoce 'enaate yakxonacewene (yamakaane sawoce) ba'akaabaabiwaa yaaluteneme letaasefaraaraa yamasabesabiyaaweneme qane ba'eresu therethaaree yaleelabate sikxone letaasethanaqeqe `arabenyaa yakxonane qure'aane wada 'aneta 'awaradene (ka'enaresume) kafilu baganate wesathe kafilume ba'esaate wesethe nawe

'alaaheme bashaa noro (baanede haayemaanote laaye) 'anede hhezebe baadaragaacawe nabare gene yamishaawene sawe ba'ezenatu wesethe yaasegabaale badaayoceme la'enaresu wadaajenaa radaate meneme yalaacaweme
ka'eresu leelaa radaatocene yaazune? (radaatoce 'ayedalume) 'alaaheme radaate 'eresu becaa nawe 'eresume mutaanene hheyaawe yaadaregaale 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
kameneme nagare yaa ba'eresu yatalayaayubate feredu wada 'alaahe nawe <<'eresu 'alaahe geetaayee nawe ba'eresu laaye tathagaahu, wadaresume 'emalasaalahu>> (balaacawe)

samaayaatenenaa mederene fathaari nawe kanafesocaacehu seetocene kabeete 'enesesaawoceme `aayenatocene (wanedocenaa seetocene) la'enaaneta 'adaragalaacehu ba'eresu yaabazaacexwaale yamimaselawe meneme nagare yalame 'eresume samiwe tamalekaacu nawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere (deleboce) makafacaawoce ya'eresu naacawe sisaayene lamishaawe sawe yaasafaale; yaathabaaleme 'eresu nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawenaa

la'enaaneta kahaayemaanote yaanene ba'eresu nuhhene yaazazabatene danagagalaacehu yaaneneme wadaaneta yaawaradenawene yaaneneme ba'eresu beraahimene musaanenaa `isaaneme yaazazenebatene haayemaanotene batekekele 'aqwaaqumu ba'eresume 'atelayaayu maalatene (danagagene) ba'agaariwocu laaye yaa wadaresu yametetharaacawe nagare kabadaacawe 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe wada'eresu ('emenate) yemarethaale yamimalaseneme sawe wadaresu yemaraale

(yahaayemaanote sawoce) `eweqatume kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa bamakaakalaacawe lameqanyenate 'eneje laleelaa 'aletalayaayume 'eseka tawasaname gizee (bamaaqoyate) kageetaahe yaalaface qaale baalenabarace noro ba'enaresu makaakale ('ahune) batafarada nabare 'enaziyaame kaxwaalaacawe matsehhafune 'enediwaresu yatadaragute ka'eresu ba'eregethe ba'awalaawaaye therethaaree wesethe naacawe

laziheme (denegaagee sawocene) theraa 'enedataazazekaweme qathe bale zenebaaleewocaacaweneme 'atekatale <<balaacaweme kamatsehhafe 'alaahe baawaradawe hulu 'amaneku bamakaakalaacehume laasetakaakele taazazeku 'alaahe geetaacene geetaacehume nawe la'enyaa szeraawocaacene 'alelune la'enaanetame szeraawocaacehu 'alelwacehu ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale kerekere yalame 'alaahe bamakaakalaacene yesabasebaale mamalashaame wada'eresu becaa nawe >>

'enaziyaame ba'alaahe (haayemaanote) la'eresu taqabaaye kaaganya baxwaalaa yamikaraakarute maaserajaacawe bageetaacawe zanede beleshu naate ba'enaresume laaye quthaa 'alelabaacawe la'enaresume beretu qethaate 'alelaacawe
'alaahe yaa matsehhafune ba'ewenate yaawarada nawe mizaaneneme ('enedazihu) sa`aatitu mene'alebaate qerebe makxonewaane mene yaasaaweqehaale?

'enaziyaa ba'ereswa yamaayaamenute ba'ereswa yaacaakulaalu 'enaziyaame yaamanute ka'ereswa fariwoce naacawe 'ereswame 'ewenate makxonewaane yaaweqaalu nequ! 'enaziyaa basa`aatitu yamikaraakarute ba'eregethe (ka'ewenate) baraaqa sehhetate wesethe naacawe
'alaahe babaarocu ruheruhe nawe lamishaawe sawe (basafiwe) sisaayene yesathaale 'eresume beretuwe 'ashanaafiwe nawe

(baszeraawe) yaxwaalanyaayetune `aalame 'azemaraa yamifalege yakxona sawe la'eresu ba'azemaraawe laaye 'enechamerelataalane yaqerebituneme `aalame 'azemaraa yamifalege yakxona sawe ka'ereswa (yatawasanalatene becaa) 'enesathawaalane la'eresume baxwaalanyaayetu `aalame meneme faanetaa yalaweme

kahaayemaanote 'alaahe ba'eresu yaalefaqadawene la'enaresu yadanagagu tagaariwoce la'enaresu 'alelwacawene? yaferedu qaale baalenabara noro bamakaakalaacawe ('ahune) batafarada nabare badalanyoceme la'enaresu 'asaamaami qethaate ba'eregethe 'alelaacawe

badalanyocene kaszarute szeraa (waagaa bateneszaa'ee qane) fariwoce kxonawe taayaacawaalahe 'eresume ba'enaresu laaye wadaaqi nawe 'enaziyaame yaamanute malekaamoceneme yaszarute baganatoce chafeewoce wesethe naacawe la'enaresu bageetaacawe zanede yamishute hulu 'alelaacawe yehe 'eresu taalaaqe cerotaa nawe

yehe (taalaaqe cerotaa) yaa 'alaahe 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene baarocune yamiyaabaserebate nawe <<ba'eresu (maleketeene bamaaderasee) laaye bazemedenaa wedeetaane 'eneje waagaane 'alethayeqaacehume>> balaacawe malekaamituneme szeraa yamiszaraa sawe la'eresu ba'ereswa malekaamene nagare 'enechamerelataalane 'alaahe mahhaari 'amasegaanye nawenaa

yelequneme <<ba'alaahe laaye weshatene qathafa>> yelaalune? 'alaaheme bishaa balebehe laaye yaatemaale 'alaaheme weshatune yaabebesaale 'ewenatuneme baqaalaatu yaaragaagethaale 'eresu baleboce wesethe yaalane hulu `awaaqi nawenaa
'eresume yaa kabaarocu nesehhaane yamiqabale, kaxaathi'atoceme yeqere yamile, yameteszaruteneme hulu yamiyaaweqe nawe
'enaziyaaneme yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene lemanaacawene yeqabalaale kacerotaaweme yechamerelaacawaale kahhaadiwocume la'enaresu beretu qethaate 'alelaacawe
'alaaheme labaarocu (hulu) sisaayene bazaragaa noro bamedere wesethe (hulume) wasane baalafu nabare gene yamishaawene baleke yaawaredaale 'eresu babaarocu wesethe `awaaqi tamalekaace nawenaa
'eresume yaa tasefaa kaqorathu baxwaalaa zenaamene yamiyaawarede cerotaaweneme yamizaragaa nawe 'eresume radaatu mesegunu nawe
samaayaatenenaa medereneme mafetharu, kataneqasaaqaasheme bahulatu wesethe yabatanawene (mafetharu) ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu nawe 'eresume bamishaa gizee 'enaresune bamasabesabe laaye caaye nawe
kamakaraame maanenyaaweme yaaganyaacehu nagare 'ejocaacehu baszarute (xaathi'aate) mekeneyaate nawe kabezuweme yeqere yelaale
'enaanetame bamedere wesethe yametaaqetu 'ayedalaacehume la'enaanetame ka'alaahe leelaa kazamademe karadaateme meneme yalaacehume
babaahhere laaye 'eneda gaaraawoce kxonawe taneshaalaayocume (marekaboce) ka'asedanaaqi meleketocu naacawe
bishaa nafaasune yaragaa yaadaregawaale babaahherume jarebaa laaye ragiwoce yekxonaalu bazihe wesathe bathaame taagaashenaa 'amasegaanye lakxona hulu ba'eregethe meleketoce 'alelu
wayeme baszarute xaathi'aate mekeneyaate (bamaasethame) yaathafaacawaale kabezume yeqeretaa yaadaregaale
(ka'enaresu lamabaqale); 'enaziyaaneme ba'aneqatsocaacene yamikaraakarutene lamaawaqe (yaathafaacawaale) la'enaresu meneme mashashaa yalaacaweme
kameneme nagare yatasathaacehute yaqerebitu hheyewate mathaqamiyaa nawe 'alaahe zanede yaalaweme menedaa la'enaziyaa la'amanutenaa bageetaacawe laaye lamithagute balaachenaa hule gizee nawaari nawe
la'enaziyaame yaxathi'aatene taalaalaaqocenaa thayaafocene yamirequ bataqothume gizee 'enasu yamimerute lakxonute
la'enaziyaame yageetaacawene theri lataqabalute, solaateneme laazawatarute, nagaraacaweme bamakaakalaacawe mamakaakare lakxonawe kasathanaacaweme sisaaye lamilagesute
la'enaziyaame badale badarasabaacawe gizee 'enaresu (bamasalu) yamimalesu lakxonute (balaachenaa nwari nawe)
yamathefome nagara waagaa betheewaa mathefo naate yeqereme yaalanaa yaasaamara sawe menedaawe ba'alaahe laaye nawe 'eresu badalanyocene 'ayewademe
katabadalume baxwaalaa (bamasalu) yatabaqalu 'enaziyaa banaresu laaye meneme (yawaqasaa) manegade yalabaacaweme
(yawaqasaa) manegadu ba'enaziyaa sawocene bamibadelute, bamedereme wesethe yaala hhege wasane bamiyaalefute, laaye becaa nawe 'enaziyaa la'enaresu 'asaamaami qethaate 'alelaacawe
yataagasenaa mehherate yaadaragame sawe yehe kamererocu (katafalaagiwocu) nagaroce nawe
'alaahe yamiyaathamaweme sawe ka'eresu baxwaala la'eresu meneme radaate yalaweme badalanyoceneme qethaatune baayu gizee wada mamalase manegade 'alelane? yamilu sikxonu taayaacawaalahe

kaweredate yatanasaa fariwoce kxonawe ba`aayene sereqote wada'ereswa (wada 'esaate) 'eyaasetawaalu ba'ereswa laaye yamiqarabu sikxonu taayaacawaalahe 'enaziyaame yaamanute - <<ba'eregethe kasaariwocu 'enaziyaa nafesocaacawenenaa beetasabocaacawene bateneszaa'ee qane yaakasarute naacawe>> yelaalu

nequ! badalanyoce ba'eregethe bazawetaari seqaaye wesethe naacawe la'enaresume ka'alaahe leelaa yamiradwacawe zamadoce meneme 'alenabaruwaacaweme 'alaaheme yamiyaathamawe sawe la'eresu (wada 'ewenate) meneme manegade yalaweme
la'eresu mamalase yaleelawe qane ka'alaahe kamamethaatu bafite lageetaacehu taazazu baziyaa qane la'enaaneta meneme mathagiyaa yalaacehume la'enaanetame meneme makaade yalaacehume

bizorume (waqasaa yalabeheme) ba'enaresu laaye thabaaqi 'aderegane 'alelaakenehemenaa baaneta laaye maaderase 'eneje leelaa yalabeheme 'enyaame sawene ka'enyaa yakxonane tsagaa baaqamasenawe gizee bareswa yedasataale 'ejocaacawe baaseqadamuteme xathi'ate mekeneyaate makaraa betedaresebaacawe (tasefaa yeqorethaalu) sawe (welataane) bathaame kahhadi nawenaa
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaa ya'alaahe nawe yamishaawene yefatheraale lamishaawe sawe seetocene (lejoce) yesathaale lamishaaweme sawe wanedocene yesathaale
wayeme wanedocenaa seetoce 'aderego yaathanaadaacawaale yamishaaweneme sawe makaane yaadaregawaale 'eresu `awaaqi caaye nawenaa

lasaweme 'alaahe baraa'eye, wayeme kageredo wadiyaa, wayeme maleketanyaane (male'akene) yamilekenaa bafaqaadu yamishaawene nagare yamiyaawaredelate bikxone 'eneje (bagahaade) liyaanaagerawe tagabiwe 'ayedalame 'eresu yabalaaye thebabanyaa nawenaa

'enedazihume wada 'aneta kate'ezaazaacene sikxone manefasene (qure'aanene) 'awaradene matsehhafume 'emenatume mene 'enedakxona yametaaweqe 'alenabarekeme gene (manefasune) kabaarocaacene yameneshaawene sawe ba'eresu yamenemaraabate berehaane 'adaragenawe 'anetame wada qathetanyaawe manegade ba'eregethe temaraalahe
wadaziyaa basamaayaatenaa bamedere yaalawe hulu ya'eresu wada kxonawe 'alaahe manegade (temaraalahe) nequ! nagarocu hulu wada 'alaahe yemalasaalu
hha.ma (hhaa mime)
galaache bakxonawe matsehhafe 'emelaalahu
'enyaa taawequ zanede `arabenyaa qure'aane 'adaragenawe
'eresume bamatsehhafocu 'enaate wesethe 'enyaa zanede ba'eregethe kafetanyaa thebabe yatamalaa nawe
denebare 'alaafiwoce hhezeboce lamakxonaacehu qure'aanune ka'enaaneta maagadene 'enaagedaalane?
bafitanyocume hhezeboce wesethe kanabiye bezune lekanaale
kanabiyeme 'anedeme yamimathaalaacawe 'alenabarame ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabaru bikxonu 'eneje
ka'enaresume baxayele yebalethe yabaratutene 'athefetanaale yafitanyocume ('athafaafe) mesaalee 'alefwale
<<samaayaatenenaa medereneme maane fatharaacawe>> belahe betethayeqaacawe <<'ashanaafiwe `awaaqiwe ('alaahe) ba'eregethe fatharaacawe>> yelaalu
('eresu) yaa mederene la'enaaneta menethaafe yaadaragalaacehu bareswame wesethe tememaru zanede la'enaaneta manegadocene yaadaragalaacehu nawe
yaame kasamaayaa wehaane baleke yaawaradalaacehu nawe ba'eresume yamotacewene 'agare hheyaawe 'adaragene 'enedazihu (kamaqaaberaacehu) tewewathaalaacehu
yaame `aayenatocene hulu yafathara la'enaanetame kamarekabocenaa kabeete 'enesesaawoce yametegaalebwacawene yaadaragalaacehu nawe

bajarebaawocu laaye 'enedetedalaadalu kaziyaame baresu laaye yatadalaadalaacehu gizee yageetaacehune tsagaa 'enedetaasetaawesu; 'enedetelume - <<yaa yehenene yamaanecelawe senekxone la'enyaa yaagaraalane geetaa theraate yegabaawe
'enyaame ba'eregethe wada geetaacene tamalaashoce;nane>> ('enedetelu)
kabaarocume la'eresu quraachene (lejene) 'adaragulate sawe ba'eregethe geletse kahhaadi nawe
kamifatherawe wesethe seetoce lejocene yaazane? bawanedoce lejoceme ('enaanetane) marathaacehune?
'anedaacaweme la'alerahhemaane mesaalee baadaragawe nagare (baseete leje) batabasara gizee 'eresu baquchete yatamalaa kxono fitu yathaqora yekxonaale
bageethe (takaleso) 'enediyaadege yamidaragawene? 'eresume (ladakaamaanatu) bakerekere yamiyaaberaaraawene fethure (seetene) la'alaahe yaadaregaalune?
malaa'eketeneme 'enaresu ya'alerahhemaane baaroce yakxonutene seetoce 'adaragu sifatharu nabarune? mamasekaraacawe ba'eregethe tetsaafaalace yethayaqaalume
<<'alerahhemaaneme bashaa noro baaletagazaanaacawe nabare>> 'alu la'enaresu bazihe meneme `eweqate yalaacaweme 'enaresu yamiwaashu 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalume
ka'eresu (kaqure'aane) bafite matsehhafene sathanaacawene? selazihe 'enaresu 'eresune yachabathu naacawene?
katoweneme <<'enyaa 'abaatocaacenene bahaayemaanote laaye 'aganyanaacawe 'enyaame bafalagocaacawe laaye tamariwoce nane>> 'alu

(nagaru) 'enedazihume nawe kabafitehe bamaanenyaayetume katamaa wesethe 'asefaraarine 'alelaakeneme; qemethelocewaa 'enyaa 'abaatocaacenene bahaayemaanote laaye 'aganyane; 'enyaame bafalagocaacawe laaye takataayoce nane yaalu bikxonu 'eneje

('asefaraariwe) <<'abaatocaacehune ba'eresu laaye ka'aganyaacehubate yebalethe qathetanyaane (haayemaanote) baamathaalaacehume?>> 'alaacawe <<'enyaa ba'eresu batalaakaacehubate nagare kahhaadiwoce nane>> 'alu
ka'enaresume tabaqalene yaasetabaabaayocume macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara tamalekate
beraahimeme la'abaatunaa lahhezebocu baala gizee ('asetaawese) <<'enee kametegegazute hulu netsuhhe nanye >>
<<kaziyaa kafatharanye basetaqare ('alegegazaame) 'eresu ba'eregethe yemaraanyaalenaa >>
bazereyocume wesethe yemalasu zanede (baanede 'amelaake maamanene) qari qaale 'adaragaate
yeleqe 'enazihene (qurayeshocene), 'abaatocaacaweneme qure'aanenaa galaache maleketanyaa 'esekamathaalaacawe derase 'athaaqamekwaacawe
'ewenatume bamathaalaacawe gizee <<yehe degemete nawe 'enyaame ba'eresu kahhaadiwoce nane>> 'alu
<<yeheme qure'aane kahulatu katamoce bataalaaqe sawe laaye 'ayewarademe norwalene?>> 'alu

'enaresu yageetaahene cerotaa yaakafafelaalune? 'enyaa baqerebitu hheyewate nurwacawene bamakaakalaacawe 'akafaafelanaale kafilaacaweme kafilune szaraatanyaa 'aderego yeyeze zanede kafilaacawene kakafilu balaaye badarajaawoce (bahabete) 'abalathene yageetaaheme tsagaa (ganate) kamisabasebute (haabete) balaacha naate

sawoceme (bakehhedate) 'anede hhezebe yamikxonu baalenabaru noro ba'alerahhemaane;lamikedute sawoce (bazihece `aalame) labeetocaacawe kabere yakxonune thaaraawoce ba'enaresu laaye yamiwathubaacaweneme (yabere) masalaaloce baadaragenelaacawe nabare
labeetocaacaweme dajaafocene ba'enaresu laaye yamidagafubaacaweneme 'alegaawoce (kabere baadaragenelaacawe nabare)
yawareqe geetheneme (baadaragenelaacawe nabare) yeheme hulu yaqerebitu hheyewate mathaaqamiyaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame; (thafi nawe) macharashaayetume 'agare bageetaahe zanede lathenequqocu naate
ka'alerahhemaane geszaatsee (kaqure'aane) yamidanaabareme sawe la'eresu sayethaanene 'enaasethagaalane selazihe 'eresu la'eresu quraanyaa nawe
'enaresume (tadanaabaariwocu) tamariwoce makxonaacawene yamiyaasebu sikxonu 'enaresu (sayethaanaate) kaqathetanyaawe manegade ba'eregethe yaagedwacawaale
(bateneszaa'ee) wadanyaa bamathaame gizee (quraanyaayee hoye!) <<ba'eneenaa baaneta makaakale yameszeraaqenaa yame`eraabe reqate banora waye menyotee! mene yakafaahe quraanyaa nahe>> yelaale
sela badalaacehume zaaree 'enaaneta baqethaate tagaariwoce makxonaacehu 'ayethaqemaacehume; (yebaalaalu)
'aneta daneqorowocene taasamaalahene? wayese `ewerocenenaa bageletse themate wesethe yakxonune sawoce temaraalahene?
'anetaneme (qethaataacawene setaaye) benewasedehe 'enyaa ka'enaresu tabaqaayoce nane
wayeme yaanene yaqatharenaacawene benaasaayehe 'enyaa ba'enaresu (qethaate) laaye caayewoce nane
yaaneneme wada 'aneta yatawaradalehene 'athebeqahe yaaze 'aneta baqathetanyaawe manegade laaye nahenaa
'eresume (qure'aane) la'aneta, lahhezaboceheme taalaaqe kebere nawe wada fiteme (karesu) tethayaqaalaacehu
kamale'eketanyocaaceneme kaaneta bafite yalaakenaacawene (takataayocaacawene) ka'alerahhemaane leelaa yamigazuwaacawe yakxonune 'amaalekete 'aderegane 'eneda kxona thayeqaacawe
musaaneme bata`aameraatocaacene wada fare`onenaa wada shumaamenetocu ba'eregethe laakene <<'enee ya`aalamaate geetaa maleketanyaa nanye>> 'alaacaweme
bata`aameraataaceneme bamathaabaacawe gizee wadiyaawenu 'enaresu ba'ereswa yeseqaalu
kata`aamereme 'anediteneme 'anaasaayaacaweme 'ereswa kabetheewaa bathaame yabalathace betekxone 'eneje (kakehedataacawe) yemalasume zanede baqethaate yaazenaacawe
<<'aneta degemetanyaa (`awaaqi) hoye! geetaahene 'aneta zanede qaale bagabaalehe la'enyaa lamenelene 'enyaa (qethaatune biyaanasaalene) tamariwoce nane>> 'alume
seqaayune ka'enaresu laaye bagalatheneme gizee wadiyaawenu kidaanaacawene yaafaresaalu
fare`oneme bahhezebocu wesethe tathaaraa 'alame; <<hhezebocee hoye! yamesere gezaate yanee 'ayedalamene? 'enaziheme jeratoce kaseree yamifasu sikxonu (yanee 'ayedalumene?) 'atemalakatumene?
<<bawenatu 'enee kazihe yaa 'eresu waraadaa negegeruneme ligaletse yamaayeqarebe kakxonawe balaache nanye
<<ba'eresume laaye yawareqe 'anebaaroce lamene 'aletathaalubateme wayeme malaa'ekete ka'eresu gaare taqoraanyetawe lamene 'alemathume>> ('ala)
hhezebocuneme 'aqeelaacawe taazazuteme 'enaresu 'amatsanyoce hhezeboce nabarunaa
baaseqothuneme gizee ka'enaresu batabaqalane huluneme 'asathamenaacaweme
(bathefaate) qadaamiwocenaa laxwaalanyocu (maqathaachaa) mesaaleeme 'adaragenaacawe
yamareyame lejeme mesaalee batadaraga gizee hhezebocehe (kahhaadiwocu) wadiyaawenu ka'eresu yeseqaalu
<<'amaaleketocaacene yebalethaalune wayese 'eresu?>> 'alume lakerekereme 'eneje laaneta 'eresune mesaalee 'alaadaraguteme ba'ewenate 'enaresu kerekera beretu hhezeboce naacawe
'eresu baresu laaye yalagasenelate la'eseraa'eelame lejoce ta`aamere yaadaragenawe yakxona baariyaa 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame
beneshaame noro bamedere laaye ka'enaanata meteke malaa'eketene baadaragene nabare
'eresume (`isaa) lasa`aatitu (maawaqiyaa) ba'eregethe melekete nawe <<ba'ereswame 'atetharaatharu takatalunyeme; yehe qathetanyaa manegade nawe>> (balaacawe)
sayethaaneme 'ayaagedaacehu 'eresu la'enaaneta geletse thalaate nawenaa

`isaa bataameraatoce bamathaa gizeeme 'alaacawe <<ba'eregethe bathebabe mathaaxwaacehu yaziyaaneme baresu yametelayaayubatene kafilune lanaaneta laaberaaraalaacehu (mathaahu) 'alaaheneme feru taazazunyeme
<<'alaahe geetaayee geetaacehume nawenaa tagazute yehe qathetanyaa manegade nawe >>
kamakaakalaacaweme 'ahhezaabocu talayaayu la'enaziyaame labadalute ka'asaamaami qane qethaate wayolaacawe
sa`aatitune 'enaresu yamaayaawequ kxonawe badenegate letemathaabaacawe 'eneje yethabaabaqaalune?
wadaajoce baziyaa qane kafilaacawe lakafilu thalaate nawe 'alaahene fariwoce becaa siqaru
(lanaresuse) <<baarocee hoye! zaaree qane ba'enaaneta laaye ferehaate yalabaacehume 'enaanetame yametaazenu 'ayedalaacehume>> (yebaalaalu)
'enaziyaa ba'aneqatsocaacene yaamanunaa fetsume taazaazhoce yanabaru (baarocee hoye!)
<<ganatene gebu 'enaanetame misetocaacehume tedasataalaacehu tekabarume 'alaacehu>> (yebaalaalu)

kawareqe yakxonu safaafi zerege saahhenocenaa kubaayaawoce ba'enaresu laaye yezezoraalu ba'ereswame wesethe nafesoce yamikajelute, `aayenoceme yamidasatubate hulu 'alela 'enaanetame bawesethwa zalaalame zawetaariwoce naacehu
yeheceme yaaci teszarute banabaraacehute waagaa yatasathaacexwaate ganate naate
la'enaaneta bawesethwa bezu ferafereewoce ba'eregethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
'amatsanyoce bagahaname seqaaye wesethe ba'eregethe zawetaariwoce naacawe
ka'enaresu (qethaatu) 'ayeqalalelaacaweme 'enaresume ba'eresu wesethe tasafaa qoraachoce naacawe
'alebadalenaacawememe; gene badaayocu 'enaresuwe nabaru
<<maalike hoye! geetaahe banyaa laaye (bamote) yeferade >> 'eyaalu yethaaraalume <<'enaaneta (baqethaatu wesethe) zalaalame nawaariwoce naacehu>> yelaacawaale
'ewenatanyaawene manegade ba'eregethe 'amathaanelaacehu gene 'abezaanyocaacehu 'ewenatune thayewoce naacehu
yelequneme (banabiyu laaye bamaadame) nagarene 'athanakarune? 'enyaame (tanekolaacawene wada'enaresu bamamalase) 'athanekaariwoce nane
wayeme 'enyaa mesethiraacawenenaa weyeyetaacawene yamaanesamaa makxonaacenene yaasebaalune? 'ayedalame; maleketanyocaaceneme 'enaresu zanede yetsefaalu
<<la'alerahhemaane leje (yalaweme 'eneje) binorawe 'enee (laleju) yatagazhiwocu majamariyaa nanye>> balaacawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere geetaa yazufaanu geetaa kamilute nagare hulu tharaa
tawaacaweme yaanene yesefaraarubate yanabarutene qanaacawene 'esekamiganaanyu derase (basehhetataacawe wesethe) yewaanyu yechaawotume
'eresume yaa basamaaye wesethe ligegazute yamigabaawe bamedereme wesethe ligegazute yamigabaawe 'amelaake nawe 'eresume belehaatanyaawe `awaaqiwe nawe

yaame yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe hulu negeszenaa ya'eresu becaa yakxonawe 'amelaake laaqa yasa`aatitume (yamamechaawaa zamane) `eweqate 'eresu zanede becaa nawe wada'eresume temalasaalaacehu
'enaziyaame ka'alaahe leelaa yamigegazwacawe 'enaresu yamiyaawequ kxonawe ba'ewenate kamasakarute basetaqare melejaane 'ayecelume
maane 'enedafatharaacaweme betethayeqaacawe <<ba'eregethe 'alaahe nawe>> yelaalu taadiyaa (ka'emenate) wadeete yezoraalu
(nabiyu) geetaayee hoye! 'enazihe yamaayaamenu hhezeboce naacawe; yamaalatume (`eweqate 'alaahe zanede nawe)
'enaresuneme tawaacawe nagaree salaame nawe baleme wadafiteme (yamimathaabaacawene) yaaweqaalu
hha.ma (hhaa mime)
'aberaari bakxonawe matsehhafe 'enemelaalane
'enyaa (qure'aanune) batabaarakace leelite wesethe 'awaradenawe 'enyaa 'asefaraariwoce nabarenenaa
bawesethwa yatawasanawe nagare hulu yelelayaale
ka'enyaa zanede yakxona te'ezaaze sikxone ('awaradenawe) 'enyaa (maleketanyocene) laakiwoce nabarene
kageetaahe bakxonawe cerotaa (talaaku) 'enaho 'eresu samiwe `awaaqiwe nawenaa
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere bamakaakalaacaweme yaalawe nagare hulu geetaa kakxonawe (talaaku) yametaaragaagethu 'enedakxonaacehu (nagaru 'enedaalenawe makxonune 'ewaqu)
ka'eresu leelaa 'amelaake yalame hheyaawe yaadaregaale yegadelaaleme geetaacehu yamajamariyaawocu 'abaatocaacehume geetaa nawe
ba'ewenatu 'enaresu yamichaawatu sikxonu bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe
samaayeme bageletse chese yametemathaabatene qane tathabaabaqe
sawocene yamishafene (bakxona chese) yehe 'asaamaami qethaate nawe
<<geetaacene hoye! ka'enyaa laaye qethaatune gelathelene 'enyaa 'amaanyoce 'enekxonaalanenaa>> (yelaalume)
(qethaatu bawarada gizee) la'enaresu magegasatse 'enedeete yenoraacawaale? 'aseraje maleketanyaa yamathaacawe sikxone (yakaadume sikxonu)
kaziyaame ka'eresu yazoru; (kasawe) <<yatasatamaara `ebede nawe>> yaalume sikxonu
'enyaa qethaatune latheqite gizee galaachoce nane 'enaaneta (wada kehedataacehu) ba'eregethe tamalaashoce naacehu
taalaaqitune beretu 'ayaayaaze bameneyezebate qane; 'enyaa tabaqaayoce nane
ka'enaresume bafite yafare`onene hhezeboce ba'eregethe mokarene kebure male'eketanyaame mathaalaacawe
<<ya'alaahene baaroce wadanee 'aderesu 'enee la'enaaneta taamaanye maleketanyaa nanyenaa
<<ba'alaaheme laaye 'atekuru 'enee geletse yakxonane 'aseraje yaamathaahulaacehu nanyenaa (bamaalate mathaalaacawe)
<<'eneeme 'enedaatewagerunye bageetaayanaa bageetaacehu tathabeqiyaalahu
<<ba'eneeme baataamenu raaqunye>> (tawunye 'ala)
qathelome (sela zaatubate) <<'enazihe 'amatsanyoce hhezeboce naacawe>> ('athefaacawe) sile geetaawene lamana
(geetaawe) <<baaroceeneme yezahe baleelite kxide 'enaaneta yamikataluwaacehu naacehunaa
<<baahheruneme yatakafata kxono tawawe 'enaresu yamisathethamu saraawite naacawenaa>> ('alawe)
ka'atekeletocenaa kamenechoceme bezu nagarocene tawu
ka'azemaraawoceme kamalekaame maqamachaame
ba'ereswa tadasaacoce kanabarubaateme delote (bezune nagare tawu)
(nagaru) 'enedazihu kxona leeloceneme hhezeboce 'awarasenaate
samaayenaa medereme ba'enaresu laaye 'alaalaqasume yamiqoyume 'alenabarume
ya'eseraa'eeleneme lejoce 'awaaraaje kakxona seqaaye ba'eregethe 'adaanenaacawe
kafare`one; 'eresu yakoraa kawasane 'alaafiwocu nabarenaa
kamaawaqeme gaare ba`aalamaate laaye ba'eregethe marathenaacawe
kataameraatoceme bawesethu geletse yakxona fatanaa yaalabatene sathanaacawe
'enazihe (yamakaa kahhaadiwoce) ba'eregethe yelaalu -
'ereswa yafitanyaayetu motaacene 'eneje 'ayedalaceme 'enyaame yameneqasaqase 'ayedalaneme
'ewenatanyoceme 'eneda kxonaacehu 'abaatocaacenene 'amethulene
'enaresu balaachoce naacawene wayese yatubeba`e hhezebocenaa 'enaziyaa ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute? 'athafaanaacawe 'enaresu 'amatsanyoce nabarunaa
samaayaatenenaa medereneme bahulatu makaakale yaalaweneme hulu qalaajoce kxonane 'alefathareneme
hulatuneme bamere 'eneje 'alefatharenaacaweme gene 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
yamalayaawe qane lahulume qatharwacawe nawe
zamade kazamadu meneneme yamaayethaqemebate 'enaresume yamaayereradubate qane nawe
'alaahe yaazanalate sawenaa yaamana becaa siqare ('eresuse yereradaale) 'eresu 'ashanaafiwe 'azaanyu nawenaa
yazaquma zaafe
yaxathi'aatanyaawe megebe nawe
'eneda zayete 'atalaa nawe bahodoce wesethe yamifalaa sikxone
'eneda ganafala wehaa 'afalaale (yamifalaa sikxone)
yaazute; wada gahaname makaakaleme baxayele gotetute
kaziyaame <<karaasu balaaye kafalaa wehaa seqaaye 'anebwabubate >>
<<qemase; 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe keberu nahenaa>> (yebaalaale)
<<yehe yaa ba'eresu tetharaatharubate yanabaraacehute nawe>> (yebaalaalu)
thenequqocu ba'eregethe batsathetanyaa manoriyaa wesethe naacawe
ba'atekeletocenaa bamenechoce wesethe naacawe
fite lafite yataqethaachu kxonawe kasese hharenaa kawaferaame hhare yelabesaalu
(nagaru) 'enedazihu nawe; `aayenaamaawoce yakxonune nachaache seetoceme 'enaathanaadaacawaalane
ba'ereswame wesethe yatamaamanu kxonawe; kaferaaferee hulu yaazezaalu
yafitanyaayetune mote 'eneje (daagemanyaa) ba'ereswa wesethe motene 'ayeqamesume yagahanameneme qethaate ('alaahe) thabaqaacawe
kageetaahe bakxona cerotaa (thabaqaacawe) yehe 'eresu taalaaqe `edele nawe
(qure'aanune) baqwaaneqwaaheme yaagaraanawe (hhezebocehe) yeganazabu zanede becaa nawe
tathabaabaqeme 'enaresu tathabaabaaqiwoce naacawenaa
hha.ma (hhaa mime)
yamatsehhafu mawarade 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa kakxonawe 'alaahe nawe
basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe lame'emenaane hulu (lacelotaawe) 'eregathanyaa meleketoce 'alelu
'enaanetaneme bamafethare kataneqasaaqaasheme (bamedere laaye) yamibatenawene hulu (bamafetharu) lamiyaaragaagethu hhezeboce ta`aameraatoce 'alelu

baleelitenaa ma`aalete matakaakaateme, kasisaayeme (kazenaame) 'alaahe kasamaaye baawaradawe baresume mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe bamaaderagu, nafaasoceneme (bayaaqethaachaacawe) bamaazawaawaru lamiyaawequ hhezeboce maaserajaawoce 'alelu
'enazihe baaneta laaye bawenate yamenaanabaacawe sikxonu ya'alaahe maaserajaawoce naacawe ka'alaahenaa kamaaserajaawocume wadiyaa bayatenyaawe negegere yaamenaalu?
weshataame xathi'atanyaa lakxona hulu wayolate (thefaate tagabaawe)
ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce ba'eresu laaye yaminababulate sikxonu yesamaale kaziyaame yakoraa sikxone 'enedaalesamaate kxono (bakehhedatu laaye) yezawateraale ba'asaamaamime qethaate 'abeserawe
ka'aneqatsocaaceneme 'anedaacene baawaqa gizee masaalaqiyaa 'aderego yeyezaataale 'enaziyaa la'enaresu 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alelaacawe

kafitaacaweme gahaname 'alelace yasabasabuteme habete ka'enaresu laaye meneneme 'ayemaleselaacaweme ka'alaahe leelaame radaatoce 'aderegawe yayaazuwaacawe ('ayethaqemwacaweme) la'enaresume taalaaqe qethaate 'alelaacawe
yehe (qure'aane) mari nawe 'enaziyaame bageetaacawe 'aneqatsoce yakaadute la'enaresu kaberetu qethaate yakxona 'asaamaami seqaaye 'alelaacawe
'alaahe yaa baahherene bawesethu taanekwaawoce bafaqaadu 'enedineshaalalubate kacerotaaweme 'enedetefalegubate 'enedetaamasagenuteme la'enaanata yagaraalaacehu nawe
lanaanetame basamaayaate yaalawenenaa bamedereme yaalawene hulu bamalaa ka'eresu sikxone yagaraalaacehu nawe bazihe lamiyaasetanatenu hhezeboce ta`aameraate 'alelabate

la'enaziyaa la'amanute sawoce (mehherate 'aderegu) balaacawe la'enaziyaa ya'alaahene qanoce lamaayefarute yemeraalunaa hhezebocene yeszarute banabarute nagare yemanadaa zanede (mehherate 'aderegu balaacawe)
malekaamene yaszaraa sawe lanafesu nawe yaakafaame sawe ba'ereswa laaye nawe kaziyaame wada geetaacehu temalasaalaacehu
la'eseraa'eele lejoceme matsehhafenenaa hhegene, nabiyenateneme ba'eregethe sathanaacawe kamalekaame sisaayoceme lagasenelaacawe ba`aalamaate laayeme 'abalathenaacawe

kate`ezaazeme geletsocene sathanaacawe `eweqatume kamathaalaacawe baxwaalaa bamakaakalaacawe lameqanyenate 'eneje laleelaa 'aletalayaayume geetaahe bateneszaa'ee qane baziyaa ba'eresu yelayaayubate banabarute nagare bamakaakalaacawe ba'eregethe yefaredaale
kaziyaame kanagaru (kahaayemaanote) batekekelanyaayetu hhege laaye 'adaragenehe selazihe takatalaate ya'enaziyaaneme yamaayaawequtene hhezeboce zenebaaleewoce 'atekatale
'enaresu ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneneme ka'aneta 'ayegafaterulehemenaa badalanyome kafilaacawe yakafilu radaatoce naacawe 'alaaheme yathenequqocu radaate nawe
yeha (qure'aane) lasawoce yalebe berehaanoce nawe lamiyaaragaagethume hhezeboce marinaa 'ezenate nawe

'enaziyaa xathi'atocene yaszaru hheyewataacaweme motaacaweme tekekele sikxone 'eneda'enaziyaa 'eneda 'amanutenaa malekaamocene 'enedaszarute lenaadaregaacawe yetharatheraalune? ('ayetharetheru) yamifaredute menenyaa kafaa!
'alaaheme samaayaatenenaa mederene (lacelotaawe 'enedamiyaamalaketebaacawenaa) nafeseme hulu baszaraacewe szeraa tememanadaa zanede batekekele fathara 'enaresume 'ayebadalume

zenebaaleewene 'amelaaku 'aderego yayaazawene, 'alaaheme ka`eweqate gaare yaathamamawene, bajorowenaa balebu laayeme yaatamabatene, ba`aayenume laaye shifaane yaadaragabatene sawe 'ayahene! taadiyaa ka'alaahe baxwaalaa yamiyaaqanaawe maanawe? 'ategaszatsumene?

'ereswame (hheyewate) yaqerebitu hheyewataacene 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaceme <<'enemotaalane; hheyaaweme 'enekxonaalane kagizeeme (maalafe) basetaqare leelaa 'ayaathafaaneme>> 'alu la'enaresume bazihe (bamilute) meneme `eweqate yalaacaweme 'enaresu yamitharaatharu 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalume
'aneqatsocaaceneme geletsoce kxonawe ba'enaresu laaye batanababulaacawe gizee kerekeraacawe <<'ewenatanyoce 'eneda kxonaacehu 'abaatocaacenene 'amethu>> maalate 'eneje leelaa 'alenabarame

<<'alaahe hheyaawe yaadaregaacexwaale; kaziyaame yegadelaacexwaale, kaziyaame wada teneszaa'ee qane yesabasebaacexwaale ba'eresu therethere yalabateme gene 'abezaanyaawocu sawoce 'ayaawequme>> balaacawe
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere gezaate ya'alaahe becaa nawe sa`aatitume bameteqomebate qane yaane gizee 'athefiwoce hulu yekaseraalu
hhezebeneme hulu tanebarekaaki kxonaa taayaataalahe hhezebe hulu wada matsehhafwa tethetharaalace <<zaaree teszarute yanabaraacehutene nagare temanadaalaacehu>> (yebaalaalu)
yehe matsehhafaacene nawe ba'enaaneta laaye ba'ewenate yenaagaraale 'enyaa yaanene teszarute yanabaraacehutene 'enaasegalabethe nabarene (yebaalaalu)
'enaziyaa yaamanutenaa malekaamocene yaszarutemaa geetaacawe ba'ezenatu wesethe yaagabaacawaale yehe 'eresu geletse yakxona maagenyate nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadutemaa (la'enaresu yebaalaalu) <<'aneqatsocee ba'enaaneta laaye yenababu 'alenabarumene? koraacehume kahhaadiwoce hhezeboceme nabaraacehu >>

<<ya'alaahe qatharo 'ewenate nawe sa`aatitume ba'ereswa (mamethaate) therethere yalame >> batabaala gizeeme <<sa`aatitu mene 'eneda kxonace 'anaaweqeme matharaatharene yamenetharaathare 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaneme 'enyaame 'aragaagaachoce 'ayedalaneme>> 'alaacehu
yaszaruwaacaweme xathi'atoce la'enaresu yegalatsulaacawaale yaame ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabarute qethaate ba'enaresu laaye yewaredebaacawaale
<<yeheneneme qanaacehune maganaanyatene 'eneda rasaacehu zaaree 'enerasaacexwaalane ('enetawaacexwaalane) manoriyaacehume 'esaate naate la'enaanetame karadaatoce meneme yalaacehume>> yebaalaale

yehe 'enaaneta ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce maqalajaa 'aderegaacehu bamayaazaacehunaa qerebitume hheyewate sela'ataalalacaacehu nawe; (yebaalaalu) zaaree ka'ereswa 'ayewathethume; 'enaresume bawaqasaa 'ayetaalafume
mesegaanaame la'alaahe lasamaayaate geetaa lamedereme geetaa la`aalamaate geetaa yatagabaawe nawe
kuraateme basamaayaateme bamedereme la'eresu becaa nawe 'eresume 'ashanafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe
hha.ma (hhaa mime)
yamatsehhafu mawarade 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa kakxonawe 'alaahe nawe

samaayaatenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu bamerenaa yatawasana gizeeneme bamalakaate 'eneje (laqalede) 'alefatharenaacaweme 'enaziyaa yakaaduteme katasefaraarute nagare (tetawe) zawaariwoce naacawe

<<ka'alaahe leelaa yametegegazwacawene 'ayaacehune? kamedere menene 'eneda fatharu 'asaayunye wayeme basamaayaate la'enaresu (ka'alaahe gaare) magaaraate 'alaacawene? (yaamaaledunaale bamaalataacehu) 'ewenatanyoce 'eneda kxonaacehu kazihe (qure'aane) bafite yakxonane matsehhafe wayeme ka`eweqate yakxona qeresene 'amethulenye>> balaacawe
'eseka teneszaa'ee qane deraseme la'eresu yamaayemaleselatene (thaa`ote) ka'alaahe leelaa kamitharaa sawe yebalethe yatasaasaata maanawe? 'enaresume katheriyaacawe zanegiwoce naacawe
sawoceme batasabasabu gizee (thaa`otocu) la'enaresu thalaatoce yekxonaalu ('enasune) magazaataacaweneme kahhaadiwoce yekxonaalu
ba'enaresume laaye 'aneqatsocaacene geletsoce kxonawe batanababu gizee 'enaziyaa 'ewenatune bamathaalaacawe gizee yakaadutene <<yehe geletse degemete nawe>> 'alu

yelequneme qathafawe yelaalune? <<beqathefawe la'enee ka'alaahe (qethaate lamaadaane) meneneme 'atecelume 'eresu yaanene ba'eresu yameteqabaazherubatene `awaaqi nawe ba'eneenaa ba'enaaneta makaakale masekaari ba'eresu baqaa 'eresume mahhaariwe 'azaanyu nawe>> balaacawe

<<kamaleketanyoce bethee yaleelanye 'ayedalahume ba'eneeme ba'enaanetame mene 'enedamiszeszaraame 'alaaweqeme wada'enee yamiwaradawene 'eneje leelaane 'alekataleme 'eneeme geletse 'asefaraari 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe

(muhhamade hoye!) balaacawe <<'eseti negarunye; (qure'aanu) ka'alaahe zanede bikxone ba'eresume betekedu, ka'eseraa'eele lejoceme masekaari babetheewe (ba'eresu) laaye bimasakere, biyaameneme, (ka'emenate) betekorume, (badaaye 'atekxonumene?)>> 'alaahe ba'eregethe badalanyocene hhezeboce 'ayaaqanaame

'enaziyaaneme yakaadute sawoce sela'enaziyaa sela 'amanute sawoce ('emenatu) <<malekaame nagare bakxona noro wadaresu baaleqadamune nabare>> 'alu ba'eresume baaletamaru gizee <<yehe (qure'aane) thenetaawi qethefate nawe>> yelaalu

kabafitume yamusaa matsehhafe marinaa tsagaa sikxone 'alela yeheme 'enaziyaane yabadalutene liyaasefaraaraa ba`arabenyaa qwaaneqwaa sikxone (yafitocune matsaahhefete) 'aragaagaache matsehhafe nawe labago 'aderaagiwoceme beseraate nawe
'enaziyaa <<geetaacene 'alaahe nawe>> yaalu, kaziyaame qathe yaalu banaresu laaye ferehaate yalabaacaweme 'enaresume 'ayaazenume
'enaziyaa yaganate gwaadoce naacawe ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce sikxonu baziyaa yeszarute banabarute mekeneyaate taalaaqene menedaa (yememanadaalu)

saweneme bawalaajocu bago mawaalene bathebeqe 'azazenawe 'enaatu bacegere laaye kxonaa 'aragazacewe bacegereme waladacewe 'eregezenaawenaa kathute malayaaweme salaasaa ware nawe thenekaareeweneme waqete badarasa gizee (kaziyaa 'alefo) 'arebaa `aamateneme badarasa gizee <<geetaayee hoye! yaacene ba'enee laayenaa bawalaajocee laaye yalagasekaatene tsagaahene 'enedaamasagene yametewadaweneme malekaame szeraa 'enedeszaraa meraanye zaroceeneme la'enee 'abejelenye 'enee wadaaneta tamalaseku 'eneeme kamuselimo nanye>> 'ala

'enazihe (yehenene baayoce) baganate gwaadoce wesethe sikxonu 'enaziyaa kaszarute szeraa malekaamune kanasu yameneqabalaacawenaa kaxathi'atocaacaweme yamenaalefaacawe naacawe yaanene tasefaa yesesathute yanabarutene 'ewenatanyaa qatharo ('enemolaalaacawaalane)

yaaneneme lawalaajocu <<fohe la'enaaneta ka'enee bafite yakefele zamanaate sawoce (saayewathu) ba'eregethe yaalafu sikxonu (kamaqaabere) 'enedewathethaa taasefaraarunyaalaacehune?>> yaalawene hulatume (walaajocu) 'alaahene yamilamenu sikxonu (baataamene) <<wayolehe 'emane ya'alaahe qatharo 'eregethanyaa nawe >> (silute) <<yehe yafitanyocu sawoce tsehhufe taratoce 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalame>> yamilaweneme sawe ('asetaawese)
'enazihe 'enaziyaa kagaaneeneme kasaweme ka'enaresu bafite kaalafute hhezeboce gaare qaalu ba'enaresu laaye yataragaagathabaacawe naacawe 'enaresu kasaariwoce nabarunaa
lahulume kaszarute szeraa darajaawoce 'alelwacawe szeraawocaacaweneme yemolaalaacawe zanede (yehenene manadaacawe) 'enaresume 'ayebadalume

'enaziyaame yakaadute ba'esaate laaye bamigaafathu qane <<thaafaachocaacehune ba'anasetanyaayetu hheyewataacehu 'asaalafaacehu ba'ereswame tathaaqamaacehu selazihe bamedere laaye yaala 'agebaabe tekoru banabaraacehutenaa taametsu banabaraacehute zaaree yaweredatene qethaate tememanadaalaacehu>> (yebaalaalu)

ya`aadeneme wanedeme (hudene) hhezebocune ba'ahheqaafe baasethanaqaqa gizee 'awesaalacawe basetafitunaa basetaxwaalaaweme bezu 'asefaraariwoce ba'eregethe 'alefawaale <<ka'alaahe basetaqare 'ategegazu 'enee ba'enaanata laaye yakabaade qanene qethaate 'efaraalaacexwaalahunaa>> bamaalate (baasathanaqaqa gizee)
<<ka'amaaleketocaacene letaazorane mathaahebene? kawenatanyocume 'enedakxoneke yametezetebenene (qethaate) 'amethaawe>> 'alu
<<`eweqatu 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe yaane ba'eresu yatalaakehubateneme 'adareselaacexwaalahu gene 'enee yametesaasaatu hhezeboce kxonaacehu 'ayaacexwaalahu>> 'alaacawe

shalaqowocaacawene taqethaachi 'agedaami damanaa kxono baayuteme gizee <<yehe 'azenaabiyaacene yakxona damanaa nawe>> 'alu (hudeme) <<'ayedalame; 'eresu yaa ba'eresu yatacaakolaacehubate ma`ate nawe bawesethwa 'asaamaami seqaaye yaalabaate nafaase naate
bageetaawaa te`ezaaze 'anedaacune hulu taathafaalace>> ('alaacawe) kamanoriyaawocaacaweme basetaqare meneme yamaayetaayu kxonu 'enedazihu 'amatsanyocene hhezeboce hulu 'eneqathaalane

baziyaame 'enaanetane ba'eresu baalaasemacanebate (delote) ba'eregethe 'asemacanaacawe la'enaresume masemiyaanenaa maayaawocene, leboceneme 'adaragenelaacawe gene masemiyaacawenaa maayaawocaacawe, lebocaacaweme ka'enasu meneme 'alethaqamwacaweme ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yekedu nabarunaa ba'enaresume laaye yaa ba'eresu yesaalaqubate yanabarute qethaate waradabaacawe
kakatamoceme 'enaziyaane ba'akaabaabiyaacehu yanabarutene ba'eregethe 'athafaane (kakehhedataacawe) yemalasume zanede 'aserajiwocene malaalasene

'enaziyaame maqaarabiyaa yekxonu zanede ka'alaahe leelaa 'amaalekete 'aderegawe yayaazuwaacawe 'ayeradwacaweme norwalene? ba'eregethe kanasu raaqu yeheme weshataacawenaa (balemaade) yeqathefute yanabarute nawe

kagaaneene yakxonune cheferoce qure'aanene yamiyaadaamethu sikxonu wadaaneta baazorene gizeeme ('asetaawese) batathaaduteme gizee zeme belaacehu 'adaamethu tabaabaalu batacharasame gizee 'asethaneqaaqiwoce kxonawe wada hhezebocaacawe tamalasu
'alume <<hhezebocaacene hoye! 'enyaa kamusaa baxwaalaa yatawaradane matsehhafe bafitu yaalawene (matsehhafe) yamiyaaragaagethe wada 'ewenatenaa wada qathetanyaa manegade yamimaraa yakxonane samaane
waganocaacene hoye! ya'alaahene thari taqabalu ba'eresume 'emanu ('alaahe) kaxathi'atocaacehu la'enaaneta yemeraalenaa ka'asaamaami qethaateme yaadenaacexwaalenaa
ya'alaaheneme thari yamaayeqabale sawe bamedere wesethe yamiyaamalethe 'ayedalame ka'eresume leelaa la'eresu radaatoce yaluteme 'enaziyaa bageletse sehhetate wesethe naacawe>> ('alu)

yaa samaayaatenenaa mederene yafathara 'enaresuneme bamafetharu yaaledakamawe 'alaahe mutaanene hheyaawe bamaaderage laaye caaye makxonune 'alaasetawaalumene? (bamaasenasaate) caaye nawe 'eresu banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawenaa

'enaziyaame yakaadute sawoce ba'esaate laaye bamiqarabu qane <<yehe 'ewenate 'ayedalamene?>> (yebaalaalu) <<'ewenate nawe; bageetaacene yekxunebene>> yelaalu ('alaaheme) <<tekedu banabaraacehute mekeneyaate qethaatune qemasu>> yelaacawaale

kamaleketanyoceme yaqoraathenate baalabeetoce yakxonute 'eneda taagasu hulu taagase la'enaresume (lahhezebocehe qethaate) 'atecaakole yaanene yamisefaraarubatene qethaate bamiyaayu qane 'enaresu kaqane 'aneditene sa`aate 'aneje 'enedaaleqoyu yekxonaalu (yehe qure'aane) baqi gesaatsee nawe 'amatsanyoceme hhezeboce 'eneje (leeloce) yethethafaalune?
'enaziyaa yakaadu ka'alaahe manegademe yakalakalu ('alaahe) szeraawocaacawene 'athafaabaacawe

'enaziyaame yaamanu, bagowoceneme yaszaru, bamuhhamade laayeme yawaradawe 'eresu kageetaacawe sikxone 'ewenate sela kxona yaamanu ka'enaresu laaye xaathi'atocaacawene yaabaabesaale kxuneetaacaweneme hulu yaabajaale
yehe 'enaziyaa yakaadute weshatene yatakatalu bamakxonaacawenaa 'enaziyaame yaamanute kageetaacawe yakxonane 'ewenate selatakatalu nawe 'enedazihu 'alaahe lasawoce mesaaleewocaacawene yaaberaaraale

'enaziyaaneme yakaadutene (bathore laaye) baaganyaacehu gizee chaaneqaawocene baxayele metu baadakaamaacexwaacaweme gizee ('ategedalwacawe maarekwaacawe) maasariyaaweneme 'athebequ baxwaalaame wayeme banatsaa telaqwaacawaalaacehu; wayeme tebazhwacawaalaacehu (yeheme) thoritu masaariyaawaane 'esekametethele derase nawe (nagaru) yehe nawe 'alaaheme bishaa ka'enaresu (yaalathore) batabaqala nabare gene kafilaacehune bakafilu limokere (bazihe 'azazaacehu) 'enaziyaaneme ba'alaahe manegade laaye yatagadalutene szeraawocaacawene fatsemo 'ayaathafaabaacaweme
ba'eregethe yemaraacawaale kxuneetaacaweneme hulu yaabajaale
ganateneme yaagabaacawaale la'enaresu 'asetaaweqwaataale
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene (haayemaanotune) beteradu; yeradaacexwaale chaamaawocaacehuneme yaadalaadelaale
'enaziyaame yakaadute la'enaresu thefaate tagabaacawe szeraawocaacaweneme 'athafaabaacawe
yehe 'enaresu 'alaahe yaawaradawene selathalu nawe selazihe szeraawocaacawene 'abalaashabaacawe

ya'enaziyaa ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute (kahhaadiwoce) macharashaa 'enedeete 'eneda nabara yaayu zanede bamedere laye 'alekxeedumene? 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye (yaalaacawene hulu) 'athafaabaacawe lakahhadiwoceme hulu betheewocewaa 'alelwacawe
yehe 'alaahe ya'enaziyaa yaamanute sawoce radaate selakxonanaa kahhaadiwoceme la'enaresu radaate selaleelaacawe nawe

'alaahe 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce yaagabaacawaale 'enaziyaame yakaadute (baqerebitu `aalame) yethaaqamaalu 'enesesaawoceme 'enedamibalu yebalaalu 'esaateme la'enaresu manoriyaacawe naate
kakatamaame 'ereswa kaziyaace kaawathaacehe katamaahe yebalethe baxayele thanekaaraa yakxonace (baalabeetocewaane) yaathafaanaacawe bezu naate la'enaresume radaate 'alenabaraacaweme
kageetaawe bakxonace 'aseraje laaye yakxona me'emane kefu szeraacawe la'enaresu 'eneda tashalamalaacawenaa zenebaaleewocaacawene 'eneda takatalute nawene?

yaziyaace thenequqocu tasefaa yatasathwate ganate mesele bawesethwa shitaawe kamaayelawethe wehaa wanezoce, thaa`emu kamaayelawathe watateme wanezoce, lathachiwoce hulu thaafaache kakxonace yawayene thajeme wanezoce katanathara maareme wanezoce 'alelubaate la'enaresume bawesethwa kafereewoce hulu (bayaayenatu) kageetaacawe mehherateme 'alelaacawe (bazice ganate wesethe zawetaari yakxona sawe) 'eresu ba'esaate wesethe zawetaari 'enedakxona sawe, moqaateneme wehaa 'enedatagaatu, 'anejatocaacaweneme wadiyaawenu 'enedaqoraarathawe nawene? ('ayedalame)

ka'enaresume wadaaneta yamiyaadaamethu 'alelu ka'anetame zanede bawathu gizee la'enaziyaa `eweqate latasathute <<'ahune mene 'ala?>> yelaalu 'enazihe 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe laaye 'alaahe yaatamabaacawe zenebaaleewocaacaweneme yatakatalu naacawe
'enaziyaame yatamarute ('alaahe) mamaraatene chamaralaacawe (ka'esaate) mathethabaqiyaacaweneme sathaacawe

sa`aatituneme denegate yametemathaabaacawe makxonewaane 'eneje yethabaabaqaalune? meleketocewaame ba'eregethe mathetawale bamathaacaacaweme gizee maasetaawasaacawe la'enaresu 'enedeete yethaqemaacawaale?
'enaho ka'alaahe leelaa 'amelaake 'alamanoruneme `ewaqe sela sehetateheme lame'emanaaneme mehheratene lamene 'alaaheme mazawaawariyaacehune, maregiyaacehuneme yaaweqaale

'enaziyaame yaamanute sawoce (mataagale yaalabaate) <<suraa 'atewaredeme noro'alene?>> yelaalu yathanakaraceme suraa batawaradacenaa bawesethwame magaadale batawasaa gizee 'enaziyaane balebocaacawe wesethe (yanefeqenaa) bashitaa yaalabaacawene sawoce kamote yakxona makaraa baresu laaye 'eneda wadaqabate sawe 'asetayaayate wadaaneta simalakatu taayaacawaalahe la'enasume wayolaacawe
taazaazhenatenaa malekaame negegere (yeshaalaacawaale) te`ezaazume qurethe bakxona gizee la'alaahe (te`ezaaze) 'ewenatanyoce bakxonu noro la'enaresu yatashaala bakxona nabare
betesheshomume bamedere laaye maabalaashatene zemedenaacehuneme maqurathene kajalaacehune?
'enazihe 'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaragamaacawe, yaadanaqoraacaweme, `aayenocaacaweneme yaawaraacawe naacawe
qure'aaneneme 'ayaasetanatenumene? ba'ewenatu balebocaacawe laaye qulefocwa 'alelubaatene?
'enaziyaa la'enaresu qenu manegade kataberaaraalaacawe baxwaalaa wada xwaalaacawe yatamalasute sayethaane la'enaresu mamalasaacawene shalamalaacawe la'enaresume 'azezanaagaacawe
yehe 'enaresu la'enaziyaa 'alaahe yaawaradawene lathalute <<banagaru kafile 'enetaazazaacexwaalane>> yaalu bamakxonaacawe nawe 'alaaheme madabaqaacawene yaaweqaale
malaa'eketeme fitocaacawenenaa jarebaawocaacawene yamimatu sikxonu bagadaluwaacawe gizee (kxuneetaacawe) 'enedeete yekxonaale?
yehe 'enaresu 'alaahene yaaseqothaawene nagare sela takatalu wedeetaaweneme sela thalu nawe selazihe szeraawocaacawene 'abalaashabaacawe
'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe bashetaa yaalabaacawe 'alaahe qimocaacawene 'alamaawethaatune tharatharune?
bashaaneme noro 'enaresune baasaayanehenaa bameleketaacaweme ba'eregethe baawaqehaacawe nabare negegereneme bamaashamoraacawe ba'eregethe taaweqaacawaalahe 'alaaheme szeraawocaacehune yaaweqaale
ka'enaanetame taagaayocunenaa taagaashocune 'esekamenaaweqe, wareewocaacehuneme 'esekamenegaletse derase ba'eregethe 'enemokeraacexwaalane

'enaziyaa yakaadunaa ka'alaaheme manegade yaagadu la'enaresume qenu manegade katagalatsalaacawe baxwaalaa maleketanyaawene yatakaraakaru 'alaahene bameneme 'ayegoduteme szeraawocaacaweneme ba'eregethe yaabalaashaale
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene tagazu maleketanyaaweneme taazazu szeraawocaacehuneme 'ataabalaashu
'enaziyaa yakaadu, ka'alaaheme manegade yaagadu, kaziyaame 'enaresu kahhaadiwoce kxonawe yamotu 'alaahe la'enaresu bafetsume 'ayemereme
'enaanetame 'ashanaafiwocu setekxonu 'alaahe ka'enaaneta gaare sihone 'atedekamu wada `ereqeme 'atetheru szeraawocaacehuneme fatsemo 'ayaagodelebaacehume
qerebitu hheyewate chaawataanaa zaazaataa becaa naate betaamenume betethanaqaqume menedaawocaacehune yesathaacexwaale ganezabocaacehuneme (hulu) 'ayethayeqaacehume
'ereswane bithayeqaacehunaa ceke bilebaacehu tesasetaalaacehu qimocaacehuneme yaawathaale

nequ! 'enaaneta 'enaziyaa ba'alaahe manegade telagesu zanede yametethetharu naacehu ka'enaanetame wesethe yamisasete sawe 'alela yamisaseteme sawe yamisasetawe baraasu laaye becaa nawe 'alaaheme kabaretee nawe 'enaanetame dekxoce naacehu beteshashume leelocene hhezeboce yelawethaale kaziyaame (baalamataazaze) betheewocaacehu 'ayekxonume
'enyaa laaneta geletse yakxonane makefate kafatenelehe
'alaahe kaxaathi'atehe yaalafawenenaa yamimathaawene laaneta limere tsagaaweneme baaneta laaye limolaa qathetanyaaweneme manegade limaraahe (kafatalehe)
'alaahe beretune 'eredaataa liradaaheme (kafatalehe)

'eresu yaa bame'emenaane leboce wesethe ka'emenataacawe gaare 'emenatene yechameru zanede 'eregaataane yaawarada nawe la'alaaheme yasamaayaatenaa yamedere saraawitoce 'alelute 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

me'emenaanenenaa me'emenaatene kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu liyaagabaacawe kanaresume xaathi'atocaacawene liyaabeselaacawe (bategele 'azazaacawe) yeheme ka'alaahe zanede yakxona taalaaqe maagenyate nawe

ba'alaaheme kefu therethaareene tatharaathaariwocune manaafeqaanenaa manaafeqaatene, wanedoce 'agaariwocaacenenaa seetoce 'agaariwoceneme yaasaqaaye zanede (bategele 'azaza) ba'enaresu laaye kefu kabaabi 'alabaacawe ba'enaresume laaye 'alaahe taqothaabaacawe ragamaacaweme la'enaresume gahanamene 'azagaajalaacawe mamalashaanatewaame kafaace
la'alaaheme yasamaayaatenaa yamedere saraawitoce 'alelute 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe
'enyaa masekaari 'abesaarinaa 'asefaraarime 'aderegane ba'eregethe laakenehe
ba'alaahe letaamenu, bamaleketanyaaweme (letaamenu), leteraduteme, letaakaberuteme, ('alaahene) bathwatenaa kaqatere baxwaalaa letaawadesuteme (laakenawe)

'enaziyaa qaale kidaane yamigaabuhe qaale kidaane yamigaabute 'alaahene becaa nawe ya'alaahe 'eje (xayelu) ka'ejocaacawe balaaye nawe yaafarasame sawe yamiyaafaresawe banafesu laaye becaa nawe ba'eresu laaye 'alaahene qaale kidaane yatagaabaabatene yamolaame sawe taalaaqe menedaane ba'eregethe yesathawaale

ka'a`eraabe sawoce 'enaziyaa (kazamacaa) wada xwaalaa yaqarute la'aneta <<ganezabocaacenenaa beetasabocaacene 'asecagarune; selazihe mehheratene lamenelene;>> yeluhaale balebocaacawe wesethe yaleelawene nagare bamelaasocaacawe yenaagaraalu ('alaahe) <<ba'enaaneta laaye gudaatene bishaa wayeme ba'enaaneta matheqamene bishaa ka'alaahe (lamaagade) la'enaaneta 'anedaacene yamicele maanawe? ba'ewenatu 'alaahe;bameteszasarute hulu wesethe `awaaqi nawe>> balaacawe

yelequneme maleketanyaawenaa me'emanaanocu wada beetasabocaacawe fatsemo 'alamamalasaacawene tharatharaacehu yeheme balebocaacehu wesethe tashalamalaacehu mathefoneme matharethare tharatharaacehu thafiwoce hhezeboceme kxonaacehu
ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe yaalaamaname sawe 'enyaa laakahhaadiwoce 'esaatene 'azagaajetanaale
yasamaayaatenaa yamedere negeszenaame ya'alaahe nawe lamishaawe sawe yemeraale; yamishaaweneme yeqathaale 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

wada zarafaawoce leteyezwate bakxeedaacehu gizee 'enaziyaa wada xwaalaa yaqarute sawoce <<tawune 'enekatalaacehu>> yelwacexwaale (baziheme) ya'alaahene qaale lilawethu yefalegaalu <<fatsemo 'atekataluneme yehene (qaale) kazihe bafite 'alaahe belwale>> balaacawe yelequneme <<temaqanyunaalaacehu>> yelaalume ba'ewenate 'enaresu theqitene 'eneje yamaayaawequ nabaru

ka'a`eraaboce wada xwaalaa laqarute balaacawe - <<yaberetu chekaanee baalabeete wada kxonu hhezeboce (wegiyaa) wada fite tethetharaalaacehu tegaadalwacawaalaacehu; wayeme yesalemaalu betetaazazume 'alaahe malekaame menedaane yesathaacexwaale ka'ahune bafite 'eneda shashaacehu beteshashume 'asaamaamine qethaate yeqathaacexwaale >>

ba`ewere laaye (kazamacaa bamaqetu) xaathi'ate yalabateme ba'anekaasaame laaye xaathi'ate yalabateme babashetanyaame laaye xaathi'ate yalabateme 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamitaazaze sawe kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce yaagabaawaale yamishashaweneme sawe 'asaamaamiwene qethaate yeqathaawaale

kame'emenaanocu bazaafitu szere qaale kidaane bamigaabuhe gizee 'alaahe ba'eregethe wadada balebocaacaweme wesethe yaalawene `awaqa ba'enaresume laaye 'eregaataane 'awarada qerebe yakxonaneme makefate manadaacawe
bezuwoce zarafaawoceneme yamiwasedwacawe yakxonune (manadaacawe) 'alaaheme 'ashanaafi thebabanyaa nawe

'alaahe bezuwocene zarafaawoce yametewasedwacawe yakxonune tasefaa 'adaragalaacehu yeheceneme la'enaaneta 'asecakolalaacehu ka'enaanetame yasawocene 'ejoce kalakalalaacehu (letaamasagenutenaa) lame'emenaaneme melekete 'enedetekxone qathetanyaawene manegade yemaraacehume zanede (yehenene szaraalaacehu)
leelaayetuneme ba'ereswa laaye ganaa yaalecaalaacexwaatene 'alaahe yaawaqaatene (la'enaaneta 'azagaajaate) 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadute (yamakaa sawoce bahhudayebiyaa) batawaguwacehu noro ( lashishite) jarebaawocene baazoru nabare kaziyaame zamademe radaateme 'ayaaganyume
'alaahe yaacene kazihe bafite ba'eregethe yaalafacewene lemaade danagaga la'alaaheme lemaade lawethene 'ataaganyeme
'eresume yaa bamakaa wesethe ba'enaresu laaye kaasecaalacehu baxwaalaa 'ejocaacawene ka'enaaneta laaye 'ejocaacehuneme ka'enaresu laaye yakalakala nawe 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

'enaresu 'enaziyaa yakaadu, katakabarawe masegideme yakalakalwacehu, masewaa'etuneme yataasara sikxone baseferaawe 'enedaayedarese (yakalakalu) naacawe yamaataaweqwaacawe yakxonu me'emanaane wanedocenaa me'emenaate seetoce (kakahhaadiwocu gaare) baalenabaru yaala `eweqate 'enaresune maregathaacehunaa ka'enarasu (bakule) makafaate yaminakaacehu baalekxona noro ('ejocaacehune baalaagadene nabare) 'alaahe yamishaawene sawe ba'ezenatu wesethe yaagabaa zenede ('ejocaacehune 'agada) batalayu noro 'enaziyaane ka'enaresu wesethe yakaadutene 'asaamaamine qethaate baqathaanaacawe nabare

'enaziyaa yakaadute daraayetune yamahayemenatitune daraa balebocaacawe wesethe baadaragu gizee (baqathaanaacawe nabare) 'alaaheme bamaleketanyaawe laayenaa bame'emenaanocu laaye 'eregaataawene 'awarada mathethabaqiyaayetuneme qaale 'aseyaazaacawe ba'ereswame tagabiwoce baalabeetocewaame nabaru 'alaaheme banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe

'alaahe lamaleketanyaawe hhelemune 'ewenatanyaa sikxone 'alaahe yashaa 'eneda kxona tsathetanyoce kxonaacehu raasocaacehune laachetaacehu, 'asaatheraacehume yamaatefaru setekxonu yatakabarawene masegide ba'eregethe tegabaalaacehu; yaalawene ba'eregethe 'ewenate 'adaragalate (ka'erequ) yaalaawaqaacehuteneme nagare `awaqa kaziheme bafite qerebene makefate 'adaraga
'eresu yaa maleketanyaawene bamari matsehhafenaa ba'ewenatanyaa haayemaanote bahaayemaanote hulu laaye liyaaleqawe yalaaka nawe masekaarime ba'alaahe baqaa

ya'alaahe maleketanyaa muhhamade 'enaziyaame ka'eresu gaare yaalute (wadaajocu) bakahhaadiwocu laaye beretuwoce bamakaakalaacawe 'azaanyoce naacawe 'agonebaashoce, sagaajoce kxonawe taayaacawaalahe ka'alaahe cerotaanenaa wedeetaane yefalegaalu meleketaacawe kasegedataacawe falage setekxone bafitocaacawe laaye naate yehe bataweraate (yatanagarawe) thabaayaacawe nawe banejileme wesethe mesaaleeyaacawe qanezalune 'aneda'awathaa 'azemaraanaa, (qanezalu) 'enedaabarataawe, 'enedawafaramenaa, gabareewocune yamiyaasedaneqe kxono ba'agadaawocu laaye tasetakaakelo 'eneda qoma ('azemaraa) nawe (yaabarataacawenaa yaabazaacawe) kahhaadiwocene ba'enaresu liyaaseqoche nawe 'alaaheme 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa ka'enaresu bagowocene yaszarutene mehheratenenaa taalaaqe menedaane tasefaa 'aderegolaacawaale
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe fite (nafesocaacehune) 'ataaseqademu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe sami `awaaqi nawenaa

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! demetsocaacehune kanabiyu demetse balaaye kafe 'ataaderegu kafilaacehume lakafilu 'enedamichohe banegegere laresu 'atechuhu 'enaaneta yamaataawequ setekxonu szeraawocaacehu 'enedaayebalaashu (takalekalu)

'enaziyaa ba'alaahe maleketanyaa zanede demetsocaacawene zeqe yamiyaadaregu 'enazihe 'enaziyaa 'alaahe lebocaacawene laferehaate yafatanaacawe naacawe la'enaresume mehheratenaa taalaaqe menedaa 'alaacawe
'enaziyaa kakefelocu weche kxonawe yamitharuhe 'abezaanyocaacawe 'ayaawequme
wada'enaresume 'eseketewathaa derase 'enaresu bataagasu noro la'enaresu balaache bakxona nabare 'alaaheme 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
'elaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! nagaranyaa wareene biyaamathaalaacehu basehetate laaye kxonaacehu hhezebocene 'enedaategodunaa baszaraacehute nagare laaye tatsatsacoce 'enedaatekxonu 'aragaagethu

bawesethaacehume ya'alaahe maleketanyaa manorune `ewaqu kanagaru babezuwe bikatalaacehu noro ba'eregethe batacagaraacehu nabare gene 'alaahe 'amenatene wadanaaneta 'asewadada balebocaacehume wesathe 'ageethawe kehedatenenaa 'amatseneme 'enebitanyaanateneme wadanaaneta yatathalaa 'adaraga 'enaziyaa ('emenatene yawadadunaa kehhedatane yathalu) 'enaresu qenocu naacawe
ka'alaahe bakxonawe cerotaanaa tsagaa (qenoce naacawe) 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

kame`emenaaneme yakxonu hulate cheferoce bigaadalu bamakaakalaacawe 'asetaarequ kahulatu 'anedanyaayetume baleelaayetu laaye wasane betaalefe yaacene wasane yametaalefawene wada 'alaahe te`ezaaze 'esekametemalase derase tagaadalu betemalaseme bamakaakalaacawe batekekele 'asetaarequ banagaru hulu 'asetakaakelume 'alaahe 'asetakaakaayocene yewadaalenaa
me'emanaanoce wanedemaamacoce naacawe bahulate wanedemocaacehume makaakale 'asetaarequ yetaazanelaacehume zanede 'alaahene feru

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! wanedoce kawanedoce 'ayeqaledu ka'enaresu yabalathu likxonu yekajalaalenaa seetoceme kaseetoce ('ayesaalaqu) ka'enaresu yabalathu likxonu yekajalaalenaa nafesocaacehuneme 'ataanaweru bamathefo semoceme 'atetharaaru ka'emenate baxwaalaa yamaamatse seme kafaa yaaletatsatsatame sawe 'enaziyaa 'enaresu badaayocu naacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! katherethaaree bezuwene raaqu; katherethaaree kafilu xaathi'ate nawenaa nawereneme 'atekataatalu kafilaacehume kafilune 'ayemaa 'anedanyaacehu yawanedemune segaa yamota kxono libalaawe yewadaalene? (mabelaatune) thalaacehuteme; (hhameetuneme thelute) 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe tsatsatene taqabaaye 'azaanye nawenaa

'enaaneta sawoce hoye! 'enyaa kawanedenaa kaseete fatharenaacehu 'enedetetawaawaqume gosaawocenaa nagadoce 'adaragenaacehu 'alaahe zanede balaachaacehu bathaame 'alaahene fariyaacehu nawe 'alaahe geletsene `awaaqi wesetheneme `awaaqi nawe

ya`arabe zalaanoce <<'amenanaale>> 'alu <<'alaamanaacehume; gene salemanaale balu <<'emenatume balebocaacehu wesethe ganaa (thaleqo) 'alegabaame 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme betetaazazu kaszeraawocaacehu meneneme 'ayaagodelebaacehume 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa>> balaacawe

('ewenatanyaawocu) me'emenaane 'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamale'ekatanyaawe yaamanute kaziyaame yaaletatharaatharute baganezabocaacawenaa banafeso caacaweme ba'alaahe manegade yataagalute becaa naacawe 'enaziyaa 'enasu 'ewenatanyocu naacawe

<<'alaahe basamaayaate wesethe yaalawenenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawene hulu yamiyaaweqe sikxone 'alaahene bahaayemaanotaacehu taasetaawequ taalaacehune?>> balaacawe 'alaaheme banagaru hulu `awaaqi nawe

bamaselamaacawe ba'aneta laaye yematsaadaqaalu <<baselemenaacehu banee laaye 'atematsaadaqu; yelequneme 'alaahe wada 'emenate sela maraacehu yematsadaqebaacexwaale; 'ewenatanyoce betekxonu>> (mamatsaadaqe la'alaahe nawe) balaacawe
'alaahe yasamaayaatenenaa yamederene ruqe mesathire yaaweqaale; 'alaaheme yametesarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe
qa (qaafe) batakabarawe qure'aane 'emelaalahu (bamuhhamade 'alaamanume)
yelequneme kanasu gosaa yakxona 'asefaraari sela mathaalaacawe tadanaqu kahhaadiwocume <<yehe 'asedanaaqi nagare nawe>> 'alu
<<bamotenenaa `afare bakxone gizee ('enemalasaalane?) yehe ruqe yakxona mamalase nawe;>> ('alu)
ka'enaresu ('akaale) medere yametaagodelawene ba'eregethe `aweqanaale 'enyaame zanede thabaaqi matsehhafe 'alela
('aletamalakatume) yelequneme baqure'aane bamathaalaacawe gizee 'asetabaabalu 'enaresume batamaataa nagare wesathe naacawe
wada samaayeme kabalaayaacawe setekxone la'ereswa meneme qadaadaawoce yaleelwate kxonaa 'enedeete 'eneda ganabaanaatenaa (bakawaakebete) 'enedaageethenaate 'aletamalakatumene?
medereneme zaragaanaate ba'ereswame wesethe gaaraawocene thaalenebaate bawesethwame kamiyaasedasete `aayenate hulu 'abaqalene
(yehenene yaadaragenawe) tamalaashe lakxona baariyaa hulu lamaasaayatenaa lamaaseganezabe nawe
kasamaayeme berukene wehaa 'awaradene ba'eresume 'atekeletocenenaa yamitaachadene ('azemaraa) feree 'abaqalene
zamebaabaaneme razhaazhime la'ereswa yatadaraaraba 'enebuthe yaalaate setekxone ('abaqalene)
labaarocu sisaaye tekxone zanede ('azagaajanaate) ba'eresume yamotacene 'agare hheyaawe 'adaragenebate (kamaqaabere) mawethaateme 'enedazihu nawe
ka'enaresu bafite yanuhhe hhezebocenaa yarasase sawoce; samudeme 'asetabaabalu
`aademe fare`oneme; yaluthe wanedemoceme;
ya'ayekate sawoceme yatubeba`e hhezeboceme hulume malekatanyocune 'asetabaabalu zaacaayeeme taragaagathabaacawe
bafitanyaawe mafethare dakamene? ba'ewenatu 'enaresu ka'adise mafethare bamatharaathare wesethe naacawe
saweneme nafesu (bahhasaabu) yametaachaawetawene yamenaaweqe senekxone ba'eregethe fatharenawe; 'enyaame kadame gaanu jemaate yebalethe wadaresu qerebe nane
hulatu qaale taqabaayoce (malaa'ekete) kaqanyenaa kageraa taqamaachoce kxonawe bamiqabalu gizee ('asetaawese)
kaqaale meneme 'ayenaagareme ba'athagabu tathabaabaaqinaa zegeju yakxonu (malaa'ekete) yaalubate bikxone 'eneje
yamoteme makaraa 'ewenatune nagare taamathaalace (sawe hoye) - <<yehe yaa karesu teshashawe yanabarekawe nawe>> (yebaalaale)
baqanedume wesethe yenenafaale yaa (qane) yazaacaawe (mafatsamiyaa) qane nawe
nafeseme hulu ka'ereswa gaare najinaa masekaari yaalabaate kxonaa temathaalace
<<kazihe nagare ba'eregethe bazenegaatee wesethe nabareke shifaaneheneme kaaneta laaye galathenelehe selazihe zaaree `aayenehe selataame nawe>> (yebaalaale)
quraanyaaweme (male'ake) <<yehe yaa 'enee zanede yaalawe qaraabi nawe>> yelaale
<<mogadanyaa kahhaadine hulu bagahaname wesethe thaalu >>
<<labago szeraa kalekaaye, badaaye, tatharaathaari yakxonane hulu;>> (thaalu)
<<yaanene ka'alaahe gaare leelaane 'amelaake yaadaragawene baberetu qethaate wesethe thaalute;>> (yebaalaale)
quraanyaawe (sayethaane) <<geetaacene hoye! 'enee 'alaasaasaatekuteme gene (raasu) baruqe sehhetate wesethe nabare>> yelaale
('alaahe) <<wada'enaaneta zaacaane ba'eregethe yaaseqadameku sekxone 'enee zanede 'atechaqaachaqu>> yelaacawaale
<<qaalu 'enee zanede 'ayelawatheme 'eneeme labaarocee fatsemo badaaye 'ayedalahume>> (yelaacawaale)
lagahaname <<molaashene? yamenelebatenenaa chemaari 'alane? yametelebatene qane>> ('asethaneqeqaacawe)
ganateme 'alaahene lafarute 'eruqe baalekxona seferaa teqeqarabaalace
<<yehe wada 'alaahe tamalaashenaa (hhegegaatune) thabaaqi lakxona hulu yataqatharaacehute nawe>> (yebaalaalu)
<<'alerahhemaanene baruqu kxono lafaraanaa banetsuhhe lebe lamathaa>> (teqeqarabaalace)
<<basalaame gebwate yehe yamazawetariyaa qane nawe>> (yebaalaalu)
lanaresu bawesethwa sikxonu yamishute hulu 'alelaacawe 'enyaame zanede chemaari 'alela

ka'enaresume (kaqurayeshoce) bafite kakefela zamanaate hhezeboce bezuwocene 'enaresu baxayaalenate ka'enaresu yebalethe yabaratu yakxonutene (maamelachaa felagaa) baya'agarocume yamaramarutene 'athefetanaale maamelachaa 'alane?
bazihe wesathe la'eresu lebe laalawe wayeme 'eresu (balebu) yatathaada kxono (wadaminababelate) jorowene lathaala sawe gesaatsee 'alabate
samaayaatenenaa mederene bamakaakalaacawe yaalaweneme hulu basedesete qanaate wesethe ba'eregethe fatharene dekaameme meneme 'alenakaaneme
bamiluteme laaye taagasze; geetaaheneme kamaamasegane gaare tzahhaye kamawethaatwa bafite kamagebaatwame bafite 'awadesawe
kaleelitume 'awadesawe kasegedatoceme baxwaalaawoce ('awadesawe)
(yaminagarehene) 'adaametheme thariwe kaqerebe seferaa bamitharaabate qane (kamaqaaberaacawe yewathaalu)
chukxatitune ba'ewenate yamisamubate qane yaa (kamaqaabere) yamawechaawe qane nawe
'enyaa 'enyaawe hheyaawe 'enaadaregaalane 'enegadelaalaneme mamalashaame wada'enyaa becaa nawe
yamifathenu kxonawe medere ka'enaresu laaye yametesanathaathaqebate qane (yamawechaawe qane nawe) yehe ba'enyaa laaye gare yakxona masabesabe nawe
'enyaa yamilutene hulu `awaaqi nane 'anetame ba'enaresu laaye 'asegadaaje 'ayedalaheme selazihe zaacaayane yamifaraane sawe baqure'aane 'asetaawese
mabatanene bataanyoce bakxonute (nafaasoce)
kabaade (zenaamene) tashakaamiwoce bakxonuteme (damanaawoce)
gare (maneshaalalene) taneshaalaayoce bakxonuteme (marekaboce)
nagarene hulu 'akafaafaayoce bakxonuteme (malaa'ekete) 'emelaalahu
yameteqatharute (teneszaa'ee) 'ewenate nawe
('enedayaszeraawe) waagaane maagenyateme; xwaanye nawe; (yamaayeqare nawe)
ya(kawaakebete) manegadoce baalabeete bakxonacewe samaaye 'emelaalahu
'enaaneta (yamakaa sawoce) batalayaaya qaale wesethe naacehu
karesu yamizezore sawe yezezoraale

manaafeqaanenaa manaafeqaate la'enaziyaa la'amanute <<tamalekatune; kaberehaanaacehu 'enaabaraalanenaa>> yamilubatene qane ('asetaawese) <<wada xwaalaacehu tamalasu berehaaneneme falegu>> yebaalaalu gebiwe bawesethu cerotaa (ganate) yaalabate wecheweme kabakulu seqaaye ('esaate) yaalabate yakxona (dajaafe baalawe 'athere)
