<<zaareeme ka'enaaneta beezaa 'ayewasedeme ka'enaziyaa kakaaduteme manoriyaacehu 'esaate naate 'ereswa tagabiyaacehu naate mene tekafaame mamalashaa!>> (yelwacawaale)

lanaziyaa la'amanute la'alaahe tagesaatsenaa kaqure'aaneme lawaradawe lebocaacawe lifaru 'eneda'enaziyaame bafite matsehhafene 'eneda tasathutenaa ba'enaresu laaye gizee 'enedarazamabaacawe lebocaacaweme 'eneda daraqute laayekxonu (gizeewe) 'aleqarabamene? ka'enaresume bezuwocu 'amatsanyoce naacawe
'alaahe mederene kamotace baxwaalaa hheyaawe yamiyaadaregaate makxonune `ewaqu taawaqu zanede 'aneqatsocene la'enaaneta ba'eregethe 'aberaaraanelaacehu
yamatsawatu wanedocenaa, yamatsawatu seetoce, la'alaaheme malekaamene bedere yaabadaru la'enaresu malekaame menedaa 'alelaacawe

'enaziyaame ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocu yaamanute 'enaziyaa 'enaresu bathaame 'ewenatanyocu bageetaacaweme zanede masekaariwocu naacawe la'enaresu menedaacawe berehaanaacaweme 'alelaacawe 'enaziyaame yakaadute ba'aneqatsocaaceneme yaasetabaabalute 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe

qerebitu hheyewate chawaataanaa zaazaataa, maageechaame, bamakaakalaacehume mafokaakariyaa, baganezabocenaa balejoceme bezaate mabalaalachaa becaa makxonewaane `ewaqu ('ereswa) baqaayu gabareewocene 'enedamiyaasedasete zenaame, kaziyaame baqaayu 'enedamidareqenaa garetheto 'enedametaayawe, kaziyaame yatasabaabara 'enedamikxone bethee naate, bamacharashaayetume `aalame beretu qethaate ka'alaaheme mehheratenaa wedeetaa 'alela yaqerebitume hheyewate yamataalayaa theqeme 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalaceme

kageetaacehu wada kxonace mehherate, waredwa 'eda samaayenaa medere warede wada honaceme ganate tasheqadaadamu la'enaziyaa ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyocu laamanute tazagaajetaalace yehe ya'alaahe cerotaa nawe lamishaawe sawe yesathawaale 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe
bamedereme banafesocaacehume makaraa (maaneneme) 'atenakaame saanefatheraate bafite bamatsehhafe yatamazagabace betekxone 'eneje yehe ba'alaahe laaye gare nawe
(yehe maasaawaqaacene) baamalathaacehu tsagaa laaye 'enedaataazenu 'alaaheme basathaacehu nagare (bate`ebite) 'enedaatedasatu nawe 'alaaheme kuraatanyaane guranyaane hulu 'ayewademe
('enaresume) 'enaziyaa yamisasetunaa sawoceneme basesete yamiyaazezu naacawe (ka'ewenate) yamishasheme sawe (thefaatu baraasu laaye nawe) 'alaaheme 'eresu tabeqaaqi mesegune nawe

maleketanyocaacenene bageletse maaserajaawoce ba'eregethe laakene sawoceme batekekele qathe 'enedilu matsehhafocenenaa mizaanene wada'enaresu 'awaradene; berateneme bawesethu beretu xayelenaa lasawoceme mathaqaaqamiyaawoce yaalelubate sikxone 'awaradene ('enedithaqamubate) 'alaaheme haayemaanotunenaa maleketanyocune baruqe kxono yamiradaawene sawe liyaaweqe (ligaletse 'awaradawe) 'alaahe beretu 'ashanaafi nawenaa
nuhhene, beraahimeneme ba'eregethe laakene bazarocaacaweme wesethe nabiyenatenenaa matsehhafocene 'adaragene ka'enaresume qene 'alela ka'enaresume bezuwocu 'amatsanyoce naacawe

kaziyaame badukaawocaacawe laaye maleketanyocaacenene 'asekataatalene yamareyamene leje `isaaneme 'asekatalene nejileneme sathanawe ba'enaziyaame batakatalute (sawoce) leboce wesathe malazabenenaa 'ezenatene, 'adise yafatharuwaateneme menekusenaa 'adaragene ba'enaresu laaye (menekusenaane) 'aletsaafenaateme gene ya'alaahene wedeetaa lamafalage silu (fatharuwaate) tagabi 'athabaabaqwaaneme; 'alethabaqwaateme ka'enaresume la'enaziyaa laamanute menedaacawene sathanaacawe ka'enaresume bezuwocu 'amatsanyoce naacawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru bamale'eketanyaaweme 'emanu kacerotaawe hulatene kefeloce yesathaacexwaalenaa la'enaanetame ba'eresu yametekxeedubate yakxona berehaanene yaadaregelaacexwaale la'enaanetame yemeraale 'alaaheme mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

(yeheme) yamatsehhafu sawoce ka'alaahe cerotaa bameneme laaye yamaayecelu makxonaacawene cerotaame ba'alaahe 'eje nawe lamishaawe sawe yesathawaale maalatene 'enediyaawequ nawe; 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe

'alaahe yaziyaacene babaalwa (nagare) yametakaraakarehenenaa wada 'alaahe yametaasamutawene (seete) qaale ba'eregethe samaa 'alaaheme (banegegere) mamalaalasaacehune yesamaale 'alaahe sami tamalekaace nawenaa

'enaziyaa ka'enaaneta wesethe kamisetocaacawe 'enedanaatocaacene jarebaawoce yekxunubene bamaalate yamimelu 'enaresu 'enaatocaacawe 'ayedalume 'enaatocaacawe 'eniyaa yawaladuwaacawe becaa naacawe 'enaresume (bazihe qaale) kanegegere yatathalaanenaa weshatene ba'eregethe yenaagaraalu 'alaaheme (lamitsatsate) yeqere baaye mahhaari nawe

'enaziyaame kamisetocaacawe 'enedanaatocaacene jarebaawoce kxunubene bamaalate yamimelu kaziyaame wada tanaagarute yamimalasu saayenakaaku bafite chaaneqaane natsaa maawethaate banaresu laaye 'alabaacawe 'enaho ba'eresu tegasatsubataalacehu 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesethe `aawaaqi nawe

yaalaaganyame sawe kamanakaakataacawe bafite hulate yatakataatalu warocene matsome 'alabate yaalecaalame sawe sedesaa dekxocene maabelaate ('alabate) yehe ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe 'enedetaamenu nawe yeheceme ya'alaahe hhegegaate naate lakahhaadiwoceme 'asaamaami qethaate 'alelaacawe

geletsoce maaserajaawocene yaawaradene senekxone 'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamikaraakaru 'enaziyaa ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute 'enedatawaaradu yewaaradaalu lakahhaadiwoceme 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alelaacawe
'alaahe hulaacaweneme bamiqaseqaasaacawe qane (yeqathaacawaale) yaszaruteneme hulu yenageraacawaale yarasute sikxonu 'alaahe `aweqotaale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye `awaaqi nawe

'alaahe basamaayaate wesethe yaalawene bamedereme wesathe yaalawene hulu yamiyaaweqe makxonune 'ataayemene? kaszosete sawoce mashokaashoke 'ayenoreme 'eresu 'araatanyaacawe bikxone 'eneje ka'ameseteme ('ayenoreme) 'eresu sedesetanyaacawe bikxone 'eneje kaziyaa yaanasame yabazaame ('ayenoreme) 'eresu yateme bikxonu 'eneji kaziyaame bateneszaa'ee qane yaszarutene hulu yenageraacawaale 'alaahe nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawe

wada'enaziyaa (bamathefo) kamashokaashoke wada takalakalute, kaziyaame ka'eresu wada takalakalute nagare wadamimalasute, baxaathi'atenaa denebare bamaalafe maleketanyaawene bamaqaawame wadamineshokaashokute 'alaayahemene? (salaame lilu) bamathuheme gizee 'alaahe ba'eresu baalaanaagarahe qaale yaanaageruhaale banafesocaacaweme wesethe (nabiye kakxoneke) <<bamenelawe nagare 'alaahe 'ayeqathaaneme noro'alene?>> yelaalu gahaname yamigabwate sikxonu baqiyaacawe naate mene tekafaame mamalashaa!

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! bataneshokaashokaacehu gizee baxaathi'atenaa wasanene bamaalafe, maleketanyaaweneme bamaqaawame 'ateneshokaashoku gene babago szeraanaa 'alaahene bamaferaate tawayaayu yaaneneme wada'eresu yametesabasabubatene 'alaahene feru

(bamathefo) maneshokaashoke kasayethaane becaa nawe 'enaziyaa yaamanute yaazenu zanede (yeqasaqesawaale) ba'alaahe faqaade kaalekxona baqare bameneme 'ayegodaacaweme ba'alaahe laayeme 'amaanyoce yethagu

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! la'enaaneta bamaqamachaawoce seferaa tasefaafu batabaalaacehu gizee (seferaane) 'asefu 'alaahe yaasafaalaacexwaalenaa tanasu batabaalaacehume gizee tanasu 'alaahe kanaaneta 'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa 'enaziyaaneme `eweqatene yatasathutene badarajaawoce kafe yaadaregaale 'alaaheme bametesarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! maleketanyaawene batawayaayaacehu gizee kamawayaayataacehu bafite metsewaatene 'aseqademu yehe la'enaaneta malekaame nawe 'atherime nawe baataaganyume 'alaahe mahhaari 'azaanye nawe

kaweyeyetaacehu bafite metsewaatocene kamaaseqadame (dehenatene) faraacehune? baaleszaraacehume gizee 'alaahe ka'enaaneta tsatsatene yataqabala sikxone solaatene segadu zakaaneme sethu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme taazazu 'alaaheme wesethe `awaaqi nawe

wada'enaziyaa 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yataqothaabaacawene hhezeboce wada tawadaajute (manaafeqaane) 'alaayakxemene? 'enaresu ka'enaaneta 'ayedalume ka'enaresume 'ayedalume 'enaresume yamiyaawequ sikxonu baweshate laaye yemelaalu
'alaahe la'enaresu beretune qethaate 'azagaaja 'enaresu yeszarute yanabarute szeraa menenyaa kafaa!
mahhaalocaacawene gaashaa 'aderegawe yaazu ka'alaaheme manegade 'agadu selazihe la'enaresu 'awaaraaje qethaate 'alelaacawe
ganezabocaacawenaa lejocaacawe ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneneme ka'enaresu 'ayaadenwacaweme 'enaziyaa ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe 'enaresu ba'ereswa wesethe zawetaariwoce naacawe

'alaahe yatasabasabu kxonawe bamiyaasenasaacawe qane la'enaaneta 'enedamimelulaacehume 'enaresu (bamithaqeme) nagare laaye makxonaacawene yamiyaasebu kxonawe la'eresu bamimelubate qane ('awaaraaje qethaate 'alelaacawe) nequ! 'enaresu weshataamocu 'enaresu naacawe
ba'enaresu laaye sayethaane tashomabaacawe 'alaaheneme maasetaawasene 'aserasaacawe 'enaziyaa yasayethaane cheferoce naacawe nequ! yasayethaane cheferoce kasaariwocu 'enaresu naacawe
'enaziyaa 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamikaraakarute 'enaziyaa bathaame bawaraadocu wesethe naacawe
'alaahe - <<'enee ba'eregethe 'ashanefaalahu, maleketanyoceeme (yaashanefaalu)>> sile; tsefwale 'alaahe beretu 'ashanaafi nawenaa

ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamenutene hhezeboce 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene yamikaraakarutene sawoce; 'abaatocaacawe, wayeme lejocaacawe, wayeme wanedemocaacawe, wayeme zamadocaacawe bikxonume 'enekwaa yamiwadaaju kxonawe 'ataaganyaacaweme 'enaziyaa balebocaacawe wesethe 'emenatene tsefwale ka'eresume bakxona manefase dagefwacawaale kaszerocaacaweme wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zawetaariwoce sikxonu yaagabaacawaale 'alaahe ka'enaresu wadwale ka'eresume wadawaale 'enaziyaa ya'alaahe hhezeboce naacawe nequ! ya'alaahe hhezeboca 'enaresu menyotaacawene yamiyaaganyu naacawe
basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawe hulu la'alaahe 'amogasa 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'eresu yaa kamatsehhafu sawoce 'enaziyaane yakaadutene kabeetocaacawe lamajamariyaawe maawethaate yaawathaacawe nawe mawethaataacawene 'alaasabaacehume 'enaresume meshegocaacawe ka'alaahe (xayele) yamikalaakalulaacawe makxonaacawene 'asabu 'alaaheme kaalaasabute seferaa mathaabaacawe balebocaacaweme wesethe marebadebadene thaalabaacawe beetocaacawene ba'ejocaacawenaa bame'emenaanocu 'ejoce yaafaresaalu 'asetawelume ya'a'emero baalabeetoce hoye!
ba'enaresume laaye 'alaahe ka'agare mawethaatene baaletsaafa noro baqerebitu `aalame baqathaacawe nabare la'enaresume bamacharashaayetu (`aalame) ya'esaate qethaate 'alelaacawe
yehe 'enaresu 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaawene bamakaraakaraacawe nawe 'alaaheneme yamikaraakare sawe (yeqathaawaale) 'alaahe qethaata beretu nawenaa
kazanebaabaa (katamere zaafe) maanenyaawaame yaqorathaacexwaate wayeme bagenedocwa laaye yaqomace kxonaa yatawaacexwaate ba'alaahe faqaade nawe 'amatsanyocaneme yaawaarede zanede (bamaqurathe faqada)

ka'enaresume (ganezabe) bamale'eketanyaawe laaye 'alaahe yamalasawe ba'eresu laaye farasocenenaa gemalocene 'alaasegaalabaacehubateme gene 'alaahe maleketanyocune bamishaawe sawe laaye yeshomaale 'alaaheme banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe

'alaahe kakatamocu sawoce (habete) bamaleketanyaawe laaye yamalasawe (habete) ka'enaaneta wesethe bahabetaamocu makaakale tazawaawaari 'enedaayekxone la'alaahenaa lamaleketanyaawe, lazemedenaa baalabeeteme, 'abaate laleelaacawe lejoceme, ladekxoceme, lamanegadanyaame (yamisesathe) nawe maleketanyaaweme yasathaacehune (maanenyaaweneme) nagare yaazute ka'eresume yakalakalaacehune nagare takalekalu 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe qethaata beretu nawenaa

la'enaziyaa ya'alaahene cerotaanaa wedeetaawene yamifalegu, 'alaahenenaa maleketanyaaweneme yamiradu kxonawe ka'agarocaacawenaa kaganezabocaacawe latawathute sedatanyoce dekxoce (yesesathaale) 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'ewenatanyocu naacawe

'enaziyaame kabafitaacawe 'agaritune manoriyaa yaadaragute 'emenateneme yalamadute wada'enaresu yatasadadutene sawoce yewadaalu (sedatanyocu) katasathuteme nagare balebocaacawe wesethe qereetaane 'ayaaganyume ba'enaresu laaye cegere binorebaacaweme banafesocaacawe laaye leelaawene yemarethaalu yanafesuneme nefegate yamithabaqe sawe 'enaziyaa 'enasu menyotaacawene 'agenyiwoce naacawe

'enaziyaame kabaxwaalaacawe yamathute <<geetaacene hoye! la'enyaame la'enaziyaame ba'emenate laqadamune wanedemocaacene mehherate 'aderege balebocaaceneme wesethe la'enaziyaa la'amanute (sawoce) thelaacaane 'ataaderege geetaacene hoye! 'aneta rexeruhe 'azaanye nahenaa>> yelaalu

wada'enaziyaa wada nafaqute 'alaayahemene? kamatsehhafu sawoce wesethe la'enaziyaa lakaadute wanedemocaacawe (ka'agare) <<betebaararu 'aberanaacehu 'enewathaalane ba'enaanetame (gudaaye) 'anedeneme bafetsume 'anetaazazeme betegadelume ba'eregethe 'eneradaacexwaalane>> yelwacawaale 'alaaheme 'enaresu weshataamoce makxonaacawene yemasakeraale
biwathethu 'aberawaacawe 'ayewathume; bigadalume 'ayeraduwaacaweme biradwacaweme (lasheshete) jarebaacawene yaazoraalu kaziyaame 'eredaataane 'ayaaganyume
'enaaneta balebocaacawe wesethe bamaasefaraate ka'alaahe yeleqe yabarataacehu naacehu yehe 'enaresu yamaayaawequ hhezeboce bamakxonaacawe nawe

batamashagu katamoce wesethe wayeme ka'atheroce jarebaa kxonawe 'eneje; yatasabasabu kxonawe 'ayewaaguwaacehume xayelaacawe bamakaakalaacawe beretu nawe lebocaacawe yatabataatanu sikxonu yatasabasabu naacawe belahe tetharatheraacawaalahe yehe 'enasu 'a'emero yaleelaacawe hhezeboce bamakxonaacawe nawe
(betheeyaacawe) 'eneda'enaziyaa ka'enasu bafite baqerebe gizee yanagaraacawene qethaate 'enedaqamasute bethee nawe la'enaresume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alaacawe
'eneda sayethaane bethee lasaweyawe <<kaade>> baalawe gizeenaa bakaadame gizee <<'enee ka'aneta netsuhhe nanye 'enee 'alaahene ya`aalamaatene geetaa 'efaraalahu>> 'enedaalawe nawe
macharashaacaweme 'enaresu bawesethu zawetaariwoce sikxonu ba'esaate wesethe makxone nawe yeheme yabadaayoce waagaa nawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! 'alaahene feru maanenyaayetume nafese lanaga yaaseqadamacewene temalekate 'alaaheneme feru 'alaahe bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe
'enedanaziyaame 'alaahene 'enedarasutenaa nafesocaacawene 'enedaaserasaacawe (sawoce) 'atekxunu 'enaziyaa 'enaresu 'amatsanyocu naacawe
ya'esaate gwaadocenaa yaganate gwaadoce 'ayetakaakalume yaganate gwaadoce 'enaresu menyotaacawene 'agenyiwoce naacawe
yehenene qure'aane bataraaraa laaye baawaradenawe noro ka'alaahe feraacaa (yatanasaa) tawaaraaje tasanethaaqi kxono baayakxawe nabare yeheceneme mesaalee yegamagemu zanede lasawoce 'enegaletzaalane
'eresu 'alaahe nawe; yaa ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yaleela, ruqunenaa qerebune `awaaqi yakxona nawe 'eresu 'ejege bathaame rexeruhe bathaame 'azaanye nawe

'eresu 'alaahe nawe yaa ka'eresu baqare leelaa 'amelaake yaleela, neguszu kagudelate hulu yatharaawe, yasalaame baalabeetu, tsathetaane sachiwe, baarocune thabaaqiwe, 'ashanaafiwe, xayaalu, kuruwe nawe 'alaahe kamiyaagaarute hulu tharaa
'eresu 'alaahe fathaariwe (kamenete) 'aseganyiwe, qeretsene 'asaamaariwe nawe la'eresu malekaamoce semoce 'alelute basamaayaatenaa bamedereme yaalawe hulu la'eresu yaamogesaale 'eresume

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! thalaatoceenenaa thalaatocaacehune wadaajoce 'aderegacehu 'ateyaazu ka'ewenatu yamathaalaacehune haayemaanote ba'eregethe yakaadu sikxonu wedeetaane wada'enaresu taadaresaalaacehu maleketanyaawenenaa 'enaanetane ba'alaahe bageetaacehu selaamanaacehu (kamakaa) yaawathaalu bamanegadee lamataagalenaa wedeetaayeene lamafalage yawathaacehu 'enedakxonaacehu (wadaajoce 'aderegaacehu 'ateyaazuwaacawe) 'enee yametedabequtenenaa yametegaletsutene hulu yamaaweqe sekxone wada'enaresu bafeqere temasaatharaalaacehu ka'enaanetame (yehenene) yamiszaraa sawe qathetanyaawene manegade ba'eregethe tasaasaata
biyaashanefwacehu la'enaaneta thalaatoce yekxonaalu 'ejocaacawenenaa melaasocaacaweneme wada'enaaneta bakefu yezaragaalu betekedume tamanyu
zamadocaacehume, lejocaacehume bateneszaa'ee qane 'ayethaqemwacehume; ('alaahe) bamakaakalaacehu yelayaale 'alaaheme yameteszarutene hulu tamalekaace nawe

baberaahimenaa ba'enaziyaa ka'eresu gaare banabarute (me'emenaane) malekaame makatale 'alacaacehu lahhezebocaacawe <<'enyaa ka'enaaneta ka'alaahe leelaa kametegegazuteme netsuhhoce nane ba'enaaneta kaadene ba'alaahe 'anede becaa sikxone 'esekametaamenu derase ba'enyaanaa ba'enaaneta makaakale thabenaa thelaacaa zawatere tagalatsa >> baalu gizee (malekaame makatale 'alacaacehu) beraahime la'abaatu <<'enee la'aneta ka'alaahe (qethaate) meneme yamaalethaqeme sekxone la'aneta ba'eregethe mehheratene 'elamenelekxaalahu>> maalatu becaa siqare <<geetaacene hoye! ba'aneta laaye tamakaane wada 'anetame tamalasene mamalashaame wada 'aneta becaa nawe;>> (baalawe takatalute)
geetaacene hoye! la'enaziyaa lakaadute sawoce mamokariyaa 'ataaderegane la'enyaame mehherate 'aderegelene geetaacene hoye! 'aneta 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe 'aneta becaa nahe
la'enaaneta 'alaahenenaa yamacharashaawene qane lamifaraa sawe ba'enaresu malekaame makatale 'alelaacehu yamizoreme sawe (raasune yegodaale) 'alaahe tabeqaaqiwe mesegunu 'eresu becaa nawenaa
banaanetanaa ba'enaziyaa ka'enaresu gaare batathaalaacehute sawoce makaakale 'alaahe mafaaqarene liyaadarege yecaalaale 'alaaheme caaye nawe 'alaaheme bathaame 'azaanye nawe

ka'enaziyaa bahaayemaanote kaaletagaadalwacehu ka'agarocaacehume kaalaawathuwaacehu (kahhaadiwoce) malekaame betewelulaacawenaa wada'enaresu betaasetakaakelu 'alaahe 'ayekalakelaacehume 'alaahe tekekelanyocene yewadaalenaa

'alaahe yamikalakelaacehu ka'enaziyaa bahaayemaanote katagaadaluwaacehu, kabeetocaacehume kaawathuwaacehu, 'enaanetame bamaawethaate laaye karadute (kahhaadiwoce) 'enedaatewadaajuwaacawe becaa nawe wadaaje yamiyaadaregwaacaweme sawoce 'enaziyaa 'enaresu badaayocu naacawe

'elaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! me'emenaate sedatanyoce kxonawe bamathwacehu gizee (lahaayemaanote masadadaacawene) fatenuwaacawe 'alaahe ba'emenataacawe yebalethe `awaaqi nawe 'amaanyoceme makxonaacawene betewequ wada kahhaadiwocu 'atemalesuwaacawe 'enaresu (seetocu) la'enaresu yatafaqadu 'ayedalumenaa 'enaresume (wanedocu) la'enaresu 'ayefaqadumenaa yaawathuteneme ganezabe sethwacawe maheraacaweneme basathaacexwaacawe gizee betaagabuwaacawe ba'enaaneta laaye xaathi'ate yalabaacehume yakahhaadiwocuneme seetoce yagaabecaa qaale kidaanoce 'ateyaazu; yaawathaacehuteneme ganezabe thayequ yaawathuteneme yethayequ yehe ya'alaahe ferede nawe bamakaakalaacehu yefaredaale 'alaaheme `awaaqi thebabanyaa nawe

kamisetocaacehume wada kahhaadiwocu 'anedaacawe biyaamalethwacehu qathelome betezametubaacawe la'enaziyaa misetocaacawe lakxeedubaacawe (sawoce) yaawathutene bethee sethwacawe yaaneneme 'enaaneta baresu yaamanaacehubatene 'alaahene feru

'aneta nabiyu hoye! me'emenaatocu ba'alaahe meneneme laayaagaaru, laayesarequme laayaamanazerume, lejocaacawene laayegadelume, ba'ejocaacawenaa ba'egerocaacawe makaakaleme yamiqathaathefute yakxonane xaathi'aate laayaamathu (laayeszaru) babagome szeraa te`ezaazehene laayethesu qaale kidaane ligabulehe bamathuhe gizee kidaane tagaabaacawe la'enaresume 'alaahene mehherate lamenelaacawe 'alaahe bathaame mahhaari 'azaanye nawenaa

'elaaneta yaamanaacahu hoye! 'alaahe ba'enaresu laaye yataqothaabaacawene hhezeboce 'atewadaaju kahhaadiwoce kamaqaabere sawoce tasefaa 'enedaqorathu kamacharashaayetu `aalame (menedaa) ba'eregethe tasefaa qorethawaale
basamaayaate wesethe yaalawe bamedereme wesethe yaalawe hulu la'alaahe 'amogasza 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe
'elaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! yamaateszarutene nagare lamene tenaagaraalaacehu?
yamaateszarune nagare manaagaraacehu 'alaahe zanede mathalaatu talaqa
'alaahe 'enaziyaane 'enaresu leke 'eneda tanaasa genebe yatasalafu kxonawe bamanegadu (bahaayemaanotu) yamigaadalutene yewadaale

musaame lahhezebocu <<hhezebocee hoye! 'enee wada'enaaneta ya'alaahe maleketanyaa makxoneene ba'eregethe yametaawequ setekxonu lamene taasaqaayunyaalaacehu?>> baala gizee ('asetaawese ka'ewenate) batazanabalume gizee 'alaahe lebocaacawene 'azanabalaacawe 'alaaheme 'amatsanyocene hhezeboce 'ayaaqanaame

yamareyame leje `isaame - <<ya'eseraa'eele lejoce hoye! 'enee kataweraate bafitee yaalawene yamaaragaagethenaa ka'enee baxwaalaa bamimathaawe maleketanyaa semu 'ahhemade bakxonawe yamaabasere sekxone wada'enaaneta (yatalaakehu) ya'alaahe maleketanyaa nanye>> baala gizee ('asetaawese) bageletse ta`aameraatoce bamathaacaweme gizee <<yehe geletse degemete nawe>> 'alu
'eresu wada selaame yamithetharaa sikxone ba'alaahe laaye weshatene kaqathaathafa saweme yebalethe badalanyaa maane nawe? 'alaaheme badaayocene hhezeboce 'ayemaraame
ya'alaahene berehaane ba'afocaacawe liyaathafu yeshaalu 'alaaheme kahhaadiwocu bithalume 'enekwaa berehaanune galaache nawe
'eresu yaa 'agaariwocu bithalume maleketanyaawene bamameriyaa (matsehhafe) ba'ewenatanyaawe haayemaanoteme (baselaame) kahaayemaanote hulu balaaye yefaa liyaadaregawe yalaaka nawe
<<'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ka'asaamaami qethaate yametaadenaacehu yakxonacene negede laamalaaketaacehune?>> (balaacawe)
('ereswame) ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaawe taamenaalaacehu, ba'alaahe manegademe baganezabocaacehu banafesocaacehume tetaagalaalaacehu, yehe yametaawequ betekxonu la'enaaneta yatashaala nawe

xaathi'aatocaacehune la'enaaneta yemeraale kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacaweneme ganatoce yaagabaacexwaale bamanoriyaa ganatoceme bamiyaamaameru beetoce wesethe (yaaseqamethaacexwaale) yehe taalaaqe `edele nawe
leelaayetuneme yametewadwatene (tsagaa yesathaacexwaala) ka'alaahe yakxona 'eredaataanaa qerebe yakxona ya'agare makefate nawe me'emenaaneneme 'abesere

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! yamareyame leje `isaa lahhawaareyaatocu <<wada 'alaahe radaatee maanawe?>> 'enedaala hhawareyaatocume <<'enyaa ya'alaahe radaatoce nane>> 'enedaalute ya'alaahe radaatoce kxunu ka'eseraa'eeleme lejoce 'anedanyaawaa cheferaa 'amanace leelaayetume cheferaa kaadace 'enaziyaane yaamanuteneme bathalaataacawe laaye 'abarataanaacawe; 'ashanaafiwoceme kxonu
basamaayaate yaalawe bamedereme yaalawe hulu la'alaahe negusze, qeduse, 'ashanaafi, thebabanyaa lakxonawe yaamogesaale

'eresu yaa bamahaayemocu wesethe 'aneqatsocune (qure'aanene) ba'enaresu laaye yamiyaanabelaacawe, (kamaagaaraate) yamiyaatharaacaweme, matsehhafenenaa thebabene yamiyaasetameraacaweme yakxonane maleketanyaa (muhhamadene) ka'enaresuwe wesethe yalaaka nawe 'enaresume ka'eresu bafite bageletse sehhetate wesethe nabaru
kanasume leeloce ganaa yaaletathaguwaacawe bakxonute laaye (yalaakawe nawe) 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe
yehe ya'alaahe cerotaa nawe lamishaawe sawe yesathawaale 'alaaheme yataalaaqe cerotaa baalabeete nawe

ya'enaziyaa taweraatene yatachaanutenaa kaziyaame yaaletashakamwate (yaaleszarubaate) sawoce mesaalee matsehhafocene 'enedamishakame 'aheyaa bethee nawe ya'enaziyaa ba'alaahe 'aneqatsoce yaasetabaabalute hhezeboce mesaalee kafaa 'alaaheme badaayocene hhezeboce 'ayemaraame
<<'enaaneta 'ayehudaaweyaane yakxonaacehu hoye! kasawe hulu basetaqare 'enaaneta becaa la'alaahe wadaajoce nane betelu 'ewenatanyoce 'enedakxonaacehu motene tamanyu>> balaacawe
'ejocaacaweme baaseqadamute xaathi'ate mekeneyaate bafetsume 'ayemanyuteme 'alaaheme badaayocune `awaaqi nawe

<<yaa ka'eresu yameteshashute mote 'eresu ba'eregethe 'agenyaacehu nawe kaziyaame ruqunenaa qerebune `awaaqi wada kxonawe geetaa temalasaalaacehu teszaruteme yanabaraacehutene hulu yenageraacexwaale>> balaacawe
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ba`arebe qane lasegedate theri batadaraga gizee wada 'alaahe maawesaate kxidu mashatheneme tawu yehe yametaawequ betekxonu la'enaaneta bathaame yatashaala nawa
solatitume batafatsamace gizee bamedere laaye tabatanu ka'alaaheme cerotaa falegu 'alaaheneme babezu 'awesu letedenu yekajalaalenaa

negedene wayeme zaazaataane baayu gizeeme qomahe yatawuhe sikxonu wada'ereswa yebatanaalu 'alaahe zanede yaalawe waagaa kazaazaataame kanegedeme balaache nawe <<'alaaheme kasachiwocu hulu yebalethe sisaayene sache nawe>> balaacawe

manaafeqaane bamathuhe gizee <<'aneta ya'alaahe maleketanyaa makxonehene ba'eregethe (melane) 'enemasakeraalane>> yelaalu 'alaaheme 'aneta ba'eregethe maleketanyaawe makxonehene yaaweqaale 'alaaheme manaafeqaane (kalebe 'enemasakeraalane bamaalataacawe) weshataamoce makxonaacawene yemasakeraale
mahhaalocaacawene gaashaa 'aderegawe yaazu ka'alaaheme manegade kalakalu 'enaresu yeszarute yanabarute nagare kafaa
yehe 'enaresu (bamelaase) yaamanu kaziyaame (balebe) yakaadu bamakxonaacawe nawe balebocaacaweme laaye taatamabaacawe; selazihe 'enaresu 'ayaawequme

baayahaacaweme gizee 'akaalocaacawe (gezufenataacawe) yaasedanequhaale binaagarume lanegegeraacawe taadaamethaalahe; (ka`eweqate baado bamakxone) 'enaresu leke bagedegedaa yatathagu genedocene yemaselaalu chukxatene hulu ba'enaresu laaye nawe belawe yaasebaalu 'enaresu thalaatoce naacawenaa tathaneqaqaacawe 'alaahe yegaadalaacawe; (ka'emenate) 'enedeete yemalasaalu!
la'enasume - <<nu ya'alaahe maleketanyaa la'enaaneta mehheratene yelamenelaacexwaale;>> batabaalu gizee raasocaacawene yaazoraalu 'enaresume te`ebitanyoce kxonawe sishashu taayaacawaalahe
mehheratene betelamenelaacawe wayeme mehheratene baatelamenelaacawe ba'enaresu laaye 'ekule nawe 'alaahe la'enaresu bafetsume 'ayemereme 'alaahe 'amatsanyocene hhezeboce 'ayamaraamenaa

'enaresu 'enaziyaa - <<'alaahe maleketanyaa zanede laalute sawoce 'esekamibataatanu derase 'ateqalebu>> yamilu naacawe yasamaayaatenaa yamedere deleboceme ya'alaahe naacawe gene manaafeqaane 'ayaawequme
<<wada madinaa benemalase 'ashanaafiwe waraadaawene ba'eregethe ka'ereswa yaawathaale>> yelaalu 'ashanaafinateme la'alaahe, lamaleketanyaawenaa lame'emenaane nawe gene manaafeqaane 'ayaawequme
'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! ganezabocaacehunaa lejocaacehu 'alaahene kamaasetaawase 'ayaataaluwaacehu yeheneneme yamiszaru sawoce 'enaziyaa 'enaresu kasaariwoce naacawe

'anedaacehuneme mote saayemathaawenaa geetaayee hoye! 'enedematsawetenaa kadagaagwacume sawoce 'enedekxone wada theqite gizee betaaqoyanye noro 'emanyaalahu kamaalatu bafite kasathanaacehu sisaaye lagesu
maanenyaayetume nafese yamote gizeewaa bamathaabate gizee 'alaahe bafetsume 'ayaaqoyaateme 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe
basamaayaate wesethe yaalawe bamedereme wesethe yaalawe hulu la'alaahe yaamogesaale negeszenaawe ya'eresu becaa nawe mesegaanaame la'eresu nawe 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
'eresu yaa yafatharaacehu nawe ka'enaanetame kahhaadi 'alela ka'enaanetame 'amaanye 'alela 'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu tamalekaace nawe
samaayaatenenaa mederene ba'ewenate fathara qaratsaacehume qeretsaacehuneme 'asaamara mamalashaacehume wada'eresu nawe
basamaayaatenaa bamedere wesethe yaalawene hulu yaaweqaale yametedabequteneme yametegalethuteneme yaaweqaale 'alaaheme baleboce wesethe yaalawene hulu `awaaqi nawe
ya'enaziyaa ka'ahune bafite yakaadutenaa yakehhedataacawene qethaate qemasu yatabaalute hhezeboce waree 'alemathaalaacehumene? la'enasume 'asaamaami qethaate 'alelaacawe

yehe (qethaate) 'eresu maleketanyocaacawe ba'aserajiwoce yemathubaacawe sela nabaru <<sawoceme yemarunaalene?>> selaalunaa selakaadu (ka'emenate) sela zorume nawe 'alaaheme (ka'enasu 'emenate) tabeqaaqaa 'alaaheme tabeqaaqi mesegune nawe

'enaziyaa yakaadutene bafetsume yamaayeqasasu makxonaacawene 'asabu <<'ayedalame bageetaayee 'emelaalahu ba'eregethe teqasaqasaalaacehu kaziyaame baszaraacehute hulu tenagaraalaacehu yeheme ba'alaahe laaye qalaale nawe >> balaacawe
ba'alaahenaa bamaleketanyaaweme baziyaame baawaradenawe berehaane 'emanu <<'alaaheme bameteszarute hulu wesetha `awaaqi nawe>> (balaacawe)

lamasabesabiyaa qane yamisabasebebaacehune qane ('asetaawesu); yehe yamagodaadaate (magelachaa) qane nawe ba'alaaheme yamiyaamene sawe malekaameneme yamiszaraa karesu xaathi'atocune yesareyelataale; (yefeqelataale); kaszerocaacaweme wanezoce yamifasubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zala`aalame zawetaariwoce sikxonu yaagabaawaale; yehe taalaaqe maagenyate nawe
'enaziyaame yakaadunaa ba'aneqatsocaacene yaasetabaabalu 'enaziyaa bawesethu zawetaariwoce sikxonu ya'esaate gwaadoce naacawe; mamalashaacaweme kafaa!
kamakaraame (maaneneme) 'ayenakaame ba'alaahe faqaade bikxone 'eneje; ba'alaaheme yamiyaamene sawe lebune (late`egesete) yemaraawaale; 'alaaheme nagarune hulu `awaaqi nawe
'alaaheneme tagazu; maleketanyaaweneme taazazu; betezorume (maleketanyaawene 'ategodume); bamaleketanyaaweme laaye yaalabate geletse maaderase becaa nawe
'alaahe karesu baqare 'amelaake yalame; ba'alaaheme laaye 'amaanyocu yemaku

'elaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! kamisetocaacehunaa kalejocaacehu (ka'alaahe manegade bamaasetagwaagole) lanaaneta thalaatoce yakxonu 'alelu; selazihe tathaneqaqwaacawe; yeqeretaa betaadaregu betaalefwacaweme betameruwaacaweme 'alaahe bathaame mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
ganezabocaacehunaa lejocaacehu lanaaneta mafatanyaa becaa naacawe; 'alaaheme 'eresu zanede taalaaqe menedaa 'alela

'alaaheneme yacaalaacehutene yakele ferute; te`ezaazune semume; taazazume; lagesume; lanafesocaacehu malekaamene (yesathaacexwaalenaa); yanafesuneme nefegate yamithabaqe sawe 'enaziyaa 'enasu felaagotaacawene yamiyaaganyu naacawe
la'alaahe malekaame bederene betaabaderu (menedaawene) lanaaneta yedaraarebawaale; lanaanetame yemeraale; 'alaaheme 'amasegaanye taagaashe nawe
ruqune mesethire geletsuneme hulu `awaaqiwe 'ashanaafiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

'aneta nabiyu hoye! seetocene mafetaate baasabaacehu gizee; la`idaacawe fetuwaacawe `idaaneme qutharu 'alaaheneme geetaacehune feru geletse yakxonacene thayaafe kaaleszaru basetaqare kabeetocaacawe 'ataawethuwaacawe; 'ayewethume yeheceme ya'alaahe hhegegaate naate ya'alaaheneme hhegegaate yatalaalafa sawe ba'eregethe nafesune badala kazihe (fece) baxwaalaa 'alaahe (yamamaalase) nagarene menaalebaate yaamathaa 'enedakxona 'ataaweqeme

gizeeyaacaweneme lamadaarase bataqaarabu gizee bamalekaame yaazuwaacawe wayeme bamalekaame talayaayuwaacawe ka'enaanetame wesethe hulate yatekekelanyaanate baalabeetocene 'asemasekeru mesekerenateneme la'alaahe 'asetakaakelu yehe ba'alaahenaa bamacharashaawe qane yamiyaamene yakxona sawe hulu ba'eresu yegasatsebataale 'alaaheneme yamifaraa sawe la'eresu mawechaane yaadaregelataale
kamaayaasebaweme bakule sisaayane yesathawaale ba'alaaheme laaye yamithagaa sawe 'eresu baqiwe nawe 'alaahe faqaadune 'aderaashe nawe 'alaahe lanagaru hulu yatawasana gizeene ba'eregethe 'aderegwaale

'eniyaame kaseetocaacawe ka'adafe yaaqwaarathute (ba`idaacawe hhege) betetharaatharu `idaacawe szosete ware nawe 'eniyaame ganaa 'adafene yaalaayute (`idaacawe 'enedazihu nawe) ya'eregezenaa baalabeetoceme gizeeyaacawe 'ereguzaacawene mawelade nawe 'alaaheneme yamifaraa sawe kanagaru hulu laresu mageraatene yaadaregelataale
yehe ya'alaahe ferede nawe wada'enaaneta 'awaradawe 'alaaheneme yamifaraa sawe xathi'aatocune ka'eresu yesareyelataale menedaaneme la'eresu yaataleqelataale

kacelotaacehu kataqamathaacehubate seferaa 'aseqamethwacawe ba'enaresume laaye letaathaabebu 'ategudwacawe ya'eregezenaa baalabeetoceme bikxonu 'ereguzaacawene 'esekiwaledu derase ba'enaresu laaye qalebu la'enaanetame (lejocaacehune) biyaathabulaacehu menedaawocaacawene sethwacawe bamakaakalaacehume bamalekaame nagare tamakaakaru betecagaagarume la'eresu leelaa (seete) taathabaalataalace

yacelotaa baalabeete kacelotaawe yeqalebe ba'eresume laaye sisaayu yatathabababate sawe 'alaahe kasathawe yeqalebe 'alaahe nafesene yasathaatene 'eneje 'ayaasegadedeme 'alaahe kacegere baxwaalaa mecotene ba'eregethe yaadaregaale
kakatamaame kageetaawaa te`ezaaze kamaleketanyocume yaamatsace, beretuneme quthethere yataqothaatharenaate, mathefoneme qethaate yaqathaanaate bezu naate
yanagarewaaneme qethaate qamasace yanagarewaame macharashaa kasaaraa kxona

'alaahe la'enaresu beretune qethaate 'azagaaja 'enaanetame ya'a'emero baalabeetoce hoye! 'alaahene feru 'enaziyaa yaamanu (hoye)! 'alaahe wadanaaneta gesaatseene ba'eregethe 'awarada maleketanyaane (laaka)

'enaziyaane yaamanutenenaa malekaamocene yaszarutene kachalamaawoce wada berehaane yaawathaa zanede ya'alaahene 'aneqatsoce galaachoce sikxonu ba'enaaneta laaye yamiyaanabelaacehune (laaka) ba'alaaheme 'aneqatsoce yamiyaamene, malekaamene szeraa yamiszaraame kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasesubaacawene ganatoce bawesethaacawe zala`aalame zawetaariwoce sikxonu yaagabaawaale 'alaahe la'eresu sisaayene ba'eregethe 'asaamara

'alaahe yaa sabaatene samaayaate yafathara nawe kamedereme masalaacawene (fathero'ale); bamakaakalaacawe te'ezaazu yewaredaale 'alaahe banagaru hulu laaye caaye makxonune 'alaaheme banagaru hulu ba`eweqate yaakaababa makxonune ba`eweqate yaakaababa makxonune taawaqu zanede (yehenene 'asaawaqaacehu)
'aneta nabiyu hoye! 'alaahe la'aneta yafaqadalehene nagare misetocehene maasewadadene yametefalege setekxone (baaneta laaye) lamene 'ereme taadaregaalahe? 'alaaheme 'ejege mahhaari 'azaanye nawe
'alaahe la'enaaneta yamahhaalocaacehune mafecaa danagagalaacehu 'alaaheme radaataacehu nawe 'eresume `awaaqiwe thebabanyaawe nawe

nabiyu kamisetocu wada 'anedwa wareene bamasathara gizee ('asetaawese) 'eresuneme banagaracenaa 'alaahe 'eresune (maaweraatewaane) baasaawaqawe gizee kafilune 'asetaawaqa kafiluneme tawa ba'eresume baawaraate gizee <<yehene maane nagarahe?>> 'alace <<`awaaqiwe wesetha `awaaqiwe nagaranye>> 'alaate;

wada 'alaahe betemalasu lebocaacehu ba'eregethe tazanebelawaalenaa (tesemaamaalaacehu) ba'eresume laaye beteradaadu 'alaahe 'eresu radaatu nawe jiberileme kame'emenaaneme malekaamu kaziheme baxwaalaa malaa'eketu radaatocu naacawe

(malaacehuneme) bifataacehu ka'enaaneta yabalathu misetocene muselimoce, 'amaanyoce, taazaazhoce, tatsatsaacoce, (la'alaahe) tagazhiwoce, tsomanyaawoce fatoce, danaageleme yakxonutene geetaawe lilawethawe yekajalaale

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! nafesocaacehunenaa beetasabocaacehune maqathaathayaawaa sawocenaa danegaayoce kakxonace 'esaate thabequ ba'ereswa laaye chakaanyoce, xayelanyoce yakxonu malaa'ekete 'alelu 'alaahene yaazazaacawene nagare (bamathaase) 'ayaametsume yamitaazazuteneme hulu yeszaraalu
'elaaneta yakaadaacehu hoye! zaaree 'ataamakaanyu yametemanadute yaanene teszarute yanabaraacehutene becaa nawe (yebaalaalu)

'enaaneta yaamanaacehu hoye! netsuhhe yakxonacene tsatsate bamatsatsate wada 'alaahe tamalasu geetaacehu ka'enaaneta xathi'aatocaacehune lisareyelaacehu kaszerocaacawe wanezoce yamifasubaacaweneme ganatoce liyaasegabaacehu yekajalaalenaa 'alaahe nabiyune, 'enaziyaaneme ka'eresu gaare yaamanutene bamaayaasaaferebate qane berehaanaacawe bafitocaacawenaa baqanyocaacawe yamirothe sikxone <<geetaacene hoye! berehaanaacenene mulaalene, la'enyaa mehherateme 'aderegelene, 'aneta banagaru hulu laaye caaye nahenaa>> yelaalu
'aneta nabiyu hoye! kahhaadiwocenenaa manaafeqaanene taagale ba'enaresume laaye baretaa manoriyaacaweme gahaname naate mene tekafaame mamalashaa!

'alaahe la'enaziyaa lakaadute sawoce yanuhhene seetenaa yaluthene seete mesaalee 'adaraga kabaarocaacene kakxonu hulate malekaame baariyaawoce szere nabaru kaduwaacaweme ka'alaaheme (qethaate nuhhenaa luthe) kamisetocaacawe meneme 'alegafatarulaacaweme kagabiwocume gaare <<'esaatene gebu>> tabaalu

la'enaziyaa la'amanuteme yafare'onene seete 'alaahe mesaalee 'adaraga <<geetaayee hoye! 'aneta zanede baganate wesethe la'enee beetene ganebaalenye kafare`onenaa kaszeraaweme 'adenanye kabadalanyocu hhezeboceme 'adenanye>> baalace gizee

ya`imeraanene leje mareyameneme yaacene beletwane yathabaqacewene (mesaalee 'adaraga) ba'eresume wesethe kamanefasaacene nafefaane bageetaawaa qaalaatenaa bamatsaahhefetume 'aragaagathace kataazaazhocume nabarace
yaa negeszenaa ba'eju yakxonawe 'amelaake cerotaawe bazaa 'eresume banagaru hulu laaye caaye nawe
yaa yatenyaacehu szeraawe yebalethe yaamaara makxonune limokeraacehu motenenaa hheyewatene yafathara nawe 'eresume 'ashanaafiwe mahhaariwe nawe
yaa sabaatene samaayaate yatanabaabaru kxonawe yafathara nawe ba'alerahhemaane 'afathaathare wesethe meneme mazaanafene 'ataayeme `aayeneheneme malese <<kasenetheqoce 'anedaacene taayaalahene?>>
kaziyaame bezu gizee `aayenehene malaalese `aayenehe tawaaredo 'eresume yadakama kxono wadaaneta yemalasaale
qerebitune samaayeme ba'eregethe bamaberaatoce (bakawaakebete) 'ageethenaate lasayethaanaateme maqatheqachaawoce 'adaragenaate la'enaresume (lasayethaanoce) ya'esaatene qethaate 'azagaajane
la'enaziyaame bageetaacawe lakaadute yagahaname qethaate 'alelaacawe mamalashaayetume kafaace!
bawesethwa batathaalu gizee; 'ereswa yametefalaa setekxone la'ereswa ('eneda 'aheyaa) maanaafaatene yesamaalu
kaquchetewaa yatanasaa leteqoraarathe teqarebaalace bawesethwa cheferoce batathaalu quthere zabanyocewaa <<'asefaraari (nabiye) 'alemathaacehumene?>> bamaalate yethayeqwaacawaale
<<'ayedalame ba'eregethe 'asefaraari mathetonaale 'asetabaabaleneme 'alaaheme meneneme 'alaawarada 'enaaneta ('aweredwale setelu) bateleqe sehetate wesethe 'eneje 'ayedalaacehume 'alene>> yelaalu
<<yamenesamaa wayeme yamenaasebe banabareneme noro banadaaje 'esaate gwaadoce wesethe baalekxone nabare>> yelaalu
baxathi'aataacaweme yaamenaalu la'esaate gwaadoceme (ka'ezenate) maraaqe tagabaacawe
'enaziyaa geetaacawene baruqu yamifaru la'enaresu mehheratenaa taalaaqe menedaa 'alelaacawe
(sawoce hoye!) qaalaacehuneme masetheru wayeme ba'eresu chuhu 'eresu baleboce wesethe yaalane hulu `awaaqi nawe
yafathara 'amelaake 'eresu `eweqate raqiqu, wesethe `awaaqiwe sikxone (mesethirene hulu) 'ayaaweqemene?
'eresu yaa mederene la'enaaneta yatagaraace yaadaragalaacehu nawe bagaaraawocewaanaa bamanegadocewaame kxidu kasisaayume belu (xwaalaa) mamalashaaweme wada'eresu becaa nawe
basamaaye wesethe yaalane (saraawite) ba'enaaneta mederene bidarabaabaacehu wadiyaaweme 'ereswa yametaaragarege betekxone tetamaamanaalaacehune? ('atefarumene?)
wayeme basamaaye wesethe yaalane ba'enaaneta laaye thatharene yaazalace nafaasene bilekebaacehu tetamaamanaalaacehune? ('atefarumene?) maasethaneqaqeeme 'enedeete 'enedakxona wadafite taaweqaalaacehu
'enaziyaame ka'enaresu bafite yanabarute ba'eregethe 'asetabaabalu thelaacaayeeme 'enedeete nabare!

wada 'a'ewaafe kabalaayaacawe kenefocaacawene zaregetawe tanesaafaafiwoce yamisabasabume sikxonu 'alaayumene? ka'alerahhemaane baqare (baayare laaye) yamiyezaacawe yalame 'eresu banagaru hulu tamalekaace nawe
ba'ewenatu yaa 'eresu ka'alerahhemaane leelaa yamiradaacehu la'enaaneta yakxona saraawite maanawe? kahhaadiwoce bamataalale wesethe 'eneje baleelaa laaye 'ayedalume
wayeme sisaayune biyezebaacehu yaa sisaayene yamisathaacehu maanawe? ba'ewenatu 'enaresu bamogadenaa bamadanebare wesethe ceke 'alu
bafitu laaye tadafeto yamikxeede sawe yebalethe yaqanaa nawene? wayese baqathetanyaa manegade laaye tasetakaakelo yamikxeede?
<<'eresu yaa yafatharaacehu la'enaanetame masemiyaanaa maayaawocene, leboceneme yaadaragalaacehu nawe theqiteneme 'ataamasegenume>> balaacawe
<<'eresu yaa bamedere laaye yabatanaacahu nawe wada'eresume tesabasabaalaacehu>> balaacawe
<<'ewenatanyoceme 'enedakxonaacehu yehe qatharo macee nawe?>> yelaalu
<<`eweqatu 'alaahe zanede becaa nawe 'enee geletse 'asefaraari 'eneje leelaa 'ayedalahume>> balaacawe
(qethaatune) qerebe kxono baayuteme gizee ya'enaziyaa yakaadute sawoce fitoce yekekafaalu <<yehe yaa ba'eresu tekaraakarubate yanabaraacehute nawe>> yebaalaalume
<<'ayaacehune? 'alaahe bigadelanye ka'enee gaare yaaluteneme ('enedazihu) wayeme (bamaaqoyate) biyaazenelene kahhaadiwocene ka'asaamaami qethaate yamiyaadene maane nawe?>> balaacawe

<<'eresu ('emanubate yamelaacehu) 'alerahhemaane nawe ('enyaa) ba'eresu 'amanene baresume laaye tathagaane wada fiteme bageletse masaasaate wesethe yakxonawe 'eresu maane 'aneda kxona ba'eregethe taaweqaalaacehu>> balaacawe
<<'ayaacehune? wehaacehu szaraagi bikxone fasaashine wehaa yamiyaamathaalaacahu maane nawe?>> balaacawe ('alaahe ya`aalamaate geetaa yaamathaawaale)
na.(nune); babere'e 'emelaalahu baziyaame (male'akoce) bamitsefute
'aneta bageetaahe tsagaa yatagonaatsafeke setekxone `ebede 'ayedalaheme
laanetame (kageetaahe) yamaayeqwaarathe waagaa ba'eregethe 'alelahe
'anetame bataalaaqe thabaaye laaye nahe
wadafiteme taayaalahe; yaayaalume
`ebedate bamaanenyaacehu 'enedaalela
geetaahe 'eresu kamanegadu yatasaasaatawene sawe `awaaqi nawe 'eresume tamariwocune `awaaqi nawe
la'asetabaabaayoceme 'atetaazezu
betemasaasalaacawenaa bimasaasaluhe tamanyu
waraadaaneme hulu 'atetaazaze
sawene 'anawaarinenaa bamaasaabaqe kxeeyaajene
labago nagare bathaame kalekaayene, wasane 'alaafine, xaathi'atanyaane;
leba daraqene, kazihe baxwaalaa diqaalaane (hulu 'atetaazaze)
yaganezabenaa yalejoce baalabeete bamakxonu (yaasetabaabelaale)
ba'eresu laaye 'aneqatsocaacene baminababu gizee <<yamajamariyaawocu sawoce taratoce naacawe>> yelaale
ba'afenechaawe laaye ba'eregethe (yaminawarebate) melekete 'enaadaregebataalane
'enyaa ya'atekeletitune baalabeetoca 'eneda mokarene (yamakaane sawoce) mokarenaacawe maaledawe (fereewaane) lilaqemwate bamaalu gizee
(bamahhaalaacawe) 'ayaaseqarumeme
'enaresu yatanyu kxonaweme saalu kageetaahe yakxona zwari ba'ereswa laaye zorabaate
'eneda leelite chalamaame kxonaa 'anagaace; (kasalace)
yaanagume kxonawe tatharaaru
<<qoraachoce 'eneda kxonaacehu ba'ereshaacahu laaye maaledu>> bamaalate
'enaresu yamineshokaashoku kxonawe kxeedume
zaaree ba'enaaneta laaye dekxaa 'enedaayegabaate bamaalate
(dekxocene) bamakalekaleme laaye (bahhasaabaacawe) caayoce kxonawe maaladu
(taqaathelaa) baayuwaateme gizee <<'enyaa ba'eregethe tasaasaacoce nane>> 'alu
<<yelequneme 'enyaa yatakalakalene nane>> 'alu
tekekelanyaacawe <<la'enaaneta 'alaahene lamene 'ataatharume 'alaalekwaacehumene?>> 'alaacawe
<<geetaacene theraate yegabaawe 'enyaa badaayoce nabarene;>> 'alu
yamiwaqaaqasume kxonawe kafilocaacawe bakafilu laaye mathu
<<waa thefaataacene! 'enyaa denebare 'alaafiwoce nabarene;>> 'alu
<<geetaacene ka'ereswa yatashaalane ('atekelete) lilawethane yekajalaale 'enyaa wada geetaacene kajaayoce nane;>> ('alu)
qethaatu 'enedazihu nawe yamacharashaayetume `aalame qethaate taalaaqe nawe yamiyaawequte bakxonu noro (batathanaqaqu nabare)
lathenequqocu bageetaacawe zanede mathaqamiyaa ganatoce 'alwacawe
muselimocune 'eneda kahhaadiwoce 'enaadaregaalane?
la'enaaneta mene ('aseraje) 'alaacehu? 'enedeete tefaredaalaacehu
ba'ewenatu la'enaaneta ba'eresu yametaathanubate matsehhafe 'alaacehune?
bawesethu la'enaaneta yametemarethute 'alaacehu (yamile)
